chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome. There are topics listed below.  Please choose from them by clicking REPLY to the right for more information.

replies.reply_text: I am new.  Please give me a general outline of this game.
How can I make money?
How can I get a horse?
What is the drop-down box by the chat box?
What is the Shovel/Magnifying Glass/Binoculars/Rake for?
How do arena competitions work?
Is there a faster way to get around?
How can I improve my horses' abilities?
How do I get a ranch?
Chat Rules
The moderators don't do anything!
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Walk around using arrow keys.  The map at the upper left is a vast overview.  You can only see other players and buildings.  Horses and objects cannot be seen unless they are 'at' the same spot as you.  So you need to explore the map by walking around.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Lots of ways!  Find objects in woods or beaches and sell them at a shop. Performing jobs (mini-games) when asked, and completing quests when offered are just a few of the ways to earn money.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find a wild horse by walking around the different areas of Horse Isle.  When a horse is on the same 'spot' as you, they will show up in this window.  No wild horses will be in the towns.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: What is selected in the drop-down box will determine who can see your chat.

replies.reply_text: Explain CHAT NEAR
Explain CHAT BUDDIES
Explain CHAT HERE
Explain the names in the box.
Explain CHAT ISLAND
Explain ADS CHAT
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the screen can hear you with CHAT NEAR.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just those on your buddy list will see your chat with CHAT BUDDIES.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the same square as you will see your chat with CHAT HERE.  This is especially useful when in art rooms, such as the drawing room or poetry room.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The names in the drop down box are of those people currently online.  You can pick any of those names and only that person will see your chat.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: These objects are used for quests.  Residents may ask you to find something for them, or look for clues.  These objects will be needed to finish many of the quests on Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Where can I get these objects?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: These objects are permanently in your tool box.  Simply push the wrench in the lower right hand corner to open up the tool box, then click whichever tool you need to use.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The arenas let you compete, using one of your horses, with other players in the game.  There is a starting time to each event, so once your horse is entered, you need to wait until the event starts.

replies.reply_text: Do I need to stay in the arena after I have entered?
What does my horse need in order to compete?
What do I need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  When it is time for the competition to start, it will just pop up in your window no matter where you are.

replies.reply_text: What does my horse need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Your horse needs to be fed, watered, not too tired, have horse shoes on, healthy, and fully tacked in order to compete.

replies.reply_text: How do I know if my horse is ready to compete?
Do I need to stay in the arena after I have entered?
What do I need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't need anything other than what your horse needs.  You can, however, have some competition clothes on.  Any of these items can be found in the clothing stores in the different towns.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: When you look at your horse, there are stat bars that will tell you how their health, hunger, etc is.  Those need to be above 200.  Below the stats bar, it will show you what tack your horse is wearing.  It should have a saddle, saddle pad, and bridle on.

replies.reply_text: Where do I get everything for my horse?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The different towns have the stores and services needed to get your horse all ready for competition.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: If you have a horse that is fully tacked, you may ride it around.  That allows you to move faster.  Also, there are wagons that go between towns, and boats that go between islands.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: There are trainers located in different towns around Horse Isle.  They will train your horse for $1000, but you can only train your horse once during that game day.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Ranches are very expensive, so you need to save up a lot of money in order to buy one.  Some of them vary in price, but they are all the same.  There is no advantage to buying a more expensive one...  Except maybe for the location.

replies.reply_text: How do I get money?
What is a ranch good for once I buy one?
Where are the ranches?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The ranch building itself rests you, you can pick up your mail, and it determines how many out-buildings you can have.  Each of the different out-buildings have different bonuses.

replies.reply_text: Explain the barn.
Explain the shed.
Explain the water well.
Explain the grain silo.
Explain the trainer.
Explain the windmill.
Explain the flower garden.
Explain the wagon.
Explain the vegetable garden.
Explain the big barn.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: All ranches are on the mainland of Horse Isle, Tail Isle, or Starfish Isle.  The ones on the mainland are mostly below Earton.

replies.reply_text: What is a ranch good for once I buy one?
How do I get money to buy one?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Having a barn allows you to have three more horses.  You can have an unlimited number of barns on your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The shed allows you to carry 20 more items in your inventory.  You can only have up to two sheds on your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The water well waters you and your horses when you stop into your ranch.  It really doesn't pay to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The grain silo will feed all your horses when you stop in your ranch.  It really doesn't pay to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The trainer trains all of your horses for free, one point in all of their stats once per game day.  This is only done when you click on the trainer and tell it to train all of your horses.  Since training can only be done once every two hours, there is no reason to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The windmill earns you $500 every 12 game hours.  You can have as many on your ranch as you want.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The flower garden is just for looks.  Nothing else.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The wagon will take you to the nearest wagon station for free.  This also allows for free wagon transportation around the isles.  It really does no good to have more than one at your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The vegetable garden feeds you whenever you stop at your ranch.  There is really no reason to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Swearing is pretty straight-forward.  Offensive/inflammatory language includes, but is not limited to, racist remarks, pushing religion, political statements, ethnic stereotypes, etc.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Here is a list of the basic rules for chat conduct.  Click REPLY for an explanation.

replies.reply_text: No swearing or offensive/inflammatory language.
No date-speak.
No cheating the filter.
No sharing or asking for personal information.
No chat spamming/flooding the chat.
No use of all caps.
No ruining the fun for others.
Use the Ads Chat for any advertising.
No giving out passwords or riddle answers in global or island chat.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: No looking for a girl/boy friend or any other chat that is related to relationships.  This is not a dating site.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The filter is set up for a reason.  Some words are flagged, while others are changed.  Do not do anything to purposely cheat the filter.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This includes age, email address, phone number, home address or city that you live in.  This also includes screen names for messengers and websites such as Myspace.  No advertising other sites.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Chat spam is typing nonsense just taking up space.  It is also pasting the same thing multiple times in a row.  This applies to socials and buddy-adding as well.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: All caps is considered yelling and rude.  It is fine to have one or two words in all caps in order to emphasize the word in a sentence, but not all.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This includes harassing/bullying/name calling.  This also includes tricking other players out of horses, items or money.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This allows different people to see your advertisement when they want to buy or sell horses.  Also, people can mute this channel if they don't want to see it.  This channel is set so each player can only post once per minute.  This prevents spamming of ads.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The moderators handle most everything in private messages, so most players will never actually see them handling problems.  Please feel free to help players with questions in the game and such, but let the mods handle the problems.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Many people want to solve these on their own.  If someone blurts it out where they can see it, it ruins the fun for them.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the same island as you can hear you chat on CHAT ISLAND.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This is where all advertising should occur.  Posts can be seen by anyone that hasn't muted it.  All players are limited to one post per minute.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The big barn allows you to hold an extra 6 horses instead of the normal barn, which only allows for 3 more horses.  You may have as many big barns on your ranch as you want.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

npc_list.name: Mary Molasses
npc_list.long_description: Mary Molasses is sweet, outgoing and energetic. Horses and people love to be around her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Any other horse stores around here?
What feed is the best bargain?
No thanks, just looking around.
Not really, but do you have something to do to pass the time?
Yes, actually, Ted Capocella sent me.  He said you should have some hay ready for him?
What was I doing for you again?
I have those bales you needed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nearest one would be in Treeton, but I have some great deals!

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me which feed is the best bargain?
Thank you for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hay is cheap and a little filling, while oats are expensive, but very filling.  It's a toss-up between them.

replies.reply_text: Any other horse stores around here?
Do you happen to have any free samples?
Thanks much for the advice!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  Here take this Horsie Treat.

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually I do!  For a $1,000 entry fee, would you like to try your hand at a simple horse quiz? If you can answer all my questions, I'll give you $50,000.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I don't think I know enough about horses yet.
Sure, I'd love to give it a whirl. (Hand her $1000.)
Maybe some other time.
Yeah, I'm ready!
I think I should go study, maybe next time.  You can keep my $1000, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: First Question: Where does the Azteca originate from?

replies.reply_text: Brazil
Mexico
India
England

chatpoints.chat_text: INCORRECT!  That was not the correct answer.  I'm sorry,  but I have won this challenge.  Try again sometime if you would like!

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll come back after I've studied in the library!
Maybe I'll get it next time!
Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Second Question: How deep can the Bashkir Curly dig for its food?

replies.reply_text: 1 foot
4 inches
2 meters
3 feet

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct again! Third Question: When was the National Show Horse first developed?
Correct! Fourth Question: The Welsh Cob can sustain what gait for long distances?

replies.reply_text: Canter
Trot
Gallop
Piaffe

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct once again! Fifth Question: What breed’s lines were added to the French Trotter to make it a faster horse?

replies.reply_text: Thoroughbred
Welsh Mountain Pony
National Show Horse
Standardbred

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Sixth Question: What was the original Knabstrup’s height?

replies.reply_text: 16.3 hands high
12.2 hands high
14.3 hands high
15.2 hands high

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Seventh Question: What was the Suffolk Punch originally bred for?

replies.reply_text: Plowing
Trail Riding
Dressage
Jumping

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct again! Eighth Question: Which of these were NOT crossed to create the Gelderland?

replies.reply_text: Friesian
Appaloosa
Oldenburg
Hackney

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Ninth Question: The Missouri Fox Trotter is most frequently used by whom?

replies.reply_text: Farmers
Carriage Drivers
Jumping Competitors
Forest Rangers

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Final Question: The Friesian was an ancestor of what breed?

replies.reply_text: Fell Pony
Exmoor Pony
Caspian
Dartmoor Pony
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I did have his hay ready, however I thought he had forgotten and I sold it this morning.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  Is there anything I can do?  He really needs that hay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you can get me three more bales I could put back what I had to sell.

replies.reply_text: I don't have time right now.  I'll be back later.
I suppose I could do that.  Where should I get the hay?
That doesn't sound too hard.  I'll be back as soon as I have them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need three more bales of hay to complete Ted's order.  You should be able to build them by the jumping arenas to the north of here.

replies.reply_text: I remember now.  I'll be back soon.
Thanks, you too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there... Don't see many people in these woods...

replies.reply_text: Why are you named Twig?
What are you doing in the woods?
Later Twig...
I'm back! And I have something from your sister.
Help me out here, Twig. I think I was supposed to be doing something for you, but I can't remember what it was.
Hi, Twig. I'm on an errand for Mino and he needs some moss and lichen.
Hi Twig!  Mehitabel asked me to find Archy, and Tobias said he was coming to see you.  I don't suppose he's still around?
Sorry to bother you again, Twig, but where did Archy go again, after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, err, it's not my real name... It's just my nickname 'cause I like the forest so much!

replies.reply_text: Okay...   What are you doing in the forest?
Later, Twig. I'm going to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm searching for the very rare red pine cones!  I'll pay you $1000 if you ever find one!

replies.reply_text: I've got one to give you!
Well, good luck with that!  Bye!
Aren't you lonely out here by yourself?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?

replies.reply_text: I actually have another one to give you!
Thanks. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Lonely? I guess a bit. I do miss my sister Daf. I haven't seen her since she moved to Wington.

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do to help?
Oh, dear. This sounds too personal. I'd rather stay out of it. See you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: If you wouldn't mind, could you take her these yellow roses? She loves daffodils, but I don't know where to get any of those.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to take roses to her.
I just don't think I'm up for island jumping right now. Sorry!
Where did you say I could find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: She lives in the north part of Wington.

replies.reply_text: Great! I'll be back in a jiffy.
I've got to get going now. Enjoy your new pet!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did she like the roses?

replies.reply_text: She loved them! And look at the goldfish she sent back for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were taking roses to my sister Daf in Wington, remember?

replies.reply_text: Got it! I'll get right to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? I mean, well, I like the moss and lichen here very much. It adds a lot of character to the trees, and of course, you always know which direction is north from looking at it, but I'm curious why Mino would want it.

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and how hummingbirds need it for their nests.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that certainly explains it. Let me fill up a basket for you. Wait here a minute.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that.
I'm sure it'll be perfect. Thanks so much. This will mean a lot to Mino.
Looks like I'm on my way to Treeton.  Thanks, Twig. See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're no bother. Archy was heading to Treeton when he left.

replies.reply_text: Treeton for the oats, now I remember.  Thanks Twig!

npc_list.name: Sera
npc_list.long_description: Sera is so wrapped up it's hard to see what she looks like. Her voice sounds friendly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  My name is Sera!  Welcome to my igloo.  How do you like Snow Isle?

replies.reply_text: It's okay, are there any other cool places to go up here?
I hate it here!  It's so cold! I'm going south!
I love this place!  There are snowballs everywhere!
I heard I can have a free nap and free cocoa?
It's okay.  A bit cold, though.
It's freezing up here! I hear that Winter Lotus blossoms grow up here. Have you seen any around?
Hello Sera, do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, if you travel up to Santa's workshop, you can wrap any object and turn it into a present.

replies.reply_text: Wow! That's really cool, I'm going to go try it out right now.
But I don't GET a present?  Eh, that's no fun.  See ya later.
That's neat.  Brrr!  It's cold!  Do you have anything warm to drink?

chatpoints.chat_text: Christmas Isle is nearby, if you haven't seen it already.

replies.reply_text: Christmas Isle? All year round?  Are there presents?
Well, what kind of Christmas Island is this?  I'm leaving!
Oh, okay.  I'll just have some cocoa.
Yawn!  I'm sleepy, I think I'll take a nap.
Thanks!
Whew!  I've had so much cocoa I'm going to burst!  I better go!
Now I'm sleepy.  I think I'll take a nap.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm glad you like it here!

replies.reply_text: It's very nice, but I'm kind of thirsty, can I have something to drink?
Yawn!  I'm sleepy.  I think I'll take a nap now.
What are you talking about!  I hate this place, I'm leaving!
ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............

chatpoints.chat_text: So....  Are you going to wake up now?

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
Huh?  Wuh?  Did you say something?
Well, now I am.  That was pretty rude, I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey!  You're kind of boring.

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
(Sleepily.) Sugar plum fairy... sugar plum fairy... Zzzzzzzz

chatpoints.chat_text: Pay attention to meee!!!!

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
(Sleepily.) A monkey stole my horsie... Come back Mr. Giggles... come... back... Zzzz
Huh?  Wuh?  Did you say something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhhh!  Stop it!  I can't handle it anymore!

replies.reply_text: What's wrong with you! You must be crazy!!
I'm sorry, I did sleep for a long time, but you seem a little stressed out, so I'm going to go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  You think I'm crazy?

replies.reply_text: YES!  I'm leaving.
Ummm.... No.... It's... uh...... great here....
No, you're just a little lonely all the way up here, but I'm going now.  Thanks for the nap!
No, just lonely. I would be, too.  Could I have some cocoa now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, um, nope!  You can go back to sleep, if you want!

replies.reply_text: Oh, great!
No, I think I'll get going now, c'ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, it is.  But you sort of get used to it.  Having a good coat helps, too.

replies.reply_text: A coat would probably help fight off the cold.
I'm sure it does.  Well, off I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: You bet!  Speaking of coats, there's a man down on Desert Isle that was supposed to send me up some, but I haven't heard from him.  Leroy is his name.

replies.reply_text: Desert Isle is a long way away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure is, and I don't like the heat, else I'd go down there and get the coats myself.  Hey, maybe you could go get them!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I could!
Umm, I really don't want to run down to Desert Isle right now.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  He lives down on the southern part of the isle, between Santon and Hotton.  It's a long trip, so you better get going!

replies.reply_text: Right.  I'll be off right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: I got those coats from Leroy for you!
Is there anything else to do around here?
Can I have a free nap and some cocoa?
This place is just so great!
I'm way too cold!  I'm outta here!
I was supposed to pick up coats for you...  Where was that again?
I hear that Winter Lotus blossoms grow up here. Have you seen any around?
Hello Sera, do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?
Thanks so much!  I'm glad I could be such help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right.  Come again.  You can have that free cocoa or nap anytime you want!
Get them from Leroy.  He lives down on the southern part of Desert Isle, between Santon and Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Winter Lotus? Oh, sure, they're rare, but you're definitely in the right place!

replies.reply_text: Oh, good, what a relief! I'm supposed to take one to Pattini on Jungle Isle. Can you tell me where they grow?

chatpoints.chat_text: Jungle Isle? You know that as soon as you pick the flower it starts to melt, right?

replies.reply_text: That's what I'm afraid of. Do you have any ideas?
I know, but I need to try. Can you tell me where they grow?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it seems to me that some sort of ice box would be logical, to keep the flower cold. You might try talking to one of the elves on Christmas Isle. That seems like the sort of thing they could construct.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that, thanks!
Good idea. Can you tell me where I can find the flowers as well?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's some growing just outside, around the frozen pond close to my house. You have to look closely to see them, since they are so white; they blend in with the snow.

replies.reply_text: Oh, good to know! Do you have any ideas on how to keep it from melting?
I'll look by the pond, then. Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, I need these coats.  You could try Leroy down on Desert Isle.  He's the one who provides me with coats, you might remember.

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course.  How could I forget?  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Ernie Angler
npc_list.long_description: Ernie Angler is a very tall man with a passion for fishing that is contagious.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my store!

replies.reply_text: Where can I go fishing?
What do I need to go fishing?
You don't have any fishing poles in stock?
I have some fish that I caught.  Is there anything I can do with them?
I just came from Stella's.  Do you happen to have her sack of fish ready?
Here are your 25 earthworms.
Hello, can I buy a bottle of tuna oil from you?
Hello. I was wondering if you know someone by the name of Patience?

chatpoints.chat_text: There are a few ponds just south and east of my store!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I have another question...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  Just a fishing pole,  bait,  and the right attitude!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I have another question...

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't!   But I can quickly make you one if you give me $100 and a strong skinny branch!

replies.reply_text: Okay...  I'll go look for one!
Okay!  I've got a branch right here.  Please make me a fishing pole!
Okay!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course!  You can sell them to me, or I can fry them up for you so you have fresh fish to eat!
