npc_list.long_description: Dewey Waders is a man living his dream. He spends his work hours talking about fishing and his evenings and weekends fishing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello there!  How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: Could you make me a fishing pole?
Could you fry some fish for me?
I don't need anything now.  Thanks.
I don't really need anything myself. Just looking around. These fishing lures you have on display are awesome.
Actually, I was wondering if you could send me to Loch Isle again?
Package delivery!
I need help finding a woman named Patience. I believe she wanted to go fishing. Has she been by here?
Dewey package delivery - delete this reply when it goes live.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.  I'll just need $100 and a strong, skinny stick.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Here ya go.
I don't have a strong skinny stick..  Where can I find one?
Guess I don't have what you need right now.  Maybe I'll be back later.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: There should be some in the forests.  Just wander around some.

replies.reply_text: Neat.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  I'll have it done in a jiffy.  It does cost $5 for little fish, $10 for normal fish, and $20 for big fish.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Here's a little fish.
Okay.  Here's a normal fish.
Okay.  Here's a big fish.
Oh.  Ummm, nevermind.  Bye.
All right.  I have another little fish.
Here's a normal fish.
Here's a big fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.
All right.  I have  another normal fish.
Here's a little fish.
Here's a big fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.
All right.  I have another big fish.
Here's a little fish.
Here's a normal fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thankee. I make 'em all meself, right here. People from all over Horse Isle order my special lures. In fact, I've gotten swamped with deliveries lately. You look like the agile type. Don't suppose you'd be willing to make a special delivery for me?

replies.reply_text: I'm not really that agile. Maybe someone else can help you. Bye!
Well, sure. I've got a little time, I can help you out. Who do they go to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go ahead and give them to Davy on Loch Isle. He likes to take his grandfather fishing. Now there's a true angler, Sam is!

replies.reply_text: That sounds kinda far. Maybe I'll pass after all.
Okay, but... how do I get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll send you there. No need to come back when you're done. Thanks for the help!

replies.reply_text: Thank you. I might just head out and do some fishing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't recall someone by that name. Sorry I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway.

npc_list.name: Lars Temper
npc_list.long_description: Lars Temper is a hard working, older man that doesn't hear well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hullo there!  What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: Sasha wanted me to give this sandwich to you.
I don't need anything now. Thanks.
I think I need some horse shoes for my horses.
Cedric needs a new blade made for his axe.
Murray sent me.  He needs 2 kegs of nails for the fences.
Hi Lars!  I'm back with the iron ore!
Good day to you, Lars! I was wondering if you could help me with this (You hold out the bell and clapper)
Hi Lars!  I was wondering, do you work with brass by any chance?
Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you've come to the right place.  I sell steel and iron shoes.  Just pick whichever you want for you horse, and I'll put them on for ya.

replies.reply_text: All right, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  Why does he need a new axe blade?  What happened to the old one?

replies.reply_text: Well, he lost his axe in the snow.  All we could find was the handle, so he asked me to come to you so you could make him a new one.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see.  Well, give the handle here.  I don't usually make blades, but I'll see what I can do.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: There!  Good as new.  You tell that Cedric to be more careful with that thing.

replies.reply_text: I will Sir.  Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's fence-mending time again?  Poor Murray.

replies.reply_text: He does seem a tad overworked about now.  How much do you want for the nails?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you what, I'll give Murray the nails free and clear, if you will bring me 50 pieces of iron ore to replace the ore I used making the nails.  Deal?

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a good deal. I'll be back as soon as I have all the iron ore.
No way.  That was not part of the deal.  He'll have to figure this out himself.  Bye!
Thanks a lot, I'm sure Murray will appreciate this.  Bye!
I'll be back as soon as I have all the iron ore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, can't help you this time.  I'm a traditionalist, I only work with iron or steel.  Besides, I can't think of anyone who does work with brass.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I just figured I'd ask.  Thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day!  Can I help you?  Are all your animals feeling well?

replies.reply_text: They're all fine, thank you!
Oh, everyone is fine, but I need your help with something else.
Sorry, I forgot... Where am I going again?
Hi Nora, I'm back!
As far as I know they are. However, Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
They sure are! Thanks for asking. By the way, would you happen to know a dentist you could recommend?

chatpoints.chat_text: How can I be of assistance?

replies.reply_text: Do you know if any of the cats around here have had kittens lately?

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, my cat, Frosty, recently had kittens.  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Jack O'Lantern sent me to find a white kitten for a friend of his.  The catch is, for whatever reason, I can't buy the kitten.  I can barter or trade for it, but I can't buy it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you may be in luck.  Frosty had three calicos, one all black, and one all white kitten.  I still have one of the calicos and the white kitten.

replies.reply_text: Great, what do you want for it?

chatpoints.chat_text: You could pick up a couple of orders I placed for the office.  Do that for me and the kitten is yours.

replies.reply_text: No problem!  Where am I going?
I don't actually have time now.  I'll stop by later.  Bye!
That's Shellton and Wington.  I'm on it!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to go to Ollie's Pet Shop in Shellton, and Kay's Pet Shop in Wington, remember?

replies.reply_text: Uh, yeah, that's right, Ollie and Kay.  I'm on my way!
Thanks, he's adorable!  I'm sure he's going to a good home.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I've seen those two flying around offshore before. It's sad that Falcor isn't feeling well. Unfortunately, I can't help. Luckdragons aren't very common, so medicine for them isn't in very high demand. I'm afraid you'll have to ask elsewhere.

replies.reply_text: I had a feeling you'd say that. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: If there were several dentists around, that would be an option. But as far as I know, there's only one. Although rumor has it that she is excellent! But where she practices, I haven't a clue.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay, thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!

replies.reply_text: Hi.
Hi. Actually, I need to leave. Sorry.
Hello.  I've just come from Sumiko Stallman in Appleton.  She asked me to ask around for some old supplies you could donate, or sell cheaply.
Hello!  I was doing something for you, right?
Hi.  I am back from giving Colina her package.

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I do you for?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, thanks. Just looking.
You have so many saddles to choose from. It's overwhelming. How do I pick one?
You have quite the nice shop here.  Anything you need done?  Polishing saddles or an errand or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do carry a wide range of saddles. The best advice I can give you is to take a peek at the saddle descriptions that the library offers you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, that's good advice. I think I'll go there now. Bye.
Why can't you just tell me which one to buy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay. Just holler if you need some help. And... if not, then thanks for stopping by.

replies.reply_text: Will do.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Different strokes for different folks. Listen, I could tell you, but it would take a while and you are going to need some time to think about which one suits you best. Again, my advice is to do some research at the library. It's free and worth it.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
All right, I guess I'll go check it out. Thanks and goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't sweat it. Maybe I'll see ya again sometime.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have wonderful timing!  I was needing to make a special delivery, but didn't know when I would be able to get out to do it.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm a pro at deliveries!  What do you need me to deliver?
A delivery?  You know what, I'm actually a little busier than I thought.  Maybe I'll come by later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're going to have to go to Lava Isle.  Can you do that?

replies.reply_text: You bet!
Not yet, sorry.  I guess I'll get to work on some quests and come back later.  Bye.
I'll head out now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard about that.  What's she need?

replies.reply_text: Halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm...  No, nothing like that, sorry.  But I'll sure let her know when I get some in.

replies.reply_text: That would be great!  Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you?  Ah, yes, the package.  That should go to Colina in Ashton.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll deliver that now.  Bye!
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome!  Come on in.  Look around.  Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  Just looking around.  Thanks.
What is the difference between Horse Candy and Treats?
Yes.  I need to pick up 5 bags of oats for Temperance.
Yes, I need to pick up some foal formula for Phyllis Colt, if you happen to have some in stock?
Actually, yes.  I'm trying to find Archy for Mehitabel. Has he been by here yet?
Yes there is. I've forgotten where you said Archy went after he finished his business with you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Horse Treats will make your horse happy, and is a little bit of food as well.  The Horse Candy will make your horse happy and give it a little more energy.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that makes sense.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aaah, yes.  The monthly bags of oats.  I'll go grab them.  Oh, it will cost $900.

replies.reply_text: All right.
Oh...  Umm..  I don't have that.  Let me go make some money, quick.  I'll be back soon.
Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have it right here.  That will be $500 even.

replies.reply_text: Phyllis gave me just enough to cover it all.  Here you go!
Well, maybe I'll come back later when I have the cash.
I sure will!  Thank you very much!
He always visits Ryland when he's in Treeton?  I guess he's next on my list.  Thanks, Oliver!

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries. I told you to drop in on Ryland. Archy always stops to check on him whenever he's in town.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I have to see Ryland next!  Thanks Oliver!

npc_list.name: Minnie Biscuits
npc_list.long_description: When you enter the Food Shop, you are immediately struck by a tantalizing aroma of nuts and bread.  A door opens and a plump, merry sort of woman peeks out, disappears for a second, and then comes out, clapping flour from her hands.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day, love!  Nice to see you 'ere.  How are you?

replies.reply_text: Fine, thanks.  Just stopped in to see what you've got.
Wonderful, thanks!  What's that smell from the kitchen?  It's delicious!
I've come for nut bread.
Hi Minnie! I have the cardamom you asked for.
Minnie, could you please send me back to Spice Isle?
Hi Minnie.  Would you happen to have any cilantro?
Actually, I'll be a lot better if you have any fruit that has gone bad.
I'm great, thanks for asking! I was told you could help me with some spices I need.
Hi again, Minnie. (You sniff the air in the tiny kitchen) Something smells... different. What is that?
Greetings Ma'am. I'm here on behalf of Hansel and Gretel and their new bakery. He's looking for vendors for the following items. (You show Minnie the list.) Are you interested?
I'm back from Rika's.  Do you have the berry vendor for me?
Excuse the intrusion, but where should I go for the berries again?
I'm running in circles, it seems. I can't find lemons to buy anywhere. You wouldn't have any, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's me world famous nut bread!  Would you like to try a slice?  Fresh out the oven, just now!

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I really don't have time.
Fresh nut bread?  I'd love some!
No thanks.  After the bite I had last time, I don't really need any more....
I really can't right now, but I have to ask... What makes it smell so good?

chatpoints.chat_text: Suit y'self!  Bye now!

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll go cut you a nice big slice! (Minnie turns and walks back into the kitchen, and a moment later, you hear a THUNK! as if something large were cut, not with a knife, but with an axe! Soon, she brings you a steaming slice of nutcake on a plate.) There you go, nice and fresh! Go on, have a bite!

replies.reply_text: (You pick up the slice and bite down--and while it smells delicious, the cake is rock hard and utterly inedible!) Augh! That's... I mean, don't get me wrong, it smells wonderful, but... ow!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Minnie looks utterly crestfallen.) I know it's a bit... dense... but he used to -so- like them that way! "The denser the better," he said!

replies.reply_text: Somebody actually... ate these?!
Ow.. I think I'll go take care of this tooth.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  This fella from another Isle... Pablo, I think, his name was; Spanish chap... Why, Pablo'd come in here and bring me walnuts and acorns, and for every ten of each he brought me, I'd make him a loaf.  And right happy he was to have 'em, too!  Used to buy them by the dozen, he did!  And always he'd say to me, "Minnie, if ever anybody brings you walnuts and acorns and you bake this bread, and I can't come down and get it m'self, send it to me and I'll buy it and pay 'em well, whoever it is brings it!"

replies.reply_text: (You stop yourself saying, "You've -got- to be kidding!" just in time.)
"Pablo", did you say?  Hmmm, I might have heard that name.
Not now, thanks.  Maybe some other time.
Okay, here are ten acorns and ten walnuts.
Where can I find walnuts and acorns?

chatpoints.chat_text: They grow on trees, don't they?  There's plenty of walnut trees on Jungle Isle, and there's oaks all over the Isles, wherever there's grass.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try to find you what you need.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: All right then, let's see...

replies.reply_text: I have more!
That's all for now.  I'll be back, though!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes dearie, that'd be the spices I use in it.  Only the very finest, you know!

replies.reply_text: Well, it certainly smells good.  Bye now.
Spices? Where do you get those from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, from The Spice Shoppe! Speaking of that dearie, do you suppose you could run a quick little errand for me?

replies.reply_text: Oh, my! Look at the time!  I have to run right now. Perhaps another time? Bye!
I suppose I could fit that into my schedule. What do you need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you dearie! I am making hermit cookies, and need a small bag of ground cardamom from The Spice Shoppe.

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, I really don't have time for that. I'll stop back in soon and try to get that for you.
Sure, no problem! Uh... How do I get there?
Oh, Rika said she appreciates your business. Thanks and bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's no problem, I'll send you there. Rika will be able to send you back.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  See you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry. I don't keep that in stock. I usually get it direct from Rika at The Spice Shoppe when I need it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, could you please send me there?

chatpoints.chat_text: My goodness. What an unusual request.

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, dear, but I don't have what you need. You'd better try the other shops.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well. Thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't help you with that, but I can get you to the woman who can!

replies.reply_text: That would be terrific!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, yes. That's my first attempt at my soon-to-be-famous Berry Pie for the county fair this year! I am so excited because I came across a recipe for a huckleberry and thimbleberry pie. The only problem is that now I am all out of berries. Do you think you could go out and pick me some fresh ones for me? There’s a loaf of my famous nut bread in it for you… (Minnie holds up a fresh baked loaf of nut bread to tempt you.)

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, Minnie.  I just love your nut bread!  How many berries do you need?
Ummm... No thanks.  It sounds gross, just like your nutbread.
I'll be right back!
You're welcome, Minnie. Good luck at the county fair!

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find huckleberries on the grassy lands. They shouldn't be too hard to find, but you have to be patient because they are few and far between! Thimbleberries are found in bushes. You have to find the bushes first. (Minnie smiles sweetly.) Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thank you for the tip.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Back so soon, dearie?  Did you find the 15 huckleberries and thimbleberries that I needed for my berry pie?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'll be right back this time.
I can't find any berries, Minnie!  Can you give me any hints?
I got them right here, Minnie!
No, but in the meantime, could you please send me back to Spice Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm. (Looking over the list.) I can help you with the spices and the berries.

replies.reply_text: You can?! That's great.  Now let me give you the letters of credit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Slow down, I'm not saying I can handle this volume.  You need to see Rika Millgrater on Spice Isle.  I'm sure she can handle that sized order.  I can send you there, and when you get back, I'll give you the berry supplier.

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful, could you send me to her?
I have to go to Spice Isle?  I really can't right now.  I'll come back in a bit.  Bye.
Thank you. Then it's off to Molten Meadows for me! Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, you poor dear.  All this running around has you quite turned around, doesn't it?  I said that you might find a berry vendor in Molten Meadows.

replies.reply_text: That's right, thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure don't. But why don't you try George on Pirate Isle? I bet he could help you out.

replies.reply_text: Minnie, I could hug you! Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. How are you?

replies.reply_text: I am well, and yourself?
I'm good, just looking.
I'm great, thanks for asking. I'm here for Mino's plants.
Where did you say I should look for the well-rotted manure?
You mentioned something about amending the soil. Will Mino know what you mean by that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am well also. Do you need help with anything?

replies.reply_text: Yes. What is probably the best flower to get someone for a gift?
Nope. Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  If you need anything, just ask.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm. Depends, really. I like roses, but my friend, Vicky, loves daisies. I guess it just varies person to person.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Thank you for the advice. I should go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep anytime. Goodbye.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. I've got a great assortment of sages, and of course, honeysuckle and trumpet vines. He's getting a lot of plants here for the $1000 we agreed upon.

replies.reply_text: $1000? No problem. He gave me money to cover that.
I'll be back with the money in awhile.
Amend the soil? Will Mino know what you mean by that?
I'll get these right to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: We discussed it when he ordered the plants. He won't be able to grow much if he doesn't. Puuhonua Isle is mostly sand. Well-rotted manure will enrich the soil and give it the ability to hold moisture. He probably just forgot to mention it to you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll remind him.
I might as well get it now, while I'm out and about. Any idea where to get manure?

chatpoints.chat_text: Check at some of the livery stables. One of them is bound to have some.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: Cecil Shuteye
npc_list.admin_description: Woodworker of miniatures
npc_list.long_description: Cecil looks and talks more as if he were the captain of a ship than the owner of an inn.  Perhaps he was, at one time.  His eyes sparkle and his voice, while quiet, is that of someone who's perfectly at home with his work.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day.

replies.reply_text: Hi there.  Just passing through.
Hello.  I just came from Vern and Grandpa Whystan in Tropicton.  They're looking for building blocks.  Can you make them from plans?
Hi!  It was 1 log of ebony wood and 5 regular logs you needed?  I think I have them here.
Good day, are the blocks ready?
Hey there, Cecil! Would you, by any chance, have an extra copper-bottomed stock pot I could buy? Or know where I might get one from?
Hi Cecil! I'm looking for cookies. Chocolate chip walnut cookies, to be precise. You wouldn't happen to have those?
Hi Cecil! I'm back with $100 to buy a cookie.
Any chance I could have some of the wood ash from your fireplace?
Hello, Cecil!  I have a proposition for you...

chatpoints.chat_text: From plans, eh?  Always good to have plans.  Let's see those plans.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Aw, these are cute! All right, I'll make these. Maybe I'll make a set for my nieces and nephews, too. Now let's see here...
Oh, you know what would be perfect? If some of these blocks were hardwood and some were ebony! Wouldn't that be fun? And look here... You've only got 1x2 blocks. What happens when you get to a door or a window? You'll need some half-size, 1x1 blocks! I'll make some of those too, just let me make a mark...

replies.reply_text: This project is getting bigger every time I go see someone!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Nothing wrong with that. Here, let me copy these plans real quick.................
(Cecil pulls out a pad and pencil and scribbles hurriedly.)

replies.reply_text: Take your time...
Okay.  I'll go get them for you.
Hold on, I think I have them here.
Okay, will do.  Thanks!
$500?  I didn't realize it was going to cost me!  No thanks!
Thanks.  These are just right.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Copper-bottomed stock pot, you say? Hmmm. Seems to me I saw one being used recently.

replies.reply_text: Here? In Treeton?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it was while I was vacationing. I can't for the life of me remember who was using it though. Just their cat -- cute little fellow! Kept curling around my ankles.

replies.reply_text: Okay. That's a start. Which island did you vacation on?

chatpoints.chat_text: I traveled to Jungle -- amazing scenery! And to the desert isles. I went through a ton of sunscreen there.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! It must have been one of the inn keepers in Tropicton or Hotton.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I was looking for adventure, so I didn't see it in any town. I'm more of an off-the-beaten-path kind of traveler.

replies.reply_text: Yikes. That leaves a lot of territory for me to search. Can't you remember anything more about the pot?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry. But you might want to ask those inn keepers. They might be able to give you more information. It never hurts to ask.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion.
I've got that right here.
I'm going to have to make a bank run.
Thanks very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you with that. I just cleaned it out. But since you are here, you might want to consider some of our fried chicken. It is scrumptious!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the offer, but I think I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition you say?  This could be the highlight of my day.

replies.reply_text: Well Iona over in Flipperton wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
I'm sure you'll have a good time there.  I'll let Iona know.

npc_list.name: Reid Pebbleton
npc_list.long_description: Reid is a small young man, who no matter what he does, appears to be reading cue cards far off.  He is not a dreamy sort, nor is he blind; he appears to genuinely not be too sure exactly where you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up and smiles warmly at you.) Hello. Welcome to my shop. May I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Smiles in return.) Hello. Do you have any rare gems?
Nope, just looking.  Thank you.
Actually, I'm hoping I might be able to help you.  Have Horse, Will Quest, you know.  Is there anything you need found, fetched, carried or conjured?
Sorry to be a pest, but what was it you had me looking for again?
I'm back from the Great White North!

chatpoints.chat_text: All of our stock comes from travelers like yourself. You could find anything ranging from the simple agates to the beautifully divine diamonds.

replies.reply_text: Really? I better go collect some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  If you need anything, just ask.

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles.) Beaches and the deserts will probably be the best place to find gems. For ores, search collections of rocks.

replies.reply_text: (Smiles in return.) All right, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Oh. I see. Yes, I see. (Reid looks at you briefly, as if he hasn't ever seen anything like you before; then looks away and taps the counter in thought.) Hmmm.... novel idea that, let me think.

replies.reply_text: Are you all right?
(You look around the shop while he thinks things over.)
I'll come back later when you've had a while to think about it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right?  Yes, I'm very well, thank you very much for asking.  Yes.  Now what was it I can do for... oh wait.  You wanted to do something for me, didn't you?  Yes, that was it.  Let me think.

replies.reply_text: (You look over the shop. There are some really find specimens here.)
I think I'll come back later after you've had some time to think.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: "As far to north as you can go, to an isle with center snow.  Right between a man and bird, dig and you'll find my last word."

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  I've thought of something, but it will be a lot of work.  Do you mind a lot of work?  Because if you do there's no point in carrying on this discussion.

replies.reply_text: Not at all!  "Nil Sine Magno Labore," that's my alma-mater's motto, and mine too!  Tell me what you need.
Oh no, I hate work.  I just want someone to hand me money and lots of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha, you're on the wrong planet, I must say!  Good day to you then.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, I was just being sarcastic.  I'll do your job for you.
Sheesh, grow a thicker skin, why don't you!  Good.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sarcastic, are you?  Well, I am blind to sarcasm.  I expect you to mean what you say, and say what you mean.  That should not be too much to ask.  Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Look, if you can't handle a little sarcasm--
I'm sorry.  I didn't mean to be rude.   What would you like me to do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Fine. Be that way. (Walk out.)
(Nod and leave the store quietly.)

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a great university in the Foreign Lands that I have always dreamed of attending.  The problem is that it's far away and it's expensive.  I've been running this rock shop for years to try and earn the money for it, but I'm nowhere close.

replies.reply_text: I know the feeling!  Isn't there a less expensive university you could go to?
Why would you do that?  You have a lovely rock store in a beautiful town...
You're nuts.  Why would anybody want any more schooling than is required by law!  Good luck with that!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, there is.  That's always an option.  But the University I wish to attend has the best geology program anywhere on this side of the planet, and that's where I have my heart set on going.

replies.reply_text: So you want me to get you money, then?  Or a letter of recommendation?  Or something like that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have ambition, too.  I want to be more than just a shop-keep.  So, I want to go to university.  The world is so full of wonders!  I want to arm myself with the knowledge to experience as many as I can!

replies.reply_text: That's very wise of you!  How can I help?  Do you need recommendations or ...
If you say so.  So, what would you like me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I got the University Newsletter, and they have announced a scholarship competition for incoming freshmen!  They want us to submit a collection of local minerals, labeled with where they were found and what they are and such.

replies.reply_text: So, I guess you want me to go out and find you one of each rock?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I already have plenty of rocks.  What I would like are my grandmother's cataloging cards.  She had the best!  Unfortunately, she took them with her on her last field expedition and left them there.

replies.reply_text: Where did she go on her last expedition?
Why don't you just have new cards made?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because I thought it might help to show the University that geology runs in my family.  Perhaps they will think I am a natural.

replies.reply_text: I guess that makes sense.  Okay!  Tell me where to look!
Is it okay if I just pass this one up?  The thought of university gives me the shakes.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know the last place she went was up north.  She liked to go to the little isles way up north and look for meteorites.

replies.reply_text: You can't be more specific?
I'm on my way.  I'll let you know what I find.  Oh-- wait... what am I looking for, anyway?
Maybe some other time.  I hate snow.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: All I can tell you is what she told me.  "As far to north as you can go, to an isle with center snow.  Right between a man and bird, dig and you'll find my last word."

replies.reply_text: She left you a poem?
And what exactly am I looking for?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, she was a little weird.

replies.reply_text: Gotcha.  Now, what am I looking for?
I'll be back as soon as I've got everything I can find!  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: My grandmother's geological cataloging cards?  Somewhere on a small island way-the-hey up north?  Isn't that what I told you?

replies.reply_text: Why so it is!  I'll be back.
Thanks, bye.
Are you absolutely sure you can't give me any more definite information?
Could you read me that poem again?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Reid smiles pleasantly, but somehow, you aren't sure he's smiling at you...) Welcome back. And what did you find there?

replies.reply_text: Here you are! (Lay out what you found on the counter.)
I'm sorry, but I could only find the box.  Apparently some animal dug it up and spread out the cards.
Thanks a lot!  Best of luck at University!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't you find a little isle up north with a bird and a man on it?  I mean, of some kind?  A snow bird and a snow man, perhaps?  Really, all it wants is a little imagination.

replies.reply_text: All right, all right, I'll have another go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, maybe it buried the cards in the same area?

replies.reply_text: Oooo, that's an idea.  I'll go back and dig around.

npc_list.name: Sandy Flint
npc_list.short_description: Owner of The Shore Rock Shop
npc_list.long_description: Sandy Flint is a young man who somehow looks wise beyond his years.  He has a curious, penetrating expression, such as one who has concentrated hard on small details for a long time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, welcome to The Shore.  What can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Just looking at all the pretty sparklies, thanks.
Hello there.  I was wondering... I need a metal pot made...
Could you tell me something about these stones and things?
You needed 25 copper ores and 10 logs, right?
Hi, Mr. Flint.  How's that pot coming along?
Hi there, Mr. Flint.  Do you, by chance, ever work with brass?
Can you make clarinet keys and reeds?  Xamba sent a set of molds for you to use.
How much silver did you need for the clarinet keys?
I have the 25 silver ore you needed to make the clarinet keys.  Will you need anything else to make the reeds?
Have you finished the clarinet keys?
Have you finished the clarinet keys?
I heard a rumor that you were a cooper.  Can you help me with a leaky bucket?
Hi there.  I need a copper candlestick.  Can you make me one?
Hi.  I have those chunks of Copper Ore that you wanted for the candlestick.
Good day!  I was wondering if you could repair this brass bell for me?
Hi there, are you finished with the bell yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Well, you've come to the right place, then.  I'm a coppersmith.  Part time, anyway.

replies.reply_text: A "coppersmith"?
Cool!  Well, I need a copper pot for Shaylene Shampu.  She's going to try to make me some goat cheese.

chatpoints.chat_text: A "coppersmith" is someone who works with copper, making all sorts of things.  Such as pots, vases and jewelry.  Arthur lets me use his forge, and I make pots and pans for him, see?

replies.reply_text: Cool!  Well, I need a copper pot for Shaylene Shampu.  She's going to try to make me some goat cheese.

chatpoints.chat_text: She's going to make chevre?  Wow, excellent!  I haven't had a good chevre in years!  Sure, I'll be happy to make a pot.  Did she give you any specifications?

replies.reply_text: Uhn... No, not really.  I think she's just winging it, to tell you the truth.
What's "chevre"?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's Shaylene, all right!  Well, I'll just make one of a nice, serviceable size.

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks!  Do you need me to get you anything?
Twenty-five copper ores and ten logs.  I'll see what I can do.  Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right!  Have you got them?

replies.reply_text: I sure do!  Here you are!
Uh, no.  Just wanted to make sure I knew what I was supposed to get you.  I'll get on it right away.
Great.  Uhm... How much is this going to cost me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'll just charge you a nominal fee.  Just you make sure Shaylene sends me some of her cheese!

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: "Chevre" is French for "goat," also used commonly for any kind of goat's milk cheese.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  I see.  Well, I... honestly have no idea what size pot she needs, she didn't exactly say.

chatpoints.chat_text: Copper pot!  Here it is, my first ever, all-copper pot!  Hmm!  Goat cheese!  You know, I wish grapes grew in these isles, I'd love to have Shaylene make some Raisin Chevre.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, well, first we have to see if she can make cheese at all.  How much for the pot?
Sure grapes grow on these isles!  I found some just recently, on Aesop Isle!

chatpoints.chat_text: You didn't!  I've been all over these Isles and I've never seen so much as a vine!

replies.reply_text: But there are!  There's a fox named Renard who's got a vineyard full of grapes, down by Dust Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?!

replies.reply_text: Really!  I've been there!  I saw them.  Anyway, I'll have the pot now, I'm in kind of a hurry.
Really!  I've got some with me!  Look!
Really!  I don't have any with me now, but if you like, I can get you some!
You're on!
Thanks!  I'll get this to Shaylene right away.
Thanks!  I'll get this to Shaylene right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, I can tell you all kinds of things about these stones.  What would you like to know?

replies.reply_text: Why are diamonds so rare and expensive?
What are rubies, and why are they valuable?
What is a sapphire?
Why are emeralds green?
Please tell me about these ores.
Please tell me about agates.
Why are gems only found on the beaches?
What good are dinosaur bones?
Nothing now. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Why are diamonds so rare and expensive?
Diamonds are the hardest material known, and because of that, they are very scratch resistant. That makes them excellent jewelry stones.
Diamonds also refract light into spectral colors; that's called a diamond's "fire." All these things make a diamond very valuable.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Okay.  Thanks!
Could you tell me about another kind of stone?

chatpoints.chat_text:
What are rubies, and why are they valuable? That's a good question! Believe it or not, a ruby is just a red sapphire. Sapphires come in all colors, but only rubies and padparadshas have their own names.
Rubies and other sapphires are the second hardest stones after diamonds, and that makes them good, hard-wearing jewelry stones. But rubies are prized above all the others because of their color, which is so rare in nature. Rubies get their magenta-red color because of tiny amounts of chrome in the crystal structure.

replies.reply_text: Chrome?  But... I brought some chrome to Nicolette for paint.  It was leaf green!
I see.  Thanks.
Can I ask about something else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  That was probably chrome oxide; different chemical composition, you see.
What is a sapphire? Well, all sapphires are a form of corundum, aluminum oxide.  But what makes them different is inclusions.  Do you know what an inclusion is?

replies.reply_text: Yes.
No, what is it?
No, but I don't care.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, in this sense, an "inclusion" is what happens when a few atoms in a crystal are replaced with atoms of a different mineral.  In a ruby, aluminum atoms are replaced with chrome.  In a blue sapphire, a few aluminum atoms are replaced with atoms of iron and titanium.  Green sapphires have inclusions of cobalt, nickel or other things, depending upon the shade of green, you see.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Right.  Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: When people say "sapphire," they almost always mean the blue kind.  Blue sapphires are valuable because true blues are extremely rare in rocks and minerals.  Blue is almost everybody's favorite color, you know.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay, thanks.
May I ask you some more questions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why are emeralds green?  Ah!  Emeralds are a form of beryl, and are colored green by inclusions of chrome.  They're brittle, though.  And really good, natural emeralds are very hard to find nowadays.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Thanks.
Cool!  Can I ask you about another stone?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Ores! Well, we have four different kinds of ores you can find around the area. Iron ore contains the least of the mineral you want because iron oxidizes -- it rusts -- so readily, that you almost never find pure iron in nature.
Copper ore is a little more variable. Copper oxidizes, but not as quickly as iron, so you do find a little "pure" copper, what's called "native copper," around; so copper ore looks much more like pure copper than iron ore does.
Silver ore has even more native silver in it; generally it's little bits and nuggets of pure silver mixed in with bits of quartz and what-not.
Gold ore is just like silver ore; only gold is rarer than silver. That's what you wanted to know?

replies.reply_text: Yes, thanks.
No, but... Oh, well.  Thanks for explaining it anyway.
Can I ask about something else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, agates!  Agates are very common on these isles!  We're lucky!  Did you know agates were once thought to be able to cure snake and scorpion bites?

replies.reply_text: But... Well, okay.
Okay, well, why are agates banded like that?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's because of the way they form, you see.  Agates form in lava flows.  Lava flows have bubbles in them, when they cool, from gasses which get trapped.  Then, as the years go by, rain flowing on the cool lava dissolves quartz and other minerals which flow down through the lava and fill these cavities up.  The water leaves, but the minerals it carries stay behind as bands of colored stone.

replies.reply_text: No kidding!  That's interesting.  Oh well, I'm on my way now.  Bye.
Can I ask about something else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, gems aren't only found on beaches, of course.  But they're easiest to find there because the action of water, waves from the ocean and river water and so on, frees them from the stones that surround them where they grew.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  That makes sense.  Thanks!
Cool!  Can I ask you about another stone?

chatpoints.chat_text: What good are dinosaur bones?  Well, how else have we got to learn about dinosaurs?

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay, thanks.
May I ask you some more questions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, let's see.... $200.  It was an experimental piece, so I'll let you have it cheap.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll take it.
But... sorry, I don't have it.  Oh well, Shaylene will have to get it herself.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be wonderful.  Well, let's see...  The pot will be $200.   It was an experimental piece, so I'll let you have it cheap.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll take it.
But... sorry, I don't have it.  Oh well, Shaylene will have to get it herself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Brass!  Why yes, during my apprenticeship.  We had to make all kinds of things out of it, why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no reason.  Just asking.
Well, a fellow named Lenny on Lava Isle needs a steam valve about... so big? ...and I said I'd ask around for him.  He gave me some copper and some zinc oxide.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, are you ever in luck! It just so happens.... (Sandy Flint runs into the back of his store, and comes back out with a very dusty box, which he sets down on the counter. From deep inside he pulls a brass valve about... so big...)
How about this?

replies.reply_text: Wow... Well, it's certainly just about the right size...

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you what, I'll trade you those materials Lenny gave you for it.  How about that?

replies.reply_text: No, thanks, I'll keep looking.
Deal!
Thanks!  I'll get this right back to Lenny!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it's always fun to work with Xamba.  I can make the keys if I have the molds.  You said you brought them?

replies.reply_text: Yep. Here you go. (You hand over Xamba's Clarinet Molds for Sandy to examine.)
Twenty-five silver ore, then.  I'll come back when I have it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Twenty-five pieces, to be sure all the molds are completely filled.

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  I'll be back with your ore.
Sure, I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not yet.  But they should be done by the time you pick up the reeds.

replies.reply_text: I almost forgot about the reeds.  Where should I go to get them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see Barrett in the store on Tail Isle.  He makes them there.

replies.reply_text: Barrett on Tail Isle.  All right, I'll see you when I get back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  They just finished cooling.  Let me put them in a bag for you.  Did you get the reeds?

replies.reply_text: Yes, Barrett had a box already made.
Will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not sure how that rumor got started. I'm a coppersmith, not a cooper. I guess it sounds similar, but I work with copper, not wood. Sorry, I can't help you with your bucket.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  I'll try some other people.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe.  How big of a one?

replies.reply_text: Oh, about... (You show him with your hands.) so high and so wide...
Never mind, this is too weird.  He can get his own.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! I know what you want! (He leaves for a moment and then comes from the back of his store with a copper object.) Here's one I made a while ago, just the size and shape you need. I'll trade you 20 chunks of copper for it. Don't want it lying around here forever. Do you have the ores?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I think I do, here!
No, I don't, but I know where to get them!  I'll be back!
Thanks, this is great!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks at the pieces you are holding.) It's not so bad as it looks. I could buff up the bell to make it shiny again and reattach the clapper. Sure, I'll have it as good as new for only $500.

replies.reply_text: Deal!  Here you go.
Thanks, I'll be back later.
It looks wonderful!  I'm sure Oringo will be thrilled to have it back.  Thank you so much.

npc_list.name: Galvin
npc_list.admin_description: At his home near treeton
npc_list.long_description: Galvin is a small, grizzly looking fellow.

chatpoints.chat_text: This place is a mess!   Please forgive me,  I really only look after my island property.

replies.reply_text: The place looks fine to me.
Island property?
I must be going.
I'm glad you're home! Rafiki said you might know something about a Golden Sheep?
Hello! I've come to keep my promise and replace Nina's birthday present!
Hi! I'm back and I have the necklace!
Hi.  What was I doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, thank you.  You should really see my island property instead.

replies.reply_text: Island property?
I must be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep,  I own an island off to the east a little bit.   I could take you there if you'd like!  Need to charge $50 though...

replies.reply_text: Okay, here is $50 for the trip.
No thanks,  I don't have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he now? I thought he was going to keep that information a secret.

replies.reply_text: Was it a secret? Oops, I won't ask you about it then.
He was, but it's really important that I find this sheep. It belongs to Candide. The poor sheep was washed off of his ship in a storm, and I promised to find it for him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Lost in a storm, eh? Poor little sheep. Well, I'm sorry to say the sheep is not here any longer.

replies.reply_text: Oh no. I guess I'll go look somewhere else, then. Bye.
Do you know where it is?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you see, I have a sister who lives on Tail Isle. She's always been an animal lover, and it was her birthday last week, so I thought the sheep might make a nice birthday present.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't want to take anyone's birthday present away. I guess I'll just go.
So the sheep is already there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, and I suppose it ought to be returned to its rightful owner... I just don't want Nina to be too upset. In exchange for the sheep, will you promise to return here after you've found the sheep and help me find a replacement present?

replies.reply_text: That's not part of my job. I think I'll just go.
Sure, I could do that. It's only fair. I'd hate for Nina to be out a birthday present, too.
I won't forget. Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. I've been wondering when you'd be back. I think I'd like to have a necklace made for her. All girls like jewelry, right? Do you think that's a good idea?

replies.reply_text: Make a necklace? This is sounding like more work than I anticipated. I really don't have time for this right now.
Some do. Though it seemed to me your sister's greatest passion is birds. Maybe something that has to do with birds would be better?

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, you may be right. (Galvin jumps to his feet.) I've got it! We'll make her a feather necklace!

replies.reply_text: Uh... What a silly idea. Good luck finding someone who will make that for you.
Sounds... uh... perfect. Who wouldn't want a feather necklace, after all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly! Deidra in Horseshoe Village is renowned for her naturalistic jewelry. I bet she could make the perfect peacock feather necklace. Why don't you visit her and have one made, and then bring it back to me so I can see how it turned out?

replies.reply_text: Uh, no thanks. I'm allergic to peacock feathers. Bye.
Sure, I could do that. A promise is a promise after all.
All right, I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it turned out just... beautiful, I suppose, eh? I know you already have the Golden Sheep in return for this, but I really do appreciate you following through on your word and coming back to help me with this, so please take this small reward. Now hurry and get that delivered to Nina!

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were supposed to get a peacock feather necklace made by Deidra for me to give to my sister for her birthday present.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll get right on that.

npc_list.name: Galvin
npc_list.admin_description: On his island
npc_list.long_description: Galvin is a small,  grizzly looking fellow.

chatpoints.chat_text: So how do you like it!?   Beautiful, no?

replies.reply_text: Yes, lovely island. Please take me back to shore now.
Hmm...  Not quite what I expected.  Thought there would be a little 'more'...
Yes, it's lovely.  I'm going to go look around some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, okay, okay.  Off you go then!
Well,  I could drop you off at Quiet Isle right south of here.  They have a larger island...  You should be able to find a ride back from there also.

replies.reply_text: Okay, that sounds great!
No thanks,  I'd rather you took me back to the mainland.
I'll think about it.  I'm going to look around a bit first.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, off to the next island!

npc_list.name: Rafiki
npc_list.long_description: Rafiki is a darkly tanned older boy who is usually seen without shirt or shoes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who are you!  What do you want!   Leave me alone!  I'm hiding here...

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  I'll go.
Why are you hiding?
Hey Rafiki! I thought you said the worm holes take you some place amazing. I didn't find any place out of the ordinary.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid of people.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.
Why are you afraid of people?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because I might accidentally tell my secret!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay.  Bye.
What is the secret?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, just the fact that there is a treasure buried above the pond on this island...  ACK!  I told you!   See...  That's why I don't like talking with people...

replies.reply_text: Okay.   Better luck next time...
Really? Do you have any other secrets?
Well, good thing I already found that treasure.  Thanks!  Bye.
I'm sure someone like yourself must have many secrets.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I have many secrets! But I don't want to tell you!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I won't force you. Bye.
What's another secret?
If you have many secrets, what's the big deal about sharing one more with me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just that I saw a Golden Sheep on our island.... BAH! I did it again!

replies.reply_text: You'd just better stop talking, then.
I'm looking for a Golden Sheep! Where did it go? Or is that a secret, too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course it is! I would never tell you that I smuggled it off the island.... ARGH! I can't believe I just told you that!

replies.reply_text: I can't believe it either. Can't believe you're so bad at keeping secrets, that is.
Smuggled it? To where?

chatpoints.chat_text: Noo, I'll never tell you! And I know Galvin will never betray me, either! UGH! I said too much again! I just can't talk to you anymore!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, bye then!
Well, thanks for the information! I know where to look next...

chatpoints.chat_text: Me either! Please just leave before I tell you more, I beg you!

replies.reply_text: Well, if it means that much to you... Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a big deal because one of the secrets is a terrible, horrible, muddy, no good kind of secret! But you end up someplace awesome!

replies.reply_text: Well, I certainly don't want to know about any kind of terrible, horrible, no good secret! So your secret is safe from me! I'll leave you alone now.

Well that's the very best kind of secret to share! The ones where you have to get your hands dirty like planting a garden. It starts muddy and ends up beautiful. And you want the world to be a beautiful place, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: I won't tell you. I won't. Never, ever!  If I told you, you'd get all muddy and be super duper mad at me.

replies.reply_text: I won't get mad at you! A little bit of mud never hurt anyone!
Okay. I certainly don't want to get muddy. You don't have to tell me a thing, because I'm leaving now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm talking a LOT of mud! This gnome popped out of a hole by the dead tree and he said he was digging worm holes so I dug there and... NOOOO! I told you! I am SO SO BAD at keeping secrets!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for spilling the beans... er, mud! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Drat! Drat! Drat! I wasn't supposed to tell you that secret! That's the Terrible, Horrible, Muddy No Good Secret!

replies.reply_text: Well you DID tell me, and I DID get muddy, but what's so terrible about that? Nothing. Since I'm not mad at you, don't you think its only fair that you tell me about the amazing place?
And I'm going to be really, really mad at you if you don't tell me about the amazing place! So spill the beans again. Or the mud. Or whatever!
Oh forget about! I'm gone like last night's dream.

chatpoints.chat_text: Argh! I am so so so so bad at keeping secrets. After you dug and dug and dug, did you talk to the gnome that made the worm holes? He knows the way to the amazing place.

replies.reply_text: Well drat it all! I guess I didn't take this adventure far enough. Okay, I'm outta here.

npc_list.name: Venda
npc_list.short_description: Mother of Rafiki on Quiet Isle
npc_list.long_description: While Venda is certainly nice enough, she seems easily vexed.

chatpoints.chat_text: How did you get here?  No boats travel this way!

replies.reply_text: I dunno...  I'm lost...
Oh, Galvin dropped me off here.
I'm looking for a sheep that may have washed up on this island. Have you seen any sheep recently?
Yes, you said that before... Anyways, I was wondering what I was doing for you again?
Yes, you said that before... Anyways, I am back with money from Anani for the fronds!
I know. Well, Galvin brought me here. Nice place, by the way!  Is there anything I can do for you, maybe, since I am here?
Hi there.  I'm ... well, it's a long story, but do things tend to wash up on this island?
Pony Express delivery for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you can take a trip back to the mainland at the boat dock to the west.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh...  That Galvin...  Always a trouble-maker!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I guess I should be going...
Do you know that your son isn't home?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  That man always acts so strange...

replies.reply_text: Yes, I guess.  Okay, well, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I haven't seen anything, no. You might ask my son, though, if you can find him. He wanders the island a lot, he may have seen something.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, since you are here, would you run a quick errand for me?

replies.reply_text: I can't right now, sorry.  Maybe later?
Sure, I can help you out, I suppose.  What do you have in mind?
I'll run these right over to her as soon as possible!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were running those palm fronds over to Anani on Palm Isle.  Please hurry back!

replies.reply_text: Yes, thank you for reminding me!
Thank you and good luck picking fronds!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wash up?  Every now and then.  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: To be honest, I promised a little kid I wouldn't say, but he lost something in the water and I'm trying to help him find it.
Never mind.  Sorry to waste your time.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I seeeeeeee.... Well, when things do wash up, they tend to wash up onto the north shore.  Haven't seen anything there for a while, though.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll go look there then.  Bye!
It is so quiet on this island, I don't blame you for ordering a ton of books! Thank you, and enjoy reading all of those!

npc_list.name: Dakota
npc_list.long_description: Dakota is a rugged individual. She has spent most of her 60 plus years living alone in this desert.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh ho!  You caught me just before I could head out.  I was just about to go looking for scorpions.  If you have some for me, I'll be glad to take them off your hands.

replies.reply_text: Actually, I do have some scorpions.  You can go ahead and have them!
How about little lizards?
Ah, no.  I try to avoid them.  I don't like scorpions.  Bye!
Actually, I'm looking for a spider.
Scorpions? Don't you ever get stung?
I'm back.  I have the agates you wanted.
Not right now, sorry.  What I'm trying to find is someone who does sandpainting.
Hi Dakota!  You're into scorpions and bugs and stuff, right?  Have you heard of something called Lac?
All right.  Bye!
I have another one for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Lizards are all right.  I don't like them as much as I like scorpions though!  You can go ahead and give them to me if you like.

replies.reply_text: Here you go!  You can have them all!
I'll keep that in mind.
I have another one for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: A spider?  Why, I just got one not long ago.  It's very pretty.

replies.reply_text: Can I see it please?  Does it have a blue mark on its back, perhaps?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes it does!  It's the first thing I noticed when I saw it in Jaxon's store.  I must admit it doesn't seem very happy to be here though.  Just sits all day in its web over there in the corner.

replies.reply_text: Look, this may sound strange and I'm not crazy, but that spider's sister sent me to find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah right, and I'm a lizard's uncle!

replies.reply_text: No, really!  His sister talked to me and asked me to find him.  He was taken a couple of weeks ago by someone who found him in an old shack on a beach.  Then he was sold to Jaxon and then you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay!  I may not believe such a far-fetched story... but obviously you do.  Since the spider seems so unhappy here anyway, why don't you take him.  You and he can have a nice conversation about fairies, goblins, talking horses and such.

replies.reply_text: I'm not crazy!  But I would like to take him back to his sister.
Thank you so much!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do get stung every now and then but I keep plenty of agate handy.  It cures the sting you know.

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do for you?
Really?  Neat!  Well, I'll let you heal yourself with a rock and I'll be on my way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do seem to be running a bit low on agates, maybe you could bring me some?

replies.reply_text: Sure, how many do you need?
Hmm, not right now. I'm sort of busy at the moment.
Oh, that's not too many.  I'll be back in no time!
Have fun with your scorpions!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sandpainting you say?  Go see Sani.  He's our village shaman and positively the best sandpainter in all the Horse Isles!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Really?  I'll go see him then, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I can't say that I have.  Does it have to do with scorpions?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I guess not.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there! Come on in and have a seat. Wait! Not there.

replies.reply_text: Huh? Do what? You invite me to come in and sit and then tell me not to? I'll just leave now.
Hi there. Do you happen to have any nopales?
Oh, sorry. Where would you like me to sit?
Howdy!  Sorry to bother you, but do you know where I can find the sandpainter?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here, try this one. I do believe I picked all the spines out of that one.

replies.reply_text: Spines? What are you talking about? That is too creepy. I'm going now.
Spines? Is that what you call those prickly things in the cactus?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, of course. Spines protect the cactus from herbivores.

replies.reply_text: That is a big word. What does it mean?
Herba what? You mean Herb eats cactus? I knew he was odd. Thanks for clarifying that for me. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nopales? Why, yes, of course I have some.  They're very tasty!  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no reason.  I was working on something, but think I'll take a break from it. Bye.
Rose is looking for some. She wants to make Will a Southwestern Cactus Salad.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good for her! Not many people think of cactus as food. It's definitely a healthy and tasty alternative in a lot of dishes. How much does she need?

replies.reply_text: She says about a pound. Is that possible? And how much will it cost?
Wow! Thanks! I think this will be exactly what she's looking for. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Herbivore? That would be an animal that only eats plants. Like those horses that roam around all over the desert.

replies.reply_text: I see, so the spines keep horses from eating a cactus. Interesting. I am not trying to be difficult, but why would they want to?
Oh, speaking of horses, I am going to hop on mine and get out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: As you have noticed, there is a lack of moisture here in the desert. Some cacti can help satisfy a thirst when there is nothing else around. Others are used for medicinal purposes.

replies.reply_text: Very interesting. I appreciate you telling me this. Can I come again to hear more?
Bor-ing! Good-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, come back anytime.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No bother.  You're looking for the sandpainter?  Go see Sani, next door.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our home.

replies.reply_text: Pillan?  I brought you that message from Yorick, and I know you gave me soup, but now I don't remember who I was supposed to bring it to.
Thanks, but I didn't mean to barge in.  I'll be leaving now.
Pillan? Hi, I am delivering a message from Yorick.
Thanks!  How are you this dazzling day?
Hi, Pillan! Did your wife like her anniversary present?
I believe I gave you the rodent.  What do you think?
Thank you, but I'm looking for a man who makes sandpaintings, do you know him?
Hello, Pillan! What a wonderful stock pot you've got there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, is this about hockey, then?

replies.reply_text: Yep. He wanted me to let everyone know that it starts in a couple of weeks. (Grumbles under breath.) First this island, then that island...
Oh, sure, why not? I'll just add it to everything else I keep having to carry on this quest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sure.  Go see Hudson on Turtle Isle.  He likes that soup, so be sure not to spill it or let it spoil.

replies.reply_text: All right. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm well, thank you for asking. Today is a bright day for me in another way - the anniversary of my marriage.  I'm giving my wife wishing coins as a present.  Sometimes I feel like she's married to that wishing well!

replies.reply_text: Huh.  I like to make wishes, too.  In fact, I think I'll go do that now.  Bye.
Why is she so addicted to wishing?  Do you need the money?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, she's wishing for things. She's hoping for a little pet, I think. She used to have a pet rat, before we married, but you can't get rodents around here.

replies.reply_text: I've never seen a companion come out of a well.  Maybe I could go find a pet for you to give her.  Wouldn't that make her happier than coins?
Yuck! A rodent? When I throw coins into a well, I hope that a rat doesn't come out! This is getting too creepy. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pillan suddenly becomes much more animated.) Oh, would you do that? I've been wanting to get her a gift that I know she would love, but it's hard for me to find the time to travel. Well! This will be just fine! What kind of a pet do you think we should arrange for her?

replies.reply_text: I'll bet she'd adore a gerbil.  They're very lively, and they know great jokes.  Besides, they're a breed well suited to the desert!  I'm sure I've seen one in a pet store.
I think she'd love another rat!  They're so intelligent!  I know there are sometimes very sweet rats to be found on prison isle...

chatpoints.chat_text: You seem to know what you're talking about.  A rat it shall be!  Please take this money for travel and expenses, and do hurry back... We're planning to exchange gifts in just a few hours!

replies.reply_text: I'll get right to it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Perhaps you're right.  A gerbil might just be the perfect present.  Please take this money for travel and expenses, and do hurry back... We're planning to exchange gifts in just a few hours!

replies.reply_text: I'll get right to it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank goodness, you've returned!  Did you have any trouble finding a rat?

replies.reply_text: No, not any trouble in the least.  I picked out a very sweet, gentle rat.
Oh, rats... Right.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank goodness, you've returned!  Did you have any trouble finding a gerbil?

replies.reply_text: No, no trouble in the least.  I found the wittiest gerbil.  You'll be amazed by his eloquence and charisma.
Oh, riiiight!  Anniversary... Gerbil... I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: It was just what she'd been wishing for all this time!  Now she only goes out to the well for water.

replies.reply_text: I'm very glad to hear it.
I'm sure she'll love it.
I'm sure she'll love it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, this is a most unique gift.  Now maybe she'll be able to stay away from that wishing well for a while.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Happy anniversary!

chatpoints.chat_text: You want Sani, he lives across the road.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. I don't know how we'd manage without it. It's perfect for soup or beans or cooking up stew. I would never get rid of it.

replies.reply_text: Drat! It's just what I'm looking for. Can you tell me where you got it?
I guess I'm just wasting your time and mine, then.  Guess I'll go tell Stinky he'll have to forget about his Red Beans and Rice recipe.

chatpoints.chat_text: A trader came through years ago. I don't think they make them like this anymore.

replies.reply_text: I really, really need one.
I was afraid of that. There's a recipe that calls for a big, copper-bottomed pot. Seems that the recipe won't turn out right without the right pot.
Looks like Stinky is out of luck, then. Thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's what Augie said! Word for word. He finally found someone willing to sell him one. However, he's decided making adobe bricks the traditional way is just too much trouble. Maybe he'll sell you his.

replies.reply_text: Augie?
I don't get the connection. Stock pot and adobe bricks? Don't you just mix mud and straw?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. He and his cat live out by Odysseus. He wanders around just to the east of the old man.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much for that information! I'll head over there now. Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there's more to it than that. Traditionally, the elders would cook up prickly pear cactus. They added dirt and grasses to the mixture until it was thick. The cactus juice was the glue that really held the brick materials together and made them more durable, once they were baked by the sun.

replies.reply_text: Boy. That does sound like a lot of work! Could you tell me where to find this Augie?

npc_list.name: Kele
npc_list.long_description: Kele is a cute, young girl who is very tan and barefoot.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't worry about Mooki.  He glares at everyone.  Just ignore him and come on in!  Make yourself at home.

replies.reply_text: Uh... All right.  Thanks, but I don't think I'm going to stay very long.
Thank you.  So, uh...  does Mooki make a good pet?
Guess what, Kele!  I've got a letter from Eliza for you!
Thanks, but I'm looking for someone who might make sandpaintings.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, the best!  See, he likes to fly, so he takes letters to my friend, Eliza.  She lives in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: That's sort of neat.  It must be fun having a penpal so far away.
That's cool.  Have fun writing your letters. Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is!  I'm afraid I haven't been able to send her any letters lately, though.  You see, Mooki hurt his wing, and can't fly.  Poor Eliza must be wondering why she hasn't gotten any letters from me recently.

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  Poor Mooki.  I hope his wing gets better.
Poor buzzard.  Hope he gets better.  I'm going to go, though.  He sorta creeps me out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it will.  In the meantime, I'm afraid Eliza just won't get any letters from me.

replies.reply_text: Maybe I could deliver your letter to her.
That's too bad.  Hopefully he gets better soon!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you?  Oh!  You're the best! Thank you!  Just let me hurry and add that Mooki hurt his wing, so she won't have to worry anymore.

replies.reply_text: Take your time!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do?  Oh my heavens!  Thank you so much!  I... I don't know how to even begin to repay you.  I know this isn't much, but I'd like you to take it!

replies.reply_text: Well, thank you!  I hope Mooki gets better soon!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Here it is!  Oh, I can't thank you enough.  Eliza lives up in Shellton, though I think I've mentioned that before.  Oh, just... Oh, thank you!

replies.reply_text: It's not a problem!  I'm glad I can help.  I'll have this letter delivered in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you want the grandfather.  He'll help you.

replies.reply_text: (You start to ask her who that is, but Kele has just picked up something very definitely dead and is feeding Mooki.) Er... Thanks.

npc_list.name: Fala
npc_list.long_description: Fala loves the desert. Many nights she sleeps outside. She has no fear of the desert creatures.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please come in!

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure that I can. Your door is rather small.
No thanks. I can't fit through your doorway.
I guess I can crawl through your door...
Thanks. Do you know of anyone here in Santon that does sandpainting?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure you can. Just duck down. Simple as that.

replies.reply_text: Great. Thanks!
Ahh... I don't think I want to.
Why do you have that easel?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right then. (Smirking) You could if you really wanted to.

replies.reply_text: (Looking annoyed, you simply leave without saying a word.)
Is that a challenge?  I love a good challenge!

chatpoints.chat_text: I never thought about that...  But yeah, go ahead. Whatever works for you.

replies.reply_text: Why do you have that easel?
Well, that was fun.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bye.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was just saying that you could come in if you really wanted to.

replies.reply_text: I know, and now that I am in here, I think I should have stayed outside.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine then.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love a painting of my friend done, but not many people are in these parts.

replies.reply_text: I could try to do it for you.
That's too bad.  Well, I should get going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  She has black hair, is generally tan and has cute, rosy red cheeks.  She likes blue, so her hair things are always blue.  Her shirt is blue, too, but her vest, purple.   Orange would be a nice complement for the background, too, I would suspect.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you want Sani.  He and Yepa live across the road.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Let me turn down the music so we can chat.

replies.reply_text: Wow, do you get many snakes in here, playing that snake charming music?
No, thanks. I have to be on my way.
I'm sorry to bother you but Venus sent me.
Hello again!  Long time, no see.  I have birthday presents for you from Betsy and Ben.
Where did I have to go for you again?
Great.  Well, you got the presents.  I actually found Ben in Tropicton running the general store there.
Hi there. You wouldn't by any chance have old fruit, would you?
Howdy!  I was wondering if you could help me.  I'm looking for a painting made of sand, any suggestions?
Hello, Bena! I've got a delivery of apples for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haha, no snakes, but we do see the occasional scorpion or lizard.

replies.reply_text: Scorpions and lizards? I'm not sure I want to see those either. I'll just go now.
Oh, I wouldn't mind seeing those. What is there to do here in the desert?

chatpoints.chat_text: You mean besides shopping? I have really good prices on my wares.

replies.reply_text: You do have good prices, but I am not really in a shopping mood. Goodbye.
I don't think I need anything right now. I was really just looking for an adventure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Adventure, you say? Well, you might spend some time searching the desert for a camel. I hear there are some out there.

replies.reply_text: Camels? Oh, yeah! That sounds like my kind of adventure. Thanks for telling me about them. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh really?  Let me guess, she needs more cinnamon?

replies.reply_text: Yes actually.  Does she always get it from you?
Oh wait, I need to go.  Sorry to bother you.
Okay.  I'll let her know.  Thank you.
Actually Betsy tracked him down with the help of Davy McGee.

chatpoints.chat_text: Where is he?  How is he?  Is he married?  Is he working?  Did he choose a career?

replies.reply_text: Slow down all ready!  Geez, you're as bad as your sister!  Ben is fine, he runs the General Store in Tropicton.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiling broadly.) Well, Papa always said that retail is in our blood! Oh look at this beautiful jewelry box from Betsy, I bet Rebecca carved it. Aw, and this incredible necklace from Ben, he always knew what I'd like. Would you mind bringing something back to Ben for me?

replies.reply_text: Come on, do I look like a UPS delivery person?  I gotta go, see ya!
Okay.
Okay, no problem.  Bye!  Oh, and have a Happy Birthday!

chatpoints.chat_text: You said you'd go to Ben's in Tropicton and then to Betsy in Carrotton.

replies.reply_text: Ben...Betsy...got it.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha! Not likely. Fruit disappears off the shelves as soon as I stock it. You might want to try in Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Paintings made of sand? You have to go see Sani and Yepa! They live here in the village.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will!
Thanks! And enjoy those apples!

npc_list.name: Felton
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 15
npc_list.long_description: Felton has thick horn rimmed black glasses on. He is in his late 40's but his hair is already completely grey. There are books cases filled with books on dinosaurs, and display cases of actual dinosaur bones in his home!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, traveler!

replies.reply_text: Hello.
I have a Tyrannosaurus bone for you!
Hi!  Waverly just sent me to ask if you needed anything fixed.
Hi!  I was wondering if you have seen Trigger's saddle pad around.
Hi! I'm wondering if you happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Hello, I'm looking for a retired fisherman who used to live around here.  You don't know who that might be, do you?
Hello.  I believe I may have something that belongs to you.
Hello! I am here to deliver a gift on behalf of Karee Dentin. Gosh, that sounds awfully formal!
Hi!  I'm wondering if perhaps you might know, or have known, a Miss Knight?  Or Miss Bishop, or Castle?
Hello there. I'm wondering if a rider came through here recently that talked about garden gnomes and cats choking him? Also, dinoasaur bones, which made me think of you.
Could you tell me what the strange rider talked about again? I can't quite remember.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't get out as much as I used to,  but I expect you travel a great deal?

replies.reply_text: Actually no.  I don't.
Yeah,  I get around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh...  Well then...  Nevermind.

replies.reply_text: Okay,  goodbye.
Well,  actually, I  do travel some.  Why?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I've heard rumor of an excellent Tyrannosaurus dinosaur bone buried at the southern tip of this island!

replies.reply_text: And...  I suppose you'd like me to go find it for you?
Hmm...  I don't have time right now.
That sounds really neat!  Do you want me to go get it for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would be most grateful.  I could pay too!

replies.reply_text: Okay,  I'll try to find it.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for your help earlier.  I actually have word of another possible location... In case you are interested...

replies.reply_text: Sure, go on...
No thanks, I don't have time now.
I have a Triceratops dinosaur bone for you!
Actually, I was wondering if you have seen Trigger's saddle pad around.
Actually, I'm wondering if you happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Hello, I'm looking for a retired fisherman who used to live around here.  You don't know who that might be, do you?
Actually, I believe I have something of yours.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well,  it's very far away.  I hear it's likely buried on the tip of the turtle head, on Turtle Isle!  Because of the distance involved,  I would pay more for this one if you manage to find it!

replies.reply_text: Whew...  That is a trip!  I'll try to bring it back to you!
Thanks.
Actually, it was a lot of work...  Could you pay me a little more?
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow.  You have been a tremendous asset to my studies!  Let me know if you want more work!

replies.reply_text: Sure.  What do you need now?
I don't have time right now.
I have found the Pterodactyl bone!
Actually, I was wondering if you have seen Trigger's saddle pad around.
Actually, I'm wondering if you happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Hello, I'm looking for a retired fisherman who used to live around here.  You don't know who that might be, do you?
Actually, I believe I have something of yours.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...   Do you have a magnifying glass?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I do.
Yes I do, but I don't remember how to use it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, you have a nice tool box that is shown with a wrench.  Just open that up and you can search for small objects.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, great.  Now,  I have reports in my journals of tiny Pterodactyl bones surfacing in Blow Hole Forest,  just north of here, on this very island.  They are tiny though,  so look carefully!

replies.reply_text: Great,  I'll be off then!
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for all your help!  I'm sure I will need more help soon.

replies.reply_text: Okay, bye.
Actually, I was wondering if you have seen Trigger's saddle pad around.
Actually, I'm wondering if you happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Actually, I'm looking for a retired fisherman who used to live around here.  You don't know who that might be, do you?
Actually, I believe I have something of yours.
