I don't even know that song.  Sorry I can't help.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not too hard if you want to just try.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll give it a try, I guess.  Do you know which key to start on?
Hmm...  No thanks.  I'm heading out now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Start the song on E.  It's the third key from the left.  Thank you for doing this for me.

replies.reply_text: Well, don't thank me yet.  We'll see how I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd offer you some cookies, but I'm all out of flour!

replies.reply_text: Drats.  I love cookies!
Oh, dear.  I hope you get some flour soon.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know!  It's such a shame, isn't it?  I just love baking cookies!  Apparently I love it so much, I used up all my flour.

replies.reply_text: Hmm... Cookies sound really good.  Maybe I should go get some flour for you.
I don't like cookies all that much.  Maybe someone else will get some flour for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Would you?  If you go and get me some flour, I can whip up a batch of cookies in no time!

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'll go get some flour!  Ah... Where should I go to get it?
Weeeell.  I think I'll go get it a bit later.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a little food store up in Wington.  Cara should have my flour ready and waiting.  I just haven't been able to go pick it up yet.

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  I'll go talk to Cara about getting that flour!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did you manage to get the flour?

replies.reply_text: You bet I did!
Uh, I was supposed to get you flour?  Oh, right!  Could you remind me where I'm supposed to go?
Oh, that sure is a nice piano you have there.
Not yet.  I'll just hurry and get it now.
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
Not quite yet.  I'm here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I can remind you!  Just go up to Cara in the Food Store in Wington.  She should have the flour all ready for you.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right!  Thanks a bunch!
All right!  I'll be back to see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Welcome back again! Please, have a seat!  Would you like a cookie?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, thank you!
No, thank you.  I was just admiring your piano. It's quite beautiful.
Thanks, but I'm just gonna go.  Bye now!
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
Hi there. (<l>You quickly explain the situation with Stacie.</l>) So, I didn't want to move her if it was a serious injury.
Not right now.  Thanks though.  I'm here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my!  I heard about that.  That was the night all my horses got loose!  I'll never forget it, I was so worried about them.  But we found them all.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  I'm glad you got them back, I'd be worried, too!  Did they all stay together?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they did, all except Mousy.  We found him off by himself on the northern end of the island, where those odd prints were.

replies.reply_text: Odd... You mean... How do you mean, odd?
Thanks!  Interesting, I'll go speak to the farrier.  Thanks for your help!  Bye!
I've already spoken to him--or tried to--but I'll try again!  Thanks, Elaina!
Thanks, I'll see what I can find out.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did the right thing. Tell you what. I'll tend to the child and you go tell her aunt. I'll bring Stacie to her as soon as I get her fixed up.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I'll head over to Art Isle right now. I'm sure Heather will be grateful for your help.
I'll let her know. Thank you!

npc_list.name: Tessa Strapp
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP11
npc_list.long_description: Tessa Strapp is a hard working, bubbly blonde.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!

replies.reply_text: Hi. Can I get a glass of water?  I am parched.
Hi. I'm in need of a new saddle.
(You are speechless while staring at the crumbling wall and water-damaged roof.)
Bye.
Hi! I'm looking for clues to the disappearance of Opal's "Star of Solomon".  Did you see or hear anything the night of the theft?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, you'll have to go somewhere else for that.  I don't have any clean water,  just what you see collecting in the buckets here and that's dirty water from the roof.

replies.reply_text: Really? Okay, then. Guess I'll have to go elsewhere. (Muttering... What does she drink?)

chatpoints.chat_text: I can help you with that.  I'll be honest and let you know that I don't have much.  I've got your high-end and your mid-range.  Nothing really cheap, but both ooze quality.

replies.reply_text: I appreciate your honesty. Truthfully, I am looking for something a bit cheaper. Thanks for your time. Bye.
Sounds good. I'll have a look around, then. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry about that. Oh, and I have excellent hearing, so to answer your question...  I drink the water from the leaky roof.

replies.reply_text: Is that healthy?!?
Really?  Umm...  Well, I'll be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Starts laughing.) Yeah, the place is a bit of a mess. I'll get it fixed up eventually.

replies.reply_text: Huh.  Well, I'm going to get out before something falls on me.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?
You better get on that.  You wouldn't want it to ruin your merchandise.

chatpoints.chat_text: I like to keep my customers happy.
Sure.
Actually, I've been so busy running the store that I haven't been able to get any supplies.  Would you be able to pick up some things for me?

replies.reply_text: Well...  I really don't want to do a bunch of running around.  Sorry.  Bye.
Sure thing.  What did you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I really wouldn't, but it will probably be a bit before I can get any patching up done.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to hear that.  I need to be going.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I really need to patch these holes.  Could you go visit Karl in Whiskerton?  He collects pitch from the pine trees in the nearby forest.  I'll need probably 3 buckets.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.
Go to a different island?  I don't think so.  Bye.
Okay.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!

replies.reply_text: Hi. I'm in need of a new saddle.
I got those pails of pitch for you!
What did you need me to do for you again?
Bit of a mess you have here still.  I'm outta here.
Were there any other supplies you needed me to get for you?
What was I doing for you again?
I got those planks for you.
You said there was one other thing you needed?
What did you need me to do again?
I got that bucket of nails for you.
How are the repairs going?
Hi! I'm looking for clues to the disappearance of Opal's "Star of Solomon."  Did you see or hear anything the night of the theft?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?

chatpoints.chat_text: Head to Whiskerton and see Karl.  He collects pitch from the forest.  I need about 3 pails' worth.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Be back soon.
Sounds good.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Probably not, but it's the only thing I have available.  The store is a bit in shambles.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Well, I'll be going.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I need wood to start working on the roof and walls.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Where can I get the wood?
Well, I'll come back a little later, maybe, and help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go get 10 logs out of the forest and bring them to Rebecca in Carrotton.  She works with wood a lot and should be able to shape them for what I need.

replies.reply_text: Carrotton?  There isn't even a direct route from here.  No thanks.  Bye.
Okay.
Great.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go collect 10 logs then bring them to Rebecca in Carrotton.  She'll make some planks for me.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Be back in a bit.
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  In order to actually get these boards up, I need some nails.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I can do that for you.
Oh, there's something else I need to do now.  Maybe I'll be back later.  Bye.
Sounds good.  I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see Liam at the local blacksmith.  He should be able to give you a bucket of nails I can have.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll be right back.
Thanks.  You know, Liam seemed pretty happy to help.
Thanks.  Good luck fixing stuff up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  I thought he would.  Thanks again for everything.  You've been a big help.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I hope the repairs go well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Slow, but good.  I'll get everything fixed eventually.

replies.reply_text: Good, good.  Have fun.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sorry, I don't know anything about it.  I was staying with a friend on Cat Isle that night.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  Thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard about that, I'm pretty sure.  What's going on?

replies.reply_text: She's gotten her new property and she asked me if I'd go around finding halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I vaguely remember hearing something about it.  What's up?

replies.reply_text: She's gotten her new property and she asked me if I'd go around finding halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't have any children's saddles, but I do have a really nice, old, used one here.  It needs to be cleaned and polished a bit, but I can sell it to her for pretty cheap.

replies.reply_text: How cheap is "pretty cheap"?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, say, $100?

replies.reply_text: That would be great!  I'll take it!
That's more than I've got with me.  Sorry, no thanks.
Thanks, this will do fine!  I'll get it to her right away.  Bye!

npc_list.name: William Sleapwhell
npc_list.short_description: Owner of The Colt of Wington
npc_list.long_description: William Sleapwhell is a well dressed man in his late 40's.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings! Welcome to my home. May it be a place you can hang your hat. Please come in.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! What a warm welcome.
I'll have to come back some other time.
Hi.  I wonder if you might remember anything about the night Opal Sandstone's "Star of Solomon" sapphire was stolen.
Thank you so much! I'm wondering if you could help me. I'm in search of a copper-bottomed stock pot.
Can I have some ashes from your fireplace?
Good day, Martina sent me with the menu choices for Holli's wedding.
So, is everything ready to go?
Thank you. Zachava said I might be able to get an onion and a head of cabbage from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's always warm here. Warm and relaxing. How can I be of service to you?

replies.reply_text: I'm in need of a nap. Can't seem to keep my eyes open.
I'm famished. Got any good grub?
I'm tired and hungry...
I just wanted to meet you and now I must go. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then, you have come to the right place, my friend. You'll see that I have it on my menu of services.  Just pick the nap option and you'll get a nice rest.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I do. Glad you asked. I would recommend the ham and eggs, but my wife is smitten with the stew. Take your pick; they will both hit the spot.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I happen to have a remedy for both. You can eat some delciously warm food and take a relaxing nap. That should make you new again.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a little strange, but whatever tickles your fancy. Come back sometime for my wife's stew. It's a treat!

replies.reply_text: All righty.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping by and come again.
Hmmm.  I remember that night.  Except for the theft itself, no, I can't say there was anything unusual going that night.

replies.reply_text: Or any time before or after?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really.  Well, one of the guests complained about a funny smell outside his window but that was all.  Never found out what it was.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A stockpot? That's interesting. I had a fellow in here a couple weeks back looking for one. But I couldn't help him, either. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Really? Do you know where he was from?

chatpoints.chat_text: I couldn't say. I told him to ask at the other inns around the island. Maybe another inn keeper could give you more information.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just gave my last bit to another traveler that came through asking. Sorry I can't help you!

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Have a nice day.
Thanks, I will! (You start nibbling on some cookies while waiting.)
(You pass the time looking out of the Inn's window, watching the horses entering the Draft Arena.)
Yes sir, Holli chooses 6 appetizers and the cutoff date on changes is 2 weeks prior to the wedding.  Thanks, see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes indeed you can! I've got some in the root cellar. Great stuff for soup! Let me grab you those. (William disappears for a couple of minutes and then comes back out with a brown paper bag.)

replies.reply_text: What do I owe you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a thing. This will be my good deed for the day. Just pass on the good will.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much. I will be sure to do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: A French Horn!  A most discerning gift, I must say!  Very classy!  Yes, as it happens, I have several in my collection.  What price range were you considering?

replies.reply_text: Considering whom this is going to, I'm interested in a good one, regardless of price.
Cheap.  Well, okay, inexpensive.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good morning there.  And what is it today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, really, just passing by.
I just came from Lucie B. Euro, she said she was a band student of yours, yes?
I'd like some information. I understand you know a thing or two about someone with an exceptionally beautiful voice?

chatpoints.chat_text: Lucie....?  Lucie.... Oh, yes!  Second Trombone!  A very capable student.   What about her?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking to buy a French Horn for ...a... friend of mine, and Lucie suggested you might have one.

chatpoints.chat_text: In that case, I have a very fine, nearly new French Horn which I might consider selling, or trading for.  From a very reputable maker, and with a grand sound.  I will sell it for $5,000.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  That's way too high.
Hmmm.  Okay, I'll take it!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's less than I paid for it!  A good instrument is very pricey, you know.

replies.reply_text: Yes, but that's out of my league entirely.  Sorry.  Do you have anything cheaper?
Oh, all right.
Thanks.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do have in my office ...and I must say, I have no idea why... an old horn that was used for many years worth of students.  The sound... is probably still passable although it doesn't have the great richness of tone that a good horn will have.  It needs polishing and some minor... well, let's just say I'll sell it very... cheap.  $500.

replies.reply_text: That's good enough.  I'll have that one.
Hmmm. Let me think now.... will Silver Mary be satisfied with an old one?  I don't dare go back and ask... Okay, I'll take the expensive one just be safe.
Thanks, goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, JUST a thing or two. A lovely, lovely lady with a voice sweeter than a nightingale. She came through town and then left almost immediately. Much to my sorrow. She said Bird Isle was just too small for two women of the same name.

replies.reply_text: Would you have any idea where she headed to after leaving here?

chatpoints.chat_text: She mentioned something about a groundskeeper. I believe it was her uncle? I think she was heading there. If you do find her, please give her my best regards. My very, very best regards.

replies.reply_text: Umm. Sure. Thanks for that tidbit. I remember seeing a groundskeeper on my travels. Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Liam Flux
npc_list.long_description: Liam Flux likes being a blacksmith but he doesn't like dealing with the customers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who's there?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Just me.  I was wondering about your horseshoes.
Wow, crabby man.  I guess I'll take my business elsewhere.

These are two different species of cocoa tree.  And these last two are Trinitario, a hybrid of the two, you see.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot!  Wow!  Well, I'll get these to Emma straight away!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, some of my gardeners have been asking for Jack's seeds.  They grow pumpkins so perfect.  It's almost magical!

replies.reply_text: Why not, he seems a little on the magical side himself.  Where do you want these?
No problem, but can I ask you something?  What's in these bags?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's ground cochineal.  I make it from dried beetles that are found in the cactus plants around here.  It makes the most fabulous shades of red.  Jack loves it.

replies.reply_text: How interesting...  So Jack uses this for red dyes and paints, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly!

replies.reply_text: Cool!  Well, I've got to get this back to Jack, see you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a lovely old couple who live in Santon who still do the native crafts.  Why don't you talk to them?

replies.reply_text: Santon?  I'll head right over there, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to Hotton Financial. How can we help you?

replies.reply_text: Why should I put money in your bank?
Yes, I'd like to deposit some money.
Actually, I don't think I want to make any transactions here.
Excuse me, but... why... (You look, slightly embarrassed, from one man to the other.) Uhm... Have you lost your voice, Mr. Nickelendime?
I found it!
What was I looking for again?
Pony Express delivery!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Harold whispers to Wesley.) Because if you don't, your money will likely blow away in the wind while riding your horse, and then you will probably regret it.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense to me,  good answer. So, I'd like to deposit some money now.
I don't think so...  I'd rather bury it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great. You can be sure that we'll take good care of your money. You can come back whenever you need to and withdraw. Let us know if we can help you further.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good decision. You can be sure that we'll take excellent care of your money.

replies.reply_text: Great.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Harold whispers to Wesley.) Actually, we don't need your business. Please don't come back begging to make a deposit.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay.  I guess I'll go to a different bank.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughing.) Go ahead and bury it. (Harold mutters.)

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.  I will.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Harold, noting your discomfort, goes off to do something else. Wesley leans forward, regarding you curiously.)
Actually, that's precisely his problem! He's lost his voice and he can't find it!

replies.reply_text: Oh.
He.... what do you mean, he can't find it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Wesley leans even closer, and talks very softly.) Well, apparently, he can only talk to people... other than me, unfortunately... when he's got Victor Voice with him.

replies.reply_text: I think I'll go to another bank!
Victor Voice?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Apparently there was... well, I don't know the whole story, but he had some kind of trauma as a kid while he was playing sock-puppets with his brother.  And ever since then, he won't speak out loud unless he's got Victor--that's the puppet's name.  But he was camel-trekking in the desert a few weeks ago, and a crazy monkey swooped down and stole the sock right off Harold's hand!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's (guffaw!) dreadful...

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll say it is!  Say, would you be willing to do the Hotton Bank an enormous service?  He said the monkey took it toward a big rock that sits all by itself in the desert, somewhere south-ish of here.  There's a reward in it for you if you can find it for me!

replies.reply_text: Sure, okay.  Sock puppet... There shouldn't be more than one of those in the desert...  I'll go look.
No thanks.  This is too weird.  Bye!
You're welcome!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Find Victor Voice.  Harold's sock puppet.  He said the monkey took it toward a big rock that sits all by itself in the desert, somewhere south-ish of here.  If the monkey isn't around anymore, maybe it buried it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: If the monkey isn't around anymore, maybe it buried it.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll remember that.  See you later!
Thanks.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Cadence
npc_list.long_description: Cadence is a happy and outgoing lady who loves gardening.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, come in, come in.

replies.reply_text: Hi, is there anything I can help you with?
I can't right now, I should be going.
Hi!  Evelynn said she lent you Nolan's cook book.  Do you have it?  Nolan would like it back.
Could you tell me if you've seen Trigger's bridle?
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
What was it you wanted from the smith again?
Hi, I talked to Mr. Flux...
What store was it I was supposed to go to, to ask about barrels?
I'm back.  No spare barrels at the food store.  Sorry I can't help you there.
Hello! What's that you're busily drawing?
Hi Cadence, can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi Cadence, can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi Cadence, I'm back with all the seeds! Oh, and Elaina said she's taking care of her own trellis.
Hi Cadence, I'm back from the blacksmith's with your things!
Thank you. Mehitabel asked me to try to find Archy.  Has he picked up their vegetable seeds yet?
Sorry to pop back in, Cadence, but where was Archy heading again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes.  My vegetable garden has so many weeds in it.  If you could do some weeding for me, you can have some of the vegetables that grow while you're there.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I can do that.
Weeding?  No thanks.  I should go.
Hunh... Okay... Well, anything apart from that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Thank you.

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Thanks!  I better hurry back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, I haven't.  Sorry dear, but try at the flower shop. Iris hears everything that's going on.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid not, dear.  I was away at the time.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, thanks for your time.  Bye.
Can do, I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: A mole trap, please.

replies.reply_text: Right.  Okay, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... From your tone, I take it that the old geezer wasn't very cooperative.

replies.reply_text: No, not really. He says he doesn't make traps. (You diplomatically decide not to tell her what else he said.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Honestly, that man... Well, there's got to be some way to keep the mole from eating my potatoes.

replies.reply_text: Well, you could always ask it politely, I suppose.
You could put up a "No Moles Allowed" sign.
Have you thought of growing your potatoes in pots or tubs?  Then the moles can't get in and you don't have to bend and stoop so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha, ha, ha.

replies.reply_text: Have you thought of growing your potatoes in pots or tubs?  Then the moles can't get in and you don't have to bend and stoop so much.
Oh, well, can't help you, sorry.
Okay, I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Food store.

replies.reply_text: Righty-o.
Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Apart from that?  Well... yes, there is something.  There's a mole that keeps eating my potatoes before I even know they're there.  I need a trap so I can catch him and put him somewhere else.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound like something I would enjoy doing.  Sorry.  Bye.
Sure, I can do that.  Where should I go to get it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm plotting out the garden! (Sighs happily.) I love springtime.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I saw your garden next to your house. It looked freshly planted, though.
It's a great time of year. I'll leave you to it.
I don't. Too much pollen. Makes me sneeze.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no. Mine is all laid in! No, for the last few years I've commandeered the community garden project. You've probably seen it, it's down by Dominique's house towards the south side of town. It's so nice to have fresh vegetables, and not everyone has the land. It's been a great project for the town!

replies.reply_text: That does sound like a nice way to bring the community together. Is there any way I can help?
It's kind of you to keep it together.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, that's very kind of you to offer! As a matter of fact I could use some help. Just a few quick trips within town. Could you do that for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure, why not?
No, I've got to go home and dust my garden gnome collection. You've just reminded me. Maybe another time, though.
Off I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were visiting my neighbors on the south side of town to pick up seed packets for the garden. There should be six in all.

replies.reply_text: Oh, how silly of me. I've already done that. Here are the seeds.
Oh, that's right. Forget my own head next. I'll go take care of that.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to Liam the blacksmith's to pick up some things he was making for me for the garden.

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'll go right now.
Okay, I'll head over there now.
Happy planting!
So it's off to Zamora, next?  Hope she knows where he is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Always a pleasure, I'm sure. Archy always stops in to see Zamora. That's where he was headed.

replies.reply_text: Right...Zamora.  Here goes nothing!  Thanks, Cadence.

chatpoints.chat_text: Careful!  Don't touch anything without gloves on.  I've just sterilized everything.

replies.reply_text: I don't have any gloves so I guess I'll just be going now.
Actually, I was just here to see if you still had Phyllis' broom?  She was wanting it back.
I'll be careful. I was wondering if you might have any horsehair laying around?
I won't touch anything, I just want to to find a painting made of sand...
Oh sorry.  Umm..  Do you need help with anything?
I won't touch anything. I promise.  By the way, what was I doing for you again?
No problem.  Here's your cleaning supplies!
Hello, Ed! I bet I can guess two things about you. You were a captain, and you've been to Santon! How'd I do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Phyllis Clipper? Ah yes, I remember her. Hold on a second. (Mr. Klippit goes into the back room and then returns with the broom) Here you go!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He looks at you like you're nuts, and then gestures around his immaculate and sterlized barn.)

replies.reply_text: Oh right. Obviously not. I'll just get out of your hair now. (You work hard to hold back a snicker at your little joke.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Sand?  Sand??  Do you see any sand in here???  If you're not a horse, get out!

replies.reply_text: Sorry!!
Okay. I can do that.  Bye!
You could have been a bit nicer about it, but all right, I'll head over there now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well a lot of help you are.  Geesh.  You're the one that offered and now you can't even remember?  You were getting my cleaning supplies from the general store.

replies.reply_text: I'll go get that now.
Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're wrong on both accounts. Now are you here on business or just to waste my time?

replies.reply_text: Wrong? Really? I'm confused. I found this, and you are the only person I know named Klippit. (You show Ed the engraving on the inside of the pocketwatch.)
Wasting your time? Guess I'll just toodle-loo on outta here then! See ya!
Sorry! Didn't mean to ruffle your feathers. Guess I'll just keep this for myself. Good-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ed looks stunned. As a matter of fact, he actually tears up!) That was my great-great grandfather's! I haven't thought about him in ages. He was an honorable man.

replies.reply_text: Then it is only right that I give it to you. Here, please take it.
Wow! I wasn't expecting a reward. But I sure appreciate it! Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Luke Straw
npc_list.long_description: Luke Straw is very proud of his store.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome!  I sell some of the best horse feed on the Isles.  How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, really?  What's so special about yours?
I don't need any help right now.  Thanks.
I just came from Quinn.  He is needing another pail of water.
I'm looking for some place to get a painting made of sand, any suggestions?
Hello.  I'm here to pick up some animal treats for the pet shop.

chatpoints.chat_text: Everything is grown and made with care right here on Desert Isle.

replies.reply_text: Well, that's neat.  I'll see if I find anything I need.

chatpoints.chat_text: Another one?!?  Wow, he's taking that water display of his seriously.

replies.reply_text: Yep.  He sure has a lot of water around his house.  So...  Can I have another pail for him?
Thanks.  I'll carefully take this back to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nothing comes to mind, sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  Thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he mention what he wanted, or just the regular?

replies.reply_text: It sounded like he just wanted what he normally gets.
You know what?  I have no idea.  I guess I better go talk to him again.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. May I help you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I need to heal my horse. They got into something, but I don't know what.
No, thank you. Just visiting.
Good day to you, Doctor! This might sound like a very strange question, but have you ever had patients who -erm- weren't of a four-footed persuasion?
Hello again, doctor! Could you please remind me what your recommendation was for scurvy?
Hello, Nerina sent me to pick up some medicine for her otter.
Hi!  I'm looking for a painting made of sand... Do you know who I might see?
Hi Doc!  I was wondering if you could help me...
Yes. Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
Yes, I'm here on behalf of Ricardo. He has a horse that won't sweat. We were hoping you'd have some advice.
I sure hope so! I'm looking for a dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Poor thing. When did it start getting sick?

replies.reply_text: When we stopped by a pond to relax after our daily run.
I don't know.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nods.) Did it happen to drink any water from the pond, by any chance?

replies.reply_text: Yes. It seems like it got sick a while after that.
No.  I don't know what's wrong with it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nods) That is all right. Probably just got a cold or something. A shot of antibiotics will help.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  That's a relief.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, sounds like it got something from the water.   There's always a chance of a horse getting sick from the water.

replies.reply_text: Oh, maybe I should just buy the pails of water from the feed shop.
Yeah, probably.  Can you help it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nods.) Yes, that would help, but don't fear the ponds, though. Most are clean, but even the cleanest of ponds have to have some bad in it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no worries.  I won't fear them, just be more cautious of them.  Thank you for your help.
Okay.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.  Just select that horse and we will heal it up good as new.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're welcome.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: If I remember correctly, I recommended 10 oranges, 10 strawberries and 10 rotten tomatoes for your seafaring friend.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Audrey looks startled for a moment, then nonchalantly leads you into a quiet corner.) Are you accusing me of treating people? I don't have the necessary training for that.

replies.reply_text: I didn't mean to sound accusing.  I'm desperately searching for help for a friend.  She refuses to seek medical attention herself, but she's afraid the end is near!
Never mind.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: An honest cry for help!  Your plea has not fallen upon a cold heart, dear.  I'll try to lend a bit of advice.  Who is your friend, and what are her symptoms?

replies.reply_text: Well, she's a member of a band of... uh... she's a... northern, ocean-traveling type.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, Never mind, dear.  I think I can understand perfectly why this friend of yours doesn't want to seek help. What symptoms are we talking about?  Pale and weak, and perhaps she has purple blotches on her skin?

replies.reply_text: How in the world did you guess?

chatpoints.chat_text: Your friend is almost certainly suffering from an early stage of scurvy.  It's unfortunately common in ahhh... seafarers like your friend.  Their diet is so poor.  All your friend needs is some fruits and vegetables, especially those high in Vitamin C.

replies.reply_text: That's easy enough.  So, I'll just take some oranges to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, oranges are excellent, but I think you should give her a variety of good foods that are high in vitamin C.  Perhaps you can persuade her to expand her diet.

replies.reply_text: What do you recommend, Doctor?

chatpoints.chat_text: Take 10 oranges to your friend; tell her to eat one or two a day until they're gone. Also, take 10 strawberries and 10 nice ripe tomatoes.  All these fruits are high in vitamin C, and have other properties that encourage good health.  We can hope she'll find something she likes, and therefore might continue to eat.  That's the best advice I can give you for now.

replies.reply_text: I only have one other question --  the only tomatoes I've ever seen in these isles have been rotten.
Are you kidding me?  That's SO much work gathering!  Forget this quest.  I'm going to search the desert for diamonds.
Thanks very much, Doc, I'll get right to work.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sandpainting is a native art form.  Why don't you ask around the desert?

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll do that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, if I can.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm looking to get a kitten.  Do you know if anybody around here might have any kittens that they are giving away?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I've had a couple litters of puppies lately, but no kittens.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Atreyu's friend? Sorry, I don't treat people. I'm not certified for that.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no! I'm sorry, I should've clarified. Falcor is a luckdragon, not a human.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I see. Never heard of a luckdragon, so I don't think I can really be of much help. Sorry. Good luck with your endeavor!

replies.reply_text: Darn. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: A horse with anhidrosis? We don't usually see them around here as we get dry heat, and it seems to be the humidity that really does those horses in, but I do know about it. What do you need to know?

replies.reply_text: Anything you can tell me!
Let's start with what causes it.
Anhi-what?
How do you tell a horse has it? I mean, couldn't it just be that he isn't hot?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, we don't know for sure what causes anhidrosis, but it seems to develop in some horses that have moved from a cool climate to a hot one- especially one that's humid. Other horses develop it as part of a metabolic problem.

replies.reply_text: Metabolic problem? Like what?
Huh, okay. How do you tell that a horse has it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Cushings for one- if you're not familiar with it, it's not the same as Cushings in people. You can think of it as a very rough equivalent to diabetes in humans. It also may be a symptom of a neurological problem.

replies.reply_text: Well, I hope that isn't what's going on in Ricardo's horse. How do you tell for sure that a horse has it?
I guess what I'm not sure of is- couldn't the horse just not be hot? How do you tell that the horse really has a problem?

chatpoints.chat_text: First of all, the horse obviously doesn't sweat, or just stops sweating adequately- but not because he isn't hot. A horse with anhidrosis will often take short heaving breaths, like a panting dog. They might have dry skin, and their hair coat often thins and falls out, especially around the eyes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, so it's really not something you could mistake. How do you start to treat it?
It sounds really rough on their systems. Does this mean that the horse isn't able to exercise any longer, since he can't cool himself off?
That doesn't sound good. How does it develop?

chatpoints.chat_text: First you make sure the horse is getting what he needs- that means plenty of water, so he can sweat, and supplementary electrolytes. You keep the horse in the shade during the hot parts of the day, and if he seems uncomfortable, put him behind a fan or give cold water rinses. Then scrape the water immediately off and rinse again, until the scraped water comes back cool.

replies.reply_text: Why scrape? Why not leave the nice cool water on them?
What about exercise? Can you even ride a horse that has this condition?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, most horses are able to exercise. But you need to be sensible about it. They should be worked in the early morning or evening, not at the hottest part of the day, and be mindful to cool them out properly afterwards. Work raises their internal body temperatures, and they absolutely should not be put away warm.

replies.reply_text: This sounds really serious. I guess the bottom line is- is there anything you can do for it? Can anything make a horse sweat again?

chatpoints.chat_text: There are some herbal remedies, and there's some anectodal support of a technique called acupuncture.

replies.reply_text: No medication then?
I'll head up there then. Thanks for all your help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Anhidrosis. It's the medical term for someone or something that doesn't sweat, or that doesn't sweat adequately to cool the body down.

replies.reply_text: Oh. How does that develop?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you leave the water on their bodies, the heat from the horse actually heats up the water again. It doesn't cool them off at all. So it's important to scrape it, so that whatever's left can start to evaporate. That's also why you keep hosing 'til what's scraped off runs cool.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see. So how do you even go about treating this?
Wow, I never knew that. I guess it's dangerous to work a horse who can't sweat, right? Since they can't cool themselves?

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you with that. Rumor has it that there is a new dentist around, but I'm not sure where her place is. Somewhere north of here, I'm sure.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for that bit of information. It may come in handy.

npc_list.name: Jean Stonwasht
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must begin at CP19
npc_list.short_description: Sales Associate at Karina's Boutique, Hotton

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, but I like this job, despite the people.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. Come again soon.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  He wants a full set of clothes for his daughter, but he wants them today. We are trying as best we can, but whatever.   How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: I would have hung up on him.
Oh no, thank you.  Hope it smoothes out in the end.  Goodbye.
Actually, I was wondering if there was anything I could do for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Snaps gum.) I know sir. We're trying our best. (Sighs.) Yes, I'm sorry, sir. Have a nice evening.

replies.reply_text: Well, I see you're busy.  See ya.
Hello.  He sounded mad.
Hi there.  This is probably an unusual request, but do you carry silk garments?
Hi!  I'm looking for a painting made of sand, can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: For me? (She snaps her gum while appearing to think.) Hmm.. You know, Karina is on a "research" trip, but she likes to be kept updated on the shop. Would you be able to run a package to her for me, since I can't leave?

replies.reply_text: I suppose I could do that for you.  Where is she?
Actually, I really don't have time right now.  I'll come by later when I can.  Bye!
Research?!  What kind of research would a shop owner be doing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Silk? Sure, I've got silk. (Snapping her gum.) Our racing silks are real silk. I believe it has better aerodynamic properties. Looking for silks?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm looking for silk, actually.  Could you possibly sell me some silk fabric?  White?  For a wedding dress.

chatpoints.chat_text: A silk wedding dress?  That's fancy...

replies.reply_text: It's for Princess Lilanna.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you must mean Shirley Slate's daughter!  How interesting.  I knew there was a daughter.  Haven't seen Shirley for a long time, not since she moved to the Distant Lands.

replies.reply_text: She's found a handsome prince.

chatpoints.chat_text: Handsome?  I hope so, for his sake.  Anyway, silk... silk... Any idea how much you need?

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.... That's a good question.  Kilye didn't mention if there was going to be a train or not... How about I buy enough for a fancy dress with a train, and bring back whatever's leftover on the bolt?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yes, that'll be okay, so long as there's enough left on the bolt to make something from. Hang on.
(Jean goes into a back room, and a short while later emerges with a good-sized bolt of white silk fabric.)
Here you go, I'll let you have this for $3000, and if there's any leftover, I'll buy it back.

replies.reply_text: (You stand around contemplating the ineffable concept of "finished with the laundry.")
(You stand around contemplating why frogs never turn into princes when you kiss them...)
(You stand around contemplating your own allergy to silk.)
(As you stand around contemplating, a song enters your brain and refuses to leave! You start to get really sick of hearing __________.)
Great!  I'll get this to Kilye right away!  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Jean suddenly affects a snooty accent, looking down her nose at you.) We don't sell art, we sell fashion!

replies.reply_text: Well, excuuuuse me!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She scoffs at you.) Well, fashion of course! I'm sure she will be able to enlighten you, if you care to ask her.

replies.reply_text: Umm..  okay. I suppose I can do this for you.  Where is she?
On second thought, I don't think I want to see what "fashion research" is.  Bye.
Great!  I guess I'll start in Tropicton.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks up, but continues speaking in the phone and lifts a finger telling you to wait a second.) Yes? Well, we should get that in within the next couple days. (Sighs.) No ma'am, I can't speed up the delivery. Please call back in a couple days and it should be here. Thanks. (She hangs up the phone and looks up at you.) Welcome back.

replies.reply_text: I can see you're busy.  I'll just go.  Bye.
Hi.  What was I doing for you again?
Hi there.  This is probably an unusual request, but do you carry silk garments?
Hi!  I'm looking for a painting made of sand, can you help me?
Hello.  I brought Karina the package, and she gave me this for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Snapping her gum.) You were delivering that package to Karina for me.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for Olav?  He stayed here while they were building his house.  In fact, he just recently finished the roof and moved into it.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Do you know where he built his house?
I'm sorry, but I'm not from around here.  Where is Sweltry Forest?
Great!  I'll go look.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I forget that not everyone knows this island like a native.  Sweltry Forest is the forest on the western side of Hotton.  Go all the way to the western side of the forest and you can't miss Olav's house.

replies.reply_text: So go west it is.  Thanks for the information.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you he built himself a house in Sweltry Forest.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, that's right.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodwin?  Oh!  Goodwin of the pigeons, that Goodwin!  Did you bring me a homing pigeon to release for him?

replies.reply_text: Yes! I have a pigeon for you. Here it is. (You hand over the pigeon.)
May it fly home safely!  Bye-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. I've got a customer who takes all that I produce. She uses it to amend her soil.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to organize our annual Ice Cream Social...  There's so much to do and so little time to get it done.

replies.reply_text: An Ice Cream Social?  That sounds like fun, in a old-fashioned kind of way, anything I can do to help?
Ice Cream here in the desert?  That sounds like too much work.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have the time to help me?  Oh, bless you!  It's going to be a few trips, but lets start with the basics.

replies.reply_text: A few trips, I don't have that much time. Maybe next time I'm in town.
All right, what do you consider "the basics"?
Ice Cream Makers and rock salt?  You're right, let's start with the basics!  I'll be back before you know it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my, I asked you to pick up the ice cream makers from Earton and the rock salt from Witherton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right Simon Goods and Zeke Sacker.  I'm on my way!
Sure, I'll check in the next time I'm in town.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you came back.  I have my ice cream machines, now I need my ingredients.

replies.reply_text: What sort of ingredients do you have in mind?
Why do I feel like a long and involved task is at hand?  Sorry, maybe next time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have my sugar, milk, cream and egg supply arranged.  I need my flavor ingredients and I'm all set.

replies.reply_text: Ingredients? As in more than one? I really don't have the time right now, sorry!
I'm not doing anything pressing at the moment, what do you need?
(Looking over the list.) Okay, I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're getting the ingredients for the ice cream.  Check your list!

replies.reply_text: The list?  Oh, I forgot, my bad!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's wonderful, let's have them.

replies.reply_text: Here are the bananas.
Here's the chocolate.
Here's your vanilla beans.
Here are your 50 strawberries.
Here are your 50 snowballs.
That's all I have with me right now. I'll come back when I have the rest.
That should be everything.
There's more...
I have to get the rest of the ingredients. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
I have more...
I have to get the rest of the ingredients. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
Ready for more?
I have to get the rest of the ingredients. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
There's more
I have to get the rest of the ingredients. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
There's more.
I have to get the rest of the ingredients. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
Thank you!  Enjoy your Ice Cream Social!

npc_list.name: Ormand
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 8
npc_list.long_description: Ormand is a relaxed bachelor. His life is quiet and simple and he is happy.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you want?

replies.reply_text: Oh, nothing.  I was just dropping by to say hi.
Nothing! Geeze.  Bye.
I just wanted to ask a question...
Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for Archy.  Have you seen him recently?
I'm really sorry to bother you again, but where did you say that Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi?  Well, there, you've said hi.  Now be off with you!

replies.reply_text: You don't have a lot of stuff, do you?
All right, all right.  Try to be nice to someone...

chatpoints.chat_text: What?  No!  And it's no business of yours what I have, or don't have!  Now go!

replies.reply_text: I bet Lajita would be willing to share some of her special stew with you.
You're right.  It's not any of my business.  I'll just go, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't want no stinkin' stew!  Now off with you!

replies.reply_text: I'm going to get you some stew.  It will probably cheer you right up!

chatpoints.chat_text: Back again, are you?  Didn't you get it the first time?  Go away!

replies.reply_text: Look!  I brought back some of Lajita's stew.  You should eat it up while it's hot.
Wait.  Wasn't I supposed to be doing something for you?
Eeep!  Crotchety old man!  Goodbye.
I just wanted to ask a question...
Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for Archy.  Have you seen him recently?
I'm really sorry to bother you again, but where did you say that Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: No!  I told you I didn't want no stinkin' stew!  Especially if it's that Lajita's!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right!  Thanks for reminding me!  I'll be back with that stew in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: What?  You brought stew even after I told you no?

replies.reply_text: Yep.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... ah... thanks?  Here, this isn't much, but I gotta give you something for bringing this stew I didn't want in the first place.

replies.reply_text: Thank you very much!  Enjoy the stew!

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you doing back here?  Go on, git!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right already.  Geeze, Mr. Cranky.
(Without a word, you push in past Ormand, and spread the large, glorious teal and aqua rug across the floor of his cabin.)
(You slam the door on your way out of the house, then sneak around to peek through a crack between the boards of the cabin's walls.)
I just wanted to ask a question...
Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for Archy.  Have you seen him recently?
I'm really sorry to bother you again, but where did you say that Archy went?
This is simply a gift.  I know you don't want it, but you have to take it.  It's not from me.  I'm not going to tell you one word about who it's from, because you mustn't give it back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're crazy!  You force your way into my house and insist I take things?  Git out of here!  You know how to use the door!

replies.reply_text: (You slam the door on your way out of the house, then sneak around to peek through a crack between the boards of the cabin's walls.)
Yep, I've had enough of this.  The rug is delivered.  Bye.
(You leave silently.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I got no time for annoying people with bothersome questions... Now GIT!!

replies.reply_text: What a grouch!
The old folks town?  Oh, you must mean Flipperton!  Thanks Ormand.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you he went over to the old fogies' town...now git!!

replies.reply_text: Old fogies?  Oh, you mean the retirement village on Dolphin Isle.  Thanks again, Ormand. Now I'll be a gitting out of your way.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Elliott
npc_list.admin_description: Elliott 'borrowed' Sabella's mare, apples

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hi.

replies.reply_text: Hi.  What are you doing by yourself out here?
Why did you take Apples?
Hi, Elliott.  I have something from your Grandfather!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nothing...

replies.reply_text: Umm, okay.  Just be careful.

chatpoints.chat_text: Umm...  I just wanted to take her for a ride.  I was going to bring her back in a little while.

replies.reply_text: Well, Sabella has been very worried about her!  Why didn't you just ask?
You shouldn't have taken her.  Now let me have Apples so I can bring her back to Sabella.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was afraid Sabella wouldn't let me ride her.  She's overly  protective of this horse.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  You should have asked anyway.  I'm going to take her back now.
Probably for a reason.  She doesn't need little boys stealing her horse!

chatpoints.chat_text: I wasn't stealing her!  I was going to bring her back!

replies.reply_text: Well, give her to me now and I'm sure there won't be a problem.
You may need to go apologize to her and help her out some before she lets you near her horse again.
Well, you'll have to see.  I'm bringing Apples back now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay.  I'll do that.

replies.reply_text: Good.  Bye.
I'm sure your Grandfather will love this picture.  Enjoy your candy!

chatpoints.chat_text: What is it?  Is it candy?

replies.reply_text: Actually... Yes.  It is.  Here you go!

npc_list.name: Veronica
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 9
npc_list.long_description: Veronica is a very harried mother of several children.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cam!  You give that back to your sister right now!

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Is there anything I can do to help?
I'll be leaving now.  Kids freak me out.
Hey Veronica... What's your favorite color?
I'm sorry to bother you, but have you seen a blue tube man with wavy arms by chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  You could get me something to distract these guys for a little while.

replies.reply_text: What did you have in mind?
Sorry.  Not really in the mood for running errands.  Bye.
There's a piano over there.  Would that distract them some?

chatpoints.chat_text: A guy in Appleton makes balloon animals.  If you could have him make 3 for my kids, that'd be great.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.  Do you know his name or where in Appleton he lives?
Alright.  I'll do that.
Appleton?  I'm not running all the way to Appleton!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think his name starts with an 'R'.  I know he lives on the east side of town, though.  Sorry I don't know more.

replies.reply_text: That's fine.  I'll go get them for you.
Well, I'm not going to wander all over down there not knowing where I'm going.  Bye.
Thanks.  I'll be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cam!  Play nice with your sisters!  Oh, did you get the balloons yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.
I couldn't find that guy that made them...  Do you remember anything more?
Yep.  Here they are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really.  Just that he wants to be a clown, his name starts with 'R' and I believe he's near the eastern border of Appleton.

replies.reply_text: Alright, that should help.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, before you go.  Make sure the animals are all the same.  I would hate for the kids to fight over which one is better.

replies.reply_text: Alright, will do.  Bye.
I'll leave you to tend to your kids...
You know, it did cost a bit to get down there and I had to pay $35 for them...

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for getting those balloons.  They've been sitting playing with them so quietly.

replies.reply_text: I'm glad.  Bye.
That's great.  Oh, that's a neat piano.
Hey Veronica... What's your favorite color?
I'm sorry to bother you, but have you seen a blue tube man with wavy arms by chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's all I had on hand right then.  Sorry.  I guess I can at least give you the money for the balloons.

replies.reply_text: That would be nice.
No, that's all right.  I should go.  Bye.
Thanks.  That does help.

chatpoints.chat_text: It would.  They love Three Blind Mice.  If you were able to play all of that, it might calm them down some.

replies.reply_text: I guess I can try.
I guess I can try.  Do you have any hints on how to start it?
I really don't have time to try to figure that out right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, start on E, the third note.  You will have to jump up to the highest note, the C, at a couple points in the song, too.

replies.reply_text: All right.  That helps.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks.  It helps to distract the kids when they're rowdy.  If you wanted to play them something, it would probably help keep them pacified for a bit longer.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I could do that.  What song did you have in mind?
I really can't play piano.  Maybe I'll try later sometime.  Good luck with the kids.

chatpoints.chat_text: They love Three Blind Mice.  I'm sure they'd love to hear the whole thing.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll try.
I guess I can try.  Do you have any hints on how to start it?
I really don't have time to try to figure that out right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, heehee. That's all right, I won't tell her.  So you wanted to know my favorite color?

replies.reply_text: Yes, for no particular purpose, of course.
Actually, no. Never mind. I have to go!
Red? Cool, I'll tell Ro- I mean- umm... thanks! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: My favorite color? Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Ohh... Well... I was just curious, that's all. No reason.
Rosemary wants to know, for your birthd- oops! I shouldn't have told you that...

chatpoints.chat_text: A what?  No, I don't think...  Cam!  Now what did I say about putting things in outlets that don't belong?

replies.reply_text: My goodness!  Well, I'll be on my way now...

npc_list.name: Cosmo
npc_list.long_description: Cosmo is a man with a vision. You find him and his home "shop" thoroughly entertaining.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, come in!  Would you like me to tell you your future?

replies.reply_text: I actually just came to give you this letter from your sister.
Sure!  This could be a bit fun.
I guess.  I don't really believe in that stuff, though.
If you insist.
No way!  I'm outta here.
No thanks.  I do have a package for you through the Pony Express!

chatpoints.chat_text: A letter from Rainey?  Oh, that's great!  I've been worried about her.  Moving so far away and all alone, too, but I knew she'd be all right.

replies.reply_text: That's good.  She misses you a lot.  Perhaps you could write her a letter, and I'll give it to her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  I knew you'd be coming, so I've already written a letter!

replies.reply_text: Why, that's simply amazing!
I'll hurry back faster than lightning!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then, just let me pull out my trusty deck of cards.  Now, if you'll pick a card out of these three.

replies.reply_text: I'll take the queen of hearts!
How about the ace of spades?
Hmm... That joker looks pretty promising.
Maybe I'll pass.  I'll come back later, though!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  You'll have a good life, filled with horses that love you!  There's also a good chance for lots of friends!

replies.reply_text: That's awesome!  Thanks, Cosmo.  That made my day.

chatpoints.chat_text: You must be the adventurous sort.  There's lots of adventures, quests, and tasks that will take you to all four corners of the isles!

replies.reply_text: That sounds just like me!  Great, I can't wait to get started.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're such a goof!  I bet you make people laugh all the time.  Here's for your future, filled with laughter!  And probably a good joke or two.

replies.reply_text: That's so right!  I am a bit goofy.  Bye Cosmo!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right!  Here, why don't we just gaze into the crystal ball?

replies.reply_text: Well, all right.
No, I think I'm gonna head out.  This future telling stuff is stupid.

chatpoints.chat_text: The mists are beginning to clear.  Ah, I can see, yes.  It's coming through quite clearly now.  Would you like me to continue?

replies.reply_text: Might as well.
This is stupid.  I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Ah, yes.  No matter what you set out to do in life, you'll succeed.  Never give up and you can do anything!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right.  Thanks.  I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose I must insist.  Here, which palm would you like me to read?  Your left, or your right?

replies.reply_text: Left.
Right.
Neither!  I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo.  A long life line.  That's good.  Ah, and see this one here?  It means you'll be rich and famous some day.  Aaw, how sweet!  All your horses must love you to death!  Want me to go on?

replies.reply_text: I guess so.
No!  This is so stupid.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Oh!  This one is good.  See, it says you're a great person, and you're destined to have a lot of friends!

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess that's good.  Thanks... I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tsk tsk.  This doesn't look good... Oh, wait.  No!  It's fine.  There was just a piece of dirt there.  Want me to really give it a read?

replies.reply_text: Ah... Okay?
No way.  You creep me out.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  Let's see.  You have a very sunny disposition most of the time.  Your horses must really appreciate that.  Oh, and this one says you're gonna be around for a loooong time!  That's great!

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  Thanks.
Umm okay.  Thanks.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Lief
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 9, 15
npc_list.long_description: Lief is a friendly looking man who obviously adores his daughter.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. How are you?

replies.reply_text: Good. (Notices the swollen eyes.) Are you okay?
Good, good! Just riding through. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am. Thank you for asking.

replies.reply_text: Are you sure? You look really miserable.
You look miserable and I'm hoping it isn't something that's contagious - see ya later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm fine - it's just this allergy I have.

replies.reply_text: Allergy? To what?
Allergy?? I'm sure that's contagious! I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Leans in close to whisper.) Flowers!! I'm allergic to flowers. Daisies, dandelions, wildflowers - any kind you can think of. But my daughter LOVES bringing them home, so what can I do?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no! I wish there was something I could do to help.
Boy, that sounds like a definite problem. Hope you get it worked out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually Ben Burlap over at the Tropicton General Store has a medicine made on the isle that has helped in the past.

replies.reply_text: Wow, good luck with getting that here from way over there.
I am heading that way.  I could pick it up for you.
I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there.  Did you get the medicine?

replies.reply_text: Umm, no sorry, where was I going again?
Yes.  Here it is. I hope it helps.
No, I changed my mind. Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ben Burlap at the Tropicton General Store has it.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I am back on my way.
Thanks. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there. Thanks again for picking up that medicine for me.

replies.reply_text: Happy to help. Do you need any other help? I've got some time on my hands today.
Hello again, and you are very welcome. Just came by to check on you. You look good, so I'll head back out.
You are more than welcome. That said, I think there was something I was doing for you. Can you remind me?

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, I do. Would you be able to pick up a package from Vivian for me? My daughter loves horses, but that's not something we can afford. Vivian said she'd create a coloring book of horses, so I am hoping that brings Talucia a bit of happiness. She is such a delightful child and I do hate disappointing her.

replies.reply_text: Horses are expensive to keep, so I understand your dilemma. I still love coloring books, and if I had one of horses, well, I'd sure be happy. So, sure, I can certainly go to Vivian for you.
I might be able to, when I have some time. But today I'm too busy. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: I did! She has her mother's smile.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, Hello!

replies.reply_text: Did you get the picture of her smile? She has such a great smile!
Hello to you, too! And now, good bye, good bye!
Will do! I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to pick up a coloring book from Vivian for my daughter.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll head over there now.
Yes indeed! And I did! So here it is!

chatpoints.chat_text: That looks amazing. Please give it to my daughter. I want to take a photo of her reaction. (Lief gets his camera ready for the big moment.)

replies.reply_text: Happy to do that!

npc_list.name: Autumn
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP20
npc_list.long_description: Autumn is a loving, young mother in her 20's. She has shiny hair cut shoulder length and she has bangs. She is always smiling and her eyes sparkle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my home! Please do come in.

replies.reply_text: No, that's okay.  I see you are in your pajamas and I do not want to disturb you.
Well, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you like some oatmeal?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I would love some.
No thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! Can I ask a favor of you?

replies.reply_text: I would love to but I should really be leaving now.
Sure, what do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: It was nice to meet you. I hope you enjoyed the oatmeal.

replies.reply_text: You bet, Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am wondering if you could read my son a book while I do these dishes?

replies.reply_text: I would love to! Thanks for asking.
You know, that's not really my cup of tea. I don't do well with kids. Sorry, I'll have to pass on that one.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's no bother to me but if you insist. Thanks for stopping by.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.
Well,  I guess I'll come in then if it's no problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, I won't make you eat my famous oatmeal.  Your loss.

replies.reply_text: Wait!  I changed my mind.  May I please have some?
Well,  I just don't like oatmeal.  Sorry, no offense.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here is his favorite book.
That's not a problem. I understand. Thanks for visiting.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! Here is the book, 'The Three Little Birdies'

replies.reply_text: (READ) Three little birdies went out one day to catch some worms for their mommy...
I am sorry.  I don't have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Baby cries loudly.) Oh my, you have upset my child terribly... Off with you now...

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  Bye.
This oatmeal is delicious.
I don't see why this oatmeal is famous. Just your average oatmeal to me.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are eating my son's oatmeal which has different ingredients. Try eating the one I gave you.

replies.reply_text: Ooops!  Mmm   you're right,  much better.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Child looks at you, uncertain what to think.)

replies.reply_text: (READ) They looked and they looked but only saw bugs...
Hmm.. I have to go now.  Sorry I didn't finish the book.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Child stares at you interested.)

replies.reply_text: (READ) Their dear friend, Spunky the City Squirrel, said he could help....
I have to go now.  Sorry I didn't finish the book.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Child smiles as you are reading.)

replies.reply_text: (READ) So he took them to a garden that had just been watered....
Well, I have to go now.  Sorry I didn't finish the book.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Child is giggling with excitement)

replies.reply_text: (READ) The birdies were so happy, for Spunky had found them a pile of worms to bring to their mommy.
I have to go now.  Sorry I didn't finish the book.
No problem!  Have a nice day.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do YOU want!  Haven't you upset my child enough?

replies.reply_text: Nothing,  goodbye.
I'm real sorry.  I'd like to read that book now if it's okay?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for entertaining my child earlier. (Child smiles at you.)

replies.reply_text: You bet.

npc_list.name: Breezy
npc_list.long_description: Breezy is a younger woman who has an air of mystery about her...

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my home. You are welcome to rest, if you like.

replies.reply_text: I must be on my way, thanks!
Do you know anything about Tail Forest?
Hi there.  Anything interesting go on around this place?
Hi.  What was it you wanted again?
Okay, here it is.  A ruby necklace.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, goodness!  There is an old myth about it!

replies.reply_text: Please, go on!
I'm not interested in stories.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, in fact, just east of here is said to be a forest path that leads to an enchanted meadow.

replies.reply_text: Enchanted?!  How so?
Yeah, right...  And I've heard Santa is REAL, too!!  Ha!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: By a unicorn!

replies.reply_text: Ha!!  I doubt It!  I don't have time for this.  Bye.
Hmm...   Maybe I'll go check it out.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Interesting.... hmmm, interesting!  Well, the aura of the trees has changed from Kelly green to puce...

replies.reply_text: I see... and what does that mean?
Oops, I just remembered, I have to run home and dust the cat.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm glad you asked!  Now generally, a change in aura to puce, in anything, not just trees, indicates the coming of October.

replies.reply_text: Uhm... Yes, but... October comes inevitably, once a year.
I'm sorry, I have to go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, the month people call October comes once a year, but the concept of... (She gets a faraway look and slowly waves her hands in the air.) OCTOBER can overwhelm one at any time! It brings feelings of drought and sewing, you know. Overwhelms one with a sense of chimney sweeps. Puce. October. A depressing time.

replies.reply_text: I can see how that would be a problem.  Well, what's to be done about it?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's the dandelions' fault, you know. Yes! Sometimes they bloom again in the month called October, and this confuses the trees! The dandelions must be stopped!

replies.reply_text: Obviously.  How does that need to be done?
Well, I'll leave you to it, then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks deeply into your eyes.) There is something, and you can help! I need a Ruby Necklace! By wearing a ruby necklace around my neck, or maybe tied to my elbow, I will be able to convince the dandelions that my power to produce shades of RED is greater than theirs! They will bend before my will! October will be dispelled!

replies.reply_text: Well, they sell really nice ones on Rock Isle, so if I were you, I'd head there.  Bye!
Ooooo-kaaaaaay, so, uhm.... Would you like me to fetch you a ruby necklace, then?
Okay, I'm on my way.  I'll try to be back before the aura becomes mauve.
Oh... I think I may have one here.  What about this?

chatpoints.chat_text: A ruby necklace!  And one with a chartreuse aura would be best!

replies.reply_text: Rrrrright.  I'm on it.
Oh, uhm... thank you very much.  Yes, indeed.  Well, I'm off!  Good luck!

npc_list.name: Spider
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP14
npc_list.long_description: Spider is big and mostly black. He has brownish legs and is very soft.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Spider has etched the word HELP in its web.)

replies.reply_text: Holy smoly?  That must be a coincidence!  Wow!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Spider slowly adjusts his web, and the word NO appears.)

replies.reply_text: You... you mean you can understand me?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Spider slowly adjusts his web, and the word YES appears.)

replies.reply_text: This is too weird.  I have to get out of here!
Can you talk?

chatpoints.chat_text: (A voice so small and faint you have to bend down to hear.) Yes.

replies.reply_text: Holy smoly!
Now I'm really creeped out!  I need to go and lie down.  Bye!
I'd like to help you... but no one would believe me!  See ya!
Wow! That's amazing. Hey, would you have any spider silk just laying around? Unused? That I could have?

chatpoints.chat_text: Please help me!  I know it's a lot to ask...

replies.reply_text: Well, ummm... I'm really busy right now...  Maybe later.
If I help you, then the next thing you know every talking insect would be asking me for something!  No way!
What kind of help do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: About 2 weeks ago some people came in here and spotted my little brother.  I heard them coming and was able to hide, but they put my brother into a jar!

replies.reply_text: Well, that sounds about right!  I think I'll put you into a jar, too!
How awful!  But what can I do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Please find my little brother!  He's so young and he's probably scared.  I heard one of them mention something about a pet shop in the desert.

replies.reply_text: I dunno... The desert, you say?  I sunburn real easy.  I don't think I'm the one to help you.  Bye.
Is there anything else you can tell me?
I really hate snakes and scorpions.  I don't think so.

chatpoints.chat_text: That was all I heard them say... but my brother is very pretty.  He has a beautiful bright blue mark on his back.  It's quite unique.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like he's poisonous!  Too risky for me, no way!
Well, I can go ask around, but I'm not promising anything.
I'll be back hopefully soon... Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back!  Did you find him?

replies.reply_text: Here he is!  All safe and sound!
No, sorry.  I looked everywhere.  Is there anything else you remember?
Not yet.  Sorry, I'll keep looking.
You're welcome.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I didn't hear them say anything else.  All they mentioned was a pet shop in the desert.  Please find him for me!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll look some more. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  Since you were so kind to rescue my brother, I'll give you a hint to a treasure, if you want.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I'm glad I could help.  I don't really need a treasure, though.  Thanks.
It was really no problem.  So...  what about this treasure?
Excuse me, would you have any spider silk just laying around? Unused? That I could take off your hands?
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks again for finding my brother.  I hope you found that treasure all right.

replies.reply_text: I did.  Thank you very much.
I didn't...  You wouldn't be able to give me a hint again, would you?
I sure did. Thanks. I was wondering if you would have any spider silk just laying around? Unused? That I could take off your hands?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just look closely by the double palm trees and the driftwood that are west of here.  Good luck.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: You want spider silk? What for?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and how hummingbirds need it for their nests.)

chatpoints.chat_text: For that kind of spider silk, you'll have to go ask the "Spiders of the Skulls," as I like to call them.

replies.reply_text: That sounds too creepy for me! I'm outta here.
Yikes. That sounds creepy. Kind of makes me nervous.

chatpoints.chat_text: Makes me nervous, too! A skull in the desert is not my idea of a great place to live. Nope, give me beach-front property any day and I'm one happy camper.

replies.reply_text: Okay, sounds like I need to head to the desert and look for some skulls. Anything else I need to know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, be careful. Morticia is deadly and Elvira is not much better. Carlotta isn't too bad, but watch out for those fangs.

replies.reply_text: Yikes. Thanks for the warning. Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Harmony
npc_list.admin_description: &+  New quests must begin at CP 22
npc_list.long_description: Harmony lives in her own musical dream world. She is sweet and fragile.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings. Would you like to hear some piano music?

replies.reply_text: Sure. That sounds nice.
No, thank you.
I found your harmonica!
Actually, I was just curious about where you thought your harmonica was again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful, please have a seat on the couch. Make yourself comfortable and I will play a classical piece.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.
Hmm... Actually, I can't stay for that long. Thanks though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, nice talking to you.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you rather hear a piece that I wrote?

replies.reply_text: Sure, that sounds neat.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wrote it for someone special. (Her eyes start to get all dreamy looking.) His name is Willow and he is a lovely person.

replies.reply_text: Wow, not sure I should be hearing this.

chatpoints.chat_text: (While playing the song she starts to sob.)

replies.reply_text: (You roll your eyes and run out the door.)
Harmony, what's the matter?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She watches you run out the door, and throws herself against the piano, crying even harder.)

My sister and I are both in love with the same man and we fight about it all the time. Last fight we had she took the harmonica Willow gave to me and hid it. I haven't been the same since. It's the only gift I ever got from him and I cherish it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that is so sad. Do you have any idea where it might be?
That's too bad. I think I will let you have some alone time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have heard a rumor or two. But I am caretaker of this community and cannot leave to find it. Could you help me?

replies.reply_text: I would love to help you. What have you heard?
I wish I could, but I don't have enough time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you!  The last rumor I heard was that it is buried in the retirement community on Dolphin Isle, behind our Swedish grandmother's house.

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good Luck!

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for finding my harmonica!  It makes me so much happier!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.
I'm glad.  Is there anything else I can do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have hardly stopped playing my clarinet since you brought it!  Thank you so much.

replies.reply_text: I'm happy you like it.
You are more than welcome. And now, I've got something else for you! I'm delivering a toothbrush from Karee Dentin, Wington's dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, there is.  I gave my clarinet to a student who needed one some while ago, but I never did get around to replacing it.  It's time now, though. I really miss it.

replies.reply_text: That was really nice of you.  How can I help you get a new one?
I don't have any idea where you'd find a clarinet.  Good luck in getting one, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: I got my last one from Xamba on Jungle Isle.  He makes all kinds of musical instruments.  Would you please go see if he has another?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, he's too hard to find.  Maybe you can ask him next time you're on Jungle Isle.
Sure, I can do that.  Do you think it will be expensive?
You're welcome.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, do you have my clarinet?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I've forgotten where to get it.
Yes!  Here it is.
Not yet.  I'll go get it now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Xamba should have one, remember?

replies.reply_text: Oh yes!  I'll go see him.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't wait to start playing.  Hurry back!

replies.reply_text: Will do! Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much!  It's beautiful.  I can hardly wait to play.

replies.reply_text: Actually, Xamba suggested I ask you to play for me.  Would you mind?  I'd love to hear it.
Well, enjoy!
