chatpoints.chat_text: Well, please remember, I haven't played in a while. I'm rusty. But if you do want to hear it - okay. (Harmony plays a few random notes, then a couple of scales. After a few minutes of noodling around, she begins a complex jazz solo full of runs and trills. She is breathless when she finishes.)

replies.reply_text: That was incredible!  You don't seem rusty to me.
I'm happy you like it.

chatpoints.chat_text: The last rumor I heard was that it is buried in the retirement community on Dolphin Isle, behind our Swedish grandmother's house.

replies.reply_text: I'll head that way now.  Bye!
I'll be sure to tell her. Have a great day.

npc_list.name: Willow
npc_list.long_description: Willow is a shy, polite and orderly man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh... Hi there. (Looks down at the floor.)

replies.reply_text: Hello. I saw your cabin as I was touring your community and I was wondering if I could have a glass of water?
I'm sorry to disturb you.  I'll be on my way now.
Hello. I've brought you something. Its from Karee Dentin, Wington's dentist. Here, please take this.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you aren't disturbing me. I am um... just a little shy. Please come in.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  I need to be somewhere else right now, anyway.
Okay.  If you insist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. Please come in. How about a glass of freshly squeezed lemonade instead?

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I am absolutely parched.
Oh, that's all right.  I'm actually not thirsty at all anymore.  Don't know what I was thinking.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Um... Do you need anything else?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  You have been very kind.
Well, actually, I couldn't help but overhear these two young ladies fighting over a love interest and I am pretty sure it was you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great, then.  Thanks for stopping by.

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, that's all right.  I need to be somewhere else right now.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can I help you with something or are you just wanting to chat?

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, I couldn't help but overhear these two young ladies fighting over a love interest and I am pretty sure it was you. You are Willow, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I am and you must be referring to Harmony and Melody. They are always either fighting over me, bringing me gifts or blowing me kisses.

replies.reply_text: And you don't like the attention?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not that so much, it's just that I am very shy and don't know how to handle all this affection and there are two of them.  They are sisters and I couldn't pick one over the other. That just isn't right.

replies.reply_text: Wow, sounds like you have a plate-full there. Good luck with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gee, thanks. I am just hoping that another younger man will move into the community soon that they can adore instead.

replies.reply_text: I would love to stay and chat more, but I have to be on my way, or I will be late for a very important date.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds good, thanks for visiting.

replies.reply_text: Anytime.  Bye!
You are welcome. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Yawning and rubbing her eyes.) Yes?

replies.reply_text: Oh... Were you sleeping?
Sorry I woke you, but I have a special delivery from Karee Dentin, Wington's Dentist. She's new to town and wants to spread the word.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh huh. What do you want?

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  I am sorry I woke you. I'll leave now.
I am wondering if your grandpa has a recipe I am looking for?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks.
Please don't bother us right now. I'm tired and want to go back to sleep.

replies.reply_text: Okay, sorry. Maybe I will ask a neighbor if...

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay. Bye. (Closing the door on you before you finish talking.)

replies.reply_text: You are very welcome! See ya!

npc_list.name: Sunny
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP7
npc_list.long_description: Sunny is married to Storm...

chatpoints.chat_text: I have nothing to say right now.  I'm ignoring that big oaf, Storm.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay.
Storm would like to apologize for his dumb argument.
Are you now? Well, this has nothing to do with Storm. Its a gift, from the dentist in Wington.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  So he's ready to admit that I was right!

replies.reply_text: Yup!  You were right, the sky definitely floats on the clouds.
No!  Neither of you were right!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ack!  I just asked him and this was not true!  You can go now.

replies.reply_text: Okay, sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't understand.  So what's he apologizing for?

replies.reply_text: For arguing about something senseless.  It is a dumb argument to be having!  Meaningless.
He wanted to tell you that you were right.
I don't have time for this.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh...  But shouldn't I always want to be right?

replies.reply_text: No.  There's no point.  If one of you is right, that makes the other one wrong, which neither of you wants!  Just don't argue about stuff, and then you both can be happy!
I don't have time for this.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh...  I think I understand!  Good advice.  Please tell Storm that I accept his apology!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will!
I don't have time for this.  Goodbye.
Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks so much for your help earlier.  We are starting to learn how to get along now.

replies.reply_text: No problem.
That's great!  Here's a gift, from the dentist in Wington.
Well, now you know! Enjoy it!

npc_list.name: Storm
npc_list.admin_description: & new quests start on CP11
npc_list.long_description: Storm is a colorful character. He and his wife Sunny make for an interesting couple.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there, stranger!

replies.reply_text: Hey, what was all the noise in here?
Hi, I must be going.
Sunny said that she accepts your apology!
Hello to you! I've got a gift for you from Karee Dentin, your local dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, the wife and I were having a 'discussion'.

replies.reply_text: Oh, really?  It must have been interesting.
Oh, well, keep it down.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Truly!  We were discussing why the clouds float in the sky.  Or rather, I say that the clouds float in the sky.  She claims that the sky floats on top the clouds!  How ridiculous!  Anyone can clearly see that the clouds float in the sky.

replies.reply_text: Are you serious?  You're kidding, right?  You wouldn't seriously argue over such a silly thing?
Oh.  Well, of course you are right!  The clouds definitely float in the sky!
Hmm...  You are wrong. The sky definitely floats on the clouds!

chatpoints.chat_text: Bah! (Storm grumbles.) What do YOU know! You can be on your way now.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haha. (Storm grins widely.) Did you hear that, sweety? I'm right! You are wrong! Haha! You can be on your way now.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, you do not agree that it's a terribly important discussion?  We are talking about the sky here!  It's around all of us, always!

replies.reply_text: Okay, you are right.  You were on the right side of that argument!
Fine, but you were clearly on the losing side of that argument!
Point taken.  However, whether or not something floats on something else is meaningless!  Why cause needless argument?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... Hmm... But who was right?

replies.reply_text: (Sigh.) You are hopeless. I must be on my way. Bye.
It's not about right or wrong,  It can't be.  It was a dumb argument!

chatpoints.chat_text: So are you saying she was right?

replies.reply_text: Yes!  Now you understand.
No, neither of you were!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  I think I'm starting to understand.  We shouldn't waste our time arguing about things?

replies.reply_text: You are starting to get it, but I must be on my way now. Bye!
Exactly!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well, in that case, could you please apologize to my wife for me...  She won't speak to me right now...

replies.reply_text: Sure thing!
I don't have time for this.  Bye.
Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks to you, we are getting along better already!

replies.reply_text: Great.  Bye.
Wonderful! And to make your day even better yet, I've got a gift for you from Karee Dentin, your local dentist.
Okay.
I'll do that. Have a terrific day.

npc_list.name: Rainey
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP8
npc_list.long_description: Rainey has brown, long, curly hair. She is 19 and living alone for the first time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Do come in, won't you?  It gets a bit lonely here at times, being new to the community and all.

replies.reply_text: Ah, I bet!  Is that a picture of your brother on the wall?
I'm sorry you're lonely.  I should probably go, though.  See you again soon!
How are you?  Floria asked me to stop by and pick up the eider down feathers she ordered from you.
I'm sure it does. I've got a gift from Karee Dentin. Maybe that will help cheer you up. She's the dentist in Wington.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is.  That's Cosmo.  I think I miss him most of all.

replies.reply_text: I'd miss my brother too, if I had a brother and moved away.
Ah, how sad.  I hope you get to see him soon.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd like to speak to him, but Sunshine Meadows, where he lives, is so very far away.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you write a letter?  I'll even deliver it for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd truly do that for me?  You'd go all the way there, just for me?

replies.reply_text: Of course!
Well, maybe later.
I'll be back with a reply in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Back so soon?  That was very quick!

replies.reply_text: There's none faster than me in all of Horse Isle!  See, I've already got a letter from Cosmo for you, too.
Well, um... I sorta forgot where Cosmo lives.  Could you tell me again?
Oh, right.  I haven't delivered the letter yet.  I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did, did you?  That's all right!  Cosmo lives in Sunshine Meadows on the main island.  That's to the east of Appleton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right!  Now I remember.  I'll be back in a while!
Thank you very much!  Enjoy your letter!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  How can I ever thank you for taking that letter to my brother?

replies.reply_text: Don't worry about it!  I had a lot of fun doing it.
How are you?  Floria asked me to stop by and pick up the eider down feathers she ordered from you.
No worries. I'm just happy to see you in better spirits. And look, I've brought a gift from Karee Dentin, the Wington Dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have them right here, but would you like to stay and have a cup of tea?  I don't get a lot of visitors here...

replies.reply_text: I'm really pressed for time now.  Could I please have the eider down?
Thanks for the eider down!  And I promise I'll come back for a visit my next trip through this island.
I'll be happy to do that. Have a super-duper day.

npc_list.name: Melody
npc_list.long_description: Melody is confident in her music and her looks. She has very high energy.

chatpoints.chat_text: La dee da... Doo doo LA LA LA!!!

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Melody?
Uh oh... I must have the wrong cottage. Sorry, gotta go, bye! (You say insanely fast as you run out the door.)
And LA LA LA, to you too! I've got a present for you! Its from Karee Dentin, Wington's Dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, sweet pea?

replies.reply_text: Do you always greet people with singing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course. I love to sing. Why would I want to do it any other way? Besides, singing is FUN and, well, didn't you read the sign on my door?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I did.
Not really... It seems a little strange. Maybe I should go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then kick off your boots and let's DANCE! I'll turn on some of my favorite music.

replies.reply_text: All right, if you say so!
Umm...  No thanks. I think I should leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! Here; I love this song. It's Willow's favorite and I love Willow! (She starts giggling uncontrollably.)

replies.reply_text: Wow, you are right. This is great fun! I like dancing, too!
I can't dance to this song. I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine, be that way, but you'll wished you had, later. Dancing is FUN! Shut the door on your way out.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you so, silly!

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, look at the time. Well, it's been fun, but I gotta run!

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem, come back any time. I'll be here!

replies.reply_text: All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please do. I only want people here that like to have FUN!

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Fine.
Well, you'll want a great smile to go with your singing! Enjoy.

npc_list.name: Stella
npc_list.long_description: Stella is a very likeable lady and you are hoping to be offered some of her famous cooked fish.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Come in!  Here, have some smoked salmon!

replies.reply_text: Oh, sure, I'll have some.  It sounds good.
I should go.  I'm really not much of a fish person.
No thanks.  It does smell good, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Oh, that's too bad.  Well, come back any time you like.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure do.  Ask me anything about fish and I'll tell you the answer.

replies.reply_text: Umm... Maybe some other time.
Thank you.  May I have another piece?
Thank you.  That was quite good.
Thank you.
Thank you.  I should be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, thank you.  I am starting to run low on fish.  Would you be able to run an errand for me?

replies.reply_text: After you gave me that yummy fish, I sure can.
I really can't right now.  Maybe I'll come back later and help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  I get a lot of my fish from Ernie Angler, down at the fishing shop.  Could you go down and pick up my sack of fish?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.
Oh, I really don't like the fishing shop...  It's pretty stinky.  Maybe I'll help some other time.
I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you able to get the fish yet?

replies.reply_text: I sure did.  Here you go.
Not yet.  Where was I supposed to go again?
No.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just head south to the fishing shop.  Ernie Angler should have a sack for me.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back soon.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's the least I can do for you getting me more fish.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

npc_list.name: Tobias
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must begin with CP 9
npc_list.long_description: Tobias is a healthy looking lad with rosy cheeks and a bright smile. He loves his mother's cooking, most especially anything she makes with chocolate.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!

replies.reply_text: Hello. How are you?
Oops...  Wrong cabin.
Hi!  I'm looking for Archy. Has he been by here yet?
Hello there!  I'm sorry, but I forgot. Where was Archy going after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, thanks...  except that I am out of hazelnuts for my delicious chocolate spread.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  That's too bad. Can I go to the general store for you?
Umm... If you are thinking of asking for my help, please don't bother. My time is precious.

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. Thanks for accidentally stopping by.

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Absolutely, in hopes that I might be able to taste your yummy creation. To Hazel's cabin I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry for thinking of bothering you. I hope your time is spent wisely. Goodbye.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much. Talk to you soon!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: So?  Were you able to get my hazelnuts?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  Here you go.
Not yet.  Where did you say I could get them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hazel has them and she lives just down the street here in Earton.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go get them for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Thanks for getting those hazelnuts for me!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.
Hi!  I'm looking for Archy, has he been by here yet?
Hello there!  I'm sorry, but I forgot. Where was Archy going after he left you?
So I'm three or four weeks behind him now?  I guess I had better talk to Twig and see what he can tell me.  Thanks, Tobias!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a problem, Archy was going to see Twig after he left here.

replies.reply_text: Twig? Now I remember. Thanks Tobias!

npc_list.name: Griffin
npc_list.long_description: Griffin is neatly dressed and it is obvious that he does value outside appearances.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  Kinda like you just did.  No bother though.  I don't really mind.

replies.reply_text: That's nice.  Uh, have you always lived here?
Great.  Well, got to go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Been getting a number of visitors lately.   Makes life a bit more interesting around here.

replies.reply_text: I suppose it would...   Have you always lived here?
I guess.  People do like to just walk around into others' cabins.
Well, I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.  Come in.  Sit down if you like.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I will.  Thanks.
No, thanks.  Just looking around.
Could you send me to prison again?
Actually, I was just wondering if you needed help with anything?  I'm just looking for something to do.
I'm sorry but what was I doing again?
I found Wendy for you.
I'm sorry but what was I doing again?
I brought your niece home, or rather she brought me back.  Oh and I have your ladder too.

I'm on the trail of a wayward tale and Felicity said you might be able to help me. When you were watching the docks, did you happen to see a fellow who'd lost a monkey come through? Sounds like he might have been going on and on about the monkey?
Who did you say the sunburnt rider was talking about?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  Used to be a warden up on Prison Isle.  No places to live up there and I've always liked the mainland anyway.

replies.reply_text: Prison Isle?  What happens there?
That seems like a long trip.
Wow.  That's crazy.  Well, I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It wasn't too bad.  There is some magic in these isles.  Some people can travel faster and farther than others.  I knew someone.

replies.reply_text: Really?  That's neat.  How did that work?
Magic?  I really don't believe in magic.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, believe what you like.

replies.reply_text: Yep, well....  Oh, look at the time.  I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, people get sent there for all sorts of things.  Cruelty to their horses, begging for money...  That sort of stuff.  Then they have to make gravel.  Eventually they get to leave.

replies.reply_text: I would like to check it out.  Would that be possible?
Wow.  Well, I hope I never get sent there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Behave and I'm sure you never will.

replies.reply_text: I'll remember that.  Thanks for the nice chat.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I went to see my friend and then I was at work.  Worked out well for me.  Cut down on travel time and costs.

replies.reply_text: Interesting.  Would you be able to send me there?  I kind of want to check it out.
Crazy.  Well, I should be going.  Thanks for the nice chat.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  I  could send you there.  It would cost $100 for me to do that.

replies.reply_text: That's not too bad.  All right.  Send me there.  I want to see it.
One hundred dollars?  To go to prison willingly?  No thanks.  I guess I should be going anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You sure you want to go?  If you do, there's no getting back until you've finished working.  No one can rescue you.

replies.reply_text: Yep, I'm sure.  Send me.
Hmm...  Maybe not, then.  I guess I'll head out.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you really want to, I guess.  You sure?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  Send me.
Hmm...  No, nevermind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm.  Well my niece is a little late coming home.  If you would bring her home for me I would really appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: You know what?  I just remembered something else I need to do.  I'm sorry, but I'm sure your niece will be home soon.
Okay, I think I could do that.  What does she look like and where could I find her?
Okay, I can do that.  I'll start looking for her immediately.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's okay we all forget things sometimes.  You were looking for my niece Wendy.  If you look around on the ground you may find some clues as to where she went.

replies.reply_text: Oh! Okay I remember now.  I should be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's wonderful!  I don't see her with you though.  Where is she?

replies.reply_text: Well, I found her in Eartip Forest but it seems she got her kite stuck in a tree.  She won't let me bring her home until I bring her back your ladder and get her kite down for her.
Oh! I just remembered something else.  I'll be back shortly.
Thank you.  Wendy and I should be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe you were taking my ladder to Wendy so she could get her kite out of a tree and then bring her home.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  Sorry to bother you I should be back soon.
You're welcome.  I'm just glad that I could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Most people pay for passage and don't say much. But this one fella - he stood out like an over ripe tomato. He was sunburnt and was going on about a lost monkey and some rambling poet.

replies.reply_text: A poet, eh? That might be worth checking out. And sure, I'll take the rats. I can always sell them to help pay for travel expenses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Some rambling poet. Hope that helps.

replies.reply_text: It does. I know of a poet on another island, so I'll head over there now.

npc_list.name: Hazel
npc_list.admin_description: &  New quests start on CP 9, CP 26, CP 32
npc_list.long_description: Hazel is nuts about nuts and well... she's a bit of a nut herself. She is short and round.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who's there?

replies.reply_text: Uh... I'm a friend of Tobias. I was wondering if I could get a bag of your hazelnuts?
Nobody. Goodbye.
Me.
Hello. Did a strange rider come by talking about his lost monkey or marbles? Or going to Jungle Isle to make money?
Who did you say I should talk to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, a friend of Tobias, you say? Surely any friend of Tobias is a friend of mine. Please come in and I'll sweep up some of these nuts for you and put them in a bag.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much.  Umm...

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry about that. I haven't been out of my home for months. There are so many nuts, and I don't know what to do with all of them. So, here I sit waiting for Tobias to run out.

replies.reply_text: How are the nuts coming? (You're worried she might get you in the door thus being forever trapped.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Me who? Are you a salesperson? The only me I know is myself.  No strangers please!

replies.reply_text: (Walk out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm just putting the last couple in and....

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much. Tobias will be very happy!
Oops. I know. I was just trying to get a bag for myself. Sorry for lying.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping by, and please come again.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: What? Well, thank you for being honest.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well.  Are you coming in?

replies.reply_text: I'd like to come in but I can't budge the door. There are too many nuts in the way, but that's okay.  I'll just stand outside the door.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aren't you gone yet?!  Go.  No strangers!

replies.reply_text: No... It's me.  Don't you remember? Tobias sent me here before for some hazelnuts?
Hello. Did a strange rider come by talking about his lost monkey or marbles? Or going to Jungle Isle to make money?
Who did you say I should talk to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh yes, that's right.  I remember now!  It's good to see you again!

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I was just in the neighborhood and thought I'd drop in and see how you were doing.

chatpoints.chat_text: How sweet of you!  I'd invite you in, but sadly I still have so many hazelnuts in my cabin that there simply isn't room for more than one person!  Tobias simply can't use up all the hazelnuts I have.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's all right. I can't stay anyway.  Bye.
You do have a lot of hazelnuts.  What are you going to do with them all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have been working on that problem.  I've been in contact with several shopkeepers on the isles, and some of them are interested in buying my hazelnuts.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like a plan!
Well, good luck with your endeavors. I have to be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope so.... But....

replies.reply_text: But?  There's a problem?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually, I'm having trouble getting the hazelnuts to the other shop owners.  I just don't have the time to deliver them and gather them as well.

replies.reply_text: Well, I have some free time and don't mind traveling, I could help you out.
I'd help out, but I really don't have the time right now, maybe later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, if you could make a few deliveries for me, that would be great!

replies.reply_text: Sure, no problem. Where do you need me to go?
Actually, this is sounding like hard work... Maybe you had better find someone else instead.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, could you first hop over to Wington on Bird Isle and deliver a bag to Cara Cook, the owner of the Wington food store?

replies.reply_text: Sure, no problem!
Wington? That's a little out of my way... Maybe you should get someone else to go.  Bye now!
All right, I'll be back as soon as I can.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need you to deliver that bag of hazelnuts to Cara Cook in Wington.  She runs the food store there.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  My, that was quick!  Did you have any problems?

replies.reply_text: Nope!  Cara said she would let you know when she needs more hazelnuts.
Actually, I can't remember where I was supposed to go.
Thanks, I sure will.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Do you have some time to make a delivery for me?

replies.reply_text: Not right now, I was just looking around. Bye.
Sure, I'm all set to go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Ethel Barryjam, owner of the general store in Hotton, would like a bag of my hazelnuts.

replies.reply_text: All the way to Desert Isle?  I don't think so... Too far.  Bye.
Ummm okay. I think I can find the place.
Okay, I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  It's good to see you back so soon!

replies.reply_text:
Thanks.
(You notice that there are considerably fewer hazelnuts in Hazels cabin now.)
It looks like you have a little more room now.
Well, I haven't delivered the bag yet.  Where was I supposed to go?
You're welcome. Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're getting very quick with my deliveries!  Welcome back!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Pheobe said she would contact you when she needs more nuts.
Actually, I can't remember where to deliver it to...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're back!  Good to see you again!  Would you, by chance, have time to make one last delivery for me? Pheobe, who owns the general store in Shellton, would like a bag of hazelnuts delivered.

replies.reply_text: Turtle Isle?  That's kind of far... Maybe later... Right now I have to go.  Bye.
Okay, I can run over there for you.
Hello. Did a strange rider come by talking about his lost monkey or marbles? Or going to Jungle Isle to make money?
Who did you say I should talk to?
I'll be as quick as I can.
Glad to help out.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ethel Barryjam.  The general store in Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes.  I'll go there now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bring the bag to Phoebe Wares in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there!  Thanks for making those deliveries!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye!
Who did you say I should talk to?
Hello. Did a strange rider come by talking about his lost monkey or marbles? Or going to Jungle Isle to make money?

chatpoints.chat_text: He did. Not much of a conversationalist. He did all the talking. And all he talked about was some lost monkey and making money on Jungle. No matter. I'm a fan of anyone who loves my hazelnuts. He didn't say where he was from or where he was heading. Why don't you try asking Felicity? Seems she might know a thing or two.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that. Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Felicity, at the boat dock.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Jasper
npc_list.long_description: Jasper is an average sized man with a knack for poetry. He can usually be found on the back porch working with words on his tablet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blue... Do... Goo...  Oh, hi!  Come in.

replies.reply_text: I can see you're busy.  I'll leave you be.
Hi!  What are you doing?
Special delivery from the Pony Express!
I'm sorry to bother you, but I have a delivery for you from Isleen.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to come up with rhymes for my poems.

replies.reply_text: Interesting...
Alrighty then, I'll leave you to that.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  Oh, and I got a new piano.  I may start putting my poems to music.  Unfortunately, I don't know how to play.

replies.reply_text: I know a little.  Maybe I could play something for you.
I don't play piano, sorry.  I should go.  Let you figure this out on your own.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great.  If you could just play me a scale, that would help me out a lot.  Just start on the bottom note.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll give it a try.
You're welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's very kind of you, but who is Isleen?

replies.reply_text: She's a Dream Mare.  Isleen brings you your dreams at night.
You know what?  This is all too weird for me.  Forget I said anything.
I'll be sure to let her know for you.  I should be getting back.  I'll see you later.

npc_list.name: Violet
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP 11
npc_list.long_description: Violet is a cute, curly haired little girl. She is wearing a purple dress. Violet giggles a lot and loves showing people her bird book.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  Come look at birds with me!

replies.reply_text: All right.  So, you like birds do you?
No, that's all right.  I really need to be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes.  I like to go to Eartip Forest to bird watch.

replies.reply_text: That sounds really neat.  You must get to see lots of birds up there.  I can't imagine too many people go to that forest.
Neat.  Well, I gotta go.  Have fun bird watching.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Twig is always in Eartip.

replies.reply_text: Twig?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  He has this weird obsession with red pine cones.  He doesn't scare the birds away, so I don't mind that he's there.

replies.reply_text: That's good.  Is there anything I can help you with?
That's good.  Have fun bird watching.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  I lost my favorite binoculars.  I've looked all over and I can't find them.

replies.reply_text: Where do you think you lost them?
That's too bad.  I need to be going, though.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I went to watch the shore birds, by the ocean...  I set them down on some rocks and they just disappeared!  Maybe look around there.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll see what I can find.
Hmm...  I really don't have time right now.  Maybe later.
No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: So?  Did you find them yet?

replies.reply_text: I did!  Here you go.
Not yet.  Where did you say you were when you lost them?
No.  I'll go look some more right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was sitting on some rocks northeast of here.  Those birds like to grab things.  Maybe they put them in one of the palm trees...

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see what I can find.
They were hanging in the palm tree up there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, those naughty birds.  Well, I'm glad you found them.  Thanks again.

replies.reply_text: Not a problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for finding my binoculars!  Now I can go bird watching again.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Just be careful where you set them so no birds get them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I will.  Thanks.

npc_list.name: Nadine
npc_list.long_description: Nadine loves flowers and all her clothes are some type of flower print.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, and welcome!  Do take the time to look at some of my paintings, won't you?

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  They're very lovely.  Bye now!
Jaelyn told me you were wearing a pink cloak when you visited her.  Could you tell me about it?
Larissa wanted me to give you this.  She said she's sorry for ever having thought of you being capable of stealing her cloak.
Your paintings are lovely!  What's that easel in the corner for?
Hi, Nadine.  Jade Maki tells me you were born in May.
Do you like your necklace, Nadine?

chatpoints.chat_text: Pink cloak?  Oh!  I remember.  I was just borrowing it from Valarie in Chillton.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Larissa thinks her pink cloak was stolen.  I'm trying to find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear!   You could go and talk to Valarie.  I'm pretty sure I remember her saying she found the cloak.  That's why she was so willing to let me borrow it.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, thank you!  That was so sweet of her.  Be sure to let her know I'm not angry with her at all.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  And I'll let her know.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be a flower painting that I was going to work on, but I keep getting sidetracked.  If you would like, you could complete it for me.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I could do that.
No thanks.  I'm not much of a painter.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the flower should have alternating purple and pink petals and have a nice bright, yellow center.  I wanted it in a dry-looking area, so the grass is yellow and orange.  Preferably with orange in the middle.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I was.  It's my favorite month.  April showers bring May flowers, after all!

replies.reply_text: She asked me to bring you a gift - a necklace with your birthstone.
Just wanted to check.  I forgot something - I'll come see you later.
You are quite welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do!  Green is my favorite color.

replies.reply_text: I'm glad.

npc_list.name: Ricardo
npc_list.long_description: Ricardo is wearing a bright orange tank top, yellow shorts and blue plastic flip flops.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey hey!  Come in!

replies.reply_text: Umm, all right.  Isn't it a bit toasty in here?
Whew, way too hot!  Gotta go.
Hi!  Your cousin, Captain Solomon, sent me.
Hi there!  That grooming kit ready yet?
Hi!  Can you help me, I'm looking for a painting made of sand?
Whew! It's awfully hot in here, I think I'm about to sweat until I melt!
Hey hey yourself! So about your horse...

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be the way I like it!  The hotter the better.

replies.reply_text: Well....  Oh, what's that easel for?
I should be going.  It's way too warm in here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a wonderful picture of a cactus that I need painted.  You wouldn't be able to do that for me...  would you?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can try.
I don't think so.  It's way too hot in here.  I would probably boil before I got the painting done.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I like bright colors.  The only thing odd, I suppose, is that the rocks are orange.  I really don't like dull colors such as gray or brown.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll do my best.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You really want to know? Well, it contains an ebony and boar's hair brush, a genuine tortoise shell comb, the finest trimming scissors and a lifetime supply of my own secret collection of fine hair and grooming products. But I wouldn't tell anyone what's in here if I were you... Pirates are very private people... if you know what I mean.
(Ricardo winks at you and touches the side of his nose.)

replies.reply_text: That sounds awesome!  Thanks, and let me get this back to him right away.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  What does he want this time?

replies.reply_text: He told me to ask you for a grooming kit just like the one you made for him.  It's for an old shipmate.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose I could do that.  I only use the finest materials and ingredients, so it will cost $2,000.  But he should know, this will last a lifetime!

replies.reply_text: That's fine.  Will 5 rubies be okay?
Okay, see you in a bit!
What exactly is in here?
Thanks!  I'll just be on my way now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, not my scene, dude.

replies.reply_text: Okay, later..... dude.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, you and me both, buddy! Wish we could take our sweat glands and put them in my horse!

replies.reply_text: In your horse? That may be the weirdest thing I've ever heard. I'm intrigued now.
In your horse? Dude, that's weird...
In your horse? Doesn't he have his own?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I just bought this new horse- you may have seen him on your way in, he's grazing picketed behind the house. Anyway, he came from up north, and he's really struggling here in the heat. He's even stopped sweating.

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe he's not hot. What's the problem with not sweating?
Oh, that sounds like a recipe for trouble.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, exactly- they can overheat and that can be a real problem. I've been keeping him cool with cool rinses in the hose, but I'm worried if I can't figure out something else, I may not be able to keep him- he just won't be happy here.

replies.reply_text: Well, have you talked to the vet? Maybe I could run by and see if she has any suggestions.
That's too bad.  Hopefully you figure something out.  Bye.
Off I go!

I hope it works! Now, she did say that it can take up to two weeks to kick in, so I guess just do what Audrey said and keep on with those cool showers. If you can keep him in the shade or under a fan during the day that would be good too. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, bodies are made to operate at certain temperature ranges. If they exceed that, some of the parts can stop working, which is why we have built-in cooling systems like sweating. I've been trying to help him with cool water showers and giving plenty of water and electrolytes, but it hasn't done the trick yet.

replies.reply_text: Oh, so this is a real problem. Have you talked to the vet? Maybe I can run by and see if she has any suggestions.
That's terrible!  I hope you find out something that can help.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Get anything useful from the vet?

replies.reply_text: Oh... well, yes and no. There's a medicine that might help, but I need to schlep up to Tropicton to get it. I'll go do that now.
Yes, just not this vet- Caren Hart in Tropicton just developed this medication for horses like Sand Dollar. (Hand him the canister of medication.)
Whoops, not yet.

npc_list.name: Mr. Tuttle
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 12
npc_list.long_description: Mr. Tuttle lives alone with his adorable kitty.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello.

replies.reply_text: Hi.  What's the easel for?
Gotta go.  Bye.
Hi.  This is a nice little area you have.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love to have a picture of my kitten painted, but I haven't gotten around to it yet.

replies.reply_text: I'll do it for you.
Oh, well.  I should be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great.  She was an orange kitten, and she loved being out under the purple night sky.  That seemed to give her pretty pink cheeks.

replies.reply_text: How cute.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, I like it.  Close to town, but not too close.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that's nice.  Anything I can help with?
I can see how that would be nice.  Well, I got to go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I was supposed to make a delivery today, but I haven't gotten around to it, yet.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I could do that for you.
I don't really like deliveries.  Maybe later.  Bye.
All right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Were you able to get that stuff I needed?

replies.reply_text: I sure did.  Here ya go.
Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
Not yet.  What was it you needed me to do?
Yup. And you wanted me to deliver it to someone. If you could remind me, I will be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Head down to the general store.  Pheobe knows what I need.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll get right on that.
Sure.  I could do that.
Umm, not really.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Well, this needs to be delivered to Bailey.  She lives on Lilac Isle.  I can send you there.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like fun.  All right. Please send me there.

chatpoints.chat_text: It would be a big help.  I know she can get you to a different isle that has some interesting stuff on it, too.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, then.  All right.  I can deliver that for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello hello.  Thanks for running that errand for me.  I hope you got to check out Rock Isle.

replies.reply_text: I did, thanks.  Goodbye.
Hi again.  Oh, what's the easel for?
I didn't.  Would you be able to send me there?
I did, but could you send me there again?
Hi! I've got some lumber for Bailey. Could you please send me back to her?
Me again!  I picked these roses up for Bailey. Would you mind sending me back to her?  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can send you to Bailey.  She'll have to send you to Rock Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, then.  I don't know if I want to be around all those flowers again.  Maybe another time.
All right.  That's fine.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you go.

npc_list.name: Kendi
npc_list.long_description: Kendi is a cute, young girl that is always barefoot.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hiya!  Wan' some soup?

replies.reply_text: Wow, that looks really good, but I don't think sand would sit well in my stomach.
Are you kidding?  I'm not going to eat sand.
Thanks, but I'll pass for now.   I'm trying to find Sando's snake, Lucy.  Have you seen her?
Not right now, thanks.  Do you know of somebody who paints with sand?
(Lying through your teeth.) I'd love some, and that's why I'm helping you with it, remember? What was I doing for you again?
Not this particular second, thanks. What was I doing for you again?
Maybe when it's all cooked. Your mom doesn't have any extra ingredients right now, but everyone else helped. Here, I've brought things back for you.
Maybe I'll take a sample- your mom and dad really liked it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You sure?  It's yummy!

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe I'll try just a little.
No.  I really don't want to.
Well, maybe I'll try just a little.
That was very yummy.  Thank you Kendi.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Silly snake wouldn't eat any soup.  Tried to go to sleep in it!

replies.reply_text: Oh, my!  Where did she go?

chatpoints.chat_text: I dunno.  Mama sent her away.

replies.reply_text: Ah, that's too bad.  Thanks Kendi!  Maybe I'll come back and try some of that soup once I find Lucy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo! The grandparents do! The grandparents are teachin' Kendi how to make art wit' sand.  I love the grandparents!

replies.reply_text: And where do the grandparents live, Kendi?

chatpoints.chat_text: They live all the way ova the otha side of the desert.

replies.reply_text: Thanks Kendi.  Bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no! Sand soup all gone!

replies.reply_text: Oh no! That's a problem. Can you make more?
Well, that's a real tragedy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sand soup hard to make. Sand soup needs... (She screws up her face in concentration.) Co-per-ay-tin. That's what. Can't make sand soup all myself!

replies.reply_text: Cooperation? Is that what you mean? I can cooperate. Can I help you make your sand soup?
I'm terrible at cooperation. I prefer to work alone. Sorry, can't count on me for this one.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Spreads her arms wide.) You ask e'rybody to help!

replies.reply_text: Everybody in the whole wide world? That's a lot of people.
...so just everybody in this little town specifically. Okay, that's much more doable.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggles.) You were helpin' make sand soup! Did you talk to e'rybody yet?

replies.reply_text: Yep, I've talked to every single person!
No, I think I missed somebody. I'll take another tour around the neighborhood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did Mommy and Daddy like my soup?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure yet; I still have at least one bowl delivery to make. Hold that thought.
They thought it was delicious!
Happy cooking, Kendi!
Okay.

npc_list.name: Sando
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP13
npc_list.long_description: Sando is wearing baggy, cotton pants with a sash for a belt.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can come in, the snakes won't bite.  They're not even venomous!

replies.reply_text: Well, that's a relief!  They're sorta pretty, the way they dance like that.
Ah, thanks, but no thanks.  I'm just gonna leave.
Hello. Kirby from Ashton thought you might be able to help me.
That's good to know, but I really wanted to ask you a question.  Do you know where I could find somebody who paints with sand?
Hi, there.  Uhm, this may sound a little weird but... do you, by any chance, have a snake I could borrow?
All righty.  I'm actually back because I couldn't remember where you sent me with regards to the scorpion issue.
Good thing! I'm wondering if you know of someone who makes dolls around here?
That's good news. I like snakes, but I don't like getting bitten. Say, I don't suppose you have any extra ingredients lying around? Kendi wants to make sand soup.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aren't they, though?  I trained them all myself, you know.  Lucy is the best!

replies.reply_text: Impressive.  Which one is Lucy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Lucy isn't here, unfortunately.  See, the other day all the baskets got knocked over.  Lucy managed to escape before I could get everything cleaned up, and now I have no idea where she is!

replies.reply_text: That's horrible!
That's horrible!  I need to be going now, though.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know.  I've looked everywhere, but I just can't find her.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Hey, if you want, maybe I could help.
Well.  I hope you find her soon.  I need to get going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Could you?  Would you really?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I love helping people out, and I feel bad that your snake got away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wow.  You're the greatest!  I suggest starting by asking my neighbors.  It's been long enough that they might have seen some sign of her by now.
Have you found any sign of Lucy yet?  I'm so worried about her.

replies.reply_text: You bet!  Loyada said she'd probably be under a rock in the village.
I forgot what I was supposed to be doing.  Could you remind me?
No luck yet, but I'll keep trying.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just ask around the village.  Maybe one of my neighbors saw some sign of her.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  Why didn't I think of that?  Well, I can't run out and find her right now.  Perhaps you could do it for me?

replies.reply_text: Of course!  I'll find her in no time.
I can't right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  There aren't too many rocks around the village, so it shouldn't take you long.  I hope.

replies.reply_text: Not too long at all!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, you're back!  Is Lucy with you?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  She was so eager to come back home!
I forgot.  Where was I supposed to be looking again?
Not yet, but I'm getting close!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Just look under all the rocks in the village.  You'll find her eventually.

replies.reply_text: All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, come in!  How can I ever thank you enough for finding my beautiful Lucy?

replies.reply_text: Don't worry about it!  I was glad I could help.
Hi, there.  Uhm, this may sound a little weird but... do you, by any chance, have a snake I could borrow?
It was my pleasure, but I really wanted to ask you a question.  Do you know where I could find somebody who paints with sand?
Hello. Kirby from Ashton thought you might be able to help me.
No worries.  I was actually back because I couldn't remember where you sent me with regards to the scorpion issue.
Good thing! I'm wondering if you know of someone who makes dolls around here?
Well, maybe you can help Kendi in return. She's looking for ingredients to make sand soup.

chatpoints.chat_text: I beg your pardon?!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I know it sounds kind of silly but.... I'm doing a Scavenger Hunt for... this kid and she wanted something that goes "Hiss" so I thought... you know...
Evidently not.  Never mind.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're doing a scavenger hunt and the kid didn't tell you exactly what to get?  That's not a scavenger hunt, that's... just nuts.

replies.reply_text: Well, she's just a kid, maybe she doesn't really understand how this is supposed to work.  Anyway, could I borrow a snake?
Aw, come on, just let me have a snake.
It's just a game, you don't have to be grumpy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely not!  Don't be ridiculous!  I don't let people "borrow" my friends!  Shoo!

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.
Oh, dear! I didn't mean to offend you. (You quickly tell Sando about the crickets and scorpions.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly!  You should go see old Sani in Santon.  He's the best there is!

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Kirby is nuts about critters! What can I do to help?

replies.reply_text: He is! (You quickly tell Sando about the crickets and scorpions. ) Kirby thought you might have a Lyre snake that could solve my problem.
If you will just lend me a snake, I will be out of your hair in a flash!

chatpoints.chat_text: A Lyre snake does eat scorpions and crickets, but that many? It would take awhile. Maybe weeks.

replies.reply_text: Darn it. Do you have any other suggestions?
That won't work then. Crow's Nest Carrie is one impatient pirate. I think I'll just give up on this quest. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm. I know! Pallid Bats!

replies.reply_text: Bats? Eeeek! Run for your lives!
Pallid Bats? They suck blood right? And they'll turn me into a vampire, right? No thank you! No thank you one bit. I am gone like yesterday's sunrise!
Now there's an interesting concept. Bats, huh?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, not just any bats. PALLID bats! And I know just who has some. Madame Babushka, Harriet's Aunt. She's a bit shy, but she loves tortillas. Let me send some with you. I'm sure she can help you.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I don't have time today. I'll have to do this another time.
Seriously? That would be awesome!
I will, and thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  You'll need to get Pallid Bats from Madame Babushka, Harriet's Aunt.

replies.reply_text: Ah yes.  I'll head that way now.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That sounds like Kendi's mom. She's my neighbor.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Groans.) Again?

replies.reply_text: This has happened before?

chatpoints.chat_text: More often than not. That kid is a real aspiring chef, but she tends to be a little... How would you put it. It's always sand soup, which is exactly what it sounds like, and it's never good!

replies.reply_text: Uninspired?
Hopeless in the kitchen?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. And she wants everyone to sample the stuff!

replies.reply_text: Well, she's just a kid. I don't suppose you have any spare ingredients you can throw in?
Thanks.

npc_list.name: Mandala
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 4
npc_list.long_description: Mandala is a tough, no nonsense kind of gal.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  I don't have any other jobs for you at the moment.  Perhaps you should come back later.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  See you later, then.
Oh, I'm not here to work.  I just wanted to know if you'd seen Sando's snake, Lucy.
I'm not here to work, I'm trying to find a painting made of sand, can you help me?
I'm not looking for a job, I'm looking for a doll maker. Would that be you?
I'm actually otherwise employed right now. Kendi sent me to see if you could help her make her sand soup. Do you have some spare ingredients? I don't think it matters what.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what are you standing around the door for?  Come in!  I have some work for you.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  What do you need me to do?
Ah, no thanks.  I don't want to work in this heat!
I finished clearing the sand away, Mandala.
Oh, I'm not here to work.  I just wanted to know if you'd seen Sando's snake, Lucy.
I'm not here to work, I'm trying to find a painting made of sand, can you help me?
I'm sorry, I've got plenty of my own work to do. Speaking of which, I need a doll maker. Would that be you?
I'm actually otherwise employed right now. Kendi sent me to see if you could help her make her sand soup. Do you have some spare ingredients? I don't think it matters what.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a lovely rock garden, but the last sandstorm has completely covered it.  I'd like for you to go and rake the sand away so that I can enjoy my garden again.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound too bad.
Maybe I'll pass.  It's too hot to work outside.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then hop to it.  You'll not like working in the afternoon heat and morning is fading fast.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back in a moment!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  Have a seat and I'll fix you something refreshing.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  That was just what I needed after working in the sun!

chatpoints.chat_text: Lucy?  His best dancing snake?  No, no.  Can't say that I ha--Wait!  I do remember seeing her.  The silly creature was trying to take a nap in my rock garden.  I chased her away right quick, you can be sure.

replies.reply_text: Did you see which way she went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see... I think she retreated to Loyada's hut.

replies.reply_text: Oh, great!  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, can't help there.  Have you looked in Santon?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, but I will.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: That would not be me. Try Yazhi.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for that bit of information.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sand soup again? I suppose it's probably the usual bowl of sand with a little water, and she'll want everyone to eat some?

replies.reply_text: Uh... well, probably. It seems like that's how it's going to go.
Thanks Mandala.

npc_list.name: Loyada
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 16
npc_list.long_description: Loyada is a colorful older woman. She has delightful tales to tell if you take the time to listen.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hullo deary!  Won't you come in?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes.  Thank you.  But I won't stay long.
Of course!  You see, I was wondering if you'd seen anything of Sando's snake, Lucy.
No, I really should be going.
Yes, thank you.  I was wondering if you would know someone who makes sand paintings?
Thank you! I'm looking for a doll maker. Can you help me?
Just for a moment. I'm here from Kendi; she's looking for ingredients to make her sand soup.

chatpoints.chat_text: Lucy?  Oh, that lovely creature?  Yes, I have.  She was curled up beneath that rock by my door.  I told her that there were other rocks in the village to go curl up under.

replies.reply_text: So she's not here anymore?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid not.  She's in the village, though.  Probably beneath a rock.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thank you very much!  I'm going to go tell Sando.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you like to hear a story?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I'd love to.
Not today, thank you.  Maybe I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wonderful!  It starts with two people very much in love, you see.  Only, they didn't know they were in love.  Not until he swore his undying love.

replies.reply_text: That's so tender.
Ah, that's sweet.  I'm not a big fan of romance stories, though.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is.  Now, this young man wasn't very rich, but he bought his new bride the most beautiful necklace!  It was an emerald the size of an egg, set in solid gold.  The chain flowed like water.

replies.reply_text: It sounds so beautiful.
Wow, that's sounds like some necklace.  But I'm bored.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it was.  Well, one day the lovely lady was walking through the desert, 'cause that's where they lived, see.  Right here in this very hut.

replies.reply_text: Oh, my.  What happened to her?
So you were the girl, and lost your necklace.  Gee, how lame.  I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: This huge storm just whipped up out of nowhere!  It was as if the wind had hands, and it yanked the necklace right from around her neck!

replies.reply_text: No!
Oh, no!  This is getting scary.  I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Oh, she was heartbroken.  For years and years she looked for the necklace, but the sands had swallowed it, and there was never a trace of it.

replies.reply_text: That's so tragic.
How sad.  I can't take it anymore!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know!  I do miss my necklace so much.  It was such a dear gift from my sweet husband, may his soul rest in peace.

replies.reply_text: So you never found the necklace?
What a touching story.  Thanks for sharing.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I wish I had, though.  It meant so very much to me.  Especially once my dear husband passed away.

replies.reply_text: That's so sad.  I wish there was something I could do to help.
I'm sorry.  I hope you find it someday.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe there is something you could do.  There's a young man in Flipperton.  His name is Nolan.  Big book worm.  I bet he'll have a book with records about the storm.

replies.reply_text: All right.  So I'll go see Nolan.
Hmm... Maybe I'll help some other time.  Have a good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Good luck, child.  I don't think it will be possible to find, but if anyone can find it, you can!

replies.reply_text: You bet I can!  I'll come back when I have that necklace!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did you find my necklace?

replies.reply_text: You bet I did!
Oh.  I, um... sorta forgot what I was doing.
Nope, but I was just about to get started.  I'll be back when I find it.
Not yet, but I was wondering if you'd seen anything of Sando's snake, Lucy.
I'm still looking for it, but I was wondering if you would know someone who makes sand paintings?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, bless my stars!  You did!  You found it!  Oh, thank you so much.  Here, take this as a sign of my thanks.  Oh, this just means so much to me.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much.  I'm so glad I managed to find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why don't you start by speaking to Nolan? He lives in Flipperton.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Oh, how can I ever thank you enough for finding my necklace?

replies.reply_text: Aw, don't mention it.  I'm so glad I could help.
It was no problem.  But I was wondering if you'd seen anything of Sando's snake, Lucy.
It was my pleasure, but I was wondering if you would know someone who makes sand paintings?
No need. Happy to help. But maybe you can help me in return. I'm looking for a doll maker. Can you help me?
No need to thank me. But maybe you can help one of your neighbors. Kendi's looking for ingredients to make her sand soup.

chatpoints.chat_text: My friend, Yepa's husband, sandpaints.  They live over in Santon.. I'm sure that's who you are looking for!

replies.reply_text: Yepa in Santon... I'll head right over.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not that talented, but Yazhi is. She's amazing! She's just Northwest of here.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I really appreciate that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sand soup again?!

replies.reply_text: Afraid so.
Thanks for your patience with her. I think it means a lot to her.

npc_list.name: Alati
npc_list.long_description: Alati is small man with a shy expression. His glasses are usually sitting on his nose.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you stranger!  I thought I was done for!

replies.reply_text: Don't mention it.
Not a problem.  Actually, I wanted to ask you about Sando's snake.
I'm just glad you're okay! I hate to say it, but I think those shoes of yours need more work.
That's okay.  I was wondering, do you know where I can get a painting made of sand?
No problem! Do you know of anyone around here who makes dolls?
Sure! I don't suppose you don't have any spare ingredients around for sand soup?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm?  Snake?  Oh yes!  I remember the one.  She slithered by here not just yesterday.  Tried to help me out of that pit.  Good snake, that Lucy.

replies.reply_text: Right.  Do you know where she went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  let me think.  She might have gone to try and get help.  Though, I'm sure you could see, she didn't manage it.  I'm glad she tried though.  Good snake.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot!  Try not to fall into the quicksand again.

chatpoints.chat_text: It seems so. I was modeling them after the snowshoes used by people in the North. (He sighs) It seems like so many of my ideas come to nothing. Look at all these half-finished inventions I have. This one here was meant to automatically cover the whole village with a balloon during a sandstorm. We get so many of those out here, so I thought that was clever. And this one over here was meant to turn sand into gold, but alas, it also failed...

replies.reply_text: It sounds like you'd just better give up inventing altogether. I think I'll go find someone else more interesting to talk to. Bye!
Turn sand into gold? Wow, that would be a neat invention! How does it work?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well it never did. That's the point. However, hypothetically speaking, you pour the sand into this funnel here, and it falls down into the gearworks there, and then you turn this crank here.... Though, now that I think of it, perhaps I need a little more leverage... Yes, yes, of course! And what if I tried stone here instead of metal... And then if I add... (Alati continues to mumble to himself)

replies.reply_text: Uhh, you lost me at "hypothetically." I'm just gonna go...
It sounds like you're really on to something! Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sure! I'm going to need to redesign this section here, and in the meantime, perhaps you can gather some materials for me?

replies.reply_text: Ugh, I can't stand gathering materials. I'll have to pass for now, but good luck!
Gathering items is my specialty! What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm going to need... mmm... let's say about 2 logs and probably 8 strong skinny branches to start. Think you can find that much?

replies.reply_text: That's quite a lot. I don't think I feel up to it anymore. Bye!
Piece of cake. I'll get right on it!
Thanks! Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: How's the gathering going?

replies.reply_text: Great! I have what you need right here!
Oh I hadn't finished yet. Let me get back to it.
Oh I forgot, what did you need again?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 2 logs and 8 strong skinny branches.

replies.reply_text: Okay!
Glad I could help. I need to be off now!
Was there anything else that you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you're still interested in helping me with my invention, then next I'm going to need you to travel to Rock Isle and ask Rocco to cut me a pair of medium round stones. He'll know what I'm talking about.

replies.reply_text: All the way to Rock Isle? Nevermind this, I think you'd better find someone else.
Why Rock Isle? That seems a little far...

chatpoints.chat_text: Rocco is the only one who can make them exactly how I like them. He's an excellent stone cutter. So what do you say?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I just don't have that much time to kill. I'll talk to you later.
It's no problem, I don't mind going that far out of my way.
Thanks! I'll be on my way then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you able to get those cut stones from Rocco?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, I'm afraid I got distracted. I'll go do that now.
I need help finding him. How do I get to Rock Isle?
Yes, here they are!

chatpoints.chat_text: If I'm not mistaken, you need to speak to a man in Shellton about traveling to Rock Isle.

replies.reply_text: Shellton. Got it. I'm off!
Traveling to Rock Isle is always hard. I don't think I want to help anymore.
No more than usual trying to track down Bailey. Was that the last thing you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've got most of my invention put together. There's just one more thing I think I need, if you have the time?

replies.reply_text: I actually need to go do something else. Maybe later.
Sure! What is it this time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need three porcelain rings made from the finest red jamuti clay. I think those will hold just the right amount of heat. You'll need to go see Genevieve to get them made.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like another long journey. I think I'll skip this one.
Not a problem. Where does she live?
Will do. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get those porcelain rings from Genevieve?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, I'll go do that now.
What was I supposed to get again?
Yes, I hope they are the right size.
Will do! Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good news! My invention worked! Take a look! (Alati displays several pieces of gleaming gold.)

replies.reply_text: That's fabulous! I can't believe it actually worked! Er... I mean...I knew you could do it all along.
Wow, thanks! Good luck with your shoes!

chatpoints.chat_text: It seems you are always rescuing me. Thank you again!

replies.reply_text: I'm just glad I stopped by in time!
I see the shoes still need some work.
Not a problem!
Try to be more careful next time.
I'm surprised you haven't given up on those shoes yet!
That's what I'm here for!
Always glad to help!
Not a problem.  Actually, I wanted to ask you about Sando's snake.
That's okay.  I was wondering, do you know where I can get a painting made of sand?
Sure! I don't suppose you don't have any spare ingredients around for sand soup?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need you to get three porcelain rings made from Genevieve. She lives on Art Isle.

replies.reply_text: I'll head there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sandpainting?  You need to see the elders in Santon.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks, I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! She lives just West of me

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ai yai yai... that sand soup is legendary around here, and I'm afraid it's not in a good way. Any way I can get out of it, you suppose?

replies.reply_text: Really? You want to try to get out of helping a little girl playing pretend?
I'm afraid not. She might cry.
Thank you!

npc_list.name: Accalia
npc_list.long_description: Accalia is an older woman and yes a bit over the top with her love of cats. She wears her long gray hair in a tight bun on top of her hair. She is wearing a simple, blue dress.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome sweetling.  Do come in.  There's not much  I know, but make yourself comfortable!

replies.reply_text: Oh thanks.  Wow.  You do seem to love cats, don't you!
Oh no, I don't want to trouble you.  I'll just go.  Bye!
I'm back!  I found some little kitten tracks leading towards the south.
I found Muffins.
Palila sent me with the box you ordered.
Hello, I'm looking for a painting made of sand.  Can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Heavens yes!  They are such good friends.  Unfortunately, my newest little kitten has gone missing.

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  What happened to it?
Ah, poor thing.  Good luck finding it!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know.  I've looked for her but I just can't find her.  Her name is Muffins.

replies.reply_text: Poor kitten.  Maybe I can help you find her?
Muffins is a cute name for a kitten.  I hope you find her soon. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd help me find my lost Muffins?  Thank you, sweetling!  Why don't you start by searching for clues outside around the house.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, that silly kitten!  She's gone to play in the orange trees again.  Well, thank you for finding that clue.  It was such a big help.

replies.reply_text: No problem. I was glad to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Could I ask just one more small favor of you?

replies.reply_text: Ask away!
I think I'm going to pass.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you go down to the orchard field and find her, make sure she's not getting into any trouble?

replies.reply_text: I'd be glad to!

chatpoints.chat_text: She's not getting into trouble, is she?

replies.reply_text: No!  I think she's guarding the oranges.  She's not in any trouble though.

chatpoints.chat_text: What a relief!  Here, take this as a reward for finding Muffins.

replies.reply_text: Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for finding Muffins for me.  I know she'll come home when she wants to.  She does love those orange trees.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I'll leave you to care for your other cats.
Palila sent me with the box you ordered.
Hello, I'm looking for a painting made of sand.  Can you help me?
Umm...  all right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I really don't know, maybe Muffins can help you.

replies.reply_text: Uh.....okay then.  See ya!

npc_list.name: Quinn
npc_list.admin_description: &new quests at CP13
npc_list.long_description: Quinn is wearing swimming shorts and rubber galoshes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello stranger.   Come in if you like, but step around the puddles!

replies.reply_text: Oh, uhhh sure... I guess...
I don't think so; it's a little too wet in here.
Maybe later, when I'm thirsty.
Hello, there!  Could you help me?  I'm looking for a painting made of sand... Any suggestions?
Sure, I'll be careful.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can I offer you anything?  A glass of water, perhaps?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I am a little thirsty.
No thanks, I have to be going.
No thanks on the glass of water. Jebidiah Jibb sent me to get a barrel of your best water.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you are.  A tall cold glass.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: So what brings you to my cabin?

replies.reply_text: Not much, just exploring the neighborhood.
Just looking around and now I have to check out the next cabin. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there is a lot to see in Hotton.  I'm hoping to make the Isle's largest water display!

replies.reply_text: No kidding?  Good luck with that in this desert heat!
Wow!  That sounds like something that would be fun to see!
I have a fear of drowning.  I don't think I'd be interested in that at all!

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope it turns out like I expect.  I'm almost finished, just a few more items to add.

replies.reply_text: I have some free time. Is there anything I can help you with?
Well, I'll be sure to stop back in when it's done and have a look.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can use more water, if you wouldn't mind running over to the feed store and asking Luke for another pail.

replies.reply_text: Okay, sure. I'll be right back.
Hmm...  Really not in the mood right now to do that, though.  Maybe I'll come back later.
I'll try my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello hello.  You get that pail of water yet?

replies.reply_text: No.  I'll get right on that.
No...  Where was I supposed to go again?
Yep. Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Luke at the feed store in town here will give you a pail.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll be back soon.
Nope.  Not a drop.
Well...  Some splashed out...  but not much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good good.  Well, I gave you a bit of a reward.  You'll have to come back sometime and see my display.  It's going to be great.

replies.reply_text: Will do.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right.  You'll have to come back sometime and see my display.  It's going to be great.

replies.reply_text: Will do.  Good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Thank you for bringing me that pail of water.  I'm just about done with this display.

replies.reply_text: That's great.  Could I have another glass of water?
That's great.  Have fun!
Hello, there!  Could you help me?  I'm looking for a painting made of sand... Any suggestions?
Awesome!  I'm here because Jebidiah Jibb sent me to get a barrel of your best water.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... As you can see, my medium is water, not sand.  But I believe you can find what you are looking for in either Sandy Meadows or Santon.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try there.  Thanks!
Don't worry, I'll remember to tell him you want some of the Orangeade.  Thanks for the water!

npc_list.name: Lajita
npc_list.long_description: Lajita is a lively woman. She always is dressed in the bright colors of the southwest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hullo, hullo!  Come in!  Can you smell my most wonderful stew cooking?  It's famous hereabouts, you know.

replies.reply_text: It does smell good.  What's in it?
Smells great!  I'll leave now so you can finish your cooking.
It sure does smell good, but I'm looking for a painting made of sand. Can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh, a bit of this, and a bit a that.  But it's not done yet!  Oh, no!  I'm missing some of the most crucial ingredients!

replies.reply_text: That's too bad, but I could go get them for you.
That's too bad.  I should be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, would you?  Why, that would be most excellent!

replies.reply_text: So what do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a potato freshly dug from the ground, fresh-picked mushrooms, and the freshest sun-dried herbs.

replies.reply_text: That's quite a list.
That's quite a list.  I really don't have time to do all that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know, I know.  But it won't take too long, I don't think.  We'll start with the mushrooms.

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  Where do I go to find mushrooms?

chatpoints.chat_text: On the east side of town, in that little bit of forest, there is a fallen log.  You'll have to look very carefully to find any, but they like to grow there.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back in a bit!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're back! Have you found the mushrooms yet?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I've got them right here!
No, I don't.  Could you remind me where to look?
No.  I'll just go look for them now.

chatpoints.chat_text: How magnificent!  Let's see those mushrooms...  Oh, yes!  These are perfect!

replies.reply_text: Yay!  All right, what's next on the list?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  How about the dried herbs?  They grow in a patch of the forest that doesn't have many trees, straight to the north.  You might have to rake away sand to get to the really good herbs, but they'll be there.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  The stew will be done soon.  You should stick around and try a bit.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no thanks. Bye!
That'd be great!  It smells so good!
Oh, good!  I was wondering if I could get a bowl for Ormand.
It sure does smell good, but I'm looking for a painting made of sand. Can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Back already?  Let's see those wonderful sun-drenched herbs!

replies.reply_text: Here you go!
I forgot where I was supposed to look!  Could you tell me where to find them again?
No.  I'll just go look for them now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Yes, yes!  Good job!  These are just what I wanted.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Just one more thing left!

chatpoints.chat_text: The potatoes!  These are hidden in a very special spot!  Try as they might, no one can find them!  But I will tell you.  The potatoes grow right in front of the gazebo!  When you dig one up, be sure to cover the hole, so no one knows where they are.

replies.reply_text: I won't tell anyone!  Be back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Finally, you are back!  You brought the potatoes, yes?

replies.reply_text: You bet!  Here they are.
I can't remember where you told me to go find them.  Could you remind me?
I'll just go get those now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh thank you!  You are the best little chica in all of Horse Isle.  Here, take this as a big reward!

replies.reply_text: It wasn't a problem.  Thank you!
It was delicious! Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well.  Maybe you could come back when you do have time and help me out.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll do that.  Bye.
We'll see.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ormand?  That cranky old man?  Why on earth would you want to take him some of my stew?

replies.reply_text: Well, I think the stew would do him some good.
I guess I wouldn't.  Not right now, at least.  I'll come back later.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Yes, I can see your point.  Oh, you are such a smart chica!  Here, hurry and take this to Ormand before it gets cold.

replies.reply_text: Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's an old couple in Santon who still practice the traditional ways.  Seek them out, I'm sure they can help.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'm off to Santon.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Muffins the Kitten
npc_list.long_description: Cute long haired, white and orange kitten.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meow!

replies.reply_text: You're not getting into trouble, are you, Muffins?
What a cute kitten!

chatpoints.chat_text: Meeeow! Meow meow meeeeooow!

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  As long as you're being good!

npc_list.name: Iggy Chewtoy
npc_list.long_description: Iggy Chewtoy is wearing a very colorful shirt that is much too big for him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to Earton Pet Shop!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.
Oops, wrong place. Bye.
I'm here to pick up some cat treats.
I'm looking for a cat that would be good at chasing mice.
Yes, I was wondering if you had any downy feathers?
Hi there. Mikko sent me to pick up the dog toy he ordered.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Uh... Yes. Can you tell me what these pets are for? I don't want to buy one and then not know what to do with it.
No, thank you. I'm just going to have a look around and leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent question. It's simple. These pets are meant to be companions for your horse. Your horse needs friends, too. A companion will keep your horse happy, which will then make your horse a great competitor.

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow. Thanks for telling me. I think I'll have a look around. I don't want my horse to be lonely or a bad competitor. Are there certain pets that are better than others?
I think that sounds crazy. I'm outta here. Geesh, pets for your horse. What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. I appreciate you stopping by. Please come back.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.
