chatpoints.chat_text: All right, but I feel sad for your horse. Don't you enjoy friends? Don't you think your horse will be lonely? Oh well, sleep on it. I bet you will be back when you see how poorly your horse competes.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Okay...  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, yes. A dog could be very beneficial to you. If you want to know about the rest of the pets... I suggest you do some research at the library. That will be very helpful to you. Let me know if I can be of assistance. Otherwise, have a great day!

replies.reply_text: Interesting. Thanks.  You have been very helpful and informative. You have a great day, too!

chatpoints.chat_text: Cat treats?  What kind were you looking for?

replies.reply_text: Oh, there's kinds?  I didn't know....  Huh.  Let me think about it.
Whatever kind Mitchy, Britt's cat, likes.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, our kittens here make wonderful companions, but they would not be very good with mice.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well.  Thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, we specialize in kittens. Birds and cats don't typically make the best roommates. I have a bird now and then, but I sell them as quickly as I can.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that. It came in this morning, actually, so good timing!

replies.reply_text: Hehe, I guess so! Say, could you possibly wrap the toy? It's supposed to be a surprise for Barney. His birthday's coming up, you know.
Thank you! And no thanks, I'm all set for now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  How are you today?

replies.reply_text: Very well, thanks.
Hi.  I wonder if you might remember anything about the night Opal Sandstone's "Star of Solomon" sapphire was stolen.
You aren't selling any cats, are you?
Hello there! I'm great. I noticed you sell several different breeds of beautiful birds here. Wow -- I'd hate to say that fast seven times. Anyway, is there a chance you'd have any downy feathers?
Howdy!  I've come to pick up the bird seed for Nora Nurture.
I'm fine, thank you.  I have a bill from Olav.
Fine and peachy dandy! Thanks for asking. I noticed you carry chickens for sale. Would you happen to have any of the Minorca breed?
I was wondering if those chickens have come in yet?
Hey there, Kay! I'm doing great, thanks for asking. Remember those chickens you ordered for Jocosa on Dog Isle? I've got another customer that needs some for the same sand flea problem!
I'm great and I've got the money for those baby chickens.
A bit flustered, actually. I'm trying follow a tale most confusing! Did anyone happen to come in here with animal allergies and spouting crazy tales about flowers that stole his money?
What was it that you told me about the sneezing stranger?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, I remember that night... Well, I remember the morning after. There was chaos in here.  I left the windows open because it was such a hot night.  There must have been a wild animal outside, because when I came in in the morning, there were feathers everywhere, and everyone seemed so upset.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Why do you think that was?

chatpoints.chat_text: I expect there was a wild animal outside.  Whenever they smell something strange they get all excited.

replies.reply_text: A wild animal?  Like maybe... a zebra?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I wouldn't think so.  Zebras are not uncommon here.

replies.reply_text: Okay, then.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, we sell too many birds here, can't keep cats with the birds around.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that makes sense.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I certainly do! I heard a rumor going around. This has got to be for Mino's surprise gift for Lelu. What a romantic man! Give me a minute and I'll get some for you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll wait right here.
Thank you so much! I'm sure Mino will be pleased. Bye now.
Okay, will do.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've been expecting this.  How much did he say I owed him?

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, Olav said that I should pick out a bird for his sister.
She's a lovely bird all right.  I'm sure Katinka will love her.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Minorca? What a lovely breed! I don't, but I can certainly order some for you. Are you sure that's the breed you are looking for? They don't do very well in a cold climate, and much prefer the heat.

replies.reply_text: This is for a resident of Dog Isle. She lives right on the beach and is looking for something to mostly keep down the bug population.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then she has done her homework! Minorcas would be a great choice. I can order them but it may take a couple of days. How many would you want?

replies.reply_text: Well shoot. I was hoping you'd have them in stock. Looks like I don't have much choice. Would you order 3 for me, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Happy to do that! I think 2 hens and one rooster would be an ideal order. They will travel nicely and the flock will increase over time. Sound good?

replies.reply_text: Oh gosh! Jocosa never specified. What to do, what to do!  It sounds like you know about chickens, so I'll go with your suggestion. Do you need me to pay now?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can pay when you pick them up. It will be $500 per hen and $200 for the rooster for a total of $1200.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks so much. I'll be back in a few days.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes they have! All nicely crated for the trip to Dog Isle. They've been feed, but keep an eye on them and offer them water every couple of hours.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I'll be sure to keep them well hydrated.

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't even have a chance to put the order in. The breeder came by right after you left. Such a great coincidence. Hang on a sec while I fetch them. (She steps into the back room where you hear a sudden burst of clucking.)

replies.reply_text: (You wait patiently, hoping they didn't just escape!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kay comes in, holding a crate that looks like it is stuffed with moving feathers.) I know it looks like there isn't enough room for them in this crate, but they'll be fine. It will keep them calm during travel. That will be $1200, please.

replies.reply_text: Oh shoot! I completely forgot about that part. I'll be right back.
That's right! Here's the bucks for the clucks! Ha ha ha ha. (Kay doesn't seem to think that's as funny as you do.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you go! You'll want to deliver them straight away. If they get stressed, they can lose their feathers and get ill.

replies.reply_text: I'll head to Josoca's place right now. Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Seems like a lot of people are getting chickens these days. I hear they make great pets. Is this customer on Dog Isle, too?

replies.reply_text: No. This customer is on Pirate Isle. Does it make a difference?
Great pets? Maybe I'll try them some day! In the meantime, we'll have to continue this discussion another day. Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: It does. A jungle island provides all kind of food sources, but Pirate Isle doesn't have the same flora or fauna to keep them well fed. You'll need to provide supplemental chicken feed. Also, Pirate Isle is hotter and drier. I think you'd do better with a different breed than the ones you got for Jocosa.

replies.reply_text: Okay, so I need to purchase chicken feed and chickens. What breed would you recommend?

chatpoints.chat_text: I think Partridge Penedesenca would be good. They are small, heat-hardy, and alert. The best breed I know of for hot and dry climates. They lay gorgeous brown eggs. There's just one hitch though.

replies.reply_text: Oh, oh! I hope I don't have to travel all over the place doing you favors to get them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nothing like that. The thing is, they were a forgotten breed and are just starting to make a comeback. Grown hens are too valuable to sell, so all I can get are baby chicks. They are also a bit pricier.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. How much pricier? I don't have much money on me.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll need $2300 for half a dozen chicks, and $200 for a large bag of chicken feed.

replies.reply_text: I have enough to cover that. I'll take them!
I'll have to head over to the bank. Be back in a bit!

chatpoints.chat_text: I just got these in yesterday. I had ordered them for myself, but I've got another order coming in tomorrow so I'm okay with selling them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much. I'm sure he'll love them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed! How did you know?

replies.reply_text: Deductive reasoning. Would you happen to know where he had been before he came here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he sold me a crate full of parrots. Said he'd fallen in love with the birds when he was traveling through the Jungle.  He rescued them from some poor soul who had too many to take care of.

replies.reply_text: That would mean one of the jungle islands. I'm wondering if he said anything else? I'd like to narrow my search down a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. Let me think. Well, he was sneezing like crazy. Said he was allergic to cats. And there was a fair amount of cat hair on his vest. And of course, he had a crate full of parrots!

replies.reply_text: I know just where to head. Thanks so much! And thank you for the parrots.

chatpoints.chat_text: He was sneezing like crazy and said he was allergic to cats. And oh my goodness! The amount of cat hair on his vest could clothe a mouse. I suggested he try to shake off some the hair. I hope he did, poor fellow! And of course, there was the crate of parrots that he sold me.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Rusty Cage
npc_list.long_description: Rusty Cage is dressed in beige trousers and a brown sweater.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my shop!

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'm gonna wander around for awhile.
Do you sell snakes?
I'll have to come back some other time.
I know you must sell cats here.
Hi.  Sam McGee sent me to get some cat treats.  Do you have any?
Hello.  I'm back with a case of cat treats from Ginger Craft.
Thanks. Do you have downy feathers?

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. Let me know if you need some help.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
What is your favorite pet?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I don't. They give me the creeps. I am very particular about which pets I sell.

replies.reply_text: Really? You don't seem like someone who would be afraid of snakes. I think I'll see if I can find a snake somewhere else. Thanks for your time.
That's good because I don't like snakes either. I've got to go take care of my horse, but its been a pleasure to meet you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd have to say my favorite is the turtle. He's easygoing like me. Everything he does is at a slow pace. Just taking in the scenery one step at a time. So cool.

replies.reply_text: I think turtles are cool, too.
I don't like turtles. They are too boring for me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, thanks for stopping by and please come back again.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Likewise. Enjoy your day and please do come back.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then I have a couple of turtles here you might be interested in.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll take a look.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, we have wonderful Persian kittens for sale.  How many would you like?

replies.reply_text: Kittens aren't what I was looking for.  Have you got any older cats?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, older cats are too independent for me.  I suggest you check in with Spike at Treeton Pets, he sometimes sells older cats.

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Usually we have a good supply here, but the cats have been really hungry and have bought me out. Maybe you can help me?

replies.reply_text: Not right at the moment, maybe I can come back later and help you.
Sure, what do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the cat treats come from the feed workshop in Carrotton on Hare Isle.  Can you go over and get some more for me?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can do that.
No, I'll come back another time and help you with that.
I'll see you when I get back. Bye!
Thank you, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Downy feathers are a speciality item that I don't keep on hand, but I have some lovely companion animals that will make you forget about your troubles!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway, but I'll have to pass on them for now. Bye!

npc_list.name: Nico Leash
npc_list.long_description: Nico Leash is an animal lover. He is thirty something.

chatpoints.chat_text: Foghorn!  Stop eating the guinea pig's bedding!  Oh, hello.  How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Just looking around.  Thanks.
Foghorn?!?
You have an interesting array of animals.
It doesn't look like you sell cats here.
Hello there! Do you by any chance have any downy feathers?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, sorry.  That's the donkey.  He likes to poke his nose all over and eat a lot of things he shouldn't be eating.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you keep him tied up, then?
Huh.  All right.  Well, I'll keep looking around.  Thanks.
Oh, how fun!  Would I be able to get a donkey?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't like to confine the animals too much.  The more room I can give them, the happier they are, and the happier I am.

replies.reply_text: That's nice.  Well, enjoy your animals.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can.  They're a little expensive, but they make just a great companion for your horse.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  I like my customers to have some options.  They all make good companions, though some are better than others.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: We used to, but they and the dogs would get into awful fights.  So, no cats, not anymore.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense.  I'll check somewhere else then.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but I don't have birds often enough to have a supply of feathers. Try someone who specializes in birds.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.

npc_list.name: Ollie Scooper
npc_list.long_description: Ollie Scooper is a happy, energetic young lad who loves animals.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there. Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No, thank you. I'm just looking.
Yes.  The Easter Bunny sent me for her order.
You have quite an interesting array of animals.
I see you have kittens.  Do you sell any older cats?
I sure hope so. I'm looking for downy feathers.
Sure, Nora Nurture sent me to pick up her order of dog treats.
Have you seen a blue wacky inflatable arm tube guy thingy?
Well, I think so. This is a little weird. I need to buy a big rubber ball. The biggest and stoutest one you've got.
Hi Ollie, I came back with the money for the rubber ball.
Hi Ollie, I'm here on behalf of Mehitabel.  Has Archy picked up the dog treats yet?
Yes, I know you already told me, but I forgot.  Where did Archy go when he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  I love my pets.  Any of them will make a wonderful companion for your horse.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.  I'll keep that in mind.
Thank you, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, but the kittens are lovely, and they will get older eventually.  Are you sure you don't want one?

replies.reply_text: I'm really looking for an older cat now.  Thanks, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. But I have kittens and puppies. Regular little furballs to keep you company!

replies.reply_text: They are cute, but I'll have to pass on them for now. Thanks anyway.
I will, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I don't think I have.  So sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay. I'll keep looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Like... a rubber ball for a dog toy?

replies.reply_text: I guess. Maybe one the size of... (You gesture with your hands.) About this big or bigger? Like a basketball?
Okay, I've got enough here with me. Here you go. (Give Ollie the money.)
Oh, I'll have to swing by the bank first.
Thanks!
Atreyu? Isn't he the one who lives on the beach northeast of here? (Ollie nods.) Thanks, I'll go talk to him. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's okay.  Archy was heading over to see Atreyu.

replies.reply_text: I'm not usually this disorganized, but Archy's travels are making me dizzy!  It's off to Atreyu I go. Thanks Ollie.

npc_list.name: Jaxon Whanacrackur
npc_list.long_description: Jaxon Whanacrackur is a large, happy man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome! Just step around the animals, all of them are quite friendly, really.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Boy, you sure have some strange pets in here!
Are you selling any cats?  Lucy Reins in Shellton is looking for one.
Hi there! I was wondering if you had any downy feathers?
Okay, if you say so.  I was wondering if you would know where I could find a painting made of sand?
Pony Express here with your package!
Oh, thanks!  Say, you look pretty busy!  Is there anything I can do to help?
Hi Jaxon!  What was I doing for you again?  I completely forgot.
Hello.  I have the box of treats!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha ha.  Yes, I suppose so, and all of them need companions!

replies.reply_text: I'll look around, thanks.
I know this might sound strange... but do you have any talking spiders?

chatpoints.chat_text: Talking spiders? What, are you crazy? Spiders don't talk!

replies.reply_text: I'm not crazy!  Look... Has anyone brought you a spider recently... Say within the last 2 weeks?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.  Well, about 2 weeks ago, someone came in with a spider to sell.  Pretty thing it was, too.  I remember it had a blue mark on its body.

replies.reply_text: That's the spider I'm looking for!  Where is he?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it isn't here.  I only had it for a day or so before someone came in and bought it.

replies.reply_text: Who did you sell it to?  Do you remember?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dakota in Santon bought the spider.  She likes crawly things.  She always has scorpions and lizards hanging around.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go and search there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cats, no.  Would she like a gecko?  I have some lovely geckos.

replies.reply_text: No, thanks, I don't think geckos were what she had in mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sell mostly exotics, and birds aren't typically among the companions I stock. Try a pet store that specializes in birds.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Painting with sand?  Sorry, doesn't ring any bells.

replies.reply_text: That's okay. Bye!
I hope all the animals enjoy their special treats!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know!  That's awful nice of you to ask.  I just ran out of treats for the animals here.  Could you run to the local feed store to pick up some for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  Is there anything specific?
I really can't right now.  Maybe I will another time.  Bye.
All right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to head to the local feed store and talk to Luke about some treats for the animals here.  Just tell him I want what I regularly get.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Be back!
Thanks!  Bye.

npc_list.name: Leroy
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 10
npc_list.long_description: Leroy is in his 50's but often acts like a teenager.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aaahaha!  Sorry about that!  Didn't mean to frighten you so!  Come in, come in!  My home is yours.

replies.reply_text: It's... all right.  Hey, why do you keep it so dark in here?
Aaaah!  I'm going.
Oh, whoa!  You scared the ba-jeebers out of me!  I can't stay long.  Sera asked me to come get some coats you were supposed to send up to her.
I'm used to it by now, Leroy!  Do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?
Haahaha!  You got me again!  You wouldn't happen to know where I can get a pith helmet, would you?
No, it's okay.  I was wondering if you know of someone who makes sandpaintings?

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  Because I like it dark!  Not to mention it's easier to hide things that glitter in the dark, if you know what I mean.

replies.reply_text: I'm afraid I don't.
I don't...  You're a bit odd.  I should go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gold!  I'm talking about gold.  I have me several gold nuggets... Or did until some rascal squirrels snuck in and stole them!

replies.reply_text: Squirrels stole them?  How on earth did that happen?
Squirrels stole them?  That's too bad.  I should go.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it seems that gold nuggets in the dark looks much like nuts to a squirrel.  They probably went and cached them somewhere hereabouts.  Trouble is, my eyes aren't so good anymore, and I can't find a trace of them!

replies.reply_text: You know, I just might be able to help you out!
Hmm...  That's really too bad.  I'm sorry, but I really can't help you right now.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really!?  Then let's make a deal!  You find both my gold nuggets, and I'll give you a nice big reward.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like a deal to me!
That sounds all right, but I don't have time.  Maybe I'll come back later.
All right.  I'll find those nuggets in no time.  You wait and see.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm... Back already eh?  You manage to find my gold nuggets?

replies.reply_text: Yes!  I've got them right here.
Actually, I sorta forgot what I was supposed to be doing.  Could you give me a clue?
No, not yet.  But I'm working on it!
Oh, I'd forgotten about that.  Actually, I'm here to ask you if you had Sera's coats.

chatpoints.chat_text: Those rascal squirrels must have cached the nuts somewhere hereabouts.  Why don't you start by searching for clues here in the cabin?  Shouldn't be too hard, 'specially if you have something that lets you see little things, like squirrel tracks.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll try using my magnifying glass!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's the spirit!  Good luck to you!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah...  Welcome back, my friend!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  See ya around!
Hi!  Hey, you don't happen to have some coats for Sera, do you?
Thanks!  Do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?
Thanks!  You wouldn't happen to know where I can get a pith helmet, would you?
Howdy! I was wondering if you know of someone who makes sandpaintings?

chatpoints.chat_text: Coats, eh?  Oh, right!  These things.  I meant to send them to her, but I completely forgot.  I won't be needing them here on Desert Isle, so feel free to take them to Sera.  She can have them!

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks!  Bye Leroy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I don't have anything that would suit a fashion-conscious type like yourself.  Just a few leftovers.

replies.reply_text: I think that would be fine.  The bigger and bushier the better.
Okay.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have this faux-bearskin coat.  It's massive!  I don't know what I was thinking with this one.  Didn't think I'd ever manage to get rid of it.

replies.reply_text: That's perfect.  How much do you want for it?
No, that won't do at all.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm.  How about $300?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, some other time, maybe.
$300?  For a fake fur, and it's moth eaten, too?  I'll give you $100.
Thanks!  You wouldn't happen to know where I could buy a pith helmet, do you?
Thanks very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've seen some people wearing them to beat the heat.  They're more like Jungle garb, though.  You might want to check at a Jungle Isle store.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm pretty sure you'll find what you're looking for in Santon... Good luck!

replies.reply_text: I'll go there, thanks!

npc_list.name: Scamper
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP11
npc_list.long_description: Scamper is a big, red squirrel with an impish grin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeeek! Squeek squeek squeek! (Hmm... He doesn't seem at all happy.)

replies.reply_text: Hey, did you take the gold nuggets from Leroy?
Silly squirrel.  I wonder what his problem is.
Did you and your friend get in a fight over the gold nuggets?
Scuttle was afraid you were mad at him and he wanted me to talk to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek? Squeek!? Squee squeeek squeek squeek! (Boy, is he angry!)

replies.reply_text: Hey!  There's no need to go throwing nuts at me!  I just want to know what you did with the gold nuggets!

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek! (He crosses his arms over his chest.)

replies.reply_text: Nothing?  You don't really expect me to believe that, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeeeeek.

replies.reply_text: Come on!  Just tell me where you cached the nuggets!

chatpoints.chat_text: SQUEEEEK! Squeek squeek squeeee squeek! (He jumps and points to the west.)

replies.reply_text: Fine!  I'll just look for more clues!  Some help you were.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek? Squeeeeeeeeeee! (His anger vanishes and is quickly replaced by tears.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, hey!  There's no need to cry, it's all right.  What happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek squeek.  Squee squeek-squee squee.  Squeek squeekers squeek.

replies.reply_text: He wanted both nuts... I mean nuggets... for himself?  That's not very nice!  Do you know where he hid them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek! (He shakes his head so hard he nearly falls off his stump.)

replies.reply_text: No, huh.  Well, do you know where he lives?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek! (He points to the north.) Squeek squeek!

replies.reply_text: He lives in a big tree to the north?  All right.  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek?

replies.reply_text: He gave me this Golden Acorn to give to you as an apology.
I will let him know that you aren't mad at him anymore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek!

replies.reply_text: I'm just glad that you guys are friends again!

npc_list.name: Scuttle
npc_list.long_description: Scuttle is a trouble maker with an attitude.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek?

replies.reply_text: Ah, yeah, hi.  The other night you and your buddy found a couple of nuts inside Leroy's cabin, right?
Erm... No.  I'm just going to go.
How come you were so mean to your friend?
What was I supposed to be looking for again?
I just stopped by to tell you that Scamper isn't mad at you anymore and that he loved his gift.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek.

replies.reply_text: Well, you see, they're not really nuts.  They're gold nuggets, and you can't really eat them.  You'd probably wind up breaking your teeth if you tried!

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek. (He looks very indignant.)

replies.reply_text: I'm not calling you stupid!  I'm just saying!  Since you can't eat them, won't you tell me where you cached them?  They're very important to Leroy, you know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek. (He waves his hand, obviously dismissing you.)

replies.reply_text: Hmm... Guess I'm going to have to find those nuggets without your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek, squeek! (He breaks into tears.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, you feel bad about what you did?
Well, that's interesting, but I don't think I want to get involved. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek. (He nods his head in agreement.)

replies.reply_text: Have you tried telling him that you are sorry?
I'm sorry about that, but I just remembered that I was supposed to be doing something else.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek. (He shakes his head no.) Squeek, squeek, squeek.

replies.reply_text: Well, I hope everything works out okay.  I do have to leave now, bye.
Oh, so you're afraid that he won't listen to you?  What if you gave him a gift?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek! (He shows you an acorn then points to the northwest.)

replies.reply_text: You want me to dig up your old golden acorn?  Are you sure?
I'm afraid I don't have time for that, maybe I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek!

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  I'll dig it up and take it to him, then.
Perhaps when I have some more time I will come back and do it then.
I will let you know what he says.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He points to the northwest and shows you his acorn again.) Squeek squeek squeek squeek.

replies.reply_text: Oh! That's right, I needed to got to the northwest and find the golden acorn to give to Scamper.
I'm just glad that you guys are friends again!

npc_list.name: Harold Nickelendime
npc_list.admin_description: CHARACTER DOES NOT SPEAK!

npc_list.name: Cara Cook
npc_list.long_description: Cara Cook is a plump, sweet woman with a flowery apron on.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, 'ello there!

replies.reply_text: Hi!  You wouldn't happen to have some flour for Elaina, do you?
Hello, goodbye!
Hi!  I'm looking into the theft of the "Star of Solomon" from Opal Sandstone.  Could I ask you a question or two?
Hi, Hazel sent me to deliver this bag of hazelnuts for her.
I was wondering if you carried any cilantro?
Hello.  I've got a delivery from Jack O'Lantern.
Hi there. I'm embarrassed to ask, but would you have any fruit that's maybe bruised and not as fresh as it should be? It's for Mino.
Hello, can I please buy a bag of flour?
Do you live alone here?
I've found Zoe for you.  She's in the garden near the flower shop.
What was I doing for you again?
What was I doing for you again?
I see that Zoe has returned.  I hope that everything has worked out for you both.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with the truffles.
Is there anything I can do for you?
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back from King Phil of Hotzeplotz.
Can I please have some grapeseed oil for Mandy?
Good day. I'm here as an agent for Hansel and Gretel's new bakery. They are looking for vendors for the following supplies. (You show Cara Hansel's list.) Would you be interested?
Hi there, you don't happen to have any empty barrels for sale, do you?
I'm looking for lemons. You wouldn't have any for sale, would you?
Hello there! Karee Dentin sent me over to pick up some dental polishing paste that she ordered.
Hello to you too! Did anyone come by, trying to selling you carrots?

chatpoints.chat_text: Flour 'or Elaina?  Aye, I got some a that!  You 'urry back to her now, ya 'ear?

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll try, now.  Although I've already told everybody all I remembered at the time.

replies.reply_text: Please do.  I'm working with Ms. Mabel.  Anything you could remember will help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me think.. Oh yes.  There was one odd thing I remember from that night, right enough.   All the horses in town were acting up that night.  Everyone whinnying and running around in circles and carrying on.  And the dogs!  The dogs were just barking their heads off in the night-time, they were.

replies.reply_text: Well they would be, if someone were racing out of town.
Before the theft?  Well... That might make sense.  Do you remember anything else?  Anything at all?

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Fraid that's all I know.

replies.reply_text: Well, every hint helps!  Thanks a lot!  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh well wonderful!  She didn't say for sure when she would be having them delivered but I'm glad you got them here!

replies.reply_text: She wanted me to tell you to just let her know when you need more.
I will.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: No dearie, I don't. Why don't you check with Minnie Biscuits.  She uses it. She might have some in stock.

replies.reply_text: Okay I will.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh? 'ow is old punkin 'ead doing?

replies.reply_text: He's fine... I think.  Anyway, he sent you these pumpkin seeds.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'E's got perfect timing, 'e does.  I was just about out.  Could you put those sacks over by the counter?

replies.reply_text: Sure. (You leave the sacks by the counter like Cara asked.) Here you go.
Flour and eggs, are you sure he isn't giving up on Halloween and opening a bakery?

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Im, a baker?  'eavens no!  'e uses the flour to make 'is papier mache masks and the eggs are for the tempra paints 'e uses.  All natural, you know.

replies.reply_text: So I've heard.  I'd better be getting these back to him.  Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Eavens! What's 'e wanting something like that for?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds' need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! Well, dearie, not that I like to advertise it, but there are times when the fruit turns quicker than I can sell it. Give me a minute to crate some up for you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll wait right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Ere you go, dearie. And tell Mino it does my 'eart good to see this fruit go to good use.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much. This will mean a lot to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can sell you a bag for $50.

replies.reply_text: I don't have that much at the moment. I'll come back later.
Sure, I have that right here.
Thank you, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No me dear.  My niece, Zoe, is usually hangin' around. At the moment I can' seem to find 'er.

replies.reply_text: Okay I hope you find her soon.  Have a nice day.  Bye!
Oh would you like me to go and find her?
You're welcome.  I'll come back when I find her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh I'm so glad.  I was gettin' worried about 'er.

replies.reply_text: She said she's scared and that she wants to come home.
I have to come back later.  I'll tell you some more then.

chatpoints.chat_text: What's she got to be scared of?

replies.reply_text: Well apparently she threw something in the garbage that you were looking for, and now you can't cook King Phil's special delicacy. She thinks you might be cross with her.
I have to go.  I'll come back later to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were goin' to see if ye' could find my niece Zoe.  She really loves flowers.  She shouldn' be too far away from 'ere.

replies.reply_text: Okay thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were goin' to tell Zoe tha' she could come 'ome.  She's in the garden next to the flower shop.

replies.reply_text: Okay thank you.
Sure I will.  See you when I get back.
You're welcome.  I'm glad to be of help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I need a dozen truffles.  Do ye think that ya can get some for me?

replies.reply_text: I have other things to do at the moment.  Maybe later.  Bye!
Sure I can do that.
You're welcome.  I'll see you when I get back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were goin' to get a dozen truffles from Fritz on Saddle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well done me love. I'm glad tha' you were able to get 'em. It didn't take ya tha' long.

replies.reply_text: No, but I had to go and find them myself.  He did lend me his pig though. I didn't know that truffles were so expensive.
You're welcome.  Glad to be of help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can ye deliver these Truffles an' Quail to King Phil?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I'd be glad to.
No not right now.  I've got other things to do.
Okay I'll see you when I get back

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Ere 'ow was the old feller?

replies.reply_text: He was his usual self, he said that he really appreciated the Truffles and Quail.
You're welcome.  Anytime.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were deliverin' Truffles and Quail to King Phil of Hotzeplotz.

replies.reply_text: Okay thank you.
Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, can't 'elp ya with that sort of volume.

replies.reply_text: Well, do you know anyone I might go to, then?
Okay, sounds like a plan.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I told ye to try Molten Meadows.  The folks there could probably use the business.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, I forgot.  Thanks!
I see.  Well, thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, but I bet you'll find some on Pirate.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help!
I'll be sure to tell her. Thanks and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: 'eavens, no.  I'd love some. I'm in a mood for a bit of stew these days... but I did hear about a fella selling some parrots in town.

replies.reply_text: Hmm. Carrots or parrots - anyone's guess at this point. I'd better ask around about that.

npc_list.name: Unicorn
npc_list.long_description: A wondrously white, yet colorful beast. You can sense that this Beast is happy in his solitude and private meadow.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is upset with your presence.)

replies.reply_text: Oh...  I'm sorry...  Should I not be here?
WOW!  A unicorn!!  Can I keep you?!  I'm going to tell all my friends!
I'm sorry to bother you, but I've come from Erebus.  He has a message for you.
Forgive my intrusion, big guy, but the water fairies asked me to bring you these. (You show him the apples.)
Steady fella, thank you for the hair.  Would you mind helping me out of here? Goodbye!
Sorry for my awful memory, but where did you say some hair was?

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is EXTREMELY upset with that thought.)

replies.reply_text: Oh...  I'm sorry...  Do you not want that?  Should I not be here?
Well, too bad!!  I'm going to keep you!  Come here, yer mine!

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn appreciates your remark.)

replies.reply_text: (Sneakily attempt to capture the Unicorn.)
Oh... You are trying to remain hidden out here?

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn confirm your theory.)

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, I will be on my way, then.  I just wish it wasn't so far, and I promise I won't tell anyone where you are!
(Make one last attempt at capturing the Unicorn.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Unicorn wonders why you have returned.)

replies.reply_text: (Attempt to capture Unicorn.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is anxious to hear your message.)

replies.reply_text: He said that he hasn't been by to visit because he's having a problem with his wings and can't fly long distances.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is upset with your news, but relieved to have heard from him.)

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll let Erebus know that you got the message.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is listening intently. He snuffles happily at the apples, but is still watching you cautiously.)

replies.reply_text: Yes, you're right, they do want something in return.  They asked me to get some of your tail hair to make a gift for the changeling prince.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense the Unicorn is getting upset again.)

replies.reply_text: No, I'm not going to cut your tail off or anything like that!  Don't you have any place around here where you might have left some hair about?
I don't see what you are pointing at, fella. Maybe if I take a really close look, I'll find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You sense that he is again suspicious of your actions.)

replies.reply_text: No, I'm not going to cut your tail off!  Don't you have any place around here where you might have left some hair about?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Unicorn raises his horn and points toward a tree along the southern edge of his meadow.)

replies.reply_text: I don't see what you are pointing at, fella. Maybe if I take a really close look, I'll find it.

npc_list.name: Pablo
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start at CP5

chatpoints.chat_text: And what can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, I'm just curious as to what's going on around here.
I was told you like Minnie's nut bread.
I am here to buy some art for Barnacle Ben. Do you have anything available?
I am here to buy some art for Barnacle Ben. Do you have anything available?
Hello, I'm looking for paint.  Can you help me?
Hi!  I've got a pigeon delivery for you from Goodwin.
Hey, Pablo! Basil Snoremore in Earton is running low on splatter paint. Do you have any for him?
Good day, Pablo.  I was wondering if you could help me with a project.
So, Pablo, is the fish finished yet?
Here's a different one. I'm looking to have this shield painted with its owner's device.
Hi Pablo, is the shield done?
Hi!  This time I have something for you.  I come with a proposition for your consideration.

chatpoints.chat_text: What's that?  Nut bread?  From Minnie Biscuits?!  Give it to me, I will pay you $500 a brick--I mean, a loaf--for it!

replies.reply_text: I have some with me.
I don't have any with me now; I just wondered... Do you really want that stuff?
This is too weird.  I think I'll go now.
Here is some more.
That's all I have.  Maybe I'll bring more later.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, you guessed, did you not, that I do not eat it!  No, I build with it!  To you, it is just a waste of food.  But to me, to the Great Artist, it is the new jade!  I am building a monument!  When I'm finished, the world will gape in awe!  Until then, I hide it away!

replies.reply_text: I'll look forward to seeing it when it's done, then.
Oh.  Well, okay then.
I have more nut bread for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Adios, then!  Bring me nut bread as often as you can, as much as you can!

replies.reply_text: I will!  Hasta luego!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  It's you again!  Welcome!  Do you have more nutbread for me?

replies.reply_text: I do!
Not right now, but I will.
Not right now.  I am here to buy some art for Barnacle Ben. Do you have anything available?
Not right now.  I am here to buy some art for Barnacle Ben. Do you have anything available?
Not right now.  Actually, I'm looking for paint.  Can you help me?
Hi!  I've got a pigeon delivery for you from Goodwin.
Sorry, Pablo, I don't. Basil Snoremore in Earton is running low on splatter paint. Do you have any for him?
Not this time, Pablo.  I was wondering if you could help me with a project.
Enough with the nutbread, is the fish ready?
Here's a different one. I'm looking to have this shield painted with its owner's device.
Hi Pablo, is the shield done?
Hi! Not right now, but I've come with a proposition for your consideration.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, as a matter of fact, I just recently finished several pirate-related drawings of ships and mermaids. I will sell them to you for 2 rubies and a pearl.

replies.reply_text: What??!! You have got to be kidding. This is getting way too costly. I'm done with this.
What??!! Wow, I had no idea this was going to be so costly, thank goodness I just happen to have some on me.
I will have to come back another time with those items. I don't have them on me.
Oh, these are pretty. I am sure he will like them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Looking for paint?  Look around you!  What do you see?  Paintings, not paint!  My paint I use!

replies.reply_text: I know, but... Okay, can you tell me where you get your paint?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go ahead if you like.  That was the last I saw of that unsavory person, and the last I ever hope to see. Enjoy yourself.

replies.reply_text: I will!  Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as it happens, there is such an island, exactly like this one, just south of Bone Isle. Story goes there's a buried treasure there. Well, of course, those wretched pirates have buried treasure all over the place, so who knows?

replies.reply_text: How do I get to that island?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know.  I suspect you ask someone on Bone Isle if they can jump you there. Why would you want to go there?

replies.reply_text: I love treasure!
The trail's gone cold, unless the woman ever came back.
Why not?

chatpoints.chat_text: A special order for royalty, eh? Well, I suppose I could whip some up for you. How many would you like?

replies.reply_text: Um how about half a dozen, to be safe?

chatpoints.chat_text: Can do. That'll be $600.

replies.reply_text: Er... I don't have that much. I'll have to come back later.
$600? Well.... I guess I can give you that much...
Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: He did? Wh... Oh, of course! Hockey must be getting ready to start. Are you letting the whole team know?

replies.reply_text: Yep. I've let Ben, Cedric, Henry and you know. It starts in two weeks.
Uh... Sure, I guess. (Mutters.) This sure is taking up a lot of my time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. Sorry. Can't say I know where you could get one, either. Good luck to you, though.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Looking for Olav?  Yep, he stayed here for a bit. Did repairs on almost all of the roofs here.  He liked the variety of roofs we have, but when he was finished, he moved on.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't suppose you know where he went after leaving here, do you?
Okay, Turtle Isle it is.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Quite the short attention span you have there!  I said that the last I heard from Olav, he was staying in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: That's right, you told me he was on Turtle Isle... Ooo, look at the kitty...
Thank you so much!
Thanks for the information, Remy.  I'm off to see Cedric.  Till we meet again!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's quite all right, Archy said that he was heading North to see Cedric.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, you did tell me that.  I'm off to the north. Thanks Remy!

npc_list.name: Eunice
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 9
npc_list.long_description: Eunice has the special talent of seeing art in everything around her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why hello traveler!  What brings you here?

replies.reply_text: Why is there a desert here?
I'm just checking things out.  I'll come back later.
Hello, there.  I wonder if you might be able to tell me about a healing salve that your father used to make for sailors.
I'm back from visiting Odysseus.  He said that a peck is a little bit more than two gallons, a gill is half a cup and lanolin comes from wool.
Hello again, Eunice.  I'm ready to start looking for ingredients, so you can make some of your father's Aromatic Liniment!
I'm sorry, Eunice, I left in the middle of writing down the list of ingredients that you needed to make liniment.  Could you tell me what they were again?
Hello Eunice!  I remember I was doing something for you.  What was it?
Hi Eunice!  Any luck translating your father's recipe yet?
I'm back, Eunice!  I have all the ingredients you asked for.
Hi Eunice!  I gave you the lanolin already... Where were we?
Hi Eunice!  I gave you the lanolin and the rosemary already... Where were we?
Hello Eunice!  I think I've given you all the ingredients you needed to make the liniment.  Can you make it now?
Hi Eunice!  Wow, it smells awful in here!  Is that liniment ready?
Hello again, Eunice.  This may seem like an odd question, but do you know anything about Jubal?
Good day, Eunice. I'm on a quest for leisure time activities, and I was wondering if you might help.
Why I've come with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah ha!  So you've noticed!

replies.reply_text: Well, it's kind of hard not to...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, yes, of course.  I'll have you know that I've shipped my own personal desert up to this island!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  That's pretty impressive!  How did you do it?
That's a little weird, I think I'm going to go...

chatpoints.chat_text: I have ambitious travelers like yourself bring sand, lizards, and all sorts of things from Desert Isle.

replies.reply_text: I'm busy now, but maybe I'll help you out later. Bye!
I'm pretty ambitious, do you still need anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, I'm having a lot of difficulty getting cacti to grow.

replies.reply_text: Art isle is one of the northernmost isles... Maybe this just isn't the place to grow cacti.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's what Salvador said, but I'm going to keep trying.  One of these times it's bound to work!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go find some cacti seeds. Where do I find them?
Well.  Good luck with that...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh! Welcome back.  Were you able to find my seeds?

replies.reply_text: No, sorry, I wasn't.  I'll come back later, once I have them.
Here you are.
Not yet.  Where was it that you wanted me to go again?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a small hut that looks just like this one south of Santon.  Why don't you poke around in there?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back.
You're welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for getting those seeds for me.  They'll be sprouting any day now!

replies.reply_text: Good luck!
I have a question for you, Eunice.  I wonder if you might be able to tell me about a healing salve that your father used to make for sailors.
I'm back from visiting Odysseus.  He said that a peck is a little bit more than two gallons, a gill is half a cup and lanolin comes from wool.
Hello again, Eunice.  I'm ready to start looking for ingredients, so you can make some of your father's Aromatic Liniment!
I'm sorry, Eunice, I left in the middle of writing down the list of ingredients for the liniment.  Could you tell me what they were again?
Hello Eunice!  I remember I was doing something for you.  What was it?
Hi Eunice!  Any luck translating your father's recipe yet?
I'm back, Eunice!  I have all the ingredients you asked for.
Hi Eunice!  I gave you the lanolin already... Where were we?
Hi Eunice!  I gave you the lanolin and the rosemary already... Where were we?
Hello Eunice!  I think I've given you all the ingredients you needed to make the liniment.  Can you make it now?
Hi Eunice!  Wow, it smells awful in here!  Is that liniment ready?
Hello again, Eunice.  This may seem like an odd question, but do you know anything about Jubal?
Good day, Eunice. I'm on a quest for leisure time activities, and I was wondering if you might help.
That's great news!  I stopped by because I have a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a small hut south of Santon.  Look closely in there and you may find some.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh wow, I was quite young, but I remember that! He called it his Aromatic Liniment. Ferocious stuff, and the men who came to buy it from him... Well, some of them were pirates!

replies.reply_text: Do you have a tin of it left over, by any chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, heavens no.  That was so long ago, and it was very popular stuff.

replies.reply_text: Please Eunice, isn't there any way that I could find something comparable?
Oh, well.  I guess Jubal will have to figure it out on his own.  Thanks for the help, though.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've never seen, or smelled anything like it.  I do still have my father's recipes, but I'm not very good at that kind of thing.

replies.reply_text: The recipe is a start.  May I take it, or copy it?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'd rather not lend my father's recipes out. They do mean a lot to me.  Here it is.  Let me see...

replies.reply_text: (You wait patiently.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear, this will be very tricky.  There are many ingredients I've never heard of.  Besides that, it's an old recipe with very strange units of measurement.  I'm afraid I couldn't even attempt it without knowing how to convert a “peck” and a “gill” into a modern unit of measurement.

replies.reply_text: Do you happen to know anyone who could help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm sure Odysseus would know.  He's very old, too, you see.  He was a friend of my father's.  He'll probably outlive us all.

replies.reply_text: Will you try to make the Aromatic Liniment if I can find the measurement conversions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can't promise.  There is also this list of ingredients we'll need to tackle, but knowing the measurements is a place to start.

replies.reply_text: I don't think I'm in the mood to hold your hand through this entire process.  Maybe I'll come back another time.
I'm going to go see Odysseus then.  Anything else I should ask him?
Will do.  Bye.
Yes, please.  The person I'm trying to get the liniment for really does need it.
No, thank you.  I'll come back some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, right!  I'm glad you came back.

replies.reply_text: Lanolin.  Check.  What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: The next ingredient is rosemary.  I have a little here for cooking, but not nearly enough.  I'd recommend Rika's shop on Spice Isle for this.

replies.reply_text: How much do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, right!  You had even started writing a list.  I kept it  for you in case you came back. The first is four cups of this lanolin stuff.  I've never met anyone with sheep, so you'll have to figure that out for yourself.

replies.reply_text: Lanolin.  Check.  What's next?
Lanolin. Check.  What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: It says 2 gills, which is 1 cup.  I'm halving this recipe, so I'll need half a cup.

replies.reply_text: Got it.  Anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: The last two ingredients are Camphor and Witch Hazel.  We would need 4 cups of each.

replies.reply_text: Do you know where to get those things?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no, not really.  They sound very foreign.  In these quantities, I doubt they're herbs.  I assume they have some healing properties if topically applied, like in the liniment.  Do you happen to know anyone who's familiar with alternative medicine -- a shaman or a medicine man?

replies.reply_text: I have a few ideas. I've met some people like that on Jungle Isle.
I don't have any idea.   I'll have to come back and see you again, when I'm more familiar with all the residents.
I'll keep it right near the top of my inventory!  I'll be back after I find everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were gathering ingredients so that I could make my father's Aromatic Liniment for you.  I hope you still have your list!

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course.  It's right here in my inventory.   I'll be back after I find everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I thought you were going to go check with Odysseus to find out what a "gill", a "peck", and "lanolin" are.

replies.reply_text: Oops!  That's right... I forgot.  I'll go see Odysseus now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  First I'll need the lanolin.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.
He couldn't give me any less.  I had to take a gallon of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Next I'll take the rosemary.

replies.reply_text: Here it is.
Yes, she said it was fresh.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, did you find the camphor and the witch hazel?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I found someone with a knowledge of these strange ingredients.  Here you go!
Yep, you can smell it even though it's wrapped so well!

chatpoints.chat_text: Before I try to make this liniment, do you mind if I take your list?  I feel a bit possessive about the recipe, if that makes sense.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.
Anything else you need from me?

chatpoints.chat_text: I just need a little time, so I can follow the directions on the recipe very carefully, but I should have the liniment ready shortly.  Why don't you play in an art room for a few minutes, or try your hand at Rainboku?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back soon.
Yes, that sounds fair.  I don't know what I'd do with lanolin, anyway.   I'm sure Jubal will really appreciate all this liniment!
Sounds good.  No time to chitchat, I want to get this delivery over with as soon as possible.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Jubal?  Oh, that is amusing.  He's the current resident of my childhood home.  I've met him before, while visiting  Palila and Odysseus.  He seems a little... preoccupied.

replies.reply_text: That's true!  He has trouble with his memory.  He said he makes rope because he found the words “make rope” on some scraps of paper, and he didn't know what else to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that is odd.  I can't imagine that we left those scraps there.  Palila told me a bit about the night he moved in -- he and his friends had a raucous party! There must be a story there, if I don't miss my guess.

replies.reply_text: People's stories can be fascinating.  That reminds me, Eunice!  Odysseus wanted me to say “hello” for him.
Bye, and thanks again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Leisure time activities...  You have time for leisure time activities?

replies.reply_text: Not for me, Crow's Nest Carrie.  She’s a lighthouse keeper on the Cross Bones.  She’s looking for a feminine hobby.
No, not me, I'm here representing a third party.  A woman in a man's world with time on her hands.
Thanks, I’ll give this to her.  She definitely has enough sand to work with!

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition? I'm all ears. Wwho's it from?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your sand paintings.  Here's your Invitation.
Don't worry, I'll tell Iona.  Bye, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi, I'm Trigger.  Fine day for riding, isn't it?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, nice and sunny.  Is everything all right with you?
Hmm...  Yeah.  Sorry, I'm in a rush.  Got to go...
Hi Trigger!  Did you ever work for a circus?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, no, not really.  I have a few major problems.

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear. Well, I hope you sort them out soon... Bye.
Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah, please.  That would be great.  What's happened is I travel around all over the Horse Isles holding shows of my riding skills, but on my travels I lost 3 items of tack, without which I can't do any more shows.  If you could find them for me, I'd reward you and be ever so grateful.

replies.reply_text: Hmm... Sounds like tiring work.  Sorry I'm too busy to go all that way.
Sure, I will go find them for you.  No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay.  Well, the last place I visited was Flipperton.  Maybe the residents have seen my saddle pad.  You could ask around for clues.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I've changed my mind.  That's too far for me.
All right.  I will.
See you when I've found your saddle pad.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thanks!  Fantastic!  I'm glad you found that leaflet.  I've travelled so much I had quite forgotten where I was after Flipperton.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.
Not right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.
All right.  I guess I could help with something else, if you would like.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, please. Well, the leaflet says before Flipperton I was in Wington, and if my memory serves me right, I left my bridle somewhere in the town.  Ask around there and you may get some clues.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, that is too far for me to go.  Bye.
All right.  I shouldn't be too long.
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow.  Thanks!  You're great.  Here, take this as a reward.  Only my saddle is missing now.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Good luck finding your saddle.
Thanks.  I could help you find your saddle, if you want.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you?  That would be fantastic. I know exactly where I lost it.  It's on Hoof Isle, in front of a willow tree under which I camped.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I'm not heading that way.
Okay.  Well, this is easier.
I'll go and get it straight away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow, that was quick.  That's the lot!  Here, take this as a reward.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot.  Bye and good luck with your shows.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Thanks for your help earlier!!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  See you later.
Hi Trigger!  Did you ever work for a circus?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Any luck?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, sorry.  Where did you want me to go again?
Not yet, sorry.  Where did you want me to go again?
Not yet, sorry.  Where did you want me to go again?
Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
I found your saddle pad.
I got that bridle for you, Trigger.
I found your saddle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Check with the residents in Flipperton.  I believe I lost my saddle pad when I was there.  Someone might have seen it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Will do.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Check with the residents of Wington.  That leaflet said I was there before Flipperton.  I probably lost my bridle there.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll go check it out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go to Hoof Isle.  I know I camped in front of a willow tree.  That must be where I lost it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  You were so much help before.  Would you be able to do me another favor?

replies.reply_text: Not right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.
I can help you find your saddle now, if you want.
Sure.  I could help you, if you like.
Hi Trigger!  Did you ever work for a circus?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I've always been more of a free-lance performer.  I know the circus you're talking about, though... I've had some friends who worked in it.  Let's see... the one who lives closest to here is Reuben the clown.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.

npc_list.name: Daf
npc_list.long_description: Daf is busy either planting, pruning or picking flowers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there!  I'm busy picking flowers.  Don't have time to talk!

replies.reply_text: Hey. I'm sorry I bothered you.  I'll be going..
Iris told me you found Trigger's bridle.
Hi! I'm looking for clues to the disappearance of Opal's "Star of Solomon".  Did you see or hear anything the night of the theft?
But I have a gift from your brother!
Didn't you give me something I was suppose to take to Twig?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it's right here.  I would have taken it to Trigger, but I don't know where he is right now.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, you better start looking.  See ya.
I'll take it for you, if you like.
I'll take it straight to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, a loose horse came running through here during the night, but that happens a lot, anyway.  And no, I didn't see it!  Very busy!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Sorry to bother you.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Twig? I haven't heard from him in ages. Is he okay?

replies.reply_text: He's fine. He just misses you and wanted you to have these roses. I think he's pretty lonely.
How should I know? I'm not getting mixed up in this. I'm outta here.
I'd be happy to. I bet Twig will love this little guy.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were taking a goldfish to Twig.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm heading back to Earton now.

npc_list.name: Gritty
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 16
npc_list.long_description: Gritty is as his name suggest. He's a coarse fellow that doesn't care much for city folk.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't appreciate strangers snooping around. Ya got a good reason to be here?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Sorry.  I'll leave.
Uh, of course I do...  How are you?
I'm sorry to barge in, Gritty.  We got interrupted right as you were explaining that Jubal might still be hypnotized.
Yes I do, as a matter of fact! I've brought you something!

chatpoints.chat_text: What?  How am I?!?  What kind of question is that after you bust into a man's home?!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  Is there something wrong?  You seem awfully unhappy.
Wow, crabby man.  See if anyone will ever help you ever.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good!  I don't need or want any help!  Leave me in peace!

replies.reply_text: Fine.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you did just barge into my house.  That would normally be a good reason to be unhappy.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I'll remember to knock next time.  Bye.
I suppose it would.  Well, I'm sorry for barging in.
That isn't any reason to go yelling at people.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?!  I think so.  Out.  I don't want you here anymore.  Leave.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  Fine.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  Thank you for apologizing...

replies.reply_text: So, you need help with anything?
How come you have a beach out here?  It's a little ways away from the actual beach.
Well, I was wondering, Gritty, did you ever do any work for pirates?

chatpoints.chat_text: I moved up here from a different beach home, so I like my beach sand.   Quite used to it you might say.

replies.reply_text: Very fun.  So, anything I can do for you?
Why didn't you move actually on the beach instead of inland a bit?

chatpoints.chat_text: There was more sand here and it wasn't the water that was important.  It was the sand.

replies.reply_text: Interesting.  Well, it was fun speaking with you.  Bye.
Interesting.  Well, can I help you with anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: Since you have actually been a bit nice, there is something I could use some help with.

replies.reply_text: Really?  What's that?
I can help.  What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I love my collections.  However, when I moved I forgot a few of my most favorite things.  Somewhere in the cabin should be five grains of sparkly blue sand.

replies.reply_text: Oooo, pretty.  Sure, I could try and find them for you.
Five grains of sand?  You're a bit nuts.  Bye.
Great!  I'll get right on that.
Umm...  That's a lot of traveling.  You wouldn't be able to give me some money for the boat fare, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I don't have money to just be throwing around.  You offered help.  I'm not paying you yet.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.  Sorry I asked.

chatpoints.chat_text: What are YOU do...  Oh, it's you.  You find those grains of sand for me yet?

replies.reply_text: I did.  Here you go.
Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
Where was I supposed to go again?
Oh, all right.  Thanks.
By the way, did you know that someone is living in your old place?

chatpoints.chat_text: My place was southwest of Treeton, on a big open part of the beach.  Look closely.  They are small.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes.  That's a buddy of mine.  No problems.  Hope you didn't bug him at all.  Barging in and all as I suppose you did.

replies.reply_text: He wasn't there.  So, no worries.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  It's you.  Well, thanks for helping me get the rest of my collection.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  You're welcome.
I was wondering, Gritty, did you ever do any work for pirates?
I'm sorry to barge in, Gritty.  We got interrupted right as you were explaining that Jubal might still be hypnotized.
You're welcome. And now I've brought you something else. Something I think you'll want!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you know about that?!

replies.reply_text: I'm trying to help Jubal remember a bit more about his past.  I have a few clues, but they don't make a lot of sense.  Someone said they think they saw you at Jubal's party with the pirates on the night he lost his memory.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't go accusing me of anything. I was just there for the money.  Just doing my job, you might say.

replies.reply_text: I'm not accusing you.  I'm just trying to help Jubal.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's the only thing I was trained for – hypnotism.  The only thing I was good at!  There wasn't much call for it after the circus closed. I had to do something for money!  I have to eat!

replies.reply_text: Okay Mr. Defensive,  I'll leave you alone.  I don't think I want to hang around a hypnotist anyway!
It's all right, you can trust me with your secret.  I swear I won't tell anyone about your part in it, and it seems to be bothering you.  Please let me help.
You mean he's... he couldn't possibly still be hypnotized!

chatpoints.chat_text: He probably is, at least partly.  It would have faded a bit over time.  I'm sure that's why his memory is not clear.  There has got to be a trick to take him out of it, but that pirate, Jack, he just had me put Jubal into a trance, and then he kicked me out.

replies.reply_text: Wow, Calico Jack doesn't sound like the great friend that Jubal remembers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jack was a very clever and suspicious man.  He had something up his sleeve.   Some of the other Crossbones Pirates seemed to be in on it, too.  At least they knew to leave when Jack told them to.

replies.reply_text: Do you know anything else about whatever the plot was?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've told you everything I know about that night, but Calico Jack did give me a couple of scraps of paper.  I don't know why I kept them.  I'm pretty surprised no one has come for them by now, actually.  If you want them, I'd be happy to give them to you, and try to forget about the whole thing.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I'll take them for you.  I hope that talking about it has made you feel better.  Calico Jack is the one who should be ashamed of himself, not you.  Thank you for trusting me.  I won't disappoint you.
Whaaa?  Are you trying to trick me?  You're too scary... I'm leaving before you make me act like a monkey.
Thank you very much.  Try not to worry about it any more.

chatpoints.chat_text: You think I want something? Why would I want anything? I've got just about all I want right now!

replies.reply_text: I really believe you'll want this. Dusty sent it.
Okay, fine. I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: Dusty? He must have gotten my package. Okay, hand it over.

replies.reply_text: Umm, 'please' would be nice. But okay, here it is.

Yes he did. I think it really caught him by surprise. I can't believe you stole his toy truck when he was 5 years old and you've held onto it all this time. But it was nice of you to finally return it. So he sent you this.

chatpoints.chat_text: An origami dove! I taught him how to make this shape!

replies.reply_text: Imagine a fellow like you doing something like origami! I never ceased to be surprised.

npc_list.name: Holly
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests start at CP7
npc_list.long_description: Holly is a very neatly dressed younger woman and her home is very tidy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Welcome to my home.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  It's chilly on this part of the isle!
I can't right now, I was just having a look around.
Hi there, I have been looking for you!
It's like a perpetual winter here.  It's good that you like it like this.
I'm back with the snowman supplies that you asked me to get.
What was I supposed to get for you?
I just dropped by to see how your snowman building went.
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with the hat from Jayne.
Hello.  I have something that may be yours.
Hi!  I was wondering if you could help me. I'm looking for hobby suggestions...

chatpoints.chat_text: Hee hee!  Yes, I suppose the snow does make the temperature a little cooler here.

replies.reply_text: I guess you must like the snow and cold, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, yes!  The cold helps preserve a lot of the treasures I have stored here.

replies.reply_text: Treasures?   Is that what's in all those glass cases?
Hmm...  Well that's nice. I'd better go.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep!  I've been all over the Isles collecting all sorts of things!

replies.reply_text: I like collecting things too!  What do you like to collect the most?
Bah, collections are boring!  I have to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, right now I'm collecting miniatures of all the horses that can be found on Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's sounds like it would take a lot of time.  Good luck with your collecting!  Bye now.
I see that you have a horse miniature missing.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sigh) Yes. It was one of my favorites. A chestnut Shire. I lost it a few weeks ago. I feel just terrible. Every time I look into the case, it seems empty without it.

replies.reply_text: Well, perhaps I could help you find it.  I'm not too busy right now.
Well, I'm sorry that you lost it, but I have to be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, if you could look around for me, that would be wonderful!  I do so miss that little horse!

replies.reply_text: Where should I go to start to look?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did you find my little chestnut Shire for me?

replies.reply_text: Yes, here it is!
No, sorry.  I almost got frostbite searching!  I'll go and look again.
Where exactly in Chillton did you say to search?
I'm back about those snowman supplies that you asked me to get.
You're very welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks again for finding my miniature Shire for me.  My collection is complete again!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome. Glad I could help!
I have been looking for you!
It's like a perpetual winter here.  It's good that you like it like this.

chatpoints.chat_text: Somewhere between Rupert's and the wagon station in Chillton is the last place I saw my miniature horse.  It must have gotten lost there.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the first place to try would probably be my old hometown, Chillton.  I used to live where Rupert lives now.  My best guess is that I lost my Shire miniature when we were on our way to the wagon station.  So perhaps you could search around there.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go and look around there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me? Why are you looking for me?

replies.reply_text: Parry sent you a gift.

chatpoints.chat_text: Parry?  Oh my, I have not heard from him in so very long. How is he?

replies.reply_text: He is okay. I think. He is not into a lot of chatter or a lot of clutter.

chatpoints.chat_text: That sounds like Parry. You said he sent me something.

replies.reply_text: Yes, a miniature stable to house your miniature horses.
Here you go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you be willing to take him a letter for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.
No, I don't think I want to go back to Treeton today.
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you deliver my letter to Parry?

replies.reply_text: Yep, all done.
Parry? Was that who it was? I could not remember what you said.
Not yet.  I'll go do that now.
No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  What I really enjoy doing is building snowmen.

replies.reply_text: Sweet!  Sounds like fun.  How often do you do that?
Well, I hope you enjoy yourself.  I need to go.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: As often as I can, but there is not a whole lot of snowman supplies around here.

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe I can help you get some.  What do you need?
Maybe some other time.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let's see.  I need lots of snow.  Maybe 100 snowballs.  That will help add to the bit that falls around here.  You will have to get them in 2 lots. Also, I need 2 strong skinny branches for the arms, and a couple of walnuts for the eyes.  Oh yes, and a carrot for the nose.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can help you get that.
I have other things I need to do right now. I'll come back later.
No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great. What do you have?

replies.reply_text: I have the first lot of snowballs.
I have the second lot of snowballs.
I have 2 skinny branches.
I have 2 walnuts.
I have a carrot for you.
I think I've given you everything you asked for.
Okay.  I have more.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back with that later.
Wow.  That was a lot of snowballs to cart.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back with that later.
These will look good as arms.  I have more.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back with that later.
I'm sure they will look good.  Here, I have more.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back with that later.
I'm sure he will look swell with that nose.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back with that later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get me 100 snowballs, 2 strong skinny branches, 2 walnuts and a carrot.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go and get them, then.
Okay.  I will be back soon.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm really happy with him, except for one thing.

replies.reply_text: Oh, what might that be?
I'd rather not get into another job right now.  I have things to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he could really do with a hat.

replies.reply_text: Where do you think I might get one from?
I think I'll come back later and help you with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have heard that Jayne on Turtle Isle has quite a reputation for nice hats.  Maybe he would have an old one that he would be able to give me.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I guess I can go and ask him for you.
On second thought, I'll help you later with the hat.  Okay?
Sure.  No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see Jayne on Turtle Isle about a hat for the snowman.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll see you when I get back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, swell.  I hope he is well.

replies.reply_text: Yes, he seemed fine.

chatpoints.chat_text: Very good.  Let me have a look at that hat.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  Here it is.
I'm glad to be of service.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh?  Really?  Do you have the miniature horse that disappeared out of my collection?

replies.reply_text: I do!
Wow!  You must have missed it.  Here it is!
No problem.  Thanks for the reward!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  I though traveling was your hobby.

replies.reply_text: It’s not for me, it’s for a lady pirate on the Pirate Isles.  She finds that lately she has a lot of time in her hands.
I’m here for one of the lighthouse keepers on the Cross Bones.  She feels that she needs a hobby to pass the time.
Thank you.  I’ll give Carrie this Seahorse and your suggestion.

npc_list.name: Caeralus
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP12
npc_list.long_description: Caeralus is  mostly a loner but for the few people that know him they say there is no truer friend.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, where'd you come from?  How'd you get in here?

replies.reply_text: I found my way through that forest maze.  Should I not be here?
I worked my way through that stupid maze!   Why surround yourself like that?  What are you trying to hide, huh?
I see you don't want me here...  I guess I'll work my way back out.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to keep nosy people like you away from me.  Now leave please.

replies.reply_text: I worked my way through that long maze and you expect me to just leave?
Fine.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes I do.  I don't enjoy dealing with rude people.  If you come in here again you better be a bit nicer about it.

replies.reply_text: Rude?!   I just came all that way and you won't even talk to me?
We'll see.
All right.  I'm sorry.  This is your place.  I should be nicer.  Why do you live so far away from everything?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would prefer not, but I suppose since you're already here...

replies.reply_text: So, why do you live so far away from everything?
Yeah, that was quite a maze you had made.  I guess I'll try to find my way out.

chatpoints.chat_text: I like my privacy.  Then I can do what I want without others questioning me.

replies.reply_text: Well, is there anything you need help with?  I imagine you don't get visitors much...
I see.  Well, I guess I'll leave you be then.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I really don't.  Umm...  I don't really need anything.

replies.reply_text: You sure?  I came all this way I'd like to help with something.
All right.  Well, I'll be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I am looking for something right now.  I could use some help with that I guess.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll help you with that.
Looking for stuff?  No thanks.  I guess I'll get out of your way.
All right.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: So?  How'd the search go?

replies.reply_text: Great.  I found them all.  They are big!
Haven't found them all yet.  Where did you want me to look again?
Haven't found them yet.  I'll get right to that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look closely around the stumps in the meadow.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh nothing, nothing...  You know, since you were so helpful last time, there is something else I could use some help with.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  I'll help.
I really don't want to do any other favors right now.  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back?  Well, thanks again for finding those feathers for me.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  What was it that you didn't want there to be proof of?
No problem.
