chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  I need some feed from the Wington Feed Store.  Talk to Levi.  He'll know what I need.

replies.reply_text: Wington?!?  Why all the way to Wington?
Wington is way too far.  Sorry.  Guess I won't be helping.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's special feed.  Levi is the only one that has it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  I'll head out now.
Well, that's nuts.  I'm not going all the way to Wington for feed.  Good luck!
Thanks.  I'll be back shortly.
Thanks.  Umm..  Would you be able to help me out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: How was your trip?  Did you get the feed from Levi?

replies.reply_text: No.  Where was I supposed to go again?
Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
Yes I did.  Here you go.
No, not yet.  Could help me out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: To the feed store in Wington.  Levi runs it.  He'll give you what I need.

replies.reply_text: Oh right.  Okay, I'll be back soon.
Thanks.  Umm..  Would you be able to help me out of here?
You're welcome...  Erebus?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, umm..  He's just my, uh, pet.   I was running low on food for him.  Thanks again.

replies.reply_text: Sure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're back.  That's great.  Erebus wants to see you.

replies.reply_text: What?  Your pet?
That's a bit weird.  I've had about enough of you.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes.  He was glad for everything you did earlier and since I don't travel much he wanted you to do something for him.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see Erebus.
That means I'm going to have to travel some more?  No thanks.  Good luck finding someone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll find him here.
How did things go with Erebus?  Well I hope.

replies.reply_text: A Pegasus?!?  You knew about a Pegasus and never told anyone?!?
Yeah...  Umm..  do you know anything about a Unicorn?
Yep, just fine, thanks.
Yeah, it went great.  I just came from Allaire and she wanted me to give Erebus a note.  She was worried about him.
I'm wondering if I might go see Erebus again. I'd like to ask him a favor on behalf of Aislin on Cloud Isle.
Actually, I didn't get a chance to give him Allaire's note.  Could you send me to him again please?
Actually....  I was able to leave the meadow before talking to him.  Could you send me back please?

chatpoints.chat_text: He likes to keep to himself, but he does like his special food, so he needed someone to help him out.

replies.reply_text: I suppose.  Well, he wants me to find a Unicorn...  Do you know anything about a Unicorn?
I suppose.  Well, time for me to head out.  Glad I could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh sure.  He likes his privacy too, but he's somewhere on the southeastern part of Horse Isle, near a forest.  If you ask around you should be able to find him.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good good.  Well, thanks for everything you did.  Enjoy your travels.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.
You're welcome.  Umm...  Could you help me out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's kind of her.  Oh, I know she likes to have his feathers.  Here, I'll give you a little bag of feathers and then send you to Erebus.

replies.reply_text: Oh, great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, Erebus really likes his privacy, but... Since you've done so much for us, I suppose I can send you back there again.

replies.reply_text: Well, I don't want to be a bother, I'll just go.
Thanks, I appreciate it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Are you enjoying your visit to Flower Island?

replies.reply_text: No way! All the smells are giving me a headache.
Oh, it is so beautiful. I'm looking forward to exploring the island.
I wasn't really planning to come here, but Krista sent you a delivery.
Actually I'm here on an errand.  Mehitabel asked me to find Archy. Has he been here lately?
Yes, yes I am.  Sorry to bother you, but where did you say Archy was going after he left here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm sorry you don't feel well. Maybe you should go somewhere less fragrant to explore.

replies.reply_text: You're right. I think I will do that. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am so glad you like our little island. Are you planning to stay long?

replies.reply_text: No, I have to be going now.
Well, I do have some time on my hands. Is there anything I should see or do while I am here?

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll want to stop and smell the flowers while you are here. Hmmm, could I ask a favor of you?

replies.reply_text: No way. I may have time on my hands, but I don't want to waste it on anyone but me. I'm going exploring now.
A favor? Sure, I guess so.
Sure, I love doing favors for people!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need to take some flowers to some friends, but don't have time to go get them. Could you bring me 10 bunches of wildflowers?

replies.reply_text: 10 bunches? That is an awful lot. I think I can do it, though.
10 bunches? No thanks! No way!
10 bunches? Is that all? I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, did you get my wildflowers?

replies.reply_text: Was that what I was supposed to be doing? I'll get right on it.
Here they are. Now you can take them to your friends.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! My friends really enjoyed the flowers you found for them.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful!
That's great!  I came by again because Krista sent you a delivery.
Actually I'm here on an errand.  Mehitabel asked me to find Archy. Has he been here lately?
Yes, yes I am.  Sorry to bother you, but where did you say Archy was going after he left here?
Okay, I'll get right on it!
I'm heading there now.
Oh he's the caretaker on Tail Isle.  Thanks Tulippe!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's perfectly all right.  Archy was going on to see Murray on Tail Isle.

replies.reply_text: Murray?  Oh yeah, he's the caretaker on Tail Isle.  Thanks, Tulippe!

npc_list.name: Lilac
npc_list.long_description: Lilac is a sweet woman that has many friends.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello dear.  Do come in... My name is Lilac.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot.  I was just looking around.  I'll be going now.
Thank you Lilac.  Thought I'd pop in and see if you need any help?
Hi Lilac!  I have a delivery from the Pony Express!
Hello, Lilac.  I'm looking for Archy. Has he been by here lately?
Hello again, Lilac!  I'm sorry, but I forgot where you said Archy went after he picked up the flower seeds.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, my dear.  Would I be asking too much of you to find my silly husband and his horse?

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I don't have time at the moment.  Goodbye.
Not at all.  Where would he be?
Okay.  I won't be long.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for your help dear.

replies.reply_text: Hi Lilac!  I have a delivery from the Pony Express!
You're welcome Lilac.
You're welcome Lilac...  But what was I supposed to be doing again?
Hello, Lilac.  I'm looking for Archy. Has he been by here lately?
Hello again, Lilac!  I'm sorry, but I forgot where you said Archy went after he picked up the flower seeds.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I've shouted for him, but he is quite deaf, you see, and it's time for tea.  I'm sure my husband will reward you.  The last time I saw him, he was in the woods at the southern-most point of the island.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I don't have time to run around at the moment.  Goodbye.
Great.  I'll go find him straight away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go find my husband, Gandalf.  He should be in the woods at the southern-most point of the island.

replies.reply_text: Right.  Thanks.
You're welcome, and enjoy!
Tulippe is Mehitabel's cousin?  I never knew... Guess I need to talk to her then.  Thanks, Lilac!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right. Archy was going to stop in on Mehitabel's cousin, Tulippe, before he left the island.

replies.reply_text: Oh, your neighbor, that's right!  Thanks again, Lilac.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, stranger.  We don't get too many visitors on this island, on account of Caeralus buying up the rest of the island.

replies.reply_text: Caeralus?
Hi there.  Is there anything I can help you with?
Hello there, Thorne.  Do you, by chance, make shoes?
Hello.  Sorry, but what was it I was supposed to get for you again?
Hi, Thorne.  I'm back with the supplies you wanted!
Hi.  Shoes ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Caeralus is a strange, very suspicious man.  I've only seen him a couple times.  Most of what I've heard is rumor.  I'm not even sure where he lives!

replies.reply_text: Rumors?
Thanks.  Is there anything I can help you with?
I must be on my way now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, some say he lives in the center of Petal Forest, but I've hiked in there and I can't imagine there is any way through those dense trees!  Others say they have seen him sneaking around in the middle of the night.  That's all I know about Caeralus.

replies.reply_text: Thanks much, bye.
Is there anything I can help you with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now that you offered, my dog, Tookers, has been gone for quite some time.

replies.reply_text: I'll gladly help find him!  Do you have any idea where he might be?
That's too bad.  Hope you find him.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  He's always wandering around the center of the old chopped forest just east of here.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll go see if I can find him for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you able to find Tookers?

replies.reply_text: No.  I'll get right on that.
Not yet.  Where was I supposed to look?
I did.  I had to find his bone for him.  It seemed like he would be heading home in not too long.

chatpoints.chat_text: He's always wandering around the center of the old chopped forest just east of here.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay, I'll go look for him.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks much for finding Tookers.  I appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: Glad I could be of some help.
Hello there, Thorne.  Do you, by chance, make shoes?
Hi, Thorne.  I'm back with the supplies you wanted!
Hi.  Shoes ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nooooooooooooooooooooooOOOOO!

replies.reply_text: You've dealt with her before, I see.
You've dealt with her before, I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: Shoes?  Why, yes, I make shoes, from time to time... Why?  Do you need shoes?

replies.reply_text: Princess Pookie-----

chatpoints.chat_text: Sigh... Well, you found Tookers for me, I guess I ought to help you.  What does she want?

replies.reply_text: Well, she wants a new pair of shoes, as I'm sure you've guessed.  And normally I wouldn't bother, but she's got a baby dragon in a cage and she won't let it go, except in trade for shoes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that kid!  What's she want now?  Like I have all the time in the world...

replies.reply_text: Well, she wants a new pair of shoes, as I'm sure you've guessed.  And normally I wouldn't bother, but she's got a baby dragon in a cage and she won't let it go, except in trade for shoes.

chatpoints.chat_text: A baby what?  You can't keep a dragon in a cage, honestly!

replies.reply_text: Well, yes, exactly!  I'd release it if I could get near it, but she's got one of her trolls guarding it.

chatpoints.chat_text: And you're sure she'll call him off if you give her the shoes?

replies.reply_text: Well, no, now that you mention it.  But I have to try.  It's cruel to keep something locked up in a cage piled over with shoes!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you're right.  It is.  And I'll make a pair of shoes, but to help you get the dragon freed, you understand; not for Miss Snappy Mouth.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much, I really appreciate it.  I'll get that dragon freed somehow.  Is there anything you need from me?
I can get those!  I'll be back as soon as I can.  Thanks so much!
Oh, no.  Two rubies?  No princess is worth that!  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to get two leather pieces and two rubies.

replies.reply_text: Ah!  Right!  I'll go do that now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great, give them to me, please.

replies.reply_text: Here you go, sir.
Okay.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Shoes. (Thorne motions to a table. Sitting together are a pair of sling-back pumps. They are hot pink, shiny, and studded with.... glittery.... stuff. The rubies you brought adorn the toes.)
There you go. That'll be $5,000.

replies.reply_text: Five thousand?  That's insane!  No way!  Forget it!
Uhm... I wish you'd have told me they were going to be so expensive.  I'll have to go to the bank.  I'll be back.
Okay, for the little dragon.  Here you are.
Thanks.  Wish me luck!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Rrruuufff!   RRrrruuufff!

replies.reply_text: (Walk away.)
Hey boy!  I just talked to Thorne, your owner.  He wanted to make sure you were okay.
Look boy!  I found your bone!

chatpoints.chat_text: Rrruufff! Wooff! Rrroonnnee!! (Pointing with his nose towards the stumps.)

replies.reply_text: I have no idea what you are trying to tell me.
What?  You lost your bone by a stump?

chatpoints.chat_text: Rrruufff... (Hanging his head.)

replies.reply_text: Ooh, you don't know which stump?
You are a weird dog.  Go find your own bone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rruff, rruff.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll dig around the stumps and see if I can find your bone.
Great.  Well, I'll go tell Thorne that you're just fine now that you have your bone.

npc_list.name: Erebus
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 13
npc_list.long_description: Erebus is a magnificent creature, he's a flying horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for coming, and for everything you have done for me and Caeralus.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Is there something else I can help you with?
WOW!  A Pegasus!!  And you can talk?!  That's really neat!  No wonder he was trying to keep you a secret.  I suppose I could follow suit.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would appreciate that.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Well, what can I do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  As you found before, I am having problems with my wings and, therefore, cannot fly long distances.  I need you to go to the Unicorn and tell him that is why I have not been to visit lately.

replies.reply_text: A Unicorn?!   Wow!  That's really neat!  Where is he?
Sure, I can do that.  I met him earlier.  It shouldn't be too hard to get to him again.
I can do that.  Umm...  Where is he?
I don't know.  It was a bit of a pain to get to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: You will need to find him on your own.  He tends to stay on the mainland.

replies.reply_text: Well, the mainland is a little big.  I'll do the best I can.
I'll do my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am glad you are back.  The Unicorn is doing well?

replies.reply_text: Yes, he seemed upset that you weren't doing well, but was glad that you sent him a message.
Yes.  Umm..  How come you can talk but he can't?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just because he chooses not to speak to you does not mean he cannot talk.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Huh.  Well, glad I could be of some help.  Is there anything else I can help with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at this time.  I may have something later.  You may see Caeralus when that time comes and he will get you to me.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Now, how do I get out of here...

chatpoints.chat_text: I am glad to hear that.  I may need something later.  You may see Caeralus when that time comes and he will get you to me.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Now, how do I get out of here...

chatpoints.chat_text: I would greatly appreciate it if you could deliver this message.  Caeralus is unable to travel that distance.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll do it, but only because I'll be stuck here if you don't let me out.
All right.  I'll deliver the message for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for all you have done for me.  Now, why did Caeralus send you here?

replies.reply_text: I spoke to Allaire.  She was concerned about your injury.  She gave me a note to give you.  Here you are.
Sorry to bother you.  I have a note from Allaire to give you.

I've come on behalf of Aislin on Cloud Isle. She's trying to build wings for her horse so she doesn't feel so plain next to all the other pegasi up there. Would you happen to have any spare feathers I could give her?
You're welcome.  Could you actually help me out of here?  I would hate to be stuck in this meadow, even if it is gorgeous.

chatpoints.chat_text: I enjoyed the note from Allaire, thank you.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.

I'm glad! I'm actually here on behalf of Aislin on Cloud Isle. She's trying to build wings for her horse so she doesn't feel so plain next to all the other pegasi up there. Would you happen to have any spare feathers I could give her?
You're welcome.  Could you actually help me out of here?  I would hate to be stuck in this meadow, even if it is gorgeous.

chatpoints.chat_text: I probably have a few. I always keep the feathers that molt off of my wings. I'll just gather up a few for you here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I appreciate it!

npc_list.name: Gandalf
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 7
npc_list.long_description: Gandalf is a tall, slender old man. He is very hard of hearing.

chatpoints.chat_text: HELLO!  DID YOU SAY SOMETHING?

replies.reply_text: Nope, see you later...
Yeah.  Sorry, but are you Gandalf?
Yeah.  I found Shadowfax for you.
WASN'T I DOING SOMETHING FOR YOU?

chatpoints.chat_text: WHY, YES I AM, BUT YOU'LL HAVE TO SPEAK UP A LITTLE.  I DON'T HEAR TOO WELL.

replies.reply_text: YEAH, I SEE. WELL, SEE YOU AROUND.
OH, GOOD.  GANDALF, YOUR WIFE SENT ME TO TELL YOU IT'S TEA TIME.

chatpoints.chat_text: OH, DEAR.  SHADOWFAX WON'T ANSWER MY WHISTLE.  SEEMS HE'S A LITTLE DEAF IN HIS OLD AGE, TOO.

replies.reply_text: WELL, I TOLD YOU YOUR MESSAGE.  I'LL BE GOING NOW.
WELL, HOW ABOUT I GO FIND HIM AND TELL HIM IT'S TEA TIME?

chatpoints.chat_text: WOULD YOU?  THAT'S SO NICE OF YOU.  HE LIKES TO GO TO THE BEACH AT THE POINT OF THE NORTH WESTERN PETAL, AND IF YOU RETURN HERE AFTER, I'LL REWARD YOU.

replies.reply_text: I'M A LITTLE BUSY NOW.  MAYBE LATER.
OKAY.  I'LL GO TELL HIM.
WON'T TAKE LONG.  SEE YOU SOON.

chatpoints.chat_text: THANK YOU, STRANGER.  HERE.  TAKE THIS REWARD FROM MY WIFE AND I.

replies.reply_text: THANK YOU, SIR.
NO THANKS.  BYE
THANK YOU.  ENJOY YOUR TEA.

chatpoints.chat_text: HELLO FRIEND.  NICE TO SEE YOU AGAIN.

replies.reply_text: YES AND YOU. GOT TO GO.  LOOK AFTER YOURSELF, SIR.

chatpoints.chat_text: WHAT?

replies.reply_text: I FOUND SHADOWFAX FOR YOU.

chatpoints.chat_text: YES.  OF COURSE.  YOU WERE FINDING SHADOWFAX.  HE LIKES TO GO TO THE BEACH AT THE POINT OF THE NORTH WESTERN PETAL.

replies.reply_text: OH, YEAH.  I'LL GO FIND HIM NOW.

npc_list.name: Shadowfax
npc_list.admin_description: &New quests start at CP17
npc_list.long_description: Shadowfax is a gorgeous silver steed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.  I'm Shadowfax.  What can I do for you?  And by the way, yes, I am a talking horse.

replies.reply_text: Errrrm.. Nothing.  I'm going now.
I have a message for you from Gandalf...
Okay.  Take care then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for the message.  I'm going in a little while, when the sun goes down.

replies.reply_text: Okay, see you.
While you're contemplating the sunset, I have a surprise for you. WildFire has sent you a gift!!

chatpoints.chat_text: And what would that be?

replies.reply_text: It's tea time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, and what might that be, I wonder?

replies.reply_text: He said it was for your birthday.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fantastic!  I always look forward to his gift.  I hope it's what he usually sends me!

replies.reply_text: Yes, I think you're going to like this.
Well, I hope you enjoy them, and have a happy birthday.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for bringing me those apples from WildFire.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I hope you enjoyed them.

npc_list.name: Easter Bunny
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP30
npc_list.long_description: Easter Bunny is a very large, pink, talking rabbit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there.  Don't be alarmed.  Come in dear.  I don't bite.

replies.reply_text: Errm...   I don't want to take the chance.  See ya.
Hello.  I'm guessing you're the Easter Bunny?
Hi!  I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
That's good to hear.
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!
Sorry, but what did you need again?
Hello!  Look what Princess Pookie stole!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes I am.  How did you guess that?

replies.reply_text: Doesn't matter.  I have to go.  Bye.
Well, I've already met talking horses, Santa and elves, so I'm not surprised to see a talking rabbit who lays eggs.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see.  Well, nice to meet you all the same, but I won't be the Easter Bunny for long if I don't find my missing eggs.  They'll probably get a chicken next year.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  What a shame.  Well, goodbye.
Oh no.  If you remember whereabouts you were when you lost them, I may be able to help find them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's so kind of you.  I was in the woods around my hut.  I only go past the tree stumps that are north of my house when I make my deliveries, so you shouldn't find any above those.  There are five eggs missing.  They may be under leaves so I hope you have a rake.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I don't have time to look right now.  Maybe later.
Well, I shouldn't be long finding them, then.  Try not to worry.
See you soon.
Great.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.  Thank you so much for your help before. Do come back if you can offer me any more help.

replies.reply_text: It was no problem.  Good luck with your deliveries.  Bye.
I could help you with something now, if you'd like?
I could help you with something now, if you'd like?
I could help you with something now, if you'd like?
Not right now.  I'm helping someone else right now.  I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
Probably not now.  Sorry.  Anything else exciting though?  It is spring now, you know.
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!
Sorry, but what did you need again?
Hello!  Look what Princess Pookie stole!

chatpoints.chat_text: How has the egg hunt gone so far?

replies.reply_text: Not great.  I'll head out and look some more.
I have all your eggs.  All safe and sound.  Do you want them now?
Sorry.  I haven't found them all yet.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do need to get my order of Chocolate Niblets from Ollie.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I really don't have time.  Bye.
Yeah, sure.  I could do that for you. Where can I find Ollie?
Okay.  I shouldn't be long.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get my order, dear?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't have time.  Maybe later.  Bye.
No, sorry.  Could you tell me where it is again?
Yes, I have it here.
Not yet. Actually, I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
Sorry, but what did you need again?
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  You need to go talk to Ollie Scooper on Turtle Isle.  He's at the pet shop.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  I won't be long.
Thank you. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh great.  Thank you. I need some chocolate icing from Sasha Stocker.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I really don't have time.  Bye.
I'll go get it for you, if you'd like.
Okay.  I won't be long.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get the icing off Sasha, dear?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't have time.  I'll go get it now.  Bye.
Yes.  I have it right here.
Not yet.  Actually, I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
Thank you. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  Let me see.  Oh, I need to collect some wrapping paper from Mrs. Claus.   Would you be able to get that for me?

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I'm not going up there.  It's too cold.
Sure, I can do that for you.
Actually, I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
Sorry, but what did you need again?
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!
All right.  Thank you.  I won't be long.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you got the wrapping paper for me, then?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't have time.  I'll go get it now.  Bye.
Yes.  Here it is.
Thank you so much. Goodbye

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again. Thank you so much for your help before. Forgive me for not getting up, I hurt my paw hopping through Appleton yesterday morning.

replies.reply_text: It was no problem.  Good luck with your deliveries.  Bye.
Not a problem.  But now I'm helping someone else.  I need to get an egg for Gidget, a wood elf.  She took an eagle's egg and won't give it back until she has a decoration to replace it.
Oh no! Will you be all right?
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
Sorry, but what did you need again?
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!
Hello!  Look what Princess Pookie stole!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that's terrible!  Let me go look for a nice one.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.
Thank you very much!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great! Another week's worth of carrots should be plenty. Think you can pick some up for me? There is a marvellous carrot patch near town where they grow.

replies.reply_text: Carrots? Are you insane? No thanks, I don't feel like digging around in the dirt today.
Erm... Well, I just bought these shoes, but I suppose the sacrifice would be worth it...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, it's already mending. My supplies are starting to run low, though.

replies.reply_text: Bummer. Good luck with that, I'm outta here.
Do you need me to get anything for you?
I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you manage to get those carrots yet?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, those weeds are tougher than they look! I'll get back to it. Bye!
Sure did, here you go!
How many did you need again?
Thanks a ton! Hope your paw feels better soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's my favorite helper! You are always welcome here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! Just wanted to say 'hi'. I must be off!
I'm glad to hear it! I'm helping someone else right now. Gidget, the wood elf, stole Leuko's egg and won't give it back unless she can have a nice decoration from you.
Thanks!  It is spring time!  It is lovely out now.
Actually, this time I think I need your help with something.
Sorry, but what did you need again?
I'm back and I got all your gems and ore!
Hello!  Look what Princess Pookie stole!

chatpoints.chat_text: Seven would work splendidly.

replies.reply_text: I'll go work on getting those now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it is around that time of year. Easter and all that. Hmm.. Let's see, I should have something here for you. (He hops around the room.) Aha! Here it is.

replies.reply_text: Oh, umm, thanks, but no thanks.  I think I'll just go now.
Ooo, what is it?  This is exciting.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? What can I do to help you?

replies.reply_text: I was given a poem by Holli Daysin in Tropicton and I think I'm supposed to see you for an Easter egg... Or something like that.

chatpoints.chat_text: How amusing!  Just what does this poem say about me?

replies.reply_text:
Go to the island of the rare hare
pick up an egg that's beyond compare.
You're the rare hare, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I suppose that's me...

replies.reply_text: And you can give me an egg that's beyond compare, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: You see, besides the normal Easter eggs I produce, my hobby is creating jeweled eggs.  They're somewhat like the Faberge eggs commissioned by the Russian Tzar.

replies.reply_text: That must be what I'm supposed to get!  Do you have any available?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well now, maybe I do and maybe I don't... It all depends... What's in it for me?

replies.reply_text: Oh, is that how it is?  Later for you then!
What do you want for this egg?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me see, I usually use duck eggs. They're a little larger than my regular eggs, you know. (Looking over the workshop.) No, I have enough of them... Ah, here's what I need. I'm running low on gems and silver nuggets.

replies.reply_text: So, you need me to get some materials for you, right?
You're going to need some gems and nuggets, then, I suppose.  I think I'll come back when I have more time.  Bye.
Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have all of these for you.
Wow! This is awesome.... Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear, are you having a moment?  I asked you to bring me 25 small gems and 10 silver chunks.  Hurry back now!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.
Bye.

npc_list.name: Karl
npc_list.admin_description: works with pitch from pine trees
npc_list.long_description: For all the sticky pitch everywhere, Karl looks relatively clean, all except for his hands which look stained and worn from working with the stuff then trying to wash it off.  He is a tall, thin man with very shortly cropped hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, careful!  Don't step in that!  You won't get it off your shoes for a week.

replies.reply_text: Umm..  Yeah.  Bye.
Wow.  What is all this?
Okay...  Umm...  Tessa sent me to get three pails of pitch for her shop.  The roof's a bit leaky.
I got the grasshopper and scorpion for you.
Was there something else you wanted me to get you?  I could do that now.
I found those small gems and agates for you.
Hey Karl!  I just had a brilliant idea!  You're into pitch and resin and stuff like that....
Hi, Karl.  I'm searching for a bucket.
Karl, your cousin Zeke says I should talk to you about Waldo's bucket.
Barrett said you might be able to help me. I've got some boots here that need to be waterproofed.
What was I doing for you?
Oh, thanks for the heads up.  I understand that you know a roofer named Olav.
Sorry to bother you again, but where did you say Olav went?
Hi, Karl!  Have you seen Archy lately?  Mehitabel said he was picking up the island's tar supply.
Sorry to bother you again, Karl. Where did Archy go again?

chatpoints.chat_text: This would be pitch.  I collect it from the pine trees.

replies.reply_text: Why?  What good is that?
Huh.  Well, have fun with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as you can see, it is very sticky.  That leads to all kinds of uses.  It hardens also, so I can encase objects in it.

replies.reply_text: Interesting.  Well, I should be going.  Good luck.
Really?  That's super neat!  What do you normally encase in it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Tessa in Wington?  Haven't heard from her in a while.  Well, let's see...  Oh, shoot.  I'm short a pail.

replies.reply_text: But you have a bunch of pails right here....

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, well, those are for other things.  I can collect some more pitch later, but if I give Tessa three pails, I'll be short one empty pail.  Why don't you run down to the feed store and get one for me.

replies.reply_text: All right.
Maybe a little later.
I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You get that pail yet?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  Be right back.
Not yet.  Where was I supposed to go?
I did.  Umm, Daria didn't seem very happy about giving you a pail.

chatpoints.chat_text: Down to the feed shop.  Daria will have one.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Be right back.
Great.  I'll try to get these back to Tessa without making a mess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  I do get a lot of them from her.  I guess I'll have to figure out something for her soon.  Make her a bit happier.  You got that pail?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: All sorts of things.  A couple things I would love to do would be a scorpion and a grasshopper.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that would be neat.  I could get them for you.
Crazy!  Putting bugs in pitch?  Huh. Well, goodbye.
All right.  Bye.
Oh, okay.  Thanks.
Thanks.  Not now, though.  Maybe some other time.  Bye.
Sure.  I could do something else for you.
All right.  I'll go start searching.  Bye.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, of course!

replies.reply_text: Have you heard of a resin called "lac"?
And the way you encase those bugs in it... you MUST know of a resin called "lac" that's produced by bugs.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm afraid I've never heard of it!  It does sound interesting though.  I'll have to look into it.

replies.reply_text: Drat, I really thought I was on the right track.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did he really?  Wow!  Well, in that case.  Waldo bukkit, Waldo buk... A-HA! Yes!... Uh... Wait a minute, no, that was a cement mixer actually... Let me think...

replies.reply_text: Please, please try to remember!
No reward is worth this.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A bucket, eh!  Well, hah!  You've come to the right place, there're buckets everywhere.  But they're all full and they're all mine!  So there!

replies.reply_text: Well, that's all well and good, but I'm looking for one particular bucket. (You explain about Waldo's missing bucket.)
Forget it, I don't have time for this.  Good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: A walrus bucket? HAHAHAHA!  A walrus bucket!

replies.reply_text: Whatever.  Did you see it?  Do you know where it is?
Okay... Zeke.  Yeah, Viola said he's in Witherton... Thanks.  I'm off.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Yeah, now I remember! Yeeees! Auntie Viola's sink was leaking, so she asked me to go get a bucket, so I went and got this one that was lying on the beach. I wonder if that's it.

replies.reply_text: You mean, Viola has it?!
That's the one!  I guess...
All right, I'll go ask her.  But I'm sure if she had a floppy blue bucket that smells like fish and said "Waldo" on the bottom, she'd know! Bye!
I'll get the ferns and be right back.
I've got the ferns right here!
Thank you so much!  Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting me a dozen ferns. I used mine all up waterproofing the boots.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the reminder. I'll be back soon.
Oh, that's right! Let me check my saddlebags... Yup! I thought so. I've got the ferns right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav? Sure, I know him.  He stayed with me while he was repairing the library's roof and putting a new roof on Jade's workshop.  Once he finished them, he moved on.

replies.reply_text: That's interesting and all, but do you know where he went after he left here?
Art Isle? That's not very far from the cold and ice.  Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem, last I heard from Olav, he was staying at the Inn on Art Isle.

replies.reply_text: That's right, you did say Art Isle!  Thanks again for the help!
Got it. Check with Arbuckle.  Thanks Karl!

chatpoints.chat_text: Archy went off to see Arbuckle.

replies.reply_text: In the cabin west of here?  Gotcha!  Thanks Karl!

npc_list.name: Daria Pale
npc_list.long_description: Daria Pale enjoys her work and it shows. She sincerely enjoys her customers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around.  Thanks.
Have any good horse treats?
Karl needed a pail for his pitch.  He said you have a bunch?
How's your oat supply?
Spike Lizzard said to say hi and that he'll try to visit soon.  He sent you these special treats for your cats.
Where did you say I could find the cat pack again?
Hi!  Dr. Feelbedder said that your cat recently had kittens.  Would you happen to have a white kitten in the litter?
Hello, Ted Capocella sent me to pick up his grain.  Do you have it ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the basics.  I've got hay, water and one type of treat.

replies.reply_text: I guess I'll look elsewhere then.  Thank you.
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, he would.  He likes to get his pails from me.  Thinks I have an endless supply or something.  Sorry.  You don't need to get in the middle of this.  Let me go grab one.

replies.reply_text: Okay...
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Usually I would say it's great, but lately I've been having problem with the mice getting into it.

replies.reply_text: Mice?  On Cat Isle?
Huh.  Well, good luck with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: My thoughts exactly!  There's a pack of wild cats that roam the forests.  They do a great job of keeping the mice out of my oats.  Normally.  Lately they've been slacking off.

replies.reply_text: Really?  I wonder why.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me too.  Why don't you run and see if you can't find them and ask?

replies.reply_text: I guess I could.
I'd rather not.  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  I don't know where they are exactly, but I know they hang around in the forest somewheres.

replies.reply_text: I better start looking then!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, welcome back!  What'd you find out?

replies.reply_text: Wolf's kitten has been really sick, and the whole pack has been really worried about her.
Karl needed a pail for his pitch.  He said you have a bunch?
Oh, I, uh... I was finding something out?  Oh dear.  I've completely forgotten!  Maybe you could remind me?
Oh, right.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure I can remind you!  You're supposed to be lookin' for the pack of cats that wanders around the forest hereabouts.  They ain't been doing their job and I'm mightily curious why.

replies.reply_text: Oh right!  Now I remember.  I'll get right on that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no!  The poor little thing.  Is she all right?

replies.reply_text: She'll be fine!  I went to the vet and got her some medicine.  Wolf said the pack will start getting the mice back in line in no time at all.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's wonderful!  Here, why don't you take this for your hard work?

replies.reply_text: Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you!  Spike knows that I love to reward my favorite cats for all their hard work.

replies.reply_text: So do all the cats stay with the pack, or do some go to other isles?

chatpoints.chat_text: A little of both.  Of course, a lot of them prefer to stay here.  But people are always looking for cats, and cats do love adventures.  Many's the time I've matched up a cat with someone from another isle.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Lucy Reins from the Shellton tack shop was hoping to find a cat to keep her company and keep the mice away.  Do you think she would match up well with any of the cats from the pack?
Thank you.  I'll go look for him.

chatpoints.chat_text: They roam around the woods.  Look around, you'll be sure to find them.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, all of her kittens are calicos. Want one? (She looks at you hopefully.)

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I need to find a white kitten.  They are cute, though!  See ya!
Thanks!  I'll make sure he gets this right away.

npc_list.name: Rebecca
npc_list.long_description: Rebecca wears a toolbelt to keep her carpentry tools nearby. She is wearing blue jean overalls and an orange knit top.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Come in.  Careful of the sawdust.  Wouldn't want you to slip or anything.

replies.reply_text: Wow.  You have quite the set up here.
I can see you're busy.  I'll leave you to your work.  Bye.
Tessa needs some planks made for her shop.
Genevieve of Inkton needs a new pottery wheel.  She said you would be able to make one for her.
I got the metal parts and the 6 logs you needed.
Hello.  Inara sent me to see if you could make a new tea table for her.
I found the 10 branches and one log that you needed.
Odysseus sent me with these plans.  He wants to know if you can make a horse for him?
I found the stuff to make the horse.  Here you go.
I need a wooden saddle form in order to make a saddle.  Would you be able to make me one?
Palila sent me.  She was wondering if you had her wood boxes ready?
I found the log and the 15 strong, skinny branches you needed.
I've come for Magnolia of Treeton. She's hoping you can make her a crib for her baby.
I have the 15 logs and 5 branches for Magnolia's crib.
I'll be careful. I'm just wondering if you happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Liza is in need of a repair for her leaky bucket.  It's a special style of bucket and she doesn't want it to look like a new repair.  Can you help?
Thanks.  Say, Vern mentioned that he invited you to Rashida's party last night.
I'll be careful. I was wondering if you could make this fish? (You show Rebecca the photo.)
Whoops! Wouldn't want to do that while I'm carrying this sculpture! It's for you, for Mona's birthday.
Thanks for the warning!  Anyway, I was here because I was wondering if you would be able to make a shield?
Hi Rebecca!  I'm here with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  I love my wood work.  I collect logs and sticks in the forest to make chairs and tables and all sorts of things.

replies.reply_text: That's really neat.  Well, I'll leave you to your work.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right.  I'll need $100 per log.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  She wanted 10 logs made into planks.  Here you go.
That's a bit pricey.
I think I need to go get some more stuff first.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need to make money somehow.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Well, she needs 10 logs made into planks.   Here you go.
I guess I need to go get some more stuff first.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure can.  I will need you to collect 6 logs and go to Earton to get the metal pieces that I'll need.

replies.reply_text: That seems like a lot of work.  Maybe I'll come back later.
All right.  I can do that.
Okay.  I'll be back soon.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Genevieve should have given you something to cover the costs.  She knows I charge.  If you spent it, you're going to have to find some way to earn some more back before I'll hand this over.

replies.reply_text: Oh, umm, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm just about done with the pottery wheel.  Hang on two seconds and I'll be done.  You have the $3000?

replies.reply_text: That is a lot of money.  I don't have that right now.
I do.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure can.  I will need you to go collect, hmm...  I still have some logs here, but I will need one more.  So, go find 10 strong, skinny branches and one log from the forest.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Really?  I have to go find stuff?  Nevermind, then.
All right.  I can do that.
All right.  Thanks.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm just about done with Inara's tea table.  You have the $2000?

replies.reply_text: Umm....  No.
I do.  Here you are.
No.  I guess I'll go try to make some money.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Inara should have given you something.  If you spent it all, you're going to have to go find some way to earn it back before I hand this over.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back soon.
All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can, but I'll need the wood to make it.  I'll need 30 logs for this and 1 strong, skinny branch.

replies.reply_text: That's a lot.  I think I'll leave it for now.
All right.
I'll be right back...
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing.  I'll need 10 logs and a strong, skinny branch.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I can go find those.
Hmm...  Maybe later, I guess.
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have the wood I need yet?

replies.reply_text: I do.  Here you are.
Not yet.  I'll be back shortly.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have it done for you.  Do you have the $300?

replies.reply_text: Oh, oops.  Not yet.  I'll go get some money.
I do.  Here you are.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I've been short of wood.  A lot of people have needed things lately.  If you could find me some wood, I'll get these done.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can do that.  What do you need?
Oooh, I don't think so.  Not right now, anyway.  Bye.
Great.  All right.  Be back soon.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. I've been working on her design. I'm going to need some materials. Can you bring me 15 logs and 5 skinny branches?

replies.reply_text: That much? Maybe this wasn't such a good idea.
That shouldn't be too much of a problem. I'll get right on it!
I'll remember, thanks!
Flower engravings? Why am I not surprised... No worries. I'll be back later with the money.

chatpoints.chat_text: The crib for Magnolia is finished! Do you have the payment?

replies.reply_text: How much did you need again?
Yep! I have it right here.
Uh, I forgot. I need to earn it still. I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need $3000 in payment. Hopefully Magnolia gave you enough.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I have it right here.
I must have used it for something else. I'll earn more and come back again.
All right. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. Was that all you needed?

replies.reply_text: Um, yeah... Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can see how a perfectly fitted and varnished patch would wreck the look of the bucket.  I could fix this, but it would ruin the primitive style... My work would look too accurate, which would be slightly out of place.

replies.reply_text: Can you think of anyone who would fix the bucket to match the style?
I'm sorry to have bothered you with it, then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think you might want to try someone who does more fine woodwork.  A cooper might be the best choice, if you could find one.  Some other options might be finding a wood carver or a basket maker.  Those types of craftsmen might have the skill to repair this correctly.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She lets out a hearty laugh.) He did! Took him long enough to get some guts up to asking me to something. Anyway, was there a problem?

replies.reply_text: Actually, yes. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be awful if she lost one of those pieces!  They are very skillfully carved.  Just gorgeous.  Well, let me look at my stuff and see if it ended up with my things somehow.

replies.reply_text: That would be great.  Thanks.
Okay, sounds good.
Great!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I'm too busy for any more jobs!

replies.reply_text: I'll keep looking then.
It will be an adventure!

chatpoints.chat_text: A shield?  Not really my thing, and I'm super busy right now, so I won't be able to.  However, you could try Xamba.  He normally makes instruments, but maybe he'll take a stab at it.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Thanks for the tip.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have a proposition for me?  Let's hear it.

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
You're right, this could be good for business.  I'll tell Iona you're going to attend.

npc_list.name: Daedalus
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP19
npc_list.long_description: Here we have an artist at work. So absorbed in his creations that he's a bit out of touch with the rest of the world.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Come in, come in.  Welcome stranger.  Is there something I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  No thanks, just looking.
No thanks.  What's with all the feathers?
Gee, it looks like a bird exploded in here!  See ya!
Actually, there is! I was wondering if you might have found half a horse shoe.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well Icarus has it in his head that he wants to fly, so I'm building a set of wings for him.

replies.reply_text: Fly?  People can't fly!  Good luck with that!
Really?  I thought only pigs could fly.  See you around.
Now that's an interesting idea....  Anything I can help you with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually, I could use some more feathers.

replies.reply_text: I suppose I could get you some.
I was just kidding actually.  I have to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Thanks!  Right now I'm running low on the small black feathers.  Could you find me about 25 of those?  You can find them all over the isles.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like way too much work.  You'd better find someone else.  Bye.
I think I can find that many.
I'll hurry as fast as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!

replies.reply_text: What was it you had me doing again?
I managed to find those feathers you wanted.
What was it you had me doing again?
I got those peacock feathers you needed.
Okay Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for getting those feathers for me!  The wings are taking shape nicely.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome. Is there anything else you need help with?  I have some free time right now.
Thanks.  Good luck with all this flying business!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, there is.  I'm ready to add the peacock feathers to the tip of the wings.    Do you think you could find me 20 peacock feathers?

replies.reply_text: I don't think I have the time right now.  I'll come back later.
Sure, I think I can find that many.
Okay.  Be back soon

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed you to find 20 peacock feathers.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll be back shortly.
Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Thanks for the peacock feathers!  The wings are almost finished now!

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear it!  Is there anything else I can help you with?
That's neat!  Well, off I go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'm almost finished, but I could use a little more wax to finish gluing on the last of the feathers.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can get that for you.  Where should I go for the wax?
I think you could find someone else to help.  I have other things to do now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Albert at the general store here on Hoof Isle usually has some in stock for me.  If you could run over and pick some up I'd be most grateful.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can run over there.
I really am short on time right now.  I can come back later.  Bye.
Be back in a flash.

chatpoints.chat_text: Any trouble getting the wax?

replies.reply_text: Nope!  Got it right here. :)
Where was it again you said to go for the wax?
Haven't gotten it yet.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Albert Junker's general store here on Hoof Isle.  He always keeps a supply of wax for me.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back in a bit.
Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry to say the wings didn't work, but thanks again for all your help.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to hear that.  Maybe you can try something else.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed you to find 25 small, black feathers.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. Can't help you with that.

replies.reply_text: Well darn. Thanks anyway and have a great day.

npc_list.name: Mrs. Claus
npc_list.long_description: Mrs. Claus is chubby and happy. She is wearing a red velvet dress that is covered with her green apron.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, dear. Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  Just looking around.  Goodbye.
Yeah. The Easter Bunny sent me for some wrapping paper.
Actually, I was hoping I could help you with something.
What was I supposed to do again?
I got the carrot treats!
The reindeer loved his treats. They really are his favorite, aren't they?
I enjoyed helping you earlier.  If there's anything else you need, feel free to ask.
How are Christmas plans coming along? Is there anything I can help with?
I'm sorry.  I forgot what you had asked me to get for Santa. Could you remind me?
I'm back with the harnesses.
Hi there, Mrs. C.! How goes the Christmas planning this year?
Hi Mrs. Claus, I have some pixie dust for you!
Santa sent me.  Do you need help making the soup?  I know he doesn't feel very well.
What ingredients did you need again?
I have those ingredients you needed!
I got the carrots for you!

Howdy Mrs. Claus, I sorta need your help.  I got a poem from Holli Daysin from Tropicton, and it says to go to the land of the holiday snow; and get from it's most famous resident something to show.  Would you happen to know what I'm looking for?
Hi Mrs.Claus, Ferrel Ironman said you might be able to help me. I have to bring him 5 pinches of Pixie Dust.
Hi, Mrs. Claus, sorry to be a pest, but...
Hello, Mrs. Claus! It was three candy canes and two peppermint candies you asked for, yes?
Oh, okay. Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I will keep that in mind.  Thank you, dear.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, how thoughtful of you! Actually, there is something I've been wanting to do, but Christmas preparations have kept me far too busy...

replies.reply_text: Oh? What is that?
I'm sorry, I changed my mind. I don't want to help anymore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you see, one of our reindeer was extra good last year. We would have been in such trouble if it hadn't been for his heroic deeds.

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear! I would hate to not have had Christmas last year.
What happened?
I'm sorry, I just realized I forgot to eat. I need to go!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a very long story, but Santa took a wrong turn at Hotton, and if it wouldn't have been for our reindeer, half of Horse Isle wouldn't have woken up to presents the next morning.

replies.reply_text: Oh, my. I'm glad everything turned out okay!
Does Santa make wrong turns often?
Well, that's silly, I'm going to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Everything always does.  That's why it's called Christmas.

replies.reply_text: Yes, well, about the reward for the reindeer? It does sound like he deserves one!
I don't know about that. I think I'm going to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear! I have chattered on a bit. Well, his favorite treats are carrot treats. Could you possibly go get three of them and bring them to him?

replies.reply_text: I'd love to!
That sounds like a lot of work just for one reindeer. He isn't even a horse!  No thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to bring 3 carrot treats to the reindeer.

replies.reply_text: Right! I'll get them right away.
Oh, yes, the carrot treats. I have them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, why don't you take them to the reindeer yourself? I have so many presents to wrap, I'm afraid I might never get to it. Come back to me when you're done. I'm sure I'll have something for you.

replies.reply_text: Sure! I'd love to!
Where is the reindeer?
I don't want to go hunting for some smelly reindeer.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm sure he's just wandering about Christmas Isle somewhere.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay, I'll go find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not often.  I don't know what happened that time.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure he was just looking at the wrong map, or something.
Well, I'm glad everything went all right in the end.
I will.  Bye.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually there is, dear. You see, Santa's and my anniversary is coming up, and I have completely run out of time to get him what I wanted to.  I don't know how I am going to be able to leave here to get him anything.

replies.reply_text: Good thing you have all these presents available to choose from.
Oh, no! That's awful, what can I do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you mean it, dear? You would be willing to help me?

replies.reply_text: Of course I would! I helped Sa... I mean, yes, I will.
I will have to come back later to help you - I have somewhere else to be right now.
Of course!  I would love to help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, what I wanted to get him was 8 handmade and specially dyed reindeer harnesses.  I know you can get the harnesses made by Barb Sower in Shellton, and I would like Kilye to do the dyeing. She does beautiful work.You had better check with Kilye first to see what she will need from Barb.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  I better head out now, though.
Okay, I will.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see Kilye about making reindeer harnesses for Santa. She will probably need you to go see Barb Sower to get pieces made.  Remember, I need all 8 as quickly as you can get them for me.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right. I will go do that now.
Here're the next two.
Here are two more.
Here are the final two harnesses.
Thanks Mrs. Claus. I hope you and Santa enjoy your anniversary.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello dear. They are going very well - Santa and the elves are working very hard to have everything done in time... Well, the elves are, anyway. (Throws a sideways look at Santa, and whispers.) Santa is pondering ways to help them. He says.

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear everything is on track! TTFN Mrs. C.
Do they need help this year, or is Santa just taking thinking breaks? (Wink wink.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually dear, they do need a bit more help. See, the Horse Isle lands have been becoming so populated that the elves and Santa are having a bit more difficulty in keeping up.  I do worry he will wear himself out.

replies.reply_text: That's not good!  What can help them?
Sounds like you better contact the elves union for more elves, then!  Talk to you later.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: They need some more Christmas magic! Or more specifically - Pixie Dust!  That can help quite a bit in this shop.

replies.reply_text: Pixie Dust!? Isn't that the stuff from Cloud Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is. By any chance, are you able to go to Cloud Isle and get some for me?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I can't go there right now. Maybe later, when I can, I will stop back by. Bye, Mrs. C.
I can go to Cloud Isle! How much would you need?
No, not at all. I can bring back whatever you need.

chatpoints.chat_text: I will be able to use whatever you can bring back.  I will pay $250 - and I would prefer them in groups of 15 for that price. How does that sound?

replies.reply_text: Great, Mrs. C.  I will be back soon with some pixie dust to help out the elves and Santa.
Actually, I have some right here to start you off until I can get back up there.
Here is some more.
That's all I have for now.  I'll come back soon with more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, well, I already have a few of the ingredients, but I still need 5 carrots, two packages of noodles, and some celery.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound too bad.  Where would be the best places to look?
I don't think I have time for all of that right now.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  That would be wonderful.  Do you think you could pick up a few ingredients for me?  I would do it myself, but I'm just so terribly busy.

replies.reply_text: On second thought, I need to be going.
Sure!  What do you need?
I will hurry back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 5 carrots from Windy in Crystalton, two packages of noodles from Clementine in Hotton, and celery from Nana in Tropicton.  Please hurry back!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll be back soon!
Here they are.
I'll bring this to him now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It sounds like you are looking for one of Santa's special hand-crafted decorations.  He likes to do wood carving, it helps him relax.  You should ask him if he would give you one of them.

replies.reply_text: Do you really think he might?  I guess I should go ask him, then.  Thanks Mrs. C.!

chatpoints.chat_text: Whatever does Ferrel need with Pixie Dust?

replies.reply_text: Well, he agreed to make a new pot for Fergus O'Toole, seeing how someone took his pot of gold pot and all, and now he has no magic. Ferrel says that the Pixie Dust will help jump-start Fergus' magic.
Thanks Mrs C.!  Have a great Christmas!

chatpoints.chat_text: But you're on a quest and you need something, isn't that right, dear?  Everyone here is.  What is it you need?

replies.reply_text: Thanks for understanding.  I need a peppermint ball.  Do you have one?

chatpoints.chat_text: Peppermint ball?  Oh, my, I haven't made those in ages!  I guess I could take some time to make a few.  There are a few things I need, though.  Can you get them for me?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  I've done far too much travelling as it is so far, but... thanks anyway.  Bye.
Somehow I saw this coming.  Sure, I can do that.  Well, I can try, anyway.  What do you need?
Actually, I think I have those in my pack!
Peppermint Candies?  Aren't those all the way up on Cloud Isle?
Okay, that's not a problem.  I'll be back as soon as I can.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, that's where they appear; but people bring them down and sell them to food stores all the time.  I'm sure you'll have no trouble finding some without going to Cloud.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll do my best.  Bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right.  Have you got them?  I've got everything ready to add them to!

replies.reply_text: Not yet; I just wanted to make sure I was looking for the right things.  I'll be back!
Yes, I have them right here!
Thanks awfully, Mrs. Claus.  You've saved the day again!  Goodbye!

npc_list.name: Bailey
npc_list.long_description: Bailey is a small, middle aged woman. She is at peace with herself and the world and it shows in her eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  I hope you are having a nice visit.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Well...  there's nothing here.
Of course I am.  What a beautiful little island you have here.
It's all right.  I think I'm going to wander around a bit more.  Talk to you later.
Could you send me to Rock Isle?
Could you please send me back to Turtle Isle?
Umm...  Could you send me back to Turtle Isle?
Hello again, I was wondering you might have any random odd jobs I could do for you?
How's that trellis doing?
I am.  What was it you needed me to do again?
I've got the wood you asked for.
I'm back... Boy are you gonna love these!
I'm sorry, wasn't there something else you needed?
Hello.  Pony Express delivery!
Wow! Look at that tide roll in! Lovely island you have here. Have you lived here long?
Seems like I spoke with you about something recently. Can you remind me what it was?

chatpoints.chat_text: It may appear that way to some, but I do like my privacy and my pretty flowers.

replies.reply_text: You don't get lonely?
They are very pretty.  Did you plant them yourself?
Since you do like your privacy so much, I guess I could leave you be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really.  Mr. Tuttle is so nice about sending people out here to visit.

replies.reply_text: Speaking of Mr. Tuttle, he had me bring this box of supplies for you.  Here you are.
Well, that's nice of him.

chatpoints.chat_text: I did.  I love flowers and I love purple.  Mr. Tuttle was nice enough to get me seeds in order to plant all of these.

replies.reply_text: Speaking of Mr. Tuttle, he had me bring this box of supplies for you.  Here you are.
That's neat.  Lots of work, but neat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, a lot of work, but it was worth it.

replies.reply_text: Sure looks like it.
Would you be able to get me back to Turtle Isle?
Oh, look how those roses are thriving here!  Could you please send me to Rock Isle now?
You know, those roses really were the perfect choice! Would you mind sending me back to Turtle Isle now?
You're welcome.  Umm...  Are you able to get me back to Turtle Isle?
You're welcome.  Well, I'm going to go look around a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I think so.

replies.reply_text: Nice.  Well, I'll look around a bit more.
Would you be able to send me back to Turtle Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, why, thank you!  I do love it here.  Nice and peaceful.

replies.reply_text: I see you like your quiet.  I'll leave you be.
The flowers are very pretty.  Did you plant them all yourself?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can, but there is also a really nice isle to the east of here.  Rock Isle.  I can send you there first if you like.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  That'd be great.  I always like to explore new islands.
No thanks.  Could you just send me back to Turtle Isle?
I'll think about it.  I'll come back and chat in a little bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: There ya go, dear.
There ya go, dear.
Well, if it wouldn't be too much to ask, could you go to La Fleur and pick up some roses for me?

replies.reply_text: Awww, you want me to go back to Shellton?  I don't have time for that.  Please just send me to Rock Isle.
La Fleur is in Shellton, right?  I'd be happy to do that for you.
I'd really rather just explore your island some more, if it's okay with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You really think so?  I was hoping that they would.

replies.reply_text: Oh, they're going to be glorious!  Now, I hate to be a scutch, but could you send me to Rock Isle?
You're right, they will be beautiful.  If it's not too much to ask, could you send me back to Turtle Isle one more time?
They are going to make your island even more beautiful.  Would you mind me wandering around some?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, as a matter of fact, I've got these plans for a rose trellis, but I haven't been able to get the supplies I need. Would you mind doing a couple of little errands for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I have some time free, I'll be more than happy to help you out.
I figured you'd only have one and I could blow this hot dog stand!  Sorry, could you just send me on to Rock Isle?
If it's all the same with you, I'd rather just look around some.
Let's see, 5 logs and 15 branches?  I should be back in no time!  Could you do me a favor and send me back to Turtle Isle so I can get started on this for you?
Wow!  That's a lot!  Well, I'll get started on that in a bit. Just send me to Rock Isle first, okay?
I think I'll just poke around your island some before heading off to look.
All right, you got your logs and branches.  Is there anything else you need me to get for you?
All right!  Could you send me to Turtle Isle, please?
I'd really rather just explore your island some more, if it's okay with you.
Thanks!  You're right, these roses will fit into your color scheme beautifully.

chatpoints.chat_text: You agreed to go to La Fleur in Shellton to pick up my order of roses.

replies.reply_text: Ah, yes.  Okay.  I'll get right on that.  Send me to Turtle Isle, please.
That's right!  Well, I'll come talk to you when I want to get going.
Thanks.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me?  Nah.  I have other ways of getting around.  I can't abide boats, or anything that rocks, really, or sways.

replies.reply_text: Hmm.  Then you wouldn't really know much about the currents around here, would you?
I see.  Well, I guess I'll leave you to your wanderings, then.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Currents?  You mean ocean currents?  I pay absolutely no attention to them at all.  They are beyond my purview.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, do you know anyone around here who might know something about currents?
Very wise of you.  Rotten things, those currents.  Well, good day, then!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm originally from Earton. Moved here twenty years ago. Earton is such a bustle! I love the quiet here.

replies.reply_text: I can't stand Earton, it's a zoo.  Oh... is that the time?  I need to run home and brush the owl.  See you around!
Oh, don't I know it!  You must do a lot of sailing, or rowing.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She tilts her head and looks at you quizzically.) What do you want to know about currents for? I can get you wherever you want to go, there's no reason to worry about them.

replies.reply_text: Oh, just for purely ... oceanological reasons.  You know, currents bring food, food brings birds.  I like birds.
Just curious. That's what my friends say about me! Always curious! Just like Curious George.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh-huh...

replies.reply_text: Oh, never mind, sorry to bother you.
So, if one were interested in currents, with whom might one speak, do you know?
I'll do that, thanks.  If you could just send me back to Turtle, please?
Great, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You wanted to know about the currents. I suggested you talk to the harbormaster of Shellton Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Rocco Shale
npc_list.short_description: Owner of Rock Isle Rock Shop
npc_list.long_description: Rocco Shale is wearing khaki pants and a grey t-shirt.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello!   Always nice to see people in my store!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I can't imagine you get too many people out here.
Could you send me back to Turtle Isle?
That's nice.  You have really good prices on your stuff!  How do you stay in business?!?
This is a neat island.  I'm going to explore some.
Alati from Sandy Meadows would like to place an order for a pair of medium-size round stones. He said you'd know what he meant.
I'm back to pick up the stones for Alati.
So what exactly do you do with all the rocks and gems that people sell you?
Hey there! I don't see any dinosaur bones in stock. Could you check your backstock for me? I need one.
Hello! I've got a Pony Express package for you.
Hello Rocco! I was told that you might be able to supply me with 2 dozen oyster shells.
Hello again. Where did you say I could find the oyster shells?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do get a number of people because of Bailey and Mr. Tuttle.  Once someone finds out about this island, they tend to come back.

replies.reply_text: Why?
I can see why.  This is neat.  I'm going to go explore more.
Is there something I should know?

chatpoints.chat_text: All those rock piles create ore.  Some iron, some silver, and some even gold.  Other than that, there is a rumor about a treasure...

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that ore is kinda neat.  What good is it, though?
Treasure?  Where?
Ooooo, I'm going to go look around.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you find the jewelry workshop you can have necklaces and rings made.  These can be sold for quite a bit.  I'll even buy them from you.

replies.reply_text: That's great!  Thanks.
Interesting.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: All those rock piles create ore.  Some iron, some silver, and some even gold.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that ore is kinda neat.  What good is it, though?
That's neat.  I'm going to go collecting.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. Working on another invention, is he? I've made these for him before. Did he want this added to his tab?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please.
All right, though there isn't much to explore...
I will. Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, some of them I keep to sell to other visitors, like yourself. Some I sell to craftsmen throughout the isles.  And some I use to make items for personal use.

replies.reply_text: Sounds efficient.  Have fun seperating them out.
Oh? Are you working on anything now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, as a matter of fact I am.  I am designing a new sign to go outside my shop.  Say!!  Would you be able to help me with a few things?

replies.reply_text: No way! I am just here to get the best prices on rocks and gems.
I guess I can.  What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need these plans to go to Smiddy Jones over in the jungle so he can start work on them. Could you do that?

replies.reply_text: Sure. No problem.
No problem.  I'll be off now.
Could you send me to Turtle Isle so I could get started?

chatpoints.chat_text: Back so soon? Did you get the sign made?

replies.reply_text: Oh, right - that's what I was supposed to be doing. Where do the plans go again?
Yep.  Here it is. It is beautiful - and heavy!
Not yet..  Umm...  Could you send me to Turtle Isle, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Take the plans to Smiddy Jones in Tropicton.

replies.reply_text: Headed back out.  Catch ya later, then.
Oh, right!  Could you send me to Turtle Isle, please?
That looks great!  See you soon with more stuff to sell. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No need to check, I just got a box of bones delivered this morning. Let me grab one for you. It will cost you $2100.

replies.reply_text: Sounds great. I'll wait right here!
Darn. I don't have that much on me. I'll be right back!
Man, this thing is heavy! Thanks a ton! Ha-ha-ha!
Some day, if I have time, maybe we can talk about that. Thanks and have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Talk about impeccable timing! I just had roasted oysters for lunch. I love them.  I left the shells by the shore. I'm sure if you hurry, you can rake them up before the waves wash them out to sea.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I left the shells by the shore. I'm sure if you hurry, you can rake them up before the waves wash them out to sea.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! !

npc_list.name: Grey Slate
npc_list.long_description: What this obviously city-bred gentleman is doing out in such a rural place as this you can't imagine, but he seems quite at ease.  His shoulders stoop as if he has done a great deal of studying or very fine, detailed work.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slate is looking down, sullenly, at a drawing spread out on his counter. It might be a design for ...a crown?) Oh, hello. Something I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: Just looking, thanks.
Is that supposed to be a crown or something?
Another crown?
Hi!  How's by you?  Can you please send me to Hotzeplotz again?
Mr. Slate, please, isn't there any way I could get back to Hotzeplotz?
Okay.  Here's your lunch.  Now can I go?
Hello!  Say, would you be willing to make some metal doors and stuff for a kids' building block set?
Who did you say could do the menorah again?
I'm back with the menorah! And Inigo is sending his bill.
Hello, Mr. Slate!  I am, you may have heard, on a mission for the Chocolatiere Royal!  Please send me back to King Phil?
Hi, Mr. Slate.  I just came from your niece Lilianna, she wants you to make her a wedding ring.
Uhm.... Was it 3 gold ores and a hammer from Liam Flux in Wington that you wanted?
Hi, Mr. Slate. I'm back with the supplies you wanted.
Hi!  Is the ring ready?
Good day Mr. Slate, I have a proposition here for you.
Quest Checking - do this and you can head back to Kevin!
Uhm... Mr. Slate? Can I ask you if you've ever heard of things washing up on Hotzeplotz Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a pretty sight, is it? (He gives a derisive snort.) You know what this is? This is a design for a crown for the King of Hotzeplotz!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Good luck with that...
The King of Hotzeplotz?  I didn't know there was a king on these Isles!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slate shrugs and sighs.) Well, he's not really a king, King Phil. He's just this loony old geezer with tons of money! He bought an island, now he's King Phil the First of Hotzeplotz!

replies.reply_text: King Phil the First?  I guess when you have plenty of money you can do that!  Where is Hotzeplotz?  I've never seen it on the map.
Yeah, he must have lots of money if he wants you to make that... thing for him!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually, Hotzeplotz is just the name of his ranch--I mean, his castle.  On... what's he call it?  Ah!  Hotzeplotz!  One of the Unknown Isles.

replies.reply_text: Lucky guy!  I'd like to see a... castle. How do you get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't, unless he invites you! (Slate shrugs again.)

replies.reply_text: I guess it's good to be the king.

chatpoints.chat_text: So, now, I have to make this crown.  And look at what I need to make it!  I'm never gonna get all this stuff!

replies.reply_text: Gold, silver, diamonds, gems... Surely you have most of this stuff in your inventory.
I don't envy you!  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I've got stuff in stock.  But you see, that's the problem with King Phil.  He pays you fantastically! You could live happy for a year!  But he doesn't pay you until he gets the finished work.  So, I can't use my stock, I need it to sell until he pays me!

replies.reply_text: That's going to be tough for you.  But if he pays that well, I'm sure you'll manage.
Say... I like shiny, sparkly things, and I don't mind collecting them.  How about a deal?  If I go collect these things for you, can we split the profits?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, gee, thanks a ton, kiddo!

replies.reply_text: Bye!
Oh, all right, I'll help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey!  A fifty-fifty split, okay?  Now, I don't know exactly how much he's gonna pay, but he's always been good in the past, and it's not like he hasn't got the money.  So, we both get paid when the work is delivered.  Deal?

replies.reply_text: Deal!  What do you want me to do first?

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Now before we get started, a piece of good advice.  Remember, we're not getting paid until this is over, so don't spend money buying things--you'll go broke!  Just go look for them! Besides, I don't want other people to know I got this job, see?

replies.reply_text: I won't tell anyone, and I'll search for all the stuff myself so nobody will guess!
You're kidding, right?  No way!  I'm out of here!  This is crazy!
I'm on my way!
I have that much with me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? You have the ores for me?  10 gold, and 20 silver?

replies.reply_text: Got them right here.
Oh! That's what you wanted! Sorry, I'll get them right away!
Five diamonds?!
No, sorry, that's just asking too much.
I've got those on me now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oy!  He originally wanted fifty--but I told him they would clash with his eyes.

replies.reply_text: No, sorry, that's just asking too much.
Okay.  I'll do it.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's your loss, buddy!

replies.reply_text: Bye!
Oh, fine. I'll go find five diamonds somewhere.  And twenty-four small gems.
I'll be back.
Well actually, I've got them right here in my saddlepack.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  You've got the gems for me?  Five diamonds and 24 small gems?

replies.reply_text: I sure do.  Here they are.
Uhm... No, just wanted to come by and make sure that was how many you really wanted.  I'll go find them.  Somewhere...
Wait a minute... Peacock feathers?  With all this expensive stuff?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, it's what he wants.  He's the king!  I'm gonna argue?  What?

replies.reply_text: Okay.... See you.
Lucky for me, I've got those right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent!  You've got my ten peacock feathers?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Right here.  Say, could I possibly have a little money toward getting my poor horse some new shoes?
Oh no.  Probably not.  Let me go look some more.
This is, I hope, the last bit you need, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, got it?  One beeee-ootiful piece of royal blue cloth?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Here it is.  This had better be the last thing you need!
Yes.  Here it is.  This had better be the last thing you need!
Where was I supposed to go to get that again?
Not yet.  I'll go get that now.
Ooooooh-kay.
It's... lovely.  Or something.  Now what?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now we need you to take this rather... amazing... crown to King Phil the First.

replies.reply_text: Me?!  Why me?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo.  Don't I remember someone saying they wanted to see a castle?  Well, here's your chance to see a castle!

replies.reply_text: But... how do I get there?  There aren't any boats to... whatever you said, in Unknown Isles.
No!  I'm not going!  Forget it!  No way! I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Boat, shmoat!  King Phil sent to me his Scepter.  You take the crown, and you wave the scepter, and there you'll be, in Hotzeplotz!

replies.reply_text: This has got to be the weirdest thing I've ever done!  Okay, let's do it!
No, no, no... and also no.  That's it.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I got it from Kilye in Tropicton last time I needed something like that.
