replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see her now.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  You're back!  Did he pay you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, he did.  Here you go.  King Phil is your brother?!
Uh... what?  Wait a minute... I think I'm lost...
Uhm, no, Mr. Slate, he didn't... I uhm... I got kinda sidetracked and... sorry!  Can you please send me back there again?
A pleasure doing business with you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heh!  Don't worry!  This time, I ain't takin' the job!  Although, I do have another job commissioned that you could help with.

replies.reply_text: Another one? No thanks. The last one was quite enough.
Really? What is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  Certainly, Sir... Knight.  Grab the scepter...

replies.reply_text: Okay...
(I hate this mode of transport...)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slate narrows his eyes and frowns.) Well, I guess I might be convinced, for the right incentive.

replies.reply_text: Oh, please, after I've done so much already, I have to do something else?!
Forget it.  Goodbye.
Nope.  Goodbye.  This is too crazy.  Goodbye.
Oh, really?  Well, I've been all over these Isles and I've never seen stores selling... that stuff.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well, then!  You haven't talked to Remy on Art Isle, have you?  He makes the best.  But you gotta ask him for the good stuff, you know.  You go get me that, and I'll send you back to Hotzeplotz.

replies.reply_text: Whatever... Off I go.
Aww, come on!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you got sidetracked, eh?  Sheesh!  All right, here, give me the end of that scepter...

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would I be willing to what?

replies.reply_text: Well, here, look at these plans. (You lay Vern's plans out on the counter.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slate scrutinizes the plans carefully.) Hmmm... Nope.

replies.reply_text: Not even for a Knight of the Realm?!
But Vern said you'd be perfect.
All right, I'll look elsewhere then.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tsk.  No, it's not that.  It's that I work in low-temperature metals; gold and silver and some copper.  Gold and silver are too expensive for a toy like this, and copper you don't want kids putting in their mouths.  You need these made of iron.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see.  Okay, well, who do I see to get these made, then?
Okay, thanks, will do.  He's in.... Treeton?  Or Shellton?

chatpoints.chat_text: Shellton blacksmith.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: King Phil has requested a menorah from me for Chanukah this year. He wants something that is suitable to his palace, but I specialize in smaller pieces.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad - better 'fess up soon. Bye.
There are some excellent craftsman around these isles. Why don't you have someone else make it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Say, that's a great idea!  Why don't you see if Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle could do it?

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I could do that.
Me? Oh no you don't - I'm not getting roped into this.
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah - this is exactly what I think King Phil was looking for. Say, you wouldn't be willing to deliver it for me would you?

replies.reply_text: No way! Do you know how heavy that thing is?
(Sighs.) I guess I could.

chatpoints.chat_text: Check with Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  Bye.
Thanks.   Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Grey Slate gives a chuckle.) Wedding ring, eh? Who's she marrying? Some frog?

replies.reply_text: Well, uh, yeah, as a matter of fact. Well, he was a frog, he isn't anymore. Mostly.
No, she's marrying a very dashing Prince, in fact.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh, yeah.  Right.  Whatever.  So, what about this ring?

replies.reply_text: She didn't give me any specifics, I guess she figures you know what you're doing and will supply her with something appropriate.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just as well.  That kid never could make a decision.  Ooooo-kay, well, there's a few things I need then.

replies.reply_text: Oh, please, not a diamond!
Okay, what are they?
Oh, no no no no no!  I've had enough of this searching around for stuff.  You take care of it.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not a diamond.  I've got one I've been keeping for just this occasion.

replies.reply_text: Gold ore then, I'll bet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gold ore.  Let's see.......... Three will do.  Yeah. And a new hammer.  Why don't you go to Liam Flux in Wington.  Tell him what it's for, he knows the kind of stuff I need.  Can you do that?

replies.reply_text: No.  Really.  Gold ore is so hard to find!  I'm off.  Your niece will have to ask someone else, like her fiance, or something...
Sure, I can do that.
Okay, I'll go get this done now.
Right. Oh, and while I'm here, could you send me to His Majesty?  She wants something from him too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeeeeeeeeeeees...

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll get right on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, let's see what you've got.

replies.reply_text: Here it is.
Okay, I'll come back tomorrow then.
I have to talk to King Phil about this project also; Lilianna wants a Four-In-Hand.  Could you send me to Hotzeplotz?
I promise to bring it safely to Lilianna.  Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition?  It's not from his royal highness again, is it?

replies.reply_text: No it's from Iona, over in Flipperton.  She wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll give Iona your regrets.  Sorry you can't attend.

chatpoints.chat_text: Like shipwrecks? Lost treasure? Wayward sailors? Ocean debris?

replies.reply_text: Well, uhm... sure I guess? Any of those? But shipwreck debris would be great!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, according to Seamus, who proclaims to be an expert on ocean tides, things do wash up there along the west coast. It's all way too convoluted and complicated for me to understand, but if he says so, I'm guessing it is probably true.

replies.reply_text: That's just what I needed to hear! Can you send me there?

npc_list.name: Betsy Burlap
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start at CP22

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, I inherited this shop from my dad. Been taking care of it for several years now.

replies.reply_text: Umm, yeah, that's really interesting.
Really? You take care of it all alone?
I'm sorry, but where was I going again?
Hi, I'm back!  You were right, Sam and Davy have heard from your brother.
That's great!  You told me to check with you the next time I was in town.  Do you have another job for me?
Sorry, it's me again.  Who do I have to go to first?
I'm back and the twins were thrilled!
Excuse me, but am I supposed to be back here yet?
Well, it looks like your Burlap Family Reunion worked out really well, didn't it?
Excuse me, but I'm wondering if you have any rotting fruit? I'm asking for Mino.
That's great.  Anyway, I was wondering if you had some oil for Merry Comber.
That's very dedicated, but I have some wreaths from Lilibeth for you.
That's nice. Say, you wouldn't happen to have any lemons for sale, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm all alone now. I have twin siblings, Bena and Ben, that used to help me.

replies.reply_text: Why don't they help now?
Oh, too bad you are alone. I really need to be going. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Bena married and moved to the desert. She runs a store there.

replies.reply_text: What about Ben?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ben, well... Ben ran off looking for adventure. We haven't seen or heard from him in a long time.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's too bad. Maybe one day he'll send you a letter. Well, I better be going. Bye!
Since you're all alone here, would you happen to need any errands run or deliveries made?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I've been thinking about doing something special for the twins.  They have a milestone birthday coming up.  The problem is that I've lost track of Ben.  Do you think that in your travels, you might be able to track him down for me?

replies.reply_text: I don't think so.  If you don't know where he is, how am I supposed to find him?! Sorry, see you next time.
I'd be happy to help you!  Do you have any idea about where I should start?

chatpoints.chat_text: You poor dear, you were on your way to the McGees' on Loch Island.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I forgot... Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now, let me think... Our father was a close friend of Sam McGee.  Sam and Papa taught Ben how to fish.  Ben in turn taught Sam's grandson, Davy.  Ben was always partial to Sam and Davy, maybe they've heard from him.

replies.reply_text: Do you know where I can find the McGees?

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe they live on Loch Isle now... Yes, that's right, Loch Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm sorry, but that's way out of my way.  Maybe some other time, bye bye!
Loch Isle?  Sure, no problem!
Okay.  I'll be back as soon as I've talked with the McGees.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's wonderful!  I was hoping Ben had kept in touch with someone.  What did he say?  Where is Ben?  How is he?  Is he married? Did he choose a career?

replies.reply_text: Slow down a second!  Davy said that Ben is in Tropicton.  He runs the General Store there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.  I don't suppose young Davy mentioned why Ben was in contact with them and not with us?

replies.reply_text: It seems Ben kicked around a long time before he finally settled down.  He's afraid that you're mad at him for leaving in the first place, and he's embarrassed that he hasn't been in touch.

chatpoints.chat_text: That silly, silly man!  He's our brother.  We might not like him at times, but we'll always love him.

replies.reply_text: That's what I figured!
It would be my pleasure.  'Til next time, goodbye!
I think I'm going to be busy somewhere else, sorry.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes, I did, thank you for remembering.  Would you be able to go to Tropicton and Santon for me?

replies.reply_text: Gee, I'm sorry... They're at opposite ends of the Horse Isles... Totally out of my way.  Maybe next time.
I could do that, no problem!
I'd be more than happy to.  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's all right, dear.  I asked you to bring Ben his present in Tropicton first, then go see Bena in Santon.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, that's right.  I'm on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad everything went so smoothly.

replies.reply_text: They certainly did.   Oh, and the twins sent these back to you.
Well, it looks like your Burlap Family Reunion worked out really well, didn't it?
Thank you, this entire adventure has been my honor to perform!  I'll see you the next time I'm in Carrotton.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, I asked you to go to Ben in Tropicton and then Bena in Santon.  Have you gone to both of them yet?

replies.reply_text: Well, Ben got his gift.
Umm... Not yet.  I guess I'll go find Ben.
I have seen Bena, but I feel like there was more I was supposed to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then you probably need to go to Santon to see Bena.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you should probably go back to Santon to see Bena.  Your other option is to go see Ben again.

replies.reply_text: That sounds good.  I'll be back as soon as I can.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Thank you so much for all your help.  Anything I can get for you?

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I don't need anything now.  Have a good day!
Excuse me, but I'm wondering if you have any rotting fruit? I'm asking for Mino.
Yes, please.  I was wondering if you had some oil for Merry Comber.
Actually, I have a delivery of wreaths for you from Lilibeth.
That's nice. Say, you wouldn't happen to have any lemons for sale, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: What is that man up to now?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds' need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: How sweet! Lelu is going to be thrilled. Unfortunately, I can't help you. Did you try Nana in Tropicton? I bet she could help you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure do.  It will cost $500.  I'm assuming she gave you something to pay for it with?

replies.reply_text: Yes, she did.  Here you are.
She did, but I must have spent it on the trip over here...  I'll be right back.
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh good, I'm all out and I have a couple of customers looking for them!

replies.reply_text: That's good, where do you want this crate?
Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness, I sure don't. Try a food store.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my stable.  Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around.  Thanks.
This is a very clean barn.  Is it new?
What can I do here?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
I sure hope so. I'm trying to find some manure for Mino. He has something he needs to plant.
Why, yes, you can. If you've got empty feed sacks, that is. I need to make up some sandbags.

chatpoints.chat_text: I will take care of any of your horse's needs.  This is a perfect place for a horse to rest, get some great, high quality feed and nice, fresh water.

replies.reply_text: Oh great!  Thanks.
Why would I pay you to care for them when I can?

chatpoints.chat_text: It is.  I built this barn myself and have just recently opened it.

replies.reply_text: That's great.  Anything else you need for it?
I can tell.  It looks great.  Well, I better go care for my horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you own a ranch with its own barn, grain silo and water well, then I guess you don't need my services, but if you don't, then this is the only place to rest a horse.  You can feed and water your horse on your own, but I do provide the best feed around and there is no chance of your horse getting sick on water here like it can on pond water.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I really need more hay.  I just need plain bales because I make my own hay from that for some special feed for any horses that stay here.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can go get hay for you.
I really don't want to bale hay now.  Maybe another time.  Bye.
Forty?!?  Wow, that's a lot.  It may take me awhile.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  You get those hay bales?

replies.reply_text: How many did you need again?
Not yet.  I'll go get right on that.
I did.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 40 bales of hay.  Remember you can either pitch it yourself at a hay pile or you can buy some at a feed store.  Either way works fine for me.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll get right on that.
Oh, I actually have 40 right here.
All right.  Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  Thanks for getting those hay bales for me.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Was there something else you needed for your 'special feed'?
You're welcome.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually there is.  Would you be willing to find some ferns and dandelions?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I could do that.
Ugg...  I really don't like searching for things.  I've been doing that way too much.  Maybe another time.
All right.  Be back in a while.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  How'd your searching go?

replies.reply_text: I haven't found everything yet.  I'll keep looking.
What was I looking for again?
Perfect.  I got what you needed.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 20 ferns and 20 dandelions.  The ferns are found in forests and the dandelions are all over in the grass.  They shouldn't be too hard to find.

replies.reply_text: Oh right.  I'll be back in a bit.
That's right.  I actually have that.  Here you go.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, of course I have.  How's she doing at that?

replies.reply_text: Very well, actually.  She's got a barn and property, and now she's looking for stable equipment.  Buckets, tubs and so on.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay.  As it happens, I have a bucket and tub that a boarder left here a while ago.  She's welcome to them.  Here, let me fetch them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
Thanks so much, they'll be put to very good use!  Goodbye!
Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. It just so happens that I have several customers that just love to garden so I always keep some on hand.  Wait here a minute and I'll get some for you.

replies.reply_text: Whew! You made my day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. Someone came by earlier and bought every last one.

replies.reply_text: Darn it. Okay, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now listen here, that offer was for the porch swing only, not for inside my home. Don't even think about it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay. I'll go now. (You mumble...) Sorry to bother you.
I'm sorry to bother you, but I am looking for a sketch of the Weeping Willow tree.
Uh, that's okay, I don't need to go inside. I'm just wondering if you happen to know what the triumph of Sam McGee is?
Well... errr... Pony Express with a special delivery!  I was just going to put this on your door step...

chatpoints.chat_text: The sketch? The sketch, you say?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, um, the sketch.
Sketch? Did I say that? I must not be thinking right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who sent you here? How do you know about the sketch?

replies.reply_text: Some guy on Jungle Isle sent me here. He is doing some collection of all the wonders of the islands.
I know nothing! I am going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have heard about that. You stay out here on the porch. I'll go get the sketch.

replies.reply_text: (You sit in the swing and wait... and wait.)
Never mind. I am leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Tucker pokes his head out and looks around.) Whew, no one is here to see me give you this.

replies.reply_text: No, you keep it. I changed my mind.
Umm, thanks. I think.
I will try to figure that out. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find the next sketch?

replies.reply_text: No, can you give me the clue again?
Actually, I got sidetracked.  I'm just wondering if you happen to know what the triumph of Sam McGee is?

chatpoints.chat_text: The climate changes constantly here and is reflected in a plethora of shades. A number of globular patterns make up the location. Although the majority of this species flourishes here, one has lived its life fully and now withers away. Find the withering one. A sketch must be completed before it is completely gone.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll try to figure it out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sam McGee? Now there's a name I haven't heard in years. Is that ol' coot still around?

replies.reply_text: Yep, he is. He's living with his grandson out on Loch Isle. Did you know him well?

chatpoints.chat_text: Quite well. We knew each other as boys growing up in Horse Shoe Village.

replies.reply_text: Would you know what his triumph is, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: His triumph, eh? It does sound familiar, but I can't quite place it... (He looks lost in thought.) Nope, I'm sorry. I'm afraid I don't remember. Perhaps you can do something for me, though?

replies.reply_text: I can't, sorry. I have too much going on right now. Bye.
Well, I suppose... What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a book of his I borrowed once upon a time and never got a chance to return. Haven't felt right about keeping it all these years. If you know where he is, maybe you could return it for me?

replies.reply_text: I'll get it to him, don't worry. Thanks for your help!
Yeah, thanks yourself.  Sheesh.

npc_list.name: Fletcher Feelbedder
npc_list.long_description: Fletcher Feelbedder has more hair on his face than on his head.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  What seems to be the problem?

replies.reply_text: Wolf's kitten is sick.  She needs some medicine, but Wolf can't get it for her.
Nothing right now.  Thanks anyway, though.
It's not really a problem, I just need some help.
Well, Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
I need a dentist and can't find one! Do you know of any dentists on the isles?
I found a dentist! You'd ask me to let you know. She practices in Wington, out of her home.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wolf?  You mean that wily old cat that romps in the woods?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that's him.

chatpoints.chat_text: A sick kitten, hmm?  Let me see what I have that you can take back.  It'd be best for the kitten to come here, but I doubt Wolf would allow that.

replies.reply_text: I doubt it.  He seems pretty protective of her.

chatpoints.chat_text: I bet.  Ah, here it is!  Just give her a dose of this, and she should be better in no time!

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, how can I help you?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for a white cat that's looking for a new home.  Do you know of any on Cat Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me think...  Well, Wolf's pack hasn't had any new kittens recently, as surprising as I know that news is!  You should see Daria at the Feed Store, their cat had kittens a little while ago.

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: What kind of friend is Falcor? Species-wise, I mean.

replies.reply_text: He's a luckdragon. Part dog, part dragon. He's been doing some sort of sneeze and cough combination.

chatpoints.chat_text: Luckdragon, eh? I don't think I have the proper resources for helping an animal like that. I'm very sorry.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Do you have any idea who does have the resources?
Drats. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I honestly don't have a clue. Good luck finding the vet that does!

replies.reply_text: I see. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you. But if you find one, I'd like to know. I've got this awful toothache that needs to be taken care of.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay, I'll try to remember to tell you if I find one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fantastic! I'll zip over there on my lunch. Thank you so much!

replies.reply_text: Happy to help!

npc_list.name: Percy Pakij
npc_list.long_description: Percy Pakij dresses flamboyantly, quite of out of place for this store.

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, nothing.  Thanks.
Salvador's markers have all run dry.  Do you have any?
Wolf, the head hauncho kitty of the cat pack, his kitten is sick, and he needs some medicine for her.
Do you happen to have the pucks ready for the Horse Isle Battalioneers?
Well, its a bit embarrassing to ask, but I'm looking for fruit that's less than fresh.
Hi there!  Do you happen to have some storage bins and paint I could buy?
Hi!  Chanda asked me to bring you these candles.
I was wondering if you carried lemons?

chatpoints.chat_text: Markers?  I think I might have a box.  Let me go look.

replies.reply_text: All right.
Why, thank you so much!  Bye now!
All right.  I'll do that.  Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have them right here.  Are you taking them directly back to Yorick?

replies.reply_text: I don't think so...  I need you tell me who to see next.  I just came from Hudson.
Sure, no problem, I will let Yorick know. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Surely you jest? What good is fruit that is anything less than fresh?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds' need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah. I see. But no. Can't help you. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Me too. Any ideas on who might have some?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you DID say hummingbirds eat the fruit flies. Maybe other birds do, too. Of course, they'd have to eat the flies on the wing.... (Percy laughs so hard he doubles over. Finally, he catches his breath and looks at you.) A little joke. Get it? "Wing"? As in WINGTON?

replies.reply_text: Ha. Ha. Funny. Thanks for the tip.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you mean the big wooden storage bins?  I happen to have three that I was using myself, but I don't need them anymore.  I have some leftover brown paint from painting the front door, if you want that also.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Can I buy all of them from you?
No, that won't do.  I'll go look somewhere else.  Thanks.
Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was wondering when I'd get this order. I've had several people asking for them.

replies.reply_text: Well, better late than never...  I guess...
Okay, I'll let her know, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope.  Can't say as I do.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there. What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Just looking, thanks.
Hi, I heard from Tony Grocer up in Chillton that you're the lady who raises goats?
Hello.  I have some cow's milk here, and I heard you might be able to make cheese with it.  Can you do that?
Hello... uhm... What was I supposed to be doing again?
Hi, Shaylene!  I've got your cheesemaking supplies here!
Oh, I brought you everything, I believe.
Hi there!  Is the cheese ready?
All right, I changed my mind.  Can I have that list back?  I'll go get the items.
Shaylene?  Hiya, I'm sorry, something came up and I've forgotten where to go get all this stuff on your list.  Could you please remind me?
Hi, Shaylene.  I got your name from Cinnamon, as someone who might be able to make cheese.  Are you the lady who raises goats?
Oh, I brought you everything, I believe.
Hi! Patricia over in Appleton sent me to talk a little business with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!   Are you looking for goat's milk?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for goat cheese, actually.  Do you make any?

chatpoints.chat_text: Goat cheese? Ooo, now there's a thought! No, actually, I've never made chevre, but I've always wanted to try to. You like chevre, do you?

replies.reply_text: I do!  But I'm not looking for it for me.
No, I don't.  Too sour for my palate. But actually, I'm looking for it for someone else.
What's "chevre"?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Hmmm.  I don't have any of the equipment needed to make cheese, I'm afraid, or else I'd love to give it a try.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, sorry then.  Thanks for your time, though.
Ooooo-kay.  Well, if I were to get you what you need, do you think you might give it a try?

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you do that for me?  What a great idea!  I have a business, as you can see, and I'm kind of rushed, as you can also see.  So I can't travel far.  But sure, I'll take you up on that!  I'll pay you for what you get for me, too!

replies.reply_text: Excellent.  What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hang on.  Let me go look at my books and see.  I don't know offhand.  Be right back!

replies.reply_text: Fine.
Whoa!  This is a long list!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I know it's a long list, but I figure one might as well start out right, right?

replies.reply_text: No, really.  This is much too much to do.  I can't travel all over like this!   Goodbye.
No argument here.  But do you know where I can get some of these things?
Whatever.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me think, let me think.... Sandy Flint is a coppersmith, he can make the pot.  I know there's a honeymaker somewhere, and they probably make stuff from wax, too.  Any blacksmith can make a curd knife, though I like Franklin's work best.  There's a paper-maker in Tropicton, and tack stores might have cheesecloth, since you use it for keeping tack clean.

replies.reply_text: Great, that's a start.  I'll get started on all this and come back when I have everything, shall I?
Bye!
Say, if I were to bring some cow's milk, could you try that, too?
I have more items from your list.
That should be everything you wanted.
That's all I have with me.  I'll bring the rest later on.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can try it, if you can get it here before it spoils.  Cheese-making milk has to be absolutely fresh.

replies.reply_text: I'll see what I can do!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting me some cheese-making supplies.  You didn't lose my list, I hope!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Right.  Okay.  I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, let's see.

replies.reply_text: I have a big, copper pot.
I have red wax.
I have cheesecloth.
I have cheese wrap.
I have a curd knife.
That should be everything!
Shaylene, I looked everywhere for rennet or starter mix, but I can't find it.  Do you have any idea at all where I can go?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shaylene gives you a funny look.) A pot can be made by a coppersmith. I think there's one in Appleton. Wax things are made by beekeepers. Try Wington. There's a papermaker in Tropicton and Franklin in Earton makes the best utensils. And cheesecloth... Some tack shop someplace should have it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll go look for it now.
I have more items from your list.
That should be everything you wanted.
That's all I have with me.  I'll bring the rest later on.  Bye!
I have more items from your list.
That should be everything you wanted.
That's all I have with me.  I'll bring the rest later on.  Bye!
I have more items from your list.
That should be everything you wanted.
That's all I have with me.  I'll bring the rest later on.  Bye!
I have more items from your list.
That should be everything you wanted.
That's all I have with me.  I'll bring the rest later on.  Bye!
Glad you're happy with it.  Can you make the cheese now?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it seems to me there's still something missing.  Please check carefully.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll be back to pick it up.
Oh!  And I was able to get you something else--this jug of cow's milk from Cinnamon on Jungle Isle!
Great!  I'll be back to pick it up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cow's milk?  All the way from Jungle?  Hmmm.... I don't know.  Let me see it.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.
It has?!  But I brought it as quickly as I could!  Can't you do something with it?
Figures.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I can't, sorry.  And you brought it all that way, I feel terrible.  Oh well.  I'll do the goat cheese, though, as soon as I have everything I need.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.
Here's hoping!  Thanks so much for all your work!  I'll get this to Renard right away!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  The starter mix!  Oh, don't worry about that, I was talking to Percy and he got me some from his sister who has a catalog business.  So you don't need to get me that.

replies.reply_text: What?  Now you tell me!  Well, I have some other items from your list.
Okay, then.  Well, that's everything, I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! Chevre is French for goat, but it's commonly used to refer to any kind of goat's milk cheese.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I see.  Yes, I think that will do.  Can you make it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? What sort of business are you talking about?

replies.reply_text: I represent Hansel and Gretel's bakery and they are looking for a cheese vendor for the bakery, interested?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but I don't think my goat cheese is what they are looking for in a bakery.  Why don't you see if you can find someone who makes cream cheese?

replies.reply_text: Any suggestions?
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, haven't a clue!

replies.reply_text: Well, it's been swell, but I have to keep looking.  See ya!

npc_list.name: Joanna
npc_list.admin_description: new quests on CP#7
npc_list.long_description: Joanna has a twinkle in her eye and a bounce in her step. She must be filled up with the musical beat!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there!  Come on in.

replies.reply_text: I should be on my way.  Bye.
Thanks.  I will.
Thanks! I'm just wondering if you might happen to know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Thanks so much! I'm wondering if I can talk to you about Brooklyn and Angie. They are making quite a bit of a racket right now and I can't talk them out of leaving the Cloud Isles.
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! Oh, I heard that you help people out.

replies.reply_text: That I do.  Did you need something?
Umm... I don't really like to, but if you need something, I suppose I could help.
No, I try not to.  I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, well, I go out riding everyday. The 'ears' on this fun isle are so neat to go riding on.  Well, anyway, I was riding through some cotton plants, and I seem to have lost my riding crop.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's too bad.  Well, good luck finding it.
I can go see if I can find it.
All right.  I'll be back in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello again!  How'd the search go?

replies.reply_text: Not great.  I'll go keep looking.
What was I looking for again?
I found it!  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: My riding crop.  I believe I dropped it in the cotton plants down one of the 'ears'.  You'll have to find a way to rake away the cotton plants to find it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go look.
All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  Thanks again for your help!

replies.reply_text: Anytime.  Goodbye.
Of course! I'm actually wondering if you know anything about the triumph of Sam McGee?
Thanks so much! I'm wondering if I can talk to you about Brooklyn and Angie. They are making quite a bit of a racket right now and I can't talk them out of leaving the Cloud Isles.
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sam McGee? The name isn't familiar, I don't think I know who that is.

replies.reply_text: All right, thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear! The twins can be very contrary at times. I suppose they've sent you to 'negotiate' with us?

replies.reply_text: Why yes! How did you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've had residents from Molten Meadows, Crystalton and Tropicton all come here with the same complaint. I just don't know what to do about those two girls.

replies.reply_text: They told me they want new instruments, and they'll come home. But looking around, I can't see how their musical talents wouldn't be too loud for the local residents here, either.

chatpoints.chat_text: My husband Evan has dug a root cellar near the base of the large tree. That will work wonderfully to dampen the sounds. We want to encourage our children in their music endeavors. Unfortunately, funds have been tight lately.

replies.reply_text: A root cellar is a great idea! It sounds like you feel new instruments are too expensive for the girls at this time. If I can find someone willing to barter with me to make new instruments for something other than money, would you go for it?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a wonderful idea! I'm not sure we have much to barter with, but if you are willing to research this, it would be a blessing to our family.

replies.reply_text: You can count on me. I know of a metal worker who can probably make the cymbals, and I think I know of someone to make the drums. I'll be back when I know more!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see if you could find residents to barter with so my daughters could have new instruments.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I'd completely forgotten. No worries. I am on my way now to Jungle to see a man about making cymbals.

npc_list.name: Jubal
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests start at CP33
npc_list.short_description: A Resident of the Sand Isles.
npc_list.long_description: Jubal is a young man. He is thin and his skin is weathered beyond his years.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, traveler.  You're quite far off the beaten path, aren't you?

replies.reply_text: I like to explore and wander around all the isles, even the small ones.
Yes, I suppose I am.  What are you doing?
So what?  See you later.
Hello again, Jubal.  Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi Jubal, I'm finally back.  It took a lot of work, but I brought back four tins of Nereus' Aromatic Liniment for your hands!
Sorry, Jubal, I got distracted.  I remember that I gave you your liniment, right?
I'm back, Jubal.  How's that liniment working for your hands?
Hi Jubal.  What was I doing for you?
Hi Jubal.  Palila says the last people she saw come out of your tent on the night of your party was a performer with a turban, and Calico Jack.  Can you think of who I could ask?
Hi Jubal, if you remember, I was going to go look for information about those scraps of paper?  I'm ready to continue now.
I'm back Jubal, and I believe I have it figured out. First, let me give you all these scraps of the note... You see how they all match up to form a complete message?
Jubal, I'm finished digging the floor out of your teepee, like you asked.
Hi Jubal, remember me?  I gave you a gum drop and then fled?
Hi Jubal.  Palila says the last people she saw come out of your tent on the night of your party was a performer with a turban, and Calico Jack.  Can you think of who I could ask?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's good; I used to sail with a band of pirates.  That was the good old days...

replies.reply_text: Really?  You were a pirate?  Where are they now?
Ahhhhh!!! Pirate!!! RUN AWAY!

chatpoints.chat_text: On an isle to the far northeast.  They've buried treasure on the beaches, if you've got a keen eye to find them.

replies.reply_text: What do I do when I find one?
How do I get to Pirate Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Use that handy shovel of yours to dig them up.  The harder they've been to come across, the more they're worth!  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'm going to go look for them now!

chatpoints.chat_text: There are two bands of pirates on Pirate Isle.  The Skulls and the Crossbones.  You can get to one or the other, depending on which rowboat you find.  There are two rowboats on two separate beaches.  Good luck finding them.  They've moved since I did any exploring.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  Thanks.   So... What'chya doing?
Thanks for the info.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am braiding rope.  I hope that this will one day be the longest rope on Horse Isle!

replies.reply_text: Do you make smaller ropes?
Why are you making rope?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure do, come back later and I can sell you one.  I have to finish my masterpiece first.

replies.reply_text: Okay, see you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Right after I'd left the pirates and moved here, I woke up and found that my memories had gone kind of fuzzy. In this very tent I found a couple of scraps of paper.  One said "make" and the other said "rope."  I took it as a sign.  I didn't have a career goal at the time, so I started making rope.  It's a natural choice for a former mariner.

replies.reply_text: So how's the rope-making business treating you?
Interesting.  Well, enjoy your rope-making.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's not a lot of money in it, but it's relaxing, and I have lots of time to work on my masterpiece.  The only problem is that it's very hard on my hands. They get so cracked and chafed.  I wish I had something that could bring relief to my poor hands.

replies.reply_text: I could fetch something for you.  Do you know someone who sells beauty supplies?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have absolutely no idea who would have a salve that could help my hands, but if you find some, I'll pay very well for it!  I remember a great healing salve some other seafarers had around.  It smelled so bad, you just knew it had to work.  I wouldn't recommend asking the pirates, but if you know of any retired sailors, one of them might know what that stuff was.

replies.reply_text: I do know of a retired sailor or two.  I can go ask around.
I don't know any old sailors.  Well, maybe I do, but I'm going to pretend I don't.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were checking with retired sailors to learn of a good stinky healing salve that I could use on my hands.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Thanks.
With any luck, I'll be back shortly!
Well, let me tell you... Oh never mind.  It's not worth going into.  Just remember that Eunice on Art Isle made it, in case you need more.
(You shout in through the tent flap.) Thanks a lot, and good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is the same stuff!  I remember it now!  I have such a hard time keeping my memories straight.  I don't have much, but what I have is yours.  You've earned it, and these tins of liniment are worth more than jewels to me.

replies.reply_text: I was happy to do it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's wonderful stuff.  My hands are doing much better now.

replies.reply_text: Well, I came back because I was intrigued by your scraps of paper, and I wonder if I could try to help you figure out where they came from, and what they mean.
That's great!  Well, I'll be off now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a happy life here, but if you really want to try, it's fine with me.  I have to warn you that I have absolutely no money or jewels left, after paying you for the liniment.  I wouldn't be able to pay you for your help – not in the amount you're probably accustomed to.

replies.reply_text: Oh, the money doesn't matter.  It brings me pleasure to help people.
In that case, I'll come back after you start making some money.  Bye.
Do you have any idea who might have left the papers here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Quickly -- get out your shovel and dig in this very spot!

replies.reply_text: Oh, gosh!  How could I have forgotten?  I'll do that right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Most of my old Crossbones Pirate friends were here, and we had a... performer, I think. I don't remember the party very well.  I do remember pretty clearly saying goodnight to my best friend Calico Jack. It was the last time I ever saw him.

replies.reply_text: That's a start.  I think I'll go ask Palila if she remembers anything else about that night.
Whoops!  I'll have to come back some other time!  I think I hear my... horse calling me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe Palila knows something about it.  My memories are really only reliable from the day after I moved in.

replies.reply_text: Whoops!  I'll have to come back some other time!  I think I hear my... horse calling me.
That's a start.  I think I'll go ask Palila if she knows anything useful.
I certainly will.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to talk to Palila about these scraps of paper.

replies.reply_text: Now I remember.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's very kind of you to want to help someone like me.  I wish I had more I could tell you about these scraps of paper.  My memories are pretty hazy.

replies.reply_text: Do you have any idea who might have left the papers here?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know who the performer might have been, but you could ask some Crossbones Pirates.  I remember something... Calico Jack was captain, or... no, he wasn't captain but – he wanted... oh well, it's gone again.

replies.reply_text: It would help me to have those two scraps of paper, Jubal.  Do you mind?
Thanks, I'll go ask the pirates.

Jubal, did you ever notice that these scraps of paper have numbers on them?  Look!  The one that says "MAKE" has a little number 2 in the corner, and the one that says "ROPE" has the number 15 written on it.  I think these are pieces of a larger note

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you can find the rest of the note, I would be most interested in what it says!

replies.reply_text: I'll try my best!
I'm pretty sure I have it figured out, and I brought you a little something.
Oh, I have no idea what they mean.  I'd better go ask Dieter for help.
I'm so happy for you!
I don't like it when people scream at me.  Bye.
I'm getting out my shovel.  How exciting!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find it?

replies.reply_text: Find what?  What was I doing again?
Your memory is sound! Look at this! (You give Jubal the treasure chest)
No, I didn't find anything.  I'd better go quickly.  What?  No, I'm not hiding a gigantic treasure chest under my jacket!
Thank you very much, Jubal!  It has been my pleasure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, friend.  I'm so happy to see you!  Come in!

replies.reply_text: Thanks Jubal!  I'm just out exploring.   Have a good day.
Thank you!  I see you're still making rope?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, though my memories have returned in full force, I still find it relaxing to make rope.

replies.reply_text: It's good to see you happy and healthy.  Goodbye now.

npc_list.name: Posy
npc_list.admin_description: &New Quests CP15
npc_list.long_description: Posy has short, curly hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go find me 15 bunches of daisies and a white rose.  The rose can be found in a flower shop.  Treeton is probably the best place to check.  If you're having problems with the daisies, there's a place you can make bunches of them on Flower Isle.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Please, please.  Do come in.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks.
No thanks.  I gotta go.  Bye.
Hello! I have come for the sketch of the dead, um, I mean, withering tree.
Why thank you, I will.  I was just asking around, I'm looking for hobby suggestions.
Thanks, I will.  I've come with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Make yourself comfortable.  I don't get a lot of guests out here.

replies.reply_text: Why is your forest called Flower Forest?  There really aren't any flowers in it.
Why not?  This seems like a nice area.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know.  No need to remind me.  I love flowers so much, but the only place I can get them to grow is in my own garden.

replies.reply_text: You know, there are flowers all over Horse Isle.
That's sad.  Well, I should be going.  Good luck with your flower growing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it is, but I can't get any flowers to grow anywhere.  So, I think people don't want to wander all the way over here to just see a plain old forest.

replies.reply_text: You know, there are flowers all over Horse Isle.
I don't think that really matters to most people.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose not, but it matters to me.  It's hard to have a Flower Forest with no flowers in it!

replies.reply_text: Anything I can do to help?
That is true.  Good luck with that.  I need to be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Oh, would you be able to pick me up some flowers?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  I would love to.
Oh, no thanks.  I really don't have time to go hunting for flowers right now.  Maybe later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for getting those flowers for me.  They're just beautiful!  Would you be able to do another favor for me?

replies.reply_text: I would love to.
Not right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.
Great.  I'll be back as soon as I find them.

chatpoints.chat_text: So? Did you find me some beautiful flowers?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
What did you need me to do again?
I sure did.  Here you are.
What did you need me to do again?
I did.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go find 15 wildflower bunches and you'll have to buy a yellow rose at one of the flower shops.  The one in Shellton sells them, I believe, but others may have one, too.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.
Okay.  Thanks.
All right.  Thanks.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for your help before.  Things are starting to look very pretty around here.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I was glad to help.
Why thank you, I will.  I was just asking around, I'm looking for hobby suggestions.
Thanks, I will.  I've come with a proposition for you.
Hello! I have come for the sketch of the dead, um, I mean, withering tree.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I am so glad you came for it. I have been waiting so long the paper has started to yellow.

replies.reply_text: So, the sketch was done a long time ago?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, thankfully, it was done before the tree, well, you saw the shape the tree is in.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, pretty sad. Since it took so long to get here, do you have the next clue for me?
Yeah, not sure he wants a sketch of that.  But oh well, do you have the next clue for me?
(Sigh.) I will try to figure that out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find the next wonder yet?

replies.reply_text: No, can you give me the clue again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you asking for yourself?   I have found that flower arranging is a wonderful hobby.

replies.reply_text: Well, not exactly.  I was sent here by a lighthouse keeper.  She has some spare time and wants a hobby.
Crow's Nest Carrie asked me to try to find her a hobby…
Thank you.  I’m sure she’ll find these books interesting.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, who would send a proposition to little old me?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your floral designs.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll be sure to share your enthusiasm with Iona.

npc_list.name: Hidalgo
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 4
npc_list.long_description: Hidalgo is a Painted Stallion.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The painted stallion whinnies at you, as if asking what you want.)

replies.reply_text: Sorry boy.  I'm going.  Don't worry, I'm not after your oats.
Oh, sorry, but are you Hidalgo?  It's just that Salvador sent me with this letter.  I had no idea you were a horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry for that.  I have to act like a normal horse, otherwise people laugh.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  I see.  Well, I won't laugh.  I've seen loads of talking horses.
Oh, okay.  Goodbye then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  May I see my letter, then, please??

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, sure.  Here you go, boy.
I'll go now and let you read it in peace.  Bye bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for bringing me the letter.  It's so good to hear from friends.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome Hidalgo.  Take care, boy.

npc_list.name: Wolf
npc_list.short_description: Leader of the Cat Isle pack
npc_list.long_description: Wolf is a huge, long haired cat. He is mostly gray but has some reddish brown spots.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meow!

replies.reply_text: I don't want anything!  I promise! I'm just gonna go now.
What do I want?  Daria wants to know why you haven't been keeping the mice out of her oats the way you usually do.
You're welcome!  I hope your kitten is okay.
Daria sent you this special treat, she thought you'd like it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meooow!  Meow meow mew meow merow!

replies.reply_text: Your little kitten is sick!?  That's terrible.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mew.  Meow meow, mew mew meow!

replies.reply_text: And you can't get any medicine for her? That's why your pack hasn't been keeping the mice in line?  They're all so worried? Oh, no!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mew?

replies.reply_text: Of course I'll help!  Just tell me what I have to do!
I'd love to help, but I can't right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meeew.  Meow meow meow.  Mew meow.

replies.reply_text: Of course!  I'll go to the store right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meow?

replies.reply_text: I've got it!
I hate asking, but I've forgotten what I'm supposed to be doing.
Right.  I'll just get on it right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meeeerow.  Mew meow meow meow.

replies.reply_text: Sick kitten... Go to the store... Medicine.  Oh!  I remember now!  I'll go to the General store right away!

chatpoints.chat_text: Meow meow!  Mew mew meow meow mew. Meow!

replies.reply_text: You're very welcome!  I hope your kitten gets better soon.  I'll let Daria know that the pack will hop right into action to get those mice in line again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mew merow.

replies.reply_text: Lucy Reins in Shellton wants a cat to keep her company and help with her mouse problem.  Would any of your pack be interested in joining her?
I'm glad to hear that.  Thank you.

npc_list.name: Odysseus
npc_list.admin_description: &New quests start at CP11
npc_list.short_description: The old greek hero and genius.
npc_list.long_description: Odysseus is a distinguished looking old man with white hair and many wrinkles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there, friend.  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  I'll be going.
I'm looking for a guy named Hidalgo.  Do you know him?
Actually, is there anything I can do for you?
I got the horse made for you.
Palila sent me with the box she made for you.
Hello Odysseus.  I was wondering if you could translate some measurements from an old recipe.
Hi there!  Are you busy?
I was actually doing something for you.  Do you remember what it was, because I can't anymore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hahaha he is not a man.  Haha.  He is a horse, and a grand one at that.  He's out back of the hut, eating his oats.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm let me think.  Why, yes.  There is something you could do.  I have a drawing here of a miniature wooden horse I'd like to get made for my friend Mona on Art Isle.  She'd love it to go in her garden.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm seems like too much hard work.  Sorry, I can't.  I'm busy.
All right.  What do I do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fantastic.  Here, take these plans to Rebecca on Hare isle.  She'll be able to knock it together for me.  You may need some cash up front, so take this, too.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I really don't have time to go that far.
Okay.  I won't be long.   I hope.
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, fantastic.  Let me have a look at it.

replies.reply_text: Here.
Sorry.  I think I'll keep it now, since I did all the work.
Thanks a lot.  Bye now.
Is that it?  Remind me never to help you again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do come back.  I may need help getting this to Mona.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.  Thank you so much for your help getting the horse made.  You couldn't do one last favor for me, could you?

replies.reply_text: No, sorry.  I'm busy.
Yeah, sure.   What do you need?
Palila sent me with the box she made for you.
Not yet.  Actually, I was wondering if you could translate some measurements from an old recipe.
Umm...  Not yet, but are you busy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Could you take the horse to Mona on Art Isle?  I'm sure she'll give you a little something for the trouble.

replies.reply_text: No.  That is way too far.  Sorry.
Okay.  I'll take it to her.
Bye, then.  Nice seeing you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for all your help.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Bye.
Palila sent me with the box she made for you.
Hello Odysseus.  I was wondering if you could translate some measurements from an old recipe.
Well, I can't remember where you wanted this horse to go.  Could you remind me, please?
Hi there!  Are you busy?
I will.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure I can.  What are the units?

replies.reply_text: A “gill” and a “peck.”  Have you heard of them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.  A gill is the equivalent of half a cup, and a peck is just a bit over two gallons.  If this recipe is as big as it sounds, you'll probably be fine substituting two gallons. Who's preparing an antique banquet?

replies.reply_text: Eunice might try to make her father's Aromatic Liniment.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  Well, that was some strong stuff, but it did the trick. Say “hello” to Eunice for me.  Nereus was a dear friend.

replies.reply_text: I will do that.  Oh, by the way, would you know where to find lanolin?
Thank you.  I'll remember.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.  Take it to Mona on Art Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right!  Thanks.  I'll do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, no, not at the moment.  What brings you all the way here?

replies.reply_text: Uhm, nothing. I just remembered I have to be somewhere else.  Bye.
(You explain about the Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Wisdom? (Odysseus seems to find the whole idea highly amusing!) Well, well, well. Wisdom. Let me tell you, I've been alive a long, long time. And in all that time, I think I've only learned one thing that's been true always and everywhere.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Please tell me what it is!
Just one?  That's too bad.  Can't be much good, then.  Oh well, I'm off!
That's it?
Hmm!  Interesting!  Thanks a lot!  I'll go tell Wiseman!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's it!

replies.reply_text: Hmm!  Interesting!  Thanks a lot!  I'll go tell Wiseman!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  I gave you plans for a wooden horse.  You were supposed to take those to Rebecca in Carrotton to have it made up.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Thanks!  I'll get right on that.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Jade Maki
npc_list.long_description: Jade Maki is a walking jewelry display. Necklaces, bracelets and rings adorn her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello.  What may I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, just looking around.  Thanks.
You make jewelry?
What good is jewelry?
I'm confused - was I supposed to bring someone a pearl necklace?
I'm confused - was I supposed to give someone a seashell necklace?
I'm ready to deliver more gifts now.
I brought Nadine and Krista their necklaces!
I'm back!  Ethel and Viola loved their necklaces, too.
Not for me, but for Mona- here, she sent me with this pony sculpture.
Hi Jade Maki. I'm trying to get a very custom order done. A coral and obsidian necklace. Could you do that?
Hi Jade!  I have a little proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure do.  Just bring me the needed things, and I can make anything on that list.  The ores are most important, of course.

replies.reply_text: Ores?  Where do I get those?
What good is jewelry?
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's mostly for looks.  It's also worth a lot.  So, if you can find a good rock store and sell it there for normally quite a bit.

replies.reply_text: Oh, great!  Thanks.
Do you know where the best place to sell it would be?
Is that really the only thing jewelry is good for?

chatpoints.chat_text: I know Rocco Shale sells and buys things at really good prices.  I don't know where his rock store is right now, though.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find all ores on rock piles.  The only ore I use is gold and silver.  No need to bring me any iron ore.  That won't do me any good.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, some stones have special meaning to certain people.  The best example of these is birthstones.  Have you heard of them?

replies.reply_text: Yes, but can you tell me more?
No, can you tell me about them?
No, but that's okay with me.  I'll talk to you some other time.
I bet birthstone jewelry is great for presents.

chatpoints.chat_text: Traditionally, every month has a gemstone linked to it.  The gem linked to the month of your birth is called your birthstone.  Many people like to wear jewelry made with that stone.  Other times, mothers will wear jewelry with each of their children's birthstones on it.

replies.reply_text: Hm, that's nice but not very interesting.  Thanks, though.
What birthstones go with each month?

chatpoints.chat_text: Which season would you like to hear about?

replies.reply_text: Spring.
Summer.
Autumn.
Winter.
I'm all set for now.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Aquamarine is the stone for March. You might guess from its name that it's the color of the sea. Legend says that it protects those who travel on the sea.

April is, of course, the diamond. These lovely stones are the toughest of gemstones, but also the most expensive! Clear quartz crystals are sometimes used as a substitute.

Since May is the month in which the world turns green, it makes perfect sense that its stone is the emerald. Its rich green is a symbol of nature.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me about another season?
I've never seen some of these gems on Horse Isle before.
That's good to know.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Many people spend June by the seaside. That is where you find the June birthstone: the pearl. It's not actually a stone, and needs no cutting or polishing, but can be worn right from the shell.

The bold ruby is the gem for July. One of the four precious stones (along with diamonds, emeralds and sapphires), the ruby has been called the king of gemstones.

August's peridot, pronounced per-i-doh, is a paler green than emerald. It was once thought to drive away nightmares and give its wearer persuasive powers.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me about another season?
I've never seen some of these gems on Horse Isle before.
That's good to know.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Blue sapphires are the traditional stone for September. Sapphires come in all colors, though, except red. A red sapphire is instead called a ruby; they are the same stone but for color.

October is represented by either the opal or the tourmaline. Pink tourmaline is especially popular. While tourmalines come in every color, each opal contains many colors as well.

Named after the Sanskrit word for fire, the golden topaz is November's stone. It is a symbol of friendship and fidelity. Other golden stones can also be used, including citrine.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me about another season?
I've never seen some of these gems on Horse Isle before.
That's good to know.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text:
December's traditional birthstones have included blue-hued stones, especially zircon, blue topaz, or turquoise. Lately, some people also use tanzanite, a recently discovered deep blue-purple stone.

The garnet is found in almost every color, but traditionally it is chosen in fiery red for the birthstone of January. Other popular colors of garnet are rose-pink, cinnamon, and green.

With color fit for royalty, February's amethyst has been worn as a gemstone since ancient times. Ranging from light lavender to deep purple, it has been said to confer clear-mindedness.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me about another season?
I've never seen some of these gems on Horse Isle before.
That's good to know.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, some are quite rare.  For some of them, I just substitute matching crystals.  But others can be found if you know who to ask.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me about another season?
That sounds suspiciously like you want me to find out who to ask.
That makes sense to me.  If I'm ever looking for one, I'll check in with you.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, just giving you information.  Not everything leads to a quest, you know.

replies.reply_text: I suppose you're right.  Can you tell me about another season?
I don't know if I believe that.  I'll talk to you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no!  Please give Krista a sapphire necklace and Nadine an emerald one.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll get right on that.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely!  Actually, I have four friends that I wanted to send birthstone necklaces to.  Do you think you can help me out?

replies.reply_text: I knew a quest was coming up.  Not now, thanks anyway.
Sure!  Where do they live?

chatpoints.chat_text: The first two are close to here.  Nadine lives in Earton, and Krista is right here in Whiskerton.  Since Krista was born in September, she should have a sapphire necklace.  Nadine's birthday is in May, so she should get an emerald necklace.  Both should be made with gold chains. If you could craft those here and then deliver them, I would really appreciate it.  Then you can worry about the other two.  I don't have a lot of cash right now, but here's $500 to help cover expenses.

replies.reply_text: Sapphire to Krista, emerald to Nadine.  Got it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I'm not ready for more yet.  Make sure you check next time you're down this way!

replies.reply_text: Will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wonderful.  Thank you!  Can you do the next delivery now?  It's a little trickier.

replies.reply_text: Sure, why not.
Trickier?  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you can come back when you're ready, I'll be here.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ethel runs a store in Hotton.  She has an April birthday, so I'd like to send her a diamond necklace.  My old friend Viola was born in July, so a ruby necklace is right for her, but I'm not sure where she's living now, except that it's probably somewhere snowy.  Again, both necklaces should be gold.  How's that sound?

replies.reply_text: A diamond is pricey.  Can you front me a little more money this time?
Wait, you don't even know where Viola lives?  And a diamond?  I don't have time for this now.
I'll see you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all!  Please bring Viola a ruby necklace, and Ethel a diamond one.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good!  Was Viola terribly hard to find?

replies.reply_text: Not at all, she lives on Berg Isle now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then how could you have delivered both necklaces?  That can't be right.  Please find Viola.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Glad to help.
Well, I bet whatever you come up with is going to be one of a kind!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, that's not really my kind of work. I don't deal with sea treasures at all.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I might be interested in a "little proposition", what is it?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your jewelry.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll give your answer to Iona, bye!

npc_list.name: Palila
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 10
npc_list.long_description: Palila lives in a tepee. She loves the Desert climate.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  Sorry I didn't notice you there.  I get a bit engrossed in my work.

replies.reply_text: Well, it looks very beautiful.
I'll leave you to your work.  Bye.
People buy these from you?
Hi there, Palila.  I wonder if you could tell me anything about the night Jubal moved into his home.
Hello, Palila.  Can you remind me what you knew about Jubal's party?
Hi Palila!  You're a fine wood craftswoman.  Could you possibly fix the hole in this bucket for me?  I need to have it fixed so it still looks old-fashioned.
I can understand that. Sorry to disturb you, but I was wondering if you could possible recreate this fish? (You show Palila the photo.)
That's perfectly understandable.  I have a proposition here for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you!  I love my work.

replies.reply_text: Where do you get all the wood boxes from to work on?
I can see that.  I won't keep you any longer.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rebecca tends to send someone down with a big bag of all different sizes.  I haven't gotten any from her lately, though.

replies.reply_text: I could go see what's holding her up.
Doesn't she live all the way up in Carrotton?  That is way too far.  I'm sorry.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they do.  Every one I make is unique, too.  Maybe later you could deliver some of my finished ones for me.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I could do that.
Hmm...  Probably not.  I really don't like doing deliveries.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great. Well, come by later and maybe I'll have some done for you to deliver.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll do that.
Where do you get all these boxes from to work on?
Thanks.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Any luck with Rebecca?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  She was low on wood.  Here is your bag of boxes.
I haven't seen her yet.  I'll get right on that.
What did you need me to see Rebecca for again?

chatpoints.chat_text: She normally sends me a bag of wood boxes.  Could you see what's keeping her?  She's up in Carrotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay, I'll be back soon.

STIG-1 MAKE-2 EPSJ-3 UBAL-4 ONSH-5 OREN-6 OTIN-7 BOATS-8
THEW-9 AYTO-10 THET-11 REAS-12 UREA-13 GUMD-14 ROPE-15 VOKES-16

A girl's best friend, dug out of the ground;
cutting me brings out my merit.
I can make rainbows, they do astound;

chatpoints.chat_text: When put together, in order, and spaced out differently, the scraps read:  “Stigma keeps Jubal on shore not in boats, the way to the treasure a gum drop evokes.”  It seems to me that if you take a gum drop to this fellow Jubal, that will make him tell you about a treasure.

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Rose
npc_list.long_description: Rose is a fitting name for this maiden. She has flowers in her long golden hair and beautiful, delicate jewelry. She is wearing a long, flowing skirt and a white lacy blouse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there... (She smiles at you.)

replies.reply_text: Um, hello! Do you live alone out here in the forest?
Hi. Can you help me?
Hi... Uh, I'm just doing something right now. Bye.
Hello!  Have you seen a baby troll wandering around, recently?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do. I used to live in a big town, but I came out here since... well... it's a pretty forest, isn't it? Is there something I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: Maybe. A friend of mine lost something out here and I was just looking for it.
No, not right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can try. What is it you need?

replies.reply_text: A friend of mine lost something out here and I'm looking for it.

chatpoints.chat_text: What was it they lost?

replies.reply_text: A wishing box... that's what my friend said. He's an elf, actually. I guess elves own things like that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I just found a box lying right around here and it looked quite special.  It must be this wishing box you're looking for!  I have it right here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! This has to be it. Wow, a wishing box. Man, who wouldn't want one of those?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not many, I think. Though my one wish wouldn't fit in a box... (She smiles sadly.)

replies.reply_text: Well... thanks again for your help. Maybe I'll come see you again. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello again. Did your friend get his magic box back?

Hello again Rose!  This is off the subject, but I'm in a bit of a hurry: Have you seen a baby troll wandering around, recently?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're welcome, dear. It was no trouble.

replies.reply_text: Bye!
Say, is there anything I can do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again. How are you?

replies.reply_text: I'm fine. Should be going, though. Bye!
Good, thanks. Anything I can do for you?
Hello again Rose!  Have you seen a baby troll wandering around, recently?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I don't think so. Not now anyway. Thank you for asking, though. It's very sweet of you to be so helpful.

replies.reply_text: Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... there is something you could do for me, if it's not too much trouble. You see, I've been living in this forest for a long time, and so it's been a very long time since I've had my favourite food. Perhaps it sounds silly, but if you could find it, I would just love some pie a la mode.

replies.reply_text: Uhh, I have no idea where to find that. Sorry, bye!
Pie a la mode? I'm sure I could get some for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be so kind of you! I've always loved sweet things like that.

replies.reply_text: See you again soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!

replies.reply_text: Hi, I haven't got your pie a la mode yet. I'm still looking.
I found some pie a la mode for you!
Hello, Rose!  Have you seen a baby troll wandering around, recently?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well don't worry too much, dear. It's just a little favour. They might sell some in one of the food shops, though, if you're wondering.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back!
Thanks a lot! Enjoy your pie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  I saw him just to the northwest of these rock piles.  He sort of disappeared into a bunch of trees.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll look around up there.

npc_list.short_description: A Large Troll Guarding the Bridge
npc_list.long_description: A large and gnarly troll.

chatpoints.chat_text: Residents only!  New password please!  No password?  Don't ask other travelers!  Go to prison then!

replies.reply_text: What?  But...  Umm....  Okay.
But I don't know it!
Hi Mr. Bridge Troll!  How are you this fine day?  Me, I'm just glorious!  Footloose and fancy free!  Not a care in the world!
Hi Big Troll... Was I doing something for you?
Hi Big Troll!  I found your son on Turtle Isle, but I couldn't catch him.  I told him it was time to go home, and he poofed away!

Hello again, Big Troll!  How's Wee Troll today?  I wonder how that water is today!  Do you think it's cool?  Warm?  Do you ever go for a swim?  Do you?  I'm just so curious about the hidden lives of trolls!
Hi Big Troll!  Could you help me into the water to see the fish?
Ummm... Mr. Troll?
Mr. Troll. I've got something for you!
What was it that you wanted in trade for Rick Hammerstroke's wind chimes?

chatpoints.chat_text: You no know?  Village girls know!

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Okay.
Thank you very much!  I'm so glad he's safe where he belongs now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You, happy human!  Help Big Troll?

replies.reply_text: I see what you mean.  Don't you have some sort of magic that could help you find your baby?  You're good at poofing people across the bridge, I know.
I'm a little too scared after looking at her.  I think I need to steel my nerves before I help trolls.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't leave bridge job, human!  And where to poof?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I don't work for smelly trolls, especially ones who can't even keep track of their own kids.
Oh, of course.  In that case, I'll be happy to look for Wee Troll for you.  Did you say it wandered into the forest?

chatpoints.chat_text: HE, human!  Baby SON troll!

replies.reply_text: I'm so sorry.  Which way did you say your son went?
Hee hee hee!  Oh... Oh...  You're too much!  Ha ha!  I've got to leave before I fall right off this bridge from laughing so hard!

chatpoints.chat_text: That more like it!  He go South – into Bridle Forest.

replies.reply_text: Will I need some sort of tool to find him, do you think?
I'm sorry, I really have to be going now.  I'll come back later to help you though.
I apologize again for offending you.  I'll be back after I look through the forest.
Ha ha ha... Ohhhh no....

chatpoints.chat_text: You check Bridle Forest for Wee Troll.  Hurry!  Wife MAD!

replies.reply_text: Don't worry, I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why Human bother me? Human want a smack upside the nose?

Nope! I'm so outta here!
No, thank you! Sir, I was told that you took some wind chimes. Could I get them back from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Rumor wrong. Me no got.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. I was told a troll took it. If you didn't take it, could you tell me who did?
Well, if you don't have it, I give up. Sorry to have bothered you. I'll get out of your hair now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me took. Me gave present.

replies.reply_text: Can you tell who has it now? I'd really appreciate it.
But it wasn't yours to give! Bad troll!
