chatpoints.chat_text: Wife gots.

replies.reply_text: Your wife? The troll on the other side of the bridge? Is there something she might like in exchange for it?
Hmmm. I think I've had enough troll talk for one day. Bye!

I see. You gave them to your wife. I'm sure she wouldn't appreciate you taking them back... unless you gave her something even better! What if you gave her something you made? What could you give her that would be better than the wind chimes?

chatpoints.chat_text: More color. Give me. I get gift back. Give you.

replies.reply_text: Color? Ohh! Copper! Are you saying you'll give me the wind chime back for some copper?  I'll do it!  Tell me how much you want.
Ohhh! This makes sense. A strong troll like you, you can pound out a bunch of wind chimes for your wife! That's so perfect. I'll do it.
You aren't making much sense. I think I'll quit this quest now.
I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: What you got?

replies.reply_text: I've got the copper you wanted. For the wind chimes, remember?
Oh, darn. Looks like I forgot the copper. Nevermind!
Thanks so much, and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: 30 pieces.  Copper.  You get.  Now.

replies.reply_text: That's right. And I've got them right here!
Now. Later. Whatever! I'll be back when I can. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The young man is lying on the beach, unconscious.)

replies.reply_text: Umm... Hello?
Er, since you can't exactly talk to me, I think I'll just go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unnhh... (He sits up a little and looks at you with bleary eyes.) ...Where am I? Who are you?

replies.reply_text: You're on Saddle Isle.  I just found you lying here a moment ago.
Who are you? What happened?
I'm nobody, actually. I'm leaving is what I am. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Far from here, up north, our ship crashed upon a reef in a terrible storm. I don't know what happened to the others, but I managed to grab hold of a broken railing before I was lost in the sea.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's quite a story!

chatpoints.chat_text: My name's Will.  I was first mate on an unfortunate sailing ship...

replies.reply_text: Unfortunate?
Say no more, I can guess the rest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Saddle Isle? Phew... I must have drifted far... I wonder how long I've been here.

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure, sorry. Were you shipwrecked or something?
Who are you? Are you a sailor?
Yep, Saddle Isle. I'm sure you can figure out things from here. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It really is amazing that I've washed up here, so close to home. I've been gone on that ill-fortuned voyage for over a year, and when we got lost it was so far from here... (He looks distant.)

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do to help you?
Want me to show you where the nearest town is?
Well, there's some good luck, at least. I had better go now. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, there is. If you could somehow bring me some food and water... I'd be much obliged.

replies.reply_text: Of course! I'll get some from the nearest house, probably in Cantle Meadows.
Umm....  I'm actually a little busy right now..  Sorry.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's kind of you, but I don't think I could make it as it is... Maybe if you could bring me some food and water?

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course! I'll get some from the nearest house, probably in Cantle Meadows.
Umm....  I'm actually a little busy right now..  Sorry.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. (He smiles weakly.)

replies.reply_text: I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He seems to have collapsed again from exhaustion- you'd better bring him that food and water from Cantle Meadows soon!)

replies.reply_text: Don't worry, I'll be right back.
I have it!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He sits up again.) Huh? Oh, thank you! You're a real saint.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome! I wouldn't think to do otherwise. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No problem. I have to go now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: There is, actually. Now that I've eaten and drunk... I know I buried some money back on Horse Isle a while ago, and I could really use that now. Do you think you could dig it up and bring it to me?

replies.reply_text: Um, no, that's too much work for me. Sorry.
Sure, I can do that. Where is it exactly?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.

replies.reply_text: Hi! Was there anything else you needed?
Hello...  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's buried in the far east of Horse Isle, on the coast. Head east of Treeton and it should be out on the beach, near a rock, I think.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll come back when I've found it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you able to find my money yet?

replies.reply_text: Not yet. I'm still looking for it.
Where did you say it was buried again?
Yep! I have it right here!
You're welcome! And thanks for the present.
Oh... eh... I might have- but don't worry, I'll get it back to you, one way or another.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well- (He looks thoughtfully off into the distance.) there is one more thing I need to do... but you probably can't help me.

replies.reply_text: What is it?
Oh. You're probably right. Bye, then!

chatpoints.chat_text: When I left on that long voyage, I left behind a girl... and I need to find her. I doubt you've ever met her before, though. (He sighs.)

replies.reply_text: Why?
Well... good luck finding her.

chatpoints.chat_text: She just keeps to herself, you see. Don't worry about it... (He gets a faraway look in his eyes and turns away from you.)

replies.reply_text: Okay...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again. I can't thank you enough for all your help- you're very kind.

replies.reply_text: No problem! Anything else I can do for you?
Don't mention it. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He's sitting on a rock when you approach, staring at what seems to be a very old, worn picture.) Oh- it's you. Hello again. How are you doing?

replies.reply_text: Oh, good, but I'm kind of busy. See you later!
I'm doing fine, how about you?
Not bad... Um, have you been sitting here this whole time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm all right. (He looks misty-eyed as he puts the picture away.)

replies.reply_text: You seem sort of sad to me.
Well, that's good.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's just that... I haven't had any luck finding the girl I told you about. Her name was Rose, and we were going to be married when I came back from my voyage. But it's been so long since I left... I doubt anyone even believed I was alive. I've searched and searched, but I just can't find her. Maybe I never will... Anyway, I've just ended up back here where I started. (He stares at the ground and sniffs.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's sad. I'm sorry to hear that. Here, you could use this... (You hand him the handkerchief.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Here...? (He looks around at the beach sadly.) Oh, no. I've been all over actually, but, well... I've come back here.

replies.reply_text: Well, I suppose the view of the ocean is nice. It's a good place to think.
Why? Is something wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes... (He seems distracted.)

replies.reply_text: Well... I'll leave you, I guess. Goodbye.

npc_list.admin_description: Baker
npc_list.long_description: Martha is a wonderful mother and her eyes shine when she looks at her children. She is dressed in a plain house dress and apron.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, dear! Can I help you with something?

replies.reply_text: No, I'm all right. Are those your kids?
Nope, sorry to bother you. Bye.
Yes, there is! There's a shipwrecked sailor on the coast, and I need to get him some food and water! Would you have any to spare?
Yeah.  I was wondering if you know anything about an original piano piece made for Kyleigh?
Yeah, umm, Penelope up in Witherton broke her leg, and is having me ask around to see if someone has something she can borrow to take her mind off of it.
Hello, I was wondering... Do you, by chance, ever do any baking?
Hi!  Wedding cake ready?
Excuse me. I may be in the wrong place, but I'm looking for the lady once known as Long Matty Black. I don't suppose...?

I hope you can. I think that Dalton is of the opinion that you can bake him a magical cake that will heal him. I have a couple of special things I think he wants in it: Stardust from a real star, and Horn Serum from a unicorn. Can you help him?

chatpoints.chat_text: First let's talk about why tack cleaning is so important. Which of these is not a reason to clean your tack?

replies.reply_text: To keep dirt and dust off of it.
To keep the leather hydrated.
To check for wear or damage.
To keep the leather from changing colors as it ages.
All of those are good reasons!
Those aren't good reasons. None of them are true.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm sorry, that wasn't correct. Maybe you'll give it another try another time.

replies.reply_text: Darn, okay. I'll go study up.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Right. Dirt and dust actually eat away at leather, causing damage and dryness. Dry leather can crack, so keeping the tack moisturized is important too. And of course you don't want your equipment to break on you while you are riding.
Several different types of leather can be used for tack. They have their own pros and cons. Which of these sentences most accurately describes the difference between grain and calf leather?

replies.reply_text: Grain leather is buttery soft and breaks in quickly, whereas calf is more durable but takes longer to break in.
Grain leather is more durable but takes some time to break in, whereas calf is buttery soft and breaks in quickly.
Grain leather comes from buffalo, whereas calf leather comes from cows.
Grain leather comes from bison, whereas calf leather comes from cows.
Grain leather comes in a broader variety of colors than does calf.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You got it. When you look at a saddle made of grain leather, it looks like it has small holes in the surface. The leather is often thicker than calf, and it holds up longer and takes more wear. The downside is the thickness and that it takes longer to break in. It may also be slicker than calf. Calf leather is more expensive, because it is softer, grippier, and takes less time to break in. But it is also more fragile and wears quicker.
There are many different tack cleaning products on the market. Some of them are especially crafted for different types of leather, but in general, they serve the same basic functions. Which of the following products is used to clean- not to seal or condition- leather tack?

replies.reply_text: Glycerin soap
Castile soap
Neatsfoot oil
Sulfur soap
Antibacterial soap

chatpoints.chat_text:
That's right. Many people think that glycerin soap is useful for cleaning leather, but that's not so; it actually seals the pores of the leather. It can seal dirt into the pores, so you want to get the tack nice and clean first. Castile soap is made with olive oil and it is a nice mild soap, good for removing dirt.
While you're cleaning, you may find some dark, greasy splotches of dirt that stick to the leather, especially on the underside where the leather touches the horse. What are these called?

replies.reply_text: Riders
Jockeys
They don't have a special name- they're just dirt!
Monkeys
Wranglers

chatpoints.chat_text:
Right, they're called "jockeys" because they ride along in the saddle with you. To remove these, gently scrape them with a fingernail, or use a damp sponge with a little bit of soap.
Say you got caught in a downpour. What's the best way to take care of your soaked tack?

replies.reply_text: Clean it immediately while it's still soaked! Then oil it liberally to avoid any drying out.
Dry it with a hair dryer, then clean it thoroughly and oil it.
Dry it vigorously with a towel, then clean it thoroughly and oil it.
Leave it alone to dry on its own until it's just barely damp, then clean it and oil if needed.
Leave it alone. The water will have cleaned it for you.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You got it. Water didn't hurt the cow, so it won't really hurt your leather. If you scrub at it while it's wet, though, or heat it up, you could damage the grain or cause it to crack. Just store it in a dry place, wait for it to dry out, and take care of it as you would normally.
This type of leather conditioner used to get a bad rap for "rotting the stitching," but in reality, it does no such thing. It's derived from certain bones of cattle.

replies.reply_text: Neatsfoot oil
Olive oil
Glycerin soap
Lederbalsam or leather balsam
Oil soap

chatpoints.chat_text:
Right. There are two kinds of oils marketed as neatsfoot- the pure animal product and one containing petroleum. Some people think the petroleum product is the same thing, but it isn't; it will rot linen stitching. That isn't a big deal these days since so much of the thread used in tack is synthetic, but the animal product is still better for your leather.
You've just taken your tack out of storage and it's got little fuzzy green spores all over it. What do you do to get rid of the mold?

replies.reply_text: Clean it as usual- saddle soap will get rid of it.
Use an antibacterial soap.
Use white vinegar to kill the spores, then clean as usual.
You don't- the tack is now useless. You'll have to replace it.

chatpoints.chat_text:
That's right- white vinegar will naturally kill the mold without damaging the leather. An antibacterial or antifungal spray made for furniture or wood will also work, but it's harsh on the leather, so it's not the best solution.
Moving away from leather a little bit, let's talk about saddle pads. Many pads these days, especially the corrective type, are made of pure sheepskin. Sheepskin is very breathable and disperses heat well, so it makes for a good saddle pad. How would you keep a sheepskin pad clean?

replies.reply_text: The same as any other pad- throw it in the wash with detergent.
You can only rinse these- imagine shampooing a sheep! A cold water rinse will keep them clean.
All you need to do is give them a gentle brushing when you're done riding.
Let them dry, then brush gently. When they get dirty, hand or machine wash with a specially formulated soap.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Just right. You'd want to treat sheepskin like a wool sweater- don't wring it and don't use harsh detergents, which can damage the fibers. Brushing off the dirt and the occasional careful wash will keep your sheepskin pad in good condition.
Speaking of natural materials, let's talk about an important piece of Western tack. Traditionally, the Western cinch or cincha was made of either horsehair or mohair. You can still find these today. What's the best way to take care of these natural materials?

replies.reply_text: Every time you ride, soak it in warm water and wash with a mild shampoo to remove sweat and mud.
When it gets gross, throw it in the washing machine on the delicate cycle- easy!
Brush off any caked dirt or sweat after each ride, and hand wash with cold water when needed.
You don't need to take special care of it- the beauty of these is that they need very little care.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You got it! Mud and sweat will eat away at these natural hairs, so those need to be cleaned off. Since mohair and horsehair cinches are all natural, they may shrink, so you want to use cold water.
Finally, let's talk about one of the most important parts of your saddle- the tree. This is the frame on which the saddle is built. When you evaluate a saddle before purchase- especially if it's new- you want to check to make sure that the tree isn't compromised. How do you do this?

replies.reply_text: Gently tap the pommel and cantle with a rubber mallet. If it sounds hollow or especially if it creaks, the tree may be broken.
Holding the pommel, gently flex the cantle back to you. If a number of wrinkles appear in the leather seat, or if it creaks, that's a sign of a possibly broken tree.
Ride in it, and if it is unbalanced, it's safe to assume there must be a problem with the tree.
You can't do this on your own- you want a qualified saddler to help you determine this.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yes! Of course, not all creaky trees are broken, and not all trees with give are broken. Stiff or dry leather will sometimes creak, and spring trees have more give than the traditional styles and may flex more. You may want to call up a saddler to have a check, but these are pretty good indicators that something might be wrong.

If you want to try it, I'll take $1000 from you up front. If you get it right, you'll get your $1000 back, plus $2000 extra- so you'll walk away with $2000. But if you get it wrong, I keep the $1000. How about it?

replies.reply_text: You'd take care of it the same way as leather- regular cleaning and conditioning, with the occasional oiling.
You don't- another advantage to serge is that it pretty much takes care of itself. You don't need to clean it.
Similar to suede, you'd brush it off with a soft brush and clean with a damp cloth when necessary.
You'd take care of it similarly to leather, only omitting the oiling, which would soak into the flocking underneath.

chatpoints.chat_text:
That's exactly right! Serge is pretty durable. If you're using a pad- and if the saddle is properly fitted, you'll only need a light cloth one- it shouldn't get too dirty. Gently brushing off any dirt accumulation and wiping clean is really all it needs.
Great job! You clearly know how to take good care of your tack. Here's the $2000 bonus I promised you!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, that's not right. Actually, serge is pretty durable. If you're using a pad- and if the saddle is properly fitted, you'll only need a light cloth one- it shouldn't get too dirty. Gently brushing off any dirt accumulation and wiping clean is really all it needs. If you used soaps or oils, they might leach into the flocking, and you don't want that. replies.reply_text: Password?  What's the password?
Why would I need a password to cross the bridge?

chatpoints.chat_text: The password is for the residents.  Then there aren't people all over Saddle Isle.  Personally, I don't understand why they don't like the company.

replies.reply_text: So...  What's the password?
Yeah, couldn't imagine.  Do you know what the password is?
Well, I guess I won't bug them, then.  Thanks for the chat.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: The password is 'fuzzy'.  Easy enough.  Have fun on Saddle Isle.  Don't tell them I told you the password.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that poor girl.  I know she loves to play outside.  Paige must be going insane having her inside all day.

replies.reply_text: Well, you could say that...

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me see...   Hmm...  I really don't have anything a child would enjoy.  I don't have a lot of books around or anything.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  And why are you looking for Olav?

replies.reply_text: His sister, Katinka, asked me to find him for her.  She's a sweet old lady, and I thought that this would be the least I could do for her.  Any idea where he might be?

chatpoints.chat_text: Katinka is looking for him?  Poor dear... Olav and I courted while he was here, but he got bored here and moved on.  He wrote to me for a while, but the last I heard from him, he was in Earton.

replies.reply_text: I guess I should head to Earton, then.  Any idea where in Earton he stayed?
Well, I'm certainly going to try.  Thanks for the information.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right. I told you the last I heard from Olav, he was staying in Earton.

replies.reply_text: That's right, Earton.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I wondered what the delightful sound was! I'm sorry to say, I haven't seen them at all. I hope you find them. And please tell Rick I so enjoyed the sounds they made.

replies.reply_text: I'll let him know. Thanks, and have a great day!
That sachet smells very nice.  I better be heading to Earton, myself.  Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: No bother. Archy left here and went to Earton.

replies.reply_text: Earton?  Thank you very much, Kyleigh.

npc_list.name: Elsa
npc_list.long_description: Elsa is an old woman with bluish, white hair who uses too much cheap perfume.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hiiiiiiii!  Ha ha ha ha.  Come and see my picture!  Isn't it wonderful?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes...  It's very nice.
Um, is that an outhouse?
Uh, not really.  It might need some more work.
Ahhh!  Creepy old lady! RUN!
Yeah, um, that's great.  I was actually here to see if I could find out what kind of pie you ordered from Olivia.  You see she seems to have lost her list.
You've already shown me but, um, yes it is.  Anyway, I have your pie for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's the barn that my father built.  Oh, I just love family history!

replies.reply_text: Oh, I've built a barn on my ranch.  It's very nice.
I plan on building a barn someday.
Oh, is that what that big red blob is?  See ya later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's just 'cause you're not from around here.  Artists from Ice Isle are always more talented.   You wouldn't understand.

replies.reply_text: What are you talking about!  That's just a big red blob with some squiggles!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... My father was a master carpenter.  It takes a LOT of talent to build a barn and this house.  Don't worry if yours isn't as nice as his is.

replies.reply_text: Are you talking about this house?!  It's falling apart!

chatpoints.chat_text: You must just not have an "artist's eye" for things. I do so love drawing. (Hums to herself)

replies.reply_text: (You slowly back out of the room as she goes back to drawing.)

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it's just vintage.  Tea or coffee?

replies.reply_text: Oh, um, I guess that was an invitation... I like coffee.
Oh, uh.... I prefer tea.
I really must get going.  We'll see you another time.

chatpoints.chat_text: On Ice Isle we think coffee's better, but here's your tea.

replies.reply_text: Uh, thanks.
Oh okay then, I'll have some coffee.
You know, I think I hear my horse neighing for me outside.  I better get going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tea is much better for your digestion but here's your coffee.

replies.reply_text: Uh, thanks.
Oh, okay then, I'll have some tea.
You know, I think I hear my horse neighing for me outside.  I better get going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you like a pastry?

replies.reply_text: (You look at the dried-out pastry and wonder how old it is. It appears to have a small dead bug stuck in the filling.) No thanks.
No thanks.  I'll be sure to tell Olivia right away.
You're welcome.  I'll just be going now.

npc_list.name: Britt
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP11
npc_list.long_description: Britt is a sweet young lady.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Please come in.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  I love your cat.
No thanks.  I have to go.
I see you are using that alpaca wrap from Mikko.
Hello there! I have brought you a birthday present from Mikko!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks. His name is Mitchy. Come here Mitchy. ( Mitchy looks up, stretches and comes over, sitting next to Britt.)

replies.reply_text: Wow.  Can he do other tricks?
Cute.  I have to go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping in.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  He knows how to beg and roll over.  He only does that for treats though and I am out.

replies.reply_text: Aww.  I would love to watch if you ever get some more treats.
Too bad.  Well, I have to go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Would you like to pick up some for me?

replies.reply_text: Not really.  Maybe another time, but I'm a bit busy right now.  Bye.
Sure.  I could do that.  Where do I go?
All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  How did your trip go?

replies.reply_text: I haven't gone yet.  I'll get right on that.
What was I supposed to be doing again?
Great!  Here are the treats.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go to the Earton Pet Shop.  Iggy knows the type of cat treats that Mitchy likes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  Bye.
Thanks.
Thanks.  So...  Do I get to see some more Mitchy tricks now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. Okay Mitchy. Rollover! Mitchy looks at Britt, then slowly lays down and rolls to her side.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  is that it?  That's kinda dumb.
Neat!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good boy.  Here's a treat.  Sometimes he'll roll all the way over, but only if he wants to.

replies.reply_text: Huh.  All right.  Well, I should be going.  Have fun with Mitchy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Thanks for getting the treats for me.  Mitchy has been very happy.

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear that.  Bye.
Can I see Mitchy roll over again?
Hello there! I have brought you a birthday present from Mikko!
I see you are using that alpaca wrap from Mikko.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay Mitchy. Roll over! (Mitchy looks at her, then slowly rolls to his side, then flips his legs over and rolls completely to the other side.)

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Neat!  I guess he can roll all the way over!
That's just nuts.  Have fun with Mitchy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  Here Mitchy.  Here's a treat.  Good boy.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for showing me the trick.  Bye.
I'm pleased you like it. And I'll tell him right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: I love it! And look, you can't even see any cat hairs on it. Its very warm and cozy. You should get one for yourself.

replies.reply_text: I usually hang out in warmer climates, so I don't need one. But I'm so glad you like it. I've got to go now, so I'll see you around.
You know, that's a great idea! I love searching these snowy islands for wild horses. Speaking of wild horses, I think I'll go look for one now.

npc_list.name: Mikko
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP6

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I'm so glad you're here!  Could you help me?

replies.reply_text: Not right now.  I'll stop by later.
Sure.  What's wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: A friend of mine, Matti, left to explore Ice Isle, and there was a storm.  He hasn't been back yet.  Could you help find him?  I need to stay here and make sure I'm here if he comes back.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  I'm not good in snow.  Good luck, though.
Of course I'll help.  Where do you want me to look?
All right.  I'll let you know once I find Matti.

chatpoints.chat_text: How's the searching gone?

replies.reply_text: Not good.  What was I doing?
Haven't found him yet.  I'll go look some more.
Barney found him!

chatpoints.chat_text: Search for Matti.  Barney will help you.  He was up north of here, by the snow caves.  He might have moved by now.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go look for him.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see that.  Thank you so much.  Here's a little something for your trouble.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  It was no problem.  I'm glad we were able to find him.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks again for finding Matti.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  I'm glad he's safe.  Bye.
You're welcome. Can I do anything else for you?
I think I was getting something for you. Can you remind me what it was?
Look what I have! (You hand the wrapped dog toy to Mikko, making sure Barney doesn't see anything.)
I'm looking for a new adventure, and plan on traveling west to some of the warmer islands. Is there anything you might want from there?
What was I doing for you again?
Can you remind me what I was supposed to do with this throw?
Britt absolutely loves her gift! And the money you gave me upfront pretty much covered my costs.
No problem.  Say, I'm back with that gift for your friend.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, there is, if you don't mind. I ordered Barney a new dog toy for his birthday, which is coming up soon. Would you be willing to pick it up for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure! I'd love to!
I can't, sorry. I'm allergic to pet toys. See you!
Okay. I'll be back before you can say, "Bow wow!"

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure can. You were going to pick up the dog toy I ordered from Iggy Chewtoy in Earton for Barney's birthday.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I remember now! I'll get right on it.
I was glad to do it. I'm sure Barney'll have a ball chewing on that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I do. I've heard that Dog Isle has expert craftsmen. I'd love to find something unusual for my sister Britt. Her birthday is coming up soon.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! I don't even know how to get there. I guess I can't help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You could bring me back some warmth! Ha-ha! Actually, I need a gift for Britt. Her birthday is coming up.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like you need a personal shopper. I'm great at getting specific things, but I would have no clue what she'd like. Sorry!
If you have something specific in mind, I'm sure I could help.
She is such a sweet person. I didn't realize her birthday was coming up. Do you have any ideas on what to get?

chatpoints.chat_text: I do, as a matter of fact! I've heard that there is a shop on one of the jungle islands that sells handmade items. I'm sure they would have something perfect for a cat lover! And Britt certainly loves her cat.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! I wasn't planning on traveling that far today. Maybe I can do that some other day. See you around.
Well this will be a win-win situation! I was just planning on heading that way. I'd be happy to get something for Britt.
Well gosh, speaking of cats, I'm allergic. I don't think I'm the best person to help you out on this one. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be wonderful! I'm not sure what your travel costs will be, or what the gift will cost. I can't wait to see what you find.

replies.reply_text: I will do my best to impress you! I'll return as soon as I find something appropriate.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were helping me with a gift for Britt. You were going to get something hand crafted from one of the jungle islands.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm on it and will be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mikko looks at the throw and smiles his approval.) It's perfect. Could you please get it wrapped for me? I know Santa wraps gifts all year long.

replies.reply_text: Absolutely!
Seriously? That's just too much for me to do today. Maybe another day.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get Britt's gift wrapped. Remember?

replies.reply_text: Ah yes! Be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: If you can get him to wrap it in something bright and cheery, that would be great.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over there right now. Be back in a jiffy!
Happy to be of assistance! Have a great day.

npc_list.name: Yorick
npc_list.long_description: A large man, Yorick has a full beard and a friendly, welcoming demeanor.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there.  Come on in from the cold.

replies.reply_text: Brrrr...  Thanks.
No thanks.  Need to keep moving...
Hi Yorick! I'm FINALLY back.
What was I doing for you again?
I gave you the hockey pucks and sticks, here are the combos and mask.
Thank you, do you mind if I ask you a question?
Thanks, this will only take a sec, where did you say I should look for Olav again?
Thank you.  I have a package for you from the Pppppony Expppppress.  Brrr!
Thanks. I'm only stopping in. You wouldn't have happened to have seen a toy soldier in a paper boat float past here, would you?
Thanks, I will. I'm trying to find Archy. He's late and Mehitabel is getting worried.
Thank you, I will.  I'm sorry to bother you again, but where did you say Archy was going to after he left here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Come, warm yourself by the fire.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Oh, that stew smells good.
Thanks, but I need to be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, thank you.  Would you like a bowl?  It is quite hearty.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  That'd be great!
No thanks.  Anything I can do for you?
No thanks.  Thanks for the offer, though!  Bye!
Thanks!  That was delicious.  Bye.
Anything I can do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you would still like to help, please come back when you have it. Thanks.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good. See you then.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need some stuff done, but it would probably require quite a bit of traveling.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, then! I have quite enough to do already on these isles.
Hmm, why don't you tell me a bit more? I travel quite a bit, so it might be something I can fit into my schedule.
No problem.  I'll be back when it's all done.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm the manager for the Horse Isle Battalioneers - the local hockey team.  We have practices starting up and I need to get word to all the players. I also need to have some equipment picked up that was taken to be repaired at the end of the season.  I know it's a lot - do you think you can help?

replies.reply_text: Uh... I don't know. That sounds like a lot of work. I think maybe I better pass on this right now.
Sure, I can help out with that. What all do I need to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi again. Were you able to notify everyone and pick up the equipment I needed?

replies.reply_text: Yep! I told Ben, Cedric, Henry, Remy, Pillan, Hudson, Rolando and Stephen. They'll all be here on time.  I also got the equipment.  Here are the hockey pucks and the hockey sticks.
Yep, I sure do. They're right here.
Thanks... Oh, and by the way - Percy said to tell you that Barb Sower would be able to make the team sweaters when you're ready.  Thanks again. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Possibly; do you have your 50% quest points completed reward yet?

replies.reply_text: Yep, sure do!
No, not yet.  Sorry.
Sure, what is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need you to notify the players that practice starts in 2 weeks.  Then pick up some equipment that was being repaired.  Go talk to Ben Burlap in Tropicton first.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll head there now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Miss Katinka's brother?  He and I used to discuss Horse Isle's Hockey League, but I haven't heard from him recently.

replies.reply_text: Do you remember if he said anything about why he was leaving or where he was going?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me think... Basically, he wanted to go somewhere that wasn't always frozen. I still have the letters I received from him. (Yorick pulls out a few old letters.) He wrote me to tell me about his travels and give me some scouting reports on other hockey teams and of course, to keep an eye on Katinka for him.

replies.reply_text: Does it indicate where he was when he sent these letters?
That's okay.  I'll start at Witherton and see where the trail leads, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Whether or not I'd mind depends on the question, doesn't it?  What's your question?

replies.reply_text: I was wondering if you could help me.  I promised Miss Katinka that I'd help her find her brother.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you, the last I heard from him, he was in Witherton.  Ask around there!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, Witherton.  I forgot.  Thanks again!
You're welcome!  I'm sure the team will love the new logos!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, no, can't say I have. We never get anything washed up here. No messages in bottles, no paper boats... the tide always carries it further along south.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyhow.
Darn it, missed him again!  I'm off to Rider, thank you, Yorick!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's perfectly all right.  After our visit, Archy said he was going to Rider Isle.

replies.reply_text: Right!  He was on his way to Rider. Thanks Yorick!

npc_list.name: Soren
npc_list.admin_description: PIANO QUEST

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, why hello.  Didn't see you over there.  Sorry.  I just can't seem to find...

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  I'll be on my way.  I see the two of you are busy.  Bye.
That's all right.  What a lovely piano.  You must play a lot.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do.  I just love to play.  My wife and I play duets together all the time.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a lot of fun.  Well, I'll leave you two be, then.  Thanks.
Could I try to play something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.  Let's see...  Ah, here's a piece that shouldn't be too difficult, "Sweet Crystalton". It's a song I wrote.

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  All right.  I'll try it.
Oh, I don't know that.  How do you play it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it starts on E and jumps up to G.  There's a partial scale in the middle.  That starts on D.  Go ahead and try it out.  I'm sure you'll do great.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: EDC Hmm... That doesn't sound right... CDE maybe?  Oh hello.

replies.reply_text: Hello.  What are you doing?
Hello. I can see that you're busy.  Bye.
Hello.  I have a delivery for you from Xamba.
Anika!  I found your hat!
Sorry, Anika, I got sidetracked.  What was I doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Practicing my warm-ups. It takes a lot of time and effort.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Good luck on that then.
Say, I'm looking for some odd jobs to do.  You don't have anything like that, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh okay. Goodbye then. (She continues playing her warm-ups.)

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you.  Bye

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Will do.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Odd jobs?  Like... taking out the garbage, or fixing the roof or...

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll take out the garbage if you want, but... I'm more into finding lost objects, search-and-rescue, that kind of thing.
Take out the garbage?!  Are you kidding?  No way!  Forget I asked!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... search-and-rescue eh?  You might want to talk to Mikko, he's always losing Matti.  Hmmm... well, I don't suppose you could search-and-rescue my old woolen hat, could you?

replies.reply_text: That I can do!  Where did you lose it?
Nah, that's too dull for an old pro like me.  Thanks anyway, bye!
Okay, I'll go look for it.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You forgot already?!  Honestly!

replies.reply_text: Oh, uhm... no, I uhm... just remembered!  Bye!
Sorry, yeah.  I just don't have much of a memory.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were supposed to search around the bridge for my lost hat, remember.

replies.reply_text: Ooooooooooooooooooooooooh.  Right.  Back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Let me see!

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Thanks a lot!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Linnea
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 11
npc_list.long_description: Linnea believes in dressing for comfort and living in comfort.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  Please come in and warm yourself up.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  What are you doing?
No thanks.  I should keep going.  Bye.
Thanks, I'm here with a proposition for you.
Thank you. I'm here looking for Archy. Has he gotten here yet?  Mehitabel is very worried.
Thanks, Linnea.  Sorry to bother you again, but where did you say Archy was going when he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am making a braided rug.

replies.reply_text: That looks neat.  Where do you get all this fabric from?
Interesting.  Well, I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have to make trips to the larger isles to get cloth.  I haven't been able to go for a long time, though.

replies.reply_text: I could make a trip for you.
Hmmm..  Well, I hope you have a nice trip once you do head out.  Bye.
I'll be back in not too long.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  How was your trip?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  What was I supposed to do again?
Oh, I haven't gone yet.  Sorry.  Be back soon.
Great.  I got what you needed.
Umm...  What was I supposed to do again?
Great.  I got what you needed.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 5 pieces of cloth.  You'll have to collect a bunch of cotton and go see Barb at the Sewing Workshop in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay, I'll get right on that.  Bye.
Oh, sorry.  All right.  I'll be back in a bit.
Oh, thanks!  Sure, I could do something else for you.
Thanks, but maybe later.  I don't have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  Thanks for your help earlier, but I was wondering if there was something else you could get for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure I can.
Not right now.  Maybe later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  I'm out of berries to make purple dye and red dye.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I can go find stuff for you.  What do you need?
This is going to require walking around and finding a lot of stuff, isn't it?  No thanks.  Bye.
All right.  I'll be back when I find everything.
Oh, all right.  Be back in a bit.
Thanks.  Good luck with your rug-making!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for all your help.  I may need you to deliver some rugs for me later, but I'm not quite done with them yet.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll come back some other time.
I see a lot of rugs piled up by the door here.  Do you need someone to deliver these for you?
Hi Linnea.  I'm ready to talk to the retirement community caretaker about your donations now!
Hello again, Linnea.  I'm back with a proposition for you.
Hi Linnea, I'm here looking for Archy, has he gotten here yet?  Mehitabel is very worried.
That's okay, Linnea.  Sorry to bother you again, but where did you say Archy was going when he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I usually make rugs specifically for people who order them.  Those are just some I keep on hand to sell to people who are passing through.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Bye.
Oh, I see.  Well, as you suggested, I'll check back now and then to see if you need to have anything delivered.  I really like to do little jobs like that.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's funny you should mention little jobs... I have been thinking of making some charitable donations, but I haven't had the time to begin.  It might be a bit of work to find just the right people.   Would you like to help me with that?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  What do you need me to do?
No, thanks.  I don't like the way that word "charitable" sounds like "doing something for nothing."  I'll see you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd like to donate three of these especially bright rugs.  I was thinking that elderly people might appreciate them for their cheery colors.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense.  Do you know someone who fits the description?
Wow, those are some big rugs.  Maybe I'll come back after my horse has more endurance training. Bye.
I can go right now!
Oh, I don't think I want to do that.  That sounds like an awful lot of traveling.  Maybe I'll come see you another day.

chatpoints.chat_text: This is very exciting for me!  Please keep track of how the recipients like their rugs, if you don't mind.

replies.reply_text: I don't mind at all.  Now, which rugs shall I take?
I think I'll come back and talk to you after I've figured out some way to take notes.  Bye.
I'll be sure to come back when I'm finished and let you know how everyone liked them!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you're back!  What's the news on those donations?

replies.reply_text: Well, I told you about Flavius... The purple rug went to Dalton, in Treeton.
Oh, I forgot what I was doing.  Where was I supposed to go?
I asked a few community leaders, and I think I found the perfect recipients.  First, I gave the red and orange rug to Flavius, on Dolphin.
I'm back from Ormand's cabin, Linnea.
I'm done delivering the first rug in Flipperton, Linnea!  Where should I go now?
I'm finished donating two of the rugs, Linnea... in Flipperton and Treeton.  What do you think I should do with the last one?

Well, I told you about the first two... The last rug went to Ormand, in Hotton. He's a mean hermit, but the Mayor of Shellton insisted he was the best choice.  I forced my way in, laid out the rug, he yelled at me, and I left.

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard that there is a retirement community somewhere.  Please find the caretaker there, and ask them to help you distribute my donations.

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: How did he like it?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm not sure.  I guess I'll go back and find out.
I don't think he sees very many selfless acts.  He said that the rug really gave him hope for the future.
I gave the purple rug to Dalton in Treeton.

chatpoints.chat_text: How did he like it?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm not sure.  I guess I'll go back and find out.
He's been sick lately.  He said the rug made him feel much better!  He was so pleased that the mayor of Treeton remembered him, too.  It made him feel proud to live in that community.

To Ormand in Hotton.  He only ever yells at me when I see him, but the Mayor of Shellton insisted he was the best choice.  I forced my way in, laid out the rug, told him it was an anonymous gift, he yelled at me, and I left.

chatpoints.chat_text: Could you tell if Ormand liked the rug, at all?

replies.reply_text: No.  I guess he probably liked it.
I peeked into his house, and he was kneeling on the rug, crying, and whispering to himself: 'Who would be this kind to me?'

chatpoints.chat_text: Isn't there any way to find out for sure?

replies.reply_text: No, I don't want to go all the way to Hotton again.  The rugs are delivered.  That's it for me.
Yeah, okay, I guess I will go back and see what I can learn.
I'll go back and find out now.
I'm sorry I didn't try a little harder after I gave him the rug.  I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Softly) I never imagined that helping others could be so rewarding! You've taken great care to find just the right people to give the rugs to.

replies.reply_text: I was pleased to do it.
Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... I'm not sure.  If the caretaker of Flipperton gave you one name, maybe she knows someone else?

replies.reply_text: Ohh, right.  I was supposed to go back and talk to her again.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, I'm not sure.  Perhaps you could talk to the people who suggested the first two recipients... They might know someone else to donate to.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right!  I forgot to go back and talk to the mayor in Treeton to see if she knows anyone else.  I'll go back now.

chatpoints.chat_text: what sort of proposition are you talking about?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your rugs.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll relay your message to Iona.  Take care!
Maybe I'll get lucky with Yorick, thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: No bother. When Archy left here, he was heading to see Yorick.

replies.reply_text: Yorick, I completely forgot about him.  Thanks again, Linnea!

npc_list.name: Barb Sower
npc_list.long_description: An average size woman with curly, short reddish-blond hair, Barb has glasses and, by the huge smile on her face, it appears that she really enjoys her work here in the workshop.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Do you have anything for me to work on?

replies.reply_text: Hmm..  not now, sorry.  Bye.
I have a lot of cotton. What can I do with it?
I do. Maddog Robert sent me to have a new hat made for him.  His was ruined by crabs.
Here is the cloth and the raspberries.
Yes. Barnacle Ben needs these jolly rogers repaired.
I have clean jolly rogers from Barnacle Ben.  Can you mend them?
Magnolia sent me to get some bedding for her baby's crib made.
Magnolia sent me to get some bedding for her baby's crib made.
Magnolia sent me to get some bedding for her baby's crib made.
Magnolia sent me to get some bedding for her baby's crib made.
I have the 25 cotton and 15 strawberries that you needed!
I have the 25 cotton and 15 blueberries that you needed!
I have the 25 cotton and 15 blackberries that you needed!
I have the 25 cotton and 15 dandelions that you needed!
Hi, Kilye said I should come and talk to you about making Mrs. Claus' anniversary gift.
Hello, Ms. Sower. Do you, by any chance, recognize this cloth?
I'm back with the cotton and cattails.
Hello, I'm looking for paint.  Can you help me?
Hi, sorry to bother you again, but can you sew costumes?
Hi!  Carly Cobbler sent me to pick up her new linens.
Hi, sorry to bother you again, but what did you need me to get for you?
I'm back and I have your cotton.
Hi Barb. Antonio sent me. He thought you might be able to make a teddy bear for his pet gryphon, Melanie.
What was it I was supposed to get for you?
I'm back with the materials for the teddy bear.
Hello. Leasa sent me with some cotton.  She said you would know what to do with it.
Hello. Do you have that fabric for Leasa finished yet?
Hi there Barb! Do you happen to have an extra spinning wheel that I could buy from you?
Hi Barb. Do you know of anyone on the isles that could dye this cotton canvas? Kilye doesn't seem to be available for the job.
Hello, I was hoping you could help me.
I'm baaaack! And look what I've got!
Hey Barb. Is the mainsail ready?
Hi, Barb. Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
I do! I have an entire outfit that I need custom made. Shirt, dress pants, dinner jacket. I need the whole works for a guy who isn't up for traveling right now.
Hello, again! Can you remind me of the seamstress you were talking about?
Its me, again, Barb! Thank you so much for suggesting Zerena. She's making the outfit now, but needs 2 dozen doll-sized buttons to finish it. She said you would have them.
I do!  Would you be able to make a small, waterproof, feather pillow?
I'm back!  I was trying to remember all the stuff I was getting for you.
I have those ingredients you need!
Have you finished the pillow for Bess yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, cotton makes cloth. It can also be used as a filling for things like a saddle pad. Otherwise, cloth can be sewn into all sorts of goodies.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: A pirate? Oh my. Do you have the old hat? I assume he'll want it the exact same.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I got that impression.  Here you go.
That would be a good idea.  Here you are.
All right.  I'll start collecting.
Thank you. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no, dear. ( wrinkles her nose ) I'm afraid I won't work on anything that smells that bad. Why don't you take them to Eliza down the road to be cleaned first?

replies.reply_text: I understand that! I will be right back.
Thanks so much. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was wondering when she'd get around to asking for that! Did she tell you what color she wanted it to be?

replies.reply_text: She'd like it to be pink!
She'd like it to be blue!
She'd like it to be purple!
She'd like it to be yellow!
I'll get right on it. Bye!
I'll get right on it. Bye!
I'll get right on it. Bye!
I'll get right on it. Bye!
Alright. Be back soon!
Alright. Be back soon!
Alright. Be back soon!
Alright. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have the bedding for Magnolia's baby crib all finished! Do you think she'll like it?

replies.reply_text: She'll love it! Don't you need any payment for this?
I'm on my way. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.... not my pattern. You might ask Kilye, in Tropicton. It looks like her work.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll do that.  Bye!
Good - I will take these to Kilye now. Thanks Ms. Sower.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Kilye sent you? What was it that you were looking for?

replies.reply_text: Oh never mind. I don't want to do this now.
Mrs Claus' anniversary is coming up and she would like some reindeer harness made for Santa. She needs 8 of them.  Can you help?
Sure. I will be back when I have them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Paint?  No.  No paint here, sorry.

replies.reply_text: Do you know who might have some?

chatpoints.chat_text: Uhm, no, not really. The general stores don't?

replies.reply_text: Not that I know of.  But I'll go check.

chatpoints.chat_text: Costumes? Yeah, I do that from time to time. What kind of costumes did you have in mind?

replies.reply_text: I need an 1880s hoop skirt and a Major General's uniform.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! The Pirates of Penzance, eh? Well, I'll tell you what. If I made them for you, they'd be pretty expensive. But Harry Holterz, over at the livery stable? He used to work for a repertory group, as stage manager. He'll have what you need, I'm sure.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful!  Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, did she send along some of my supplies?

replies.reply_text: You mean the moonbeams and the silver linings?  Here they are, but what do you use them for?
Supplies?  I don't remember any supplies, I'd better go back and ask Carly!
Cool!  I can get the cotton while I'm waiting.  Be back soon!
Don't you have enough cotton around here already?

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you for 50 pieces of cotton to replenish my stock, remember?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah.  I'll get right on it!
Thanks, will do!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can never have too much cotton.  You get the cotton to replenish my stock while I make the sheets.

replies.reply_text: Oh all right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Let me think. It will have to be extremely durable to handle the claws of a griffin. Typically, a teddy bear would use 2 cloths. I'd better triple the layers. Bring me 6 cloths and 15 pinches of pixie dust -- I'll soak the cloth in a solution with the pixie dust. It'll give it a wonderful sparkly sheen. Can you bring me those?

replies.reply_text: Six cloths and 15 pinches of pixie dust? I can do that.
As luck would have it, I've got those things right here!
I can't right now.  I'll come back later.
I'll be back as soon as I have the materials.
This looks perfect! Thank you so much, and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were bringing me 6 cloths and 15 pinches of pixie dust.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll be back.
Oh perfect! I've got them on me now. Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yeah, sure.  She has me make a specific type of fabric for her quilts.  She should have given you 50 pieces of cotton for me, right?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's what that was for?  Shoot.  I guess I better go collect some.
Yep.  I have it right here.
All right.  Bye.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heavens no.  I need my spinning wheel!  In fact, I can't think of anyone who makes their living like this who would be willing to part with a spinning wheel.

replies.reply_text: Where do you get them, then?  I need to find one to buy.

chatpoints.chat_text: We're a pretty tightly knit group - spinners.  I'd have to say every spinner I know was given their wheel and the knowledge of how to use it by mothers or aunts.

replies.reply_text: Wow, no wonder Janice seemed so "bummed."  Isn't there anything you can suggest?
Oh well, I'll figure it out later.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you could find someone who uses a spinning wheel for decoration - I've never met such a person, but there are probably folks who are into the "primitive" look for their houses. You'd probably have more success trying to buy one from a person like that.

replies.reply_text: Lightbulb moment!  Thanks!
Hmm.  I guess I'll have to mull over it a bit.  Thanks for the tip though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? She must have more business than she can handle. I'm not sure if Trudy still works with cloth, but I think she's your best option at this point.

replies.reply_text: Trudy? I don't remember seeing a Trudy around the isles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. That depends. What were you needing help with?

replies.reply_text: Marina Mooring needs a new headsail for her antique sailboat.
A new saddle pad! Mine is getting pretty worn out.
Nothing, actually. I've changed my mind. Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, I think this is the first time I've ever been asked to make a sail! And I must say, I'm very surprised, what with all these sail boats around the isles. I even stocked up on some cotton canvas ages ago, just in case I was asked to do just that.

replies.reply_text: Then you can help me? That would be great!
First time? That's amazing. And discouraging. If you've never made one before, I'm not sure asking you is a good idea. Maybe I should look around the isles for a sail maker. I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I can't help you with that at all. You'll need to see someone else for that.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd be happy to do that for you, but you need to know that it would cost you $1500. I've got high quality cotton canvas, but it wasn't cheap when I bought it years ago. A head sail is bound to use a ton of it.

replies.reply_text: No problem. Marina gave me the money. Here it is! Oh, and she gave me these specifications, too.
Yikes! I'm not carrying that much. I'll have to go to the bank and get some. Be right back!
(Barb hands you the bolt of material.) Whoa! This IS a ton of cloth! I'll be back with it dyed before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Trudy is Ed Klippit's assistant. She's a sweet girl, and fairly quiet. Most people don't even notice her.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I never noticed her at all! I'll head over there right now. And thanks.
I'll be back in a few!
You've outdone yourself, Barb. I think Marina is going to love it! Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to have Trudy dye the material and then bring it back here so I can sew the headsail.

replies.reply_text: That's right! Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear. That's a big order. I've got several orders I'm working on right now, and an entire outfit is a bit much for me to take on at this time. If your friend isn't up for traveling, you'll need to get his measurements regardless of who you use to sew the clothes. Here, let me give you one of my tape measures.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! I didn't even think about needing his measurements. I'd love to have a tape measure!

chatpoints.chat_text: Quincy's sister over at The Mare.  I've heard that she has done some really fine work.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
Thanks so much! See ya!
I'm not sure I've met her yet. I'll head over there after I get Farley's measurements. Thanks for the suggestion.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a relatively odd request.  I'm assuming waterproof because it is for someone that works on the ocean here?

replies.reply_text: That's right.  It's for Bess.  She's a harbormaster over on Starfish.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right. Well, let's see what I have here. (She disappears into her back room and rummages around through different fabrics.) Ah, yes. This fabric should work well.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  I'll be back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: The waterproof pillow, right?  I needed paraffin wax from the general store, beeswax from Evelynn and fifty feathers.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help with my memory.  I'll be back soon!
Great!  I'll come back in a bit.
Thanks!

npc_list.name: Pegleg Johnny
npc_list.long_description: Pegleg Johnny has dark, greasy hair and a slanted grin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  Gotta go.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.
I'm looking for something etched on a bone.  Do you know where I can get that?
I'm wondering if you knew anything about a foghorn that's gone missing from a lighthouse recently?
This is a longshot, but I don't suppose you've ever met an extremely large octopus hanging around a shipwreck? (You show him Dalton's picture.) I'm trying to get where this guy once went.
Sorry to come back, but you said you knew someone who'd met an awfully big octopus... who was it again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  That be no good at all.  Well, I'll figure somethin' out.  You go warn others.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tough cookies.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for nothing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wait, lubber – the lass is sick from eatin' her own bad cookin'.  All she eats be sugar, fish, grease, an' more sugar.  That'd make a goat sick.

replies.reply_text: Thank you for your insight.  I'll keep asking around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, that I do.  Ye be lookin' for Willie.  That's his hobby.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I ain't sayin' a word, lessin' me Cap'n says otherwise!

replies.reply_text: Arg! You pirates are soooo frustrating!

chatpoints.chat_text: An' what's in it for me, lubber?

replies.reply_text: Please? It's for an ailing old man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, an' I'm not feelin' quite meself either in me old age, even given I still have all me teeth.

replies.reply_text: So you can sympathize, right? It's important to him. So, have you ever met an octopus like the one here?
I don't suppose you could tell me your aunt's name?
Well, that's something to go on, anyway...

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrrr, no. Surely she ain't goin' by Long Matty Black anymore! An' Auntie don't speak to me anymore, does she? Not since I were a little boy!

replies.reply_text: Why, what did you do to make her so mad at you?
No, I guess I can't see a baker going by the name Long Matty Black. Oh well, I'm sure I can find your aunt.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Cos I'm a ruddy pirate, ain't I? Family heritage! Me grandpa were a pirate and me great-grandpa were before him, and just because she wants to get out of the business, arrrrr, none of us can be pirates anymore so far as she's concerned! Arrrrrr, I got disowned!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to hear it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me auntie, the baker. Don't ye go askin' me her name again, hear? I told ye I don't know! Long Matty Black was a fearsome name on the seas once, but it ain't no name for someone respectable! (He spits to show you what he thinks about respectability!)

replies.reply_text: Uhhh, thanks.

npc_list.name: Captain Jack
npc_list.admin_description: the manifest quest; new quests must begin at CP10

chatpoints.chat_text: Why hello there.  What brings ye here?

replies.reply_text: Oh, just looking around.  Bye.
So...  You're the captain?
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really under the weather.  Do you know anything that would help her?
Ahoy Captain!  I'm looking for something etched on a bone, could you help me?
Eli Grits in Earton sent me to discuss a business...er...arrangement with you.
Er, Captain Jack... Who did you say I should see about the molasses?
Ahoy Captain! I was wondering if...(You stop yourself from telling him about the missing foghorn, realizing that you need to be a bit trickier and see what you can learn.) I was wondering if...
Ahoy, Captain! I was wondering if you could remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back with the beans and rice, Captain!
I'm back for the empty pot, Captain!
Excuse me, Cap'n? We had an accord. The foghorn for the meal?
Excuse me, Captain, but I don't suppose you've seen a kraken in your life?
Thank you, Cap'n. The seas have been good but seems a supply boat was pirated. And that certainly isn't good for the people waiting for those supplies.
I was speaking to Cap'n Solomon and he thinks your crew did the pirating of that supply boat.

chatpoints.chat_text: That I am.  What of it?

replies.reply_text: Well, umm...  Nothing I guess.  Bye.
I was, uh, looking for a job.  Anything I can do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... Let me think.  Ah, here be a task for ye.  It involves ghosts.  Think ye can handle it?

replies.reply_text: Ghosts?!?  No way.  Nevermind.  I think it's best I just get out of here all together.
Ghosts?  Sure.  I can handle it.  What did ye, uh.. I mean, you, have in mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need manifests from some ships.  The residents will nary give them up though.

replies.reply_text: Well, how am I supposed to get them then?
I'll get them.  Where do I go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Everything has its price.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.  I guess I'll see what I can do.
That sounds like way too much work...  Or just really expensive.  Good luck finding someone to play with the ghosties.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rowboats will take ye to the ships.  I need one manifest from each.  Good luck to ye.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I'll probably need it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see yer still with us.  The ghosts must not have been too angry today.

replies.reply_text: Oh, ghosts, uh...  What was I doing with ghosts again?
I haven't gotten those mani-whatever things.  I'll go get right on that.
Not too bad.  Here are the manifests.

chatpoints.chat_text: Get me manifests off each of the ships.  The rowboats will take ye there.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Okay.  Bye.
Oh, oops.  I'll go get the rest.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: If ye cross the bridge towards the Crossbones, ye best be needin' the password.  It be 'landlubber'.  Don't forget that now.

replies.reply_text: I won't.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back matey!  I hope the sea has been good to ye.

replies.reply_text: It has.  Thank you.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really under the weather.  Do you know anything that would help her?
Ahoy Captain!  I'm looking for something etched on a bone, could you help me?
Eli Grits in Earton sent me to discuss a business...er...arrangement with you.
Er, Captain Jack... Who did you say I should see about the molasses?
Ahoy Captain! I was wondering if...(You stop yourself from telling him about the missing foghorn, realizing that you need to be a bit trickier and see what you can learn.) I was wondering if...
Ahoy, Captain! I was wondering if you could remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back with the beans and rice, Captain!
I'm back for the empty pot, Captain!
Excuse me, Cap'n? We had an accord. The foghorn for the meal?
Excuse me, Captain, but I don't suppose you've seen a kraken in your life?
Thank you, Cap'n. The seas have been good but seems a supply boat was pirated. And that certainly isn't good for the people waiting for those supplies.
I was speaking to Cap'n Solomon and he thinks your crew did the pirating of that supply boat I asked you about.

chatpoints.chat_text: That be a load of rubbish.  What gave him the idea?

replies.reply_text: He has a big bump on his head from a piece of the sky!
Hmm...  I don't know.  Umm...  I'll be moving on now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It was probably somethin' else.  Go talk to one of the pirates in Patch Forest.  They'll straighten ye out.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't like t' hear that one o' me crew be feelin' poorly, but I'm nae help in these matters. Some o' these other buccaneers might be able t' help.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, Captain.  I'll keep asking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, ye need to be seein' Saggin' Jowls Willie.  He be yer man.

replies.reply_text: Thanks Captain, I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, did he now? What be the arrangement ye has in mind?

replies.reply_text: I'm the representative for Hansel and Gretel's new bakery and they are are looking for people who can supply these items. (You show Captain Jack Hansel's list.) Do you happen to know anyone who could help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, maybe I do and maybe I don't.  Why ye be tryin' to get in me business?

replies.reply_text: Look, I'm only trying to help Hansel and Gretel line up their suppliers.  The last thing I want to do is get into your business.
Do you think they would be interested?

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye completely addled?  I told ye to see Cannonball Cate and Porthole Wilma.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah.  Now I remember.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go ask them if they can handle the volume. Ye can tell them I'll help make sure their product gets delivered. Fer auld times sake... And a percentage. (He winks at you.)

replies.reply_text: Will do, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go on, Matey. Ye were saying?

replies.reply_text: Uh, right! I was just wondering if you... um... needed an apprentice! Yes! That's exactly what I was wondering. I've always wanted to be a pirate and I thought maybe you could let me hang around a bit, and get the feel of it?
To tell the truth Captain, I seemed to have forgotten! Later!
Saying? What was I saying? Hmmm. The thought seems to have left me. And on that note, I'll leave you with that thought!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Captain eyes you suspiciously and rubs his chin.) An apprentice ye say? Be ye workin' for that blackguard Captain Solomon?

replies.reply_text: What?!? No way! He's a... a scurvy dog!

(You hang your head.) Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn was stolen. She needs it to warn ships so they don't crash into the rocks off the shoreline. I thought by snooping around, I could find it. I'm so sorry.
Apprentice? No! I was just kidding, Captain. Haaa, haaaa, ha? Not funny, huh? I'm going to leave now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye know what me dear sweet mum always told me? If a body gossips TO you, they'll gossip ABOUT you! That's what me dear old mum said. I be wondering what kind of things ye be sayin' 'bout ME, behind ME back! (The Cap'n glares at you.) Best you be leavin' now, afore I make ye walk the plank!

replies.reply_text: Gulp! Yes, sir! I'm leaving now. Right NOW!
I'm sorry, Captain. I'm a blabbering fool. The only scurvy dog around here is me.  I was trying to find out where Crow's Nest Carrie's missing foghorn was. I'm sorry I wasn't upfront with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. No offense taken, Matey! Me men stole that foghorn on account of it were being used all hours of the day and night. We weren't gettin' no shut eye at all!

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about the crickets and Crow's Nest Carrie's lack of sleep.) So I could please have the foghorn back now?
I know how grumpy Crow's Nest Carrie was when she wasn't getting any sleep. I can't begin to imagine what a whole crew of grumpy pirates are like. I think I'll just head back to Earton now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell ye what, Matey. You bring me something to fill the bellies of me men and then we'll do business. Do we have an accord?

replies.reply_text: Accord? Oh, you mean agreement! Yes, sir! We have an accord!
Seriously? This is getting too involved. I think I'll go do something else now.
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. Ye were gettin' beans and rice for me crew. And ye best make haste. Their bellies are rumblin' something fierce!

replies.reply_text: Right! I'll be back in a jiffy.
I'll need the pot back as soon as you've finished the beans and rice.
Hope you enjoy them!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do ya now? Well, give us a few minutes and come back. We'll empty it soon enough!

replies.reply_text: Terrific! I'll be back in a couple of minutes.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. That we did, Matey.

replies.reply_text: Umm. So where's the foghorn?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye need to be searchin' dem empty barrels. Thar be so many of them that the crew can't seem to remember which one they stashed it in!

replies.reply_text: Great! I got you the red beans and rice like I said I would, and now I have to go searching, too? Can you at least tell me which barrels?
