npc_list.name: Sara
npc_list.long_description: Sara is busy cutting up strawberries in the kitchen. You see her shoulder length hair is a little frazzled looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi, I'm kind of busy making strawberry pie, do you want something?

replies.reply_text: I need to get off of this island.
Nope, not yet, sorry.

Hi. I'm trying to find an island that looks like... this?
(You draw a Z on the tabletop with your finger.)
It's supposed to be right next to this Isle.
I'll make this fast.  Have you seen any stray sheep running around this isle?
Do you make pies often?
Hi Sara, I'll try not to bother you for too long.  Could you help me with a charitable donation from Linnea, the rug maker? I've already donated two of her rugs, and I have this last one.
Hello Sara, could you remind me who I should take Linnea's last rug donation to?
It sure smells delicious in here. Would it be possible for me to get one of those pies?
Excuse me, Sara. I was told you might be able to help me.
Actually Sara, I have a gift for you from Candide.
Actually, no, I have something for you! (Hold out the pony sculpture.)
Sorry to interrupt you, just here to deliver a package from Pony Express.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm busy myself, but you can talk to Crazy Eddie, I'm sure he's not doing much of anything right now.

replies.reply_text: Okay, can I snitch a strawberry?
Okay, I will.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a tiny island shaped like that, just offshore. (Sara gives you a slightly odd, searching look.)

replies.reply_text: Could you send me there, please?  There doesn't seem to be a boat.
Is something wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: Something wrong?  No, nothing's wrong...

replies.reply_text: Okay, so can you send me there?
Am I, by any chance, not the only person who's asked to go there?

chatpoints.chat_text: To be honest, no, you're not.  A piratess came in here a while ago and asked to go there.

replies.reply_text: Interesting!  Please, send me there too?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can, sure.  But there's no boat and no bridge.  That piratess might still be there, and even if she is, you'll probably need to find your own way back.

replies.reply_text: Oh, great.  All this work to get stuck on a tiny island.  No, I quit.  Thanks anyway.
I'm sure I can find it.  If nothing else, I'm a good swimmer!  Please send me there.

chatpoints.chat_text: I surely haven't. Sorry I couldn't be more help. Good luck finding what you're looking for.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do, quite often. I have a few friends on these isolated islands, and pies make nice neighborly gestures.

replies.reply_text: I see. Thanks for your time. Goodbye!
Who's this pie for?

chatpoints.chat_text: This one is for Candide, who lives on Eldorado Isle, just to the east of here. You can visit him, if you like. I'm sure he'd appreciate some company. Would you like me to send you?

replies.reply_text: No, not today. Thanks, though!
Yes, please!
Actually, I was hoping to get a pie from you. For someone. A... umm... friend of sorts.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's a beautiful rug!  I never knew we had such an accomplished rug maker around.  Where did you say she lived?

replies.reply_text: Crystalton.  Her name is Linnea.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll remember that.  Back to the problem at hand.  I know a lot of people that would be thrilled to receive that rug.  Let me take a close look at it.  It has some lovely cool blue-green shades.  It seems to me that you could find a very appreciative recipient in a hot climate.

replies.reply_text: Now we're talking about color psychology?  I'll come back later.  I don't feel like traveling to hot places right now.
Do you know of someone on Desert Isle whose life would be improved by the rug?
Thank you!  Did you want me to come back and tell you if he liked his rug?

chatpoints.chat_text: I know him pretty well -- he'll like the rug.  Don't worry about coming back here.  That would mean a lot of extra trips for you.  If Ormand absolutely refuses to take the rug, come back and see me.  Maybe I can think of someone else.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again, Sara.  You're very helpful!

chatpoints.chat_text: Take it to Ormand.  I know he'll love it, though he won't say so.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, yet again, Sara.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would need 25 fresh, firm strawberries and 7 small chunks of sugar. I've got orders for all these pies, but if you get me the ingredients, I'll just bake another one. Then you can get one of these now.

replies.reply_text: I have those right here!
Oh, okay. I'll be back.
Thanks so much. It smells wonderful.

chatpoints.chat_text: That depends. I'm really busy right now. Just what kind of help did you need?

replies.reply_text: I need to get some fresh vegetables and was told that Candide would have them. Can you send me there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Candide sent me a present?  He shouldn't have!

replies.reply_text: Well, he said he wanted to do this because of all the delicious strawberry pies you've sent him.
It would be my pleasure, but could you please send me back to him?
It would be my pleasure, but I don't want to head back there quite yet.  I'll come back to see you when I do.
Have fun!
Enjoy those tins and have a great day!

npc_list.name: Hudson
npc_list.admin_description: sends player to Bone Isle
npc_list.long_description: Hudson is an adorable little boy with short brown hair and large blue eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  My name is Hudson!

replies.reply_text: Hi there Hudson, it says that this is Sara's cabin.  Where is she?
Okay. Here's the scoop. Yorick asked me to deliver messages about hockey and here's some soup for you. (Shoves bowl at Hudson.)
Hi Hudson.  Who was I supposed to tell next about hockey practice?
Hi Hudson.  Who was I supposed to tell next about hockey practice?
Hi Hudson.  Leasa sent me over here to pick up her thread.
Hello Hudson. Can you tell me anything about a mysterious rider wearing a purple vest? Like where he might have come from? Or what island he calls home? Or a name of someone?
Can you remind me what it was that you told me about the mysterious rider?

chatpoints.chat_text: My mom is at our cabin on one of the little islands.  It's our vacation home.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!  I'll just take a nap or get some tea and be on my way.
Cool, could I see it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, I could send you there.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
On the other hand... I'll stay. I have some other stuff to do first.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you go!
Uhhh, okay. Thanks. (Inhales deeply) Is this some of Pillan's soup? This is good stuff.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, yeah. Moving on now.  Look, I'm not trying to be rude, but this is taking way longer than I expected, and my horse and I are getting tired. So, heads up - hockey practice starts in two weeks.  Now, who do I tell next?
Oh, wow - thanks! Sorry for being a little grumpy. Off to Percy's now.   Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You will need to get the pucks from Percy Pakij.  He'll know who you should see next.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: It looks like you have the hockey pucks already, so go see Rolando.

replies.reply_text: (Sigh.) All right. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Grandma needs her thread back?  Okay, I'll get it for you.

replies.reply_text: Why do you have all this thread anyway?
I can't wait.  I'll come back later.
I will.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gosh. He didn't say anything about where he was from. There was something really weird about him though. Grasshoppers were crawling out of his saddlebacks. I thought that was a little freaky, but he seemed a nice enough guy.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! I think I know just where to head next.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. You wanted to know where he was from, but I couldn't tell you. The only thing that stood out was all the grasshoppers crawling out of his saddle packs.

replies.reply_text: That's right! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Artax
npc_list.admin_description: Atreyu's Horse Lost on Neverending isle #3

chatpoints.chat_text: Neeeeeiiiggghh.

replies.reply_text: Artax!  It's you.  Are you okay?  Atreyu sent me in search of you.

chatpoints.chat_text: He whinnies lightly

replies.reply_text: Okay, well let's get you back home!  Falcor should be able to carry you...  Lets go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sighs

npc_list.name: Scooter
npc_list.admin_description: has Leuko's egg
npc_list.long_description: A large, brown and gray squirrel with an unusually large, fluffy tail.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  That's a crazy fluffy tail!
AAAAHHHH!  Squirrel!
You have Leuko's egg, don't you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeee (Holds tail, seeming to smile.)

replies.reply_text: Well, you're welcome...  I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeeeek. (Shaking head.)

replies.reply_text: Hmm... What's that big white thing hiding under your tail?
Oh, umm... Okay.  I guess I'll keep looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks around sheepishly.) Squee?

replies.reply_text: Nothing?  I think that looks an awful lot like an eagle's egg.  May I have it, please?  Leuko is worried about her egg.
Thank you very much.  Leuko will be very happy.

npc_list.name: Pip
npc_list.long_description: A small, fluffy, brown and black chipmunk.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek! (Runs and hides near a willow tree root.)

replies.reply_text: Oops.  Sorry to scare you.  I'll just be on my way.
It's all right.  I won't hurt you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chip chip?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Wow, I can't really understand chippy speak.  Guess I'll leave you to your little home.
Can I help you with something?  You look a little troubled.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squee? Chip chi chip.. ( Sadly looking around.)

replies.reply_text: You don't like how you're living?  Well, it isn't exactly warm I guess, and it does rain here a lot.
I think your home looks just fine.  You are just a chipmunk, after all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeeeek! (Runs off behind the willow tree.)

replies.reply_text: Sorry I made you mad, but I have more important things to do than help a chipmunk.  Bye.
Oh, did I upset you?  I'm sorry.  I guess maybe your home here could use a little work.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chip chi? Sque squeeek. (Making fanning motions.)

replies.reply_text: Ferns?  You want ferns to give yourself some shelter?  All right, I can do that.
What?!  Fans?  There aren't any fans around.  Good luck finding that.  Bye.
Find 10 ferns?  All right.  Be back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chip chip?

replies.reply_text: Yep, here are your ferns.
Oh, I was supposed to get you 10 ferns.  I'll go get right on that.
Thanks.  Hopefully those work for you.
Oh, I don't have 10 yet?  Sorry, I'll go get on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chip chip. (Waving at you with its little paw.)

replies.reply_text: Happy to help.  Your little shelter is looking very nice.
I was glad to help.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chi chip. Squeek? (Tilts head.)

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do something else for you.
What?  Umm..  I don't think I want to do any more work for a chipmunk.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeeek, chip chip squee! (Holding belly.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, you're hungry?  I can find some acorns for you, if you want.
Food?  Well, good luck finding some.  Bye.
You want me to find mushrooms, too?  All right.  Well, I'll find 15 of each.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chip chi?

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I was supposed to find you 15 acorns and 15 mushrooms...  I'll get right on that.
Here is your food.
Oh, I thought I had enough.  Sorry.  I'll make sure I have 15 acorns and 15 mushrooms next time.
Enjoy your food.

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek.  Chip.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I'm glad you're enjoying your food.

npc_list.name: Flavius
npc_list.long_description: Flavius appears old, very old!  His long white hair hangs in wisps over stooped shoulders.  His eyes though are clear and sharp as he peers at you. You'd guess that he must be at least 100 years old!

chatpoints.chat_text: Doesn't anybody knock now-a-days?

replies.reply_text: Sorry,  I didn't realize anyone lived here!
Well, if I had knocked, the door probably would have fallen down!
Oh, sorry, didn't mean to disturb you.  Bye.
I'm sorry. I'll go back out and try it again. (You walk back around the door and knock very gently, so it won't fall down.)
I'm sorry Flavius, I was just in such a hurry, I forgot to ask how you felt about the rug!  Linnea would like to know.
It's me, Flavius.  I just wanted to come say hi.
Uhm... hello, uhm... got a minute?
Hello, Flavius. I'll try to remember to knock in the future. In the meantime, I'm here to deliver a gift from Karee Dentin in Wington.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well someone does!  What do you want anyway?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, bye!
Ummm, I was just looking around and exploring a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Explorer, eh?  I used to do some exploring myself in my younger days.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Where did you go exploring?
I need to go explore some more now, too.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: All over these isles!  I was probably the first person to see  many of these islands!

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's impressive!
Nice... but right now I need to be the first person somewhere else!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heh, you don't know the half of it!  I know things about these isles no one else does!

replies.reply_text: Really?  Like what?
I'll bet you do, and when I have more time I'll come back, and you can tell me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Like hidden treasure, for one!

replies.reply_text: Treasure?  Where?
I've been all over, and never heard of you before or any hidden treasure!  See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now you don't think I'm going to tell the first young scamp who barges in my door where treasure would be buried, do you?

replies.reply_text: Well... I was hoping you would.
No, I suppose not.  Bye.
Why not?  Maybe I could find it and bring it to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: That door has been there for over 50 years and it hasn't fallen down yet!

replies.reply_text: Don't get so excited.  I'm leaving and I'll make sure I don't slam the door behind me!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Snorts) Yeah, I'll bet! But the treasure has been hidden for years! What makes you think you could find it?

replies.reply_text: You're right.  I guess I'll be going now.
Well, I could try!  You could at least give me a chance to find it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let's see what sort of mettle you're made of... I'll send you out on a small quest and see how you do.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm... Could we do this later?  I really have some other things to do right now.  Bye.
Okay, what do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let's see if you can follow directions.  Take this plate back to Sandra here on the isle and tell her thanks for the sandwich, it was delicious.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I guess I can do that.
Maybe later.  I don't feel like doing deliveries today.

chatpoints.chat_text: Be quick about it!  I'm old you know!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll hurry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not so fast!  You can follow directions, but how good are you at searching?

replies.reply_text: Well, pretty good I think...
No treasure yet?  I'm outta here, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sandra lives here on Dolphin Isle.  You'd better hurry, or I may change my mind about telling you where that treasure is!

replies.reply_text: Okay, back in a flash!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, did you give Sandra back her plate?

replies.reply_text: Where did Sandra live again?
Yes, no problem.
No, sorry, I forgot. I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good.  Well, it looks like you can follow directions!

replies.reply_text: Yep!  Now where is the treasure hidden?
Yeah, but I'm tired now.  I'll come back later, when I have time to find the treasure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you won't mind going to find my glasses, then.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I don't have time for all this.
Your glasses?  Hmmmm... Okay.  Where did you lose them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I took a walk today along the beach north of here.  I fell asleep under a palm tree.  I must have lost them there, because I don't remember having them when I came back home.

replies.reply_text: Could you be more specific? There are a lot of palm trees along the beach!
I don't like sand, it gets in my shoes!  You'd better find someone else, this is getting too hard.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know which palm tree!  If I knew, I'd go find them myself.  Are you good at searching or aren't you?

replies.reply_text: Okay!  Okay!  I'll go and see if I can find them.
You're being mean!  Bye!
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well? Did you find my glasses?

replies.reply_text: Not yet... Where did you lose them again?
Yes I did!  Here you go!
Not yet. I'll keep looking. (Run out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Bah!  I told you!  Somewhere near a palm tree on the beach north of here!  Now hurry up, I'm not getting any younger, you know!

replies.reply_text: Right... Palm tree... Beach, north... Be back soon!
I'm really getting tired of your attitude.  Find your own glasses!  BYE!
Thanks!  Now will you tell me where the treasure is?  Please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmphhh!  You sure are impatient, aren't you?  I'll tell you where the treasure is when I'm sure you're worthy!

replies.reply_text: I think you're just trying to make me do things for you, and there is no treasure!  I'm not going to be your go-fer anymore!
Well, what else do I have to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... I need to be sure you're honest.  I don't want to tell you where the treasure is, and have you keep it all for yourself!

replies.reply_text: I'm honest!
Well, I would keep it all for myself, so there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Prove it!  Here's $500.  Take it to Trixie at the General Store.  I need to pay off my account.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.
No treasure is worth all this.  I have to go.  Bye.
Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well?

replies.reply_text: Trixie said your account is now paid in full.
I'm sorry, I spent the money.  Could you give me more, please?
Where was I supposed to go again?

chatpoints.chat_text: No!  You'll have to earn $500 and pay Trixie yourself!  Now off with you!

replies.reply_text: Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Trixie at the General Store here on the island.  Now hurry up!

replies.reply_text: Okay I will, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, saves me a trip to town.... Well?  What are you waiting for?

replies.reply_text: Ummm... Nothing I guess... Bye.
You said you'd tell me where the hidden treasure was buried!

chatpoints.chat_text: What?!  Oh, that!  Ha ha ha!  There is no buried treasure!

replies.reply_text: What?  But you said...!
You are MEAN!  BYE!

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't honestly think there would be a treasure lying around for years and no one finding it, do you?

replies.reply_text: Well, you said there was!  And you made me do all those things for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heheheheh...  Yeah, I did have you running all over, didn't I?  Okay, well, the least I can do is give you a little something...

replies.reply_text: Well, yeah!  After all, I spent a long time doing everything you asked me to!
You had better!
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Glad you brought my glasses back.  Now, go away.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  Bye.
I'm sure they are yours!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in!

replies.reply_text: Good day to you, Sir!  I'm on a mission to distribute rugs to discerning persons who might appreciate them for their cheerful colors and...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Lurching to his feet.) Are you some kind of salesman? I don't want whatever you're selling. I've got all that I need. Why do you people always pester old men? Do I look like an easy sell?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I wouldn't sell these for a king's ransom! I wanted to give you a rug. They're really pretty, don't you think?

chatpoints.chat_text: Giving? This is some sort of ploy by Iona, isn't it?  I don't like to be beholden to anyone, especially a sanctimonious busybody like her.

replies.reply_text: Oh no, Sir, this is directly from Linnea, the rug maker. She just wants to make people happy with her rugs. Won't you please accept one?
Sancti-what-ius?   You're just like the rest.  Too snobby to take a gift.  I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... I don't know...

replies.reply_text: Don't you think a rug would look nice here in front of your fire? How about this nice bright <font color='#FF6600'>orange</font> and <font color='#FF0000'>red</font> one? Let's try it!
Gee, you're stubborn!  I don't think you deserve this rug after all.  Goodbye.
Oh, no!  This is completely free.  It's not really a gift if you pay for it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... I don't know what to say!  Sometimes I feel melancholy about how the world seems to be changing for the worse, but now something like this happens.  It's almost like I... (<i>Flavius heaves a little sigh.<i>)

replies.reply_text: Yes?
Blah, blah, blah... Whatever.  One down, two to go.
I'll pass that along to Linnea. Well, I must continue with my work.  I'll be sure to come back and visit you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh!  The rug person!  I thought you were Iona, barging in.  Well, it's nice to see you again!

replies.reply_text: Good to see you too!
It is nice to see you again, also! And I've brought you a gift from Karee Dentin. She's the new dentist in Wington and wants to give you a toothbrush.

chatpoints.chat_text: That depends.  For what?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Guru Wiseman's Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)
Oh, forget it, I won't take up any more of your time.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: And you want wisdom?  From me?!

replies.reply_text: Yes.
No.  Bye.
I don't, but Guru Wiseman does.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, right.  Okay.  I'll tell you the best wisdom I know.  Get out your commonplace book and write this down.  Ready?

replies.reply_text: Ready.
Got it, thanks.
That's wisdom?!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Grinning complacently.) Yes, if you think about it....

replies.reply_text: Right.  Okay.  Well, thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: What? Is this some sort of trickery? I don't like to be beholden to anyone. Why would anyone want to give me something?

replies.reply_text: No trickery. She just wants to introduce herself. In case you ever need a dentist, you'll know where to find one.
I'll be sure to tell her you said that. Have a good day!

npc_list.name: Gidget
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP11
npc_list.long_description: She is quite petite but has long blond hair and pointy little ears.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, um, how did you get in here?  Did I not hide my entrance well enough?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  I found it along with all the acorn shells.  Just like the ones you left by Leuko's nest!
I found it without too much difficulty.

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess I'll need to hide it better.  What can I do for you, now that you have barged in?

replies.reply_text: I would like Leuko's egg.  There were acorn shells outside her nest so we know you took it.
Leuko was worried about her egg and there is evidence near her nest that you have it.
Nothing.  I'll just leave.
I've been sent here by Kiah to retrieve a sacred jungle treasure that you took.

chatpoints.chat_text: What?!  Leuko's nest?  What would I be doing by Leuko's nest?

replies.reply_text: Apparently stealing her egg.  The question is, what would you want an eagle egg for?
Well, her egg is missing.  Do you know anything about that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, but it makes such a nice decoration.  I found it, by the way.  I didn't steal it.  It was on the ground.

replies.reply_text: Well, Leuko is worried about it.  Could I have it back please?
And you didn't think it might just belong to the nest up in the tree right above where the egg was?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wellll....

replies.reply_text: May I have it back please?  Leuko is very worried about it.
Hand it over!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I found an egg in that small forest.  I didn't know it belonged to anyone and it makes such a nice decoration.

replies.reply_text: Well, Leuko is very worried about it.  Could I have it back please?

chatpoints.chat_text: It makes such a nice decoration though....  Tell you what.  You find me something else for its place, and I'll give it back.

replies.reply_text: What?!?  It's not even your egg!  I'm not going to deal with this!  I guess Leuko will have to get her own egg back.
Fine.  What would you like instead?
All right.  I'll go get that and be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get the egg yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'll get right on that.
What did you want to replace Leuko's egg?
Here.  I got a beautiful easter egg for you.  May I have Leuko's egg now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see the Easter Bunny.  She always has bunches of eggs.

replies.reply_text: Oh right.  Okay.
Great.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  Look at my pretty egg!  Thanks!

replies.reply_text: I'm glad you like it, just remember not to go stealing others' eggs anymore.
I hear you've been "collecting" things again. Kiah tells me you have a sacred jungle treasure in your possession, and she'd like you to give it back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Kiah? (Is it your imagination, or did you just catch a glimpse of fear in the wood elf's eyes?) Umm... I don't know what she's talking about. I don't have any sacred jungle treasures.

replies.reply_text: Hmm, Kiah must have been mistaken. Sorry to have bothered you.
Are you sure about that? Very sure? Sure enough to be okay with me returning to Kiah to tell her as much?

chatpoints.chat_text: Um... well... I mean.... well.... I suppose that it's possible I might have something... (You see Gidget swallowing hard.)

replies.reply_text: Go on...

chatpoints.chat_text: I like to take walks and collect pretty things to decorate my home with, you know. And I've walked in the jungle before... There's so many pretty things there! And, well... anyway... I suppose I could have something special, but I don't know what it would be.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you show me what you've collected lately? Maybe it will stand out.
Well, if you don't know and I don't know, then how am I supposed to take back the right thing? I give up. Bye...

chatpoints.chat_text: Good idea! On my last walk through the jungle, I only brought back two things. Let me grab them. (Gidget disappears into a back room. You hear some rummaging around and a large crash. You're about to ask if everything is all right when Gidget returns with two small objects.) Here they are. This first one is some sort of rock. I liked it because of the swirly pattern of the stone. This other one looks like some sort of nut. I liked it because of it's unique heart shape. Which one do you think it is?

replies.reply_text: I have a feeling that it's the rock. The swirly pattern on it makes it seem special somehow...
I think it's the nut. It's certainly a strange object, and Kiah is certainly... well.... strange.
Absolutely, I will.
Absolutely, I will.

npc_list.name: Viola
npc_list.long_description: A small, stoutly built woman with a quick smile and gentle manner.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dear me child, come in, come in!

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, thanks.  I was just looking around.
Thanks, I will.
Hello again, Viola.  I just popped in to see how you are doing and if you might need anything.
I'm sorry, but what was I getting again?
Hello, I'm back!
I gave you those thimbleberries.  Was there anything else you needed?
Thank you. (Brrrrrr...)
That ruby certainly stands out in all this snow.
Hi there. I'm looking for a bucket.
Hi, Viola.  Sorry to be a pest, but I forgot where it was your nephews lived...
Hi Viola, listen... Karl said that Waldo's bucket is here.

chatpoints.chat_text: You must be cold.  Come sit by the fire and get warm.  I don't have much, but you're welcome to whatever I have.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  Just getting warm for a while would be nice.
I'm feeling warmer now.  I think I'll be going.
Actually, this time I have something for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're welcome.  I'm glad you stopped by, I don't get very many visitors.

replies.reply_text: I imagine not!  You're so far away from everyone.
I suppose so.  I should be heading out now.  Thanks for the hospitality.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, well, even though I do like company from time to time, I like my privacy also.

replies.reply_text: I guess I can understand that.  Umm, is there anything I can do for you?
I can understand that.  I'll be leaving now and thanks for the chat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's so nice of you to offer.  Actually, I could use some more apples.  I usually get them from the general store on Ice Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can run over there and get those for you.
Actually, I was heading the other direction. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thanks.  That would be such a big help!  Just talk to Windy at the store.  She usually has a bushel held back for me.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
Hmmm... Maybe I can get those for you another time.  Bye.
Okay, I'll hurry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, there you are and back so quickly, too!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Here are the apples you wanted.
Could you tell me again where I was supposed to go?
What was it I was doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ice Isle.  Go see Windy at the general store.  Better hurry, I heard there was a storm coming.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed you to get me a bushel of apples from Windy at the general store on Ice Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right!  Okay, I'll go do that right now.
Okay. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's so lovely to see you again.  Sit by the fire and warm yourself.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I am a bit chilly.  If there's nothing you need, then I'll be going.  Bye!
Thanks, that fire is nice and cozy!  I was just wondering if you need me to get any more apples... or anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, there is something.  I was going over my grandmother's recipe file and I found a recipe that I haven't had since childhood.  Since I found her old recipe, I've really been craving it.

replies.reply_text: That's really swell, but I've warmed up, so I'll be going.  Goodbye!
Your grandmother's recipe?  What is the recipe for?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's for my most favorite treat when I was a little girl.  Grandma's Homemade Thimbleberry Jam!

replies.reply_text: Thimbleberry Jam?  That's it?  You got all worked up over some jam?  I've gotta go now, it's been nice.  Bye!
So I take it you want me to go find you some thimbleberry jam?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, child, I don't want somebody else's thimbleberry jam, I want to make my grandma's jam.

replies.reply_text: So, go ahead and make her jam... I'll stop by the next time I'm around.
Okay, what can I do to help you with that?
Sure, I can do that!  I'll be back as soon as I gather up all the berries.

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to gather 50 thimbleberries for me, so I can make my grandma's jam.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I forgot.  I'll be back as soon as I gather up all the berries.
Glad they meet your requirements.  Do you need anything else for the jam?
Gee, thanks!  And I certainly will stop back for some of that jam.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  What a surprise!  I certainly wasn't expecting anything.

replies.reply_text: Oops - actually, I forgot it.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
Do you remember Jade Maki?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  We were great friends years ago, but I've lost track of her since I came to Berg Isle.  Did Jade send you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, she wanted to send you a necklace with your birthstone.  Here it is.
Thanks for the pie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it makes me feel warm just to look at it.

replies.reply_text: In this weather, I'm sure every little bit helps.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bucket, dear?

replies.reply_text: Yes. Waldo, I'm sure you know him, yes? He's lost his bucket. He says someone took it. (You describe the bucket.)
Sorry, never mind, I'm going somewhere warmer.

chatpoints.chat_text: A blue bucket?  Hmmm...  Well, I wouldn't know about...  Oh, wait.  Hmmm.  My nephews were up here a few days ago and I think... but no, they're good boys, they wouldn't take an old walrus' bucket.

replies.reply_text: But they might have seen it.  Where are they now?
If you say so.  I guess this is a dead end, then.  Thanks anyway.  Bye.
Too bad they don't live closer.  Thanks, I'll go see what they know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well, Karl lives in Whiskerton, and Zeke lives in Witherton.  Or is it the other way around?  No, no, I think that's it.  Yes.  Karl in Wither... Whiskerton, and Zeke in Witherton.

replies.reply_text: Uh, right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did he?  Well... I certainly don't remember having Waldo's bucket, but... what did it look like again?

replies.reply_text: It was... Well, it was blue and... (You look around and notice a bright blue bucket underneath Viola's cabin sink!) It looked like that one there!

chatpoints.chat_text: That one?  Is that one blue?  They tell me I'm colorblind, you see, but how would I know?  That one under the sink?  It doesn't need to be there anymore, I fixed the leak. Karl said he would, but he forgot.  Just a moment.

replies.reply_text: It should say "Waldo" on the bottom.
Okay, I'll wait.
Thanks so much!  I'll get this Waldo right away!

npc_list.name: Greig
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 19
npc_list.long_description: Greig is wearing a pair of glasses, has another pair hanging around his neck, and he is wearing a third pair on top of his head! Silly man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello there.  Come in, have a seat.

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks.
No thanks.  I should really be on my way.
Oh, I found this note!  It had almost been lost under your floorboards!
Thanks!  I just stopped by to pick up Olav's reeds, are they ready yet?
Oh, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: So, what brings you to this nice little patch of forest?

replies.reply_text: Oh, just exploring.
I was on my way to Hoof Isle and took a shortcut through the forest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  An explorer!  How exciting.  You wouldn't be able to help me with something, would you?  Being the explorer you are and such.

replies.reply_text: Oh, umm..  I didn't really say I was an explorer, just that I was exploring...  and I think I'll continue on my way.  Bye.
Of course I can help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  Hoof Isle is such a nice little place.

replies.reply_text: Great to hear.  Well, best be on my way.  Bye!
I don't need to go there quite yet.  Is there anything you needed while I'm here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually yes.  I am quite forgetful you see, and I'm afraid I've lost something.

replies.reply_text: I can find it for you.  What did you lose?
Ick, I hate searching for things.  Nevermind.  I guess I will head straight to Hoof Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  I am quite forgetful you see, and I'm afraid I've lost something.

replies.reply_text: I can try and find it for you.  What did you lose?
Ick, I hate searching for things.  Nevermind.  Good luck finding whatever it is you lost!  Bye.
All right, I'll go start searching.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there.  Come in, sit down.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Didn't you want me to find something for you?
Thanks!  I haven't found your glasses yet.  Sorry.  I'll go look some more.
I found your glasses!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah, that's right.  My glasses.  How'd that go, by the way?

replies.reply_text: Haven't found them yet.  I'll get right on that.
Where was I looking again?
I found them!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a cotton patch north of here.  North of the ranches too.  I think I lost them in the middle while I was picking cotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll go look for them.
You're welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Come on in and sit down.  Haven't I seen you before?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  I'm heading out.  Bye.
Yeah...  I found your glasses for you.
Yep.  Anyway, I just stopped by to pick up Olav's reeds, are they ready yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's right.  Of course.  Would you be able to find something else for me?  You did so well last time.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  What did you lose this time?
No, I really am not great at searching for things.  Finding your glasses was all luck.  Hopefully someone else can find them.  Bye.
Well, I'll take a look and see what I can find.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Come in and sit down.

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for something for you...  aren't I?
I should get back out and look for your watch.  Bye.
Oh, I found your watch!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm.. let me think..  Oh, of course!  My watch!  Have you found it yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'll go look some more.
Where was I supposed to look again?
I have.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there's a larger pond that I was fishing at to the west of here.  There are a lot of weeds though, so I hope you have a rake.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I do.  Thanks.
You're welcome, and thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in.  Have a seat!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Haven't lost anything else lately, have you?
No thanks.  I should be on my way.
Oh, I found this note!  It had almost been lost under your floorboards!
Thanks!  I just stopped by to pick up Olav's reeds, are they ready yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's right.  You helped find my watch and glasses.  No, I haven't lost anything else.  Thanks again for your help.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav?  Do I know anyone named Olav?

replies.reply_text: Olav the roofer?  He used to live on Ice Isle, now he lives near Hotton....anything??

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav?  Olav....Oh yes, my old friend Olav!  Now why did he send you?

replies.reply_text: (Sighing) Olav asked me to pick up the reeds you've collected for him.
Thanks, I'll let Olav know.  Good bye!

npc_list.name: Azmaguru
npc_list.long_description: Azmaguru is short and gnarled like an old tree root. With bright feathers in his hair and a tribal tattoo under his eye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Grunts, peering at you curiously.)

replies.reply_text: (You look nervously at one of the skulls.) Um...hello?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, explorer. You want something from Azmaguru?

replies.reply_text: No, that's all right.  I think I'll just be going now.
Yes, Witherton Jones sent me for the statue of Tumetai.
Yes, if it's not too much trouble, can you tell me about the Lost Ring of the Tumetai?
Well, I was wondering if there was anything I could do for you?
I forgot.  What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with your necklace!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhh, the statue of Tumetai. First, Adventurer you must prove yourself worthy to hold such treasures. Which do I have?

replies.reply_text: The amethyst statue.
The emerald statue.
The gold statue.
The silver statue.
The topaz statue.

chatpoints.chat_text: And of what creature is my statue?

replies.reply_text: It's an anaconda.
It's an egg.
It's a gorilla.
It's a sloth.
It's a tarantula.

chatpoints.chat_text: Finally, what element does my statue represent?

replies.reply_text: Air
Earth
Fire
Spirit
Water

chatpoints.chat_text: I regret, I cannot give you the statue. Would you like another attempt, perhaps?

replies.reply_text: No, thank you, that's quite all right.
Yes, please. I believe I have the right answer this time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Very well, what material is my statue made of?

replies.reply_text: Amethyst
Emerald
Gold
Silver
Topaz

chatpoints.chat_text: And of what creature is my statue?

replies.reply_text: It's an anaconda.
It's an egg.
It's a gorilla.
It's a sloth.
It's a tarantula.

chatpoints.chat_text: Finally, what element does my statue represent?

replies.reply_text: Air
Earth
Fire
Spirit
Water
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome once more to my hut.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.
Thank you. I was wondering if you know about the Lost Ring of the Tumetai?
Hello.  I was wondering if there was anything I could do for you?
I forgot.  What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with your necklace!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know of the ring, of course. All Tumetai do. But you are not Tumetai, so the ring does not concern you. Anyways, it's lost, and I do not know where it is.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well... okay then. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: There is, if you so choose. I require another necklace created in representation of my tribal position. My Honor Necklace. I cannot leave my people at the moment as I need to prepare for the ceremony. Would you be willing to fetch it for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure I can do that for you!  What position did you get?
Not right now, old man.  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is no matter to you. My Honor Necklace must be made by a non traditional jewelry maker and she knows what I need. You will not find her in a store on the main isles.

replies.reply_text: On second thought, this sounds complicated!  Forget it.
Okay.  That shouldn't be too hard.  Where should I look for your necklace maker?
Gee, thanks for being all cryptic.  I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have agreed to find the maker for my Honor Necklace. Please bring it back soon because I need it for the ceremony in a few days.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I remember now but can you give me a hint where I need to go?
