Hail, Majesty!  I have received instructions from the Choclatier Royal!  I go forth to carry them out! Might it please you to send me back to Sir Slate's?
Your Majesty's Chocolate Garden is underway, my liege.  May I return to Grey Slate now?
Hail, my Liege!  I have returned to your Sceptered Isle.
Hail, my Lord King!  I've come with a request from Princess Lilianna.
My Liege, I have come to petition you for the use of the Choclatier Royal's services!
Hail Majesty! I have returned with the Struffoli and milk you requested!
My Liege, what did you want in order to allow me use of the Choclatier Royal's services?
Your Majesty, I have a delivery from the honorable Royal Chef Cara Cook of Bird Isle.  Please receive her fare of Quail and Truffles.
My Liege, I beg a moment of your time.
My Liege, I was wondering if there were any tasks you might like for me to perform?
What was I doing for you again?
My Liege, I return with your heart's desire.  I have with me the Turkish Delight that you requested.
Your Majesty, where was that sheep again?

(You find it hard to explain precisely what you're doing here.) Your Majesty, I come here as, uh... as emissary from the Great Knight Sir McAzure Gonagall! He sent me with his application; wants to be your poet laureate.
Hello, Your Majesty. This is a long shot, but I don't suppose you remember once meeting a boy called Dalton?
Excuse me, Your Majesty, but could you remind me please how you suggest I could get in touch with Dalton's dragon friend?
Thank you, sir. I'll deliver this envelope to Grey Slate. (This guy's off his rocker!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (King Phil sets aside a map of Hotzeplotz--and you notice the word "TREASURE" and several X's marked thereupon.) Well, young Errant; now that you are here in the land of Hotzeplotz, surely there is some question I can answer?

replies.reply_text: Actually, yes, there is.  How did you collect all these wonderful white animals?
No, thank you, my liege.  I must return to Grey Slate as quickly as may be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Collect?  Not at all!  All these lovely creatures were inhabitants of this isle when I bought the place!  They are my loyal subjects.

replies.reply_text: That's very interesting!  I wonder why that would happen.  Are any of these creatures ever for sale, might one enquire?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did I not just say, Errant, that these are my loyal subjects? Sell my subjects? Never! Though from time to time, perhaps I might, with their consent of course, give one as a Royal Gift.

replies.reply_text: I crave your pardon, my liege.  I assure you, I meant no offense.
Don't be so touchy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, you may.  In fact, I would encourage you to take this opportunity.  You know, I don't allow visitors to return to my island, well, unless they can cook.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  I'll return when I'm ready to leave.
On second thought, sire, I think I will return to Grey Slate now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Is there anything else you would like to know or do before I send you back?  Remember, Errant--once you have left Hotzeplotz, you may not return!

replies.reply_text: No, I'm ready to go back now.
Might I have Your Majesty's leave to explore his Splendid Isle for a short while?

chatpoints.chat_text: And no digging up any buried treasure while you're out wandering. Not that there is any. But it's my island, remember, so if you find anything, remember, it's mine!

replies.reply_text: I shall certainly keep that in mind.  Good day to you, my lord.

chatpoints.chat_text: (King Phil stands up and shoos away the creatures.) Have you... uh... found something, by any chance, while you were wandering?

replies.reply_text: Me?  Nope.  Nothing.
Yes, King Phil.  I found this.

chatpoints.chat_text: You found a treasure?  On my island, yet?!

replies.reply_text: No!  Just some... rocks.  And things... you know, like you find on any beach.
Alright, I did find a treasure. Finders-keepers!
Yes, I found a treasure.  I'll sell it to you for $20,000.
Yes, my liege.  I found this.  And as you are the ruler of Hotzeplotz, I lay it in the hands of its rightful owner.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just some rocks, eh?

replies.reply_text: Just rocks.  Surely I can keep rocks, can't I?
Well, okay, I found a treasure.  But... Finders-keepers, right?
Hey!  But, I found it!  I....

chatpoints.chat_text: (King Phil gives you a sidelong glance.) I think it's time for you to go home and pay my brother already.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Please send me back to Grey Slate now.
Thank you, my lord King!  Long may you reign!
I'll do that!
Now it's time for me to leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: Knight of Hotzeplotz, return here every once in a while.  You never know; maybe some day I will have a quest for you to do!

replies.reply_text: I will, Sire!  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you doing here?!  How dare you trespass upon my private lands!

replies.reply_text: But I was only... I didn't mean...

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, Sir... whatever your name was.  How's by you these days?

replies.reply_text: Fine.  It's all fine, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Candide?  Who's Candide, and what does he want with my Golden Sheep already?

replies.reply_text: He'd like to have it back. He lost it in a storm at sea.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... he can't have it! The sheep is mine, end of story.

replies.reply_text: Okay... I guess... Can you just send me back to Grey Slate, then?
All right, who am I to argue? Thank you for your time. Good-bye.
Isn't there anything I can do to change your mind? That sheep was a special gift to Candide from the Prince of Eldorado. Surely there is something I can do to change your mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: Your story has touched my simple heart. I can understand the pain of losing a treasure. I will allow you to take the sheep only if you bring me a treasure of equal value.

replies.reply_text: I will do my best to bring you whatever treasure you desire, Your Majesty.
(Cough.) Bagels and knishes? In exchange for a Golden Sheep? Absolutely! Can you just send me back to Grey Slate?
Where is the sheep, Your Majesty?
Thank you! (You bow on your way out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Gifts? Who's gonna be sendin' me gifts?

replies.reply_text: It is from Grey Slate, Your Majesty. It is a beautiful, heavy, and very tall menorah.
Wow, thanks, Your Majesty! Could you please send me back now?
Thank you, Your Majesty! I am going to look around the island for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  You're just the person.  You are to go to Theobroma Isle, just south of here, and put yourself at the disposal of my Chocolatier Royal.

replies.reply_text: Mmmm!  Chocolate!  Yes, my liege, I will be delighted to be of service.
No thanks, I'm just here visiting.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah-HA!  Just the person I wanted to see!  I've got a job for you!

replies.reply_text: Uh, no thanks.
I am at your command, Your Majesty.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wish you to put yourself at the disposal of Emma, the Chocolatière Royal.  I will send you to her.

replies.reply_text: Yes, my Lord King.  I will go at once.  Please send me thither forthwith.
No thanks, chocolate gives me zits.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you have, eh?  And what does that ditzy kid want now?

replies.reply_text: She's to be married to Prince Anuran---

chatpoints.chat_text: Prince "Anuran?"  Oh, honestly... Sheesh!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I know. But she likes him. And if I may say so, Sire, there will be very few arguments in this marriage.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, right, like anyone could have gotten a word in anyway!  Oh well, what does the kid want from her kindly old uncle this time?

replies.reply_text: She would like a carriage, drawn by a four-in-hand of your finest white horses.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(King Phil smacks his forehead with his palm.) Oy, that kid! Carriage?! Since when have I got a carriage, of all the...
And a four-in-hand? The only thing my horses have ever pulled in their life is a face! They're riding horses, not cart horses!

replies.reply_text: So... Do I tell her you can't do it, then?
But your Majesty, it's her wedding!
I thank Your Majesty.  I'll deliver that message at once.  Might I please be sent back to Grey Slate?

chatpoints.chat_text: You have, eh? Well, I think that I might be granted that, if you do something for me first.

replies.reply_text: Geez, this is getting complicated. Never mind - just send me back please!
(Sighs) I shoulda known. What would you like me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: What I would really like is some struffoli and fresh milk. Ha! Now there's a culinary delight!

replies.reply_text: Struffoli? And milk? Yeah - that's what I'd have expected a king to ask for (snickers). Where would I find this culinary delight?
That's the lamest request I've ever heard. Just send me back now.  This is too much work for me.
Okay, thanks.  Could you send me back to Grey Slate?
Okay.  Well, I have something I want to check out here first quick, then I'll head out.

chatpoints.chat_text: What I would really like is some struffoli and fresh milk.  I heard there's this lady who has cows and fresh milk.  Why don'tcha see if she can tell ya where to get the struffoli?

replies.reply_text: Okay, sounds good.  Could you send me back to Grey Slate?
Okay.  Well, I have something I want to check out here first quick, then I'll head out.
It is an honor to bring this delivery to you, your Royal Highness.  I'll just look around some then head out.  Bye.
It is an honor.  Could you send me to Grey Slate please?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looking up and noticing Alfred and his camera, he smiles broadly, and waves.) Hi, Ma!

replies.reply_text: My Liege?
Your Majesty...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Hello there, my loyal Knight!  You wanted something, already?

replies.reply_text: Yes, my Liege.  I am on a quest.

chatpoints.chat_text: What the greased pig are you doing back here?

replies.reply_text: Begging Your Majesty's pardon, I am on a quest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh-ho!   You and everybody else on these islands!  What is it this time?

replies.reply_text: It's a long story, Your Majesty, but I am in search of Jet Black fabric.  For curtains, you see.
Oh, forget it, this is just too weird.  I can't cope anymore.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah.  Jet black... curtains.  Oh well, to each his own, I suppose.... Nah, I ain't got nothin' like that around here.

replies.reply_text: Rats.  I was told that this Jet Black color is so... black, I guess, that only Royalty would have it.  Do you know of anyone who might have it?
Okay, well, thanks anyway, Your Majesty.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmmmm.... Let me think......  You know, I remember seeing somebody on... hmmmm... maybe it was Pirate?  No!  It was Lava!  Yeah!  Somebody... Ah!  This weird mage kind of guy.  He had black robes on, maybe you can ask him where he got them.

replies.reply_text: You wouldn't happen to know where on Lava, would you?
Uh oh.... I dimly begin to see where this is leading.  Thanks.  I'm going to go get this over with...  Can you poof me out of here, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Know?  How am I supposed to know?  He's a wandering mage, he wanders, already!  Just go to Lava and ask around, I'm sure somebody's seen the guy.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do.  Can you send me back off the island now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hunh.  Well, now that you mention it, Patricia Plum makes the best Turkish Delight.  She's in Appleton, you know.  Now how's about you go and get me some from her?

replies.reply_text: Not right now, I can come back and help later.
Okay, I can help you with that.
I will see you when I get back.
It is an honor to be of service to you, my Liege.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you mean, what were you doing?  You don't know?  How am I supposed to know?  Well, as it happens, I do know!  You were getting me Turkish Delight from Patricia Plum in Appleton, already!

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.
All right.  Could you send me back please?
Oh wow, this really isn't sounding good for him... thanks for your time, Your Majesty, I'll deliver this right quick.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Dalton! Of course I remember that boy. Isn't just anybody who goes gadding about on a dragon!

replies.reply_text: A dragon?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Isn't that what I just said? I passed him in a sailing ship once, and he was sittin' up on that dragon's tail, pleased as punch!

replies.reply_text: Wow! I don't suppose you'd know where I could find this dragon? I have reason to believe he could help Dalton.
I know the one you mean. Thanks, King Phil!
I have no idea which dragon Your Majesty means... but I'm sure I can find him.

npc_list.name: Old Dude
npc_list.long_description: The horse who stands before you was once an elegant Hunter, but now his brown face is flecked with grey, and his back sags a bit. He eyes you curiously when you approach, slowly switching his tail and visibly eyeing your buckets.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Old Dude reaches out his great head, and eagerly sniffs your pockets--and your ears. You realize that a horse nose near your ear can create quite a bit of suction on your eardrum!)

replies.reply_text: Hello there.  How are you, old fellow?  Here, have a treat!
Hello, old fellow.  You look happy here.  Bye now!
Aren't you a fine old gentleman?  Hello, boy.  You look happy.
Hi fellow, I brought you an apple!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Old Dude reaches out his head and sniffs your hand.)

replies.reply_text: Would you like a carrot?
Would you like these daisies?
Would you like these flowers?
Would you like an apple?
Sorry, I don't have anything for you.  Bye!
There you go!  That was good, wasn't it?  Bye now!
Oh, well, maybe I'll try something else, then.
Good man.

npc_list.name: Old Ellie
npc_list.long_description: Old Ellie, in her day, was a magnificent Arabian.  Now, in her dowager years, the crispness of her blaze has disappeared, and her once luxurious mane is now short, although its flaxen roots still show.  Her coat is still a lovely red chestnut, through, and with all her white markings, she must have been a feast for the eyes in her younger days.

chatpoints.chat_text: (If anything, Old Ellie reminds you of a very large puppy. She wanders up to you, and greets you as if she'd like nothing more than to curl up in your lap.)

replies.reply_text: Hello, there, old girl, how are you?  Can I offer you something to eat?
Hi, Ellie.  How are you today, sweetheart?
Look at you!  Good girl!  Aren't you a beauty!
Hello, gorgeous! I've brought you an apple!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Old Ellie rubs her head up and down on the side of your arm. She seems so happy to have a soft place to rub her eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Would you like some daisies?
Would you like an apple?
Would you like a carrot?
Would you like these flowers?
There you go, old girl.  Maybe I'll bring you some more sometime, okay?
Sorry, old girl, I was sure I'd had something you liked.  Next time.
You're a star, old girl.

npc_list.name: Old Kate
npc_list.long_description: Old Kate is a golden mare, and even in her dowager years, her dun Teke coat glitters in the sunlight.  She regards you with an almost imperious friendliness, and is soon sniffing your hands and face and rummaging through your hair with her lips.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The dun mare then presents her shoulder for you to scratch as she investigates your pockets.)

replies.reply_text: Hi, there, old girl!  How are you? Would you like a treat?
Good to see you again, old girl.
Ooo!  Look at you!  Hi there, girl!  What a lovely golden girl you are!
Hi Kate! I brought you an apple!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Old Kate presents her back for you to scratch. Her dun stripe is still clearly visible, running straight from her mane to her tail.)

replies.reply_text: Would you like these daisies?
Would you like a carrot?
Would you like these flowers?
Would you like an apple?
Sorry, I don't have anything for you.
There you go, old girl.  Maybe I'll bring you some more sometime, okay?  Bye!
You sure I can't convince you?  Oh, well...  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She snorts, shakes her mane, and gets back to her grass.)

replies.reply_text: Bye, girl.
Good girl.

npc_list.name: Old Decaf
npc_list.long_description: Old Decaf, no doubt named for his cafe-au-lait color and evident easygoing temperament, is the old, faithful, bomb-proof horse you have to love. He sports a big blaze, at the top of which you can still discern, through the advancing grey, a mark in the shape of a shamrock. He gazes at you with the aire of having seen it all, and wondering which of his favorite treats you might happen to be carrying.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The grand old man with a big white blaze eyes you curiously as you advance.)

replies.reply_text: Hello, old fellow.  How are you?  You look well.  Would you like a treat?
Hi, there Decaf.  Just came for a visit.
Hi there, you good old gent. I brought you an apple!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The grand old man reaches toward you for a sniff.)

replies.reply_text: Would you like these carrots?
Would you like an apple?
Would you like these daisies?
Would you like these flowers?
Sorry, I don't have anything for you.  Bye!
Those are good, eh, boy?  You like them?  I'll try to bring you more.
Oh, well... Can't be friends with everyone.
You're a good man.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Donna takes off her baseball hat and wipes her brow with her sleeve.) So! Anything I can do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Yes, there is.  I realize you're busy, but could you possibly fit my horses in somewhere?  They need a rest.
No, thanks, I can see you're busy. I'll let you get back to work.
Actually, it looks like you could use some help yourself!  Is there anything you need, or need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Donna chuckles.) Many horses are! So Santa boards them elsewhere.

replies.reply_text: Very wise.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes! It's always busy around here. (Donna shakes her head and smiles.) Every year, little kids ask Santa for ponies, and he boards them here until they can be delivered. So it's always busy.

replies.reply_text: You mean, these ponies are... Wow!  There are some lucky kids out there!
Uh oh!  My horses are afraid of ponies!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Welcome to Crystalton Livery.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. Just looking around.
My goodness, it looks busy around here!
Hay delivery?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Howdy! I'm hoping you've got some empty feed sacks that I could take off your hands. I need to make some sandbags.
Hello there! I've brought a bow to be fixed. Curtis tells me you have the best horse hair around to do the job.
Hello, again! I'm wondering if that bow is done and how much I owe you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear, yes there is! (Donna's face lights up in a brilliant smile.) What I need more than anything is to stock up on hay and bedding! Would you be willing to bring these to me?

replies.reply_text: Nnnnno, sorry, I don't do deliveries.  Bye now!
Sure!  What do you need, and how much?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, first of all, of course, I need hay!  Nothing fancy, just baled, plain hay.  I can only get my help to stack it if you bring 25 bales, but I will pay you $3,000 for every 25 bales you bring me.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm allergic to hay as it is, sad to say.
No problem!  What else do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need bedding, too.  We use coconut husks, the outer, stringy part makes a nice soft bedding, and makes a new pony smell wonderful under the tree!  Now, again, I need these in bulk.  I will pay you $750 for every 25 coconuts you bring me.

replies.reply_text: Now that's an interesting use for coconuts!  Sure, I can bring those!
Coconuts?!  As horse bedding?  No way!   Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you so much!

replies.reply_text: Will do!  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hay Delivery!  Yes!  Have you got what I needed?

replies.reply_text: Yes, right here!
Uhm... Who, me?  No, I just thought... Never mind.  It's just so busy here, got a little confused.
Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing.  Just choose whichever horse needs a rest and I can accomodate them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, she mentioned that.  Has she gotten started on it, do you know?

replies.reply_text: It's going well!  In fact, she's asked me to ask the other liveries if they've got any spare feed tubs or buckets.  Would you...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, spare... nnnnno, not really.  But I have this very nice large, new tub that doesn't exactly fit in my stalls.  If you think she can use it, I'll sell it for $150.  Bought it for much more.

replies.reply_text: No, that's too much.  I'll keep looking, thanks.
Okay, that's a good deal.
I'll get this back to her!  Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I do have some. I could sell them for $100 a piece. How many do you require?

replies.reply_text: Ouch! I think I'll look elsewhere. Thanks anyways.
I need half a dozen. So that would be $600? Okay, I've got the money and I need to get this done. I'll take them!
Thank you so much! And have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hate bragging, but I do! Strong, white horsetail hair is the best. Most people don't know this, but rehairing bows is a family tradition. I'd be happy to fix that bow for Curtis. He is such a talented young man.

replies.reply_text: Here you go! Should I wait around for it or will it take awhile?
Awesome. I'll be back in a few minutes.

chatpoints.chat_text: No charge! I believe in supporting the arts and that entire family is musical.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I'll get this to Curtis ASAP. Have a lovely day.

npc_list.name: Seamus Schooner
npc_list.long_description: Seamus Schooner has the look of someone who's been at his job for so long that he does it almost automatically.  He is the very model of an old time Old Salt. He even keeps a pipe in his mouth--although obviously he's never used it as anything except a prop!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Harbormaster's office is almost a museum of maritime artifacts. A large bell hangs over the desk, with a tag on it reading, "Ring For Service.")

replies.reply_text: Hello! Anybody here? (You ring the bell and immediately clap your hands to your ears, wishing you hadn't!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Eventually Harbormaster Schooner comes waddling out of his office.) Aye, now what might you be wanting?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, I was just wondering what a Harbormaster's Office looked like.  I'll be going now.  Bye.
I'm trying to get to Half Haven, but I don't see a regularly scheduled boat...
Could I get passage to Half Haven again, please?
I have a package for you, Sir.
Mr Schooner! Good to see you. Do you have a few moments to answer a question or two?
I'm trying to find a metalworker here in Shellton.  Do you know who I'm supposed to see?
Iona sent me here to find a quilter. Would you know who that is?

chatpoints.chat_text: Half Haven, eh?  Well, there is no regular service there, do y'see? Very rough seas there, by Half Haven.  I don't send a boat there unless I have to, see?  Now if you have business there, I might go, for a price.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.  Maybe I don't want to go there.  I get seasick easily.  Thanks anyway.
I really would like to go to Half Haven, if it could be arranged.

chatpoints.chat_text: It'll cost you $400 for me to bring you there an' back m'self.  That acceptable to ye?

replies.reply_text: That sounds fair.
Hmmm.... Don't think I can afford it, sorry.  Bye.
Thanks.
Thanks, and good luck with the new wheel!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Schooner looks up and considers.) I might do, yes. What is it y' want?

replies.reply_text: I'm interested in the current flows on the water hereabouts.  You see, I, uhm, lost something on the water and was wondering where it might have floated off to.
Oh, nothing.  Sorry to waste your time.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Currents, is it?  Well, that thar's a complicated subject, that is, and if I'm to be telling you about, you'd better be getting pencil and paper and writing this all down!  Better yet, make y'self a map!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. I've already spend way too much time pursuing this today. I'll have to come back another day.
I take it this is one of your favorite subjects!  Well, I'm ready, go ahead.

chatpoints.chat_text: There're two main currents amongst all these here small isles.  One comes in from the south, around the Lava Isles. T'other one, that comes in from the nor'east, round both sides of Whorl Isle.  Y'got that?

replies.reply_text: Got it.  Please go on.

chatpoints.chat_text:
The current what comes from the south side of Whorl divides, y'see, when it hits Hotzeplotz. That's why there's this huge whirlpool between Hotzeplotz and Whorl.
The northern branch of that current, now that hits that whirlpool area, and gets deflected through the strait between Hotzeplotz and Eldorado. Now there's a nasty passage in a storm, I can tell you!

replies.reply_text: I'm taking notes.  Please go on.
This is already too complicated.  Perhaps some other time.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that current goes up the east side of Bone, y'see, an' splits at the north end.  Some goes north of Atropos, and the rest goes whirling clockwise around Paradise.  Ever'thing north of Gavin's island just goes northwest, foll'in' Saddle's coast, 'cept one bit what goes east 'round where they say the 'girth' of the island is.

replies.reply_text: Got that.  Now, current that comes up from the south?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, that there's a much more powerful current! Just shoots everything north around the whole area between here and Nonesuch. Lots and lots of eddies, too, especially between Lilac and Rock and between Haven and Serenity. But the worst of the eddies are between Haven and Crescent. If you've got any brains at all, you don't take no boat out there! It's just insane.
Everything else just sort of flows north and west like it gave up trying to decide what to do and is just trying to escape. Oh, and there's a pretty rough area between Loch and Hotzeplotz that's worth avoiding, if you ask me.

replies.reply_text: I think that covers everything.  I'm off to hunt for flotsam and jetsam.  Bye, and thanks!
Got it.  So, if I were out looking for something that, say, broke up on Lilac and floated off, where would you think the best places to look might be?
I will.  Thanks for all your help!  Bye!
Great!  While I'm here, can you take me to Half Haven Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, ho!  That depends, d'y'see!  Depends if the tide's a-comin' or a-goin' don't it?   An' I'll tell you this, wherever the current is fast, or where there's a whirlpool like east of Hotzeplotz, you won't find nothin' unless there's been a storm.

replies.reply_text: Do you know of any places that are... known for things washing up?
Oh, what was I thinking?  This all sounds way too complicated.  I think I'll go home and fry the napkins.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's easy enough. Earl Bronze has gotten himself quite the reputation for his ironwork lately.  You'll find him at the Blacksmith's.

replies.reply_text: The Blacksmith's?  Makes sense, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You must mean Leasa. She makes some really original quilts.  She lives in Shell Forest.

replies.reply_text: Shell Forest?  Thanks for your help!

npc_list.name: Mabel
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS, full; please use the next Mabel
npc_list.long_description: Ms Mabel is terribly old, but she has bright eyes and a keen expression. You sense a good bit of impishness, only barely kept in check by a sense of propriety. She sits in a comfy chair, wearing, under a serviceable dressing gown, a scarlet kimono embroidered with dragons.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, do come in.  Tell me what brings you all the way out here.

replies.reply_text: Nothing, really, just looking around.
Ms. Mabel, I've come for your help regarding the theft of the "Star of Solomon" Sapphire.
Hello Ms. Mabel!  With your help, I've solved the mystery of the "Star of Solomon."
Sorry, Ms. Mabel, but... I got sidetracked, and I forgot what I was supposed to do...
I'm looking for information on the triumph of Sam McGee. Do you know anything about it?
I've come bearing a gift! Karee Dentin from Wington wants everyone to know she's available for dental care.
Hi there!  I'm trying to track down a woman named either Miss Knight or Miss Bishop ... or maybe Miss Castle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  Well, you must sit down here and tell me everything you know about the case.  I want to know every detail.

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, I wanted to solve it on my own.
(You carefully tell Ms. Mabel everything you have learned so far about the theft of the "Star of Solomon.") And that's all I really know at the moment.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, really!  That is an extraordinary thing to do, to come here and just tell me that.  Well, it was interesting meeting you.  Good-bye.

replies.reply_text: Good-bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ms. Mabel thinks over what you've told her for a long time.) Might I see that piece of cloth?

replies.reply_text: Certainly.  I have it here.  I think it might be part of the thief's jacket.
No, I disagree.  I think it must be part of a jacket.
What makes you think that, Ms. Mabel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well.  I suppose you do know best. Young people and all these days...

replies.reply_text: Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there are several hints, you might say.  For one thing, the cloth.  This very heavy cloth isn't typically used on jackets.  This is the kind of cloth, you know, that Kilye in Tropicton uses on saddle pads.  The teal-blue dye, too, is typically hers. Furthermore, look on this side.  What do you see?  Hairs.  Black and white.  Quite tangled in the fabric, so the saddle pad was definitely used.

replies.reply_text: So this was used on a piebald horse, or a blue roan... or... a zebra!
That only means that the thief had a horse, there are plenty of those all over the place.

chatpoints.chat_text:

chatpoints.chat_text: There is such a one.  Seek her out.

replies.reply_text: Is that all you can tell me?
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me see the Periwinkle Shell and Aquamarine beads.  Put them down on this table here.

replies.reply_text: Here are the Periwinkle Shell and Aquamarine Beads.
Well darn. I don't have what I thought. I'll be back.
Here are the Amber and Black Fire Opal Beads.
Well darn. I don't have everything that I thought I had. I'll be back.
I have them right here.
Drat! I forgot all about those. I will be back.
10 Oranges and 10 Apples? Gesh. I wish you had asked me for those sooner. Can you please send me back to Caren Hart?
I've got those right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to bring me 10 oranges and 10 apples.

replies.reply_text: I'll go get those straight away.  Goodbye for now.
Perfect! I've got them right here.
And the pipes are ready, right?
First, I had to put in a lot of work to see them. They are pretty amazing to look at. Oh, and they gave me these strange wooden disks.
Well, I put a whole lot of time and energy and all I got in return were these dumb wooden disks.

chatpoints.chat_text: May I see them?

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll check with her. Thanks for all your help. I hope it ends up being worth all my time and efforts.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have your pipes ready for you, child.  Sit and listen, I will tell you how to use them to find the Spirit Horses.

replies.reply_text: You have my full attention.
No thanks, I think I've done enough already.  I can't afford all this travelling.
Thank you.  And next?
Okay, I think I know what to do. And then what?
Thank you.  And next?
Thank you for all your kindness, Ms. Nizhoni.  I'll go in search of the Spirit Horses now, and return once I've found them all.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: They say help is given to those who ask. What help would you like?

replies.reply_text: Can you remind me where to look for the Beaded Periwinkle Shells?
I need to search for the Aquamarine, where?
The Black Fire Opals - I was supposed to look somewhere with fire?
I should search for the Amber where again?
I am hoping that I've found everything you need. I'd like you to check what I've got.

chatpoints.chat_text: Some say, help is given to those who ask. Some say, there is a tunnel on the lower half of the island. Dig, and you may find yourself someplace else.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go far, in the four directions. Start in the East, and follow the path of the Sun.

replies.reply_text: And where do I find Night's Black Horse?
Thanks!
Sun's Golden Mare - where do I find her?
Dusk's Blue Horse was?
I need to look for Dawn's White Horse, where?

chatpoints.chat_text: Near vessel wrecked upon sandy shore.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Where heat rules the day and water is no mirage.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Where white appears blue, white that is not snow.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Search a small isle of white.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nizhoni stops her weaving and looks up as you enter. Is she looking at you? Or into you?) Welcome back. Sit and be at home.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, but I just stopped by to say hi.

chatpoints.chat_text: The travels are far, and wide. Only one of the greatest spirit of adventure can choose to pursue such an endeavor as to seek out the Spirit Horses.

replies.reply_text: I am ready to seek them out! Where can I find them?

npc_list.name: Candide
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 33
npc_list.long_description: Candide is a gentle, optimistic man who has seen many wonders in his life on his various travels. He has retired from the life of adventure, however, and prefers to spend his days tending to his garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, fellow traveler! Rest your feet and tell me of the world abroad. We don't get too many visitors out here in the isles!

replies.reply_text: Uh, thanks, but there's really nothing to tell. Goodbye now.
Thank you, this is a marvellous place you have here! Have you really traveled to so many places?
Thank you! I was wondering if I could get fresh onions, garlic and bell peppers from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Most of them. A few are places I would have liked to visit, but never did.

replies.reply_text: I guess you'll have to live with that regret. Time for me to go!
Why don't you go and visit them?
Which place would you say was your favorite?

chatpoints.chat_text: You might say I lost the spirit for traveling. I have had enough excitement to last ten lifetimes. When I found this beautiful island, I decided to stay and make a home here.

replies.reply_text: I don't see why. This island is very out of the way. I think I'll return to civilization now.
What was your most exciting adventure?
You must have gained quite a bit of treasure over the years to afford to buy your own island!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I miss the home of my youth, oddly enough. Back in the days when I was carefree and innocent of the ways of the world, and nothing could go wrong. In a way, this island reminds me much of that place, which is why I suppose I feel at home here. Among all the places I've seen, though, there's only one place where I was treated kindly.

replies.reply_text: (You sit up quickly after having fallen asleep.) Uh... speaking of home, that's where I need to be. Bye!
Which place was that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, they were all exciting! Ships, high seas, pirates, grand cities, wars and battles, giant mountains and golden beaches... I was even a slave on a boat once!

replies.reply_text: I thought there was something funny about you... I think I'll just go now...
You sound awful cheerful about that!

chatpoints.chat_text: A little, I admit, though the majority came from only one place.

replies.reply_text: I see you aren't going to share you secrets. I might as well go.
Which place was that?

chatpoints.chat_text: A grand, magnificent city! An ancient place of unparalleled beauty: Eldorado!

replies.reply_text: Eldorado? That's just a myth. I don't have time for any more of your stories.
I've never heard of it, what sort of place is it?
Eldorado? You've seen the famous City of Gold?

chatpoints.chat_text: Cheerful? There was nothing cheerful about it, I promise you. But I did learn a very important lesson from it. Whatever situation you find yourself in, it is up to you to make the most of it. Just like a seed that is planted in the ugliest garden can grow into the most priceless flower with purposeful care. This is the only way to be happy in life.

replies.reply_text: You make no sense. I'm just gonna go...
Ah... "Bloom where you are planted," so to speak? Is that why you have such a large garden?

chatpoints.chat_text: Precisely. I work in my garden every day to remind me that I make my own happiness. Would you care for some of the fruits off my trees?

replies.reply_text: Uh, not really. Thanks anyway.
I would love some!
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is a wondrous place of riches and beauty. The streets glimmer with gold, and all the houses are magnificent beyond compare. The city is ruled by a kind and wise prince, and all the citizens are blissfully happy. No one is in need, and no visitor is ever turned away empty-handed.

replies.reply_text: Such a place could never exist. I'm going to find something better to do.
Is that where you made your fortune? What sort of treasure did you get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed I have! It was the brightest point of all my travels, and I always think back on it fondly. The prince of the city showered me with parting gifts of enormous value. I've named my island after the city to remember the peace and friendship I experienced there.

replies.reply_text: Not to mention the treasure. I feel inspired to go find treasure of my own. Good-bye!
Ooh, what treasures were you given, if you don't mind me asking?

chatpoints.chat_text: The prince gave me four Golden Sheep from his personal herd. They are marvelous creatures with fleece of pure gold. Athamos, the ram, looks after the others, Nephele, Helle, and Phrixia.

replies.reply_text: Golden Sheep? Now I know you're crazy. I'm gonna go now.
Wow, Golden Sheep? Can I meet them?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would introduce them to you, but I'm afraid I cannot. (Candide begins to weep.) You see, to my eternal shame... I have lost them!

replies.reply_text: That's a shame. Oh, well, good luck with your island.
Oh, no! Lost!? How did that happen?

chatpoints.chat_text: The seas around these little islands can become quite rough. On our journey here, a giant wave washed over us and poor Helle fell in the water! Athamos jumped in after her, and Nephele and Phrixia jumped in after him. The ocean washed them away, and I'm afraid I'll never see them again!

replies.reply_text: That may be. I'm really sorry for your loss. I'll just leave you alone now.
Well, maybe I can help you find them! Surely they washed up somewhere...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Candide looks hopeful.) Do you really think so? I just hate the idea of forever losing the precious gift the Prince of Eldorado gave to me. Do you really think you can find them?

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe not. I wish you luck, though!
Of course! And I'm just the person for the job. I'm great at finding lost things!
I'll be on my way, then!
Do you have any idea where I might start looking?

chatpoints.chat_text: Great to see you again, fellow traveler! How is the search for my sheep coming?

replies.reply_text: It's hard. I'll go back to looking.
I haven't found them yet. Do you have any ideas where I might try looking?
I found one of them! But I can't get her to follow me back here. What should I do?
I found one of them! But I can't get him to follow me back here. What should I do?
I found one of them! But I can't get her to follow me back here. What should I do?
I found one of them! But I can't get her to follow me back here. What should I do?
I have one of your sheep!
I have one of your sheep!
I have one of your sheep!
I have one of your sheep!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Helle fell off the boat on a stretch of water between Quiet Isle and Bone Isle, so I would start looking around the islands in that area. You might try asking the people who live there if they've seen anything.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll do that. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, the sheep must not trust you because it does not know you. I have an idea, though. All the sheep are suckers for apple treats. I bet if you offered one to the sheep, they would follow you home.

replies.reply_text: This is turning into more and more work. I think I'll quit while I'm ahead. Bye.
That just might work. Do you have any apple treats on you?
Thanks! I'll get right on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! This is Nephele, the gentle one. She watches over the herd and keeps them out of trouble. I will just let her outside where she can roam the island.

replies.reply_text: She certainly seems gentle. I'm glad she's back safe and sound!
She will be glad to be back with the rest of her herd!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! This is Athamos, the strong one. He leads the herd and protects them from danger. I will just let him outside where he can roam the island.

replies.reply_text: He certainly seems strong. I'm glad he's back safe and sound!
He will be glad to be back with the rest of his herd!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! This is Phrixia, the brave one. She loves to explore new places and is never shy of strangers. I will just let her outside where she can roam the island.

replies.reply_text: She certainly seems brave. I'm glad she's back safe and sound!
She will be glad to be back with the rest of her herd!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! This is Helle, the shy one. She sticks close to her family at all times. She is probably the loveliest sheep in the herd. I will just let her outside where she can roam the island.

replies.reply_text: She certainly seems shy. I'm glad she's back safe and sound!
She will be glad to be back with the rest of her herd!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! How is the search for the remaining sheep going?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes. I'll get right back to searching.
I haven't found them yet. Do you have any ideas where I might try looking?
I've found another sheep!
I've found another sheep!
I've found another sheep!
I've found another sheep!
I believe I found all of your sheep!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! How is the search for the remaining sheep going?

replies.reply_text: I'm still working on it. I'll get back to searching.
I haven't found it yet. Do you have any ideas where I might try looking?
I've found the last sheep!
I've found the last sheep!
I've found the last sheep!
I've found the last sheep!
I believe I found all of your sheep!
(You hand over the sheep.)
(You hand over the sheep.)

I promise! And thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, friend! I'm so happy to see you again.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! I'm just passing through and can't stay this time. Take care!
Thank you! I wonder if you'd have some lanolin you'd be willing to part with, Candide.
Thank you!  I wonder if you know of a healing salve that would be good for chafed hands?
Thank you! I was wondering if I could get fresh onions, garlic and bell peppers from you?
Nice to see you, too! I just dropped by to see if, now that you have your sheep back, there's anything else I can help with?
Sorry to bother you, but what am I doing with all of this yarn?
I'm back from Sara's! Katinka made her a lovely sweater and hat set with your yarn.
And I'm glad to see you! You are just the person I need help from to for an extreme makeover. (You quickly explain the condition of Farley's hair... or lack of it!)
Where did you say I should look to find someone who can make a toupée?

chatpoints.chat_text: Though they have unusual wool, my sheep still produce oil.  In the process of shearing and preparing wool, lanolin is a byproduct.  I get two to four cups out of each fleece.  It's great stuff to make your hands soft, and I have it in abundance!

replies.reply_text: Could I possibly talk you out of four cups of it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Four cups? That's all you want? I'll have to give you a gallon. I keep it in gallon containers. It's cool now, so it's fairly gloppy, but you can heat it up to liquefy it.

replies.reply_text: This is kind of gross, but who am I to argue! How much do you want for it?
Eeeewww. Nevermind. Jubal can figure this out himself. I'm going.
Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: From my time as an explorer, I do remember sailors using something really smelly, but I have no idea what it was.  Now that I think of it, I'll bet it was lanolin-based.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, I guess I'll have to keep asking around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course. If you'll just wait here a moment, I'll get those for you. I'll have to charge you $200. I hope you understand. I have to have all my gardening supplies shipped in.

replies.reply_text: I understand. The $200 is no problem at all. I've got it.
Darn. I hadn't thought about that. I'll be back shortly.
Thank you so much. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, now that you mention it, I want to do something special for Sara for all those delicious strawberry pies she sends me.

replies.reply_text: Uh oh, I feel a long chore coming up...  Sorry, but I don't have a lot of time right now.  Bye!
That's really nice of you.  What do you have in mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've been spinning all the wool I've sheared off of my sheep and I'd like an expert needle crafter to use this golden yarn to knit something special for Sara.

replies.reply_text: Do you have anybody in mind?
And I'm supposed to knit this myself?  Sorry, I'm not that domesticated!
I think I might know just the lady you are looking for.  What sort of garment do you have in mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know, maybe a hat and scarf or a sweater?  Let it be her choice.  And you can bring it to Sara for me, but come back to let me know what she says.

replies.reply_text: Okay, so you want me to take this yarn to be made into a gift for Sara, deliver it to her and then come back to you. Sounds like a plan!  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to take the yarn to a knitter to have it made into a gift for Sara.  After it's made, bring it to Sara and then come back to see me.

replies.reply_text: Let's see.  Take yarn to a knitter, get a gift for Sara, bring said gift to Sara and then come back to you.  Got it.  See ya!
Do you know who would be able to make this for her?

chatpoints.chat_text: I knew you'd be the one who could get things done!  Did Sara like them? Do I owe Katinka anything for her work?

replies.reply_text: Geez, slow down!  Katinka said that you don't owe her anything.  She'll keep the rest of the yarn as payment.  Sara was overwhelmed by your generosity and sent you this.
Thanks, I'll be going now.  See you again soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've heard tell of an old woman on Snow or Ice Isle that makes extraordinary hand-knitted garments.

replies.reply_text: I guess I'll head that way, then.  Bye.
Thank you so much! By the way, do you know of anyone who can craft this into a toupée?

chatpoints.chat_text: You might try asking the residents of Sandy Meadows. I thought I heard about a woman who makes dolls that lives there. That would be my best guess.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. I'll head over there now.

npc_list.name: Sahkyo
npc_list.long_description: Is he appaloosa, pinto, dun... or all of these?  He is large, elegant and sleek, and between the white patches on his coat you can see spots, large and small, of what almost looks like every color of the rainbow, but muted into shades of warm and cool greys. His mane is striped with white, black and gold, and he stands before you, regarding you curiously and imperiously.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sahkyo regards you curiously. He doesn't move when you approach, just swishes his tail, calmly swatting away gnats. He has the kind of silky, glittery coat you can't help but touch, and you politely walk up to his shoulder and pat him.)

replies.reply_text: Hello there, fellow, how are you today? Can I look at these markings I heard you have?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sahkyo turns an ear toward you as you pat his shoulder. He is powerfully muscled, and looks as if he races the wind for fun.)

replies.reply_text: Good boy.  May I look at them?  Where are they?
Good boy.  I'll leave you to your grazing now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The beautiful stallion turns to you and nickers, and then turns and motions, with his muzzle, to his right side.)

replies.reply_text: Is that where they are? Good fellow. Let me see. (Keeping your hand on the horse's back so he knows where you are, you walk around him to the side he indicates.)

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Almost as if the horse were speaking to you, you hear:)
The Dawn's White Horse gave me Speed; how joyous his neigh!
The Sun's Golden Mare gave me Strength; how joyous her neigh!
The Dusk's Blue Horse gave me Agility; how joyous his neigh!
The Night's Black Horse gave me Endurance; how joyous his neigh!

replies.reply_text: A lightning bolt, paw print, hand print, three lines. Intriguing! I guess that's the message Nizhoni wanted me to hear. (Sahkyo lowers his head to pluck up wisps of beach grass. You get the impression you've been dismissed.)

npc_list.name: Materia
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 7

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I just can't believe that this has happened.  Where did that little thief go?

replies.reply_text: Uh.. What are you talking about?
Thief?  What thief?
It looks like you're a little busy, so I guess I should leave you alone now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That monkey came in here again and stole my best constellation map!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry about that.  I guess I should probably let you go find him, then.
That doesn't sound too good. What monkey?
Oh, that's bad.  Umm..  I'm busy helping someone else right now.  Anyway, can I ask you a question?

chatpoints.chat_text: That monkey Matata!  He's always getting into trouble and stealing things.

replies.reply_text: Do you need help finding him?  I have some time, and I could go look for him.
Well, I better leave you to it, then.  Good luck finding him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really? That would be wonderful. (Materia looks up at the sky.) It looks like it'll be time for me to start my stargazing again.

replies.reply_text: Actually... I just remembered I have something else to do, sorry!
Of course!  Do you know where I should start looking?
I will!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have my constellation map yet?

replies.reply_text: Here it is!
No, I still don't have it.
Where did you say I should look again?
You're welcome.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks again for bringing my map back. Would you like to take a look at the stars? (She motions to a telescope beside her.)

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I need to go.
I'd love to!
Not right now. I do have a question for you though. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (You see a bunch of twinkling lights.) Feel free to come back anytime.

replies.reply_text: The stars were beautiful, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Try talking to Cupcake to the north of here.  There are a lot of monkeys around there, and Matata has been known to hide out around that area.  Please hurry back!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Thanks!  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She gives an exasperated sigh.) Oh I suppose. What's the question.

replies.reply_text: (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)
Nevermind.  I can see you're not in the right frame of mind to help me now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe one of the monkeys stole it.  They're always stealing things from me.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm..  Well, Rashida sounded pretty sure it was someone that was at the party.  Thanks though!

npc_list.name: Flo Withego-Solomon
npc_list.long_description: Short and stout is Old Flo the Piratess.  She might even be a female dwarf; she is muscular and rather hairy.  Not the kind of person you want to trifle with.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, now, hopin' to do a wee bit o' pirating y'self?  Well, you're so smart, you tell me 'ow it happened.

replies.reply_text: You disguised yourself as someone everyone was likely to notice, while you kept an eye on Opal's store and learned how the stone was kept.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well blow me down!  'Ow did ye get on my island, then?  Why, I ought to run ye through fer tresspass!

replies.reply_text: Yes, I can see you're mean too!  I'll... just... uhm... swim for it.  Bye!
No!  I'm not going anywhere!  I believe it was you who stole the "Star of Solomon" Sapphire from Opal Sandstone on the night of 8th August last!
Come back here!  We're not through talking yet!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well be off w'ye then!

replies.reply_text: Yes!  Right-o!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, aye?  Do ye now, arr?  An' what be givin' ye that impression, mate?

replies.reply_text: Uh... mmm... I dunno... a hunch?
Could you please show me that blanket you're carrying?

chatpoints.chat_text: (As she speaks, the blanket starts... wiggling, as if there was something alive inside it!) No! An' why should I then? Be off w'ye! This be the Solomon Island-- my isle!

replies.reply_text: I would think the "Solomon Island" would belong to Captain Solomon!
And I'm here to get back the "Star of Solomon!"  It belongs to Opal!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it don't, arr!  It belong' to me!  I be his mother, Flo Solomon!  And this here be my Island!  So shove off!

replies.reply_text: Oh, fine.  Be that way.
No, I won't!  I want the "Star of Solomon"!  Hand it over!

chatpoints.chat_text: Never!  It be mine!  It bear me own name and that thievin' son o' mine, he stole it from me so I would never find the treasure o' this isle!  It's mine, I tell you!  Now away w'ye!

replies.reply_text: What is it with you pirates?  Life isn't just about treasure!
Knowing pirates, it's quite possible that he stole it from you, but who'd you steal it from, then?  Shall we go through all the people it's been stolen from until we arrive at the original maker?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(With a ferocious roar and a wild sneer in your direction, Flo sets down the green twill blanket on the ground, and rips its folds open! With a hiss and a shriek, out jumps a SKUNK who comes racing up to you, tail bushed!
With a sudden jolt of panic, your horse rears, screaming, and leaps aside--escaping the spray of the skunk, but knocking down Flo--and with a loud thud! and then a clang, something blue and as large as an eyeball falls from Flo's pocket and rolls into the hole!)

replies.reply_text: Easy there, boy!
Easy there, girl!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Look! Look! The Solomons' Mine!
By a brilliant ray of sunlight that streams into the hole, you can see the Star of Solomon sitting just right in a specially-made golden setting. Light reflected from the sapphire's star shines onto six silver hinges. With a great groan, a door slowly opens, revealing a stash of gems--including an enormous, facetted Beryl that glitters as if it were on fire!

replies.reply_text: Oh.... WOW!
Okay, fine, have your treasure.  Just give me the "Star of Solomon".
And since it was opened with Opal's Sapphire, half of that treasure belongs to her!

chatpoints.chat_text: It belong to the Solomons what found it, and what buried it long ago, arr!

replies.reply_text: (You think fast! The skunk's now back in its blanket. You whistle for your horse! Your horse runs past Flo, knocking her down and pinning her against some driftwood! The donkey runs over and joins in, ready to kick!)

chatpoints.chat_text: All right!  You got me fair 'n' square!  But this treasure be mine!  An' only the Star of Solomon itself can get ye off the Island, see, and I'm the only one knows how to work it, arr!  So in return for you callin' off your 'orse an' me lettin' you go 'ome, you can pick.  Ye can take w'ye either the Star of Solomon, or ye can take that there: Barry Solomon's Beryl!  Which is it to be, landlubber?  Think careful now!

replies.reply_text: First tell me how you managed to steal the Star from Opal's store!
Thank you. (As you touch the stone, you can clearly see the horse-shaped mark on its base.)
Thank you. (As you touch the stone, you can clearly see the horse-shaped mark on its base.)
Then you broke Opal's window and put Freddy's blanket over the broken glass so it wouldn't cut you--

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, an' how'd you know that, eh?

replies.reply_text: (You give Flo the torn piece of fabric.) You left this behind as you hurried to make your escape.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  Anybody'd think o' that.  Folk only remember the disguise; then after the theft, no one knows ye!  Go on now.

replies.reply_text: You stayed on Art Isle with Remy.  Had some trouble with your zebra getting away from you there, I expect.

chatpoints.chat_text: No! That's not true. I were trainin' ol Freddy 'ere. (Flo pats the skunk, nested in his blanket beside her.) Freddy can catch up horses and all like nobody's business! Good ol' Freddy.

replies.reply_text: Ah!  Then on the night of the crime, you must have sent Freddy running all around the town, trying to make noise to cover the break in!
You left a map of this island in Remy's Inn on Art Isle.  The price of carelessness again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, matey, now ye know all.  So choose: want ye the Star, or want ye the Beryl?

replies.reply_text: I'll take the "Star of Solomon", after you show me how to make it send me home.
All right.  I'll let you have the Star, since you need to send me back.  I'll take Barry Solomon's Beryl then.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The sheep ignores you completely.)

Ready to go now, are you? Right then, let's get you back home!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there! What can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing - I was just looking around.
Yeah, can I rest my horse here?
Wow, what beautiful lights! Where did you get them?
Hi.  Sorry to bother you, I'm asking around to see what folks heard or saw about the time Opal's big sapphire was stolen.
Hi there, Santa sent me here to see if you could help him with an anniversary gift for Mrs. Claus.
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Would you by any chance have well-rotted manure? I'm trying to find some for Mino.
I'm looking for some empty feed sacks to make into sandbags. Would you happen to have a half dozen?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure go ahead. We take good care of all our guests.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh these? (gestures at the beautiful lights and shrugs) I make them as a hobby.

replies.reply_text: Those are beautiful. I know my horse will enjoy resting here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I saw and heard plenty that night!  You can't believe what an uproar the horses were in!

replies.reply_text: Really?  Please, go on!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well!  Here's what happened.  That day, just as it began to get dark, and all the travelers were bringing in their horses for the night.  A small gentleman ... well, I call him that out of politeness ... came in here with a zebra, and asked me to put it up for the night.

replies.reply_text: Did he have a donkey with him?

chatpoints.chat_text: No he didn't.  Let me finish.  Anyway, we get lots of zebras but this one was really upset.  Limping a little.  Acting old, if you know what I mean.

replies.reply_text: Yes. I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well anyway, the poor beast was in a really rotten mood and kept bucking and kicking and really getting all the others upset, and you know how horses are.  They always assume, "Well, he's upset, I'll do that too, just in case there's anything worth being upset about."

replies.reply_text: Yes, that's horses, all right!  Anyway........?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was eager to get that fellow out of here. I told him, "Look, if you want to board that zebra overnight, you should take him to a vet's, 'cos he's in pain. I can't have him annoying my other customers."  And then what does the little stinker do?  He says, "Well, you can have him then, I don't need him."  And he runs out!  Just like that!

replies.reply_text: The rotter!  He should be in prison!
Well, that's all I need to know.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: So here I was, stranded with this zebra.  And I couldn't keep him in here causing all this fuss.  So.  I take the poor thing, and lead him out to the yard, and turn on the light, and guess what I saw!

replies.reply_text: Please!  Tell me!  You didn't find the little rat, did you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes indeed!  There was that little jerk, cowerin' behind my hay bunk, stuffing things down his pockets like he was trying to keep something down in 'em, or making sure something was there.  And as soon as he sees me, he grabs one of my own horses, that was out in the yard, and races off toward the shore.  Found the horse next morning by the dock.

replies.reply_text: The.... that... I don't...know what to say!  At least you got your horse back.
Great!  That's all I need to know!  Thanks for your time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes.  But you want to know the oddest thing?  I can see you do!  A day or so later, I was trying to work with this poor Zebra, cleaning out his feet and I noticed something odd about his feet.

replies.reply_text: What was it?
Sand I can see... Ice... he must have just been on Snow or Ice Islands...  Now this man you saw, what color was his jacket?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh I really couldn't see.  Grey or black or... some dark color.  But there you go.  Now you know everything I know.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  You've helped me a lot!  Goodbye, now!
By the way, do you still have that zebra?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  Healed him up and sold him.  Hope he's happier now.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  You've helped me a lot!  Goodbye, now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure I can do that. I will need some gems to get started. Hmmm, Christmas lights? Fifteen rubies and fifteen emeralds ought to work out just fine. My fee is $2000.

replies.reply_text: Santa's good - he knew you would need those so I have them right here, along with the payment.
Oh that's right, he did tell me you would need them. I better go and get them. I will be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess so. What did he have in mind?

replies.reply_text: He would like to have a string of Christmas flashing lights made for her.
These are beautiful. I will hurry and take them back to Santa Claus now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I think she mentioned something about it last year at the Livery Owners' meeting.  How's that going?

replies.reply_text: She's gotten her new property and she asked me if I'd go around finding water buckets and feed tubs that other stable owners no longer need, or might care to donate.

chatpoints.chat_text: What a splendid idea!  Wait right here...

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Don't you want me to pay you for these?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, don't be silly!  Sumiko is very welcome to these!  And thank you for coming all this way to get them for her!

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I'll get these to her as soon as I can.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm so sorry.  Fresh out.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! I could sell half a dozen to you for $600.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I was hoping I could get them for free. Let me see if I can find some anywhere else. If not, I'll be back!
Sounds like a bargain to me!  I've got the money right here.
Please save those for me. I'll be right back with the money.
These will be perfect! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Anani
npc_list.long_description: Anani is a short woman who has situated herself quite comfortably beneath the island's lone palm tree. She is busily weaving palm fronds and coconut strings into baskets.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there! I make the best baskets on Horse Isle, yes? You have come to buy a basket, yes?

replies.reply_text: Umm, no. Sorry. I'm just looking around.
Umm... Not this time. Did you happen to see any Golden Sheep come this way?
Hello! This is a very tiny island to live on!
Umm...  No.  Actually, I don't know how to get off this tiny island.  Could you help me?
Well, no.  I was wondering if you would know how to fix this bucket.
No, I actually have some fronds for you from Venda.

chatpoints.chat_text: I did, yes! I tried to catch it. Golden fleece must be very valuable, no? But I could not catch it. It ran from me. It jumped into the water and started swimming.

replies.reply_text: Shoot. Did you see which way it went?

chatpoints.chat_text: It dove in the water at the top of the island, see there? With the current, it may have washed up on any of the islands near here.

replies.reply_text: Do you have a way I can get to those islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: The tinier the better. That way I can work in peace and quiet, yes? Plus, with my boat, I can visit any island I wish.

replies.reply_text: I see. I'll let you get back to work, then.
You have a way to get to the islands around here? Can I visit them, too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! You may use my boat anytime that you wish. All I ask is that you bring it back in one piece, yes?

replies.reply_text: Of course! Thank you very much.

chatpoints.chat_text: You may get back the same way that you came. Dig through the tunnel in the corner there, yes? (She points to the southeastern edge of the beach.) Or you may wish to visit other islands near here, no?

replies.reply_text: Dig in the beach to get back to Mare Isle. Got it. Thanks!
Um... Sure! I like to visit other islands. You know of a way to get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: I work with palm fronds and coconut string.  You need to find someone who works with wood, yes?  I could not do much more than stuff the hole with fronds.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway, I'll keep that in mind.
I will and good luck with the baskets!

npc_list.name: Luna
npc_list.long_description: Luna is a young woman who seems to have a perpetual dreamy look upon her face. She spends most of her time pouring over her books and writing out her own theories.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there. How is it you have come all the way out here to disturb my studies?

replies.reply_text: Uh.. I'm sorry. I'll just leave.
I didn't mean to disturb, I've just been exploring.
Hi Luna. I was wondering if, by any odd chance, you had ever found any riddles lying around here?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's all right. I suppose I could use a distraction. Well, since you are here, is there something you need?

replies.reply_text: No, thank you. If it's all right, I'll just take a walk around your island.
Can you tell me how to get off of this isle?
Actually, I'm searching for a Golden Sheep which was lost at sea near here. It may have washed up here. Have you seen any sheep on your island lately?

chatpoints.chat_text: That will be fine. Just take the boat from the docks to the mainland when you are ready to leave.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You may use the boat from my personal dock to get you back to the mainland. It is free of charge.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have actually. Just the other day. I spied it through my window wandering the beach. It seemed like it wanted to jump back into the water, but was too afraid.

replies.reply_text: Did you see where it went, by chance?
Thanks, I'll just take a look around myself then, if that's okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact I did find one when I first moved to this isle. How odd that you would know about it.

replies.reply_text: Well, actually Demetrius found a treasure riddle, and the first clue lead me here.
Yeah, it is odd.  Can I have it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I guess since you're here, you might as well listen to it. Ready?

replies.reply_text: Yep - go ahead.
Thanks. I'm going to start looking now. Bye.

npc_list.name: Sumiko Stallman
npc_list.long_description: Sumiko is tall, and looks perhaps a little stretched.  You can see many years of hard work on her face, and also in the way she moved.  She has a pleasant look, although her mind is clearly elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  What's up?

replies.reply_text: Hi.  Just came in to see your barn.
Just passing through.  Bye.
Okay, I'm back!  What would you like me to do first?
You wanted buckets and feed tubs?
What next?
Hi!  Four saddles and four halters with leads, yes?
Okay!  What else do you need for your riding center?
Back once again!
I'm here on an errand for Mino.
I'm crossing my fingers that you can help me out. I need to make some sandbags. I need empty feed sacks to do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.  Feel free to look around and talk to the other boarders all you like.

replies.reply_text: This is really a very well-kept barn, I do like it!  It looks like taking care of this place has been your life's work.
Thanks.  I'll be on my way now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Has been.  But I'm selling soon.  Decided to finally up and go for my dream!

replies.reply_text: What's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm opening up a Riding for the Handicapped Center.  Over the years, I've gotten some nice, gentle, patient horses from my customers, and I recently got some land.  Just need things.  Lots and lots of things.  You know how it is.

replies.reply_text: I sure do!  Good luck with that!
I'll bet you do.  Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sumiko looks up at you as if you have just rescued her from drowning.) Oh, would you? Could you? With my stuff? I'm happy to pay you for your time and effort! Let me make a list!

replies.reply_text: A list?  Forget it!
A list?  No problem!  For such a great cause, I'm happy to help!  I'll be back shortly.
I can do that.
Why not just use what you've got here?
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: These things all have to stay with the barn when I leave. I've already set aside what I can spare.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay.
Thanks a lot!
I can do that.  I'll ask at the tack shops, I'm sure people bring in used equipment all the time.
No, thanks, I'd rather not do lots of travelling right now.  Maybe later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have them?

replies.reply_text: Here they are.
Not yet.  Just wanted to make sure I knew what you wanted.  I'll get on it right away.
Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why thank you, you're a gem for asking! There is one thing I really, really need, but it's not going to be easy to get, I'm afraid.

replies.reply_text: What?!  The other things weren't easy to get, either!  No way.  I'm out of here!
Not to worry, I live for a good challenge!  What is it you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a custom mounting block.  One with handrails on either side, that the horse stands between, and a ramp for wheelchair-bound riders to use.

replies.reply_text: That's a great idea, but I don't think I can carry that back to you on my horse.
That's a great idea, but I'm really not in the mood for shlepping around after even more stuff for people to build with.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tsk! No! You don't have to shlep around anywhere! I know someone who has exactly what I need. And furthermore, I happen to know she has a wagon she can deliver it in.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Oh!  Well, who, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Talia Timbers, in Earton!  She used to have a riding school up there, she's got all kinds of things like that.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
Oh, not... not to be crabby or anything, but Talia's a bit... snappish.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, she is a bit terse.  But she's a good person under it all.

replies.reply_text: If you say so...

chatpoints.chat_text: She does have one small... well, I won't say problem, but... eccentricity.

replies.reply_text: Eccentricity?!
Oh, no. That turns me off right there!  I'm going to quit while I'm ahead!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, sort of.  She likes to haggle.  Not because she's cheap, mind you.  I think she just considers it a sport.  But if you keep after her, you can get some great prices, so don't give up!

replies.reply_text: That's fine!  I love to haggle!
I'll do my best!  Bye now!  Wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're back! How did it go?  Did you get the mounting block?  And how much did you pay?

replies.reply_text: Haven't gotten it yet, sorry.
I got it.  But she charged me twice what you gave me for it.
I got it, but it cost all the money you gave me.
I got it, delivered, and for only $2,500!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you don't want to tell me... I guess that's fine.  I'm afraid I have nothing much to give you in return...

replies.reply_text: I did my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry you couldn't get a better bargain than that.

replies.reply_text: I did my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did?  That's wonderful!  Well done!  Please keep the rest of the money, you deserve it!

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I will!  Bye!
Oh, no, I couldn't.  Please, you're doing something really good here and I know you need the money.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I insist.

replies.reply_text: Well, thank you.  I hope I can help again in the future.
Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mino? I heard rumors that he has a wonderful anniversary surprise planned for Lelu. I bet this has something to do with the surprise.

replies.reply_text: You're right, it does! He needs some well-rotted manure. Would you happen to have any on hand?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't help you with that, but I bet Dwight in Carrotton can.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! Bye for now.
Darn. Thanks, just the same.

npc_list.name: Talia Timbers
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Earton Livery Stable
npc_list.long_description: Talia is tall, very thin, and extremely gruff.  She runs a very tight ship here in Earton.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Come in!  Don't crowd the alley!  Dangerous around horses to crowd alleys.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, didn't mean to intrude. I'll just go.
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Hi, have you got a minute?  Honestly, just a minute?
Hi. Can you spare a couple of minutes? I'm running an errand for Mino.
I'm looking for half a dozen empty feed sacks. Would you happen to have any?

chatpoints.chat_text: Heard about it.  Good luck with that.  Wish her well.  Move aside, there!

replies.reply_text: You wouldn't happen to have any old buckets or tubs you could give... or sell me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Buckets or tubs?  Nah!  Use everything!  Use it 'til it falls apart.  Make it earn its keep!

replies.reply_text: Um... Yes.  Okay, then, I'll look elsewhere.  Good day to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Talia throws her coat onto an upper peg and waddles toward an empty stall.) Back here for something for Sumiko. Reckoned so. Well? What is it? Speak up!

replies.reply_text: Okay, well.  Do you still have a Mounting Block with... arm rails on both sides, you know, the kind she can use for her center?
Nnnnnnnno thanks.  I think I've had all I can take of you.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no you haven't!  Get back here!  What'd'ya want?

replies.reply_text: I want to go home!
Okay, I want a mounting block, with handrails and a ramp.  Sumiko says you have one and you can deliver it to her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, go home, then! That's where giving up gets you! (Talia grabs her coat and trundles off down the aisle and out of sight.)

replies.reply_text: Honestly!  Some people....!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Have that.  Know just what she wants.  Still got it.  $10,000, tell her, and it's hers.

replies.reply_text: $10,000?!  No way!  She only gave me $5,000!
$10,000, eh?  But it's not even new!  I'll give you $1,000 for it, on her behalf.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, $10,000 I want!  You can contribute, too!  Good cause, riding center like that.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right... Anything to get this over with.
Absolutely not!  I only have $5,000 and that's the most I'll pay!  It's for Sumiko!
Uh, thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  For Sumiko.  But not for anyone else!  $5,000 I'll take and you're getting a deal!

replies.reply_text: Fine.  $5,000 then, here you go.
You know, she told me the thing wasn't even worth $5,000!
I'll be waiting to see it tomorrow at Sumiko's!

chatpoints.chat_text: And what if it isn't?  It's worth what I want for it!

replies.reply_text: Oh, have it your way.  $5,000 it is.
I'll give you $2,000 for it.
Oh, no!  No. Sorry, I don't think we're going to reach any kind of equitable deal here.  Goodbye.
All right!  Okay.  You win.  $5,000, okay?  I'll meet you half way.  Sorta.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, hey, hey!  Hang on.  Okay, how about... $6,000?

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right!  Just to make this stop!  I hate haggling!
Okay.  You'll deliver it straight away, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, sure!  Tomorrow.  Tell Sumiko she'll have it tomorrow.  Thanks!  That was fun!

replies.reply_text: (Sigh.)
A pleasure doing business with you!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mino? Of course. What do you need?

replies.reply_text: (You explain about Mino's plans, and his need to enrich the sandy soil.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Darn. I'd love to help, but I have a service that cleans the property daily. You might want to try asking Harry in Shellton. Good luck on your errand.

replies.reply_text: I will. And thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you. Now if you could please move...

replies.reply_text: Yikes! I'm leaving, I'm leaving!

npc_list.name: Harry Holterz
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Shellton Livery Stable
npc_list.long_description: Harry is not old himself, but he's an old-time horseman.  The kind of person who can look at a horse for a moment and tell you its whole life history.  He has a slow-going, kindly nature, but you can see that he is careful and diligent to a fault.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Welcome.  How can I help?

replies.reply_text: Just looking, thanks.
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Hello.  I heard you might be someone to talk to about theatre costumes.
Hello there. I was told you might be able to help me.
Hi there!  Dr. Emdee told me that she thought your cat had kittens recently.  Any white ones in the litter?
Have you seen a blue wacky inflatable arm tube guy thingy?
Hello, hello! I'm hoping you've got some empty feed sacks that you don't need.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup.

replies.reply_text: I was wondering, could you spare any old stall buckets or feed tubs for her new barn?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.... (He wanders off down the rows, and returns with two feed tubs from a far stall.) Need to replace these. Good, but don't look nice in a commercial barn. Sell 'em to you for $100 each.

replies.reply_text: No, that's too much.  I'll keep looking, thanks.
All right.  They'll do fine.
Thanks a lot.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe.  What do you need?

replies.reply_text: A dress with a hoop skirt, and a Modern Major General's uniform.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Pirates of Penzance is it? Who's putting it on?
