replies.reply_text: I'm glad to hear it! Take care, now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elowyn whickers softly at you.)

replies.reply_text: Hello, girl. (You give her a pat.)
Hello, girl! How do you like your new wings?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elowyn dances in a circle to show off her wings.)

replies.reply_text: Yes, they are beautiful. Glad you like them!

npc_list.name: Ugly Duckling
npc_list.long_description: Here before you is the very picture and definition of the word meeskite (funny-looking).  Huge feet, a tiny, slightly off-center bill, and  rather oversized eyes look up at you ready to challenge anything nasty or insensitive you might say.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes?

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Hello.  Didn't mean to...
Hi there.  Hope your artwork is doing well!  Bye for now!
Hi there.  You haven't, by any chance, found a couple pairs of Kitten Mittens around here, have you?
Duckling!  Has Red Riding Hood been here already?
Say Duckling, You wouldn't have, by any chance, have found a glass slipper recently, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Didn't mean to what?  Go ahead, say it.  Get it out of your system.  "What an ugly bird!"

replies.reply_text: I wasn't going to say that!  Honestly!
Okay.  What an ugly bird.  Now that we're past that, how are you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Everybody says that.

replies.reply_text: Well, I imagine they might.  Anyway, nice to meet you.  How are you?
Well, I wasn't going to!  And if that's what you think of me, goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine.  I'm fine.  Lovely spot up here, don't you think? So what are you doing up here in the clouds?

replies.reply_text: I just came to see what was up here, really.  Do you live here full time?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I do.  You know why?

replies.reply_text: No, why?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because half the people here are even funnier-looking than me!  And that allows me to pursue my dream without people caring about how I look.

replies.reply_text: You have problems, bird!  See you around!
What dream is that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I want to be a great artist!  The greatest there ever was!  So I came here!  Nobody says, "He wants to be a great artist to compensate for his ugliness!" up here.  No, they do not!

replies.reply_text: But... you're going to grow up to be a beautiful swan!
Uuuuuuuh... Yeah.  Okay.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: These days, kiddo, even a beautiful swan needs a career!  So I came up here to get one where I'm not going to be ridiculed!  There's only one small problem with this plan.

replies.reply_text: There are no artist's materials up here, and you want me to get you some?
Uh-oh.  I see exactly where this is going.  No thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's not be hasty!  And no, there are plenty of artist's materials up here.  I specialize in candy.  What I need is a model!  Someone to pose for me!

replies.reply_text: There are so many people up here, won't anybody pose for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: No!  They won't!  Because every time I try to ask one of them, they sit for a while, and they look at me, and they start snickering, and soon they're laughing so hard they can't stay still!

replies.reply_text: (You mumble, "I can understand that.") Well, sorry, can't help you there.
I'll pose for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't be silly.

replies.reply_text: I'm not being silly!  I bet I can pose until you finish your....

chatpoints.chat_text: Candy and Pixie-dust sculpture of you?  I'll take you up on that!  You sit right there and look dignified, and if you can make it all the way through 'til I finish, I'll pay you for your time.

replies.reply_text: You're on!
Ah, forget it.  G'bye.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Good! (The Duckling waddles off and gathers his "art supplies".)
Now, you just sit there. That's good.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Duckling examines you carefully, first through one eye, then the other, then with his head tilted at different, bizarre angles.)

replies.reply_text: (Awww, that's so fu-- no!  I must not laugh!  Not even chuckle!)

chatpoints.chat_text:
You're doing good, you're doing good!
(The Duckling quickly licks pieces of candy to get them to stick together. Sometimes he has to lick them really fast in order to soften them!)

replies.reply_text: Guffaw!
(Must not laugh!  Nothing about this duck is funny! Must not laugh!)

chatpoints.chat_text:
Okay, now. A little cotton candy for your shoes...
(The duckling pulls out wads of cotton candy, dips them in water from the pond, and stomps them rapidly into something resembling boots by stomping them with his webbed feet as he lies on his back.)

replies.reply_text: Snort!
(You nearly choke trying to surpress a snicker! You hope he didn't see that!)

chatpoints.chat_text:
Now, a little detail...
(The duck makes lines for creases and fabric folds by standing with his back to the scupture and, with great dignity, waggling his pointed little pin-tail.)

replies.reply_text: Hee hee hee that's so cute!
(That's it.  Gotta shut my eyes!)

chatpoints.chat_text:
Hey! Don't shut your eyes! I need to see your eyes!
(When you open your eyes again, the duckling examines them piercingly. Ducks' eyes have whites?!)

replies.reply_text: (Just look past him.  Look through him... Don't laugh...  He's not fun..ny-he-he  no!  Not funny at all!)
Snicker!  OOPS!

chatpoints.chat_text:
And now for the piece de resistance, your glorious hair!
(The duckling puts a big pile of cotton candy on the "head" of the sculpture.)

replies.reply_text: HA HA HA HA HA!
(You grit your teeth and hold you breath; you can feel yourself turning blue!)

chatpoints.chat_text: See!  What'd I tell you!  Everybody ends up laughing at me!  Get out of here!

replies.reply_text: But, but... All right... See you around.
Thanks!  Anytime. (I have to go somewhere I can laugh!)
Thanks an awful lot!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Red Riding Hood?  The kid that lives over there in that funny looking house?  Yeah, she just skipped by here heading for her grandmother's.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I have a bad feeling about this...  Do you have any idea whom she might have gone to after she came to visit you?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I don't keep track of little kids.  She could have gone anywhere!

replies.reply_text: Okay. If she does happen to backtrack, could you keep her here for a while?

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely, positively, NO.  I'm only going to this party for the cake!

replies.reply_text: Please!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't beg!  Makes you look like a whiny brat!  No.  And now if you'll excuse me, I've got some preening to do.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A glass slipper? What do you think an artist would need with a glass slipper? Are you trying to make fun of me, is that it?

replies.reply_text: What is it with people and their attitudes around this place? Never mind then - the prince can just find a different way to locate his "true love". I'm outta here.
No! Of course I wasn't, I was simply trying to help Prince Charming find the glass slipper he lost.

chatpoints.chat_text: He lost it, you said? And if this Prince lost an object such as this, and if someone happened to come across it, hypothetically speaking, that wouldn't be a bad thing for an artist to pick up perhaps.

replies.reply_text: Um, yeah... What you said!
Huh? Whatever. I can't take anymore of this!

chatpoints.chat_text: I perhaps might have found an object - tested for shaping noses on my sculptures - that perhaps matches the description of a "glass slipper".  You say it belongs to Prince Charming?

replies.reply_text: Yes! And he is extremely anxious to get it back! Do you have it?
Thanks Ugly Duckling! (Snickers.) See you around!

npc_list.name: Mother Cat
npc_list.admin_description: replace CP#0 1550 with 1263 when ready to go
npc_list.long_description: Mother Cat wears an apron splashed with flour and a bit of egg.  She looks overworked, overstressed and under-enthused.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh... Hello there... (She turns to her kittens.) Felix! Archie! Mehitabel! Stop that right now!
Felix: We weren't doing anything!
Archie: Well, it was your fault, Felix!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I've come at a bad time.  Goodbye.
Oh, my.  Is there anything I can help you with, Mother Cat?
Hi, sorry to bother you again, but where were the mittens?
Hello!  I'm back!  I've found the mittens!
Hello, hope you're doing okay today.  Thanks for the pie!
Hello there! I was in the area and thought I'd stop in to see how the family is doing.

chatpoints.chat_text:
These naughty kittens have lost their mittens!
Mehitabel: Please, please please, pleeeeeeeze can't we have some pie?!
Mother Cat: No begging! No, you shall have no pie until those mittens are found!

replies.reply_text: I think I'll just go.  Goodbye.
I'm good at finding things, how about if I find the mittens?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, I don't know...
Archie: Would you really? That'd be fabulous!
Mehitabel: Pie! Pie! Pie!
Mother Cat: Beeee QUIET!
I'm so sorry. It's been a long day. Frankly, if you could find those mittens, I'd be very grateful. Their grandmother made them and... Oh dear, what will she think?

replies.reply_text: No problem at all!  Where were they lost?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Turning to her kittens.) Well?
Felix: Uhm... I lost mine right outside the Princess' castle.
Archie: I didn't lose mine, Mehitabel did!
Mehitabel: I did NOT lose them, I put them down by the pond with mine and the duck took them!
Mother Cat: I don't care who did what, so long as you know where they are!

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I have enough to go on now.  One pair outside the Princess' castle, and two by the pond?
That's an awful lot of running around on Cloud Isle.  Maybe another time.  Bye.
I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mittens... mitt-- by the Ugly Duckling and the Princess' castle. It's horrible! I work, and I slave, and do I do it for me? No! For them I do it! For them!

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll be back!
You're very welcome!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text:
I know you! You’ve helped me before. Please come in… (She turns to her kittens.) Mehitabel! Stop pulling your brother's tail!
Mehitabel: But Felix drank my bowl of milk!
Felix: Well, it was your fault! You started it! You ate my cookie!
Archie: MOM! Mehitabel hid my catnip!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. Things haven't changed much here, have they? Those kittens must drive you batty!
You know, I suddenly remembered an errand I need to run. Good luck with the kids!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes they do! And things have gotten worse. There's been all this noisy banging going on since early this morning. As you know, cats are nocturnal. With all the noise, these kittens are exhausted from lack of sleep. (Mother Cat lets out a huge yawn.) I could use some sleep myself. I'm at my wits' end here.

replies.reply_text: Would you like me to ask around and see if I can find the cause? Maybe one of your neighbors is remodeling or something.
I'm sure someone is just doing a bit of remodeling. It'll probably stop in the next day or so. Well, that was an easy fix! Guess I'll be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be lovely. Maybe you can convince them to remodel during reasonable hours instead all morning long?

replies.reply_text:
(You jump at the sound of a sudden loud banging - it almost sounds like thunder!)

Goodness! I see what you mean. I'm happy to try. No guarantees, but I'll do my best! I'll start asking around right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: The banging that's been going on. (A loud bang startles the kittens and they start running around the house like banshees.) You said you'd ask around to see what's going on and if it could be stopped during sleeping hours! (She turns to her kittens who are tangled up fighting with each other.) Get back to bed NOW!

replies.reply_text: Ah yes, I remember. I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text:
I’m so glad to see you! (She grabs one kitten by the scruff of the neck and tucks him back into a cozy looking basket and tells him to stay there!)
Were you able to find out where the noise...(She gives the other two kittens who are wrestling around a stern ‘I mean it’ look so they suddenly start grooming each other.)
… is coming from? (The two kittens start biting each other and yowling.) That's IT! Go to your baskets, the lot of you! NOW!

replies.reply_text: Ummm. What? Did I agree to do something for you?

npc_list.name: Sam McGee
npc_list.long_description: Sam McGee is an old grandfather who has lived a long and fulfilling life.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The old man looks up at you with kind eyes from his chair in the corner.) Hello! Do you know my Triumph?

replies.reply_text: Hello, sir. I'm afraid that I don't.

No, and I'm not sure I want to know. Goodbye.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry... I don't know what it is. I wish I could help you.

replies.reply_text: You... You mean to say... the bear is your triumph?! Triumph is the bear's name?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! My most cherished possession as a child, now returned to me! I can't thank you enough!

replies.reply_text: Well.... You're welcome! Glad I could help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Thank you so much for returning my Triumph to me!

replies.reply_text: It was no problem! Bye now!

I'll see you when I get back.

Great!  I'm sure he would love them.

npc_list.name: Davy
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP32
npc_list.long_description: Davy is Sam's loving grandson and devoted caretaker. He doesn't get to spend much time on himself as his grandfather requires most of his attention.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Welcome! It's not often we get visitors way out here. Please excuse my grandfather. He's been unwell. Is there anything I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: Thanks! You live quite a ways away from civilization.
I'm sorry to hear your grandfather isn't well. What's wrong with him?
Yeah, I noticed your grandfather is a little... off. What this "triumph" he keeps on about?
I'm just passing through. Thanks, though.
Umm, how do I get off your island?
Actually, I'm here to deliver some special fishing lures from Dewey that you ordered.
Been fishing with your grandfather lately?
Hello again!  Do you happen to remember the Burlaps who ran the General Store in Carrotton?
I'm sorry... Where in the world is Ben Burlap again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, we do, but it's neccessary for Grandfather's health. The doctor suggested we find a nice, calm place in a warm climate for him to relax in.

replies.reply_text: Well, it seems you've found the perfect spot!
Well, I hope he gets better. Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's hard to say, really. Sometimes he's fine, and other times he just doesn't seem completely lucid. He starts talking about his triumph, and gets lost in the memory of it.

replies.reply_text: What is his triumph, if I may ask?

chatpoints.chat_text: I honestly don't know. He always asks after it though, and always seems so sad. I wish I knew how to make him feel better, but I really have no idea what it is.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's quite a problem you have there. Good luck.
Do you suppose there is anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it really is a beautiful island, and very peaceful. It's perfect for my grandfather.

replies.reply_text: I hope it helps him get better. Now, how do I get off this island of yours?
What's wrong with him?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can send you to our neighbor island. You can take a boat from their dock to the mainland.

replies.reply_text: Maybe in a little while. I want to look around some more.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's really nice of you to offer. Really though, I wouldn't even know where to begin. And Grandfather's no help, he won't tell me anything about what his "triumph" is. So we're stuck, I'm afraid.

replies.reply_text: You can't think of any major feats your grandfather might have performed? Or any major events in his life?
Well, okay. I guess I'll leave you to figure it out, then. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I really can't. All of my life growing up, I can never recall him talking about his triumph before. It's only been recently as he's become ill. It could be anything, really.

replies.reply_text: Is there anyone else who might be able to tell us?
I guess you really are stuck. I'll just be off then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, now that you mention it, he had a few friends amongst neighbors in the last town he lived in. Someone there might know. You really don't mind going to all this trouble? I can't travel myself and leave him alone here.

replies.reply_text: When you put it that way, it does seem like an awful lot of work. Maybe I will pass. Can you just send me home?
I don't mind at all! Now, what town am I travelling to?
I'll get right on it. Can you help me get off this island?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! Did you find out anything?

replies.reply_text: Not yet. I'll get back to it. Can you get me off this isle?
Iona told me Sam was a great neighbor when he moved there from Carrotton, but no one else really had anything to say.
I did, but I'm not finished talking to everyone. Can you send me back?
What was I looking for again?

chatpoints.chat_text: We were looking for information on what my grandfather Sam's triumph might be. I sent you to Flipperton to interview the residents there.

replies.reply_text: Oh yes, I remember now. Can you get me back there?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right, I'd forgotten he lived in Carrotton for a while. If no one in Flipperton knows anything, maybe someone there would. Did you find out anything else?

replies.reply_text: Felton moved into Sam's old house and gave me a couple of things Sam left behind. Here, take a look...

chatpoints.chat_text: Huh, look at this. This is definitely my grandfather in this photo when he was a little boy. I wonder what it is he's holding. Looks like that part was torn off. And this diary looks very interesting.

replies.reply_text: You'd think there would be some information in it.
Well, I said I'd deliver it, and I have. I need to be off, now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't suppose you'd be willing to make another journey for me?

replies.reply_text: Not really. I just want to get back to the mainland.
Sure, what did you have in mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: You did such a great job in Flipperton. Could you go to Carrotton and do the same? Talk to the residents and find out if anyone knows anything about my grandfather's triumph. In the meantime, I'll look through this diary and see if I can learn anything.

replies.reply_text: I don't really feel like travelling that far. Could you just send me back to the mainland?
Not a problem, just send me back to the mainland, and I'll get right on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back again! Did you find out any more information?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet. Can you send me back to the mainland?
I forgot where I was supposed to go. Can you remind me?
Nothing really new, but I have a book from Tucker that belongs to Sam.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sure. It was Carrotton I asked you to travel to. Hopefully someone there knows about my grandfather's triumph.

replies.reply_text: I remember now. Can you send me back to the mainland?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, let's see it. (Davy begins flipping through the book.) By the way, there was nothing really helpful in that diary. There was one reference to a "Triumph" that seemed to refer to his childhood, and that was it.

replies.reply_text: So it sounds like we need to go back even further into his past.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me either. I guess, though, you could give this bear to my grandfather, since it was his as a little boy. It might be fun for him to see it. And I can keep looking for clues in this box.

replies.reply_text: Can't you give it to him yourself? I really am too busy to stay here any longer. Can you get me off this island?
Sure, I can do that, I suppose.

chatpoints.chat_text: It appears to be my grandfather as a small boy. He's standing between a well and a gazebo somewhere, and it looks like he's holding a box. There's a shovel off to the side.

replies.reply_text: A shovel? Like he was going to bury the box?

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe. I wonder where this place is. I bet whatever is in that box would be helpful.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, we could dig everywhere and never find it. I guess our quest is over. Can you send me back home?
Well... I may have an idea. Tucker did say that they grew up in Horse Shoe Village. That seems like the most logical place to look.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you be willing to travel to Horse Shoe Village for me and look for this buried box?

replies.reply_text: I think my horse is worn out. Maybe later. Can you just send us back to the mainland?
Do you really need to ask? At this point, I'm dying to know what Sam's triumph is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! There can't be more than one gazebo or well in that little town, so hopefully it shouldn't be too hard to find the spot.

replies.reply_text: I'll find it, no worries. Can you send me back to the mainland?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, again! How did your search go?

replies.reply_text: I haven't been there yet. Can you send me to the mainland?
Where was I going again?
I found an old wooden box!
I gave you that wooden box.  I don't really know what you want me to do now that there wasn't anything interesting there.

chatpoints.chat_text: To Horse Shoe Village, to dig in the spot between the gazebo and well for the box buried there by my grandfather.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah. I'll get right to that. Can you send me back to the mainland?

chatpoints.chat_text: Awesome! Let's see what's inside it! (Davy grabs some tools and gives the lid of the box a quick yank to pry it off.) Well.... huh. This is weird. It's nothing more than an old teddy bear. That doesn't make any sense.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's too bad. I was really hoping there'd be another clue inside there. I don't know what to to do now.
How dumb. I give up. Can you just send me home?

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe. Hmm, nothing really interesting in this book. Just a bunch of fishing lures. Wait.. What's this? (Davy pulls out what looks to be a piece of an old torn photograph.) Look here! Do you suppose it fits with the other torn photograph? (Davy pulls out the other piece and fits them perfectly together.)

replies.reply_text: It looks like a perfect match! What does the picture show?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you go. Hopefully it will make him happy!

replies.reply_text: We'll see!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you give that teddy bear to my grandfather yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet. I'll do that now.
I did! And guess what? The bear was his Triumph! I mean, Triumph is the bear's name!

chatpoints.chat_text: Seriously?! Well then, I guess our quest is over! How can I ever thank you for all your help? Please take this as a small reward!

replies.reply_text: I'm just glad I could help! Thank you very much! Can you send me back to the mainland again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! Thank you so much for your help earlier. My grandfather has been so happy to have his childhood treasure back again!

replies.reply_text: I was glad to help!  I must get back home, though. Can you send me back to the mainland?
I was glad to help!  Do you two still go fishing?
Hello again!  Do you happen to remember the Burlaps who ran the General Store in Carrotton?
I'm sorry... Where in the world is Ben Burlap again?
Thanks! I was just glad to help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep! We go every day, just about. We're getting low on earthworms again. It's hard to get enough way out here on this little island. If you happen to have any, I'll buy them from you in lots of 10. I could pay you $500 for every 10 earthworms you bring me.

replies.reply_text: I'll remember, thanks!
That sounds great! I'll start collecting right now. Can you get me off this island?
I have 10 earthworms for you!
I have 10 more earthworms for you!
Thank you! Hope you enjoy your fishing!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure do!  Mr. Burlap was a really nice guy, he used to go fishing with Grandpa. His son, Ben, used to sneak out of the store and take me fishing.  We'd sit by the pond and Ben would tell me all about the great adventures he was going to have.

replies.reply_text: Yep, that's the one! Have you, by any chance, kept in touch with Ben?  He left Carrotton looking for adventure and Betsy hasn't heard from him since.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, as a matter of fact, we just got a letter from him last week.

replies.reply_text: Really now.... Where is he?
Do you think he'd mind if I told Betsy where he is?  I think she thinks that he's turned his back on his sisters.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that... I'm sure Ben wouldn't mind.  You see, he roamed around for so long before he settled in Tropicton, he thinks that his sisters are mad at him.  It's about time one of those Burlaps made the first move!

replies.reply_text: You've got that right!  I'll tell Betsy the good news... Um, can you send me back to the mainland?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ben owns the General Store in Tropicton, remember?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that's where he is... Could you help a traveler out here and help me off of your island?

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I tell you about Unicorns?

replies.reply_text: Can I buy one for my very own?
Can I pick the Unicorn I team up with?
What's the advantage to riding a Unicorn?
How do I tell it where I want to go?
Why is it so expensive to rent a Unicorn?
No thanks, I think I understand what's involved now.
Excuse me, sir, have you seen Little Red Riding Hood today?  Within the last hour or so?
Can they travel to all those little isles?  The ones east of Horse Isle?
You actually already told me what I needed to know.  I do have a couple small sugar chunks for the unicorn.  May I go to Serenity Isle, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no!  Unicorns are very proud and fiercely independent.  They won't tolerate the idea of belonging to someone.  They're powerful, too.  It's best never to insult them.

replies.reply_text: I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not really very wise.  Unicorns are fussy.  They won't cooperate with everyone.  Best let me decide who's a good match, since I know them all so well.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll trust your judgement.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, they can't fly like Pegasi, it's true, but what they can do is warp from place to place or even to another player. Teleport instantly from where you are to where you're going. Saves a lot of time!

replies.reply_text: True enough!  Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: You talk to them.  You tell them, !WARP (destination) or !WARP(playername).  They'll get you there safe and sound.

replies.reply_text: All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, lots of reasons.  Special feed, special grooming.  Other specialized care that Unicorns need that other animals don't.  And you have to admit, for the speed at which you can travel with a unicorn, they're certainly worth the price!

replies.reply_text: I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good!  Well, have a good day!

replies.reply_text: I will!  Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That kid?  No, she hasn't been around yet today, thank goodness.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Well, it's like this.  Her grandmother's planning her a surprise birthday party for later today.  Only, she's already left, and we need to delay her.
No reason.  I'll be going.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see where this is going!  You want me to keep her here for a while, if she shows up?

replies.reply_text: Please!
Thank you so much, you're a great help!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Most of them!  Were you looking to go to a particular isle?

replies.reply_text: Not right now.  I was just curious.  I had a different question about the unicorns.
Actually, yes.  I was wondering about those Tranquility and Serenity Isles.  They sound very relaxing.
No, not really. I was just curious.  I guess I'll be on my way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes.  Quite relaxing.  You must be quite adventurous in order to be allowed there, though.  You know all those jobs people ask you to do?  You must have them all completed.  You even get an award!

replies.reply_text: I have completed them all!
Hmm...  I haven't done that yet.  I guess I'll go get to work.  Bye!
Really?  That's nuts!  Those are sooooo hard, though!
It was!  So, can you send me there, or how does this work?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, some people have finished all of them and gotten the award.  I'm sure you'll get there someday.  Just don't give up!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.
I guess I'll keep working on them.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'm sure on the unicorns would love to bring you there, but they do like their treats.  The sugar chunks are their favorite.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see.  So, if I bring a couple small sugar chunks, one of the unicorns will bring me there?
What?!?  Wow.  I do all this work to get all my quests completed and now I have to find sugar chunks??  Forget it.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, I'll go get some.  Bye!
I have some here.  Please take me to Serenity Isle!
Hmm...  Well, I'm not sure if I want to go yet.  I'll come back when I do.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Little Red Riding Hood
npc_list.admin_description: At her own house

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Hello!  How are you today?  I'm just starting out for the long, long trip to Grandmother's house.  I have a basket of goodies, and a beautiful, bright red hood, and I know how to get there all by myself and---

replies.reply_text: Whoa, there!  One thing at a time!  I'm fine, how are you?
(Yikes!  Who pulled this kid's chatty-string?!)  I'm fine.  But I'm busy now, gotta run!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm fine!  I'm just great!  I have my basket of goodies to bring to my grandma, and I'm going to go take them to her, because she's my grandmother and she needs goodies and you know goodies are hard to get when you're old like my grandmother and---

replies.reply_text: I get it!  I get it!  Does your grandmother live very far from here?
See you around, kid!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, she does! A long, long way! Past the Duckling and past the Pig and past the Princess and past the pretty horsies and Aladdin and all! And I have to go through three teleporters to get to her! I have to go East, then East, then South! Can you imagine? And I do it all by myself because I'm a big girl now! Aren't I terrific?

replies.reply_text: (I don't believe it!  She stopped on her own!) Yeah.  Whatever you say.  I hope your travels don't take you anywhere near the Big Bad Wolf.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Big Bad Wolf?  I'm not worried about the Big Bad Wolf.  Who's afraid of the Big Bad Wolf? Not me!  No way!  Not at all!  No sir, not one bit!  I'm not afraid of anything because I'm the bravest and---

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, okay!  Fine.  I'm sure you could talk him to death!  Go, see your grandma.  Have a good time.  Bye.
Look, kid.  Why don't you let me make the delivery for you?  I've got a nice, fast horse...

chatpoints.chat_text: No!

replies.reply_text: No?
Suit yourself!

chatpoints.chat_text: No!  It's my goodie basket and it's my grandmother and it's my job to get goodies to my grandmother and nobody's going to stop me so there!  Pthbtbtbtbtbt!

replies.reply_text: Why, you rude little...  Goodbye!
Oh, well, there was some hope. Well, you get going. I'll go with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: No!

replies.reply_text: Well, why not?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because only babies need someone to go with them to guard them from the Big Bad Wolf and I'm not a baby and I don't need guarding because I'm a big girl now and I can go there all by myself so there!

replies.reply_text: (......sigh.) Okay. Go ahead if you want. But I'm going to ride ahead anyway and make sure the Wolf is in his lair and your grandmother is safe.
Fine.  Enjoy your trip.  All alone.  Bye.
Tough.  I'm going.  East, east, south you said?  I'll find her!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Grandmother Hood
npc_list.long_description: A dear old thing, wrapped in a pink woolly shawl.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(In answer to your knock, a dear old lady, very shaky on her feet, beams at her visitor. In a raspy voice, she says:)
Oh, hello there, dear, come for a cup of tea?

replies.reply_text: Hello there!  Is there anything I can do for you, Grandmother?
Oh, I'm so glad to see you!
I'm back, Grandmother Hood!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you dear thing, no!  But thank you so kindly for asking!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll come by every now and then to see how you're doing.  Bye-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you dear?  Well, you look a little shaken.  Please come in and sit down.... There, now.  What's on your mind?

replies.reply_text: Grandmother, your granddaughter, Little Red Riding Hood, is on her way here right now with a basket full of goodies.

chatpoints.chat_text: She what?!  Oh, no.  Oh, dear, no!  Oh my stars and bars!

replies.reply_text: I know!  I offered to bring the goodies myself or at least accompany her, but she wouldn't have it, so she's on her way alone!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that child! She knew she wasn't supposed to leave for at least another two hours! Oh, what a disaster!

replies.reply_text: Yes, exactly!  And I'm very worried, because the Wolf and all...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Grandmother Riding Hood looks up at you with considerable worry.) Why, you don't think the Wolf told her, do you?

replies.reply_text: Uhmmm.... what?

chatpoints.chat_text: About the party!  About her surprise birthday party!  I just put the cake in the oven and I haven't even wrapped her present and... land sakes, she's already on her way...

replies.reply_text: But... but... what about the Wolf?!  Aren't you worried about him?

chatpoints.chat_text:
B.B. Wolf? Oh, don't be silly! We have a strictly enforced law up here you know. Nothing bad can happen to you on your birthday. Well, nothing too bad, anyway....
Please, you've got to do me a favor! Go out all the way along her route (and she wanders a bit), and anyone you can find, ask them to waylay her!

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding?  I've met that kid!  I don't think anyone could stand to be around her more than five minutes!
No thanks, I can't stand that kid myself.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I know, I know... but maybe if, with the right incentive, you know...  For example, the pigs love to eat wildflowers, and we don't have them up here.  The Pegasus Uniter, he loves honey and... Well, you understand, this is really important to me, won't you please help?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... no.  I'd have to get those things from Down Below, and it's hard enough getting up here as it is!  No thanks.  Bye.
All right.  Birthdays are important. I'll do what I can.
See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, welcome!  It's so good to see you!  Now, have you done as I asked?

replies.reply_text: I was able to get a few people to keep your granddaughter occupied for a while. (You go into detail about your travels.)
Uhm... sorry, I got distracted.  What did you want again?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Grandmother Riding Hood puts her fists on her hips.) You've forgotten already? For shame! Find some people on the way to my granddaughter's, and ask them to keep her with them for a while so I can finish getting her party ready!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Sorry.  Will do.
But Grandmother, the wolf... He said you invited him to the party!
Thanks!  I hope the party goes well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes! Of course I did, dear. He and I are bridge partners. We have a Cloud Isles championship, don't you know! We're quite a team! (Grandmother Hood beams.)

replies.reply_text: Right.  Okay...

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, and here she is, just in time! Welcome, Red!

Little Red Riding Hood: Grandmother! What big PRESENTS you have!

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!

npc_list.name: Paras
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 10

chatpoints.chat_text:
(There is a small mound in the center of the nest, and you begin to wonder if anyone has been here for a long time. Then, the mound shudders. Almost reflexively, you poke at it, and from within comes a voice that says:)

Go away!

replies.reply_text: Have it your way.
Sorry, but... are you all right in there?
I have your feathers and moonbeams!
Pardon me, what was it I was supposed to get again?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right?  Oh, for... No.  I'm not at all all right.  Please go away.

replies.reply_text: If you insist.  Bye now.
Uhm... Is there anything I could do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Help?  I'll say there's something you can do!  Go away and leave me to my misery.

replies.reply_text: Please come out! Whatever it is, it can't be that bad!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't be that bad?  Why of all the... Well!  Honestly!  I say...

replies.reply_text: (Getting off your horse, you kneel down and root through the ash. Inside, you find a beautiful, iridescent phoenix!) Really, I don't see what your problem is! You're a magnificent bird!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Magnificent? Magnificent?! Oh, for the love of... Look at me! Just look at me. Do you see any flight feathers? Even one?
(When the Phoenix stretches his wings, you realize that all the long primary and secondary flight feathers are... not there.)

replies.reply_text: Eww!  Ugly bird!  Here, you go back in your... nest thingy, and I'll just go!
Hmm... That is a problem.  But we can fix it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fix it!  And how, might one ask?

replies.reply_text: Sparkly feathers!  I've seen them up here.  They're just the right size--

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, but they're not mine, you see!  It's the principle of the thing.

replies.reply_text: Well, you can sit there and starve on principle, or you can let me get you feathers and let me help you!
Okay, I'll go get them.  Wait here.
Great!  Now you can fly around just fine!  See you later!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: What was it?  Well surely it was your idea in the first place, and you don't remember?!  Fourteen sparkling feathers and three moonbeams.  And do hurry!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there! (The Phoenix stretches his wings to show off his beautiful plumage.) Thank you for your help. It all worked out very well.

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear it!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Marisole
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 11
npc_list.long_description: Marisole is a pretty young woman who is generally cheerful and kind to everyone, but reveals little of herself. She even makes sure to hide her ears.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, there! Welcome to my little stretch of paradise! Please come in and sit down.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'd love to. You sure have interesting things in here. Is that giant family tree on the wall yours?
Thanks, but I'm just looking around. Bye.
Hi! What a beautiful island you have!

chatpoints.chat_text: Um... kinda. But enough about me. Have you had any grand adventures lately? I'm afraid I don't get out in the world much.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you leave it and travel yourself?
It's actually kinda boring travelling so much. You aren't missing anything. But you could try it if you really have the urge.
Speaking of travelling, I really have to go. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I could never! I know it sounds silly, but this island is my ki... er... my heritage. It's my duty to care for it, and all who reside here.

replies.reply_text: But... no one else lives on it but you.
If you say so. I need to get going. Thanks for the visit!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... no, not anymore, sadly. Though recently I've seen a wild horse wandering the meadows. A beautiful grey stallion who appears like a shimmering ghost in the distance! I've started calling him Rhavi. He must have washed up here from somewhere.

replies.reply_text: Well, a horse certainly makes a good companion. You should try to catch him!
A wild horse? Cool! I'm going to go try to catch him! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, no! I could never call myself a good ruler if I forced my subjects to serve! Or.. (cough)... I mean... I'd just like to be friends with the horse, but I'm not sure how to do it. (Marisole looks downcast.)

replies.reply_text: Have you tried feeding him?
Ruler? Subjects? What are you talking about?
You're weird. Everyone knows it's fun to catch horses. I'm outta here. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Marisole brightens.) That's a fabulous idea! Though, I don't really have anything special around here to feed him with, and since I can't leave.... I don't suppose you'd be willing to bring back some special food for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure! I don't mind running errands like that. What kind of feed did you have in mind?
I'm actually really busy right now. I'll have to come back later. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd love to give him some daisy hay and some honey oats. How about 5 of each?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, I'll get right to it!
Um, that actually sounds like a lot of work. I think I'll pass. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's so good of you! Here, take a little money for traveling expenses. Hurry back!

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! Did you get the special feed?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I forgot. Let me go do that now.
I can't remember what you said to get...
I have the special feed!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I asked for 5 bales of daisy hay and 5 bags of honey oats. How does that sound?

replies.reply_text: That's fine. I'll be back soon!
Glad I could help! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, again! Please come in and visit. Thanks so much for your help earlier, the wild horse and I are starting to become good friends!

replies.reply_text: I'm glad to hear it! But I have to go now. Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nothing.. nothing really. Just a figure of speech. Anyway, do you have any ideas on how to get the wild horse to like me?

replies.reply_text: You could try feeding him.
I think you're avoiding the subject. I'm just gonna go. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! I'm surprised you found your way here. Not many people do anymore.

replies.reply_text: Well, l'm going to go look around. Bye!
Robin sent me here. He wanted to give you a present. He thought it might help ease your loneliness here.
No problem! Hope you enjoy your harp!

npc_list.name: Rhavi
npc_list.long_description: Rhavi is a wild stallion who is shy of all strangers. He will not let you touch him.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The wild horse backs quickly away from you.)

replies.reply_text: Wait, I won't hurt you.... Okay, I won't bother you.

npc_list.name: Richard
npc_list.admin_description: testing

npc_list.name: Will
npc_list.admin_description: Second Will- After Handkerchief

chatpoints.chat_text: (He's sitting on a rock when you approach, staring at what seems to be a very old, worn picture.) Oh- it's you. Hello again. How are you doing?

replies.reply_text: Oh, good, but I'm kind of busy. See you later!
I'm doing fine, how about you?
Not bad... Um, have you been sitting here this whole time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm all right. (He looks misty-eyed as he puts the picture away.)

replies.reply_text: Well, that's good.
You seem sort of sad to me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's just that... I haven't had any luck finding the girl I told you about. Her name was Rose, and we were going to be married when I came back from my voyage, but it's been so long since I left... I doubt anyone even believed I was alive. I've searched and searched, but I just can't find her. Maybe I never will... (He sniffs and looks away from you.) Anyway, I've just ended up back here where I started.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's sad. I'm sorry to hear that. Here, I think you could use this... (You hand him the handkerchief.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Here...? (He looks around, misty-eyed, at the beach.) Oh, no. I've been all over actually, but, well... I've come back here.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess the view of the ocean is nice. It's a good place to think.
Why? Is something wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes... (He seems distracted.)

replies.reply_text: Well... I'll leave you, I guess. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you... See, I just don't- (He stops suddenly and stares at the handkerchief in disbelief.) But... but... this is Rose's handkerchief! I'm sure of it!

replies.reply_text: Yep, it is! She gave it to me.
It sure is! I can take you to her right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He jumps up in excitement.) She did?! You know her? Can you take me to her?

replies.reply_text: Of course!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wonderful!! Thank you! This is just too good to be true, it is. Lead on, my friend!

replies.reply_text: Okay, follow me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hullo! I do apologize for not seeing you there.

replies.reply_text: No problem - gotta go. Bye!
That's okay. What were you doing?
That's okay.  I'm back with the glass slipper you were looking for.
I found a clue about your glass slipper. There are webbed feet near the area where you were resting!
That's all right.  I was looking for something for you, right?
Hullo! I'm hoping you might be able to help me. (You explain what Astrid told you of Dalton and his mysterious companion.) I don't suppose that rings a bell?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was looking for something. It is something I must find.  I must have it.

replies.reply_text: Good luck with that.  Watch where you are going, though.
What is it? Maybe I could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, see - oh, this is most embarassing - it is a shoe.

replies.reply_text: A shoe? You gotta be kidding me. You're as nuts as everything else in this wacked-out place. I gotta get out of here.
A shoe? Why would you be looking for a shoe?

chatpoints.chat_text: This is a special shoe. It is my one true love's glass slipper! I have to find it so I can find her!!

replies.reply_text: Wait a minute... Let me see if I understand this. You are looking for a shoe that belongs to your true love, but you don't know who that is until you find the shoe?? Oy, I'm confused.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it is like this. My father threw a ball to find me a wife (something about needing an heir for the kingdom) and invited all the eligible women in the kingdom.

replies.reply_text: And?
This sounds like it is going to take a while.  I'll come back for the rest another time.

chatpoints.chat_text: There was a girl... a beautiful maiden that arrived. We danced all night and I fell in love. But right as the clock struck midnight, she ran away! All that was left was a single glass slipper.

replies.reply_text: So... you do have the slipper?

chatpoints.chat_text: No. I stopped to rest here and took a short nap. When I woke up, it was gone! I don't have any idea where it could be.

replies.reply_text: I hope you find it and your true love.
I could help you find it, if you would like. I could look around and see if I find anything.
Okay.  I will let you know what I find.
Glad I could help! Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Webbed feet?? I wonder where those tracks could have come from? Although... I do remember hearing of an Ugly Duckling. Go and find this creature at once and inquire as to the whereabouts of my glass slipper!

replies.reply_text: Woah! Check the attitude there, Your Highness - you can go and inquire with him yourself.
I'll do that for you, but a please would have been a nice addition. (Wave while walking away.)

chatpoints.chat_text: You were looking around here for clues as to where the glass slipper went.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go look now.
Well, thanks anyhow.

npc_list.name: Rose
npc_list.admin_description: Second Rose- after agreeing to take Will to her
npc_list.long_description: Rose is a fitting name for this maiden. She has flowers in her long golden hair and beautiful, delicate jewelry. She is wearing a long, flowing skirt and a white lacy blouse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again- (She gasps as the sailor steps out behind you.) Will?! Is it really you?! (She rushes over to him.)

replies.reply_text: Well, I think my work here is done.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, how can we ever repay you?! Here, take all of this. (She gives you some gems. Will beams at you and from his pouch, takes out another $3000.)

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much; I'm just happy to see you two reunited!
Cool, thanks. I'll leave you two now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Will you come visit us again? I think we'll be living somewhere near Cantle Meadows, we've both always liked it there so much. I hope we see you soon! Goodbye and thank you again!

replies.reply_text: Sure! Bye for now!

npc_list.name: Rose
npc_list.admin_description: Cottage Rose after finished Sailor Quest
npc_list.long_description: Rose is a fitting name for this maiden. She has flowers in her long golden hair and beautiful, delicate jewelry. She is wearing a long, flowing skirt and a white lacy blouse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I'm doing wonderfully!  I was going to make a fruit salad, but I'm quite low on fresh fruits.

replies.reply_text: You are?  I would love to gather some for you.  What exactly did you have in mind?
I am really not in a berry-picking mood right now.  Maybe I'll come by later.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again! It's certainly wonderful to see you.

replies.reply_text: It's nice to see you, too.  And look at this lovely cottage you and Will have!
It's nice to see you, too.  And look at this lovely cottage you and Will have!  I'll come back and visit again when I have more time.  Bye!
Hi Rose. I'm back with the ingredients you needed.
Hi!  I forgot what I was getting for you....
Hi Rose!  I thought I would just stop by to see how you are doing.
Hi Rose.  I have this list from you, but I can't really remember what I was doing.
Hi Rose!  I'm back with some fruit!
Hi.  What else did you need for your fruit salad?
What was I doing for you again?
Hello.  I have the cream and marshmallows for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! We do love living here. We can't ever repay you for all of your kindness. Everything is (hesitates) almost perfect.

replies.reply_text: Almost? Why, whatever could not be perfect? You have Will back and a lovely home.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know, and it seems so silly. But... it's just that I want to make Will his favorite dish and I can't seem to find all the ingredients I need.

replies.reply_text: Well, then, it's a good thing you two are so happy together. I don't think he'll even miss it.  You'll be okay without it. Bye!
What are you making for him that you can't find the ingredients for?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a Southwestern Cactus Salad.  He first ate it on his travels and has loved it ever since. But there are two ingredients I just don't have.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's too bad.  Perhaps next time you're shopping, you can ask your grocer to get them in for you. Talk to you later. Bye!
Which two items are you missing? Perhaps I would be able to get them for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: The items I still need are nopales and cilantro leaves, and I can't find them anywhere!

replies.reply_text: Nopales? What are those?
Perhaps you should check the stores. Gotta go now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nopales are prickly pear cactus pads. They are very delicious, but I wouldn't have any idea who would have a jar of them.

replies.reply_text: Cacti, huh? Well, I suppose Desert Isle would be a good place to check around on. What was that other thing you needed?
Me neither, but if I hear of something in my travels, I'll let you know. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cilantro. The recipe calls for fresh leaves, but it also says you can substitute dried cilantro. So I suppose a cup of that would be fine. I don't know if any of the food stores would carry it.

replies.reply_text: This is looking to be quite a bit of searching for these items.  I think I'll just come back later.
Tell you what.  Why don't I check around on Desert Isle and the food stores and see if I can get you those two last items.
Okay, see you soon! Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's great! You have the nopales and the cilantro?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Here they are.
Thanks! If you ever need anything else, just let me know. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need nopales and cilantro.  You mentioned checking Desert Isle for the nopales and the food stores for the dried cilantro.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll get right on that.  Bye!
I'll get right on this.  Bye!
Grapes?!?  I think I remember where to get those.  Some small isle?  Anyway, I'll be back once I get the fruits you need.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were collecting those fruits for me so I can make a fruit salad for Will.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go find more right now.
I have some right now!
Do you remember where I can get those grapes?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  I remember they grow on a small isle in the south, but that's really all I know.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Let's see what you have.

replies.reply_text: Actually, I need to go out collecting.  I'll be back when I have what you need.
Here are the oranges.
Here are the apples.
Here are the pears.
Here are the bananas.
Here are the grapes.
Here are the berries.
That should be everything!
I have some more.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I have some others.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I have some others.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I have some others.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I have some others.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I have some others.
That's it for now.  I'll be back when I have more.
That should be everything.
I really need a break.  Maybe I'll stop by later and finish helping you.  Bye!
What do you you need?  I'm up for more errand-running.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, my grandmother always had marshmallows in her fruit salad, so I really will need some marshmallows.  I'll also need some cream to make whipped cream.

replies.reply_text: I could get those things for you.
That sounds like far too much work.  Good luck!
Marshmallows?!  They are nasty in fruit salad!  I will have nothing to do with that!  Bye.
I'll head out now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed you to get a jar of cream from Cinnamon and 10 marshmallows to finish off my fruit salad.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll get those things now.  Bye.
Thanks!  Bye.

npc_list.name: Will
npc_list.admin_description: Cottage Will after finished Sailor Quest - should I make will retired and library??

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our happy home -  come in!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Just passing through.
Hi there, Will.  I wonder if you know of a healing salve that would be good for chafed hands?

chatpoints.chat_text: I remember that we used something that smelled horrible while I was a sailor, but I don't have any idea where it came from.

replies.reply_text: Darn.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. How are you today?

replies.reply_text: Fine, but I gotta keep exploring.  Bye!
Fine, but I gotta know.  Why do you live in a pumpkin?
Hey, I'm back with those things you wanted.
What was I looking for again?
Not bad, thanks for asking. Mother Cat and her three kittens could be better. Would you happen to be doing any remodeling? There's a lot of banging going on and its driving Mother Cat batty.
Is there anyone else you can suggest that might know about the banging?
Wasn't there someone else you said I should talk to, other than Mother Goose?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, see, there was this girl...

replies.reply_text: I think I know where this is going, no need to continue. Bye.
What happened to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: We got married! But, she wouldn't stay with me unless she could live in a pumpkin.

replies.reply_text: A pumpkin, huh? Well, to each their own, I guess. Have a happy life.
Really? Well, where is she now?

chatpoints.chat_text: She still won't live here! Says it must be "properly decorated" before she will move in. There are certain things she wants to make it look nicer.

replies.reply_text: What sort of things? I could probably help you find some of it.
Sounds like you better hire an interior decorator, then. Bye.
Okay, I'll go and get started on it.
Hope she likes it. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 15 pinches of pixie dust and 15 moonbeams. You can find them scattered around up here on the clouds.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know exactly how she feels! Its driving me batty too and I do wish it would stop. I haven't a clue where the noise is coming from. Have you talked to Mother Goose?

replies.reply_text: Why yes I have!
Not yet, but I'm planning on doing just that. Thanks for pointing me in her direction!

chatpoints.chat_text: The only people l can think of is Mother Goose and the old guy Larry.

replies.reply_text: Larry?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup - the grumpy dude that hangs out by the sparkling trees just east of here. Maybe he knows something.

replies.reply_text: I'll talk to him now. Thanks for your help!

npc_list.name: Tony Grocer
npc_list.admin_description: Thanks, got 'em!
npc_list.long_description: Tony Grocer is a little bear of a man, happy, loud and friendly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on in!  Get in here where it's warm!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around, thanks.
Hi.  I need five liters of skim milk.  Do you carry it?  I don't see any, but Nicolette seemed to think you might.
Hi, Tony.  Say, you don't carry cheese, by any chance?
Hi Tony! Yorick sent me to pick up some equipment for the Horse Isle Battalioneers?
Hi there. I'm embarassed to ask, but would you have any fruit that's maybe bruised and not as fresh as it should be? It's for Mino.
Hello.  I need 24 empty bottles and some labels for the bottles.  Do you have that?
Where would you like me to put this bushel of apples? Bruno sent them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Goat's milk okay?  That's all I've got.

replies.reply_text: Goat's milk?  Uh.... I guess so.  It's for paint.
Goat's milk?  Uh.... I guess so.  It's for paint.

chatpoints.chat_text: Paint?  Oh, paint.  Oh, yes.  Here you go.  That'll be $500.

replies.reply_text: What?  No thanks!  That's much too much.  Goodbye.
Well... Silver Mary promised me a big reward at the end of this so... okay, here you go.
Oh, wait.  I already got some.  Sorry.  I guess I have a bad memory.  Bye!
Oh, wait.  I already got some.  Sorry.  I guess I have a bad memory.  Bye!
Thanks.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cheese?  Well, I got some cheddar and a little domestic Camembert.  It's a bit runny, though.

replies.reply_text: No, that won't do.  I need some gourmet cheese.  Red Windsor, Stilton, Emmental, Gruyère...

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you, crazy?  Why are you askin' me for that kind of stuff?

replies.reply_text: Well, you got in some fresh goat's milk for Nicolette, so I thought you must know someone with goats, and most people who raise goats make cheese...
Sheesh!  Just asking!  Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, you draw a lot of conclusions, don't ya?  Well, yeah, I know someone who raises goats, but if they make cheese, it's news to me.

replies.reply_text: Well, on the off chance that they do make cheese, can you tell me who they are?
Okay, thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: For paint?  What do you need milk for paint for?  You've got cans full of paint on your horse, I can see them from here.  You don't need it.  No, no milk for paint.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: So, hockey season must be getting ready to start back up!

replies.reply_text: Yep! Do you have the equipment that Yorick needed? I think it was a goalie mask and the helmet combos for the team?
I'm headed there now. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you, crazy?  Why are you askin' me for that kind of stuff? This is a general store. Go ask at a food store. Gesh!

replies.reply_text: Gulp! Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've got the bottles.  Don't have any labels, though.  You'll have to get those from somewhere else.  The bottles will cost $2000.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll take the bottles, then, and get the labels elsewhere.  Do you have any suggestions where to look?
Hmmm.  Okay, thanks.
Thanks a lot!
Thanks! And enjoy those apples!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do indeed! I don't have much use for it. Keeping things cold here is not a problem! You want something frozen, just set it out in the snow! I can sell it to you for $500.

npc_list.name: Rapunzel
npc_list.short_description: A beautiful girl with really long hair!

chatpoints.chat_text: (You hear a voice talking very faintly to you and, after looking around, notice a window far above you. A girl leans out of the window.) Hello!

replies.reply_text: Hi there! Why are you way up there?
That is too far for me to yell. Hello and goodbye!
Hi. What was it you wanted me to get for you again?
Rapunzel, Rapunzel, Let down your hair - I have brought your hairpiece back!
Hello again! I hope you are still enjoying that hairpiece!

chatpoints.chat_text: I live in this tower, waiting for my prince to come along.

replies.reply_text: Well, to each his, err, her own, I guess. Have fun waiting!
Oh! Well, how will he be able to get to you when he comes along?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not a problem - watch! (A long, long, really long braid of blond hair comes flying out the window and lands at your feet.) He just climbs up this.

replies.reply_text: That's insane.  Where did you get that much hair?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have never cut it! I like having hair this long, but sometimes it is a bother trying to make it look pretty.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you just buy some nice hairpieces?
That does sound like a problem. Better put some on your birthday list this year. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love to, but I can't leave this tower, and I have heard of a craftsman that does the most beautiful and elegant work. I would love to have something made by him.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, I would love to help you out, but I am not really available right now. Sorry.
I suppose I could go and get something for you. What would you like and where do I go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle is a master metal weaver. I would like him to make me an intricately woven metal hairpiece that could be woven into my braid.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I can do that - but it might be a while before I am back.
That sounds like quite a chore. Maybe I will stop back by later.
Be back soon.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would like Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle to make a beautiful hairpiece for me.

replies.reply_text: Ahh that's right - be back with it soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I am.  Thanks again for getting it for me.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Bye.
Thanks! And good luck with your prince!

npc_list.name: Renard
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must begin at CP18.
npc_list.long_description: Once a magnificent red fox, Monsieur Renard's face is now flecked with grey.  Nevertheless he regards you keenly, perhaps trying to size up your brainpower, as you approach.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah. bonjour, bienvenu. Comment ça va?

replies.reply_text: Et vous, monsieur? Tres bién, merci!
Um... What?
Hi.  I'm ready to go back to Dust Isle now.
Hello.  Can you tell me where on these isles I might find any cheese?
I've changed my mind, M. Renard.  I'll do my best to get your cheese for you.  Where should I look?
Hello! Bonjour! I have cheeses for you, M. Renard!
Hello, uhm... I was doing something for you, but I seem to have forgotten what it was.  Could you possibly....?
Bonjour, Monsieur Renard!  Say, you don't happen to have, or know where a kid named Gina would have left a box, would you?
Quest testing - Ariela please.
Quest testing - Need to give cheese to Renard

chatpoints.chat_text: Il fait beau, ce jour, n'est pas? And how do you find my lovely island?

replies.reply_text: It's very nice.  It must be very cozy here for you.
Well, I asked... uhm... Oh.  It's nice.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The fox looks up at you very reproachfully.) You do not even understand that I welcomed you as a friend? (He shakes his head.) And what brings you out so far, eh?

replies.reply_text: Nothing much.  Just wanted to see if there was anything interesting out here.
Nothing.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is my, how would you say, my place of retirement. Ah, I was one of the great ones in my day. Maintenant, in my retirement, I come to live here.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, I won't disturb your leisure, then.  Good day, Monsieur.
Retirement?  Might I ask what you are retired from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Mais, bien sûr, but of course!

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  Okay, well, please tell me about yourself.
I don't have time.  Perhaps some other day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then, now that you are here, I will of course tell you about myself, eh? Alors, I am Monsier Renard, the greatest, and... le plus rusé, the most cunning of foxes ever to be followed by the hounds!

replies.reply_text: You were chased by packs of hounds?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, absolument! For fifteen years, I led them, how they say, "the merry chase." I was one of the lucky ones, comprenez vous? Each time, I escaped them. And now, when I come to the age of retirement, as you see, I come to live here.

replies.reply_text: It's a beautiful spot.  But it's so out of the way!  Why did you pick this place?

chatpoints.chat_text: Vraiment, is it not absolutely clear? It is the grapes that grow here! Not a sour one among them! Everything here, it is parfait, perfect for the raising of the grapes! Ah, an idyllic existence, would you not say? Indeed it is, but for one thing.

replies.reply_text: I think I'll leave now, before this turns into a quest.
A vixen, you mean?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, the company of les plus belles renardes, yes, sometimes I miss that, oui. Mais non, that is not what I miss the most. Ah well. One cannot have everything, n'est pas?

replies.reply_text: Well, what is it, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: It is le fromage! The cheese! Ah, I remember, raiding the store-rooms of the farms! And there I would find the wonderful fromages de la belle France and elsewhere! Brie, Roquefort, Pont l'Evêque, Port Salut, Savoyard, Saint-Paulin, Carré de l'Est, Bresse-Bleu, Boursin, Camembert....

replies.reply_text: Yes, I get the idea.
Ew... I hate cheese.  Thanks for the company, but I'll just go.

chatpoints.chat_text: ...Gouda, Edam, Caithness, Smoked Austrian, Japanese Sage Derby, Wensleydale...

replies.reply_text: All right!  Okay!  Would you like me to go see if I can find you some cheese, then?
No, I was only kidding.  Bye.
Sure!  No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainement! You need only to find me and ask!

replies.reply_text: Thanks. Au revior.
Thanks, I will.  When I'm done, will you be able to send me back to Dust Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Alors, mais c'est incroyable! I asked that you would get an old fox some cheese, n'est pas? You have already forgotten, eh?

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I'll get right on that.
As it happens, I ran into someone who at least knows someone who has goats!  I'll go ask them!  Can you send me back to Dust Isle now?
Hmmm.... No, don't know anybody like that.  But I'll ask around.  Can you send me back to Dust Isle now?
Yes, I remember meeting someone who has some cows.  I'll go ask them.
I've got some ideas how to proceed, but I'd like to look around your island a little more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Vraiment? You have with you the cheese, la plus bon fromage? Please, let me see it! Let me sniff it!

replies.reply_text: Here you go.  The cheese in the paper is Brunost, and the one in the wax is Prim.  Or at least, that's what she tried to make.  It was her first attempt.....
Merci beaucoup, Monsieur! Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! Look who it is! C'est mon ami, mon ami des fromages! Welcome! And what can I do for you today, then?

replies.reply_text: I'm just here to look around, thanks!
Can you send me back to Dust Isle?
Bonjour, Monsieur Renard!  Say, you don't happen to have, or know where a kid named Gina would have left a box, would you?
Nothing much, I'm just wandering the isle, like I do. Say... you look a little sad. Is everything all right?
Monsieur Renard, can you tell me again where your children went off to?
Monsieur Renard, I've spoken with all your children! (Tell him all the messages you've heard from his children.)
Rumor has it that you've found something strange on your beach?
Would you be so kind as to tell me what I was doing for you?
Excuse Monsieur Renard. Can you tell me again where to find Ariela?

chatpoints.chat_text: A box, you say?  I have no box, no.  What is it you look for, eh?

replies.reply_text: (You tell Renard about the quest that Gina has given you, and explain about the "Box with a Fox.")

chatpoints.chat_text: No no no, there has been no child here, no no.  No one left.... hmmmmmmm.... But just a second now, let me think, let me think.......... Ah, yes!  I think, yes, I think I may have seen something!  On the southern Sand Isle, just beside the bridge, I noticed there, a picture of a fox.  Was it on a box?  I didn't stop to see.  But you go look there!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, but that I cannot say. Alors, but I was not looking, so I for certain, I did not know. But you will go look and see what you can find, d'accord?

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks, Monsieur!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sad? Moi? No, assurement, not sad. But, perhaps, a little wistful.

replies.reply_text: Wistful? What's on your mind, Renard?
Oh, is that it? Well, I hope you get over it soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, it is that it is a hard thing for a fox of my age to have such... children!

replies.reply_text: Children? I didn't know you were a father.
Do you have kids? I never knew. I've never seen them around on this isle.
Children? (You think of other foxes you have known.) I can believe it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oui, yes, a most proud papa am I! Four beautiful cubs I have, and I could not be more pleased with them. Sauf that they do not call, they do not write, they do not communicate with their papa!

replies.reply_text: So I take it they've moved away from home now?
Funny, that's what my mom always says about me. So they've gone pretty far off, huh?
Ohhhh no. I see where this is going. I am not going anywhere to track down someone's prodigal children. I hope they write you soon. Me, I'm outta here.  I'd like to hitch a ride to Dust please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oui, very far. They all left some six months ago to seek their fortunes. And have I heard from them? (You suspect that under the fur, Renard's face is slowly turning scarlet.) Non, I do not!

replies.reply_text: Well, I have to feel sorry for you. I bet they've just gotten excited about being on their own, forgetting you might be worried. Maybe I can track them down for you.
That's rough, buddy.

chatpoints.chat_text: (A twinkle comes into his eye.) You would find my wayward renardeaux, then?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'm really an excellent finder.

chatpoints.chat_text: Magnifique! Alors! Well, to find them.

replies.reply_text: What?! You mean you don't even know where they are?
(Repeat his words back to yourself.) All right, I guess I can go with that. I'll be back once I've found them!

chatpoints.chat_text: Non, assurement I do. Indeed, I have just told you!

replies.reply_text: Augh! You hardly told me anything!
Well, can you tell me again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, listen most carefully.  One left the home for fun, was the mane motivation. One went to seek what she felt she was dew. One stowed away, because he wouldn't shell out for the boat ride. And one... well, she just got lost. You'll find them all on the rocks.

replies.reply_text: Okay... all right, I've got it. I think. Maybe. I hope, anyhow...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah... (Thinks for a moment, a satisfied smile on his face.)

replies.reply_text: You're very welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: Merci beaucoup, Monsieur! It pleases me that you would help such a creature as she. If you would please, check the eastern beach.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over there now.
Oh do tell! I love to hear about interesting and beautiful creatures. I promise not to think of you as crazy.
Well, I've certainly had my fill of crazy people, so I think I'll just head on off this isle - very, very quickly!

chatpoints.chat_text: This creature - this Sirène of the sea - she is most beautiful! But I can not approach her. She trembles at the sight of me. Perhaps you can help?

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to try. Tell me where to find this... Sirène and I'll head right over.
Uh, siren of the sea? I've heard their song draws you to them. And then you drown. So, no thank you. I am so gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oui, yes, you were going to see about the most beautiful creature on the beach east of here.

replies.reply_text: Oh right! On my way.

chatpoints.chat_text:

chatpoints.chat_text:

chatpoints.chat_text:
