Right.  That makes a lot of sense, I suppose.  Do you think you can stop stealing money from me if maybe I offer to buy you some more bananas?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well, I never thought of that before.  I suppose we could do that.  But you will have to get bananas for everyone else first, and then we can negotiate a treaty with the Monkey Thieves Guild.

replies.reply_text: Yes, anything to get you guys off my back!
No.  I think we're done here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yay!  So first, you will need 25 bananas. Take 5 of them to Haku.  He lives in the bank in Hotton.  He'll let you know where to go next, but pay attention because he's not likely to repeat himself!

replies.reply_text: Okay, but I thought you said they didn't understand English?
No way.  This is too sneaky for even me!
All righty, then.  I'll be back when I'm finished!

chatpoints.chat_text: Who have you seen so far?

replies.reply_text: I saw Haku in Hotton, Kuna in Appleton, Unama in Wington, and Akun in a Christmas tree.  Who's left?

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to see Tahaku.  He's our strongest member, because he hangs out at the wishing wells and catches everyone's wishing coins!  He's a genius, I tell ya!

replies.reply_text: That's horrible!  I can't believe you steal people's wishes!?  And I can't even believe I am helping you sneaky monkeys!  Well, I've come this far.  Where can I find Tahaku, specifically?
I think I'm losing karma from helping you this much! I'm gonna split... like a banana on ice cream!
Great. Thanks a bunch. I hope this is the last of all this monkeying around! (You leave Matata mumbling to yourself.)

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for the monkeys in the Monkey Thieves Guild starting with Haku at the Hotton's bank.  You might have to look really hard for us monkeys.  We tend to be very sneaky and hide a lot!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, right, I forgot. I feel like a chimp, I mean, chump right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Last I heard, he was hanging out in the tree next to the wishing well on this island.  Look high, low, and around the well.  Maybe use them fancy eyeballs you have!  But, you know, at least you don't have that far to go this time.

replies.reply_text: Fancy eyeballs?  Yeah, right.  Thanks, Matata.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, sure, kid.  But I need to discuss it with the rest of the Guild, so come back later.

replies.reply_text: Ooooooooookay.  I guess I'll come back later, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  You've come to stand up for Cheeky to be in the Guild, have you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have.  Just because he's a little...different...doesn't mean he can't play with the rest of you monkeys.
Actually no, I was just kidding.  Ha ha ha.  Funny joke, right?  I'll see you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: But....he's BLUE!!! (Matata starts jumping up and down, squawking in jibberish noises you think might be laughter. )

replies.reply_text: Well, of course he's blue!  He's a very sad monkey.
You make a good point. I've had more than my share of monkey business and monkey puns.  Later.

chatpoints.chat_text: HAAA hahaha! SAD??!!! That's so funny! OooooOoooo EEEEEEK eeek eeek! (Matata rolls to the ground in laughter.)

replies.reply_text: Stop it!  It's not funny!  Cheeky is different and has every right to be in the Monkey Thieves Guild because he is a monkey, too!
You're right!  It's very funny now that I think about it!  Hahaha!  Thanks for the laugh!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo oh oh that's rich!  I needed a good laugh.  Ha!  Thank you oo ooo.  Oh.  Okay, so what were you saying?

replies.reply_text: I was saying that you need to let Cheeky into the Guild.  It would make his day, I know it!
Nevermind.  I'll just come back when you're done laughing at the expense of others.
Thank you, Matata.  I expect this will help with the resolution of our agreement.

npc_list.name: Emma
npc_list.long_description: Emma is a hale, hearty, no-nonsense type of person.  Somewhat gruff and used to being in charge of things, she expects everyone she meets to be competent as well.

chatpoints.chat_text: He's nuts.  Nuts, I tell you!

replies.reply_text: Uhm... Hello?
Who?  King Phil?  Yeah, we knew that.  What's up?
I'm back, Emma!
Emma!  I've got the seedlings!
Hello again, Emma, how's it going?
I've got all the logs, Emma. Where would you like them?
Uhm, sorry Emma, where was I going again?
Hi Emma.  I brought you those seedlings already.  Was that everything?
Hi Emma!  I was wondering if I could ask you a question?
Emma, King Phil granted the petition!
Hi Emma.  I brought the sugar and grasshoppers.
Oh, I was going to go petition King Phil.  Could you send me to Hotzeplotz?
...I'll take your word on that. Right now I'm more focused on chocolate than nuts. I'm here to pick up Olivia's order.

chatpoints.chat_text: I mean, the pay's great and everything but there's no way I can do this! I mean, at the very least he could have gotten me an island with a nice tropical climate, but noooooooo....

replies.reply_text: Uhm... Hi there, I'm here to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you poor thing, you.  Did he tell you what this is all about?

replies.reply_text: All he said was that I was supposed to put myself at the disposal of the Chocolatière Royal.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh.  I see.  That'd be me, then.  Hello.  I'm Emma.  Nice to meet you.

replies.reply_text: Hello.  So what do you need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, King Phil has charged me with the Royal Task of setting up a Chocolate Farm. But not just any one. From scratch. I have to build a greenhouse, get supplies, get chocolate and vanilla plants, grow them, harvest and ferment the beans and eventually make chocolate... sigh. He's lucky he's paying me so well!

replies.reply_text: So, I guess I'm supposed to help you round up all these supplies then.
Oooo...kay.  I see where this is going.  This is going to be a long, strange trip, right?  I'll pass.  King Phil will have to find someone else.
Oh, I really, really don't want to do something like this just now.  But I suppose it's my duty as a Knight of the Realm...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, since you've got horses, yeah, that would be nice, you know?

replies.reply_text: Isn't chocolate poisonous to horses?  I know it's poisonous to dogs and cats...
Okay, so what do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yeah, if you let them eat twenty pounds of it at once...

replies.reply_text: Okay.  So, what do you want done first?

chatpoints.chat_text:
First of all, I have to get a greenhouse. I have no idea where on these isles to get a greenhouse. But see if you can find someone who might be able to build me one, and ask them... hang about...
(Emma pulls out a pad and scribbles something.) Just a minute there, hold on, almost done...

replies.reply_text: Take your time...
Okay, I'll find an architect for you.  Can you send me... off the island?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah, I can do that.  Want to go back to Phil?  Or else I can send you to Hoof Isle.

replies.reply_text: I'd like to go back to Phil's, thanks.
I'd like to go to Hoof Isle, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again, there.  Were you able to find me an architect?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I was, and I have some architectural plans here for you.
No, I couldn't find anyone.  Are you sure you don't know where I might find a builder?

chatpoints.chat_text: Awww, there's gotta be one somewhere, somebody must have built all this stuff!  Jungle Isle has some new development on it, why not ask there?

replies.reply_text: That's an awfully long way to go!
That's an awfully long way to go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh well....

replies.reply_text: Okay, see you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yeah, for ordinary people, maybe, but not for a Knight of the Realm! (guffaw!)

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, I'm going.
You're right!  It is my duty to take up quests as a Knight of the Realm!  I am off, good lady, and fair fortune be yours!
I think I've got it all here.
No, I haven't gotten all the wood yet.  I'll work on it, though.  Can you send me off the island?
Okay...  What next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now I need compost.  But I'm having Phil -- His Majesty -- bring that over.  So, I need someone to go pick up the seedlings I ordered.  They're at Rose Thorne's Flower Shop in Hotton.  Now be really careful with them!  They're rare, and they're expensive!  Don't worry, they're paid for!

replies.reply_text: Oh good.  I'll go get them now.  Please send me back off the island.

chatpoints.chat_text: You do?  Wonderful!  Let me see, let me see!

replies.reply_text: Here they are!
Glad you like them!  Is that everything?

chatpoints.chat_text: For now, yeah.  Can't do anything else until the greenhouse is up and these little plants grow.  Come back in a year's time, and I may have more for you to do!

replies.reply_text: A year?!
Wow.  Gee, thanks!  Can you send me off the island now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not too bad, not too bad.  The seedlings are doing fine and as you can see the greenhouse is under construction.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Can you send me back now?
That's great!  Well, I think I'll wander for a bit before heading out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, back are you?  Great!  Have you got greenhouse plans for me?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  Sure you don't know where I can find an architect?  No, hunh?  Okay, I'll keep looking.  Can you send me off the island again?
Yes, I do!  Vern drew these up!  What do you think?
I already gave them to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, so you did.  How about the logs, then, have you got those?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, I'm working on it.  I'll go get those now.  Could you send me off the isle so I can collect them?
Sure do!  Here they are!  Where do you want them stacked?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sigh!) I told you where to go! To Rose Thorne in Hotton, to get my cocoa and vanilla seedlings.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Right.  Sorry.  Please send me to another island now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds to me like you just did!

replies.reply_text: Oh! Well, ummmm yeah, I guess I did. But the question I wanted to ask was if you knew where I could buy, or if you could make, chocolate-covered grasshoppers?
Well, if you're going to be rude about it, I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: You've got to be kidding me! (shudders) To each his own I guess ...I don't think you can buy them anywhere, but I could probably make them here. You might want to talk to King Phil and petition for the use of my services. It's customary with royalty.

replies.reply_text: What?! Are you serious? Whatever - that is so lame. Forget I even asked.
Petition King Phil? I guess I can go talk to him and see what he would want then.
Hopefully I'll be back soon! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent!  I have gone through my inventory and I have everything except 25 small sugar chunks and 25 grasshoppers.  I will need you to bring those to me before I can make the chocolate-covered grasshoppers. They don't require the special chocolate that is still growing so you're in luck!

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can go get those! Can you send me back to to King Phil's now?
I don't want to finish it now.  Can you just send me back to King Phil's?
Thanks Emma! Could you send me to Hoof Isle now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Surprised she sent you- the last time she sent someone else to pick up her chocolate, that person ate it. I hope you won't be doing that. Now, she paid half up front, so it's $1000.

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
I... sort of spent that. I'll be back.

Thanks Emma! This smells delightful, but don't worry... it'll all get to Olivia without the teeniest nibble! (Inhale the rich scent of the chocolate, and think to yourself: Hmmm, maybe she won't notice a teeny nibble...)

npc_list.name: Murukan
npc_list.long_description: Murukan is one of the three guardians of Katukilal, the Spirit of the Jungle.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The tall, shimmering lion is looking at you with challenging eyes. He seems to be debating on whether or not to attack you.)

replies.reply_text: Erm, excuse me... Are you Murukan the War Lion, Guardian of Katukilal?
Whoa... Easy, big kitty! (Back away slowly)

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lion begins to growl deep in his throat.) How do know that name?

replies.reply_text: I was sent by Kiah, who lives in Rainy Meadows. I have medicine for Katukilal.

chatpoints.chat_text: And she thinks you worthy of delivering it, does she? (The lion's chest rumbles as he looks you up and down.) You must prove your worth to me. Are you willing to accept a task?

replies.reply_text: Uh, I'm not sure... What is the task?
As long as it doesn't involve me being your dinner!
Yes, I expected as much. Just tell me what you want me to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murukan's eyes narrow dangerously. His chest swells and then releases a mighty roar. His tail lashes back and forth as he appears to consider attacking.) You are a fool. Either accept the task, or leave while I will still allow it.

replies.reply_text: Umm... I think I'll choose the one where I leave... Goodbye!
I'm sorry. I accept the task. Just tell me what you want me to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: (His eyes glitter as he speaks, flexing his great claws in the jungle floor.) You must bring me the Lost Ring of the Tumetai.

replies.reply_text: Find something that's lost in this jungle? No, thank you!
I'll do it. Do you know where I should look?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would suggest you begin by asking the Tumetai themselves. Find the ring and bring it back to me. (The lion gives another mighty roar. You are obviously dismissed.)

replies.reply_text: I'll find it! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lion paces up to you.) Have you found the ring?

replies.reply_text: Well.... not exactly.... Could you remind me where I'm supposed to look?
Not yet... I'll go get it now. (You hasten away before Murukan can get angry.)
Yes, I have it here!
Yes, I have it here!
I have it this time, I'm sure of it!
I have it this time, I'm sure of it!
Yes, I believe I have the right one this time.
Yes, I believe I have the right one this time.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lion flattens his ears in anger.) Talk to the Tumetai in their village north of here. Now go, and don't return again without the ring!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, sorry! I'll go now.
Thank you very much!
Do you know where I can find Pattini?

chatpoints.chat_text: Marvelous. Show it to me.

replies.reply_text: Here it is. (You hold out the gold ring.)
Here it is. (You hold out the silver ring.)
Here it is. (You hold out the stone ring.)
Sorry, I'll try to get the right ring next time.
Sorry, I'll try to get the right ring next time.
Sorry, I'll try to get the right ring next time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope you are right this time. Show the ring to me.

replies.reply_text: Here it is. (You hold out the gold ring.)
Here it is. (You hold out the silver ring.)
Here it is. (You hold out the stone ring.)
I'm so sorry. I'll get it this time, I promise!
I'm so sorry. I'll get it this time, I promise!
I'm so sorry. I'll get it this time, I promise!

chatpoints.chat_text: For your sake, I hope you are right. Now, show me the ring.

replies.reply_text: Here it is! (You hand over the gold ring.)
Here it is! (You hand over the silver ring.)
Here it is! (You hand over the stone ring.)
But Murukan, I must give her this medicine! Please give me another chance!
But Murukan, I must give her this medicine! Please give me another chance!
But Murukan, I must give her this medicine! Please give me another chance!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murukan roars at you. He does not look at all happy to see you.)

replies.reply_text: Please, Murukan! Give me another chance! I know I can bring you the right ring!
I'm sorry, I'll just go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are undeserving. Do not come back here again!

replies.reply_text: I'm truly sorry. I'll leave you alone then.
But, Murukan, I promised I would get this medicine to Katukilal! She needs it!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murukan paces back and forth. He seems to be deliberating.) For the sake of Katukilal, I will give you one more chance. But, not only must you bring me the correct ring, you must also bring me two sparkling feathers to go with it.

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll do it. I can find those easily!
I can't get those right now. I'll have to come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go then, and bring me the true Lost Ring of the Tumetai, and two sparkling feathers. If you can do that, then I will send you on to the next guardian.

replies.reply_text: I'm on it. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murukan paces up to you.) Do you have what I require?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, I'll go get them right now!
I can't remember what I was looking for...
Yes, I have it all right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murukan growls in irritation.) I asked you to bring me the true Lost Ring of the Tumetai and two sparkling feathers. Perhaps you feel that is too much for you to handle?

replies.reply_text: No, no! It's fine! I'll go get them right now.
Thank you, Murukan. Bye now!
Do you know where I can find Pattini?

chatpoints.chat_text: (<i>Murukan is lying calmly beneath his tree.<i>) What do you need, little one?

replies.reply_text: Nothing right now, thank you, though.
Can you remind me where to find Pattini, the Mother Horse?

chatpoints.chat_text: She is a wild spirit who loves to roam. She has a sacred meadow of her own in the Jungle, not too far from here. Look for a wide expanse of green grass trapped within the jungle. This is where you will find Pattini running free.

replies.reply_text: Got it. Thank you again, Murukan!

npc_list.name: First Little Pig
npc_list.admin_description: The first little pig after the straw house is rebuilt
npc_list.short_description: The Resident of a Straw House

chatpoints.chat_text: Grunt. Oh. It's you and that horse again. Come in.

replies.reply_text: Hello, uh... Filmore.  I see you've rebuilt your house with the straw I brought you.
Hello there.
No thanks, I'm just passing by to make sure all is well.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah. I did.  What's it to you?

replies.reply_text: Uh... Nothing, I mean... I was just saying...
No need to be rude!  I'm going!  Sheesh...

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd offer you something to eat.  But I don't have anything here to eat except pig slop.  You don't want pig slop.

replies.reply_text: No, I'll pass on the pig slop.
Sure, I'll try it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well you can't, because I don't have any!  It all got blown off the cloud by that Wolf.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, I guess you can eat all the candy that's all over the place, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Candy?  No.  Who wants candy?  There's so much candy up here it makes your eyes water.

replies.reply_text: Are you always in this bad a mood?

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeal! Bad mood?! Look at me, I'm a pig, I live in a straw house on a cloud, and I don't even have a proper roof at the moment!

replies.reply_text: I suppose you need more hay to fix the roof, then.  I had a feeling there was a quest in here somewhere.
Oh, goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hay, straw, honestly!  You don't make roofs out of that!  You need thatch!

replies.reply_text: Well, you're out of luck, then.  I've been all over these isles and I've never seen any thatch reeds anywhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, and I suppose the roof I've got now is made of pixie dust, is it?  No!  Cattail stems. Not the best thatch, but it keeps the rain out.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Shall I get you some, then?
Rain?!  But... You're on top of the cloud!  It doesn't rain here!

chatpoints.chat_text: How do you know?!

replies.reply_text: Oh, whatever.  So, you want cattails, then.
Okay.  I'll come back when I have cattails for you.  Goodbye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you bring me cattails so I can thatch my roof?

replies.reply_text: Oh.  No, sorry, haven't got any just now.  Just checking in to make sure your house wasn't blown down.  See you later.
Sure, here you go.
I have some more for you here.
That's all for now.  Thanks!  I'll be back!

npc_list.name: Second Little Pig
npc_list.admin_description: After his house has been rebuilt.
npc_list.short_description: The resident of a Stick-built Cabin

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello there!  That was very nice of you to save my brother and me from the Big Bad Wolf!  Come in!  Come in!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, can't, just stopped in on my way somewhere.  Thanks, though!  See you around!
Ah!  Thanks!  I like what you've done with those sticks I brought!  Very nice.
Hello there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nice.  Yes.  But a bit... spartan, don't you think?  Drab.  Plain.  Needs some brightening up.

replies.reply_text: It could use a little something, yes.  Anything particular you had in mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I don't know.  I'd like some tikis.  I think they'd fit, don't you?  I do like a tropical theme.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.  I don't know anyone who makes those, sorry.
What's a "tiki"?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you know, they're those ... Polynesian figures.  Mostly heads.  Very angular.  I hear they are supposed to be depictions of the First Man.  They were very "in" a while ago.

replies.reply_text: I see.  But I've never seen anything like that here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know there's a Jungle Isle down there, isn't there anyone who can make them?

replies.reply_text: No, I don't think so.  The only woodworker I know down there only makes musical instruments.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well.  It would be nice to have a bit of color about the place, though.

replies.reply_text: You know, speaking of Jungle, there are some really bright, red flowers that grow there; some of those would look great in your home.
I'd be happy to do that!  I'll be back when I've got some for you.  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you bring me these wonderful red flowers?

replies.reply_text: Oh!  That's what you wanted.  Sorry, I forgot all about it.  I'll go get some of those.  Bye!
Here they are, fresh-cut and beautiful!
I have a few more here.
I'll bring some more when I can, so you'll have a fresh supply!  Goodbye, now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to the Tropicton Library.  Can I help you find anything today?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I think I know my way around.
Can you please tell me how best to use the library?
Yes, I came from Quincy, the Third Little Pig, up on Cloud Isle.  He seems to have run out of reading material.
I was wondering, what do you do with the books you no longer want?
Hello there. I was wondering if you knew of someone named Michelle?
Hi there.  I've got kind of an odd request.  Did this library ever give out flags?
No thanks.  I have a question for you though.  Were you at Rashida's party last night?
You sure can. I need information on this key. Who it might belong to or who knows about keys. Anything to help me figure out what to do next.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Quincy!  How is the dear boy?  He used to come in here all the time, and then... Oh well, never mind.  He'd like some books, you say?

replies.reply_text: What happened to him?
He said you would know his taste in books, and that he'll send them back down with Winchell when he's done.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not really for me to say, sorry.  About those books...?

replies.reply_text: He said you would know his taste in books, and that he'll send them back down with Winchell when he's done.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm very familiar with the kind of books Quincy likes.  In fact, I have two spy novels that have just come in that I think he'll really enjoy!  One moment, please.

replies.reply_text: La-de-dah, la-de-dah, mmm-mmm... Oops, gotta be quiet in the library...
Hmmm... The Fracas in the Farmyard and Porcine Peril in Paris. Interesting. Thank you so much, I'll get these to him right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Between the library and City Hall, you can find out just about anything you'd like to know about all kinds of things on Horse Isle.  Is there anything in particular you'd like to know?

replies.reply_text: What can I find out about horses?
What information do you have on tack and companions?
Do you have information on places and how to get to them?
People seem to win awards right and left here!  Do you have information on what it takes to win these awards?
There are lots of minigames around here.  Do you have a catalog of them so I can find some I'd like to play?
What kind of books do you have here in the library?
Thanks, I think I know my way around.

chatpoints.chat_text: By clicking "Research Horses: VIEW BREEDS," you can see not only every breed of horse that roams Horse Isle, but also every color that breed is found in here.  You'll also find out about breed history and statistics.  Most breeds are found on the open grasslands, but some are not, and the library will tell you where to look for them, if that is the case.  Is there anything else?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
Yes, I'd like to know more.

chatpoints.chat_text: The "VIEW TACK" button will show you all the tack available from the various tack shops on Horse Isle.  You'll see what everything looks like, and what advantages it has for you and your horses.  The "View Companions" button works the same way. Anything else?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
Yes, I'd like to know more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  By clicking "VIEW LOCATIONS", you can see a short description of every island and town.  We don't have information on how to get to every island, but someone who lives close by surely will.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.
I'd like to ask something else, if you don't mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly!  Click "VIEW AWARDS", and you will see a list of all the awards available on Horse Isle, and what you need to do to earn them.  Anything else you'd like to know?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
Yes, there is something else I'd like to ask.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, no, I'm afraid all we have is maps of where the mini-games are, under "VIEW MINIGAMES".  Does that help?

replies.reply_text: Sort of.  Thanks.
Yes.  May I ask something else?

chatpoints.chat_text: All kinds!  Fiction, local history, and lots of horse stories!  Click "READ BOOKS" to see a list of books we currently have.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks!  Horse stories are my favorite.
That's a nice selection.  Can I ask you something more?

chatpoints.chat_text: If the books are still in relatively good condition, I sell them to Ben Burlap at the General Store.

replies.reply_text: Sir, yes, Sir!

npc_list.name: Cheshire
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: A curious looking cat who enjoys disappearing and reappearing wherever he chooses.  He can often be found lying around on tree branches grinning down on those who pass by.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He sits with his head upon his hands and stares down at you.)

replies.reply_text: Never mind, I think I'm mistaken. I will just be leaving now.
I'm rather sorry to bother you, I was just wandering through the area and thought you may need help.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Tilting his head a little, he sits up and stares curiously at you and then gestures to his mouth.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see you can't talk?
I don't understand what you are saying.. Perhaps I should come back later.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nodding his head, he flicks his tail to the south.)

replies.reply_text: So you have lost your grin somewhere to the south?  Well, what is a cat without his grin?
Well, I can see your dilema but unfortunately, I am a little too busy.  Good luck though.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He sadly lowers his head and then points to the south and then back to you.)

replies.reply_text: I am terribly sorry for your loss, but I need to be going now, I wish you the best of luck!
You want me to go look for your grin for you?  Well I suppose I could do that.  Do you know where it might be?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Gesturing with his paws, he mimicks binoculars and then points to the south.)

replies.reply_text: I should check the trees then?  To the south?
I'm sorry but this is all just too confusing for me. I need to leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cheshire enthusiastically nods his head in agreement.)

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to help.  It sounds like I will need to use my binoculars then.
Sorry but I think this is more your problem than mine.  Goodbye.
I will be back as soon as I can, don't worry.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He tilts his head questioningly to the side.)

replies.reply_text: No, I don't have it yet, sorry.
What was it that I was supposed to be doing again?
Yes, I have it right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (While mimicking binoculars, he points to the south.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right, I was supposed to try looking at the trees to the south for your grin.  I should be back soon!
What an odd cat.  I guess I should get going.

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis the lion in Disguise, hanging out in Gritty's beach shack
npc_list.long_description: Francis the lion in his super spy outfit: pith helmet, llama wool mustache and enormous fur coat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in!

replies.reply_text: Hello Francis,  I thought I'd find you here.
Sorry, wrong house.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yet again, I've found a place that someone lives in!  Whaddaya know?  Anyway, it's too cold here for me... and too far away from civilization!

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I guess you'll just have to hang out here and hope no one else comes by.  I'm out of ideas.
You know, I've been to a place just like this, somewhere warmer and closer to a town, and I'm sure it was unoccupied.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, think hard, pal!  The suspense is killing me! I need a residence that I can call my own.  A home, even!

replies.reply_text: Now I'm not sure.  Maybe it was all a dream.  I guess you'd better stay here after all.  I'll keep my eyes open for a better house for you.
I'm sure there was another beach house, like this one, only pretty far south, and I'm positive that no one lived there, not even spiders!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right, little pal.  I guess I'll hang around here.  See ya some other time!

replies.reply_text: Bye, for now.
Bye!

npc_list.name: Cheshire's Head
npc_list.admin_description: (Second quest)

chatpoints.chat_text: (His head floats in the air, unattached to his body.) Ah! I was wondering when you were going to show up.

replies.reply_text: You were expecting me?
What happened to your body?
A floating head?  This is just too much for me.  I'm out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nodding his head.) Of course! I just can't believe you took so long.

replies.reply_text: Well, what happened to your body?
Sorry to disappoint you, but I am way too busy to deal with this.  I need to be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that is why I was expecting you, though you seemed so slow in getting here.

replies.reply_text: Please don't tell me you've lost your body now, too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed.  It is a rather sad thought.  Perhaps I am getting too old for this business of disappearing.

replies.reply_text: All right, so you want me to go and find your body?
I really do not have the time to be looking for your body.  Maybe I will come back in a little while.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: That was the plan, yes.

replies.reply_text: Do you know what isle you were last on?
This just sounds like too much work.  I think I need to leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: I will send you there, if you like.  It should make things much easier for the both of us.

replies.reply_text: I think I need to go and get ready before I go in search of your body.  I will come back in a little while.
Okay, send me there and I will get started.
Don't worry, I shouldn't take too long.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! There you are. Oh, and you have my body too!

replies.reply_text: Yes, and he put up quite a fight!
Oh, umm..  Actually I wasn't able to get it.   I found my way off the isle where you sent me.  Could you send me back there and I'll go find it?
No problem, though perhaps you should lay off the disappearing for a while.

chatpoints.chat_text: Once again, thank you so very much for finding my body!

replies.reply_text: It was my pleasure.  I should probably be going now though.

npc_list.name: Cheshire's Body
npc_list.short_description: The body of the Cheshire Cat.

replies.reply_text: Ah, there you are!
Found you!  But perhaps I will look around a little more first.

replies.reply_text: (Quietly, you sneak up behind him and quickly grab him, leaving no chance for an escape.)
Maybe I will just look around a little more and let you calm down.

npc_list.name: Barrett Braunbag
npc_list.admin_description: Storekeeper of Tail End Store

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, traveler!  What brings you out this way?

replies.reply_text: I'm thinking about buying a ranch in this area and wanted to see the town a bit first.  Nice to meet you - bye!
Do you provide all the supplies for the ranches out here?
Could you send me back to Puuhonua Isle?
Sandy Flint tells me you make clarinet reeds.
I'm on an errand for Mino. He wants some rotting fruit for the hummingbird surpise he's planning.
Hello there. I was told you might be able to help me.
Hello there. I was told you might be able to help me.
Where did you say I could get these waterproofed?
Apple delivery!
Hello! I'm here to pick up a grocery order for Mandy.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure do!  My store may be quite small, but I have a very active delivery and special order service.

replies.reply_text: Really? That's quite entrepreneurial of you!  Who else do you deliver to?
Well, how nice for you. I'm going to continue on my way now.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I deliver to some of the inhabitants of the smaller isles.  Say there, traveler, would you be able to help me out with something?

I guess I could.  Where do I need to go?
Sounds good, thanks.  Bye!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need something taken to Lelu and Mino on Puuhonua Isle.  You can tell them I just put it on their tab.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.
No thanks.  I want to stay on this isle.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure do!  I'm proud to sell all kinds of specialty items, by special order, of course.

replies.reply_text: Can I order some reeds, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  I just finished a box, in fact.  That will cost $1000.

replies.reply_text: That's a lot of money for such small things.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, first I have to gather the swamp wood, and then make the blanks and shape them.  It takes a lot of work.

replies.reply_text: That does seem like a lot of work.  Okay, then.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you. If I were you, I'd ask at food stores instead of general stores, though.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. Who did the telling and what was the help they suggested I might be offering?

replies.reply_text: Your old galley mate thought you might have dried beans and rice.

Smelly Toes Monroe. He needs a new pair of boots. The seawall isn't stopping the waves from splashing into the lighthouse. His boots have just about rotted out. And he'll need them waterproofed, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Barrett's eyebrows shoot up when he hears you say that, and he quickly leans over the counter.) I'd prefer we keep this bit of business just between the two of us. I've got several 10 pound sacks right here. It'll cost you $200.

replies.reply_text: Darn! I'll have to go get some money. I'll be right back.
Not to worry. My lips are zipped. I've got the money right here.
Thank you kindly, Sir. And have a good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Barrett's eyebrows shoot up when he hears you say that, and he quickly leans over the counter.) I be gottin' a pair right here, but ye best be laying down $500. And keep yer lips sealed. I run a respectable business here. Changed my ways, I did. Agreed?

replies.reply_text: Agreed! Here you go!
Are you kidding me? I've got buds on here! We always talk. I guess Smelly Toes will just have to do without.
These look great. Thanks a ton.

chatpoints.chat_text: Try Karl. He should be able to take care of that.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over there now. Thanks again!
Enjoy those apples and have a great day!
Thanks so much! I'm sure she'll appreciate the zuccini.

npc_list.name: Amariel
npc_list.short_description: an older lady of queenly bearing
npc_list.long_description: There is something remarkably other-worldly about Amariel.  Quite aside from her emerald green hair, there is an aloofness, almost a sadness, that is just there, just out of reach.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Do come in.  I'm sorry I cannot stand up to welcome you.  Please, come in and rest.  Help yourself to tea.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I can't stay.  Just stopping by.  See you!
Thanks, that's very kind of you!  Do you mind if I ask you... uhm...
Lady Amariel, I'm sorry, but... could you explain again what it is I'm doing?  That was an awful lot to keep track of.
Lady Amariel, I've returned with the orbs.
I'm sorry to intrude, but I am trying to find a carved stone the color of the night.  Might you know where I could find it?
Lady Amariel, can I ask you a question?
Hello again, Lady Amariel.  I have some dragon eggshell shards here.  I heard that you can put them back together to make a whole eggshell, is that right?
Hello Lady Amariel. I have some gryphon eggshell shards here. Could you please put them back together?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why I'm in a wheelchair, perhaps?

replies.reply_text: Well, yeah.  I mean, not to be nosy or anything but...
Oh, I'm sorry, no, it's just that... I don't know how to say this so please don't take offense, but you're so different from everyone else here.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Amariel inclines her head briefly, then resumes looking at you... or at something you are part of.) There is no disgrace in being blessed with curiosity. The only blame that attaches is when curiosity knows not its proper bounds. Let us just say I have had a full and very active life. And now it is time to enjoy the rewards and the consequences of it.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I'm not quite sure I understand you.
Oh.  Okay then, sorry to bother you.  I'll be going now and leave you in peace.
Oh, I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have the look of one who is fond of puzzles, I should say.

replies.reply_text: Me?  Oh, no.  I hate them, really.  I much prefer a simple life!
Oh yes, I love them!  Do you have a puzzle that needs completing?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a puzzle.  Yes.  You've seen it, no doubt?  Perhaps from afar?

replies.reply_text: You mean the maze?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Amariel smiles kindly.) Just so. I have friends within the maze. I can no longer go myself to visit them, as you see. But they all have something that now, in my elder days, I would cherish having for myself, were they possible to obtain.

replies.reply_text: You want me to go into the maze?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. That's right.   Will you do this?

replies.reply_text: I'd like to know a little more of what I'm getting into first.
Sure!  I'm ready for all challenges!
As a Knight of the Realm of Hotzeplotz, it is my duty and honor to go questing for such an esteemed person as yourself!

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I'm sorry.  If you will not go, I'm afraid no details will I divulge.

replies.reply_text: Oh well.  You'll have to find someone else then.  Goodbye.
Okay then, I'll go.  Please tell me what I need to do.
Go ahead, I'm paying close attention.

chatpoints.chat_text: Within the Great Maze are seven friends of my youth.  They live alone, for they are not friends of each other, but only of me.  When they must interact, they do so in strict order, and you must approach them according to their ranks or not at all.  Do you understand?

replies.reply_text: I do.  Please go on.

chatpoints.chat_text: The maze is not without its dangers.  Moreso than becoming lost, traps are there to confound you, for among my friends are some who don't take kindly to strangers.  These require the most careful consideration.

replies.reply_text: I'll be sure to pay close attention.  Do go on.

chatpoints.chat_text:
When you find my friends, you must say to them this:
"Amariel sends you her warmest greetings, and regrets that we can no longer visit. But she asks that one memento of you which you know she most prizes, and sends this, her Errant, to retrieve it in her stead."

replies.reply_text: You repeat that to yourself a few times to make sure you've got it exactly right. Okay, I think I've got it.

chatpoints.chat_text: When you have all seven orbs, bring them back to me. It will be much easier for you to bring all seven at once, and easier for me to handle them.  Oh--and one more thing.

replies.reply_text: What's that, Lady Amariel?

chatpoints.chat_text: My friends... Visit the red one first.  And also... do not be alarmed, but they are dragons.

replies.reply_text: Dragons.  Okay.  I'll be off then, and I'll come back when I've got them all.  Wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have?  Really?  You have all of them?

replies.reply_text: Right here.
I don't think I've got them all, no, just checking.  Red, Blue, Purple, Green, Cyan, Yellow and Magenta... Nope, don't have them all yet, I'll go find the rest.
Okay, here are the red and blue orbs.
I've already given you the red and blue orbs, but I have the green and purple here now.
I've already given you the red, blue, green and purple orbs.  Here are the cyan and yellow ones.
Sorry I was called away.  Here is the last orb.
Green and purple, here they are.
Cyan and yellow, here you go.
Right here.
Thanks a lot!  Goodbye, now!
Lady Amariel, when I was talking to the dragons, they told me stories, some of them...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm sure they did.  And you want to hear it, yes?

replies.reply_text: I'd like to, if you wouldn't mind awfully.

chatpoints.chat_text:
All right then...
When I was a very young girl, I loved horses. I loved them more than I could possibly tell you. I wanted to ride and run and jump. But I couldn't. I was allergic to them. Broke out in hives, head to foot. Horses, mules, camels, llamas, zebras, I was allergic to them all. So I looked for something else I could ride, and I found out about dragons.

replies.reply_text: How did you do that?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, I had my means. My family were all sailors you see. Anyway, someone told me that if you get a dragon young enough, you can train it, and ride it. So I set out to do just that. And, eventually, I got the dragons you met today.
I did my very best to take care of them. I gave them the best food. I read books on horse training. Built them a barn, had saddles and bridles made....

replies.reply_text: I heard something about that.  Please go on.

chatpoints.chat_text: I soon had a racing dragon, and a jumping dragon... and great plans.  When you're young you just don't see that one most important thing of all: We are all different.  As individuals, as species...  You cannot train a cat to be a dog.  And you cannot train a dragon to be a horse.

replies.reply_text: What happened?

chatpoints.chat_text:
I kept demanding of them what was not in their natures. The older they got, the more confused, and irritated and... strange they became. They grew up faster than I did, and I just didn't see. Soon they were breaking things. A bowl I'd won, my beautiful tiled roof, my specially built fence, my best saddle, my beautiful garden... and then...
(Amariel's eyes become overbright)
And then the Magenta Dragon, my favorite and the oldest, had enough. He gathered all the dragons together, and tried to teach them to be dragons again.

replies.reply_text: Oh dear, what happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Amariel drops her head into her hands.) The dragons couldn't go back to being dragons; they were too old. The damage was done. I'd ruined them with my misplaced kindness. We broke each other's hearts. (Amariel dissolves into tears.)

replies.reply_text: Oh no... Lady Amariel, I'm so sorry.... is there anything I can do?
Well, sounds like you deserved it to me!  Well, I did what you asked.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Amariel gazes up at you, looking very old indeed.) Thank you. So much. Someday, perhaps. But not now.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye for now, Lady Amariel.  I'll come see you again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Is that all you need?  I have found Xiang to be most useful when I was decorating my home.  I would go speak with her, I'm sure she can assist you.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, my lady, I'll go to her right away.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.  Of course you may.  What is it?

replies.reply_text: Well, it seems the Magenta Dragon has had his egg stolen.
Uhm... nevermind, I just remembered, I have an exam tomorrow, gotta study!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no! Not the one he saved from his hatching! (She turns toward the Dragon Maze.) I just hope he doesn't decide to go looking for it on his own. He's not really a personable sort...

replies.reply_text: No, he isn't.  Well, you don't have to worry about that, at least, not for now.  I'm looking for it for him.  Any idea what may have happened to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Almost anything.  Just as a work of art, it would fetch an enormous sum!  Any jeweler would be happy to own it!  Anyone interested in strange artifacts, or magic or... or just people who love sparkly things.  Honestly, anyone would want it.

replies.reply_text: Just for the record, you yourself don't have it, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: No,  I do not.  I would never consider taking it and incurring his wrath.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, Lady Amariel.  I'll go ask around elsewhere.  Goodbye.

By the way, I did notice some tracks around the cave.  A very small animal, maybe squirrel sized or a little larger.  I haven't seen anything like that here.  Are there such animals on Lava Isle, do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here?  Oh, no.  No squirrels, no rats, no mice.  Insects and birds yes, and a few reptiles but that's all I know about.  Penfold keeps guinea pigs, but that's it.

replies.reply_text: Ah, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can do that.  I put this together in the first place--although do not mention this to the Magenta Dragon, he thinks it was done by Grey Slate.  Hmmm.... you don't happen to have a piece of Gold Ore, do you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent.  May I have it?  And the eggshell shards?

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Thank you, Amariel!  I'll bring this to the Magenta Dragon right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I can't help you with that. I can mend dragon egg shards, but I am allergic to gryphon eggs. Something about the oil in them brings out the hives in me.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Thank you any way.

npc_list.name: Lelu
npc_list.admin_description: Puuhonua Isle two west of hoof

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there! What brings you to our peaceful island today?

replies.reply_text: I have a delivery for you from Barrett Braunbag!
Hi Lelu, could you please send me back now?
I just wanted to look around and experience the quiet for a while.
Hello Lelu. Since you have been so nice and allowed me to visit here, I wondered if there was anything I could bring back with me next time I visit?
Lelu! I am back with the grasshoppers!
Good day, you do have a lovely little island here, but I was wondering if you could send me to a larger island?  I'd really appreciate it.
I am looking for a green inflatable arm man... thingy.  Have you happened to see one blow through here?
I'm in the mood for a new adventure! Exotic sights! Far away lands! Would you happen to have any suggestions?
Hi there, Lelu. Where was it that you said you lost your necklace?
I'm back, Lelu. Look what I have!
Oh, no problem, I was glad to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you want me to send you back? Or did you want to take a few moments to explore our island?

replies.reply_text: I would like to go back now.
I would like to explore a bit more, if that's okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be lovely.  Please take some time to meditate in the grove at the end of the island. It is designed to bring peace and clarity.

replies.reply_text: Okay, ummmm thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: How thoughtful of you!  Actually, there is something I have wanted to get for Mino, but have been unable to.

replies.reply_text: I would love to be able to help you.  What do you need?
I will remember that next time I come back. I am a little pressed for time today. Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mino has a great liking for chocolate-covered grasshoppers, but I haven't been able to find anyone that can make or sell them!  Do you know of anyone?

replies.reply_text: No, I'm afraid I don't.  Sorry.
I have an idea of someone who may be able to help with that - a chocolatier.  Why don't I check with Emma and see if she can help?
I'm sorry, but I have no idea who would do anything with chocolate.  Sorry.
Thanks!  See you soon!   Please send me back.
Thanks Lelu! I'm glad Mino will enjoy them!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's all right.  Thanks for the offer, though.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Well, could you send me back now?
You're welcome.  Well, I'll take a look around the isle a little here before I head out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes I did, in fact!  It scared the hummingbirds at first, but then they started to enjoy the bright color and the wonderfully wacky waving arms!  Mino and I tied it to the palm trees to the east of here just to keep it near the water and keep the arms moving!  It’s rather comical and makes me laugh just watching it, don’t you think?

replies.reply_text: Ha ha ha.  Yes, really comical.  See ya.
To the east and near the palm trees, you say?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you look up high near those palm trees, you'll be able to see the wonderfully green arms flailing!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for your help, Lelu!

chatpoints.chat_text: I think all the islands have something to offer in the way of adventure and exotic sights. I would like to offer one piece of advice: don't wear anything valuable while riding a wild camel!

replies.reply_text: I'll remember that! Thanks and have a great day! Oh, would you mind sending me back to Tail Isle?
That sounds personal. You must have lost something valuable riding one.

chatpoints.chat_text: I did! My mother's antique locket. I wore it constantly. The camel bolted and my locket flew right off my neck. We searched the sands for hours to no avail.

replies.reply_text: I'm so sorry to hear that. I'll remember to remove my valuables before I ride a camel! Thanks for telling me. Well, I'm off on my next adventure. Could you please send me back to Tail?
Hmm. Sounds like just the kind of adventure I need! If you tell me the area you were riding the camel in, I'll go search for that locket!
I will, and thanks again!
I'll head over to the desert isles now. I hope to return soon with your locket in hand!
I'll head over to Santon now. Would you mind returning me to Tail Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Somewhere around Santon during the camel ride that Hessa organized.  I do hope you find it.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over there now. Will you please send me back to Tail isle?
I'm so glad I could find it for you. Thank you for the reward!
Pleased to help! I appreciate the reward. Can I ask you to send me back to Tail now?

npc_list.name: Mino
npc_list.admin_description: Puuhonua Isle two west of Hoof

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our home. Can I help you with anything?

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I was just checking out your little island.
With that grin on your face, you look like the cat that ate the canary. What's up?
(As soon as Mino sees you, the two of you walk outside, where Lelu won't hear.) I'm back, and I have something for you!
(You follow Mino outside.) What was I doing for you?
(You and Mino walk outside.) I'm back, and I'm ready to help you with the second part of your surprise. What do you need?
(Once again, you follow Mino outside.) What was I doing for you?
(You follow Mino outside again.) What was I doing for you?
(You and Mino head outside again.) What was I doing for you?
I'm back! (Mino's eyes gleam, and the two of you rush outside.)
Hi Mino! (You follow Mino outside.) So, what was that about the second part?
(As soon as Mino sees you, the two of you walk outside, where Lelu won't hear.) I'm back, and I have something for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mino presses a finger against his lips, and beckons you to follow him. When you get into the next room, he turns to you excitedly.) Our anniversary is coming up soon, and I have something wonderful planned.

replies.reply_text: An anniversary? How exciting!
Oh, no. This sounds like it involves a quest. I think I'll just move on.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is. Fifty wonderful years of marriage is surely something worth celebrating. Would you be so kind as to help me surprise Lelu?

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me a little more about what you're planning? I hate to agree to something before I know what it entails.
Maybe I can come back and help you when I'm not so busy.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to pick up the plants I ordered from Helena in Treeton, and talk to Arthur about making trellises.

replies.reply_text: Darn! I'll do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Very wise of you. Here's the idea. My dear Lelu is an amazing and beautiful woman. She is as amazing as the jewel-like hummingbirds she loves. So I thought, why not create a hummingbird sanctuary? With some effort, our tiny island could be the perfect place. Then Lelu can be a jewel among jewels!

replies.reply_text: Now there's an original idea for an anniversary gift! What do you need to do to get started?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! What is it?

replies.reply_text: I have the plants and the trellis.
I have the spoiled fruit.
I have the spider's silk.
I have the moss and lichen.
I have the downy feathers.
I have the horsehair.
Oops. My mistake. I thought I had something, but it seems I don't. I'll be back.
I have the manure.
I believe I have everything you needed.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need to create an environment that hummingbirds will thrive in. I need flowering plants. The kind that hummingbirds love. I've ordered several varieties from Helena in Treeton.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense. What else do you need?
That's out of my way. Maybe I can come back and help you when I'm not so busy.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll need a trellis for the vines. Arthur in Appleton can surely make one. Would you be willing to take care of the trellis and get the plants?

replies.reply_text: I'll be happy to do that for you.
Not right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Bye!
Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I forgot the soil needed amending. Could you get me some manure?

replies.reply_text: I did -- three bags of manure!
I can do that.
I'm busy right now. Maybe I can get that for you some other time.
Oh, right.  I'll head out for that now.
Sure.  Do you know where I could find some?

chatpoints.chat_text: The sanctuary is going to be wonderful!

replies.reply_text: What was I doing for you, again?
I have something for you.
Well, that's everything you've asked for. I should probably be on my way.
You mentioned the second step of your surprise...
Well, looks like that's everything you've asked for.
I'm so happy to hear that.  Have fun!
Helena mentioned amending the soil?
I've got the hummingbirds, Mino! The crowning touch for your sanctuary.
You mentioned the crowning touch?
What was the crowning touch again?
I have a question about one of those things you mentioned.
Great!  I think I got everything you asked for.
That's going to look great covered in these vines. I've got something else for you!
You're welcome.
You're welcome.  Well, I should be on my way.  Have fun!
I'll be back soon.
This place should be swarming with fruit flies in no time! Oh, I've got something else for you!
That stuff is really strong. You could almost use it for dental floss! I've got something else for you.
That Twig guy is really.... different. But nice! Oh, and I've got something else for you.
That should keep any baby bird happy and cozy! And I've got something else!
I never realized how thick and coarse horsehair is. Strange. Oh, well. I've got something else for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: This is wonderful. Absolutely wonderful. The plants will be the foundation of the sanctuary. Now for the second step of the process.

replies.reply_text: Second step?
Um..  I'm a little busy to do a second step.  I'll just come back later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. Now I need materials for the hummingbirds to build their nests.

replies.reply_text: Let me guess. You are going to need my help again, right? I guess I'm up for that. After all, I'm really curious now to see this through to completion.
I don't have time to help you right now. Maybe I'll be back. Good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need downy feathers, horsehair, moss, lichen, and spider's silk, so the hummingbirds can build their nests. Oh, and of course, spoiled fruit.

replies.reply_text: Whoa! That's more than I was expecting. I'm not sure I have time right now.  I'll keep the list in case I can get around to it, but I have some other things to do first.  Sorry.
I have a question about one of those things you mentioned.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting materials for the hummingbirds to use to build their nests and the fruit. I gave you the list.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Right. I'll be back.
That's right. I have a question about one of those things you mentioned.
Okay, what's next?
I have some time now.  What is the crowning touch?
I think I'll pass for now. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay. Which one?

replies.reply_text: I was going to ask about the horsehair. Should I check with a groomer?
About the fruit. Are you sure you want spoiled fruit?
Spider's silk? Are you serious? And do you have any clue where I might get some of that?
I guess that covers it for now.
I haven't seen moss and lichen for sale at any of the stores. Know anyone who might have some of this?
On the downy feathers. I remember seeing a pet shop that sold different types of birds. Should I check there?
I need a break. If I change my mind, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a great idea! I knew you were the right person for this surprise.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I can handle that. I'm off!
I have another question about an item on that list.

chatpoints.chat_text: Very serious. Spider's silk is used to hold the nest together, and some hummingbirds seem to prefer that of the black widow.

replies.reply_text: I never knew that. Okay. Guess I'll go look for a spider. I think I saw one on one of the islands... somewhere!
Sorry. That's where I draw the line. I don't mess with spiders! Bye.
I have another question about an item on that list.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hummingbirds can't live off of just the sugary nectar from flowers. They require protein, too. Decomposing fruit attracts fruit flies, which are a great source of protein.

replies.reply_text: Yuck. I guess I should check with stores that sell food, then?
My mind is spinning! I need to take a break from this. Maybe I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: There's some guy... I can't remember his name, but he lives in the woods in the northern part of Horse Isle. He should be able to help you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I think I know who you are talking about! I'm on my way.
I have another question about an item on that list.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's just one last thing -- the most important thing of all!  The hummingbirds.

replies.reply_text: Of course!  I suppose you need me to travel back and forth between all the different islands to try to find some?
Egads! Enough, already! I need a break. I might be back. Good luck!
That's right! I'll head over to Jungle Isle and find Suhai now.
Of course! Here they are!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no! I've been corresponding with Suhai on Jungle Isle. She was gracious enough to obtain six pair for me.

replies.reply_text: Whew! So all I have to do is pick them up and bring them back to you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. The sanctuary will be complete just in time for our wedding anniversary!

replies.reply_text: I'll do it!
I'll probably be back to help you with this, but for now, I need to do some other things. Later!
I'm happy to do it. Really. You said Jungle, right? I better stop at the library before heading there, so I know which part of the island to look for her, then I'll go straight there. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mino's eyes tear up as he gazes at the cage in your hand.)

replies.reply_text: It's a wonderful surprise, and I'm sure she'll love it. Happy anniversary! Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderfully! Lelu adores the hummers, and the plants are filled with flowers to keep them happy.

replies.reply_text: Happy to help. Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!

replies.reply_text: How's the Hummingbird Sanctuary doing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm...  I suppose the stables would have some.  Maybe ask them.

replies.reply_text: Good idea.  I'll do that.  Bye!
You're welcome.  Well, I'll be back in a bit.  Bye.
I have something for you.
I think I got everything you need.

npc_list.name: Mabel
npc_list.admin_description: AFTER the first Miss Mabel quest is finished.
npc_list.short_description: an elderly lady of great wisdom.
npc_list.long_description: Ms Mabel is terribly old, but she has bright eyes and a keen expression. You sense a good bit of impishness, only barely kept in check by a sense of propriety. She sits in a comfy chair, wearing, under a serviceable dressing gown, a scarlet kimono embroidered with dragons.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Hello there!  What brings you here today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, just wandering around.
Oh, Miss Mabel, can you help me?  Princess Lilianna's been kidnapped by pirates!
Miss Mabel, I'm back with clues!
Miss Mabel, I've forgotten... Where did you want me to look for clues?
Miss Mabel, I've forgotten... Where did you want me to look for clues?
Miss Mabel, I'm heading to Jungle Isle to look for clues and hiding places.  Do you have any suggestions for me?
Thanks for all your help with finding the princess!
Hi, Miss Mabel, are you very busy right now?
Hi, Miss Mabel.  I just wanted to let you know, I figured time was running out for the princess, so I just went ahead and paid the ransom.
Hi there!  Uhm... I need help with another quest.
I'm making deliveries for Karee Dentin, the Wington Dentist, and I've got one for you!
Hello! I'm wondering if you might know a Miss Knight... or Miss Castle, possibly?

chatpoints.chat_text: Kidnapped by pirates, you say? Well! That is most interesting. Now, come in here and sit down, and tell me everything you know.

replies.reply_text: (You carefully tell Miss Mabel everything about the Royal Wedding and all that Dorcas told you.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. And Dorcas advised you not to go directly to the pirates, you say?

replies.reply_text: Yes, that's what she said.  But I'm going to go anyway.
Yes.  But she had a point, I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I think you should pay particular heed to Dorcas' advice. Because really, you know, it's true what they say that "there is no honor among thieves."  If a pirate kidnapped the princess, they would never bring her to Pirate Isle, where other pirates might just re-kidnap her.  No, they would secret her away to some other safe place.

replies.reply_text: Where do you think that might be?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, I really couldn't say.  Pirates are so reckless, you know, they may do almost anything, really.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, they are.  Maybe I shouldn't get involved with this.  I guess I'll pass on this one.  Sorry to take up your time.   Goodbye.
So what do you think I should do?  Go question all the pirates?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, no, dear, I certainly wouldn't do that at this very early stage. I'm sure they'll all be on their guard, because, you know, they'll all want a part of the ransom.
No. What I suggest, if you haven't done it already, is that you go back to the Castle, and check it carefully, inside and outside, for clues. And then tell me what you've found, I shall be very keen to hear.

replies.reply_text: I'm a step ahead of you at last!  I've searched the castle grounds already!
Okay, thanks, I'll do that now.  I'll be back!
Miss Mabel, you'll be proud of me!  I've already searched the castle!

chatpoints.chat_text: I wanted you to go back to Cloud Isle, and search Princess Lilianna's castle, inside and out.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, splendid!  Tell me all that you've found!

replies.reply_text: I found footprints of someone with odd, pointy shoes.
I found tracks that look as if someone had gotten on a Pegasus and flown off!
I found this bit of feather!  I think it belongs to a Pegasus!
(You tell Miss Mabel everything you learned from the Pegasus Uniter.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Odd, pointy shoes doesn't tell us very much.  I rather think you'll have to go back to Cloud Isle and look a little more carefully!  Make sure you search the perimeter of the castle carefully!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll do that. See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well that would certainly make sense.  And you've spoken to the Pegasus Uniter, haven't you?

replies.reply_text: Uhm, no, I'm afraid I haven't.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I really think that would be your next step.  After all, Pegasi can speak, and if any were involved, they could certainly tell you what they know.  Or at least, they would tell him.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll go back and ask him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent!  Now!  What does this clue tell you?

replies.reply_text: Not much, I'm afraid.  What does it tell you?
It tells me where the Pegasus had gone to, at least!  But I wanted to check with you and make sure you agreed before I went looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really!  And where do you think it went, may I ask?

replies.reply_text: To the only place you could normally find something edible that's this scarlet color--the swamp on Jungle Isle!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.... That scarlet color is unique to Venetian Food flowers.

replies.reply_text: Yes.  It looks like I have to, don't I?
Oh, no, not more travelling.  The princess can find her own way home, I've had enough!

chatpoints.chat_text: You said, didn't you, that Paul -- I mean, the Pegasus Uniter -- said that it seemed that while the Pegasus in question would not speak of what had happened, she seemed to deliberately mark this piece of feather. If so, the pegasus definitely wanted to call your attention to this place!

replies.reply_text: You're right.  I'll go there and look for clues and hiding places.  Do you have any suggestions for me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I don't really, but I will say this. Very few pirates are Master-minds. Some of them have a little good inside, but in fact most of them are a bit behind. You should keep that in mind. You never know when knowledge of a criminal's ego might be useful.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that.  Thanks, Miss Mabel.  I'll let you know what I find out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you found what you believe to be a Pegasus feather, so you should probably go see the Pegasus Uniter.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll go see him now.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're quite welcome.  I always love a good mystery.

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why no, please come, sit down and tell me all about it!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I'd like to interview you for Guru Wiseman.
On second thought, I've got to be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Guru Wiseman?  Oh, dear, I'm afraid I've never heard of him.  Who is he, and what does he want?

replies.reply_text: (You explain about the Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)

chatpoints.chat_text: And he wants me to contribute to it?  Well, as it turns out, I only have one bit of what I consider genuine wisdom to pass along, but I doubt it would be anything he'd be interested in.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure whatever you have to say will be fine, Miss Mabel.
Well, I'd certainly like to hear it.
I see!  Thanks so much, I'll tell Guru Wiseman!
But Miss Mabel, an argument is a connected series of statements intended to establish a proposition.
But Miss Mabel, what if you're right?!  If you're right, and they say you're wrong, you should yell!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, my dear, that's the meaning of an argument. I'm talking about the process of argument. The whole point of an argument is, after all, convincing someone to accept your views by presenting them with rational reasons for doing so.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Thanks, Miss Mabel.
Yes, but sometimes they don't listen, so you have to yell to make your point!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, dear; I'm afraid, you know, that that isn't true.  I believe you are mistaking a refusal to accept, with dismissal out-of-hand. The two are very different.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay, I understand now.  Thanks.  I'll go tell Guru Wiseman.
But... If they don't accept your reasons...
But!  If you're right, you're right!  And if you're right, you should win the argument!

chatpoints.chat_text: If they don't accept your reasons, then you have simply failed to convince them.  Perhaps you have not presented your reasons clearly enough, or perhaps they have knowledge that you don't have.  That's no reason to yell.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks, Miss Mabel.  I'll be going now.  Thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, dear. I'm not talking about things that are factually right or wrong, I'm talking about the process of arguing a point with another person. I'm talking about the verb argument, not the noun. Human beings, no matter how hard they may try not to, always take into account your mood and attitude when conveying an argument. That's just the way human minds work. One must take this into consideration.

replies.reply_text: I guess so.  You're right.  Well, thanks for your time, I'd better be going now.
I don't believe you! I think that's just silly.  I think if you're right, you should make sure the other person knows it!

chatpoints.chat_text: By becoming belligerent, all you convince others of is to tell you what they think you want them to hear so you will be quiet and go away.  They'll turn against you once you leave, you can be sure.

replies.reply_text: I don't care what they say about me, if they don't believe me, they're just dumb.  Gotta go.  Bye!
There's a lot of truth in what you say.  I'll think about it.  Thanks, Miss Mabel. I'll be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did you?  Well, I hope she is free now and all is well.  Well, that's that, then. Well done, I suppose.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye!
Well, I did what I thought was best.
Actually, Miss Mabel, there's something else you can help me with.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, is there indeed?  Now.  What might that be, I wonder?

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, I'm helping Guru Wiseman put together a book of Wisdom.  He asked me if there was anything you might like to contribute to it.
Uhm.... Sorry, I forgot.  I'll come back when I remember.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, do you?  Oh, dear.  I'm sorry, I can't.  I'm packing you see, just about to leave on a vacation.

replies.reply_text: But don't you just have a moment?
Oh, okay.  I'll carry on on my own, then.  Bye!  Enjoy your vacation!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm sorry, but I don't.  I've too much to do.  And you've done so many quests by now that I should think you perfectly capable of solving this one on your own.  Well, I must get back to my packing.  Goodbye!

replies.reply_text: Okay.   Goodbye, enjoy your vacation!
I'll be sure to do that. Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... Miss ... now what was her name? All I seem to remember is that she had a very high voice and always referred to me as 'we' which I found most annoying! She left a year or so ago, I believe.

replies.reply_text: I see.  She adopted a foal from Phyllis Colt and Phyllis was wondering whatever became of it after she moved.

We both plummetted down like crazed squirrels and splat we fell on her corral fence! And all her best horses escaped like hamsters from a hockey game, and the dame's hair turned green as a pickle in June!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Thanks for telling me that.  I hope you were both okay, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, we was okay.  After a while.  But the horses?  They split like a paper bag overloaded with jellybeans.  And we never seen 'em again.  Nope.  Never.  The End.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I'll go now.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text:
A name? Yeah, he had a name. A big name. An explosive name. But he was too smart to give it out to just anybody!
So, the horse-rider was back. And I could tell from that look, there was a case in the offing. What sordid caper was coming my way now, I wondered, and I sat down and listened.

replies.reply_text: Nope, nope, too weird, too film noir, I'm leaving!  Bye!
Mind if I call you.... Sam?

chatpoints.chat_text: "That's Mister Sam to you," I said as I sat down behind my desk and eyed the new client like a baby watching an ice cream cone on a rope. "Why don't you tell me all about it."

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, I'm trying to find a lost object.  A recipe about so big and so wide?  Black with red writing on it.  That's all I know about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sat back and tilted my head.  "That's all you know?  Then the dingus isn't yours.  Whose is it?" I asked.

replies.reply_text: It belongs to a lady dragon named Lornbacoll.
I'd rather not say just right now.
It belongs to a lady dragon named... uh....

chatpoints.chat_text:
Lornbacoll! Now there was a name I wasn't expecting to hear. Not that it was unwelcome! It certainly rang a bell! It rang more than a bell, it rang Big Ben!
"And Ms. Lornbacoll wants you to recover this dingus rather than doing it herself, eh? Now why's that, I wonder?" I wondered.

replies.reply_text: I have no idea why she doesn't want to look for it herself.  She asked me to look for it and I assume she'll pay me well once I find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.  The Rider was going to be cagey with me, eh?  We'll see about that.  "It wasn't by any chance some dame named Merryesther, was it?" I asked.

replies.reply_text: No.  And I'm not saying who it was.  I'd better go.
No.  Actually if you must know, it was Lornbacoll.
No.  Actually if you must know, it was... a lady dragon named... uh...

chatpoints.chat_text: I pulled my fedora down lower over my eyes, the better to think.  "And so you came to me.  Why?"

replies.reply_text: I was just wondering if you'd seen such a thing in your... wanderings around the maze.  That's all.
(You suddenly get an idea!) Because something tells me that this caper is too big for one little rider to handle! So I've come to you, Mr. Sam. I want you to help me find the Malted Falcon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Persistant, this rider.  Well, so was I.  "No," I said.  "I stick my neck out for nobody.  Now you run along."

replies.reply_text: Fine, I'll find it on my own then.
All right.... (As you turn to go you notice something... a smell that one doesn't expect in a dragon cave.... gardenias!) Say....

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, I thought to myself.  This rider was persistent!  Well, we'd soon see about that!  "Is there something else you wanted to ask?" I said, all wary like a dog that thinks he heard you open a fridge.

replies.reply_text: I met Pederlaurie just outside your courtyard.  Do you know him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Pederlaurie!  So the little creep was still hanging around my cavern, eh?  I'd have to be careful here, really careful.  "Only slightly," I said.

replies.reply_text: Is he in on this caper? I, uh (you make a show of sniffing around) have reason to believe he's been in here.

chatpoints.chat_text:
I suddenly saw myself being dragged deeper and deeper into this mysterious caper! Yeah, Pederlaurie had been here all right. But how much did I want this Rider to know?
"Well, what if he was? Lots of people come here," I said.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, but he struck me as a very suspicious character.  And this recipe... strikes me as a very suspicious thing.  So, naturally, I just wondered.  Did he ask you about it?
Okay, be cagey if you want to.  I'm going back out to find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, well!  This Rider had good instincts!  "Okay," I said.  "I'll be frank with you.  Okay, so Pederlaurie was in here.  He asked me if I had the dingus, I said I didn't."

replies.reply_text: So he's looking for it, too.  He doesn't have it, then.  Interesting.  Did he say anything else?  Where he was headed or the like?
And I take it he never said why the volcano is to be avoided?
Hmmm!  I think I know which one that might be!  I'll go search there now!  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come to think of it, the little rat hadn't said a word about why he didn't want to go there.  But it must have been important if the thought of it shook him up enough to talk about it.  "No, he didn't say a word," I said, and I waited for a response like a dog waits for you to put eggshells in the freezer.

replies.reply_text: So, Mr. Sam, what do I suggest I do now?
Okay, I'll do that.  I'll see you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: There was more to this caper than this rider had realized.  "I don't know, kid," I said airily, thinking the kid might take the hint.  "It wouldn't surprise me if the dame was in cahoots with some nasty characters.  Maybe a little goggle eye guy..."  I hoped this little rider would get the picture, and fast.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I get it.  I guess I shouldn't have rushed in so fast.  I think I know just who you're talking about.
Why can't I just get a straight answer out of you?  What a pain.  I'll see you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I tipped my fedora back and studied the stranger that darkened my door. I wouldn't tarnish my tastebuds on this creature. But step aside? "Give me a good reason why, Kid. I don't step aside easily."

replies.reply_text: I can't believe you don't remember me! I think I'm offended. No matter. Look. I'm on this totally big adventure. I know you like intrigue and mystery and all that. Well here's the intriguing part. Pirate's treasure is buried beneath your very feet!

chatpoints.chat_text: I studied the kid. Things had been awfully dull around here lately. As dull as the eyes on a rat two days dead. This might be interesting. I shrugged. "Fine."

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! I'll be out of here in a jiffy.

npc_list.name: Cyan Dragon
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 9
npc_list.short_description: A dragon the color of the sky.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhh.... I smell a visitor.  Come forward.  Let me see you.

replies.reply_text: Hello.  Uh.  Goodbye.
Hello, I'm here on behalf of Amariel.  She asked me to bring you a message.
Five green crystal shards, yes?
quest check

chatpoints.chat_text: Did she indeed?  I had no idea Amariel wished to say anything to me.  And I'm not quite certain that I would like to hear anything she might have to say, after so very long an absence with no word.

replies.reply_text: She's wheelchair-bound now and can't make it through the maze.
