chatpoints.chat_text: Is that so?  Are there no carriages then?  No wagons?  No messengers?

replies.reply_text: She sent me...
You seem very upset with her for some reason.

chatpoints.chat_text: Be that as it may, it is no business of yours.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, well.... I tried to ask the Green Dragon but he cut me off... Why do you live in a maze?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ask Amariel.  It was she who ordered it built around our homes.

replies.reply_text: She did?  Why?
Interesting.  Well, anyway, I have a message from her, would you like to hear it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ask Amariel.  I have nothing more to say about it.  Now what it is you want?

replies.reply_text: Well, as I said I have a message from her.  Would you like to hear it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Tell me your message, then.

replies.reply_text: It's this:  Amariel sends you her warmest greetings, and regrets that we can no longer visit.  But she asks that one memento of you which you know she most prizes, and sends this, her Errant, to retrieve it in her stead.
I'll go get those now.  Right.  Bye.
As it happens, I have what you want right here.
Goodbye.  Thanks for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh... A familiar smell.  Come closer...

replies.reply_text: Uhm, no thanks, I'm just passing through.
Actually, I'd like to be a little less close. Like, could you step back for a couple of minutes?

chatpoints.chat_text: Give me good reason, and I might consider it.

replies.reply_text: There's a pirate legend about all these special treasure chests that have been put into safe keeping. So I had to find all these clues which led to all these keys which unlock the chests buried underneath all the Dragons of the Maze!

chatpoints.chat_text: The short version would have sufficed. You could have said - there's buried treasure beneath you.

replies.reply_text: Oh! Okay. Thanks!

npc_list.name: Yellow Dragon
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start at CP11 w/2516 as a req, or start at CP11&CP0

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Company!  Oh, I love company!  Do come in-- oh.  No, wait.  Hmmm!  Must do these things properly, you know.  I mean, one mustn't burn one's bridges before they're hatched.  Have you seen the Cyan Dragon yet?  Have you?

replies.reply_text: No, I haven't really paid my respects, sorry.
Yes, I've spoken to her.
Hi, I'm just passing through.  Good day!
You wanted five cyan shards?
Thank you.  I'm trying to help your friend Lornbacoll with something, and I wonder if you could help.
Hello!  Do you remember me?  It's nice to see you again!
Thank you. I was wondering if you might move aside a step or two? I'm on a great adventure and I need to dig beneath your feet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Well, we can't have that can we?  Why, it just wouldn't be right!  After all, the way to a dragon's heart is greener on the other side of the fence!  You go see him now and come back when you're done, there you go, dear!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  The forms must be observed, after all.  I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, very good.  That's splendid, just splendid!  Like I always say, a stitch in time is only skin deep!  Come in!  Come in.  Now, what can I do for you, then?

replies.reply_text: I have a message for you from Amariel.

chatpoints.chat_text: From Amariel? Oh, really? (The Yellow Dragon makes a soft clucking noise.) Oh, well, I guess there's no point crying over a bird in a bush. What does the dear lady want?

replies.reply_text: You have a story to tell, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: A story to tell?  Oh, yes, I have a story to tell, indeed I do!  Did you know I was once a freestyle dragon?  Oh. yes, a great dancer!  Everybody said, "Oh, a dragon doing dressage, how silly!" but I said, "Don't judge a book by its silver lining!"  And I was doing so well, you should have seen!  Oh, you would have been floored, just floored!

replies.reply_text: I see, do go on.
Oh, well, that's nice, but I really should be giving you this message.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what can I say, I was meant to fly, not trot and well... you know, you get a little older and you don't quite have the oomph that you used to.  I'm afraid I, well, I lost to one of those big old Thoroughbreds and well, Amariel was a bit upset.  Well, she was quite upset and wanted to give up the sport, but I told her, "Every cloud makes the heart grow fonder!"  and... well.  She did.

replies.reply_text: So you don't do... dragon dressage anymore, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no.  No, I don't want to try anymore.  "Let bygones be living in glass houses," I always say.  Well, anyway...

replies.reply_text: Well, let me give you this message, anyway.  Ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, quite, go ahead.  After all, "Better late than forearmed."

replies.reply_text: Okay, here goes: Amariel sends you her warmest greetings, and regrets that we can no longer visit.  But she asks that one memento of you which you know she most prizes, and sends this, her Errant, to retrieve it in her stead.
That's fine, I have them here.
I'll have to go get them, sorry.  I'll be back.
Thank you very much.  I'll get this safely back to Amariel.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure you will, dear, and remember: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: My friend?  I've met the lady dragon, but I wouldn't presume to call her a friend.  As they say, a friend in need is soon parted!

replies.reply_text: She gave me the impression that she was coming to pay you a social visit, to share a recipe with you, and on her way she lost the recipe card.
Well, that's weird.  Never mind, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Company!  Oh, I love company!  Do come in!

replies.reply_text: Hi, I'm just passing through.  Good day!
Thank you.  I'm trying to help your friend Lornbacoll with something, and I wonder if you could help.
Hello!  Do you remember me?  It's nice to see you again!
I'm back with your ferns!
Hello again!  I'm sure you remember your old pal this time.  How are those ferns coming along?
Actually, the dead plants around your cave reminded me that I had to go see the plant doctor for you.  I'll be back again after I've done that.
I'm back with new ferns, Yellow Dragon.  These were specially grown by Dr. Fernlove to live on Lava Isle.
I'm done planting the ferns, Ms. Yellow Dragon.
Oh, what am I doing in here?  I'm not finished planting those ferns.  I'll be right back.
Thanks, but I was just stopping by to see how the ferns are doing.  They look great!
Thank you. I was wondering if you might move aside a step or two? I'm on a great adventure and I need to dig beneath your feet.

chatpoints.chat_text: A recipe you say?  Oh, maybe she learned of my fondness for delicious treats!  I'd never look a gift cake in the mouth.  What kind of recipe did she say it was?

replies.reply_text: For a Malted Falcon...  She said it was a favorite of hers.
I don't think I should tell you.  Maybe she wanted it to be a surprise.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yecchhh!  I hope that's just a clever name.  Can you imagine?  The flavors of malt and falcon just would NOT go well together, in my opinion.

replies.reply_text: You don't have any clues about any of this, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh! Is this some kind of mystery? How exciting! You should go talk to the Green Dragon. He's a mystery fanatic, and he kind of (nudge) has a thing for Lornbacoll. You might just be able to kill two birds with one nose to the grind stone!

replies.reply_text: (You stagger to your feet after the Yellow Dragon's gentle nudge sent you sprawling onto the ground.) Thanks, that's a good idea.

chatpoints.chat_text: Errr, even if I didn't remember you, you know what they say: A friend is just a stranger waiting to happen. Come in... come in.... (Sigh.)

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm just passing through.  You seem a bit downcast.  How are you feeling?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, out of sorts, you might say.  I feel like a wolf in cheap clothing.

replies.reply_text: What could be wrong? You look exactly how a yellow dragon should look, and your cave has just the right yellowish quality, too.
I don't like the sound of that.  I'll see you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm... Yes, it's okay.  I'd love some green, hedgy ferns, though.  Couldn't you just see them growing around my cave?  I think it would look stunning!

replies.reply_text: Sure!  Green and yellow go so well together.  Would you like me to get you some ferns?
Nope, I refuse to bring you things that would clash with your yellowness.  I'll see you later.
I'll go find some right now.  We'll have some greenery for you in no time!
Thank you!  Just what I always wanted!

chatpoints.chat_text: They're looking pretty green behind the ears, I'm afraid.  Not in a good way, either.  I just don't know what went wrong.  I was very careful to water them, and all.

replies.reply_text: I don't know anything about plants.  Sorry.  I'll see you later.
(Peek out at the very dead ferns.) They certainly aren't the picture of health.

chatpoints.chat_text: Picture of health?  Oooh, I like that one!  May I use it?

replies.reply_text: Feel free.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I think I figured out what to do, in case you came back to help me again.

replies.reply_text: I live to serve!  Please tell me what I can do for you.
Er... I was just passing through, actually.  Bye.
I'll see if I can find him.
I don't think he's a doctor for plants, I think he's a scientist...

chatpoints.chat_text: It can't hurt to try!  If he's a plant scientist, he probably knows a thing or two about plants.

replies.reply_text: You're right about that.  I'll see what I can find out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hurrah!  Success is near!  And aren't these ferns just the little pitchers of health!

replies.reply_text: Yes, the picture of health. The good doctor said to spade up the earth and carefully transplant them.
I'll be careful with them.  See you in a few!
Thanks!  I'm happy you like them.  I'll be off to wash my hands now!

chatpoints.chat_text: All thanks to you!

replies.reply_text: Aw, it was nothing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? A grand adventure? How exciting. Of course, here you go!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: Magenta Dragon
npc_list.short_description: A Dragon with a Mane of Crimson

chatpoints.chat_text: (From deep within the cave, you hear a low rumble, as if something slumbers inside... something best left undisturbed.)

replies.reply_text: Hello?
Goodbye!
O Dragon, you wished for five yellow crystal shards?
O Dragon, may I speak to you?
Hello? O Dragon, are you here?
O Dragon, I've returned.
Excuse me, good Dragon. I have need to dig beneath you, to fetch long forgotten treasure. May I have your permission to do so?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The rumbling grows louder, and then you hear something move. Looking into the cave, you can see a glow as if of pink-purple flame. And then you see the eye... enormous... piercing... and cold.)
A visitor in the Dragon Maze? You went through great trouble to find me, did you not? I wonder what made you do that. Are you here for gain, perhaps? Or are you here to gawp at me?

replies.reply_text: O Dragon, I've come with a message from Amariel.

chatpoints.chat_text: Amariel?! (The Magenta Dragon's voice deepens.) And what does Amariel want with me, I wonder? I do not carry. I do not give rides like a common mule. I do not respond to requests.

replies.reply_text: Nevertheless, O Dragon, long have I wandered and through many paths I travelled in order to bring this message to you.  If not for Amariel, won't you receive it for my sake?
Fine, be that way.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The dragon's head slowly rises; the eyes seem to burn as they look into yours.) Speak then, messenger. I will listen, for your sake.

replies.reply_text: O Dragon, Amariel bade me say this to you: Amariel sends you her warmest greetings, and regrets that we can no longer visit.  But she asks that one memento of you which you know she most prizes, and sends this, her Errant, to retrieve it in her stead

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, is that it? Is that all? Only a small gift. That is all she asks. How very simple. A comfort in her old age.
I would ask her in return, for some comfort in my old age. Some peace for me and my fellows. For friendships made and trusts broken! Oh, but that is much too big a thing to ask for so slight a favor!

replies.reply_text: Please, O Dragon, I've heard bits and snippets of stories from the others.  What happened?  Please tell me.
Really, O Dragon, I came all this way.  Please, may I have the Orb?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dark smoke issues from the Magenta Dragon's nostrils.) I do not treat with messengers and servants! But this I will do for you, since you have kept your word, and done your duty, and come so far and through so many tests.

replies.reply_text: What will you do?
I'll go in search of them at once, O Dragon.
I have them here, O Dragon.
Thank you, O Dragon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Take it and go. Leave me in peace. (The great dragon turns, and slowly moves back into the darkness.)

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: About what? (The voice echoes from somewhere far away. Footfalls sound, nearer.... nearer... and the Magenta Dragon appears, his eyes glaring into yours.)

replies.reply_text: On second thought, I think I'll just go.  Sorry to disturb you.  Bye!
O Dragon, I've been sent by Guru Wiseman. (You explain, carefully and in measured tones, about the Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I see. (The Magenta Dragon regards you very carefully.) I will tell you, then. The greatest piece of wisdom I know. A piece of wisdom only the wise will receive gladly.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, O Dragon.  I will write it down.  What is it?
I don't like the sound of this already, but go ahead.
Sorry to bother you, I think I'll just go ask elsewhere.
Actually, I think you're absolutely right about that!  Thank you!
Not me!  As soon as I can get out of school, I'm out!  School bores me to death!
Oooooooooookay.  Thanks anyway.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Be gone!

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The Magenta Dragon snorts acrid smoke, and examines you minutely.) You intrigue me with your pretty words. It may be indeed that you might be of some use, especially since you have hands which use tools....
Then promise me this: that you will go forth, Errant, find my Egg in whole or in all of its parts, and should it be in pieces, have it repaired. Having so done, you will then bring it back to me, never thinking to keep the prize for yourself. Promise me this.

replies.reply_text: But... I can't promise any such thing!  I may never find it.  In the end, it might be impossible.  No, sorry, I can't do that.   Sorry.  Goodbye.
This do I swear, O Dragon. (You repeat the promise, solemnly, adding only that you will do the best that is in your power to recover the egg.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I see no reason to trust that, finding my treasure, you would not keep it for your own, or sell it, in whole or in part.

replies.reply_text: What assurance might I give thee, O Dragon, that I am a person of my word?  That if I say, I shall bring it back to you whole and hale, as a measure of respect to thee?
Oh.  Well!  If that's how you feel, forget it then!  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: GONE!!

replies.reply_text: I'm going!  Bye!
Gone?  What's gone?

chatpoints.chat_text: (From the back of the cave comes what can only be described as a glowering... and then the Magenta Dragon himself appears, his eyes wide and nostrils flared with rage!) My egg! The very same from which I hatched! An item of inestimable worth it is, and ever shall be, while it exists whole! Know you, perhaps, whence it be taken?

replies.reply_text: Not a clue, sorry.  I'll just leave you to get on looking for it.  Bye!
O Dragon, if you will permit me, I've found many missing objects in my time, some very difficult to track down. Perhaps I can help you here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah.  That is well, Errant.  Then let me describe it; which never would I have done without your promise. It is the length of your forearm, composed of purple shell marbled with copper.  'Twas broken into four pieces ere I hatched, and fixed back together with gold as a glazier would assemble stained glass with lead.  The shards are said to have many magical properties; the whole together is invaluable.  Use your tools.  Search minutely for clues.

replies.reply_text: Did you find any clues here in the cave, O Dragon?
I'm off.  As soon as I have the egg, whole and in good repair, I shall return.

chatpoints.chat_text: Searched I every inch, but naught did I find but marks upon the ground where the egg was rolled out into my courtyard.  Thence, no clues were there for mine eyes to see.

replies.reply_text: Well, I have a magnifying glass here.  Perhaps I can find something.  I will start on my quest now, O Dragon! I will not let you down!

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you indeed?  And is your quest completed?

replies.reply_text: It is, O Dragon.  May I present you with your Egg.  Safe and whole as promised.
Alas, it is not, O Dragon.

chatpoints.chat_text: And yet you have come to me anyway?

replies.reply_text: Ah.  I'll leave you in peace, then.  Good day to you.
O Dragon, I have all the shards, but I don't know where to go to get them repaired.  Please, do you know?
Penfold said that ferrets must have the shards.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Magenta Dragon gives forth a most irritated sigh, sending sulfurous fumes right into your face.) Surely somebody in town will know. Go now, and don't come back until the egg is whole. (The dragon breathes a small flame, to make his point.)

replies.reply_text: Thank you, O Dragon, I shall do so.
Oh, uhm... Thanks!  Just what I needed!  Goodbye, O Dragon!  May we meet again someday!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Magenta Dragon's eyes get first very wide, and then very narrow. He snakes his head toward you.) Well, you won't find any ferrets in here, will you??

replies.reply_text: I should hope not.   I'll just carry on looking for them, shall I?  Good day to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Magenta Dragon gives forth a most irritated sigh, sending sulfurous fumes right into your face.) I will move aside. But make haste. I don't wish to be bothered.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much. I'll be out of your lair in no time.

npc_list.name: Freddy
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 6
npc_list.long_description: Freddy has a slightly manic look; happy, but perhaps over-energetic.  He's amazed to see everyone and everything.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Look what you did!
(The owner of the house seems to be waxing hysterical about a layer of grey powder on the floor--and on the face of a very large dog, who is looking at him dolefully.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm sorry, I've come at a bad time.
Good grief, what's happened here?
Thirty pumice stones is what you wanted, right?
Excuse me?? I just wanted to ask you a question.  Do you know where I might be able to find a carved stone the color of night?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Ooooh, dear. Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear! I was supposed to deliver these today and I stayed up all night getting them just right and I'd just gone out to get a box and saddle my horse to make the delivery and I came back in here and oh dear, oh dear, oh dear! Bad Spot! Bad dog!
(The dog seems to shrug.)

replies.reply_text: What happened?  What were you working on?

chatpoints.chat_text: Pumice rocks! I collect them from around here, oh, the maze is full of them, and I carefully carve them so they fit your hands, you see. They're excellent for removing mud from a horse's coat and removing botfly eggs and they're good for stable stains and all kinds of things and...Spot here has chewed them all up!

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  And you have a delivery to make too!  Can I help?  I wouldn't mind having one of those for my horses!
Tsk.  Bad dog, Spot.  Oh well, I'll leave you to clean up, then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear.  Oooooooh, dear, oh well yes, there is something you can do for me if you'd be so kind. I can't get a full order in time, oh dear, oh dear, but if you could run out and find me oh, I don't know, say, maybe... oh, I just don't know...

replies.reply_text: Okay, calm down.  You need more pumice stones, obviously.  Now, how many do you need?
Okay, I'll see what I can do.  You want a batch of thirty.  I'll go see what I can find.
Great!  I have thirty with me!  Here they are!
Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, hello there. How nice of you to come by again. Have you got any pumice stones? I can always use them and I'll pay you $75 each, you know.

replies.reply_text: I don't have any now, but I'll keep you in mind!  Bye!
I have some pumice stones with me.
Not this time, but I was wondering if you would know where I could find a carved stone the color of night?
I don't right now, but I was wondering about that easel you have.
I have another one!
That's all for now, see you anon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm.... A carved stone the color of night.  Go check out Patrick's store.  He has a very eclectic selection of goods, maybe he will have what you want.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do.  Thanks for the tip!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That old thing?  I wanted to paint a dinosaur, but never got around to it.  I'm always so busy.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  It looks like it could be pretty cute.  Well, I really should be going.  All this ash starts to clog my lungs.  Bye!
Let me do it!  Just tell me what you want, and I can paint it.  I'm quite the pro.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, all right. If you insist.
I want it to be a bright dinosaur. Bright green with orange and yellow. The ground can be a boring brown and the sky a nice, bright shade of blue.

replies.reply_text: I think I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello there.  I can do something for you, yes?

replies.reply_text: No, not really, I'm just looking around, thanks.
No thanks.  Well, actually, I'm looking around to see if anyone has jobs I can do.
Hi, uh... Please tell me again what you wanted and where I can find it?
Hi, Xiang, I've returned with the Dragons' Teeth!
Hello.  I hope so; I've got this poem from Holli Daysin over in Tropicton and I know I'm supposed to be on this island, but I don't know who will have what I need.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jobs you can do?  Oh, yes!  I have a job you can do.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Please tell me about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, I will. I used to have a wonderful set of dragons' teeth. One from each of the dragons. They were just here. (Xiang points to an empty space on a shelf.) Well, I got into a fight with my little brother and he took them! He said he buried one by each volcano in the Maze. Why? Because he knows I am claustrophobic and won't go in there. Well, that's little brothers for you.

replies.reply_text: And you'd like me to go get them for you?
Oh, no, I'm not going near that maze!  Not me!  You'll have to ask someone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you would do that I will be very grateful, and reward you well.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'll do it.
Okay, I'm on my way.  I'll return when I've got them all.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wanted you to dig up some dragons' teeth I lost.  They're buried around the feet of the volcanoes in the maze, one to each volcano.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
I thought you said your brother lost them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah.  My brother.  Right!

replies.reply_text: Hmmmm....

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wonderful!  Please let me see them.

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Thank you very much!  Goodbye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, maybe I can help you...  What does the poem say?

replies.reply_text:
Go to the land where lava flows with might
retrieve a carving of stone the color of night.
This is Lava Isle, right? So do you have any carved stone the color of night?
Lenny it is, then.  Thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe you are looking for carving made of Obsidian.  Unfortunately, I don't have any in stock right now.

replies.reply_text: Oh...  Do you know anyone who might have a spare Obsidian carving right now?
Darn...  Guess I'll have to keep looking.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Pella
npc_list.admin_description: back in her cave

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.

replies.reply_text: Hello there, it's good to see you back at home.
Hi, just passing through!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is good to be home.  Now, I believe I said I had a little something for you, did I not?

replies.reply_text: Yes, you did.
Thanks!  Bye.

npc_list.name: Bruce
npc_list.admin_description: The First Bruce You Meet.  NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: Bruce is a giant of a man, very stout and strong.  He wears a kilt in the blue and green Johnston clan tartan and carries a bagpipe, which he plays beautifully.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Before you stands an enormous brawny man in highland dress, playing the bagpipes and occasionally peering over the wall of the maze.)

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, are you Bruce?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Bruce puts down his bagpipes and stands regarding you keenly with his fists on his hips.)
Och, that I am, aye.

replies.reply_text: Great, perhaps you could help me.  I'm trying to find Pella.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pella is it?  Aye, I'm trying to find her myself.  Been trying for two days, and this is the first time I've seen a sign of her!

replies.reply_text: Oh no. If you've been looking that long I guess I have no chance of finding her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I wouldn't say that. After all, I've nae had a chance to look everywhere yet.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, but still.  I guess I'll give up.
Really?  Where have you not looked?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, in the maze, of course, for I never go there.  Actually... I canna stray far from this wall or else I lose my direction, ye ken.  And my good horse, Robert, he's gone wandered off so I can't rely on him... Well, he always does that.  Doesn't like the pipes, Robert.

replies.reply_text: How long ago did Robert leave?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'd say...... Oh.... Right after I left the house.  Threw me right on my back.  Och I was terrified he'd broken the pipes!  But I got here and I walked around and around and kept this wall on me right so I'd nae get lost!  Aye!

replies.reply_text: Whoa, whoa, whoa!  You mean, all you've done for two days is walk around this maze just going right next to the wall?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  That's right.  And I know exactly where I am at all times!  And now I find these tracks!  I've passed here twice before and nae seen them!  Here they are, look!

replies.reply_text: Oh, good grief...  Okay, well, I'll tell you what.  Why don't you go on home while you can still find your way, and I'll go find Pella?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go home?  Just when the dragons are enjoying the pipes?  Nae, if you'll go after Pella, I'll just keep walking around serenading the monsters, aye.

replies.reply_text: Well, please tell me about the clue you found, then.
Okay, I'll go look.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, who've we got here now?  Come in!  What can I do for ye?

replies.reply_text: Hello.  I'm looking for Bruce, is he here?
Oh nothing, just stopping by to see the town!  Good day!
I'm sorry, I just can't find Bruce, could you remind me where to look again?
I'm looking for a carved stone the color of night...do you know where I should look?
I have a package for you from the Treeton Gear Shop.
Hi there!  Special delivery from Goodwin!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, this is where he lives.  I'm his wife, Colina.  Bruce is nae here now ye ken.  Anything I can do?

replies.reply_text: No, I don't think so. I'll just leave you to get back to your... What is that?
Well, this may sound strange, but I'm trying to find a salamander named Pella and I have reason to hope that you or Bruce might know where she might be?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, blancmange!  I make nice big ones!

replies.reply_text: Really?  Uhm... I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: Och, aye, sure, we know Pella very well!  She often comes to the volcanos just outside town, just there, ye ken.  Haven't seen her in weeks, though.

replies.reply_text: She seems to have gone missing from her home.  There's a note in her cave, but it's very old.  Do you know where she might have gone?  Or would Bruce know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, that's nae good.  But that'd explain why Bruce is nae home; he'd be out looking for her.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, in that case I don't need to worry, then.  Thanks!  Goodbye!
Hmm!  Maybe I can help him, then!  Pella has been gone for an awfully long time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, well, one thing ye should keep in mind when dealing with Pella: She does like her little joke now and then.

replies.reply_text: You mean she's probably all right?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Och, I did nae say that, no. Nae wi' all these dragons about! But... Just a wee tidbit to keep in mind when dealin' wi' her.
Now, if ye want to go find Bruce, mostly he travels along the edge of the maze. He can nae go in, for he's got a horrible sense of direction! But you'll find him somewhere around the outside!

replies.reply_text: I don't want anything else to do with that maze, thanks.  I guess I'll just let Bruce find Pella.
Okay, I'll try to find Bruce then. Any idea where I should start looking?
Thanks a lot!  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Och, have ye nae been ter Patrick's store yet?  He may have what ye seeks.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll go there now.  Bye!
You're welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Och, aye, got a homing pigeon there have ye?

replies.reply_text: Right here.
Great!  I'll let him know!

npc_list.name: Zik
npc_list.admin_description: Not permanent

chatpoints.chat_text: Ellohay!  Aybemay ouyay ancay elphay!

replies.reply_text: I don't believe I understand you.  Do you speak English?
Oh!  You need help?  I think I understand.  Oday ouyay eednay elphay?
I don't speak Martian, sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nglisheay?  Like this?  Simple variation of native language igpay atinlay.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  So you were speaking pig latin?  Sorry, I don't know it.  So what were you saying?
This is still too weird for me. I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: Esyay! Yes in Earth Speak.  Can help you?

replies.reply_text: I probably can.  What do you need help with?
Well, this is too much for me.  I'm out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ship landed broken.  Need new parts needed.  Friend went to look for some.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, not another quest.  I really don't have time for this.
So... let me see here.  You had to land your ship because something had broken and now your friend has gone to look for the items you need to repair it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct.  Friend go look for supplies.  Gone too long.  Go look for friend?

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I can.  He can't have gone too far, can he?
I'm sorry, but I don't have time to be looking all over the place for Martians.
Okay.  I'll go see if I can find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: You find friend?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, sorry.
Where should I look again?
Yes, I did!  I'm getting objects for him right now. I better get back to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Next isle west.  Near water.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

npc_list.name: Zak
npc_list.admin_description: Not permanent

chatpoints.chat_text: Ancay ouyay elphay emay?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, here we go again.  Do you speak Earth Speak?
Forget it.  I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: You met Zik?  He send you here?

replies.reply_text: Yes, actually, he did.  He said you went to look for material to fix the ship.  He also said that you had been gone too long.
Let's pretend I didn't.  I think I'm in a little over my head here. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't find materials.  Can help you?  Just need few more.

replies.reply_text: I'm too busy, so I guess he will just have to wait a little bit longer.
How many is a few?

chatpoints.chat_text: First need 15 grey rock and 10 chunks iron.  Can you find?

replies.reply_text: Oh, why not?  It does seem like a lot, but I've had to do worse.
You call that a few?  Forget it, I'm out of here.
Okay, I will try to.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you the items?

replies.reply_text: What did you need again?
No, not yet, sorry.
Yes, I have them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 15 grey rock and 10 iron rock.  Hurry, please.

replies.reply_text: Don't go anywhere.  I should be back soon.
That depends.  What do you need?
I just really don't have the time.  Perhaps I can come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Last things needed 5 blue crystal and 5 green crystal.  Can do?

replies.reply_text: Oh, why not?  I'm already halfway through, anyway.  I can't really quit now.
No way.  I'm done.  Hope you get everything figured out.
See you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have crystals?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have them right here.
No, not yet, sorry.  I'm still looking.
What was I looking for again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Need 5 blue crystal and 5 green crystal.

replies.reply_text: Ah, yes, I remember now.
That was weird... Oh, well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my dear, my dear, you've come at last!  Welcome, welcome to my own little part of the Universe!  Do sit down!  Do, please!

replies.reply_text: Uuuuuuh, no thanks.  I need to water my plants.
Hi!  Sure!  Will do!  What's up?
Selena!  I've got some more moonbeams!  Here you are!
Selena, could you read my shards for another one of my horses?
Hi, sorry to bother you, but I think there might have been something you wanted to ask me?
Yeah... Hi!  I really only want to know if you would know where I can find a carved stone the color of night?
Thanks Selena.   How are things in the Great Cosmic Wonderverse today?
I'm back again to learn about the restless spirit, Selena.
Hi Selena, could you remind me what I'm supposed to be looking for?
Hi Selena!  Is the Great Cosmic Wonderverse in balance now?
Selena!  Why are you waving that yellow shard at me?  Have I done something to offend?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, such a clever question!  Oh, my dear, my dear, dear Rider, how I have waited to read the Shards for you and your horses!

replies.reply_text: Read the Shards?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Selena claps her hands in delight!) Oh, you wonderful, lovely rider, so keen to keep a poor, lonely soul like myself, engaged in conversation by pretending to be flummoxed! You have come of course to have the Shards read! I can see it in your hair!

replies.reply_text: No, that's hay... it was windy in the barn...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Selena takes from a table a silver platter on which lay seven shards of crystal in different colors. She hands this to you as if she were showing off her newest kitten.) Take this, dear rider. Show it to your finest steed, that in all Truth and Forsoothnecicity, I might tell you what the Fates have planned for you! Hold it up, nice and high! Now, tell me! Upon which of the crystals does your favorite horse gaze?

replies.reply_text: Uhm, actually, he's eating your plants...
The red one.
The blue one.
The purple one.
The green one.
The cyan one.
The yellow one.
The magenta one.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Selena is brought up a bit short.) Oh. Well, then I suppose you are not yet ready to make a foray into the vastocity of the Cosmobleerium! Go now! Leave me to commune with the great Ningi.

replies.reply_text: Uh, yyyyyyyyeah, fine, you do that.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: The red!  Your champion gazes upon the Red Shard!  I see in your future a great snapping!  A danger which devours scarlet!  A secret longing to escape by means of verse and rhyme!  I see you in the cloud, handing over beauty to a pig!  Ahh, the Fates, they are so clear!  And... I see also a sly one, surrounded by purple orbs!  All these things involve the same Redness!  You have a very busy future, my dear!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: The blue shard!  Oh, my dear, your noble steed has chosen an omen of manifest destiny indeed!  I see in your path a great Blue Obstacle... and several lesser, more ... squishy but cottony obstacles... also I see strings and straps of blazing blue!  And also, one last thing in your path, a ghostly thing aboard an ancient ship!  Collect the Blueness for him!  Such a fate!  Ahhh!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: The purple!  The color of Royalty!  You, my dear rider, will be given much opportunity to deal with royalty, both real and appalling!  You will have set before you choices of the greatest import!  And tasks!  Oh, the tasks!  One in particular involves a choice for a child!  And I see a wedding gala in your future!  Oh, yes!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Green!  Ahhh, yes!  Green!  You, my dear, will be made to gather green to light the way, and green to go on with the show!  You will need green for those which fly, and green to combine with that which was once green to feed those at their deserved ease!  Seek green, my dear!  Seek green!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Cyan Crystal!  The color of the sky beckons!  Find you that which Cyan Jewel which flies and bring it unto the sky itself!  There is some need of it there!  And in the coldest reaches, you will find there one who most values the Pink that becomes Cyan!  Seek her out!  And also look within, for the Great Cyanness within and beyond!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh, Yellow!  My dear!  The color of riches of course, but also the color of mixed metaphors!  There are many who need it, and few who understand it!  And then, oh yes, then, there is the yellow in the weaving of the sticks!  A most exciting omen!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Magenta crystal!  The most powerful of all!  Only one fate awaits the chooser of the Magenta crystal, and it is awe-inspiring and quite out of the ordinary.  When you do this, you must stick to the right, my dear!  Stick ever to the right!

replies.reply_text: Right, but I.... okay.
Not now, thanks, I've got to run.  Bye!
Selena, you look a little conflicted.  Was there something you wanted to ask me?

chatpoints.chat_text: As you can see, my abode is a home to the Great Cosmic Wonderverse! And I have gathered here as ornaments and reminders of that splendor, all these magnificent artifacts. (She sweeps a hand to indicate the planets and such that hang around.) Inspiring, isn't it?

replies.reply_text: Uh... Yeah!  Sure is!  What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear rider, it has come to my attention that one can sometimes obtain moonbeams on these isles.  Is this correct?

replies.reply_text: I've heard something to that effect, yes.
Yeah, I've seen them, they're pretty cool!  But they're really hard to get.
Forty two...?
Okay, I'll be sure to bring some whenever I find them.
Say, I've got some right here, if you want them!

chatpoints.chat_text: A number of the greatest cosmopological significance!

replies.reply_text: Whatever.
Ooooh, right!  Sure.  I'll bring some when I find them.
You're in luck!  I've got some right here!
I'll bring more when I can!  Goodbye!
I have another!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Selena stares at her shards and begins to hum and rock back and forth as in a trance. You start to leave her hut!) Wait! (You stop and turn around.) The Cosmic powers have told me that to find what you seek you must go see the exotic Madam Xiang!

replies.reply_text: Madam Xiang?  Okay, why not!  Thanks for the Cosmic insight... Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you're here!  I sense a severe cosmic schism - something must be done, and quickly!

replies.reply_text: A schism?  That sounds messy.   Do you have a mop?
I'll just schism my way right back out the door.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: How I wish it would be that easy. No dear, I sense a vibration of discord. I feel... I feel... (Selena gropes for her tray of crystals.) Here, the blue shard... emanates warmth... ahhhhhh!

replies.reply_text: Woah, what does that mean?
Ahhh, the blue shard, oooh... Wow, where am I?  I think I will go get some blue shards.  Thanks for the idea!
Oh? (You roll your eyes.) And what could that mean?

chatpoints.chat_text: We are being summoned by one of the ethereal plane!  Are you ready to accept this quest from the great beyond?

replies.reply_text: Oooh, sounds terribly mysterious!  I'm in!
Thanks, but no thanks.  I'm more into gathering berries and stuff.   See you later.
I guess.  Sure.  I'm ready for anything.
Okay, I'll just wait here anxiously while you do that, then?
I feel kind of antsy about all this.  I think I'll take a jog around the park while you consult your guides.  I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhhh, oooh!  I see a Great Green Turtle in the agitated vision!  Normally a peaceful old soul.  Flowers... butterflies... ahhhhh!   Many depend upon this turtle to shelter and sustain them.

replies.reply_text: Nice and vague so far.  I've never met a turtle in these parts.  Animals are notoriously tricky to find, too... Anything more specific?

chatpoints.chat_text: Step out of your literal mind, dear, and let your thoughts wander.  I'm certain you can sense the Great Turtle if you try.

replies.reply_text: Maybe I can... Well, what else do you see?
My literal mind must be working overtime today.  I'll come back when I'm not so blocked.

chatpoints.chat_text: I feel a place of ancient wisdom and learning is near this poor restless soul.  Yes... yes... perhaps the spirit is frustrated that it cannot tap the wisdom?

replies.reply_text: That's the weirdest thing so far.  Someone is frustrated because they can't go to school?
I'm fed up with people expecting me to piece together too-vague clues.  Seriously, I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sense many crumbling tomes, much wisdom.  I don't sense a school.  Yes, this is a poor soul indeed.  Ohhhh, please help it!

replies.reply_text: Even if I do manage to find a Great Turtle and some source of great wisdom, how am I supposed to find the spirit?  Is it just going to pop up and scare me when I get to the right place?
I think you're going to have to do this by yourself.  I'm not sure at all what you mean.
So that's all?  And now I'm off on a wild ghost chase...

chatpoints.chat_text: I sense your mind is cluttered with mundane trivialities.  Might I suggest you start taking notes?

replies.reply_text: You're probably right.  Please remind me what I was supposed to be looking for.
Ohhh, right.  I'm out of ink.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Our lamenting friend is supported by a Great Green Turtle, and I sensed a location of great learning.  If you seek out this place, I think you shall hear our friend.  Center yourself, seek, and ye shall find!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for... that.

chatpoints.chat_text: The guides have faded, I sense no more.

replies.reply_text: Shucks.
Thanks very much!  I wasn't expecting this!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, my dear... I sense that riches you so deserve are languishing beneath the earth.   Yessss... return to the spirit.  He desires to give, but he lacks... hands.

replies.reply_text: Means nothing to me.  I'm pretty sure Higgins is happy now.  See ya!
Oooh, more treasure?  I must have missed something.  I'll head back now and check!

npc_list.name: Ariela
npc_list.admin_description: 1st Ariela, no more quests on this ID
npc_list.long_description: A beautiful little mermaid. Somehow, you expected her to be larger, but Ariela is only about 3 feet tall. And her very fancy tail takes up at least one foot of that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found anything yet?

replies.reply_text: What was I supposed to be doing again?  I seem to have forgotten.
No I'm sorry.  I am still looking.
Yes!  I found a lot of little bird tracks leading off to the West.  Perhaps a bird took your necklace?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Now what am I going to do?

replies.reply_text: What seems to be the matter?
Oh no you don't!  I'm not getting involved in another quest.  I'm leaving before this goes any further.

chatpoints.chat_text: My favorite necklace is gone! It belonged to my mother and now I've gone and lost it! (She then bursts into tears.)

replies.reply_text: Let me guess, you want me to go and find the necklace?  Well I'm sorry but I'm just too busy.
That's horrible!  What happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I was out sunbathing on a small island when the storm hit.  I tried to make it home but instead I got caught up in the waves and ended up here on this beach.  My necklace must have fallen off sometime during the storm.

replies.reply_text: Well, good luck, and I hope you find your necklace.
Do you have any idea where it could have ended up?

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately it was so windy that by the time I realized what had happened, the necklace was gone.  The only thing that I can think of is that perhaps something carried it away.

replies.reply_text: Maybe if I looked for some clues?  Perhaps I could find something.
Hopefully you can find it.  I do need to go now though.
Okay.  I will see what I can find.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? That's wonderful! I really don't have any legs to walk on, (She wiggles her fish body a little.) Do you think that perhaps you could go and search for me?

replies.reply_text: No problem.  I'll see what I can do.  Do you have any ideas on how to find this bird?
Actually I can't right now.  I'm terribly sorry but I'm just too busy.
Okay, I will see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe you were looking for some sort of clue as to where my necklace may have disappeared to.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I remember now.  I should be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found my necklace yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  Sorry.
Where should I be looking again?
Yes I did!  It was up in a tree to the west of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Try checking up in the trees.  Birds like to hide things up there.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'm off now.
I'm glad I was able to help.  I hope to see you again.

npc_list.name: Sir Sleepwell
npc_list.short_description: a Retired Knight of the Realm.

chatpoints.chat_text: Upon my word, thou wisheth to travel to yon Lava Isles?  Aye, by my troth I can send thee there.  But first, I shall warn thee thus: if thou art not of stoutest heart--as demonstrated by your earning of the 25% Quest Points award, then the dark Lava Isles are no place for thee!  And even so, I shall set thee a task... I want... Wildflowers!

replies.reply_text: You want what?!  Okay, how many?

chatpoints.chat_text: Zounds!  Upon my word, what bringst thee hence to mine Isle Abode, forsooth?

replies.reply_text: Hello.  Deidra sent me here.  She said you might know how to get to those dark islands to the east.
Just looking, thanks.  Didn't mean to intrude.
Can you send me back to Hoof Isle, please?
Can you send me to the Lava Isles now?
I'm going to go look around for bit.
(You notice 2 obvious blank spaces on the wall just behind the noble knight.) Excuse me for being so forward, Sir Sleepwell, but aren't you missing something?
Excuse me, Sir Sleepwell, but I think I've forgotten what you sent me to Patsy for... Sorry!
Greetings, noble knight! (You notice that the shield is back in its proper place on the wall shining as good as new.) I see that Patsy returned home.
Greetings, noble knight! (You notice that the shield is back in its proper place on the wall shining as good as new.) I see that Patsy returned home.
I gave you the sword.  Was there anything else you needed?
Hark, noble knight! I seek they daughter, the fair Ms. Pugg.  Is she at home?
Okay, I'll go get those, then.  Could you send me back to Deidra, please?
I have them here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sir Sleepwell turns, looks sadly at the wall and sighs.) Gadzooks, thou art a wise and keenly observant traveler. Forsooth, I am beside myself.

replies.reply_text: Pray tell me my lord, what has thee so upset? Did I really just say that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou canst see, as plain as thy nose upon thy face, that my finest sword and shield are gone!

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe thy... I mean your page, Patsy took them down for a little cleaning or repair.

chatpoints.chat_text: That well may be, but that scamp, Patsy, hath been missing for several days now.  Kindly adventurer, wouldst thou look for that knave, Patsy, on yon Lava Isle for me?

replies.reply_text: You know, I would, but I'm already so busy... Maybe next time I'm here.  Sorry.
Sir Sleepwell, I would be honored to take up thy... darn, I mean your quest.
On second thought, I'm going to go look around for bit.
Most certainly, my lord, now if you wouldst... would... be so kind as to send me to Lava Isle and I'll begin your quest.  Here are the wildflowers.
Actually, I need to get some wildflowers for you first.  Please send me back to Deidra.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sir Sleepwell rolls his eyes and sighs deeply.) Thou were sent to retrieve my sword and shield.

replies.reply_text: Riiight... that's it.  Well, I have your wildflowers here.  Please send me to the Lava Isles.
Oh, yes.  Well, I don't have the wildflowers you want now, so please send me back to Deidra.
Okay.  Well, I'm going to look around here a little bit, then I'll come back to get off the isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yea verily that scamp didst return my shield and confess his transgressions.  He also said that thou were to bring my sword to me.  Have thoust my sword?

replies.reply_text: Yes, Sir Sleepwell, I have thy armament... darn... your sword right here.
Looks really good, doesn't it?
It has been my honor to serve you, my lord.  Could you find it in your grace to send me back to Lava Isle?
I am truly honored to have been in your service, Sir Sleepwell.  Would you please send me back to Hoof Isle now?
I'm thrilled to have been in your service, but if it's just the same to you, I'm going to go look around for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yea verily that scamp didst return my shield and confess his transgressions.  He also said that thou were to bring my sword to me.  Have thoust my sword?

replies.reply_text: Well, not exactly...

chatpoints.chat_text: Not exactly?  Not exactly??  Well then, noble traveler, get thee hence and bring me my sword!

replies.reply_text: All right, Sir Sleepwell, I'll be back in a jiffy with your sword.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: She is without, Gentle Errant!  Wandering the isles with the Messrs. Spade and Glossover forsooth!
O, 'ello, welcome to Lava Isle!

replies.reply_text: You're Patsy, then?
Hello, goodbye.
Hi, could you send me back to Sir Sleepwell, please?
Hi.  Can you get to any of the other isles around here?
Patsy!  Are you all right?  Sir Sleepwell said that you have been gone for several days now.
Yoo hoo, Patsy! I'm back, but you're not going to like what I have to tell you...
What am I supposed to do for you again?
I'm sorry, but who is supposed to fix this sword again?
I gave you the shield.  What did you want me to do about the "bigger problem"?
Hi Patsy!  I need help, Iona over in Flipperton sent me to find a stonewright on Lava.  Do you know who I need to see?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that's right. I'm Patsy, Sir Sleepwell's loyal servant.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
How come you're not with Sir Sleepwell, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, to be honest, he's a bit of a boring old coot, really.  I come here for the excitement, adventure, and really wild things.

replies.reply_text: Excitement, adventure and... really?  What's there to do here?
I see.  Well, I'm going to have a quick look around.  Goodbye, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: What's there to do 'ere?  Why, you can get Selena to tell your fortune, or you can visit the dragons----

replies.reply_text: There are dragons here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  All kinds of them.  Some of them are a bit loopy, if you know what I mean.  Well, I'll let you be getting on, no sense in standing around here.  Come back to me when you're ready to leave, and I'll send you back.

replies.reply_text: Loopy dragons, just what I need.  Well, thanks a lot, I'll be seeing you!
Could you send me back to Sir Sleepwell now, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  Well, just Igneous Isle.  You are welcome to go there, if you like.

replies.reply_text: Please.  Could you send me there?
Oh, no thanks.  I'll just stick to the main Lava Isle.  Thanks.
Wait!  Wha...?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patsy is looking at his feet, avoiding your eyes, dragging his toes back and forth in the sand.) I've been here...

replies.reply_text: Do you, by any chance, know anything about the good knight's missing sword and shield?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patsy is still looking at his feet.) Well... yes, I know where they are, sort of. I took them, borrowed them, the other day.

replies.reply_text: And?  Where are they?

chatpoints.chat_text: My friend, Koko, wanted to see a real sword and shield... so I gave them to her... lent them to her. But she hasn't returned them yet.

replies.reply_text: Let me get this straight... You took them, okay, borrowed them from Sir Sleepwell, without his permission. Then you gave them to that dizzy Koko, and now you don't know where they are. Is that about right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that's right.  I beseech you, kindly traveler.  Could you help me retrieve the sword and shield?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but you dug this hole, now you have to get out of it.
I suppose I could help.  I did promise Sir Sleepwell that I'd try to find his sword and shield.
All right, I guess I can try to talk to that dizzy girl.  Could you send me to Igneous Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, valiant traveler! (Patsy pales when he realizes what you just said.) What aren't I going to like?

replies.reply_text: It seems your ditsy friend was playing knights and dragons, slew a big rock, and broke the sword.  Then she threw the shield away on the beach.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blimey!  She did a right proper job of mucking them up, didn't she?

replies.reply_text: You got that right!  Now what are you going to do about them?  You can't return them to Sir Sleepwell in this condition.
Well, do you have any suggestions for this "bigger problem"?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a blacksmith, Ward Anvil by name, who has done some restoration work on my lord's weapons in the past.  Perchance he could repair this sword also.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like a plan.  Where is Ward Anvil located?

chatpoints.chat_text: His shop is in Hotton on Desert Isle.  Would you be able to bring the sword to him for repair, and then return it to Sir Sleepwell?  I'll return the shield, and confess my folly.

replies.reply_text: You've got to be kidding!  All the way to Hotton, then back to Sir Sleepwell? I'm sorry, that's going to take too much of my time.  See ya!

Well, you got me again.  I did promise Sir Sleepwell that I'd find and return the sword and shield.  But you always send me back to him, and I can't very well bring this sword to him before it's repaired.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right of course, can't send you back to him with his sword in that condition.  I should be able to send you to a neighboring isle....  I hope.

replies.reply_text: What do you mean maybe? Oh, all right. Go ahead and send me. (You shut your eyes very tightly.)
You hope?  I think I'll look around first.  Then maybe I'll let you send me.

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to retrieve my lord's sword and shield from Koko.  Do you have them yet?

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, I forgot... I'm on it!  Could you send me back to Koko, please??

chatpoints.chat_text: You're supposed to bring the sword to Ward Anvil in Hotton.  Blimey, the quality of help nowadays!

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, that's right.  Could you send me back to that island and I'll try it again?
Thanks again!!... (You look around.) Cool!

chatpoints.chat_text: Stonewright?  You must mean Lenny.  He's built all the mazes around here.  You'll find him behind the Dragons' Maze.

replies.reply_text: Thanks Patsy, I knew you'd know!

npc_list.name: Penfold
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests start at CP9
npc_list.short_description: A young boy, fond of guinea pigs.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sob sniff sob)

replies.reply_text: Is something wrong?
Are you okay?  You don't look so well.
I don't do so well with crying children.  I'm going to go.
Sorry to bother you... but would you know where I could find a carving the color of night?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sob) It's my favorite guinea pig! She's gone! (Sniff)

replies.reply_text: Guinea pig?  I'm allergic to guinea pigs, sorry.
What happened to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sniff) She got out of her cage. I've looked everywhere for her, but she just disappeared. (Sob)

replies.reply_text: Would you like some help trying to find her?
That's too bad.  Good luck finding her.

chatpoints.chat_text: (A smile brightens his face, and he stops crying.) Would you really do that?

replies.reply_text: Of course!  Do you have any idea where she may have gone?
Actually, I changed my mind. I need to be going.
Okay, I will see what I can find.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found my guinea pig, Kira, yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'm sorry.
Yes, I have!  Here you go.  She was just a little frightened, that's all.
Not yet.  Where should I be looking again?
Glad to be of some help!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but I'm rather busy right now.  You should probably come back later.

replies.reply_text: Okay, sorry to bother you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look closely for some clues outside.  I know she likes hiding in the shade, maybe under a tree?  Oh, and her name is Kira, so that she knows you are friendly when you find her.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Thanks so much for finding Kira! (The guinea pig shifts in his lap.)

replies.reply_text: No problem!  I'm just glad she's safe.
Sure, no problem!  By any chance, would you know where I could find a carving the color of night?
Hi there!  You've got lots of little animals, I was wondering if any of them have gotten loose lately.
Say, uhm... could you explain again how to make that plaster mold?
Penfold!  I've got the plaster cast!
Penfold, I can't find all the ferrets.  What should I do?
Sorry I had to run out so fast.  Now... what was it about the footprints again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope... sorry!

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  I'll just keep looking.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Loose?! LOOSE?! You mean, like, actually loose, out in the cold, cruel world?

replies.reply_text: I'd hardly call it "cold" out there, but yeah, out of your house.
Whatever.  Do you have all of them?
Nevermind....

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, absolutely, I have all of them!  Don't be silly!  Look at me, am I unhappy?  No!  If I were missing a guinea pig, I'd be a miserable wreck!  Why do you want to know, anyway?

replies.reply_text: All right, already!  It's just that I need to find something very valuable, and the only clue I have to go on is tiny little animal tracks.  Now I think of it, I guess guinea pig feet are a little small to have made these.
Okay, okay.  Sorry to bother you.  It's nothing.  I'll just go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Whoa, whoa, whoa!  You found animal tracks here?  I mean, mammal tracks?  Or something like that?  That's bad news!  What if it's something that eats guinea pigs?!  Oh dear!  What did they look like?

replies.reply_text: Let's see, they had... five toes and claws... and a middle footpad, and were kind of narrow... that's all I know.
No.  Didn't do that, sorry.  Thanks for your time, anyway.  Bye.
Make a plaster cast?  How do I do that?
Oh... hunh.  Didn't occur to me.  Know where I can get some plaster?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's the easiest thing in the world!  Go get some plaster from Patrick at the general store.  Better get some water, too, while you're at it.  When you find the track, use your shovel to scoop up ash from around, and build a little sort of dam a couple of inches all the way around the track.  Make it about an inch high.  Pour in the plaster, let it set up, and there's your mold!

replies.reply_text: I see.  And if I bring this to you, you can identify it?
Sounds cool!  I'll be back.
Nah, nah, too much work!  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely!  I'll look it up in my Animal Tracks book!

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, just go ask Patrick at the general store.  I'm sure he's got some there somewhere.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fabuloso!  Let me see it!

replies.reply_text: Here it is.
On second thought, it's so cool I think I'll keep it.  Bye!
Well, what are they?

chatpoints.chat_text: OH NO!!!

replies.reply_text: What?!  What?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my poor guinea pigs! We have Mustela putorius furo on the island! FERRETS! Oh no!!

replies.reply_text: Ferrets?!  Aw, come on, ferrets don't eat guinea pigs.  They may play with them but...
Ferrets?  These islands are hardly ideal ferret habitat.  Where could they possibly live?

chatpoints.chat_text: Eating them?  I'm not worried about them eating them, I'm worried about ferrets stealing my guinea pigs' toys!  Why do you think they got the Latin name "furo"? It means "thief!"  Ferrets take everything that isn't nailed down.  If it's nailed down, they take up the nails!

replies.reply_text: I see.... well.  Okay, where would I start looking for ferrets, then?  On this island, I mean.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what can I say?  Ferrets like nice, warm, cozy spots, and they love mazes.  Soooooo... if you can find a nice warm cozy spot, say, a little warm corner somewhere in there, maybe where it's close to the exit so they can come out and get water... That's where I would look.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.... Okay, I'll look.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: What should you do?  I don't know.  Can you make a noise like a squeaky toy?  Sorry, can't help you.  Keep looking in warm, cozy spots in the maze, maybe where it's close to the exit so they can come out and get water.  Remember they probably hide, too.

replies.reply_text: Okay.....

npc_list.name: Pella
npc_list.admin_description: at the volcano

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's about time, isn't it!

replies.reply_text: Uhm, hello?  Are you Pella?
Oh, well, if that's your attitude, forget it, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm Pella.  Found me at last, did you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, and I have to say, you don't look in the least bit in distress!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, why should I? I never said I was distressed.

replies.reply_text: But your note!  The note in the cave, it said to come find you if you hadn't taken it down by a certain time, and that time's long past!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, yes.  But it never said I was in distress; I just wanted to see who'd come out and find me.  Frankly, I was expecting Bruce.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, Bruce is busy piping for the dragons, and he won't leave the wall of the maze.
What?  I'm not good enough?  Well, forget it, then!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I know, he's a little odd that way.  But aren't we all?  I think it's just fabulous to be a little bit odd, don't you?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, sure. Look, are you sure you're okay?  You've been gone from your home for a long time.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pella looks up at you with a slightly puzzled expression.) You really were concerned, weren't you? I can sense that. But I'm a fire-salamander, you see. I get everything I need from the lava, so wherever I go on these isles, I'm fine. I must say, it was nice of you to be concerned for me. I'll tell you what.

replies.reply_text: What?
Okay, I'll meet you there.

npc_list.name: Bruce
npc_list.admin_description: Bruce at Home

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  How are ye?

replies.reply_text: Fine, thanks, just wanted to let you know I found Pella.
Hello, just passing by.
Great, but I can't remember what you told me about that clue back by the maze.
I'm looking for a carved stone the color of night... Do you know where I should look?

chatpoints.chat_text: Och, did ye?

replies.reply_text: Yes, she was up by that volcano north of where you were, in fine health.  She said she's on her way back to her home now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, that's good to hear.  Thank ye kindly for telling me that.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome!  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Pella's tracks were heading northeast from there.  Salamanders like Pella, they like it warm, so she'd be heading for a warm place.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks.  I'll go see if I can find her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Och, the missus would ken better than me.  Ask her.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, welcome to my store.  May I help you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, hello.  I didn't realize there was someone here.
Oh.  Sorry to bother you.  Bye!
Hi, Harriet. Got any ore today?
What a lovely store! I'll be sure to come here when I need ore. However, for this visit I was hoping to meet your aunt.
Hi Harriet. I was hoping to talk to your aunt again, but she seems upset about her scarves.
Hello, again! Where did you say I should look for the scarves?
I'm back and I think I've found all the missing scarves!
Where did you say I could find your Aunt Babushka, again?
I found those scarves!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there is!  This is my Ore Store!  I go out to the rock pile outside and the ones on Desert Isle and collect all the ore, and put it in these bins, and sell it.  All the money goes into my college fund!  I'm going to be a geologist and know everything about rocks!

replies.reply_text: Good plan!  So, what are your prices then?  I'm always on the lookout for ores.
Are you kidding?  Those prices are outrageous!  How could you possibly sell ores for these prices?!
Okay, I'll buy a Gold Ore.
I'll have a Silver Ore, please.
I'll have a Copper Ore, please.
I'll have an Iron Ore, please.
Thanks, that will do.  Bye!
May I have another?
Thanks, that will do.  Bye!
May I have another?
Thanks, that will do.  Bye!
May I have another?

chatpoints.chat_text: But... it's for my college fund!  I dig them up and clean them and bring them here and sort them so you get only the best, and it's to help me be a geologist someday!  It's my dream!  I need the money!   Even so I can just get a real horse!  All I've got is this stupid pony who hates me!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be offensive.  But your prices really are way too steep for me.
Sigh... Okay, well, I'll remember you when I really need something, okay?  Bye!
Okay, I'll buy a Gold Ore.
I'll have a Silver Ore, please.
I'll have a Copper Ore, please.
I'll have an Iron Ore, please.
Thanks, that will do.  Bye!
May I have another?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aunt Babushka? I'm afraid she's really shy. She rarely talks to anyone. Other than me, that is!

replies.reply_text: That's why Sando sent along these tortillas.
Great! I've already spent a ton of time on this quest. I think I'll just take these tortillas and have me some burritos!
I think I'll just keep it that. She can talk to you, and I'll just go talk to some other players in the game. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Tortillas? She loves them! I hardly ever see her, but when Sando sends tortillas, she shows up! I don't know how she knows, but she ALWAYS knows!

replies.reply_text: Perfect! So can I talk to her?
These tortillas must be very good!
Hmm. They do look good. I think I'll just eat them myself. Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have to warn you. She's a little bit... different. Unique might even describe her.

replies.reply_text: I'm good with different. Especially unique. Bring her on!
Oh! You mean a weirdo? No thank you. I'm outta here!
Unique describes a lot of the characters on these islands! Actually, aren't we all unique in our own individual way? I think I'll go ponder my own uniqueness. Good bye, good day and so long!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh they are! Sando makes them very thin and chewy. Just the way I like them. Put a little butter on them, pile on some shredded cheese... pop them in the oven until the cheese is melted and you've got yourself a perfect cheese crisp!

replies.reply_text: Now you are making me hungry! What else can you do with tortillas?
Cheese? I'm not much of a cheese fan. Thanks anyway, but I think I'll go find something to eat now.
Sounds wonderful! I think I'll go make myself a grilled cheese sandwich. And then maybe I'll have some yummy cheesecake for dessert!
Gosh, I almost forgot why I was here. I really need to see your aunt.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll need to take a scarf to her. She loves scarves, and she won't talk to you unless you give her one.

replies.reply_text: Scarf? I don't have a scarf! Who carries a spare scarf around with them?
Forget it. I'm done as toast with this quest. Done. Done. Done!
I love scarves! As a matter of fact, I think I'll go make a few. Later, gator!

chatpoints.chat_text: You can use them for soft tacos, or chimichangas, or quesadillas, or fajitas, or sprinkle them with sugar and cinnamon...

replies.reply_text: ...Stop already! I'll be dreaming of tortillas all night long! I've got to go get something to eat now. Good bye!
Sounds wonderful! No wonder your aunt loves them. Speaking of which, can I speak to your aunt now?
Gosh. I have no clue how we got on this subject, and no clue what I'm doing here. Guess I'd better get back to my ranch now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries. I'd be happy to give you one. She's always losing scarves. They turn up all over the desert. I'm always finding them out there.

replies.reply_text: Terrific! Here, you take the tortillas and I'll take the scarf!
Darn! I've lost track of time. I'll have to come back another day. See ya!
I bet those scarves add a lot of color to the desert floor. I wonder what the critters think of them? Maybe I'll go wander around and see if I can find a scarf or two. Later!
Thanks so much, and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: She's usually right around the biggest boulders out there.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll go check there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: A huge sand storm came through and blew away seven of Aunt Babushka's most cherished scarves. She had washed them and laid them on boulders to dry. The storm left everything out there covered in a ton of sand and I haven't had time to look for them.

replies.reply_text: Well darn it. Guess I'd better go do something else then. Thanks anyway.
I've got some time. How about I try to look for them?
Ugh. Sounds like another quest. Sifting through sand in search of scarves just doesn't sound appealing to me. So sorry!
Where do you think the scarves might have ended up?

chatpoints.chat_text: The storm blew in from the west. So I'd check east and southeast of here. Search near anything that a scarf might have gotten caught on as it was blowing by. Please let me know as soon as you find them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll get right on it.
Sure! I'll go do that right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wonderful!  Could you please give them to my aunt?  I know she would love to have them again.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.

npc_list.name: Lenny
npc_list.long_description: Lenny is a small man with lots of hair and just about the strongest arms you've ever seen.

chatpoints.chat_text: Make it? No, I didn't make it.  Well, okay, I made it bigger than it was, but there was always on these islands a maze.  I maintain it, I expand it every now and then, you know, it's a living.  I could use an apprentice, you want be an apprentice?  I'll teach you good.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm busy enough as it is.  What are you working on now?
No thanks.  Got to run.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello there.  I can do for you something, yes?  What?

replies.reply_text: Hi, nothing actually, I'm just looking around.
Hello!  I like your shop, what do you do here?
Sorry to barge in on you, but I'm looking for a salamander named Pella. Have you seen her, by any chance?
Hi, Lenny, I delivered the goblets to Mona, she loved them!  She sent me back with your payment!
Hi, Lenny.  Say, you mentioned to me that you had another experiment you wanted to try, but you never got around to telling me what it was.  What is it?  I'm curious.
Hi, Lenny, I got kind of sidetracked, what did you want me to do with this stuff you gave me again?
Lenny!  I've got your valve!  Sandy Flint had one already made!
So, Lenny, tell me about "Rock Glass."
Lenny, where was I supposed to bring these goblets?
Hi Lenny!  Xiang sent me to you. I'm looking for a carved stone the color of night.  She said it was obsidian and that you make obsidian carvings... right?
Hey Lenny! I'm back with your supplies!
I'm sorry, but what did you ask me to get for you?
Ummm I was wondering if you could help me.  I'm looking for a carved stone the color of night.
Hi Lenny!  This time I have a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Salamander?  I see plenty of them.  I can't tell them all apart.  But you're looking for a salamander, then you'll look over there by that volcano.  Because the salamanders on these islands, that's where they go.  That's where I'd look.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll look there!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do I do here?  I'm a stonewright.  I carve stones into useful things.  You know, like building blocks, and facades, and paving stones and so forth.  You won't mind the dust, it's an occupational biproduct, it's everywhere!  You live by a volcano? What can you do...

replies.reply_text: Did you make the maze here?
Oh, interesting.  Well, I'll be off, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: What am I working on now?  Well, nothing... Building right now, it's kind of slow.  So, I'm just experimenting with various things.  Right now I'm doing two interesting things.  For one, I'm working with obsidian to make Rock Glass.  It's quite beautiful, you should see!

replies.reply_text: What's "rock glass"?
I see, and what's the other experiment?
That's nice.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Rock Glass?  Oh, that's my own term, the way I use it.  You know, most people make glass from sand and lime and stuff like that.  But me?  No.  All over these islands there's obsidian.  It's a rock, and it's glass already.  So I carve it.  And easy it's not!

replies.reply_text: I see.  What do you carve it into?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Ah! You'll look here! (Lenny walks to a table and picks up a box, which he brings to you and opens. From within a wad of excelsior, he pulls an exquisite goblet made of the thinnest, dusky glass with stripes and streaks of mahogany red.)
There, you like?

replies.reply_text: Nice.  Well, see ya.
Lenny!  This is just... beautiful!  How did you get it so thin, and.... Wow!  These must be for someone really special!

chatpoints.chat_text: For someone special!  Heh! Well... No, not yet.  These are the first ones I've made actually for sale.  You sell to who you can, then, eventually, someone important notices, and then!  Ah!  But not yet.  Say.... I just thought of something!

replies.reply_text: Uhm... Sorry, I have to be going now.  Bye!
Don't tell me, let me guess: You'd like me to deliver them for you, yes?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, a smart one you are!  You sure you won't be my apprentice?  But yes, if you could deliver these to Mona on Art Isle, you'd make an old man very happy!  You'll do it?

replies.reply_text: No, I don't do deliveries, really.  Good luck anyway.  Bye now.
Sure, I'd be happy to do that.
I'll be back with Mona's payment as soon as I can!
Thanks a lot, Lenny, happy to do it!

chatpoints.chat_text: The other experiment?  Well, I'll tell you. We've got a volcano here, right?  And all this lava all over the place.  It's all hot!  And it happens, I've seen, even in the winter, the snow it doesn't stay, it seeps down in the rock, it comes up as steam.  And I'm thinking to myself, "Lenny!  All that steam, it's going to waste!  If you could channel it somewhere, an engine you could make!"  Right?

replies.reply_text: Yes, you could.  Steam power is very useful!  How's that coming?
Oh.  I see.  Good luck with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: How's it coming?  It's not coming so good.  I made a pipe, I made a trench, and I can get hot water to a nice warm spot, but control how much steam comes from the pipe I'm putting there, I need something... something like...

replies.reply_text: Like a valve?
(Uh oh, quest coming...) (You run out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: A valve!  Exactly!  But you see the problem is, an iron valve, that I could get!  Easy!  But especially this hot mineral water, it'll rust in a heartbeat! I need a brass valve.

replies.reply_text: Brass?  I've never seen brass on these isles... Well, that's to say, I've never seen anyone using it, or making things with it.
Oh, no!  I can see a quest coming here right away!  No thanks, I'm off!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure somebody makes it, I mean, it's so useful and all!  But who does it?  That, I don't know.  Do you?

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.... Brass is a copper-zinc alloy, right?  I know someone who works with copper, maybe he can make it for you, if you know where there's some zinc.
Hmmm.... Brass is a copper-zinc alloy, right? I've seen copper all over, but I've never seen zinc anywhere, have you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Zinc?  Zinc metal, no.  Zinc oxide?  Everybody on this island has some!  We use it for paint, we use it for sunscreen, for polish.  Here, I tell you what.  How about I give you these ten pounds, and these ten copper ores, and you bring them... where you bring them, wherever, and if you can have a valve made for me, about.... so big.... I'll pay you!  Deal?

replies.reply_text: Deal!
No thanks, I'm kind of tired.  Maybe another time.
I'll get this done as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Find someone who can make brass, and have me made a valve, about... so big.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Right!  I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Already made?  What kind of a coincidence is that?  Let's see it.

replies.reply_text: Here.
Thanks a lot!  I'll be sure to come by and see your steam engine in operation!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A thought?  Thoughts are good.  What have you thought?

replies.reply_text: There are these crystal shards around here.  I've seen all different colors of them, and I was thinking they'd look wonderful on your Rock Glass.
Oh, nothing, sorry, I already forgot.
Sounds great!  I'll bring them if I get any!  Bye!
I'm surprised you haven't gone into the maze yourself and gotten some!

chatpoints.chat_text: Gone into the maze? What are you, crazy? Forget about it! If you go, I'll buy from you!

replies.reply_text: Okay, see you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Wonderful, wonderful!  What have you got for me, then?

replies.reply_text: Here's a red shard.

chatpoints.chat_text: ningi

replies.reply_text: I have another one!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mona on Art Isle.  Be careful!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay.  Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You say you need a statue the color of night?  And I suppose it should represent the Lava Isles, right?  I can do that.  How about an obsidian dragon?

replies.reply_text: An obsidian dragon?  Sounds perfect!
