replies.reply_text: That's right, he's your friend.  Well, Patsy asked me to pick up the sword and shield he lent you.  He needs to get them back to Sir Sleepwell.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes. Pretty shield, but heavy sword... (Koko lowers her eyes.) Koko had a boo-boo. Koko doesn't have them any more. Koko really sorry. (Koko starts spinning again.)

replies.reply_text: Whoa, slow down there!  What do you mean you don't have them any more?  What happened to them?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Koko slows down a little.) Koko was playing knights and dragons with Epona, and Koko tried to slay the dragon, and the sword broke! Junky sword! (She starts spinning faster.)

replies.reply_text: Koko... Stay with me here.  What did you do with the sword and shield after the sword broke?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Koko stops spinning.) Koko dropped those junky things on the way home. I don't know where. ( She starts spinning again waving her arms about wildly.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, do you have any idea where you may have dropped them, or how you came home from Epona?
Oh, no... This is way more than I bargained for... You'd better find the pieces and get them back to Patsy, because I'm out!  See ya next time.
Okay, I'll see what I can find.  Any more suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know, maybe Epona can help you. (And Koko is off and spinning again.) See ya!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, see ya!
That's right, I found everything.  Could you please send me back to Patsy now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Koko told you!  Talk to Epona!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I forgot... Sorry.  I'll be back with the shield or on it! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Koko getting tired of you! Koko told you already, she threw the old shield away on the beach by a tree! Now leave Koko alone! (She is spinning again at full speed.)

replies.reply_text: Beach... Tree... Got it!  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Koko continues to spin without hesitation.) Talk to Epona. I don't remember things like that.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll see what Epona says.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a chest! A best? A chest? A diddle-de-dum? (Koko spins around and around. She isn't going to be much help!)

replies.reply_text: Okay. Never mind then.

npc_list.name: Capri
npc_list.admin_description: Capri in her clearing
npc_list.long_description: A small graceful faun with blond hair and peculiar dark eyes.  She makes her home in a hidden clearing of Bridle Forest.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am well, traveler!  Much less tired today.

replies.reply_text: Good to hear.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, traveler.

replies.reply_text: I apologize for startling you earlier... Do you live here?
Greetings, Capri.  Could you remind me where Iambe lives?
Greetings, Capri.  How are you?
Oh, Capri, I found Wee Troll with your sister Fauna, but now he's disappeared again!  Can you tell me where he might have gone this time?
Where's my rake?  I'll blunder my way back out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do, in a sense.  We fauns are, you might say, spirits of the forest.  We don't live in a particular place, or house.  This is my favored clearing though.

replies.reply_text: That reminds me... Did you happen to notice a baby troll in the forest recently?
That's very interesting!  Excuse me while I look around your little clearing.  I've never been in such a place before!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, Wee Troll comes to play with me frequently.  Today, I'm a bit tired...  I wasn't feeling up to his usual rough-housing.  I gently suggested that he visit my big sister, Iambe, and away he poofed.

replies.reply_text: I've never heard of Iambe... Can you poof me to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid not.  We fauns don't have travel magic, like trolls do.  Our powers are more centered in plants and music.

replies.reply_text: Would you tell me where I can find her then?  The baby troll's parents are growing worried about him.
I'm starting to feel a little claustrophobic.  I'll come back later and we can chat about it then.
Thanks, I'll head there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Iambe usually can be found in north part of West Treeton Forest.  She favors a particular clearing surrounded by trees, quite a bit like this one. If you check around, you should find a good spot where you can push through the trees.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again.  I'll head out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know.  Why don't you go back and let Big Troll know?

replies.reply_text: I thought I'd check with you first.  I didn't want to go back to Big Troll empty-handed.

npc_list.name: Iambe
npc_list.long_description: A jovial, physically fit faun wearing a woolly red tunic.  She makes her home in a hidden clearing of West Treeton Forest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, my dear. This is a surprise!

replies.reply_text: Hello.  Are you Capri's big sister?
Can you remind me where Fauna lives?
Hello again, Iambe!  Just stopping in to see how you are.
Oh, Iambe, I found Wee Troll with your sister Fauna, but now he's disappeared again!  Can you tell me where he might have gone this time?
Surprise to me, too!  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: So Capri sent you.  I thought it was a bit odd to see someone in here... In fact, I've never seen anyone in here.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry if I'm disrupting your privacy, but Capri told me that she sent a baby troll to visit you earlier.  Is he around here somewhere?

chatpoints.chat_text: Someone once said 'No animal is so inexhaustible as an excited infant,' and infant trolls are no exception.  I played with Wee Troll for hours, but finally I grew tired of his constant pleadings to spin him around and around.

replies.reply_text: So that means I can't get a spin? I think I'll come back later then, when you're not as tired.
Babies can be very tiring when they're in the mood to be!  What happened after he exhausted you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nice poem, dear!

replies.reply_text: Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I couldn't leave him all alone, of course.  My sister Fauna's very strong.  I figured she would be the one to tire out the trolls' small son.  If he is who you seek, then I expect he's still with her.

replies.reply_text: Where can I find Fauna?
Oooh, more searching for fauns?  I'm not in the mood.  I'll come back later.
Thank you.  I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: She stays in the Shell Forest of Turtle Isle.  She prefers a hidden clearing in that forest, much like this one.   I believe it's near some cotton plants.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again, Iambe, that's helpful.

chatpoints.chat_text: He may have just gone home.  Why don't you check with his parents?

replies.reply_text: I thought I'd check with you first.  I didn't want to go back to Big Troll empty-handed.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm doing well, dear!  My forest is flourishing!

replies.reply_text: That's nice!

npc_list.name: Fauna
npc_list.long_description: You are slightly surprised that Fauna not only has the legs of a buff-colored goat, but she seems to have a very goat-like quality to her face, as well.

chatpoints.chat_text: You should go tell his parents about it.  How would I be of any help?

replies.reply_text: I thought I'd check with you first.  I didn't want to go back to Big Troll empty-handed.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Gruffly) Why do you come here, human?

replies.reply_text: I, erm, ohh, I think I'll just be leaving.
I'm sorry to disturb your solitude, Fauna, but I'm looking for a baby troll.  His parents are most worried about him.  I've spoken with your two sisters, and I thought he may have come to you.
Where did you say the baby troll was, Fauna?
Oh, Fauna!  I found the baby troll, but then he poofed away!  What should I do now?
Hello, Fauna.  I apologize I'm if I'm disturbing you.  I was just checking up on old friends.

chatpoints.chat_text: Baaah!  Those two girls!  They don't know anything about dealing with overactive toddlers.  Wee Troll is here, yes.  I flung the lad into the lake.

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding me?  That does not seem like the best way to deal with an exuberant baby!
Well, obviously you've got everything under control... I saw some piles of gold out there I was interested in.  I'll catch you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Child, we magical people are reared differently than humans. Troll babies love to swim.  They are immune from any harm in the water.  They spend most of their childhood in the water, under bridges.  That's why the lad was so energetic today.  He hadn't had his swim yet.

replies.reply_text: But it just seems so unsafe!  He's not being watched!

chatpoints.chat_text: Child, again, you doubt.  There are other ways for me to mind the baby.  I am in tune with what happens in this entire forest, and we fauns also have an extraordinary sense of hearing.

replies.reply_text: I think I understand now.  I'm sorry.  I seem to be offending people a lot today.  Do you mind if I go get the baby and take him home?
Well, why would I interrupt his swim? I'm sure his parents can come deal with it if they get too worried. I'll see you later.
Thanks.  I'll get him home quickly.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll find him in the tiny lake north of here, toward the eastern part of this forest.  Please hurry and get him home in time for supper!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I appreciate that, human.  I usually prefer to be alone, but it's nice to know that someone is thinking of me.

replies.reply_text: Have a good day!

npc_list.name: Pederlaurie
npc_list.admin_description: when he shows up at Lornbacoll's
npc_list.short_description: A small dragon with huge eyes
npc_list.long_description: Pederlaurie is much smaller than the other dragons you've met so far.  He has a slightly nervous manner and enormous bulging eyes.  He speaks with a high, nasal voice with a peculiar accent.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pederlaurie's eyes are closed and you can hear soft snores. It is never wise to wake up sleeping dragons, so you quietly step away.)

npc_list.name: Big Blue
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS - he turns into Vesuvius
npc_list.long_description: A huge, verbose Blue Sea Perch

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi, kid.  Troll knock ya in?

replies.reply_text: Don't call me "kid"!  Yes, he did!  I'm not going to take this lightly!
Yes.  It was my fault; I was rude to him.
Yes, I guess I was getting too chatty for him.  Now I get to talk to you, though, which is a treat.
Yes.  Can you help me back out now?
No, I'm fine.  I wanted to come for a swim.

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to learn to control your temper, and mind your manners, kid.  You'll live longer.

replies.reply_text: Ugh!  Go away, nasty fish.  I don't understand why everyone is so mean to me.
I'm sorry.  I really will try harder next time.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's nice of you to think of me, kid!  I don't get many visitors.  You're in luck today... You can meet my own kid.

replies.reply_text: I can see where he gets his good looks!
Maybe some other time.  Can you please get me out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: You flatter me, kid!  Well, you don't want to stay in the ocean too long.  Let me help you out.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.
In a minute... Let me paddle around first.
Actually, I was curious - do you have any little errands you'd like me to run for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: My friends live in remote locations for a reason, kid!  They're not fond of visitors.

replies.reply_text: Oh, please?  I promise I won't bother them very much.  I just love to explore!
Ah, I can take a hint.  Okay, I'll leave them be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you were nice enough to help them before - maybe they won't mind that much.  I will need to ask you for a token for each unknown isle I send you to - just to make sure you don't do it too often.  A diamond will do the trick.

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding me?  Totally not worth it.  See you around.
Oh, a diamond?  Well, I think it's worth it to me.  I'll go find one.
It's worth it to me, and I happen to have a diamond right here!
I'd like to go to Adolphus' Unknown Isle... the one farthest to the west.
I'd like to go to Gustavus' Unknown Isle... the one in the center of the three
I'd like to go to Mercurius' Unknown Isle... the one farthest to the east.
Ugh, I don't remember which Unknown Isle I want to go to.  I guess I'll come back with another diamond once I figure it out.
Thanks!
Thanks!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I don't.  The trolls are really helpful and friendly to us here.  I do have some friends who'd probably like a few things.  Come to think of it, if you would help me send some presents to my friends, I'd be thrilled to reward you with some of the loot that has fallen into the ocean!

replies.reply_text: Are your friends fish, too?
Hm, I think I'll come back later and help you.  Could you get me out of here now, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they are.  The three wise fish of the eastern seas.  They really value their privacy, so if you start getting chatty with them, like you did with the troll, well - don't hold me responsible!

replies.reply_text: I'll be really careful to not be a pest.  What would you like me to do?
This sounds tricky.  I'd better rally myself and come back some other time.  Would you please get me out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good, you're back again, kid!  How'd it go?

replies.reply_text: I've got the produce from Zeke, and I'm ready to go meet your friends.   What do I do now?
Oh - you wanted some fruits and vegetables from Zeke.  I'll go see him now.  Could you help me back out, Please?
Well, to tell the truth...  I forgot your friends' names.  Could you remind me, please?
I went to see Adolphus.  He's not a very friendly fish, but he did seem very happy with his gifts.
I went to see Gustavus.  He's really nice!  He liked his gifts very much, I could tell.
I went to see Mercurius.  He's a little too friendly, but he honestly seemed to like his presents.
It's going well.  I'm ready to go present gifts to your friends now.
I got the gems now.  Is there anything else?
Oh, I forgot to get those gems you wanted!  An amethyst, an emerald and a topaz, right?  Could you send me back to look for them now?
It's going well, but I need to take a break for a while.  Could you please put me back on shore?
Super!  I'm finished with all your deliveries!
No problem at all.  Could you give me a boost back to land, please?
Okay, I can manage that.  Could you give me another boost back to land, please?
I happen to have those gems right here!  Anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, one other thing.  You'll need to know the names of my friends to be able to call them.  Each one lives off the northeast coast of a different Isle, so you need to know where you are going, and who you're calling.

replies.reply_text: I've got my thinking cap firmly on now.  Please tell me their names.
I'll need to come back later when I'm not so distracted.  Could you please help me back onto land for now?
Please send me to the Golden Fish of the Sun.
Please send me to the Green Fish of Nature.
Please send me to the Purple Fish of Love.
Please send me back to shore.   I don't quite get it yet, and I don't want to make a mistake.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you again, though it's kinda shabby of you to forget, after I told you it was important.  Their names are Adolphus, Gustavus, and Mercurius.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again.  I'll remember them this time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good to hear it!

replies.reply_text: Now could you send me to the Green Fish of Nature?
Now could you send me to the Purple Fish of Love?
Now could you send me to the Golden Fish of the Sun?
I need to continue with this later.  Can you put me back on shore for now?
You know, I just realized I'm done with all the deliveries.
Great!  This has been fun!  Could you please help me out of the water one last time?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Interrupts.) The Green Fish of Nature has a message for me?

replies.reply_text: No, what was I thinking?  I must've made a mistake.
Yes.  He'd like you to go talk to him right away about becoming a Wise Fish yourself, if you're interested.
Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, kid!  It's good to see you again!  Just coming for a swim today?

replies.reply_text: Good to see you, too, Big Blue!  Actually, while I was visiting Gustavus, he mentioned that I should tell you...
Hi there, Big Blue, it's nice to see you, too.  Could you help me back out again, please?
Good to see you, too!  I was wondering if it would be possible for me to visit your friends' islands again.
Hiya!  Yep, I just dropped by to cool off a little.  I'll just paddle around a bit, if you don't mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello, I didn't see you there.  Is there anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: No, not really.  I was actually just wondering if there was anything I could help you with?
I was just passing through.  I do need to be going now, though.
Did you still need me to find Lulu?
I was wondering how Lulu is doing?
I'm sorry to bother you, but Eros was a bit worried.  He knows that you are here by yourself and that you hadn't stopped by in a while, and wanted to be sure that you were okay.
I'm back! I talked to Shiri, and she gave me this little bird! (You hold the bird out for her to take.)
Actually, I was helping you.  Remember?  I just can't remember exactly what I was doing.
I gave you the bird.  Do you think you can help him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, well I do need some help finding Lulu.

replies.reply_text: Lulu?  Who's Lulu?
You know, I really don't think I have any time to be searching for this Lulu.  I have other things to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: She's a spotted necked otter.  I'm rather worried though, it's been a while since I've seen her, and I'm afraid something bad has happened to her.

replies.reply_text: That's horrible!  I hope you find her soon.  I'll stop by later and see how things are going.
I'm sorry!  Maybe I could help find her?  Do you know where she likes to hang out?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, would you really?  I know I'm usually able to find her on the southeastern part of this beach, but she hasn't been around lately.  Maybe you could find some clues?

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a great idea!  I'll see if I can use my magnifying glass around some of the trees and the water's edge.
Actually, I changed my mind.  I have some other things I need to be doing first.  Good luck.
I'll be back as soon as I have managed to find some clues.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found any clues yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet, sorry.
Yes I did!  I found some footprints that lead into the water.  Do you think she swam off to a different shore?
Not quite yet.  Where was I looking?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  Well, that must be why I can't seem to find her.  Would you mind checking the west side of Lava Isle?  I doubt she has gone very far.  Just along the beach, probably.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound too bad.  I can do it.
I'm sorry, I just really need to be going.  I'll come back when I have more time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, please, If you have the time.  I'm starting to get worried about her.

replies.reply_text: Wait.. I changed my mind.  I need to go.
No problem.  Where should I look first?
Okay.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found Lulu yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'm still looking.
Yes, I did! But it looks like she's hurt. (You gently hand her over.)
No, where should I look again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Try looking closely for clues around trees along the west beach on Lava Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
I hope you can help her.  Good luck!
I have time now, if you want me to help you.  What will you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let's see. (She bends down and closely examines Lulu.) Well, I have bandages and ointment for the wound, but I will need some medicine so it won't get infected. Unfortunately, only Audrey in Hotton has what I need. Would you mind getting it for me?

replies.reply_text: Hotton?  All the way to Desert Isle.  I don't think I can do that right now.  I'll come back when I have more time.
Sure, I'll do it.  It shouldn't be too bad.
I can do that.  I will be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, please!  I need you to go and talk to Audrey in Hotton.  She is the local vet and she'll give you the medicine I need.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll do it.  Should I have her put it on a tab or something?
Oh wait, I just remembered I have something else to do.  I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get the medicine yet?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did!  Is there anything else I can help with?
Where was I supposed to go for the medicine?
No, not yet.  I'll be back soon, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Talk to Audrey in Hotton, she'll know what I need.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right!  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Check the southeastern part of the beach.  You may want to look closely for clues near the trees and water's edge.

replies.reply_text: Right!  I'll get on that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not great, I'm afraid.  I really could use some supplies.

replies.reply_text: Well, I don't have time now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Sorry.
I can get some supplies for you.  What do you need?
Thank you!  I hope she feels better soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eros? Ah, yes, he really is so sweet. The only reason I haven't been by to visit him is that I have this awful cold. (She coughs twice.) I haven't even been able to get out and do my rounds. I'm rather worried that the sea animals around here may not be doing so well.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure they are fine.  Though, if you are worried, I could check up on them.
They should be all right.  After all, they are wild animals.  I should probably go now.  See you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really?  It may be harder than you think.  It really all just depends on what status the animals are in.  Are you sure you are up to it?

replies.reply_text: Of course I am!  If I wasn't, I wouldn't have offered.  Is there anywhere specific I should look?  There is a lot of sea surrounding this island.
Now that you mention it.. I really don't think I can do this.  It is probably way more work than I have time for right now.  I hope you feel better.
That really doesn't sound too bad.  I'll let you know what I find out.
So you can help him, then?  I was really beginning to get rather worried.
I'm really just glad that I was able to help out.  Seeing animals that have been hurt really bothers me.  I should probably go check in with Eros now.  Feel better soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, of course!  You agreed to check up on the wildlife for me.  If you go south from here to the beach, you should find Shiri.  She's a seal and keeps up with all the sea life.  If anything needs to be done, she will know.  Please let me know if anything is out of the ordinary.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll get right on that.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Little Blue
npc_list.long_description: A teeny little Blue Sea Perch

chatpoints.chat_text: Blub...

replies.reply_text: Aww, you're so cute!  Nice to meet you!
Can you talk?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure!  What do you want to talk about?

replies.reply_text: Would it be possible for me to visit the islands of the Wise Fish again?
Oh, nothing much... Just checking.
Could you get me out of here, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: I dunno... They don't like to be disrupted.  I don't think I should send you.

replies.reply_text: Oh, please?  I promise I won't bother them very much.  I just love to explore!
Ah, I can take a hint.  Okay, I'll leave them be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you were nice enough to help them before - maybe they won't mind that much.  I will need to ask you for a token for each unknown isle I send you to - just to make sure you don't do it too often.  A diamond will do the trick.

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding me?  Totally not worth it.  See you around.
Oh, a diamond?  Well, I think it's worth it to me.  I'll go find one.
It's worth it to me, and I happen to have a diamond right here!
I'd like to go to Adolphus' Unknown Isle... The one farthest to the west.
I'd like to go to Gustavus' Unknown Isle... The one in the center of the three.
I'd like to go to Mercurius' Unknown Isle... The one farthest to the east.
I'd like to visit your dad... Does he happen to have an island of his own?
Ugh, I don't remember which Unknown Isle I want to go to.  I guess I'll come back with another diamond once I figure it out.
Thanks!
Thanks!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: He does!  To visit him, though, you have to remember that his name is now Vesuvius.  Please remember that, because I'm not going to remind you without another diamond.

replies.reply_text: I'll remember.  Could you please send me to Vesuvius' Unknown Isle?
Thanks!
Thanks!

npc_list.name: Cidny-grynstrit
npc_list.admin_description: after you've found the Malted Falcon
npc_list.long_description: If this dragon didn't have arms, legs and wings, he would roll.  It's impossible to imagine how he could fly--or if he ever even considered doing so.  He is impeccably groomed and well-spoken, and happily friendly in a somewhat overbearing way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent! Now that the Malted Falcon has been found, you will kindly place it in my hands.

replies.reply_text: Not hardly! (You frantically urge on your horse, and with a great effort manage to squeeze past Grynstrit! The Fat Dragon cannot fly, but he can run... And he's coming! Best get back to Lornbacoll! You'll need allies!)

npc_list.name: Cidny-grynstrit
npc_list.admin_description: At Lornbacoll's at the end of the quest.
npc_list.long_description: If this dragon didn't have arms, legs and wings, he would roll.  It's impossible to imagine how he could fly--or if he ever even considered doing so.  He is impeccably groomed and well-spoken, and happily friendly in a somewhat overbearing way.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cidny-grynstrit's eyes are closed and you can hear soft snores. It is never wise to wake up sleeping dragons, so you quietly step away.)
Howdy stranger.  Anything I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: Hi!  Brea asked me to pick up her groceries.  Here's the list she gave me.
No thanks, just looking.
Hello!  I've got a delivery for you from Jack O'Lantern.
Please don't be offended by my question, but I'm looking for some rotten fruit. Would you have any?
Howdy, Murray sent me to pick up 2 large sacks of rock salt.  Do you have them in stock?
Hi!  I wonder if you would have some really fresh produce in the back.  I'm in need of a pear, a bunch of grapes and an ear of corn, but they must be the nicest ones you have.
I forgot to pick up my grapes.  Could I have them now, please?
Hi there!  I know this is an odd question, but... I'm looking for a blue bucket that says "Waldo" on the bottom.
I'm looking for a roofer named Olav who lived here for a while, would you know of him?
Yes, please! I need to buy some lemons.
Why yes, there is.  Elizabeth asked me to pick up her glue.
Hi Zeke!  Dolly over in Hotton asked me to pick up some rock salt for her Ice Cream Social.
Howdy Zeke. Harlan Hard Tack sent me to pick up his provisions order.
Sorry, Zeke, but what did you ask me to get again?
Hi I'm back with the Huckleberries!
Yes.  Put it on her tab, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: On your way, then.  Be sure to tell Brea to let me know if she needs anything else.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.  Thanks, and I'll see you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  How is old pumpkin head?

replies.reply_text: Oh, he's keeping busy... I think.  Anyway, he sent you some of his roasted pumpkin seeds.
Will do, but what is he going to do with the cloth?

chatpoints.chat_text: What else but his costumes!  Remind him that we're all looking forward to this year's line!

replies.reply_text: Sure, I will. Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: Rotten fruit?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds' need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: If I were you, I'd try either Nana in Tropicton, or Cara in Wington.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much for that information! Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh oh, fence-mending season again, huh?  Sure, I have the rock salt.  That will be $25.

replies.reply_text: Okay, here you go.
Thanks, this should do just fine.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're in luck today!  I've got some very nice fresh produce in back.  I'll pick some out special for you - $25 per piece, please.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'd better go.  I just remembered, I'm allergic to produce.
That sounds fair.
Thanks!  And do you have the grapes?
Thanks again!  These look perfect.

chatpoints.chat_text: A what?  Sorry, I don't sell personalized buckets.

replies.reply_text: Oh! No, sorry. I'm not looking for a bucket to buy. (You explain about Waldo and his "bukkit".)
All right.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can tell you this--I'm not dumb enough to take anything away from Waldo!  He's huge!  His tusks are longer than my arm!

replies.reply_text: I can understand that.  You didn't happen to see it lying around anywhere, did you?
Thanks anyway.  Bye.
I've already spoken to Karl, he said to talk to you!
Okay, I'll go speak to Karl and see what he knows.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, he did, did he?  Hah!  Knowing Karl and his constant need for more pails, it'd be a great surprise to me if every bucket on the islands didn't end up at his house!  You go talk to him!  And don't let him cow you!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try him again.  See you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav?  Let's see, he took a fancy to Kyleigh while he was here.  If anyone may have kept in touch with him, she would have.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the lead, I'll go see Kyleigh.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is a general store, not a food store. You'd have better luck trying one of those.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the tip.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, let me pack them up for you. I'll be right back. (Zeke goes in the store room and comes back with the 6 pots of glue.)

replies.reply_text: Is that all she needs?
Thanks, I'm sure she'll like the S'mores too.  Do I owe you anything for this?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, she's already paid for the glue.  Just give her my regards.  Bye, now!

replies.reply_text: I will, good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: She's having an Ice Cream Social?  That sounds like it will be a grand old time!  How much rock salt does she need?

replies.reply_text: She asked me to get three sacks of rock salt.

chatpoints.chat_text: That will be $25 a sack.  I'll go get them from the back, just a sec.

replies.reply_text: That's a fair price, it's a deal!
The pleasure's all mine.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Zeke ruffles a pile of papers and pulls up Harlan's list.) Here it is, let's see, well...I've got almost everything...

replies.reply_text: Ok, I'll bite. What are you missing?
Well, I promised Harlan I'd bring back his provisions, so I guess I'm going Huckleberry picking!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 25 huckleberries to complete Harlan's order.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah. I'll be right back.
Geeze that's a lot of provisions...I'll get back to Harlan as soon as possible.  Thanks Zeke!

npc_list.name: Epona
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests need to start at CP 16
npc_list.long_description: Epona is thought to be the Goddess of horses.  She watches over them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, why hello!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: You can talk? I didn't think that horses could talk.  Then again I guess I've seen a lot of odd things around here lately.
This is a little too odd for me.  I'm just going to be going now.
Hello, I came by to ask you about Koko.  She said she was here the other day, playing knights and dragons with you.
Hi, one more question, if you wouldn't mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct! The Rocky Mountain Horse originated in Kentucky.  What breed can be traced back to a single stallion named Figure?

replies.reply_text: Belgian.
Quarter Horse.
Azteca.
Morgan.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't think I'm much different than other horses.  Though I do know a lot about all the breeds.  Oh, that gives me an idea.  Do you want to try my quiz?

replies.reply_text: A quiz, huh?  That sounds like a little too much thinking for me right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.
I think I know enough about the different breeds.  Why not?  What are the requirements?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course I can talk!  I'm Epona, the Goddess of Horses.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  I suppose that makes a lot more sense now that you mention it.  Anyway, I'll just be going.
Well Epona, it is a pleasure to meet you.  So, what is it like to be the Horse Goddess?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm so glad!  I haven't had anyone take my quiz in ages.  Well, here's how it will work.  If you answer all ten questions correctly, I will give you $50,000.  However, you must pay me $1,000 every time you try.  Does that sound like a deal?

replies.reply_text: Sure! That doesn't sound too bad. (You hand her $1,000.)
No thanks, I don't think I'm all that interested anymore.
Yes I am!
I changed my mind, you can keep the money, but I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: In what US state was the Kiger Mustang discovered?

replies.reply_text: Florida.
Kentucky.
Oregon.
Montana

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but that is incorrect.  Would you like to try again?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I think I need a break.  While I'm at it, I think I'll check the library.  Maybe I can find the answers there.
Yes, please. (You hand her $1,000.)

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct!  The Kiger Mustang was found in 1977 in Southeastern Oregon.  Now for the next question.  What horse breed was developed in 1981?

replies.reply_text: National Show Horse.
Lipizzan.
Azteca.
Morab.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct! The National Show Horse was founded in 1981.  Now for the third question.  What horse originates from the Iberian Peninsula?

replies.reply_text: Appaloosa.
Lusitano.
Oldenburg.
Hanoverian.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct! The Lusitano originates from the Iberian Peninsula.  What is the fastest horse over short distances?

replies.reply_text: Thoroughbred.
Arabian.
Quarter Horse.
French Trotter.

chatpoints.chat_text: That Is correct!  The Quarter Horse has been clocked at 55mph and is the fastest horse over short distances.  What is the oldest horse breed in Denmark?

replies.reply_text: Hanoverian.
Frederiksborg.
Knabstrup.
Lipizzan.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct!  The  Frederiksborg is the oldest breed in Denmark.  What horse breed originated from horses of the  French King, Louis XIV?

replies.reply_text: Bashkir Curly.
Suffolk Punch.
Gypsy Vanner.
Canadian Horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct!  The Canadian Horse originated from horses sent to Canada by the French King, Louis XIV.  What horse was originally bred by the Nez Perce Indian tribe?

replies.reply_text: American Paint.
Kiger Mustang.
Appaloosa.
Rocky Mountain Horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct.  The Appaloosa was originally bred by the Nez Perce, a Native American tribe.  What horse breed originated in Kentucky?

replies.reply_text: Arabian.
Rocky Mountain Horse.
Standardbred.
Thoroughbred.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  I'm glad to see you've stopped by for another visit.

replies.reply_text: I was just passing by.  I can see you're a little busy so I will just be on my way.
Hello, I came by to ask you about Koko.  She said she was here the other day, playing knights and dragons with you.
Hi, one more question, if you wouldn't mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right, that silly girl had gotten her hands on a real sword and shield.  I thought it was safer to have her on my back while she was wielding that sword.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Do you know what happened to the sword?

chatpoints.chat_text: Koko declared those rocks to the west to be a dragon and when she swung the sword to "slay" the dragon, she hit the rock so hard that the sword broke.

replies.reply_text: Oh great... Did you happen to notice where the blade ended up?

chatpoints.chat_text: It fell in the ash near those rocks just to the west.  It shouldn't be too deep in the ash, you won't have to dig to find it.  If you have something to rake the ash with, you should have no problem finding it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all, what is the question?

replies.reply_text: First of all, thanks for helping me find the sword blade, but, did you happen to notice the route she took home after she broke it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, she started due west from those rocks where you found the blade, but she drifted a little north before she got to the beach. I don't think she went much more north than that little palm tree over there. (Epona gestures with her head toward the small palm tree just north of where you are both standing.)

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks again for all of your help.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello there! What can I do for you? (She carefully places her tools to the side, and takes a small break to talk to you.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, nothing. I was just passing through.  I can see that you are busy, so I will leave you alone for now.
I'm so glad I found you!  Your husband, Eros, sent me.
What was I doing again?
I have the bones that you needed!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eros sent you?  Oh, whatever for?

replies.reply_text: I... I think I lost my thought.  I'll come back later.
Well, he said that it's getting late, and he wanted to make sure that you would make it home before dark.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, isn't that sweet?  He always has been so worried about me out here by myself.  However, I can't leave just yet.

replies.reply_text: Why can't you?
I guess he'll just have to wait until later, then.  See you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not sure if my husband told you, but I'm an archaeologist.  I've been working all day, and I've almost completed an entire Eohippus fossil.  Eohippus was one of the first horse ancestors.

replies.reply_text: It sounds like your husband will just have to wait until you have finished it, then.  In that case, I will leave you to your work.
You're saying that you have to finish this fossil first?  How many more bones are you missing?

chatpoints.chat_text: It appears that two parts of the left hind leg are missing.  The problem is that I just can't seem to find them.  Would you mind helping me?

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound too bad.  I can do it.  Where do you think I should look first?
No, I'm sorry, but I'm just too busy to help right now.  If you still need help later, maybe I'll stop by.
That sounds like a plan!  I will be back as soon as I've found them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, we all forget sometimes.  I was just hoping that you could help me find the last two bones of this skeleton.  Try looking closely at the ground.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I remember now.  I'll be back as soon as I find them.
I'm just glad that I could help.

npc_list.name: Mtomka
npc_list.long_description: Mtomka is not quite a child, and not quite a teenager.  She is tall and slim and has a rangy, almost stretched appearance, as one often does when one is growing very fast.

replies.reply_text: Are you Mtomka?
Mtomka, I'm sorry, I've looked everywhere.  I can't even find a footprint.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, settle down there!  What's wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that's my name. Please help me! (The child is in a genuine panic!)

replies.reply_text: Oh, calm down.  I just came to tell you that your mother says to go home.  So go home.
Okay, okay.... Look, I can't help you if you don't tell me what you need help with, right?  What's the problem?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mtomka's face is wet with tears and her eyes are very red.) It's my friend, Odetho. We were playing around the temple and we were talking and then he just... disappeared! I have to find him!

replies.reply_text: Oh, forget it!  Are you kidding?  After I went through all this trouble finding you, I have to find someone else?!  Look, kid, just... just go home, okay?  It's a small island, Odd-whatisname will show up.
It's okay, calm down.  It's a small island, he can't have gone far.  Now, where was he when you last saw him?
Sheesh, kid, get a grip!  Did you try just calling him?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mtomka nods, but can't seem to say anything.)

replies.reply_text: Well, where was he when you saw him last, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Right.... (sniff) here. Right next to me, right here. We were talking and... and.... (sniff) We were talking, and he was gone.

replies.reply_text: Well, which way did he go, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The look of panic, which had slowly been ebbing from Mtomka's face, now reappears with painful force.) He didn't go! He was just gone! We were talking! Just ... and... he was just gone! He didn't leave me! He said he'd never ever leave me, ever ever. And he was just.... and he was gone! Please, please, help me find him!

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear.... I'm really not any good at finding lost loves.
I don't think I want to get involved in this really, uh.... Oh, please, don't cry again, I'll go look for your boyfriend--

chatpoints.chat_text:
He wasn't my boyfriend, he was just my best friend and he's been my best friend since I was tiny little and....
(Mtomka turns around and starts screaming after Odetho, becoming more hysterical by the second.... and then suddenly she just crumples in despair on the ground.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, tell you what, you stay here, and I'll look for him, okay?  Now what does he look like?
That.... (sigh) will have to do. You stay here! I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mtonka looks up at you with an expression of hopelessness that just about breaks your heart.) You didn't find him anywhere? Not anywhere?

replies.reply_text: No, I didn't, and believe me, I looked.  Come on, it's late, your mother will start to worry.  Hop up here behind me and we'll ride home.
Let's go...

chatpoints.chat_text: Meany-head! (Mtomka blows a raspberry at you, and returns to running back and forth through the trees.)

replies.reply_text: Why, you nasty, little, ungrateful...
Whatever.
Kids.  Honestly....
Oy, vey...

npc_list.name: Gina
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must begin at CP 36

chatpoints.chat_text: No hints, I told you already.  No hints other than what I tell you.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay.  What's next?
That doesn't scan very well.
What?  Aw, come on!  That could be a ... plow or a windmill or a.... okay, never mind, I'm going.

chatpoints.chat_text:
......sigh..............
Enzo: Don't listen to her, she's Can't Write A Decent Poem Girl, evil nemesis of Mrs. McLoughlin, Grade 2A!

replies.reply_text: I'll just... leave you two to it, then.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Heavy sigh.) Yeah, well, like, here I went through all this trouble for my stupid little--
Enzo: Stupid? I'm not stupid, I'm CHIROPTICON, Fire-Breathing SUPERMOOSE of the YUKON! Nations shiver at my power!
Gina: See? Stupid little--

replies.reply_text: All right, all right. I get the picture.  What's going on here?
Yeah, well, good luck with him... Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (As you approach, the perhaps-twelve-year-old Gina sneers at her brother and rolls her eyes.) Hello.

replies.reply_text: Hi there.  You look.... morose.
Hi, just passing through.  Don't mind me.
Okay, I'm ready to start that scavenger hunt now. What do you want me to find first?
Okay!  I'm back.  Here's the first item, I believe!
Hi there.  I found this Blue Mouse!  Is this what you wanted?
Read me that poem again, please?
I think I have the "hissing" item you want.
Something you need on a ranch?  How about this?
Okay, I found the Fox Box. Here it is.
Hi there, I think I have the thing you wanted quick.
Something blue that's by a house and rhymes with blouse?  Can't I have a hint?
Uhm... Sorry, I got sidetracked, can you give me that clue again?
I was supposed to get you something... uhm... long and skinny, wasn't it?
Sorry, kid, I forgot the clue.  Can I have it again?
Okay, I was supposed to find... a box with a fox?  Is it with a fox, or is in the possession of a fox?  Or both?  Or what?
I still need the fourth clue.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, my folks are shopping and I'm supposed to watch the rotten little ... and make sure he doesn't get into any--
Enzo: I AM INVINCIBLE! FEEL MY WRATH, EVIL BIG SISTER FIEND! (Enzo dumps an armful of lizards on his sister's head.)
Gina: Why you ROTTEN---

replies.reply_text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, that's enough of that!

chatpoints.chat_text:
See what I have to put up with? Every, every, EVERY DAY! And you know what's worse? I'll tell you what's worse! I thought I'd be nice to him on his birthday and I made up this really neat Scavenger Hunt and we don't even try it!
Enzo: Chiropticon disses that idea and dashes off to fight his enemies from the planet ZOLTO! Moooooooooooooooooooooose!

replies.reply_text: Oh, you poor kid.  I feel your pain.  So what was it you planned?
I don't know, maybe I'll go fight evil on the planet Zolto, too.  See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I made up this really neat Scavenger Hunt for him.  It'll send you all over the desert isles, and he won't even try it because he's a little brat!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, little brothers are like that.  Oh well, maybe you'll find someone else to do it.  Or maybe he'll want to do it later, you never know.  See you!
Well, if you want someone to try it, I'll try it.  I love scavenger hunts!
Just the way I like them!
Rats, can't anything around here be easy for a change?  Forget it.  See you later.
Ooooo-kay, I think I know what you want.  I'll be right back.
Oh!  I think I just happen to have what you want right here in my pack!
I thought it was going to be harder than this!
Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yeah. Well, they get harder.
Enzo: (as he rushes past, now wearing a cape) Eat hot burninating hamster hair, evil Zorgs of Evil! PEW! PEW! PEW!
Gina: Hey! You heard what Mom said! NO CAPES!

replies.reply_text: I, uhm.... think I'll go look for that... thing now. Bye.
Oh!  Easy!  I've got that!  Here!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yeah.....
Enzo: (Still caped and brandishing a stick as if it were antlers) Did someone cry Moooooooooooooooooose? ANTLERS FOR INDUSTRY! Yahooooo!
Gina: Don't blame me, I wanted a Pug!

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way.  I'll be back.  Good luck with Moose-Man...
Something blue that rhymes with blouse?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  No hints.

replies.reply_text: Something that goes "hiss."  Hmmm.....  A snake?
A radiator?
Uh.... Anything I have to leave Desert Isle to find?

chatpoints.chat_text: Everything for this scavenger hunt can be found in desert areas. Not on Art Isle, though. I'm not allowed to go there. Well, I am, but he's not and he'll just follow me. And you might have to, like, use a tool. There.

replies.reply_text: Why isn't he allowed on Art Isle?
Oh, well, that's a relief.  Okay, I'll start looking, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: I donno. (Gina shruggs, but you don't miss the fact that just for a second, her eyes went to her little brother and glowered.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, well, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh yeah? Let's see!
Enzo: I hope you found a huge cobra with electric fangs and dripping slime and-----
Gina: Will you SHUT UP?! Let's see it.

replies.reply_text: Here it is.
Okay, what next?
Oh, and I found this piece of obsidian, too.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You can keep it. I've got lots of rocks. Two more things to find. Okay?
Enzo:VROOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!

replies.reply_text: Not unless you give me some better hints!
Okay, I'm ready.
Oh, you've got to be kidding!  All the way to....... oh, really now!
Oooooooooooooooooh-kay.

chatpoints.chat_text:
I told you--
Enzo: The evil fiend, she'll send you to the ends-----
Gina: SHHHHUUUUUUUUUT UUUUUUUUUP!

replies.reply_text: I think I'm going to go somewhere quiet.  Goodbye.
Wow, thanks!  It was fun, I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh good, my folks are done shopping.  Bye now!

replies.reply_text: I am SO out of here!
Bye!  Good luck with your brother!   Happy Birthday, Chiropticon, Mighty Moose of the Yukon!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I told you, no hints. (Gina harrumphs and folds her arms defiantly. From somewhere in the distance you hear a high-pitched "Moooooooooooooooooooooose!")

replies.reply_text: Aw, come on, please?  I had to .... do stuff and I forgot.
Fine.  Great.  Be that way.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Looking up at you as if you are the densest object in the universe apart from a black hole, Gina reads, very slowly and carefully...)
About this thing, no songs are sung.
Just be sure you don't get stung.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I'm off.
Really, I'm busy, not an idiot!  Let me go see what I can find...

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, come on, it's not like it's a story problem or anything, honestly!
Enzo: Up, up and AWA--- (Splat! He trips over his cape. Enzo sits for a moment sneezing sand from his nose.)

replies.reply_text: Just checking, just checking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Something blue that rhymes with blouse.  It's not hard.

replies.reply_text: Okay, well, is it something that's blue naturally, or something that was painted blue or dyed blue or...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, maaaaaaaaaaan, I said NO HINTS!

replies.reply_text: Oh, forget it, I don't want to do this anymore.
I'm not asking for a hint, I'm just asking you to read the clue again, okay?
Okay, okay...

chatpoints.chat_text: SIGH. (The sneer that Gina gives you is a masterwork of histrionics.) "You need to rake right by a house. Find something blue that rhymes with blouse."

replies.reply_text: Right by a house.... hmmm...  You sure I need to rake?

chatpoints.chat_text: (shrugging) I donno. Maybe if the wind piled the sand up you'll have to dig. Oooo! That'll be SO much work!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, okay....

chatpoints.chat_text: (Flipping somewhat piquedly through her copybook for the clue) "There's a bright yellow thing that hangs from a branch. Underneath that's something lost from my ranch."

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You forgot it ALREADY?
Enzo: Of COURSE they forgot it already! My Fire-Breathing Mind-Control Rays can cancel out all thought processes in an instant! ZORK!!! Now no one on Earth remembers ANYTHING!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, it's his fault!  Come on, read me the hissing poem once again. Pllllleeeeeeeeeeease?
I'm out of here. This is crazy.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Scowling, but you can't really tell at whom) "Just south, a palm tree sways with bliss. Find me something that goes HISS. You'll have it made if you look in the shade."

replies.reply_text: And you're not going to give me the slightest hint which of thousands of shady things on this island it's near?
I'll start looking straight away.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not telling you THAT!  I already gave you enough hints!  You're supposed to be scavenger hunting, that means looking for, not asking about!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looking more morose than ever.) Oh. Hi, Scavenger Hunter.

replies.reply_text: Hi.  Just passing through.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey!  Look at me!  I'm Chiropticon, Super Moose of the Yukon!

replies.reply_text: Hello again Enzo.  How are you today?
All righty then, see you around kiddo!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm Chiropticon!  Yesterday was my birthday and I got lots of neat presents and Momma let me wear my Super Moose cape at my party!

replies.reply_text: Sounds like you had a lot of fun.  I have one more present for you, direct from the frozen North.  Want to see it?
Take care, kid, and happy belated birthday!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hisssssss Oh sssorry you ssstartled me. You ssshouldn't sssneak up on a sssnake like that.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry about that.  I suppose I should be leaving then.
Ewww!!! A snake! (You run away screaming.)
What are you doing way out here?
What was I doing again?
I found Studly for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well you sssee,  I wasss playing hide and ssseek with my brother, but the sssshowoff went into the maze and hasssn't come back out.

replies.reply_text: Well I hope you find him soon.  I have things that I really need to be doing instead of talking to snakes.
Would you like some help finding him?  I've had to do more complicated things before.  Finding a snake should be rather easy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really?  I don't want to be too much trouble.  That maze isss pretty complicated.  Asss you can sssee I've had sssome trouble locating him myssself.

replies.reply_text: Of course I will!  I wouldn't have offered otherwise.
Now that you mention it, I don't believe I have the time.  Good luck!
I'll be back as soon as I find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: You had offered to find my brother Ssstudly.  He isss hiding in the maze sssomewhere.  If you have sssome sssort of glassssss you may be able to find cluesss.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the reminder.  I'll be back soon.
No problem!  I'm just glad that I could help two brothers out.

npc_list.name: Studly
npc_list.admin_description: 'Disappears' after his quest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ssssh... I'm hiding from my brother, Assssher.  I don't want you giving away my sssspot.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I'll just be on my way.  I wouldn't want to give up your position.
Actually, that's why I am here.  Your brother sent me to find you because he was having problems looking himself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Sssso I musssst have found a good sssspot, then!  Assssher never wassss too good at hide and sssseek.  Sssso he ssssent you to come get me, then?

replies.reply_text: Yes, he did.  It looks as if he's worried about you.  He just wants to make sure you haven't gotten lost in here.
I can see that you are fine, so I will just be on my way.  Don't have too much fun!

chatpoints.chat_text: I ssssuppose that'ssss reassssonable.  I would be worried about him, too.  The only problem is that I've sssspent so long wandering around thissss maze that I am not ssssure how to get out.

replies.reply_text: If you would like, I could help you back to your brother.  I think I remember the way I came in and I can probably make the trip faster than you could.
Well, I do hope you make it out. Hopefully I will see you around.  Right now, though, I need to focus on getting out of here myself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really?  I dunno, though.  If Assssher sssseessss me being carried back, he might make fun of me.

replies.reply_text: Hmm... I suppose you're right.  I guess I'll let you make it back to him on your own, then.
Hmm... Well, I guess I could carry you until we get close and then I could set you down and you could... er.. uh.. slither the rest of the way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yessss, that ssssounds good.  Are you ssssure you are up to thissss?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I am!  It really isn't that far out of my way and I already told your brother that I would bring you back to him.
Actually, I changed my mind.  I really just don't think I have the time.
(You gently bend down and pick the snake up and begin to carry him back to his brother.)

npc_list.name: Shiri
npc_list.admin_description: Disapears after CP3

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slowly you approach the shore and manage to catch the seal before she escapes.) How dare you! What gives you the right to even see me?

replies.reply_text: Well, this isn't as exciting as I thought it would be.  Forget this, I'm out of here.
I am terribly sorry to bother you, but you see, Nerina is sick and she wanted me to check up on the local sea life.  She told me I could find you here.  I really didn't mean any harm.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you didn't have to be so rough!  So Nerina sent you, huh?  I was wondering what had happened to her.  There actually is something that needs to be done... If you can handle it, that is.

replies.reply_text: I guess I really wouldn't know if I could until you told me.  In any case, it's worth a shot.  What do you need me to do?
You know, I really probably can't handle it, or I at least don't have time.  I guess you're on your own.

chatpoints.chat_text: You see, I was exploring the beach this morning and I found this poor little bird all wrapped in yarn.  I've actually got him here with me.  Do you think you could take him to Nerina for me so she can help him?

replies.reply_text: Oh, a poor little bird?  How horrible!  This is exactly why we need to cut down on littering.  Of course I'll take him to Nerina.
Why can't you do it?  Anyway, I don't have the time to do things like this.
(<i>You watch her go without having a chance to say goodbye and then head back towards Nerina's.<i>)

npc_list.name: Guru Wiseman
npc_list.long_description: Guru Wiseman sits high up in this dead tree.  His beard is longer than he is tall; his deep, grey eyes speak of a deep melancholy. Nevertheless, he looks down at you with alarm, as if suddenly wakened from a dream.

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you staring at?

replies.reply_text: Uh... Nothing. Sorry, I'll just go now. Bye.
Excuse me, I don't mean to pry but... Who are you?
Hi, I'm back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Who am I, you ask? (The old man stares out over the sea.) I am Guru Wiseman, the oldest and wisest person on all these isles....

replies.reply_text: Are you really?
Do you.... live in that tree?
Suuuuuuure, riiiiiiight.  I'll just be going.  See you around.
Does Ruthie know you're here?

chatpoints.chat_text: The Horse Isles have rather a dearth of mountaintops.

replies.reply_text: Except ones that spew fire, yeah.
Whatever.  What do you do up there in a tree?

chatpoints.chat_text: My child, it just so happens that I like this tree. I've come up with some of my best wisdom whilst sitting here overlooking the waves.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  And what do you do with this wisdom, might one inquire?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhh, yes.  Wisdom.  I have gained much, much wisdom.  I know secrets of the greatest import.  I know the Universe in all its guises and all its foibles.  Yes, my child.  I know much.  I have learned.  And you, someday, perhaps you will learn.

replies.reply_text: You're a loony.  Bye!
I don't suppose you give out free samples, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ruthie?  You mean, the lady who brought these horses over here?  Oh, I suppose....

replies.reply_text: Oh... So you were here first?  This is your island, then.
What are you doing up in a tree?

chatpoints.chat_text:
A-haaaaaaaa! There is great wisdom, my child, in knowing that you don't own the land, but that you are simply of the land! Yes indeedy!
Oh dear.... I shouldn't have told you that, should I?

replies.reply_text: No, you shouldn't have.  It makes absolutely no sense at all.  Bye.
Why not?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh-ho!  Just because I'm a Great Wise Guru, doesn't mean I give out wisdom free-for-nothing to just anybody!  Oh no no no no no no!  No, you must prove yourself worthy!  You must prove that your mind is broad enough to accept my wisdom!

replies.reply_text: Okay, how do I do that?
That doesn't seem very wise to me!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, things aren't always what they seem!
Oh dear, oh dear, shouldn't have told you that, oh dear me. Now you run along before I accidentally fill your mind so full of wisdom you need to grow a second brain!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right, I'm going.  Bye.
Aw, come on, I'd love a little wisdom.  Can't you tell me anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I don't know. (Guru Wiseman stares down at you searchingly.) After all, how do I know if you're worthy? I can't give you wisdom if you aren't worthy!

replies.reply_text: Why not?
Oooo, I'm not worthy! Oh, oh! My poor brain would explode from the knowledge! Tsk tsk. Well, see ya.
Okay, then, well, how do I prove myself worthy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why not? Because dear child it's not done that way! You do something to prove yourself worthy and then I can tell you something that will profoundly change your life for the better. Well, maybe not for the better but change it anyway, and that's something. That's how it works, see?

replies.reply_text: Okay, then, well, how do I prove myself worthy?
Uh oh, I sense another quest coming on.  Sorry, I'm all quested out.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Prove yourself worthy, let me see, let me see................
Ah! I have it! You can help me with my Encyclopedia of Wisdom!

replies.reply_text: Your.... Encyclopedia of Wisdom?
Uhm... Yeah, right.  Good luck with that.  Bye.
You mean like, the wisdom of sitting up in a tree all day?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Heaving a heavy sigh...) All right, well, if you absolutely must know.... I'm afraid of... well, the ground.

replies.reply_text: Well, that explains why you're not in a mountain or in a cave then, I guess.  So tell me about this Encyclopedia.
You're kidding.
You're a loony!  I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well.... Horses keep throwing me on it, and it hurts, you see so... Now I'm up in this tree and I can't conduct the inteviews I wanted to conduct.  Well, you're down there, right?  And you're on a horse, and you want wisdom.  So if you want MY wisdom, you can interview the people I need interviewed for my book!  Then you come back here and tell me what they said and I'll give you some of my wisdom.

replies.reply_text: Well, uhm..... Okay, I can do that.
Why don't you just get right back up on the horse?

chatpoints.chat_text: Look, do you want to help me with my Encyclopedia of Wisdom or not?

replies.reply_text: Okay, sure.  Who do you want me to interview?
Well, tell me about this Encyclopedia then.
Uh, no thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's right here. (He pats a book sitting next to him. The book is not as thick as one would have expected.) I'm going to have it copied and given to everyone on Horse Isle so there'll be no more self-important loonies running around this place!

replies.reply_text: Says the guru sitting in the tree.  Okay.  So who do you want me to interview?
No, I think I'll bail out while I can.  Bye.
Oh, no, not Flavius!  Please!
This is a very, very long list... And it involves a lot of travelling, I see.  No chance of you helping me out with boat-fare, is there?
All right.  Oh, do I have to visit them all in order?

chatpoints.chat_text: What's wrong with Flavius?  He's a perfectly fine bloke if you get on his good side.

replies.reply_text: If you say so..........

chatpoints.chat_text: No.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back when I've spoken to them.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are indeed!  Have you visited everyone I asked you to see?

replies.reply_text: No, I haven't. Do I need to see them all and then talk to you?
Yes, I have.  I've written everything they said on the list you gave me, next to their name.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Of course!  I'm very busy thinking, you know!

replies.reply_text: I wish you'd have told me that, it would have saved me a lot of expense getting here!
Figures.  I'll be back when I've talked to the lot.

chatpoints.chat_text: mumble mumble....

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  Can't wait to see the finished book!  Bye!
An... owl?
Thanks!  Now, can I have that piece of wisdom you promised me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aw, come on.  I live in a tree!  And let me tell you, this tree ain't big enough for the both of us!

replies.reply_text: Whatever!  Now, about that piece of wisdom you promised me....?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that!  Yes, that.  Let me think now.  Hmmmm.... Ah!  Yes, here it is: Buy low.  Sell high.

replies.reply_text: That's it?!
Uh... Yeah.  Very wise.  Uhm.... Thanks, I guess.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Works for me!

replies.reply_text: Riiiiiiiiiiiiiight.  Okay. Nice meeting you, and thanks for the owl.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Jungle-Wandering Francis, initial meeting
npc_list.long_description: This animal seems to be a large lion with no mane.  It is muttering distractedly to itself.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Obliviously muttering to itself)

replies.reply_text: Hi Francis, I'm back!  Weren't we talking about how unhappy you are here in the jungle?
Hello, Miss?
(You sneak away before this creature has a chance to notice you.)
Hi Francis... Weren't we talking about how you could disguise yourself, so you can get out of the jungle?
Hi Francis, I'm back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Whaddya mean, "Miss?"

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I have a cold.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's on account of my not having a big fluffy hairpiece, and a... and a mane, even!  Well, I never, I mean, I might have, well, at one time, but no I never, even!

replies.reply_text: So, does that mean you're a lion, if you don't mind my asking?
You must be speaking some strange dialect.  I don't understand a word you're saying.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, this won't do at all.  We got started all wrong, you might say, on the wrong foot, even!  First we start with introductions.  My name is Francis the Lion -- King of the Jungle, even!

replies.reply_text: Nice to meet you, Francis.  I was sent by Omand the nature photographer to find out about you.  He's never seen a lion around here before.  It doesn't surprise me, seeing as lions are not really native to the jungle.
Yep, curious accent. I can't make heads or tails of it.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't I know it, baby! Don't I know it! People will talk though, "Francis," they say, "Go be king of the jungle, you kiddo, you... 23 Skiddoo!" and whatnot. Heavens! My goodness, they're bossy!

replies.reply_text: So how's life been, since you've made your home here in the jungle?
Zzzz.... (snort) Huh? Oh gosh, it's way past my bedtime. I'll talk to you later.
So why don't you leave?  Surely you could move into a town where they have proper groomers?
Well, I think that's about all I need to know.  Thanks for the chat!  I'm going to go let Omand know about you.  I'll be sure to come back and visit soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness you made me laugh, just now -- you're just that funny! Lions don't belong in towns! We make people go “argh,” and “help,” and “woo-woo,” even!

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't know. I could probably help you find a place that would suit you better.  Most of the people in towns seem really nice, they probably wouldn't mind a bit.  I've seen some vacant houses here and there... Why, there's one right in Earton!
This is shaping up into another quest!  I'll come back and talk to you about all this after I've brought the news of you to Omand.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, heavens, my goodness, this is all so sudden!  Okay, all right, well, I'll go check it out, then!  I'll have to disguise myself, though... Oh my goodness, it wouldn't do at all to have me walking around in broad daylight looking like a... lion.  Would you help me with a disguise?

replies.reply_text: I'll come back and we'll talk another time.
Sure!  Omand can wait.  This sounds like fun!
Sure!  This sounds like fun!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is no place for a proper lion, I tell you!   I've just lost all my 'joie de vivre', you might say.

replies.reply_text: So why don't you leave?  Surely you could move into a town where life would be more exciting?
There you go with the other languages again.  I'd better go.  Who knows what you might be saying?
I do try my best... So what sort of look are you thinking of, for your disguise?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooh, ooh, look here in this sacred tome I discovered! I like this guy, he's handsome! (Francis brings out a battered comic book, and shows you a picture of a pink lion, poorly disguised as a human)

replies.reply_text: The super-spy look.  Good choice.
That's silly, and you're silly.  See you later.
I think I know where I can get a big fur coat... I helped deliver some, once.  I'm not sure about the pith helmet.
I have no idea.  I guess I can't help after all.  I'll come back and see you some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were looking for a fancy disguise for me to wear, to be sneaky, even. I need to go house-hunting without causing a major panic, if you know what I mean, and I think you do. Remember? Like this classy fellow in my ancient text -- the big fur coat, the pith helmet, real fancy duds!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right, I was going to start with the fur coat.  I helped deliver some once.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: What's the idea? What's the idea? I'm sure an intelligent explorer like yourself will be struck with inspiration, whilst in the process of picking up my fashionable coat! Off you go -- at last, and to say the least!

replies.reply_text: I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh heavens above - you startled me again!  This place just has me so jittery.  I just don't feel comfy here.

replies.reply_text: What was I doing for you again?
This will cheer you up.  I've brought back both of those disguise elements you wanted... Here they are.  A very fashionable fur coat, and a pith helmet.
This will cheer you up.  I've brought back the big fur coat you wanted!  I couldn't find a pith helmet.
This will cheer you up.  I've brought back the pith helmet you wanted!   I couldn't find a fur coat.

chatpoints.chat_text: What's the idea?  What's the idea?  I can't go out without the full costume on!  This will never do!

replies.reply_text: Well, I have no idea where to look for the fur coat.
Well, I have no idea where to look for the pith helmet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Where do you find fur coats, usually?  In cold climates?  Igloo-dwellers and whatnot?  Heavens, do I have to do ALL the thinking for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, what could I have been thinking?  How silly of me.  I'll be back in a while.

chatpoints.chat_text: Where do you find pith helmets, usually?  In the jungle?  They're standard issue!  I wouldn't be surprised if they sold them locally.  Heavens, do I have to do all the thinking around here?

replies.reply_text: Oh, what could I have been thinking?  How silly of me.  I'll be back in a while.

chatpoints.chat_text: Put 'em on, put 'em onnnn! I'm a lion, I don't have the dexterity to assemble a disguise, and put on clothes, even! Here's the wool... it goes right on my whiskers, like in this picture!

replies.reply_text: (You carefully try to help the lion with his disguise)
Thanks!  Good luck!

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis the lion in Disguise, hanging out in Earton
npc_list.long_description: This person looks vaguely familiar to you, but it's hard to tell under his disguise.  He's wearing a massive brown fur coat, a pith helmet and an obviously fake mustache.

chatpoints.chat_text: A-Razz-a-ma-tazz, and a Poo-poo-pa-doo!  A-foe-de-oh-dohhh.... you're not Ira.  Pee-yew!

replies.reply_text: What a strange individual.  Goodbye now.
Francis!  It's good to see you again!  Do you remember me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, of course, it's you, the disguise-bringer, in full color, even!  Well, whaddaya know?  I found this house you told me about, but I think this belongs to someone, you know what I mean?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  I remembered an empty house in Earton... I guess it's Ira's.

chatpoints.chat_text: He's only away on vacation, and to ski, even!  That nosy Nadine saw me loitering here, and I told her I was a pal of Ira's, in Earton house hunting.  She told me there was an empty place on the beach, south of Earton.  I'm headed out to look at it now.

replies.reply_text: I think you should just stay here for now.  I won't know where to find you if you leave.
I think I know just the place she's talking about.  I'll look for you in your new home, when I'm in the area.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right, little pal.  I guess I'll hang around here.  See ya some other time!

replies.reply_text: Bye, for now.
Bye!

npc_list.name: Omand
npc_list.admin_description: Omand's head, floating in the jungle canopy, to give a clue where to get down.
npc_list.long_description: Omand certainly looks happier, and more at home here than he did back in his Tropicton residence.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there! I thought I'd come along and show you where I'd last seen the creature. I don't see it now, but it was just south of this deck.

replies.reply_text: Do you think I should jump down to the jungle from here and look for it, or continue across the decks to the west?
Hi!  I'm perfectly fine on my own, but thanks for thinking of me.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's your choice, of course, but this is the smaller area... You might want to try here first.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll think about it.

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis the lion in Disguise, hanging out in the Hoof Isle beach shack
npc_list.long_description: Francis the lion in his super spy outfit: pith helmet, llama wool mustache and enormous fur coat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who's there?  Put 'em up!  Put 'em up!

replies.reply_text: Hi Francis!  It's just me again.  How do you like this new home?
I'm going!  I'm going!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, heavens to Betsy! It's you again, little pal! This place will never do! You see? It's falling down around my royal ears! My chilly royal ears... I need something a tad bit warmer. Anyway, “King of the Hoof”... it just doesn't roll off the tongue.

replies.reply_text: You might try for “King of the Savanna”, perhaps.  The desert is warm, dry, and you might be able to find a place close to town.  Come to think of it, I remember an empty supply hut down there, toward the eastern town.
I think this is a fine place.  It's warmer, near a town, and no one lives here.  You should stay here.  It's better than nothing!
Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right, little pal.  I guess I'll hang around here.  See ya some other time!

replies.reply_text: Bye, for now.

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis the lion in Disguise, hanging out in Santon Cactus Seed Hut
npc_list.long_description: Francis the lion in his super spy outfit: pith helmet, llama wool mustache and enormous fur coat.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Francis' fur-coat-covered rear seems to be wedged in the doorway) Entrez, if you can!

replies.reply_text: Hi, Francis!  What a great place this is for you, don't you think?
I can't get in!  I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: It would be perfect, just perfect, if I could fit into it. Whaddaya say to that?

replies.reply_text: I guess it is a little small.  I don't have any more suggestions though, and the desert really seems to be the ideal place for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I love it, I tell you. I can feel my hair unfrizzing already! Oh, that I were free! Give me a push, will ya?

replies.reply_text: (You shove Francis as hard as you can)
Erm... I never was very strong.  I'd better go.  Good luck with your predicament.

chatpoints.chat_text: **POP!**  Ahh, that's better!  Not enough room to turn around, but it's really a fabulous locale!

replies.reply_text: I guess this is the best I can do for you.  Maybe soon you can find a bigger place.  Au revoir!
I wish I could think of another place, but this is the only empty residence I've seen in the desert.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think I'll go take a look around! I saw an oasis to the south... I have to check that out! Help me back out will you? (Francis positions himself halfway out the door)

replies.reply_text: (Again, you shove Francis as hard as you can)
Have fun checking out that oasis!  Maybe I'll join you after a while.

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis the lion in Disguise, in his final home.
npc_list.long_description: Francis the lion in his super spy outfit: pith helmet, llama wool mustache and enormous fur coat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in!  Come in!  Welcome!

replies.reply_text: Hey, Francis, aren't you tired of wearing that disguise? Surely you could take it off now.
Francis!  This is a great place!  You have to admit this is a prime location.
Thanks, but I'm kind of busy.  I'll see you around.
Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I would, but it's a problem of dexterity again.  Would you help me?

replies.reply_text: Sure! Here you go. (You carefully help Francis out of his disguise.)
I've gotten used to you in the disguise, actually.  I think you should leave it on.
You look so much more comfortable. Well, I'll leave you to your new home!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right.  If you really think so, little pal.

replies.reply_text: Yep!  And now, my opinions are needed elsewhere.  Off I go!
I'm just kidding. Of course I'll help! (You carefully help Francis out of his disguise.)
No problem. I'll see you when I get back.

npc_list.name: Francis
npc_list.admin_description: Francis as a lion, in his final resting place
npc_list.long_description: A lion with a beautiful flowing mane.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in!  Come in!  Welcome!

replies.reply_text: Just passing through.  See you later.
Thanks!  Wow, you look pretty happy now, Francis... You've really made yourself a home here.
Hi Francis!  I just stopped by to see how you were doing.
Sorry Francis, what did you ask me to get for you again?
Francis, I'm back!!

chatpoints.chat_text: All thanks to you!  My knight in shining armor, as it were!

replies.reply_text: (Giggle) I'm always glad to help!

chatpoints.chat_text: How positively lovely of you to think of little old me.

replies.reply_text: My pleasure, I'm sure.  I was just checking to see if you needed anything to help complete your new home.
I just wanted to make sure you've settled in.  I'll stop by again the next time I'm in the neighborhood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I miss the wood that grew in the jungle.

replies.reply_text: You miss the wood?
I'd love to stick around for the explanation, but I have to go.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, the ebony that grows in the jungle was the best wood I ever came across for my nails.  These local trees just don't cut it, so to speak.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I don't do manicures, bye!
So, what do you need me to do?
Only 10 logs?  I'll be back before you know it!
I believe that I have them with me right now, here...
Why thank you Francis.  It was my pleasure.  Take care, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's perfectly all right, I know how busy you are.  I asked you to bring me 10 Ebony Logs from the Jungle.

replies.reply_text: Ebony logs!  How could I have forgotten?  I'll be back in a jiff.

npc_list.name: John O'Lantern
npc_list.long_description: John O'Lantern is tall and thin with long gangly arms and legs.  He has an unusual orange pallor to his skin.  He has black eyes and a broad gap-tooth smile. His brown hair sticks up in a giant cow lick in the center of his head.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, traveler!  What brings you to my neck of the woods? Come in.  Rest a spell.

replies.reply_text: I think I'm really lost.  Thanks for the invite, but no thanks!  Bye!
Well, hello there, and who might you be?
Hi!  I'm sorry, but who's getting these roasted pumpkin seeds again?
I gave you both of their shipments. Nana said to ask you when the pumpkins were coming, and Cara asked about the costumes.
Hello!  I'm back with your supplies.
Just stopping by quick.  All right.  Gotta go.  Bye!
Hello, again!  I just stopped by to see how you are doing.
Sorry to bother you, but who's getting these deliveries?
