Okay, I'm back from the first two deliveries!
Sorry to bother you again, but who's getting these deliveries?
Hi! I'm back, and the flower ladies gave me these for you! (You gesture towards the bags you are carrying.)
I think I forgot who's getting these deliveries.
Hi!  I've made it back!
I gave you your deliveries.  Oh, and about that full employment thing...  Thanks, but I'm really not looking for full-time employment right now.
Howdy, John!  I just stopped by to see how your holiday preparations are coming along.
Sorry, John. Rather, Jack. but what am I looking for again?
So, Jake, I got the kitten.  Isn't he cute?  Who am I supposed to bring it to, again?
Hi John! Or Jack. I was visiting Hyrokkin recently, and she asked me to see you.  She needs a favor.
Sorry John, but who are these lures for?
Hi!  Thanks.  I was just exploring.
Just looking for work. You wouldn't happen to have anything for me?
Well, you were about to tell me about a job I could do for you?
What was it I was doing for you?
Hi Jack aka John! I've got all your pumpkins!
Hi Jack, what was I doing for you again?
Hi Jack! I am looking for, and I quote, an "orange squashy thing with seeds in." Reminded me of something you would know about...

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't know?  The name is O'Lantern, John O'Lantern... But you can call me Jack.

replies.reply_text: Jack O'Lantern? (You look around the cottage... You're not sure you like what you see.) I really have to be going. See you next time!
Okay, Jack O'Lantern it is... (You groan and roll your eyes in recognition.) And I suppose you're in charge of the Horse Isle Halloween festivities?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why yes, yes I am.  During most of the year, I tend to my pumpkin patch and prepare for October.  That's my busy season, you know.

replies.reply_text: I should think so, but what do you do to prepare for Halloween besides grow pumpkins?
That's all you do, raise pumpkins?  How busy can you be, growing big gourds?  I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I make all of the costumes and masks for the residents of Horse Isle.  And I supply all of the pumpkins for their autumnal needs.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like you certainly keep yourself busy all year long. I don't suppose you need any odd jobs done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I could use help with my deliveries here. (He gestures to dozens of burlap sacks, large and small, piled up against the far wall.)

replies.reply_text: What on earth do you have in all of those bags?
That's how you support yourself? With those? (You point at the sacks.)

chatpoints.chat_text: The large sacks contain roasted pumpkin seeds for eating, and the small sacks have pumpkin seeds for planting.  I send them to various shopkeepers around Horse Isle in exchange for supplies I need for my holiday projects.

replies.reply_text: I see, something for everybody, so to speak.
So that's how you can afford your activities?

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly!  I have several deliveries ready to be made now. Would you be able to help me make them?

replies.reply_text: This (You stare at the piles of sacks against the wall.) is beginning to look like a career choice. I'm sorry, but I'm too busy for all that right now. Hope you find someone who can help you. Bye!
Hmmm, I'm not that busy right now.  Okay, I'm in!
Got it.  Nana Knutkake in Tropicton, and Cara Cook in Wington.  How are they going to pay you?

chatpoints.chat_text: They'll give you supplies in exchange for the seeds.  They both know what I need, and they'll have it ready for you when you arrive.

replies.reply_text: All right then, I'll be back as soon as I've gone to both of them.  See you in a while!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry if I confused you.  Two sacks go to Nana Knutkake in Tropicton, and the other two sacks to Cara Cook in Wington.

replies.reply_text: Tropicton and Wington... Got it!  Bye!
They were both quite happy to get their shipments.  Nana said to ask you when the pumpkins were coming, and Cara asked about the costumes.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not surprising. (John's grin seems to be getting bigger!) Everybody wants my wares!

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess they would.  You're like the only game in town... right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Precisely... And that's just the way I like it. (He starts rubbing his hands together and giggling in an odd way.)

replies.reply_text: Ooookay.  I've got to be moving along, now.
Wow, thanks!  I'll stop by the next time I'm by this way and see if the next deliveries are ready.  See ya then, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am so glad you stopped by. You did such a good job last time that I have a bigger delivery ready for you, if you can still help me, of course.

replies.reply_text: Well, I don't know...I'm kinda busy right now.  Maybe I can help next time I come by...see ya!
Okay, I'm up for a little adventure.  What do you need me to do this time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad to hear that because this time the deliveries are more complex, are you still going to help me?

replies.reply_text: More complex?  I think I'll come back when you have a simpler chore for me.  See ya around!
Complex deliveries, hmmm... Well in for a penny, in for a pound I always say! Sure, I'm in.  Who's getting what this time?

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, I need to get seeds out to six merchants.  Will you need a list, or can you remember them?

replies.reply_text: Can I break it down to say... two merchants per trip?  I'd be happy to do this in three trips for you.
Six merchants??  Did I just make a career choice again?  I gotta go... See you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Seeing how you don't have a wagon with you, I suppose you are right.  You'll need to do them in three parts.

replies.reply_text: No sweat.  So where do I begin?
Now you think I need a wagon?  This is just spiraling out of control.  Catch you on the 'bound!
Okay, Crystalton and Witherton.  Any particular order?
Okay, Crystalton and Witherton.  Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  The order is up to you.  I'll have the next delivery ready for you when you get back.  Bon voyage!

replies.reply_text: I'm off, then.  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are delivering to Windy Pick in Crystalton, and Zeke Sacker in Witherton.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Very nice. Everything went smoothly?

replies.reply_text: Yep. Windy wants to know about your specialty items, and Zeke wants to know when your new line will be out.
Lets see, this time it's Flo Stemson in Appleton, and Rose Thorne in Hotton.  Again, any order to the deliveries?
Lets see, this time it's Flo Stemson in Appleton, and Rose Thorne in Hotton.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: These go to Flo Stemson in Appleton, and Rose Thorne in Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: My, my, the ladies have been most generous this year... (Jack's grin is getting broader... It sort of creeps you out when he does that!)

replies.reply_text: (You nod enthusiatically in agreement.) Where do you want them?
Okay, this round goes to Albert Junker on Hoof Isle, and Calla Lilly in Shellton... Any order?
Okay, this round goes to Albert Junker on Hoof Isle, and Calla Lilly in Shellton.  Phew.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: These seeds are going to Albert Junker on Hoof Isle, and Calla Lilly in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, I forgot... Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent... Excellent... Put them by the work table for me, will you?

replies.reply_text: Okay, anything else you need?
Thanks for the offer, but I'm really not looking for full-time employment right now.
Me?  Work for you... full-time?  I don't think so!
Wow, thanks!  This shirt is awesome!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you like it.  Please stop by and see me the next time you're on the isle, I may have some more jobs for you, all right?

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do.  See you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: My friend, the Sea Hag, recently lost her cat and she needs a kitten to replace it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, that sounds easy enough, but what's the catch?
(You stare at John in terror!) The Sea Hag!?! Oh, I don't think so, see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, if it isn't my favorite assistant!  I'm glad you stopped by.

replies.reply_text: Really?  What's up?
Uh oh... That sounds ominous... I think I better get going.  See ya around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I could use your help for a friend of mine.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I'll help you, but I don't know about your friends.  I'll stop in again next time.
Sure, what does your friend need?

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right, there are strings attached, as it were. The kitten has to be a pure white kitten, and it has to be free. You can barter or trade for it, but you cannot BUY it.

replies.reply_text: I knew there'd be some sort of catch, bye!
Sounds challenging!  Where can I find the Sea Hag once I get the kitten?
Yeah, that part's okay, but where am I supposed to find the kitten?

chatpoints.chat_text: Remember, you can't buy it, so don't bother looking in the Pet Shops.  The Veterinarian offices frequently list people trying to find homes for their kittens and puppies.  That's where I'd look if I were you. Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Let's see, no pet shops, check the Vets' offices.  Got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to find a white kitten for my friend Hyrokkin, the Sea Hag.  Remember, no pet shops!  Check the Vet offices for adoptions.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  I'm on it, see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: He is a cute one, I'll give you that.  Now bring him to my friend Hyrokkin with my compliments. You'll find her on Berg Isle.

replies.reply_text: Hyrokkin on Berg Isle.  I'm on my way.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: How is my dear friend?  What can I do for her?

replies.reply_text: Hyrokkin got a message from Asgard, Frigg and Baldur's brother and son are coming to see her. She's preparing a huge feast for her guests, and needs your help with some of the items.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly.  I'm happy to help her in any way I can.  What does she need?

replies.reply_text: She wanted to know if you know where she can get herring and cod roe.  Any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure that Jack Reelin over in Wington would be your best shot... And I have some lures I made for him that you could drop off, if you don't mind.  I'll even throw in some traveling money to boot!

replies.reply_text: I can do that for you, sure!
Maybe I'll come back to do that.  I have some other things to do first.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, I asked you to bring those lures to Jack Reelin in Wington.  He'll give you the fish for Hyrokkin in exchange.

replies.reply_text: Wington?  Oh yeah, that's right, I remember now.  I'm off, thanks!
Thanks, and I'm sure Hyrokkin thanks you, too!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Well, thanks for stopping by.  Say, if you like, I have something you may enjoy.  It's very, well, festive for fall I guess.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  I'm not much for 'fall'.  Bye.
Really? Okay, thanks!
Thanks!
Sure, I've got some spare time. What can I do for you?
Uhhh, today isn't a good day. My horoscope told me to beware all large squash.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. I'll be in once I have them.
Arbuckle? I think I remember where he is.
Arbuckle? What kind of bizarre name is Arbuckle?

chatpoints.chat_text: You needed to take those pumpkins to Arbuckle. He likes to carve jack o'lanterns- he's big into interior design.

replies.reply_text: I remember now, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I am indeed a purveyor of orange squashy things with seeds in! Although that's an interesting description of a pumpkin. You want one that's rat-sized?

replies.reply_text: Yes. Do you have any small pumpkins like that?
Thank you!

npc_list.name: Mamma Sadie
npc_list.long_description: Mamma Sadie could be anybody's mother--or grandmother!  Her whole being radiates welcome and the promise of good food and warmth.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, look who we have here! (Mamma Sadie runs up to you and gives you a huge hug, and, beaming, tugs at your cheeks.) Welcome, welcome! You made it! How wonderful! 100% of your quest points done, an amazing achievement! Just amazing! You must be so proud!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I've got to say, I'm the cat's pajamas!
Indeed, I must say, I'm the cat's pyjamas!
Yeah, I did it!  I'm exhausted!  Have you got a place I can lie down?

chatpoints.chat_text: So you are, so you are!  Well, you'll look around, you'll rest a little, you'll catch your breath already!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I did it!  I'm exhausted!  Have you got a place I can lie down?
Thanks.  I'll go take a rest now and come back in a while.
You know, you remind me of someone.... I can't tell whom, though... but you're familiar.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, there's something I can do for you, maybe?  A little nosh, maybe a little something to drink?

replies.reply_text: You know, you remind me of someone.... I can't tell whom, though... but you're familiar.
Not now, thanks.  I just came to see what you've got for sale today.

chatpoints.chat_text: Familiar?  Of course I'm familiar!  I'll bet you've already met my son, Phillip, and my granddaughter, Prunella.

replies.reply_text: You're.... King Phil's mother?!
You're .... Princess Pookie's grandmother?!
Do you know anyone else on these islands well?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, he's still doing that whole "king" bit, is he?  Honestly, since he was a tiny thing, that boy's had much too much imagination!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, he kind of does, but he's happy.
Who else do you know on these islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: Happy? Hah! He should be happy! And does he come and share his happiness with his mother?! No! Do I ever see him here? NO! Every now and then, he sends me a weasel! This is how you show your love for your mother? By sending her a WEASEL? (Mamma Sadie dissolves into tears.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't know, I'd love it if someone sent me a weasel every now and then!
Tell me about Pookie-- I mean, Prunella.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh!  Feh!  Weasels!  Weasels, ferrets, otters... They steal everything!  But everything!  But how about you?  You're all rested now, you'd like maybe a nice nosh?  A bagel?  Some nice ice cream?  Not together of course!  Maybe a cake?

replies.reply_text: I'm fine now, thanks.  I think I'll go explore the islands a bit.
Please tell me more about some of the other characters on Horse Isle!  Who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Prunella? Augh! My poor daughter Penelope, to be saddled with someone like that! She's breaking her mother's heart, and her grandmother's! She thinks she's showing off how cool she is, and what is she showing off really? That she failed English, that's what! Oy, me... And when I think what she could have become.... But no, all she cares about is boys and princess and shoes and cool and gum, and it's breaking our hearts!

replies.reply_text: Oh, don't worry, she'll grow out of it.
Let's hope she finds a prince that will put up with her!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hah!  Let's hope.  Now, you're not hungry or tired?  Yes?  There's something I can do for you, maybe?

replies.reply_text: I'll just look around the store a bit now, thanks.
I'll just wander around the island a bit now, thanks.
Please tell me more about some of the other characters on Horse Isle!  Who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Who do I know? Who don't I know! I know Miss Mabel, she's my third cousin thrice removed on my father's side... Oh, and there's my little nephew Chiropticon, Mighty Moose of the Yukon, isn't he a dear? And oh! Yes! The Big Bad Wolf! He and Grandmother Hood play bridge against me and old Flo Solomon. We always win! Old Flo, she's sharp!

replies.reply_text: Please tell me about Miss Mabel!  How did she get to be such a good sleuth?
Uhm... Moose Man is your nephew?!
The Big Bad Wolf actually plays bridge?  I thought they were just making that up!
Tell me about Flo Solomon!  She seems like such an interesting character.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, Mabel. Such a brilliant sort. Always bookish as a child. We were in school together, and she was always the first one to hand in a test. I never, ever handed in a test first! I mean, I was always done first but I was terrified of being the first! Were you like that in school?

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  It's never bothered me to hand in a test first.
Who me?  Always!  I always thought that the teacher assumed that if you finished everything too fast you just guessed, and I didn't want the teachers to think I just guessed.
Oh, no, I was always the last to hand in a test.  I kept going over and over my answers and correcting myself...
Interesting!  Well, I should get going now.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: And most of the time, the answer you had in the first place was right, wasn't it!  Ha ha ha!  I did that, too!

replies.reply_text: Yeah!  And I could never teach myself never to change an answer!  Oh well...  What else can you tell me?
No, actually I usually did change it to the right answer.  But anyway, who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you were a good student, then?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I was.  Probably better get going, though, bye!
No, not really.  Best be going now, though.  Bye!
Please tell me more about some of the other characters on Horse Isle!  Who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes!  Well, my grand-nephew.  But isn't he just the most darling little dear?  And such an imagination!  I'm so proud!

replies.reply_text: He is a remarkably silly thing!
I don't think his sister would agree with you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh!  That's because she has to be responsible for him.  She'll appreciate him when they're both older.

replies.reply_text: If you say so.  Well, I'll be going now.  Thanks for your hospitality!  Bye!
Please tell me more about some of the other characters on Horse Isle!  Who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, he is.  And so cute!  Just a little angel... Well, yes, he does give my sister's daughter a hard time, but he's been much quieter, really, ever since that business with the well...

replies.reply_text: I don't think I want to hear about this.  I think I'll just go explore.  Thanks!  Bye!
What?  Did he fall down a well or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fall down a well?  No... well... no, not really fell, I mean, it wasn't an accident but it wasn't... I mean.... oh, I'll tell you some other time.

replies.reply_text: Aww, come on, tell me!  I won't tell anyone!

chatpoints.chat_text: Weeeellllllllll... Maybe some other time.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  No problem.  See you later, then!
Please tell me about Miss Mabel!  How did she get to be such a good sleuth?
What about the Big Bad Wolf?  Has he ever really tried to eat those Pigs?
Please tell me about Flo Solomon!  How did she ever get to be a Pirate?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, Wolfie, I love him, he's such a big tease!  Eat pigs? Meh... Who knows?  He's a wolf, he eats what wolves eat.  He's very fond of my apple pie, too!  And bridge?  He's brilliant!

replies.reply_text: Well, that's funny, because the Pigs seem to be terrified of him.
Hmmm.... The idea of a wolf who plays bridge is so.... bizarre.

chatpoints.chat_text: What, it's more bizarre than a wolf who lives in a cave on a cloud?  Nu...  Well, you never mind about that.  Would you like an ice cream?  Maybe some cake?  Some water?  You can take it to your horse?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, not just now.  I think I'll go look around a little bit.
It's odd, though, the pigs seem terrified of him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pigs.... honestly.  Did you know pigs are supposed to be one of the smartest animals there are?  I don't know, sometimes I wonder if you put all three of those brains together, could you get one working synapse out of them?  Ha!  Pigs!

replies.reply_text: I've heard it said that pigs are the "Philosphers of the Animal Kingdom."
Those pigs were kind of loopy.  Well, maybe not the last one, but the first two, definitely.  Oh, well.  Thanks, I'm going to go look around for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've heard it said that Neizsche was a philospher.  I think he was just a quack!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, a lot of people think that.  I think I'll go look around a little more.  Bye now!
What can you tell me about Flo Solomon?
What can you tell me about Moose Boy?  He sounds like an interesting character.
Please tell me about Miss Mabel!  How did she get to be such a good sleuth?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Flo Solomon! Tsk, tsk, such a sad story, that! Oh, my, yes, a sad story. She and I were kids in school together, you see. And when we were in .... oh, I forget the year now, it was so long ago, this boy got this incredible crush on her!

replies.reply_text: Really!  Tell me more!
I don't want to hear any more of this.  I think I'll go wander around the islands for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well!  Honestly!  He was a very... well, I can't say he was a nice boy.  Well, he's not a nice man now, old Faustus.

replies.reply_text: Faustus?!  That old geezer in Appleton?!
Yes, go on...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, is that where he lives now? Poor Appleton!

replies.reply_text: Yes, I met him once.  Nasty old grouch!  But please, go on.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well! Back then, he just adored Flo, you know! He carried her books home from school for her. He brought her flowers and all that, and candy, and oh, you wouldn't imagine what!

replies.reply_text: I just can't imagine it!  And what did Flo think about it?
This is boring, can we talk about someone else?  Who else do you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, in the beginning she was a little flattered. Then I think she just liked not having to carry her own stuff. And she could send him on errands and all. And then! Well! Flo met old Mr. Solomon! And she fell for him in a big way! But The Mister wouldn't carry her books for her, so you can guess what happened!

replies.reply_text: Oh, my!  She wanted them both around?

replies.reply_text: I think you could build up a wall of sandbags near the door. That would surely stop the sea surge from slushing in. Gosh, that's a tongue twister!
Can't think of a thing that would help. Sorry!
That's for me to know, and you to find out! A-ha, ha, ha!

chatpoints.chat_text: I trust ye know the whe'eabouts of said sandbags to stop said slushin'?

replies.reply_text: Hey! There's another tongue-twister! Okay, back to business. What we need are used feed sacks. Fill 'em with sand and ta-da! Sandbags! I'll go ask at some barns.
Nope! But that's not my problem, matey! It's yours! Ha, ha, ha!
Here's another tongue-twister for you! How much wood could a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood? Later gator!
I'll bet barns have used feed bags. I'll be happy to find some for you.
I'll start asking around. You'll have sandbags stopping that water in no time. And smartly I go, Smelly!

chatpoints.chat_text: Open yer eyes, ye bilge rat! Da sea still be fillin' me home wit' spit!

replies.reply_text: I've studied the problem and think the best solution is to use sandbags.
Sea spit? Yuck! Count me out.
That's right! I've got your sandbags right here.
Ah, yes. You need sandbags.  I'll get some empty feed sacks and you'll be in business!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sandbags, eh?

replies.reply_text: Absolutely. Fill empty feed sacks with sand and you'll have your sandbags. I figure half a dozen should do it. If you'd like, I'd be happy to see if I can round some up.
That would be my guess. Good luck on finding some!
Sandbags should certainly do the trick.
Glad to have helped. And thank you for the reward. There's a sweet mare I've got my eye on buying!
Do you happen to know a good spot to dig? I need a place that has deep, soft sand, that is free of rocks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye ain't made sandbags outta dem yet! I oughta keelhaul yer stinky hide for messin' wit' me head! Now git outta here and start diggin'. Ya gots to fill 'em wit' sand to make 'em sandbags!

replies.reply_text: That's hardly the way to get me to do your dirty work! Digging sand isn't fun, you know!
About that -- do you happen to know a good spot to dig? I need a place that has deep, soft sand, that is free of rocks.
I thought we could work together on that. But I can see I was wrong!

chatpoints.chat_text: There be a shipwreck a wee bit o' a walk from here. Try diggin' there, matey.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I should be back in a few.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be a few marbles short, eh? Boots from Barrett. And they was needin' waterproofin'. Kin ye 'member that?

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look about, ya sea dog, does ya think I gots any time fer hobbies??  Now off wit ya!!

replies.reply_text: Jeez, I'm sorry to bother you, bye!

npc_list.name: Stinky Breeches Vincent
npc_list.admin_description: No new quests on this id, full
npc_list.long_description: Stinky Breeches is well-groomed (for a pirate) with a flashing smile of gold-capped teeth and a twinkle in his eye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lighthouse keeper is searching through what looks like old pirate maps piled on the table. He glances up at you as you enter.)

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, sir. I hate to bother you, but I wonder if you could help me.
Eeeeeekkkkkk! A pirate! Run for your life!
Please excuse my intrusion, but Crow's Nest Carrie was wondering what you might do in your spare time...

chatpoints.chat_text: What'cha be needin'? I might be inclined to help a matey as polite as ye. 'Course I'd be needin' a favor first. It's Pirate Law, ya know.

replies.reply_text: That figures. I'll find help some other way. Thanks anyway.
Pirate Law? I never heard of that rule before.
I'm not a pirate, so I don't know much about Pirate Law. You mentioned a favor?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. Ye got me all the ingredients, but not the pot to cook 'em up in. I'm needin' a big, copper-bottomed pot. It be the only way to cook 'em right.

replies.reply_text: That rings a bell now. How hard can it be to find one of those? Okay, I'll do it.
Oh, right. Guess I'm not in the mood to help you after all.
Whoa right there! This sounds like a long and drawn out quest. You best be getting someone else to help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don-cha be messin' wit' me! Lessin ye be wantin' yer best horse ta swim with sharks! Most me kin have gone on to the big sea in the sky. (Stinky takes off his hat and lowers his head in reverence -- for all of two seconds!)

replies.reply_text: You don't have to be so grumpy about it. How was I supposed to know? Jesh!  Just what am I supposed to do to help you, then?
Sharks? I'm gone like the tide!
You know, I don't much care for pirate threats! Especially to my best mount!  I am so outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Find and return me family cookbook. I wrapped it tight in sealskin, for me getaway. A sea squall ripped it from me very hands. I watched 'til the waves pounded it into the shoreline 'cross the way.

replies.reply_text: Let me get this straight. You know where the book is and you haven't gone back to get it?
Yikes, look at the time! Sorry, gotta run. Maybe I'll help you another time.
You know, this sounds too complicated. I'm gone like last year's snow!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye sayin' ye be a pirate? Long enough to know all the pirate laws? A full-fledged, cross yer bones, spit in yer mudder's eye and swear to Davy's Locker?

replies.reply_text: I swear it!
Oh, no. I'm not a pirate. Not saying that at all. I promise.
I'm not up for arguing with a pirate. Count me gone!
(Yikes! Looks like Stinky didn't believe you.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank yer lucky stars ya be smart enough to spit out the truth. (Sunlight glints off the gold caps of his teeth and his cutlass.) Best not try to pass yerself off as a pirate!

replies.reply_text: (Gulp!) You mentioned a favor?
I'll just go now... (Run away!)

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. That I did. Me belly has an awful craving for me uncle's famous Red Beans and Rice.

replies.reply_text: That's why you have that name. Eeeeuuuwwww. I am so outta here!
So, let me guess. I have to find your uncle and have him make you beans?
I've done plenty of quests and that doesn't sound hard at all. What do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be a daft one! I was breaking outta prison! No pirate worth 'is salt wants ta break in ta one!

replies.reply_text: Prison? I have to go to prison to help you? Can't you just go to the library and check out a cookbook?
No way! That place is crawling with rats! Find someone else to help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Argggg! This be me family heirloom! A treasure filled wit' da finest bean recipes around!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay. Can you tell me where exactly I'm supposed to find this "family heirloom"?
Well, find it yourself then! Bye! (Run away.)
I'll be back as soon as I can.
Thanks! Glad I could help.
Umm, aren't you forgetting something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Me family cookbook. Ring a bell er two fer ya?

replies.reply_text: Ah, yes! I'll get right to it.
Right. Maybe I can get back to you on that. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye bilge rat! Doncha be messin' wit me. There'll be no red beans and rice iff'n there ain't no pot to cook 'em in!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right! I've got it right here!
Yikes! I'll be back as soon as possible.
Where did you say I could find a pot?

chatpoints.chat_text: Me recipe calls for dry kidney beans and rice and spices and such.

replies.reply_text: And 'such'?  I know where this is leading -- some long, drawn out errand running -- and it's leading me right outta here! Later, dude!
Oh, look! There are fish offshore, just waiting to be caught. And fish is excellent for your health. So I'll leave you to fishing while I head on outta here!
Let me take a wild guess. I have to travel to far and distant islands to get those things, right? Sure. Might as well add to my travels.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what might that be?

replies.reply_text: You said you'd help me if I helped you -- that Pirate Law thing you were talking about?
Oh, never mind. I've got other quests to do. Horses to race. Gems to sell. All that kind of thing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wha'cha be pesterin' me now for?

replies.reply_text: Hello again. I was doing something for you, wasn't I?
Umm, never mind. Bye!
I've got it! Your family cookbook.
It's that Pirate Law thing. You said you might be able to help me if I did a favor for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I got all kind of teeth-rattlin', bone-shakin' tales that I could spill. But I ain't that kind of a pirate. Least ways, not on an empty belly!

replies.reply_text: Gotcha. You want your beans and rice. Fine. What's it gonna take to get the goods from Rika?
I bet you do. You know what? I'm not sure I'm up to getting between an angry woman and a hungry pirate just now. I'll be back when I'm feeling braver.
Teeth-rattling? Sounds exciting. But since you aren't talking anyway, I'm gone like the wind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. That I did. Ye fetched me family cookbook. Exceptin' I still ain't got me dinner.

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding me? You should be grateful you've got your treasured cookbook! I had to chip boulders into gravel to get out of prison.
Speaking of dinner, I've got to run! Later!
Of course. Silly me. I should have realized you'll need ingredients. What do you need me to get?

chatpoints.chat_text: Grateful, yes. But holdin' it jus' makes me belly wish fer them red beans and rice even more. And that be our agreement.

replies.reply_text: (Sigh.) I guess I can understand that. What do you need to make the beans?
Well, aren't you a tricky fellow? You set me up. At least it feels that way! Find someone else to run your errands!
Is this one of those never-ending quests? I think I'll pass!
Any idea where I might get the ingredients you want for that recipe?
Easy-peasy! I bet I know exactly where to get everything. I'll head over to the nearest store now. Be back soon!
Well, darn it. Look at the time. Tell you what. When I've got some time to waste, I'll come back and find out more. Later, dude!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye can get the beans and rice from a matey who's given up 'is sealegs. He's taken up running a store on Tail Isle.  Tell em 'is ole galley mate sent ye. But ain't nobody know 'bout 'is past, and ye best be keepin' it that way. Savvy?

replies.reply_text: Savvy! I mean, aye! I mean, yes! I'll keep quiet about that and won't tell a soul!
Okay, I'll start with the beans and rice part. I'm not good at taking notes, so as soon as I've got that done, I'll be back to hear where to go for the next thing you need. Later!

That's just not part of my travels right now. If I find myself on Tail Isle, sometime in the near future, I'll look in to it. In the meantime, you'll just have to settle for dreaming about those beans and rice! Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now for the spices. Rika will be havin' the thyme, bay leaves, and cayenne.  But ye be needin' to bribe her. Seems the lass is a bit miffed at yours truly.  Then I'll be needing some vegetables.

replies.reply_text: Okay... Any idea of what I should bribe her with? Or do you think I can just sweet talk her?
Wow! A secret past. That seems so... pirate-like! Sounds like there might be a handful of stories about characters on the islands. Care to share a few?
Great! I'm not up to facing the wrath of an angry woman right now. I think I'll pass on this for now. I'll come back if I change my mind.

First Tail Isle. Then over to Spice. Darn it, that's a lot of traveling.  But okay.  And I have an idea on what I can use to bribe Rika. Woman love jewelry, you know! I've got an emerald necklace that is sure to do the trick.
Nice scissors! So, beans and rice from Barrett, and spices from Rika. Did you say you needed vegetables?
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! Garlic, onions and bell peppers. Me dear ole mum's friend Candide grows the finest.  That be all the ingredients, 'cepting me special family sauce. But my heart got that memorized, it does. And I made up a batch to last me twice and thirty journeys 'round the globe.

replies.reply_text: Okay, then, if that's it, I'll be back soon. Oh, can you help me out with traveling expenses?
I'll be back with the ingredients shortly.
Perfect! I should be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in, already. Ye ain't just here ta pester me none, are ye?

replies.reply_text: Nope. I'm back, and I have something for you!
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Any idea where I might get the ingredients you want for that recipe?
Weren't there some vegetables you wanted?
Can we go over the list of things you need one more time?
While I appreciate all the "sparkle" you've given me, travel costs are making this a lot less enjoyable. Could you maybe give me another advance? Like another diamond?
I gave you everything you need for your beans and rice. Now will you help me?
By the way, I was wondering if you could advance me something to help with traveling expenses? I'd be grateful.
It seems to me you had one other thing you needed for your beans and rice recipe. Can you remind me what that was?
You mentioned you needed spices?
I think I gave you everything that you had on the second list.
I've got it! The last thing you need for your beans and rice!
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I just wanted to make sure the pot was working out for you.
Nope. I've come to collect on that favor you owe me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do ya now? Hand it over, already. Me belly's tired of waitin'.

replies.reply_text: I've brought you the beans and rice from Barrett.
I've brought you the fresh spices from Rika.
I've brought you the vegetables from Candide.
I've brought you the cooking pot! A copper-bottomed stock pot big enough to feed an entire pirate crew your uncle's red beans and rice. Ta-daaa!
Oops! My mistake. I thought I had something for you. I'll be back.
I've brought everything you need to make beans and rice.
I've got something else for you!
That should do it. It's everything you need for your rice and beans recipe.
I've got something else for you!
That's everything you need for your rice and beans recipe.
I've got something else for you!
That should be everything you need to start cooking.
What!?! Are you serious? I asked you if there were any other ingredients and you said that was it.
One more thing? Arrrg! That's it! I'm done. I'm gone like the wind! Find someone else to be your gopher.
You say one more thing now, but I bet this is a never-ending quest, isn't it?

chatpoints.chat_text: That be all the ingredients, fer sure. But I ain't got no pot to cook it in, matey. That be the deal. I get me beans and rice for dinner, and ye be gettin' a favor in turn. And jus' so ye knows, I'll be needin' a big, copper-bottomed pot. It be the only way to cook 'em right.

replies.reply_text: Argggg! Fine. You need a pot, I'll get you a stinkin' pot. Gesh!
You've got to be joking. I can't spend any more time on this now. I might be back. Later!
What? All this island-hopping is making me seasick. I've done all the running around for you that I can stand. At least for now. Maybe I'll be back some other day.
A pot? This is the last thing you need for your bean and rice recipe? This isn't a trick?
I don't suppose you have any idea on where to get a pot?
While I appreciate all the "sparkle" you've given me, travel costs are making this a lot less enjoyable. Could you maybe give me another advance? Like another diamond?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Stinky shrugs as he picks his teeth with his cutlass.) Ya might try askin' a cook or two... ya know, what runs an inn?

replies.reply_text: Great. I'll do that. But I am NOT happy about this!
Would it be possible to get something more for traveling expenses?
Wow! Thanks tons. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Red Beans and Rice. Ring a bell, does it? Ye was getting me the ingredients. Ya ought ta be readin' the note I gave ye, ya bilge rat!

replies.reply_text: That does ring a bell. Thank goodness, I've got those right here.
Oops. I'll be back.
You know, that note takes up valuable inventory space in my backpack! I'll be back with the goods asap!

chatpoints.chat_text: Didn't. Suggested ye ask a cook or two.

replies.reply_text: Arggg. That's all the help you can give me?
Good idea! And I know just the cook to start with.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.

replies.reply_text: Arggggggg! Obstinant, stubborn, mule-headed pirate!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Stinky is stirring something in the copper-bottomed pot you brought him. He looks up at you and grins.) I be leavin' ye to tell me iff'n me beans the best you ever tried.

replies.reply_text: I'm up for a taste. They smell great!
Ewwww! What's that nasty smell? I am so outta here!
Tasty! I can see why you like them so much. I'll leave you to enjoy them. Bye!
Wow. These are great. I guess this means since I did a HUGE favor for you, you would be willing to help now, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Roll me over and back ag'in! Me belly was so focused on these beans, I plum forgot ye needed help. A pirate's word is as good as the gold in his mouth. Whatcha be needin', matey?

replies.reply_text: Gesh! Me too. I'll be back if I remember.
Oh! Oh! I remembered!!!
That's why I'm here! I need to collect on that favor now. I need something from you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Alls ye gots to remember is to visit Barrett, Candide and Rika. Got it?

replies.reply_text: Got it! I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pirate's honor! This be the very last thing I need to make up a pot of me uncle's famous Red Beans and Rice.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I brought you everything you asked for. What else could you possibly need?
Arrggg! I just can't do it. I can't. Someday, if I've got nothing better to do, maybe. But not today. No way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did ya, now?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did! There's this sailor on the beach, and he's looking for a friend who got lost at sea. Would it be possible for you to please look along the different shorelines from atop the lighthouse and see if you can see him?
Surprised you, huh? I bet you were hoping I'd completely forgotten about it. It took me forever to do your "little" favor! But I did it, and now I need a favor in return.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. I could do that. But what be in it fer me?

replies.reply_text: Are you serious? What happened to Pirate's Honor? We made a deal. You would do me a favor If I ran all over the isles getting stuff so you could make beans and rice.
Arrrgggg! Forget it! Just forget it you obstinate, stubborn, obnoxious man!
The beans and rice bubbling on your stove means you owe me a favor. All you have to do is climb up the tower and look for shipwreck debris. Okay?
Whew. I'll think I'll go comb the beach for gems while I'm waiting.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ya gots ta admit they be some fine beans and rice!

replies.reply_text: Fine, fine. I admit it. They are amazing. Wonderful. Terrific. Stupendous. It still means you owe me a favor. Remember? Now will you please go look for Farley?
Argggg! You are the most frustrating pirate ever! I'm just going to have to tell Edgar to deal with this mess himself!
Pearls will work!  I'll be back with a pot in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I be crossing me old bones, spittin' in me mudder's eye and swearin' ta Davy Jone's Locker.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll get you a stinkin' pot.
Man, I don't know. I have to think about it. Maybe I'll be back. Maybe not!

chatpoints.chat_text: And is what ye be needin' somethin' I might want ta be givin'?

replies.reply_text: There's no reason why you wouldn't want to! All you have to do is climb up the lighthouse and search the shorelines. There's a sailor whose buddy went missing in the ocean. Please, please, please help! Could you just do that?
Definitely, positively yes! I need to you look for a guy named Farley who's probably washed up somewhere.  Pirate's honor says you should do this for me. Its a very, very small favor!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lighthouse keeper has his feet on the table and is snoring. As soon as you step near the table, he wakes up.) Who be there and what ye be botherin' me for?

replies.reply_text: Hey Vincent! It's me. I've come back to see if you spotted any place that looks like Farley might possibly have washed ashore.
Just stopped by to say hi! And now I'm saying bye!
Hello, hello! Long time no see. I was wondering if I could get a pot of your famous Red Beans and Rice?(You quickly tell him about the missing foghorn and your deal with Captain Jack.)
I seem to remember needing something from you. Can you remind me what it was?
Hey Vincent! It's me. I've brought back your copper pot!
Hey Vincent! Can you remind me what I was supposed to do for you?
Thanks! I'm sure Edgar will appreciate this.

chatpoints.chat_text: That be some serious business! Crow's Nest Carrie be needin' that foghorn. And I be needin' you to agree to bring back me copper pot. Or get me another!

replies.reply_text: Forget about it! This quest has gone on long enough! I'm outta here.
We have an accord, Vincent!
I remember trying to find a copper pot for you last time. I sure don't want to have to go through with that again. I think I'll just skip this quest.
Does this mean I can have the pot of beans and rice now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were wantin' a pot of me famous Red Beans and Rice!

replies.reply_text: That's right! Can I have it now?
Ah, now I remember. I think I'll pass on this quest. Good bye!
Thanks so much! I'll be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye was givin' me famous beans and rice to them Skull pirates, and gettin' me pot back, as soon as they ate 'em.

replies.reply_text: Right! Be back in a flash.
Yes I was! And I've got it right here.
Thanks again, and have a super terrific day!

chatpoints.chat_text: I bet dem Skull pirates will be dreaming about me rice and beans for months! I'll be taking me pot now!

replies.reply_text: Here it is!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Glares at you and snarls.) Weigh anchor ye scurvy landlubber. I don't got no spare time!

replies.reply_text: I'll just show myself out, don't get up...bye!

npc_list.name: Crow's Nest Carrie
npc_list.admin_description: Before crickets are removed/no new quests on this id
npc_list.long_description: The lighthouse keeper, er, pirate... is a young woman! Imagine that.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The place is crawling with crickets! Carrie is smacking them with a broom. By the looks of things, it's going to take her weeks to get rid of all the little chirpers.)

Wha'cha be lookin' at? Spit yer words out quick or be gone with ya already.

replies.reply_text: Sorry! Didn't mean to bother you.
Umm, excuse me. I hate to bother you but I was speaking to Cap'n Solomon....
Ouch! Now what? Maybe the Captain has some ideas.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye again! Lookin' to be keelhauled?

replies.reply_text: No, thank you! I've brought you a seashell necklace. I thought you might like it.
Wait!  I've brought you a lovely pearl necklace to remind you of the sea.
Just hold on a second. I've brought you wildflowers to cheer you up.
If you'll just take a moment and look at this? I've brought you a yellow rose. As a gesture of friendship.
That wouldn't be on my top ten list of things I'd like today. Wow. Crickets must really like this place.
Cap'n Solomon sent me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. Blast 'em. It be weeks since I got me some shut-eye.

replies.reply_text: I could probably do something to help you. I'm not sure what, but do you want me to think about it?
Speaking of shut-eye, I think its past my bedtime. Nighterz!
Ah-ha! That must be what Cap'n Solomon was talking about.

chatpoints.chat_text: There ain't be no helping this problem. Be off wit' ye already.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure there must be someone on Horse Isle that could tell me how to get rid of crickets. I'd be happy to check for you.
Okay-dokey! I won't be losing any sleep over it! Good-bye!
Hmmm. How about I start stomping on them? Between the two of us, that should kill a few dozen or so! Then we can discuss what Captain Solomon wants.
I know several people who know about bugs. I'll be back as soon as I can.
Ouch! (That didn't work. Better try something else.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (The pirate holds her broom like a bat. Careful, looks like she's ready to whack you!) Do ya now?

replies.reply_text: I do! I've got scorpions. The crickets should be gone in no time. Scorpions love eating them. (You dump the scorpions out of the bag and watch them scurry across the floor.)
Yikes! Crazy pirate with a bat in her hands. Run!!!
(Well, Sherlock! That wasn't one of your better ideas!) Oops! That's not how I envisioned this working.
Thanks so much! Enjoy your sleep.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm waitin', Matey!

replies.reply_text: What I have here is a bundle of bats for you! These are Pallid Bats, and they are really awesome. They will swoop down to the ground and eat all the crickets and scorpions and then they'll soar right on out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were lookin' fer somethin' to rid me of these blasted crickets. Now be gone wit's ya!

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm on it!
Of course! I've got the solution right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll be keelhauling ye now, ye vermin! Now me place be swarming with scorpions, too!

replies.reply_text: Yikes! Mad Pirate! Run for your lives!
This wasn't supposed to happen quite this way. I thought if we gave them some time? No, I see that isn't a good idea. Let me make it up to you. I'll find a way to get rid of the scorpions.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye best be doin' it quickly!

replies.reply_text: Faster than you can say skedaddle! I promise to make this right.
Uggg...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye got any more brilliant ideas, Matey?

replies.reply_text: Yes! How about I ask around Horse Isle and see if anyone knows how to get rid of the scorpions?
Looks like I'm fresh out. And by the way, I am sooo outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye again! Lookin' to be keelhauled?

replies.reply_text: No, no. I was doing something for you. I was wondering if you could remind me?
I think I've got the solution to your problem!
I'm back to take care of the scorpion problem!
Not at all. I was doing something for you. Could you remind me what it was?
No thank you. I was just checking to see how the bats did. After they ate all the bugs, they should have flown off.  I wanted to make sure you weren't worried about them hanging around.
You really need a change of attitude! Lighten up a bit! And since you aren't smiling at that, I'm getting out of here!
I know several people who know about bugs. I'll be back as soon as I can.
I hear you loud and clear! I'll be back as soon as I possibly can.
Ouch...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye best not be sayin' that blasted cap'n's name again!

replies.reply_text: Apologies, Ma'am. It won't happen again. You were telling me about the crickets swarming this place?
You know, I think I'll just leave now. You have a nice day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! Ye were goin' ta find somethin' to take care of dem nasty scorpions ye dumped all over me floor!

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I'm on it like flies on stink!  Back to Kirby I go!
Ah yes! And I have just the thing to take care of them, AND the crickets!

chatpoints.chat_text: I ain't the one with a need to worry, Matey! However, bein' as ye was kind enough to deliver on ye offer to rid me of them crickets, I be bound to tell you all the critters be gone. And them bats, too. A shame. Seems I be missin' them a bit. But only a bit!

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! I'm glad to hear it. Does this mean you are sleeping well again?
I wasn't worried. Not me. Not afraid of pirates at all. At least, not most times! Glad the bats took care of the problem. See ya later!
Shoot! I was hoping to see them in action. Oh well! I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sleepin' well enough, Matey! Well enough to be wantin' to give ye a reward!

replies.reply_text: And I would be thrilled to accept one!
Thanks so much! Enjoy your sleep.
No problem. I'll be back in a little bit.

npc_list.name: Elvira
npc_list.admin_description: Req to see 2142
npc_list.long_description: The black widow has a deadly appearance that extends beyond the red hourglass. Unlike her hairy cousins, she is glossy black. Her legs end in sharp points that look like they could pierce on contact.

chatpoints.chat_text: My, my. A fine looking morsel - I mean mortal - has come to my parlor. Here for a bite? Or merely a visit?

replies.reply_text: No thank you. I'm not hungry, but I would like to visit with you for just a bit.
Yikes! A talking spider! Run away!
I was supposed to do something for you. Can you remind me?
I'm back!
Just a quick visit. I'm wondering if you can tell me anything about Elphiblah, a wicked witch?
Just a quick visit. I'm hoping I can get a skein of spider's silk from you.
Merely a visit. I need a reminder of what it was you wanted for a skein of spider's silk.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on, just one teensy little bite? I am quite the master at tenderizing protein. Actually, I coined the phrase "melt-in-your-mouth."

replies.reply_text: That's the kind of thing that worries me... Hey. What's with the messy web? I thought spiders were supposed to weave works of art.
A bite? Ha ha. Not on your life! I'm gone like yesterday's sunrise!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to catch a meal, not impress art connoisseurs. Why should I waste my energy on creating something of delicate beauty only to have it ripped to shreds by some lowly bug in their futile attempt to escape me?

replies.reply_text: I see your point. Speaking of which, my point in coming here was to ask about your silk. I heard you spin the finest silk in the land.
I can't believe I'm still talking to a spider. I am so outta here.
That's an excellent point. I'm wondering if you can tell me anything about Elphiblah, a wicked witch?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, the flattery! But every bit true. I spin the most extraordinary, absolutely exquisite spider silk.  It's the strongest silk spun by any spider out there.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I'm impressed. That must be why hummingbirds love using it for their nests.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, those pesky creatures. Always zipping in and about, stealing threads of my webbing. Is that what they are using it for?

replies.reply_text: Evidently. So, do you have some you could spare?

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose so. For a favor, of course.

replies.reply_text: Why am I not surprised?  This is like a never-ending quest. Okay, what's the favor you need?
Forget it! This is way too much trouble.

chatpoints.chat_text: I want to host a tea party. I'd like you to deliver invitations to Morticia and Carlotta.

replies.reply_text: Are you serious? A tea party?
Ha ha. Right. A spider tea party? This has to be a joke. I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elvira glares at you.) DEADLY serious.

replies.reply_text: (You swallow hard.) Okay. No problem. Sure, I'll do that.
I'll get these delivered and return as quickly as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: So tell me already! What's the news?

replies.reply_text: I delivered the invitations. They both said they'll come.
I delivered Carlotta's. She agreed to come.
I delivered Morticia's. She said she'll be there.
Whew! Thanks so much. I hope I don't have to bother you again for a long time.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what about the other invitation?

replies.reply_text: I'll get right to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: The tea party invitations? You were going to deliver them. Ring a bell?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes. I'll get right to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Elphiblah? The Wicked Witch? That witch? I know that she thinks she is all that and a bag of potato chips. Pah! She is nothing. I could take her down in seven spins of my webbing! Then I would sink my fangs into her warty hide! But, since she is not here, might I have a small bite of you?

replies.reply_text: No. You can't bite me. That's so rude! Can you just tell me where I can find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll have to talk to my sister. She moved to some small isle southwest of her. Good luck! She's a scary one.

replies.reply_text: She's scary? Wow. For you to say that is really something! Thank you and I'll get out of your lair now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my. You ask a lot. Do you know how much effort it would take for me to spin you a skein's worth? Hmmm. Let me think. What would make it worthwhile for me? I know! I need decorations for the upcoming holidays!

replies.reply_text: Upcoming holiday?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Of course! The most wonderful of holidays is about to descend upon us. International Day of Latrodectus. We celebrate this for over a full week.
The first day there are spinning contests. I've won first place more than once!
The second day celebrates red bellies and red backs. Check out my most awesome red hourglass!
Day three is all about the number eight - in respect of our awesome and lethal looking legs.
On the fourth day, we compete in the Synchronized Weaving competitions. The choreography is utterly amazing!
Day five we admire each other’s web design complexity and beauty.
Day six is recipe swap and web-catch cook-off.
And day seven is all about gratitude.

replies.reply_text: Wow. That sounds like a really big deal. I had no clue spiders even had celebrations.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well DUH! It IS a big deal! And yes, even spiders have celebrations - which is what I'll need decorations for. I'll need two dozen pinches of pixie dust and one dozen silver linings. Bring me those and you'll get your skein. Deal?

replies.reply_text: Really? You want that much? Gesh! Fine. I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Two dozen pinches of pixie dust and 1 dozen silver linings.

replies.reply_text: Well that's going to take me awhile! I don't know when I'll be back.
Perfect! Looky here - look here! I've got just what you asked for.
I'll treat it with the respect it deserves! Thank you.

npc_list.name: Ginger Craft
npc_list.long_description: Ginger is responsible for most of the stock feed made on Horse Isle, skilled at all sorts of feed manufacture.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No, not today thanks. Bye!
Yes, Rusty Cage on Cat Isle is out of cat treats. Can I please have some to take to him?
Well, I was wondering if there was anything I can do for you today?
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with your new feed scoops, Ginger!
Good day to you!  I'm trying to track down a Miss Knight.  Iona in Flipperton said you were a relation?
What was it you wanted from me again?
I'm back with the honeycombs.
Thank you.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hrm.  Now that you mention it, I really need some new scoops for all of the treat bins.  Do you think you could get some made for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that for you!  I have nothing else going on at the moment.  Where would I find someone who makes scoops?
On second thought, maybe I'll come back later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: These scoops came from Smiddy Jones a long time ago.  I wonder if he could make me some more durable ones?  These were the perfect size, but I just need a bigger handle.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over to him and see what he can do for you.  How's that?
No way.  I think you should keep using the old ones.  They work just fine!
Sure thing!  I'll be back as soon as possible!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to ask Smiddy Jones in Tropicton to make me some new feed scoops for the feed bins.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  Thanks for reminding me and I'll be back soon!
I'm glad you like them and thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ginger's previously cheerful demeanor suddenly turns to such a fury that her face turns a deep red.) What does she want with her?

replies.reply_text: I don't mean to get into a family quarrel, I'm just looking for an address.
I'm sorry, did I say something offensive?
Perhaps I'd better just leave.  Forget I was ever here.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, if you must know, you did.  You brought up the name of my sister, that's what!  Now do you want to buy something, or do you want to leave?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry!  I only want to know where she lives now.
Never mind. I'll tell Phyllis she'll have to find that foal on her own.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did she do it to you, too?

replies.reply_text: Do... what?  No, I'm here on behalf of Phyllis Colt, who adopted a filly to her and Phyllis would like to know how it's getting on.
Oh, I sense a juicy story here!
Never mind.  I think I'll just go home and curl up with a good book.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well you're not getting it!

replies.reply_text: Fine, can you just give me an address for her if you have one?
Please?  It's not for me, it's for Phyllis Colt in Hotton.

chatpoints.chat_text: What foal?

replies.reply_text: The one she got from Phyllis Colt in Hotton.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ginger takes a deep breath and some of the flaming color leaves her cheeks.) All right. I'll dig that address out for you, but you're going to have to make it worth my while!

replies.reply_text: All right, what do you want me to do?
Honestly, the next time someone wants me to do them something, remind me to beat myself soundly with large theropod.  What is it you want?
Gladly.  What do you want?
Oh no.  I'm not fond of bees myself, but I'll see what I can do.
Sure, I can do that.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I... don't remember.  Who are you, exactly?

replies.reply_text: I want the address of--

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  I remember you now.  Ten honeycombs is what I wanted.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'm on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (There are other customers in the store this time, so Ginger tries mightily to retain a cheery demeanor. She appears to be trying rather too hard!) Oh, thank you! Thank you very much. One moment please while I get that information for you.

replies.reply_text: Here you are! (Lay out what you found on the counter.)
Thank you.  Goodbye.
Thanks.  You know... are you sure you don't want to talk about it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe someday. If you get the password. (Once again, she becomes overly cheerful.) Goodbye! Enjoy!

replies.reply_text: Password... right. I'll see you!

npc_list.name: Just Gus
npc_list.admin_description: No new quests on this ID
npc_list.long_description: Just Gus, part-time lighthouse keeper, part-time pirate, obsessively polishes the Fresnel Lens to ensure the light shines as far out into the sea as possible.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Ello, Matey. Suppose ye be just a looky-lou? Just passin' through? Just no time to visit an old sea dog?

replies.reply_text: Uhh. No, I could stop for a quick visit.
You got it! Just passing through! Later gator!
Hi, it's just me. Was there something I said I'd do for you?
It's just me, again! And I have just the thing to make you smile. (Yikes! You're starting to sound like Just Gus.)
I was in the area, and thought I'd ask if you need any quick favors? Nothing long and involved, please! My brain needs a break, but I need some money.
Sorry to disturb you, but Crow's Nest Carrie wanted to ask you about your hobbies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Argg! Ye just made me day, ya did! Pull up a keg and just plant yer breeches for just a bit.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. So, umm, is there anything I can do for you? Besides visit? I mean, like run an errand or something? I'm looking for ways to make some money.
Gosh. Look at the time! Maybe next time. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: If it be loot ye be lookin' fer, just I can't be helpin' ya none. But if ye be willin' to trade for just a bit of glitter, there be sometin' I gots in mind.  I just got me a fierce itchin' for a taste of me dear mum's strawberry pie. She be long dead and gone, but that just don't stop me belly's itchin'.

replies.reply_text: Strawberry pie, you say? I know someone who makes those. I could get one for you.
Oh man! I was hoping you'd ask for something I could do without island-hopping. I'll check back at another time.
Hmm. I'm sure I can find someone to make a strawberry pie for you.
I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just a looky-lou? Just passing through. Oh! It be you!

replies.reply_text: Just me, swinging by to say hi! And bye!
Yup, its me! How'd you like the pie?
I'm back. You were telling me about Michelle?
Hi Gus. I changed my mind about helping you. You said something about delivering a letter to Michelle?
Hey Gus. Can you remind me of what I was supposed to do for you?
I think I'm making some progress on the search for Michelle. I've got a letter for you.

Yes, it be me! And I've got a message for you. (You quickly explain that you need to know what Gus said to Michelle the first time they met.) I really think this Davisse gal will spill the beans, if you know what I mean!
I'm back to hear your sad story! Look, I'm taking a seat and now I'm all ears!
What was I doing for you?
Thanks so much. Enjoy the pie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Blow me over! Ye'd be a fine salty dog to do such a thing.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to do that for you. I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Gus sighs and hangs his head.) It filled me belly, that it did. It was JUST like me dear old mum's, it was. That be the problem, Matey. Just one bite and a barrel full of memories like to rip me old ticker to shreds.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! Sounds like there's a painful story to be told. I'd be happy to listen.
That's my cue to say goodbye. So, goodbye!
Just like your dear old mum's, huh? That's fantastic. So, kind of like -- so good it hurts, huh? Want to tell me about it?
I'm so sure that this is leading to another quest, I'm going to leave right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye said ye'd be getting me a strawberry pie. Just like me mum's. Ye ain't tryin' to mess wit' me, are ya Matey?

replies.reply_text: No, of course not. I said I would get it. I just forgot. I'll go do that now.
You got it! I'm outta here.
Oh, that's right! I've got it right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Just Gus starts pacing the floor -- back and forth, back and forth. Finally, he swallows hard.) 'Tis all on account of this here lass -- Michelle be her name. There be just a bit of a misunderstandin'. About me mum's pie and sometin' special I hid inside.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, not a another lost love! I've got a change of heart. So sorry!  I'm outta here.
Oh, let me guess! You hid a diamond ring inside, and you were going to ask Michelle to marry you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye daft? A ring could get caught in the riggin's and just rip her finger clean off when the sails are raised. I put me finest gem inside. Sometin' any pirate worth her salt should fancy.

replies.reply_text: I guess the gem-in-pie didn't exactly charm the socks off of her, huh?
Gems in pies would never be a good thing....  Too hard.  I think I should be going now.
I'm guessing she wasn't using a fork. I can just imagine how a pirate eats a pie, but it shouldn't have been too much of a problem, right?
This sounds like the start of a story that can't turn out any way but bad. I think I'll head out now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arggg! The lass bit into me mum's pie, bit the gem and broke a tooth!  Her yellin' was so loud I couldn't hear for a right long time! The lass ain't spoke to me since.

replies.reply_text: So, you need to make amends? Make it up to her?
Sorry, but I'm not gonna mess with someone like her. You're on your own!
I'm a bit hesitant to say this, but I don't exactly blame her. Sounds like you owe her one HUGE apology.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, Matey. Ye got that right. Me brain ain't got no ideas. Can ye help an old sailer, Matey?

replies.reply_text: I sure can! I'm really good at helping people out, finding missing things, solving puzzles. All that kind of stuff. So you can just count me in!
Nope. Sorry. If I think of any, I'll come back and let you know.
Of course I can. I can usually think of all kinds of ideas. Assuming you make it worth my while, that is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Scurvy dog! Ye haven't delivered that letter yet?

replies.reply_text: Oops! I'll do that right now.
Nope. Maybe you can find someone else to do that? I've got way too much to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ya was goin' to try to find me beauty, Michelle. Sometin' about asking at the libraries, or some such thing.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right! I'll be back soon!
And that's exactly where I checked for her. While I didn't find her, I did find someone who seems to know her. I've got a letter for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: She be one of the finest riggers I ever set me eyes on. Like a monkey that one! Swinging from one halyard to the next, fixin' fouled rigs and sailings along the way.

replies.reply_text: This isn't helpful. I'm outta here.
Hmmm. I'm not sure that's going to be enough to help me. What does she like?
Okay, I'm writing this down. Monkey-like. Good rigger. What kind of things do you think she'd like?

chatpoints.chat_text: What any sea-loving dog likes! A steady wind at yer back, a safe passage past Davy's locker, and treasure come sundown.

replies.reply_text: (Sigh!) Let me ask this a different way. Let's start with where she lives now. So I know where to find her.
Right. Sounds like any pirate. So, what does she like to do for entertainment?
Come on, Gus. Work with me here. Tell me something personal about her. Something that will help me know her better.
Sounds like she's probably sailing the seven seas. I just don't have time for that. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: ( Gus hangs his head. ) Yer guess is as good as mine, and I ain't no good at guessin'.

replies.reply_text: Great! That's no help at all. Can you give me any clue where she might be hanging around? What are her hobbies? Does she like music?
Arrrrgggg! This is just too much trouble. I'm so gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: The lass loved a good swash-bucklin' tale.

replies.reply_text: Stories? I bet she likes books, too! What a great start! I'll check with all the librarians. If they've seen her, we'll know which island to look for her on. I'll be back!
Oh, darn. I didn't realize the time. Look, I'm really sorry. I'll have to come back and listen some other day. Bye!
Okay, tell me about your problem. I'm all ears.
Sure. Why not? A letter to Michelle?
Seriously? I'd rather not. If I get all my chores done, and I've got time on my hands, I just might be able to do that for you. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye are daft, ain't ya? I ain't got no clue where the lass is. That's why I needs ya to deliver me a letter to someone who knows where Michelle is!

replies.reply_text: Yikes! You don't need to bite my head off. Hand it over, tell me who you want it delivered to, and I'll be on my way.
I think its daft of you to keep trying! I'm gone!
No, I am NOT daft! Sounds like somebody woke up on the wrong side of the bed. Gesh! So give me the letter already!
Willamena, eh? I'm on my way. Hey, that rhymes! Later!
Hi, ho! Hi, ho! It's off to search I go....

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye, now? Ye best be giving me good news. Me old ticker can't be taking much more of the bad.

replies.reply_text: Good news? Yikes. Let me go see if I can find some for you.
First things first. Tell me a little about her.
Whoa! Hold your horses. We haven't found her yet. Soon as we do, we'll figure out the perfect way for you to apologize. Now, tell me all about her.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Just Gus paces. To and fro, to and fro. Finally, he stops and kneels before a large pirate's chest. He digs through it, and finally, and very tenderly, pulls out a large compass.) A beauty fine as me ticker's desire deserves sometin' jus' as special. I had this engraved. Jus' ne'er had a chance ta give it to 'er. Ye kin take' this to that woman.

replies.reply_text: (The back of the compass says: "Piratin' wit' a wench such as yerself be worse'n bein' keelhauled" ) Jesh, Gus! These sound like fighting words. But if this is what you said, then I'll take it to Davisse.
Yikes! This thing must be worth a fortune. You know, I don't want to be responsible for it. Sorry! You'll have to find someone else to finish this. I'm leaving.
Aye, aye, Matey. As "smartly" as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: Who be darkenin' me door? Just a ghost of memories past? Or a body come lookin' fer trouble? Hey! It be you! Ye find me beauty yet?

replies.reply_text: It be me, indeed! And yes, I have found her!
Hey Gus. What was I doing for you again?
Yup! Booooo. BooooOOOOooooo! Scary enough for you? Later, Gus!
I'm back Gus, with terrific news! The roses and necklace did it. Michelle has forgiven you, and all is well!
Refresh my memory, please. What was I doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Bless me lucky stars!

replies.reply_text: Don't be getting too excited just yet. She's not hiding anymore, but she's not ready to forgive you, either.
Lucky for you, lucky for me. I actually saw a tiny bit of a smile. So I'll just leave you to talk to her now.
Lucky stars? Hey, I'm the one that's done all the work here. I should get some of the credit! But, before you get too excited, she's still not happy with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Argggg! She be rippin' me ticker to shreds. What's a poor fellow to do?

replies.reply_text: I've been thinking about this. I know she's a pirate and all that. And great at rigging a ship, but she's still a girl, if you know what I mean. And they like flowers and they like jewelry.
I don't know, and at this point, I'm just too tired to care. I'll come back and help you some other day. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just what ye be sayin', mate? Any pirate worth 'es salt gots booty full of jewelry.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she's worth her salt and all that, but it isn't the same as getting, say... a diamond necklace from you. Oh, and I'd throw in a dozen red roses for good measure. They really like that sorta thing.
Well, yes. But wenches are sentimental creatures. I'm telling you, it has to come from you.
You're right. She isn't worth the trouble. Time to get yourself a new beauty. There are plenty out there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arggg! Ain't none as fine as me beauty! And iffin ye don't be wantin' to spend the night with Davy Jones, ye won't be saying different.

replies.reply_text: Sorry! Just an idea. Obviously, a really BAD idea. Okay, back to Michelle, then. What I think you need to do is send her a dozen red roses and a diamond necklace. That just might do the trick. I'd be happy to take them to her.
No, and that's the exact reason why I'm heading off this island and doing something a lot safer than talking to a pirate! I be gone!
I appreciate that. And thanks for the reward. Have a super terrific day!
I'm sure these will do the trick! See ya later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy, Matey. How be ye?

replies.reply_text: Fine, just fine. Thought I'd stop by and say hi. So, hi! And now, bye!
You sure look cheery! I'll leave you to your happy thoughts.
Sorry to disturb you, but Crow's Nest Carrie wanted to ask you about your hobbies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Arggg! Ye bilge rat. Ye ain't delivered them roses and necklace ta me beauty Michelle yet? Be gone, aready!

replies.reply_text: I'm already on my way. See? My feet are moving!
Oh, I did! I did, indeed! And they did the trick. She loved them!

chatpoints.chat_text: A diamond necklace? From me? And roses? (Just Gus sighes heavily.) I ain't got no clue about wenches, evidently! Could ye take them things to her?

replies.reply_text: Of course. I can just feel in my bones that this is almost finished!
Arrggg! Please let this be the last trip I have to make!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arggg! Ye bilge rat.  Ye was deliverin' the compass to me Michelle!

replies.reply_text: Oh right.  I'll get that to her now.
Okay, I get it. (Loudly in case someone might be listening.) I'm going. Sorry I bothered you.
I'm sorry, I thought you were feeling better lately. Bye! (You wink and give the OK signal and then leave.)

npc_list.name: Just Gus
npc_list.long_description: Just Gus, part-time lighthouse keeper, part-time pirate, obsessively polishes the Fresnel Lens to ensure the light shines as far out into the sea as possible.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who be darkenin' me door? Just a ghost of memories past? Or a body come lookin' fer trouble? Hey! It be you! How be ye?

replies.reply_text: I'm good. Just passing through and wanted to see how you were doing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Doin' as best as can be 'spected. Under the conditions, o' course!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! I've come, I've seen, and now I'm saying good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to the Appleton Library.  Can I help you find anything today?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I think I know my way around.
Can you please tell me how best to use the library?
I was just curious, what do you do with the books you no longer want?
I'm sorry to bother you again, but who did you sell those books to?
Excuse me, by any chance, have you heard of someone named Michelle?
Hello.  I have Max Attire's library card here; he asked me to get a copy of "Our Friend, the Fruit Bat" for him.  Can you help me?
Yes, actually.  I was wondering if you could tell me who that author of the fruit bat book was?
Possibly. I found a very odd key that has a bit of colorful scarf attached to it. I have no clue what to do with it and I thought you might have some suggestions.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Between the library and City Hall, you can find out just about anything you'd like to know about all kinds of things on Horse Isle.  Is there anything in particular you'd like to know?

replies.reply_text: What can I find out about horses?
What information do you have on tack and companions?
Do you have information on places and how to get to them?
People seem to win awards right and left here!  Do you have information on what it takes to win these awards?
There are lots of minigames around here.  Do you have a catalog of them so I can find some I'd like to play?
What kind of books do you have here in the library?
Thanks, I think I know my way around.

chatpoints.chat_text: By clicking "Research Horses: VIEW BREEDS", you can see not only every breed of horse that roams Horse Isle, but also every color that breed is found in here.  You'll also find out about breed history and statistics.  Most breeds are found on the open grasslands, but some are not, and the library will tell you where to look for them if that is the case.  Is there anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: The "VIEW TACK" button will show you all the tack available from the various tack shops on Horse Isle.  You'll see what everything looks like, and what advantages it has for you and your horses.  The "View Companions" button works the same way. Anything else?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
Yes, I'd like to know more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  By clicking "VIEW LOCATIONS", you can see a short description of every island and town.  We don't have information on how to get to every island, but someone who lives close by surely will.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.
I'd like to ask something else, if you don't mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly!  Click "VIEW AWARDS" and you will see a list of all the awards available on Horse Isle, and what you need to do to earn them.  Anything else you'd like to know?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
Yes, there is something else I'd like to ask.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, no, I'm afraid all we have is maps of where the mini-games are, under "VIEW MINIGAMES".  Does that help?

replies.reply_text: Sort of.  Thanks.
Yes.  May I ask something else?

chatpoints.chat_text: All kinds!  Fiction, local history, and lots of horse stories!  Click "READ BOOKS" to see a list of books we currently have.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks!  Horse stories are my favorite.
That's a nice selection.  Can I ask you something more?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, I told you to speak to Pheobe Wares at the Shellton General Store.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  Sorry to have bothered you, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.  Doesn't sound familiar. Sorry!

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I don't think you want the library.  I think you must be looking for Higgins' house.  It's just next door.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I see Laurence still follows his idol, T.E. Lawrence. Let me see what I can find. One moment, please. (She goes into her office and returns with a book and a piece of paper.) Here you go.

replies.reply_text: Okay, but what do I do with these?
Wow!  He'll like this book.  These instructions look pretty simple, too.  Thanks!  By the way, do you know where I could get some new material for his turban?

chatpoints.chat_text: Gee, Barb is really too busy right now, but I've heard that Albert Junker over on Hoof Isle carries just about everything.  Why don't you ask him?

replies.reply_text: I'll go see Albert.  Thanks again for everything.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's no bother.  I said you should try Albert Junker on Hoof Isle.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  Hoof Isle.  I'm on my way.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I knew he'd want this book. It has tons of beautiful photographs and amazing information on clouds. Let me get it for you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much. I know he'll be thrilled.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You hold up the odd key with the colorful bit of scarf attached.) Well isn't that the oddest looking key I've ever seen! I'm so sorry, I can't begin to tell you what to do.
