replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Mortimer
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 15
npc_list.long_description: Mortimer is getting on in years now, but there is still something of the Class Clown in him.  He acts crusty and sullen, but there's mischief in there somewhere!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Who are you?  Hello.  Who are you, and why are you here?  Eh?  Speak up!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, didn't mean to bother you, I'll just... go now, okay?  Bye.
HI THERE!
Hi there... Could you tell me again where I'm supposed to bury this treasure chest?
Uhm... Mortimer, old chum, I went to bury your treasure like you told me, but this giant clam named Pearl was there, and she got it and won't give it back.
I'm sorry, I tried.  Pearl the Geoduck took your treasure and disappeared with it.
Special delivery from the Pony Express!
Hi Mortimer.  I'm trying to find Archy for his wife and Murray said he came by to visit.  Is he still here?
Mortimer, I forgot where you said Archy went after you two finished your editorial work.

chatpoints.chat_text: I said speak up, not yell!  I'm old and grumpy, not deaf!  Well, not yet, anyway, at least I don't think I'm deaf yet.  What are you doing here?  Come to make more work for me, I'll bet.

replies.reply_text: Well!  If you're going to be that way, I'm just going to leave.  Goodbye.
Oh, sorry.  Well, actually, I was looking around for people who might have small jobs I could do for them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  WHAT?

replies.reply_text: I SAID, (You speak slowly and very clearly.) I'm looking for small jobs. Have you got any I can do?
Oh, nevermind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Awww, now you don't have to talk baby talk to me!  I'm not deaf!  And I sure ain't young!  Just speak up.  Jobs, eh?  Hmmm, jobs, jobs..... AH!  You can help me with my treasure!

replies.reply_text: Treasure!  You want me to dig up a treasure?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dig up a treasure?!  Hah!  No, dag-nabbit, I don't want you to dig up a treasure, I want you to BURY a treasure for me!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Okay, I guess I can do that.  What do you need buried?  And where shall I bury it?
Well, if it's not digging one up, then nevermind.  Have fun burying one!  Bye.
I'm on my way, I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, in the ground would be nice!  Hee hee hee hee heee!

replies.reply_text: Very funny.  Aww, come on, where exactly?

chatpoints.chat_text: You mean you didn't try?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, no.
I tried, but I couldn't find just the right spot.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, dag-nabbit, now you listen to me!  I want you to go to the south-east arm of Starfish Isle, right?  Now you go south east as far as you can go, right?  And that's where you bury my treasure, and come back when you're done!  Get it?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'm going.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Clam?  Clam?  Named Pearl?  A clam named Pearl!  Well, honestly!  A clam named Pearl!  Go get my treasure back and bury it somewhere else!

replies.reply_text: No way!  I'm not touching that thing, it's.... slimy!
Not me, chum, I'm not touching that thing, it's.... gross!
Not a chance!  I'm not touching a clam, it's treyf!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't care if you touch a clam or not, just get back my treasure and bury it somewhere else!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right, I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Disappeared with it?  Awwwwwww, rats!  Awww, nuts, gosh darn it!  You couldn't get it back?

replies.reply_text: No, sorry.  I'm not jumping down a clam hole.  Just the... smell.... I mean!  Honestly, I tried.
I tried, really.  But... just.... sorry, I don't do clams.  I'm sorry your treasure was lost but... oh well. Sorry.
Thanks a lot, Mortimer!  I'll come see you again some time.
Thanks, Mortimer.  Say.... what was in that treasure chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hee hee hee!  You really want to know?

replies.reply_text: Nah, forget it.  Bye!
Yeah!  Please tell me!  What was in the chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hee hee hee HEE HEE! (Mortimer leans over and whispers in your ear.) Oyster crackers! Hee hee hee hee heee!

replies.reply_text: Riiiiiiiight.... Okay.  Well, bye, Mortimer, see you some other time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if it isn't my friend the clam digger!  How be you these days?

replies.reply_text: I'm good. Just passing through!  See ya!
Special delivery from the Pony Express!
I'm fine thanks. Murray said that Archy was on his way to see you.  Is he still here?
Mortimer, I forgot where you said Archy went after you two finished your editorial work.
I'm good. Hope you are too. I'm wondering if you might know someone by the name of Patience?
You're welcome!  Wait... Was that a good thing you called me?  Nevermind, I'll look it up.

chatpoints.chat_text: He was here, we discussed the next issue of "Caretaker Digest".  He mentioned he had to head off to Tropicton next.

replies.reply_text: Well there aren't many more items on his list, so hopefully I'll catch him soon!  Thanks for the tip, Mortimer.

chatpoints.chat_text: When we were finished, he went on to Tropicton.

replies.reply_text: Tropicton?  Ah, for the hay!  Thanks Mortimer. Catch you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Such a dear! Passed through a while back. I do wish she'd come back for a visit.

replies.reply_text: Do you know where she was headed?

chatpoints.chat_text: Beheaded, you say? Dear no! Her head was perfectly attached.

replies.reply_text: No, no. I asked if you know where she was HEADED.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for speaking up. These hearing aids don't work as well as good ears do! Now what did you want?

replies.reply_text: Can you PLEASE tell me where your niece was going to after she LEFT HERE?

chatpoints.chat_text: She left no deer here. Didn't leave an animal of any kind.

replies.reply_text: UGH! WHERE can I find find PATIENCE?

chatpoints.chat_text: Patience? You're looking for Patience? She said something about wishing on a unicorn. Such an imaginative one, she is!

replies.reply_text: Wishing on a unicorn? I think that's the best I'm going to get from you. Time to discuss this with Dumpty. Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do indeed! My lovely, lovely niece. Do you know her?

replies.reply_text: Not really, but I am trying to find her for a friend. Is she here?

npc_list.name: Pearl
npc_list.admin_description: Pearl on Mortimer's quest
npc_list.long_description: A very large clam with a long neck.

chatpoints.chat_text: For MMEEEEEE? Oooo! Treasure! Oooo, I do ssooooooo love treasure! Ooooo! Mine, mine, mine!

replies.reply_text: Fine, have it!  So long as it gets buried, I'm happy.  Bye!
HEY!  Give that back, that's Mortimer's!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you nuts?  You dug into my den and put a treasure in!  You gave it to me, it's mine.  Mine, mine, mine!  HA HA HA HA HAAAAA!! MIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIINE!

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe, but I'd better tell Mortimer you've got it.
No!  Give it back!

npc_list.name: Bess
npc_list.long_description: Bess looks just as dusty and ramshackle as her boat- until she gives you a big ol' grin!

chatpoints.chat_text: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz......

replies.reply_text: Uhm... hello?
I think I'll just tiptoe out of here.  Not the kind of person I'd like to wake from a nap...
Psst... Bess! Hey Bess! Delivery- it's a pony from Mona!
Excuse me (Gently nudging Bess) Do you know where I can find a woodworker on Jungle Island?
Pardon me, sorry to disturb you.  I'm trying to find a metalworker on Jungle Island, any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: ZZZZZZZZZ....... snorgle!  Oh.  What?

replies.reply_text: Hi, sorry to wake you, but I wanted to ask you about service from this harbor.
Nothing, nothing, I'll be going.
I have a package for you from the Pony Express?
Umm, hi.  I was just wondering if you needed anything.  Help, or something like that.
Sorry to bug you again, but what was I doing for you?
Here's your pillow!
A woodworker, I need to find a woodworker who lives on Jungle Island.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Okay.

replies.reply_text: Forget it.
Ooooo-kaaaaay, where does the boat go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Where? (Points northwest.) Over there.

replies.reply_text: To Jungle Isle?  Oh, you go to Tropicton, then.
Oh, well, I don't want to go to Jungle Isle anyway.  Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tropicton? Nah. Much too far. Just go to my own dock. Saves time. Nice short trip. (YAWN!)

replies.reply_text: Aww, come on, can't you go to Tropicton? I mean, it's a long way to walk from south Jungle to Tropicton!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, oh!  What are we?  Are we too lazy to walk all that way?  Oh, oh, oh!   Tsk!  Well, look.  I go where I go.  You want to go there, I'll take you.  You don't want to go there, that's fine.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, thanks for the information.  Bye.
Umm... Thanks.  Sleep well, I guess.
Wow, it's going to be one of a kind! I bet she'll love it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not to be woken up would be the best help!

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry about that.  I'll just leave you be then.
With all this sleeping, don't you lose customers?

chatpoints.chat_text: I doubt it. If someone wants to go that direction, this is the shortest route. (Yawn!) I get plenty of customers.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Well, I'll let you get back to sleep.  Bye!
Well, since you're so sure that sleeping doesn't hinder your business, would you like something to make your rest more comfortable?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I have been using my jacket as a pillow.  A real pillow would be much better.  Maybe even a feather pillow!

replies.reply_text: That's ridiculous.  I'm sorry I asked.
Sure, that could be nice.  I suppose I could have one made up for you.
I'll get right on that.  Bye!
Any idea on who would make a pillow like that for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: How should I know?  You're the one that wanted a job so bad that you woke me up!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay.  Sorry.  I'll figure it out myself.

chatpoints.chat_text: You said you were going to get a small pillow made for me.  It needs to be waterproof and the filling should be feathers.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Bye!
Any idea on who would make a pillow like that for you?
Ummm..  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (With one eye open) Woodworker? Jungle? Ohhh, you want Xamba, west of Tropicton. (Closes her eye and she's back to sleep!)

replies.reply_text: Thanks, sorry I bothered you. (Tip toes out of the room.)

chatpoints.chat_text: If I answer your question, will you let me get back to my nap?

replies.reply_text: Most certainly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, you're looking for Inigo. west of Tropicton.  Now get out and let me sleep!!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  ummm...nighty night, don't let the bed bugs bite!

npc_list.name: Carlotta
npc_list.long_description: You can see a HUGE, hairy tarantula, resting in the shade of the skull.

chatpoints.chat_text: ¿Por qué? What would you want that for?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and how hummingbirds need it for their nests.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I do spin a little silk. Mostly for lining my casa. Makes my home more cozy, you know? But not enough to have any extra. I'm so sorry. Try my cousins near Santon.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Qué pasa? Who is disturbing my siesta?

replies.reply_text: I don't believe it -- a talking tarantula!
Hi there. I have an invitation from Elvira.
Meal delivery!
Say there! Would you have some spider's silk that I could have?
Aaaaahhhh!!!  Talking spider!!  Run away!!
Hey Carlotta, there's a new spider on Horse Isle.
I'm baaaccckkk! Will these scorpions do?
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back for that gift of scorpions. Is it ready?
I'm back, Carlotta! I gave Señor Cangrejo your gift!
Hello, Carlotta! Do you have any errands for me today?
Hello, Carlotta! Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back, and I've got something for you!
Hello, Carlotta! You know the stuff that I needed to forget about? Well, I think maybe you forgot something, too!
Hello, hello! I've checked the list and I'm sure I've given you everything on it.
So, you were saying you had something you needed me to do for you?
Hey Carlotta! I forgot to pick up my reward for your Fiesta Deliveries!
I'm back and I did it! I figured out who wanted what and I got all the drinks and snacks delivered!
Good day, Carlotta! How'd all that secret stuff work out for you?
Hey, Carlotta! Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Can you remind me what the drinks and snacks were?
I'm back, Carlotta. I delivered all of the piñatas and balloons.
Was there something I was doing for you?
Hey, Carlotta! Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back, Carlotta. I delivered all of the piñatas and balloons.
Between food, drink and travel, I'm going to have some expenses. I was wondering if you could give me something to help out?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye-chihuahua! What's with that? Everybody else gets to say whatever they want, but a tarantula can't talk? You've got talking horses, a talking clam, talking birds and who knows what all... Why can't a spider have something to say?

replies.reply_text: So sorry! You're right. I didn't mean to offend you, I was just surprised. Of course you can speak. Silly me.
Jesh! What a grump. I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! Tasty critters, si?

replies.reply_text: Disgusting! I don't eat them. I sell them.
How disgusting! I'm gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Si, silly you. So, what are you doing in my desert? Es muy calienta here! Very hot!

replies.reply_text: Very hot, indeed! I'm just wandering around, looking for lizards and scorpions.
You are right, it is hot here! I'm looking for a spider named Draculetta. You wouldn't happen to know where I could find this spider, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sell them? Fabulosa! What an idea!! Meals on heels -- or hooves. Whatever. So if I pay you, you'll bring me dinner?

replies.reply_text: Yes. I'd rather bring dinner than BE dinner! Sure. I'll do it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh, I don't trust Elvira. She's muy loco! Crazy in the cabeza. (The spider laughs hysterically at her little "inside joke".) So, give me this party invitation already.

replies.reply_text: Sure.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll give you a diamond for 25 scorpions.  Delivered fresh, of course.

replies.reply_text: Ummm...  I have another buyer that pays more...
Okay, I'll do it.
I will.
Thanks!
Wait, I have some more.
I'll tell her you'll be there. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Take it or leave it! That is my offer.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll do it.
I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye-chihuahua! More competition for food. Where does this spider live? How big?  How hungry? Aye yi-yiii. I must stock up now. I need scorpions. Hundreds and hundreds of scorpions.

replies.reply_text: Whoa, there! No need to panic. You are the only spider on Dust Isle! There's plenty of food for tons of spiders on the different islands here.
A hysterical tarantula! Run for your lives!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si? Is this so? Ah, my heart. Too much excitement is muy malo, VERY bad, for mi corizon. I was so worried there for a teensy bit.

replies.reply_text: So you don't know the new spider? Kind of hairy, big and definitely grumpy? Goes by the name of Señor Cangrejo. He was looking for a friend named Carlotta. I thought maybe he meant you?
Well, now that your heart has calmed down, I think I'll skedaddle!
Muy malo?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm. This does not ring a bell. Grumpy? And Hairy? Wait! When I was an itty bitty spider, there was a little hairy neighbor we called Cahngy. This must be Señor Cangrejo all grown up! Where are my manners! We must welcome him to the isles. Si?

replies.reply_text: Right.... this sounds like another quest to me. I am gone like yesterday's storm clouds! Adios!
Let me guess. You want me to take him a welcoming gift?
I hope his name means grumpy, because that's just what i'm feeling now! Grumpy and tired. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! You are so smart! Just a teensy tiny gift. No? I'm thinking a bundle of plump scorpions.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll help. I take it you want me to catch you some?
Nah, I think not. I'm really tired of tromping through the hot desert, looking for scorpions. Maybe some other day. See ya around!
Plump scorpions? That sounds disgusting! I'll pass.
One and a half dozen scorpions. I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Scorpions, for a welcoming gift, si? One and a half dozen, please.

replies.reply_text: Oh right! I've got them right here!
I'll go catch some right now.
I am too tired to catch scorpions today. Maybe I'll catch some tomorrow. Or the day after... or the day after that!
I'll be back in a few!
I'll be back shortly!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fabulosa! And he liked them, yes?

replies.reply_text: He was humbled and grateful! And he stopped being so grumpy!
Thanks! See ya around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! Very bad! Very bad for my heart!

replies.reply_text: You know what I'm thinking? I'm thinking all this questing is very bad for my mood! See ya!
Ohhh. Okay. Now I understand. So, you don't know this Señor Cangrejo? He mentioned a friend by the name of Carlotta.
Speaking of bad, if I don't go feed my horses, I'll end up chipping gravel on Prison Isle! Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! I need special things for es muy special day. Very special!

replies.reply_text: Let me guess. You are throwing a party?
Special things? You know, if I can't easily buy the thing at a store, I'm not interested. Good day.
Special day? Sounds like a party! Par-tee! Par-tee! Wait a minute. Spiders have parties? Ohhhh, creepy! I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do not ask! I cannot tell you! Es muy big surprise. You do this for me, no?

replies.reply_text: No. I mean yes. Si! I can get things, but how do I know what to get if you won't tell me?
If you can't tell me, I can't get anything for you. Sometimes, you have to be willing to trust people to help you. Until you think you can do that, I am afraid I'm of no use to you.
Well now, the big surprise from me to you is..... I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I write on paper. You keep secret, si? You peek to see, then go get me these things. Then you forget. No?

replies.reply_text: Si. I mean no. I mean, yes, I'll keep it a secret and then I'll pretend I never saw anything. Si?
Ugh! You confuse the daylights out of me! Just go ahead and keep your secret to yourself. I'm so gone.
After that bit of conversation, I think I need a nap!
I'm on my way and my lips are sealed!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were keeping a secret and getting me things, Si? You still have my list, no?

replies.reply_text: Yes. No. (Sigh.) Right. Thanks for reminding me. I've got the list right here. I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh, I am so excited! Show me, show me!

replies.reply_text: I've got your tissue paper and the colors are super festive!
I've got your balloons. You are gonna love them!
I've got your peppermint candies. They smell wonderful.
I've got your gum drops. They seem nice and fresh.
Whoa! My mistake. I'll be back when I have more.
I've got your marshmallows! Super fluffy and fresh!
I think I've given you everything that's everything on the list.
My lips are zipped!
But wait, I've got something else!
Your secret is safe with me!
But this is no secret, I've got something else for you!
I've already forgotten what I didn't remember!
Before I forget, I've got something else for you.
It was hard not eating them!
Take a whiff of this! I've got something else to give you!
Fantástico! Now I've already forgotten what not to remember!
Awesome! So, you were saying you had something you needed me to do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! But for this, you must be very brave and very adventurous! Do you think you are up to this?

replies.reply_text: Si! I am. I've done tons of quests. I've even been to the Cloud Isles.
I've been to Lava, and you have to be pretty adventurous to go there! I think I'm up to it!
I've been to Lava and Pirate, so I know I'm very adventurous!
Nope, no way. I am not feeling very adventurous today. Thanks anyway.
Thanks a ton! And I've already forgotten what you didn't want remembered.

chatpoints.chat_text: No! I forgot something?

replies.reply_text: Si! I hate to mention it, as it seems it would be bad manners to do so, however! That was a long quest, and I think I've more than earned some kind of reward.
They do! They make me think about making s'mores!
By the way, I've got something else for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: So far, so good! But I need your help again, my friend! You remember the tissue paper and balloons? Si?

replies.reply_text: Great. Another quest? I'll pass.
Tissue paper and balloons. Tissue paper and balloons. Seems like what I remember was that I was supposed to forget. So I think I'll just leave now and forget I was here!
Si! What can I do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I made piñatas from 7 of the balloons. This will be part of my birthday surprise for my nieces and nephews. I need one piñata and two balloons delivered to each one of them.

replies.reply_text: Why don't you just invite them all here?
I can see where this is leading. You want me to deliver the stuff, right? I think I'll just deliver myself right on out of here!
Oh, sure, I can do that. I just hope this isn't going to take too long. I'm getting hungry!
(You wrote everything she's told you about the preferences of her nieces and nephews. Now you just need to figure it all out!)

chatpoints.chat_text: This is their first birthday. They are much too young to travel. The desert can be a dangerous place. Even for spiders!

replies.reply_text: You know, I think the desert can be a dangerous place for me, too! I better head back to greener pastures.
I see. Okay, I'll do it.
Gosh. Would you look at the time? It is late and I've got to skedaddle! See ya.
Look all over the desert for skulls? Okay, I'll do just that!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were delivering the piñatas and balloons for me.

replies.reply_text: That's right! See you later!
Lucky me, I delivered them all!
Awesome! More diamonds. Thank YOU!
What? I thought I was done. I'll have to come back some other time.
What else did you need to have delivered?
Darn. Really? I think I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need the food and beverages bought and delivered, of course! You can't have a party without them. This will not be so easy.

replies.reply_text: Of course not. I'd be happy to help. How hard can it be?
Not easy?  I'll pass. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Pretty hard. To be honest, I cannot tell my nieces and nephews apart! They look identical. Worse, they all seem to like different things. I will tell you what I remember, si? And you will figure it out, no?

replies.reply_text: Si! No. I mean, yes, I can figure it out. I'm sure of it. Start talking!
Aye carumba! You confuse me! I have to go clear my mind.
No, I think I'll pass. Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were delivering drinks and desserts to all my nieces and nephews, si?

replies.reply_text: Si! I'll get right to it.
Can you remind me what the drinks and desserts were?
Oh gosh yes! I am so ready!
Two diamonds? That should do it! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fabuloso! Now I need the food and beverages bought and delivered. This will not be so easy, but you can't celebrate a birthday without them!

replies.reply_text: Of course not. I'd be happy to help. How hard can it be?
You know, I think I'm going to have to pass on this part. But I hope you have a great day anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! I remember milk, something really sugary, hot cocoa and cotton candy. Wait! I just remembered pudding! The rest you will have to figure out. That is why you wrote down all those notes. Si?

replies.reply_text: Right. I'm on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! I know this spider. Muy malo. Muy loco. Very scary. I don't know where she lives and I don't want to! Now! Did you bring me something to eat?

replies.reply_text: Darn. Nope, nothing for you to eat. Maybe next time.

npc_list.name: Morticia
npc_list.long_description: This brown, average looking spider doesn't appear nearly as scary as some other spiders. Talk about false advertising - this spider is bad news!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh. A visitor. Do come closer, darling. Closer..... closer....

replies.reply_text: Eeeek! A deadly spider. Run!
Ummm. I'm close enough. I just want to ask you something.

chatpoints.chat_text: Darling, don't stand so far back. It's dreadfully rude to shout. Oh, my! Are those your knees that are knocking? If you are uneasy being around me, why do you darken my doorway?

replies.reply_text: (You inch a tiny bit closer.) Umm, Elvira sent me. I have an invitation. For her te-te-tea party.
Ummm, I'm looking for spider silk. Would you happen to have any?
I changed my mind. I think I'll just go now.
I'll only darken it for a couple of seconds. Just please don't bite me! I need to know where I can find Draculetta.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dear, me. You have no idea how unlikely that is. Totally unlikely. Unless -- ah, yes. She's up to something devious, isn't she? Something dreadful and dastardly, no doubt. Do hand the invitation over... I'm practically drooling with anticipation.

replies.reply_text: Sure. Here you go.
I'll tell her you'll be there. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I have spider silk. Come ever so much closer and I'll show you. Nice warm silk that you can just wrap yourself in and get down right cozy. Just like a little bug in a rug.

replies.reply_text: I think I'm close enough. Really. And I don't want the silk for myself. No, no. Mino needs it for his hummingbird sanctuary.
You know, I'm already too close for comfort. I think I'll leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Interesting. Why ever would he need spider silk?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and how hummingbirds need it for their nests.)

chatpoints.chat_text: You should visit Elvira, darling. She mentioned hummingbirds had been stealing her silk. They don't seem to bother mine.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I guess I can do that. I guess she lives in a skull, too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course, of course. Are you sure you wouldn't rather stay here and visit with me for awhile? We could get to know each other....

replies.reply_text: Umm, thanks, but no thanks. I'll just run along now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh! That dreadful creature? Ask Elvira. She ought to know. They are sisters, after all!

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks. I guess.

npc_list.name: Admiral Leonard
npc_list.long_description: A retired Naval Admiral, sitting in the shade of a palm tree.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You see a character that seems like a high-ranking navy officer that is in full dress uniform) Ahoy! It's nice to see you.

replies.reply_text: Why, thank you Sir, I trust you are well on this fine day.
(You think to yourself "Who is this loony?") Goodbye. I'm going.
I'm back.  I think that this is what you are looking for.
Why, thank you Sir.  I trust you are well on this fine day.  I must keep going though.  Bye!
What was I doing for you again?
Ahoy!  You might just be the person who can help me, sir!  Would you know of a liniment that's good for chapped hands?
Ahoy, to you too, Admiral. I have a delivery for you and a hello from our Postmaster General.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh I'm enjoying this tropical climate.  I retired a little while ago and I just can't get used to civilian life.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have noticed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, the uniform. I have just come from a fellow Officer's retirement parade. It was a wonderful occasion. It is nice to be back in uniform too.

replies.reply_text: So you have had a long career in the Navy then?
Nice talking.  I'm going bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes.  I started as a young lad and worked my way up through the ranks. I have lots of stories to tell.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Like what?
I haven't the time to listen right now.  I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there was this time when I was in charge of the ship's starboard and port markers.  One day someone painted inside the lantern and it took me 3 days to work out what was wrong with it.  I laughed so hard when I finally worked it out.

replies.reply_text: That's funny.  Do you have any other stories like that?
Well that's interesting, but I have to go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I have many more to tell, but not right now.

replies.reply_text: Okay, is there anything I can do for you?
Thank you for sharing that with me, I'm off now.  See you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I seemed to have put down my sextant somewhere.  It may seem strange that I am carrying it around, but it was a family heirloom and I didn't want it to get stolen.

replies.reply_text: Any idea where you might have left it?
This sounds like it might take too long.  I'll drop by later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I was near some rocks around here. Can you go look for it for me?

replies.reply_text: I guess I could.  I'll go and look right now.
Not right now.  I'll come back and help some other time.
I'm glad to be of help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that is my sextant.

replies.reply_text: Well here you go. (You carefully hand over the obviously well-made instrument to the Admiral.)
Thank you, have a good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were helping me find my lost sextant that I left on some nearby rocks.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, I remember a balm that we used at sea. With a pleasant fragrance of lilacs, it reminded me of my grandmother. Hmmm... hmmm... I don't have any idea where it came from though, sorry.

replies.reply_text: By your description, it doesn't sound like what I was looking for, anyway.  Thanks for your time though.
Thank you kindly!

npc_list.name: Kirby Moufet
npc_list.long_description: Kirby is a man intent on his passion - the six and eight legged kind! And the occasional critter with a hundred legs or so.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello! Do come in. You must be interested in insects to find your way here!

replies.reply_text: Actually, I just stopped in to see who lived here. I'll leave you to your studies. Bye!
I admit, some of them can be fascinating. But usually they just annoy me. I would like your help on something, if you have a minute.
Nah, bugs just creep me out. I'm outta here.
I am interested, at the moment.  Do you know of a resin called "lac"?  I don't know much else about it.
I am back and I've got quite a crisis on my hands. I'm hoping you have the answer I need.
Actually, I came back because couldn't remember what our solution for the scorpion problem was.
That's exactly why I'm here! I'm looking for colorful beetle shells. Would you have any available?

Not really, but I see you are and so I believe you are just that man to help me. (You tell Kirby the whole story about Humpty and his broken heart and how he thought he'd find Patience on Cloud Isles.)
Excuse me. Where did you say your daughter would NOT be?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course. What can I help you with?

replies.reply_text: I was wondering if you could tell me what would eat a cricket? Or maybe a couple dozen crickets?
I was wondering if you could tell me what would eat a scorpion? Or actually, a couple dozen?
Whew. Its really hot in here. Those volcanos sure heat things up, don't they?
Looks like you've got quite a collection here. If I ever need to know about an insect, I'll be sure to come back and ask you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Scorpions love eating crickets! A couple dozen could eat a good many pretty quickly. If you wait just a minute, I'll bag some up for you.

replies.reply_text: I never knew that! Scorpions sound like the perfect solution! I'll wait right here.
Oh dear. I don't think I thought this through. I'm not up for traveling with that many scorpions right now. Maybe I'll be back another time. Or not!
Bag them? You are going to just put those creepy crawling scorpions in a bag? Heavens! They could crawl out and sting me! I've had a change of heart. You can just keep your scorpions.
Darn. I'm not sure Crow's Nest Carrie would appreciate scorpions in the lighthouse. Do you have any other suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear. I guess things didn't go quite as planned, eh? You know, certain snakes have a fondness for scorpions. The Lyre snake comes to mind. One should do the trick.

replies.reply_text: Snake? Yikes! I'm outta here.
That might be the perfect solution! I know I saw a snake tattoo on Crow's Nest Carrie's arm. Do you have any idea where I might get a Lyre snake?
I don't think she's gonna go for that idea. I'm guessing she doesn't like anything that slithers or creeps or hops around. Guess I'm out of luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sando owns snakes. He might be able to help.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I was hoping you could supply one. I think I'm done working on this quest. I'll just have to remember to steer clear of THAT lighthouse! Bye!
You wouldn't happen to know where I can find Sando, would you?
I sure wouldn't! Thanks so much for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Lac?  Terribly interesting!  Yes, lac bugs produce a resin that can be used in many ways by humans!  Shellac comes to mind immediately, but there are other fabulous uses as well!

replies.reply_text: You wouldn't happen to know where I could find some of that stuff?
Oh, yeah.  Terribly interesting.  I was so fascinated just now, that while you were talking, I forgot what I needed it for.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh, no.  I'm afraid we don't have any local colonies of bugs that make lac.  You might want to try somewhere where there are lots of tropical trees.  The jungle is a wonderful place for bugwatching!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Volcanos? You came to ask me about volcanos?

replies.reply_text: Oh. Sorry. No, not at all. Its just the heat sidetracked me. I was wondering if you knew about crickets and what might eat them. I need to find a way to get rid of a whole bunch. Peace between the Skulls and the Crossbones depends on this!
Actually, yes. Volcanos are awesome! Can you tell me about them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry to disappoint you, but I'm not a volcanologist. You'll have to ask around and see if anyone else can help you with that.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Sorry I bothered you!
Maybe I'll do that. Have a great day!

Silly me! That wasn't what I came to see you for! The heat made me forget all about my mission. I was wondering if you knew what might eat crickets? A ton of crickets are swarming one of the lighthouses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, its true there's not exactly a plethora of them to be found here, but you'd be surprised how much life a volcano supports..

replies.reply_text: Seriously? There's bugs around these volcanos?

chatpoints.chat_text: Some. But you are right, most of my collection comes from the other islands of Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Well if you ever need someone to go collect a bug or two for you, let me know. I'm always looking for ways to make money!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll keep you in mind. Thanks for the offer!

replies.reply_text: Anytime, anytime! See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not offhand. If you are looking for information on a specific insect, I'm your man. But if an insect isn't the direction you want to go in, I'm afraid I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: I understand. Thanks for trying to help. See you around!
Darn. Well, maybe I should try the scorpions. I can't think of anything else to try.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! He often supplies me with desert critters. He lives in a little village just west of Hotton. I can send you there, if you'd like.

replies.reply_text: That would be Sandy Meadows! I know right where that is. I would love you to send me there. Thanks so much!
Darn. I wasn't in the mood to travel that far today. Well, I appreciate the information. Looks like you've helped me all that you can. Thanks and see you around.
I will. And thanks again.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you that you should try getting a Lyre Snake from Sando.  They eat scorpions.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh heaven's no! The heat here just kills the colors once the beetles die. Sorry I couldn't help out.

replies.reply_text: Well now I'm bummed. A long trip to no avail. I think I'll make it worth my while and pick up some crystal shards. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Kirby sighs.). That was quite a fiasco. Poor
Patience. I should have thought before releasing the tarantula in
the house. I think she used that as an excuse to move. She hates
the heat here. But Cloud isn’t her style either. Patience is afraid of
heights. I must say, I was impressed with Humpty's gift though.
Truly a magnificent specimen.

replies.reply_text: Well bummer. If she isn't on Cloud Isles, is there any other place you can think where she might go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly not any place near where spiders are known to live. She'd be terrified that she'd meet another tarantula like the one Humpty presented to me.

replies.reply_text: Okay, so I can check off my list of places to look that have spiders living there. That helps narrow the places I need to travel to. I think I need to talk to Humpty about this news. Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Any place spiders are known to live. She just can't abide by them.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

npc_list.name: Zoe
npc_list.long_description: A sweet little girl living with her aunt.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.

replies.reply_text: I've been looking for you. Your Aunt Cara sent me. (This little girl looks scared, but you don't understand why.)
I'll come back later.  Bye!
Hello.  I'm back.
What was I doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Zoe hides her face in her hands. You can see that she has been crying.) Aunt Cara sent you?

replies.reply_text: Why.  What's wrong?
Okay... Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as you know, my aunt is an exceptional cook, and she cooks with some exotic foods. I found some things on the table that really smelt bad and I threw them into the garbage.

replies.reply_text: And then what happened?
This is getting too long, I'll come back later and help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the next thing I start hearing her say is, "Where did I put those truffles?  I need to make King Phil's Truffles and Quail."

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well, I hope she gets that sorted out.  I'm going.  Bye!
And what happened next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I ran away because I thought my aunt would be cross with me, and now I am hiding here.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'm sure you'll sort it out.  See you later.
I don't think she's cross with you.  She's more worried than anything.  I probably would have thrown out something that smelt bad myself.  If you want, I'll go and talk with her.
No problem.  I'll see you when I get back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to speak to my Aunt Cara Cook to see if I could come home.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.

replies.reply_text: I spoke to your Aunt Cara and she said that she's not cross, she wants you to come home. She said that she could solve the truffle problem when you get back.
All right.  I'll see you back there.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Inititial pig in Fritz's house
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink.

replies.reply_text: Hello.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink!! Oink!!

replies.reply_text: Nice to see you, too. Bye!

npc_list.name: Zoe
npc_list.admin_description: Zoe after you find her in the flower garden
npc_list.long_description: A sweet little girl living with her aunt.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Thank you for your help earlier.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  It's nice to see you back home again.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: First Pig for first truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink oink, squeal. (You look around and find that Ruffles has discovered the first truffle.)

replies.reply_text: Good pig.  Well done!

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Second Pig for Second Truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink, snort snort!

replies.reply_text: Well done!  You found another one.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Third Pig for Third Truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeal, squeal, oink!

replies.reply_text: You keep this up and we will have this done in no time.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Fourth Pig for Fourth Truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink, oink snort!

replies.reply_text: What's that, Ruffles?  Another one already?  Good pig.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Fifth Pig for Fifth Truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Snort, snort.

replies.reply_text: Wow, you can be really proud of yourself today. You're a real expert at this.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Sixth Pig for Sixth Truffle
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink oink! Grunt!

replies.reply_text: Well, this is the last one that we need.  I really appreciate your help.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Seventh Pig for Bonus Find
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink oink!!

replies.reply_text: What's that you've found?  Something instead of a truffle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink!! Oink!!

replies.reply_text: What did you say? It looks like something that might have belonged to an ogre. We'd better be careful.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Eigth Pig in Fritz's house
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink oink!!

replies.reply_text: Hi there.

npc_list.name: Fritz
npc_list.short_description: A man living on the edge of the forest
npc_list.long_description: A friendly character who is at home in the forest.  He is familiar with all sorts of things that grow there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No, just passing through.
Hi, Cara Cook sent me. She asked me to get a dozen truffles for her.
What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with the truffles.
I'm back with the $3000 for the truffles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, I used to do that all the time, but lately I've been really busy with other things so I haven't been able to. I only have six in stock. Do you think you can help me find some more?

replies.reply_text: No thank you.  I'll come back later, bye!
Sure, but how and where do I find them?

chatpoints.chat_text: I find truffles in the forest east of here. I can lend you Ruffles the pig.  He's specially trained to seek them out. When he finds one he will stand still and grunt to let you know. Remember, he will find them but you have to rake them to collect them.

replies.reply_text: Pigs!! I think I'll pass on that.  See you later.
Okay, I can do that.  Thanks for lending me your pig.
Okay, I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find six truffles with my specially trained pig in the forest east of here.  Remember, he will find them but you have to rake them to collect them.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.
Oh yes, he did very well.  You can be very proud of him.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you what, seeing that you went out and got those for yourself and helped keep Ruffles' nose in tune, you can keep those and sell them to Cara Cook, and I'll sell you these others for half price. They usually sell for $1000 apiece but you can have them for $500 each. Is that a deal?

replies.reply_text: Deal!
I'll have to come back later. I don't have enough money for them at the moment.
Thank you.  I'll be off back to Cara Cook with these right away.

npc_list.name: Ruffles
npc_list.admin_description: Ninth Pig for final Character outside Fritz's house
npc_list.long_description: A pig that is invariably talented at finding truffles.  He's also been known to find other things too

chatpoints.chat_text: Oink!! Oink!!

replies.reply_text: Hi.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, traveler!  How may I be of assistance today?

replies.reply_text: I don't need anything really, just passing through.
Maybe you could help me.  I'm looking for a carving the color of night.  Do you have anything like that?
Hi there. Funny question, I know, but... has anyone come in here with a dragon egg?
Hello.  I need some plaster.  Have you got any?  Oh, and I need some water too...
Hi, Patrick, me again.  Say, you don't carry raisins, do you?
Howdy!  Murray told me to see you about his tar paper.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't, but you could check with Xiang, she sells things like that.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will.  Goodbye!
No, I'm not.  One was stolen from the Magenta Dragon, and I'm searching for it so I can return it to him.
Well, thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: From the Magenta Dragon?  Whoa, there!  That mean old... I thought he was a dragon, not a dragoness!

replies.reply_text: Well, he is.  It's the egg he hatched from.
Okay, well, never mind, I think I'll just be off.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Waaaaaait a minute... You're telling me that old egotist kept the egg he hatched from all this time? Uhm... that's kinda freaky, don't you think? But hey, if you do find it, come here first! I'll give you a good price for something like that!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, maybe.  Bye.
No way!  I promised I was going to return it, and I will.  Bye.
By the way, do you know if there are squirrels, or... maybe little raccoons or weasels on the islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: Somebody might keep some as pets, but me, I've never seen any.  Ask around.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patrick gives you a slightly funny look, then goes to the back and comes back with a small sack of Plaster of Paris.) Here. This and enough water to mix it, you can mix it right in the bag, I suppose. That'll be $200.

replies.reply_text: Sure, that's fine.
$200?!  No way!  Bye,
Thanks!  Bye!
Oh, not more traveling.... Oh well.  Thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: What about his tar paper? He hasn't placed an order recently.

replies.reply_text: Murray told me that he forgot to place his order, but that you have a standing order of 20 rolls of tar paper waiting for him.
No he hasn't, but he said you have tar paper in stock.

chatpoints.chat_text: Since I haven't heard from Murray in a while, I sold 10 of them to the folks in Molten Meadows.  I think I have 10 left, though.

replies.reply_text: Well that would work out well, I only need 10 rolls of tar paper.  Can I have them please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Those rolls are in reserve for Murray, I'll have the rest of the rolls next week.  Why don't you come back next week and I'll give you Murray's entire order.

replies.reply_text: Okay, here's the deal...Murray orders 20 rolls from you and sends 10 of them to Olav the roofer.  Olav sent me to pick up his tar paper from Murray....and Murray sent me to you...

chatpoints.chat_text: And...this involves me, how?  Sounds like it's Murray's problem, not mine.

replies.reply_text: Actually, I guess it's my problem, but could you help me out?  I really need the rolls you have in stock now, you can send Murray the other half when you get them in.
Oh forget it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I might help, but who's going to pay for these rolls?

replies.reply_text: Oh that...since Olav has already paid Murray for them, you should tack it onto Murray's tab.
Thanks for helping me out, Patrick!  See you next time I'm in Ashton.

npc_list.name: Sani
npc_list.long_description: Sani is one of the village elders, keeping the old ways alive.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, all are welcome in our home.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, but I'm just looking around.
You certainly have some beautiful crafts here, are they for sale?
Hello. Can you help me? I was given a poem that says "Go to the land of cacti and heat; Bring back a painting of sand that's really neat." Everyone said I should see you.
Hi!  I'm back with your supplies.
Sorry to bother you again, but what am I picking up for you again?
Good day, Sani. Shoneah asked me to bring this to you. (Sani looks a little confused.) It's the belt you asked him to make for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: We do not sell our goods. We give them to deserving people, or trade them for whatever we may need.  Just as our ancestors did.

replies.reply_text: Wow, you really do try to keep the old ways!

chatpoints.chat_text: My wife and I keep the old ways, and I do make sand paintings, this is why you have been led to our home.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I'm looking for a sand painting for Holli Daysin from Tropicton.  Can I have one of yours?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you will do something for me, I will give you one of my sand paintings.

replies.reply_text: Always a catch!  I'm sorry, but I don't have any more time for any side jobs. Bye!
Considering you won't sell me the painting, I guess the least I can do is whatever you ask me to do.  What do you need done?
Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have everything. So long!
Thank you ever so much.  This is the most amazing painting I have ever seen!  I know that Holli will treasure it.  Hasta luego!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, young one. I asked you to go see Fitzgerald on Dust Isle for Yepa's Sumac and then pick up our cornmeal from the General Store in Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Dust Isle and Hotton... Got it!  I'll be back soon. Bye!
Thanks, it was my pleasure to help.  Have a happy anniversary, bye!

npc_list.name: Magnus
npc_list.long_description: Magnus is Hyrokkin's faithful companion.  She rides him whenever she travels.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Watches you intensely) Grrrrrrrrr!

replies.reply_text: Nice puppy.... er.... wolf.  Bye now!

npc_list.name: Hyrokkin
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP26
npc_list.long_description: An extremely tall woman, with frosty white hair and wrapped in a white fur cape. Whenever she travels, she rides upon Magnus, her faithful wolf.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, stranger.  Are you a messenger from Valhalla, by any chance?

replies.reply_text: Valhalla? As in Odin and Thor and those guys? Sorry to have bothered you and your ...er ...pet?  Bye!
No, I'm not. Are you expecting somebody?
I'm sorry, Hyrokkin, but where did you send me again?
No, I'm still not, Hyrokkin...  I just stopped by to see how you are doing.
Hi!  I'm back with your fish!
Ummm, no. Sorry. But I do have a package from Pony Express for you!
No, I'm sorry I'm not. Unfortunately, I'm here to deliver a package to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was hoping, but it's a long story...

replies.reply_text: I've got time, and they tell me I'm a good listener.  Do go on... Let's start with what you are doing here in the first place.
Sorry, I don't do long stories!  Best of luck to you, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess you could say that I'm here in exile.  I sort of ticked off Thor, and I've been here waiting for him to calm down ever since.

replies.reply_text: How did you manage to do that?
You mean you got Thor that mad at you, and you're still around?  Neat!

chatpoints.chat_text: Long story short, I arrived late for his brother's funeral and I had a headache, so I admit I was a little cranky. So, I launched Baldur's funeral boat with one hand, and Magnus started biting the Berserkirs who were holding him. We didn't mean to upset the solemnity of the occasion, but Thor threatened us with his hammer. Odin calmed him down, and we got out of there as fast as possible and ended up here.

replies.reply_text: Why were you late?
Late and cranky ...for a funeral? Pretty bad form, don't you think?
This is already sounding long.. not so short.  So, I'll just head out now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Honestly? I overslept because Loki thought it would be amusing to steal my alarm clock!

replies.reply_text: And the headache?
So, how does oversleeping tie into cranky and a headache?

chatpoints.chat_text: You may have noticed, I'm rather on the tall side, and I accidentally hit my head on the door on my way out of the house.  It really rang my chimes.

replies.reply_text: And Magnus' bad behavior?
Just a sec, what exactly is a Berserkir?

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you ever met a Berserkir?  I should think not.  They are big, loud and they smell really, really bad.  They scared poor Magnus half to death!

replies.reply_text: So, none of it was really your fault.   Didn't you try to tell them that?
Can't you just apologize to Thor?
You know, as much as this is quite interesting, I really should be going.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you ever tried to tell any of those guys anything? I'm staying here, taking care of the winter storms, until they call for me.

replies.reply_text: So that's what you do here?  You control the winter storms?
You're just hiding here, playing with the weather?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I make sure these islands have enough snow, and sometimes, if I'm bored, I send a storm over by the pirates.  I like to watch their puny ships trying not to sink.

replies.reply_text: To each his own, I guess.  Oh, I almost forgot why I'm here in the first place!
A girl's got to have a hobby!  Oh, geez, I just remembered, you have no idea what I'm doing here, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was going to ask you about that.

replies.reply_text: Jack O'Lantern sent me to bring you this kitten with his compliments.
Thanks, this is very generous of you.  Are you sure that Magnus won't harm Delling?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, they'll be fine. Delling is a companion for both of us.  Thanks for listening to me, feel free to drop by anytime!

replies.reply_text: I will, bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A Berserkir is a fierce warrior, favored by Odin.  People say that they transform into wolves or bears during battle... but the truth be told, it's because they like to wrap themseves in fur... and they get so excited they foam at the mouth.  Not a pretty picture!

replies.reply_text: Is that why Magnus behaved so badly?

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to see Jack O'Lantern for a recommendation for herring and cod roe.

replies.reply_text: Jack? Oh yeah, now I remember! I keep thinking of him as John. I'll be back with the fish as soon as possible!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's you!  I'm sorry, I'm in such a  dither...  The ravens came by from Asgard and told me that Frigg is coming to visit me.

replies.reply_text: Isn't Frigg Odin's wife?  Is this visit a good thing or not?
I guess you'll be pretty busy trying to make this place presentable.  Hope it works out for you.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Frigg is bringing Baldur's son, Forseti and his brother, Bragi.  I think the ravens said that this is a friendly visit, but I'm not sure, my raven is a little rusty.

replies.reply_text: Well, what are you going to do about their visit?
Sounds like a real family reunion.  I'll leave you to your preparations.  Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm going to prepare a feast in their honor, and I guess I'll just hope for the best!

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a great idea!  Is there anything I can do to help?
I'll just get out of your way.  I'm sure you and Magnus have everything under control.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have most of the food I need, but I need salted herring and cod roe, and I don't know where to get them.

replies.reply_text: I could get them for you, I'm good at getting things!  Any ideas about who might know where I can find that stuff?
Sorry, I don't do fish. Good luck with your feast!
Okay, I'll ask John. Err... Jack!  I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: Valhalla be praised!  You found the herring and the cod roe?

replies.reply_text: Jack Reelin said it's just the way his Scandinavian in-laws like it, so I figured that you'll like it, too.
Gee, thanks!  Good luck with the Asgard contingent!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, those are the only things I need, thanks.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my! Something for me?

replies.reply_text: Thanks and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately? (Hyrokkin looks at you very suspiciously.) Please, tell me more.

replies.reply_text: (You swallow hard, wondering if you are risking your well being by giving the package to her.) I want to warn you it is from a mage by the name of Belwyn.

chatpoints.chat_text: (To your amazement, Hyrokkin's proud look crumples and she looks unsure of herself. Finally, she takes a deep breath and nods to you.) I wondered when this day would come. (Her voice is shaky.) I will take that package from you now.

replies.reply_text: (You take a deep breath. Hoping you aren't making a mistake here, you hand her the package.)
Sure. No problem. (You decide to leave before anything else strange happens!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Hyrokkin looks hesitantly at you for several seconds before speaking.) Have you brought more gifts from Belwyn? (She shudders as she asks this.)

replies.reply_text: No, not at all. I was in the area so I thought I'd stop by. I think I'll just leave now.

npc_list.name: Yepa
npc_list.long_description: Yepa is one of the village elders, keeping the old ways alive.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our humble lodge.  Would you like some cactus juice?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm just passing through.
No, thank you.  What are you making?
Excuse me, but are you the sand painter?
Thank you, but I'm here to get the blankets you're making for Carly Cobbler.
Sorry to disturb you again, but what am I supposed to be getting for you?  I forgot.
Hi, I'm back, but can you explain why you needed the willow twigs?
Could you please help me?  I'm trying to find someone who can fix this bucket.  Can you help?
No, really, I'm not that parched!  But here's a package for you from the Pony Express!
No thank you, but I've come with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm weaving a ceremonial wedding basket, just as our ancestors did.

replies.reply_text: Oh.
It certainly is a beautiful pattern, is it a wedding present?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, this isn't for a wedding, it's a traditional pattern called a wedding basket.

replies.reply_text: I see...  You do wonderful work!

chatpoints.chat_text: No dear, (Yepa looks up from her basket, smiling.) you want my husband Sani.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  Sorry to bother you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly dear, I'm almost finished with them.  I was wondering if you could do me a favor while I finish these blankets?

replies.reply_text: Certainly, I seem to have some time to kill.  What can I do for you?
If the blankets aren't ready, I'll just tell Carly to send someone else to get them.  Goodbye!
Okay, willow twigs and leather strappings.  I'll get right on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right dear.  I asked you to go to Albert on Hoof Isle for leather strappings, and to Rider Isle and bring me 6 willow twigs from the willow trees there.

replies.reply_text: See Albert for leather and go to Rider Isle for the willow trees... I'll remember this time, promise!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, I use the willow and the leather to make traditional Dreamcatchers.  We make Dreamcatchers for our children to keep the evil spirits away from them while they sleep.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's neat!  Well, here's the willow and leather.
That's so nice of you!  I'm sure Carly will be touched by your kind gesture.  Adios!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear.  I'm not at all familiar with this type of work, I'm afraid.  I usually make baskets of wrapped yucca.   Certainly, I've never repaired anything made of wood.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks anyway.
Thank you and you're welcome!  I can't wait to see the new baskets, Yepa!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, what sort of proposition could you possibly have for me?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your beautiful creations.  Here's your Invitation
Shoneah already confirmed that he will attend and I'll let Iona know that you will attend too.

npc_list.name: Mrs. Beesdale
npc_list.long_description: You don't meet many people like Mrs. Glory Beesdale anymore.  She is of the old type: refined, elegant, noble in bearing and very articulate and careful in her speech and manner.  She is used to respecting others and being well respected in return.  She paces back and forth, wringing her hands.  When she speaks, she does so with force and conviction.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  You're back!  Have you found our Leader?

replies.reply_text: No, but I've found Chickletti and Blinky!
Sorry, I haven't found anything yet.  Could you please give me another hint?
Great news, Mrs. Beesdale!  I've found His Excellency!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh! Oh! I simply don't know what to do...
(The lady walks back and forth in front of the innkeeper's desk, wringing her hands and fussing with a long string of pearls.) Oh, this is terrible! Terrible!

replies.reply_text: Why, what's the matter?  Is there anything I can do to help?
Uh oh.... Don't think I want to get involved here.  Later, lady.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh! I don't know, I simply don't know!
(She wrings her hands even more furiously, and starts looking almost hysterically at... nothing, particularly.)
Oh, my metabolism! Doctor!

replies.reply_text: Crazy lady.  I'm out of here.
Hold on there, hold on there!  I'm sure I can help!  Please tell me what the problem is.

chatpoints.chat_text:
You? You? Well, perhaps. (The dowager thinks for a long time before deciding to go on.)
I am Mrs. Glory Beesdale, the richest woman in all Spreedonia, I may say, what with my late husband dead and having left me his entire fortune; now engaged to be married to our Leader...
(She gathers herself and looks proudly and confidently (and rather affectionately) ahead.) Rupert T. Firetruck!

replies.reply_text: Doesn't sound like much of a problem so far.  Please go on.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, but it is a problem! Possibly the worst tragedy to ever befall Spreedonia! Our beloved Leader, Rupert T. Firetruck, has disappeared!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Then you need the Missing Persons department.  Sorry, nothing I can do here.
Missing?  How did that happen?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well!  He was making preparations for our marriage.  But he said he wanted to take a little vacation first.  He promised me that he would be back in a very short time!  That was several weeks ago!  And I fear that if he does not return very soon, there will be trouble between Spreedonia and Westinghousia!  Ambassador Tarantino is working himself into a lather!

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear.  I take it you've searched everywhere in Spreedonia.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, everywhere! I can assure you, His Excellency is nowhere within the state of Spreedonia. And I have Ambassador Tarantino's personal assurance that he is nowhere in Westinghousia either. Why, I even went so far as to hire two private detectives, the finest in all the land, to find him. But all they were able to tell me was that he went into the Jungle, where all the monkeys throw nuts.

replies.reply_text: (Aside.) If I stay here, I'll go nuts! Hurray, Hurray, Hurray! (To Mrs. Beesdale.) Well, I hope they come back soon with some good news. Goodbye.
Hmmm.... Well, they might know more than they think they know.  Where are they now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, I have absolutely no idea.  And I'm so disappointed in them.

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe I can find them.  What are their names?  What do they look like?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now let me see... Chickletti is small, and wears a pointy hat.  His partner, Blinky, has curly red hair, and wears a top hat at all times.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.... Do you know where they might be?
Well, actually, now that I come to think about it, I think I'd rather stay out of this.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if they are still here on these islands, I might first inquire at an inn, like this one.  I'm sorry, but I can tell you no more.  Oh, will you take up the hunt to find His Excellency?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I think I have an idea where this is headed, and I'd rather not go there.
Of course I will!
I'll let you know as soon as I have any news!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear! Oh, dear, this is dreadful! You were supposed to be looking for the Leader of Spreedonia, Rupert T. Firetruck! I sent you to at least find my private detectives, Chickletti and Blinky. They are probably in one of the inns somewhere... Oh, dear, oh, dear! Well, don't just stand there! This is a crisis of international proportions! Go! And don't come back until you've found something!

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! That is news! Did they have anything to say?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, they had plenty to say, but none of it made much sense.
Well, yes, after a fashion, I suppose... They gave me this piece of paper and a code book, but I don't know what to do with either of them.
I just wanted to stop by and say that I am on the trail of Firetruck!  I think I may know where he's hiding!

chatpoints.chat_text: In that case, you must go back to them at once!  Question them carefully!  Find out everything they know!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's wonderful!  That is the most magnificent news I've heard in so very long a time!  Where was he, and what did he say?

replies.reply_text: He said quite a lot, actually; but he's on his way back to Spreedonia at this very moment, and asked me to ask you to meet him in front of the bank.
Wow!  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Chickletti
npc_list.long_description: Chickletti is small and somewhat shabby, but vivacious and full of energy.  He has a long nose and curly black hair which mostly resides under a conical red hat.  He speaks in a thick accent, and is very self-assured indeed!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Hey! You! You need a couple-o detectives! I can-a tell, just by a look atta you face!

Blinky: Honk!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I don't think you guys are it.
I'm looking for a couple of guys named Chickletti and Blinky.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chickletti and Blinky!  Hey, that's us!  Yeah, we're the guys for you!  Now!  What are you after, eh?  Whatta you want we should find, eh?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for the leader of Spreedonia, Rupert T. Firetruck.  Do you guys know where he is?
Uh... Never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Rupert T. Firetruck! Eh, we know him, eh, Blinky?
Blinky: Honk!
Chickletti: Eh, but it's-a no use you lookin' for him, he's lost!

replies.reply_text: Well, yes, I know he's lost, that's why I'm looking for him!  Mrs. Beesdale told me that she hired the two of you to find him, but she's never heard back.  Did you find him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did-a we find him?  No, we no find him.  But-a we look everyplace.  We look upstairs, we look downstairs, we look under the table!  We no find him.

replies.reply_text: Well, did you find any clues as to where he might have gone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Clues?  No, we no find-a no clues.  We only find evidence!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I give up.  Bye.
Okay, what evidence did you find?
Umm...  Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's-a interesting note, eh, boss?  Whadda you think?

replies.reply_text: I don't know what to think.  I don't understand any of this.
I don't know.  Let me read this over again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course you no understand it!  You gotta look it up in'a you code book!

replies.reply_text: Code book?  I don't have a code book.

chatpoints.chat_text: YOU DON'T HAVE A CODE BOOK?

replies.reply_text: Shhhh!  I don't want everybody to know I don't have a code book.  I don't suppose you know where I can get a code book...?
I think I'll bow out of this now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, just-a by accident, I happen to have one right here.  That's-a one dollar.

replies.reply_text: Forget it, I'll figure it out for myself.
All right, all right, I'll buy a Code Book for a dollar.  Everybody should have a code book...
Uh, yeah, uhm, thanks.
Okay.... Uh... What do I do now?

chatpoints.chat_text: So!  You read-a the Code Book, and you know what to do!  You think you can find Firetruck?

replies.reply_text: But all it says is, "SIMPLE CIPHER."
Okay, okay, I'll read it.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, then, you gotta figure out the code for-a you' self. Good luck!
Blinky: Honk! Honk! Honk!

replies.reply_text: I knew I should have stayed in bed this morning...
Okay, fine.  But is there anything else you can tell me about Firetruck?  Anything at all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I donno... But here, boss, just because I like you, I'm-a tell-a you this.  We think he went bananas!

replies.reply_text: I can see how someone might to do that, after having met Mrs. Beesdale.
But... No, I need a place!  A place he might have gone!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Hey, you no understand! I'm-a just tell you!
Blinky: HOOOONK!
Chickletti: He's a no go crazy! He's-a go bananas! You know, boss, where the bananas grow! In-a the Jungle! Way in-a the middle of the Jungle! He's-a find a little-a hide-away! He's-a go there and change his name, or else he's-a gotta to marry a big-a nutsy woman!

replies.reply_text: Oh.....  He went to hide on.... A-ha!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Atsa good! You catch on quick! You find-a the right spot on some map, and then you go look-a close, close around there. I think-a bright kid like-a you knows whats to look-a for, eh? You go bananas and look for Firetruck! Good-a bye!
Blinky: HOOOONK! HONK HONK HONK!

replies.reply_text: (You sing...) Hello, I must be going...

npc_list.name: Blinky
npc_list.admin_description: Chickletti's Silent Partner
npc_list.long_description: Blinky does indeed have curly red hair, covered with a rather beaten-up top hat.  He has a wide smile and merry eyes, but does not seem to speak.

chatpoints.chat_text: HONK!

replies.reply_text: Nice to see you, too.
Hey, Blinky, you look like a reasonable fellow.  Can't you give me any clues about Firetruck's location?
Thanks!  Maybe this will shed some light...

npc_list.name: Augie
npc_list.long_description: A slim, darkly tanned young man who wears an overstuffed backpack and has an adorable kitten for a companion.

replies.reply_text: I've got a fishing pole right here, and a dozen earthworms to start you with. (You demonstrate how to bait the hook and cast the line. Augie watches intently.)
I'll be back with a pole and a dozen earthworms. It might be awhile, I'm right in the middle of a quest. But I WILL be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: What a great idea! Would you be willing to do that?

replies.reply_text: Sure!
I guess not right now.  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.

replies.reply_text: Hi. I understand you have a stock pot you might not be needing anymore?
Hello. Anything interesting to see out here?
Hello again! You are a hard person to find. All this wandering around! But find you I did, and I've got something for you.
Hi there. What an adorable kitten!
Boy, you sure like to wander! I've got something for you!
Hi there, Augie. Please remind me what I was doing for you.
Did you say you needed something special to trade for that pot?
Hey Augie. Just wanted to say hi while I was in the area. Take care!
Hi Augie.  I just remembered that you said the fish wouldn't last very long for Shadow.
I'm back with a pole and a dozen earthworms.
Hello again! How's the fishing coming along?
Hi Augie. Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi!  I'm back with the scallops.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. Sand dunes. Cacti. Lizards. Scorpions. Sunsets.

replies.reply_text: You find those things interesting?
Way too exciting for me. I am so outta here.
What about wild horses? And diamonds?
Sand dunes? What's so interesting about them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course. The desert is a fascinating place, if you give it time to reveal itself.

replies.reply_text: Speaking of time, look how late it is! Guess it won't be revealing itself to me today. I've got to gallop. Bye.
I bet that's true. I don't have the time today, as I'm on a quest. I understand you wanted to make adobe bricks with a large stockpot, but that isn't working out for you?
I never thought of it that way before. What about wild horses? Or diamonds. Can you find those out here?
Well, that's the problem. Time. I just don't have enough of it. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, that's true. There's not enough cacti to harvest. Not enough fresh water out here to boil it in. And not enough wood to fire up the pot.

replies.reply_text: I'd love to take that pot off your hands. Is there a price you'd be willing to sell it for?
Sounds like that's your problem, not mine. Adios, amigo!
Cactus? I'm confused. Why would you want to boil cactus?
I see your point. There isn't much of anything growing out here.  No fresh water... Gosh. That reminds me of how thirsty I am. I think I'll head up to Hotton and get something to drink. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Money doesn't do me much good out here.

replies.reply_text: Okay. How about we trade? What would it take?
Darn. Sounds like the start of another quest. I don't have time to deal with this. Maybe I'll be back some other time. Bye!
Hmmm. Let me dig through my saddlebags. Let's see. Rocks...  don't think so. Feathers...  nah. Hey! How about a glass of lemonade?
Right. Okay. Where do I go for these fronds?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, since I'm not going to be able to build myself an adobe abode... some kind of shelter would be nice. The sun can be deadly during the summer months.

replies.reply_text: What kind of shelter were you thinking of? A house made of strawbales?
Let me take a quick look in my saddlebags. Nope - no pup tent. No igloo. Sorry, dude. You are outta luck, and I am outta here!
Oh, man! Do you know how long I've been working on this quest already? And now I need to build you a house?
Gosh. I know building homes for humanity is a noble pursuit, but I just don't have the time right now. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heavens, no. That's too much trouble. Besides, I've decided I like the nomadic way of life. I just need something simple that I can carry with me. A couple of palm fronds would be perfect.

replies.reply_text: That's it? You'll trade me the pot for a couple of palm fronds? That's going to be super easy!
There's a few palm trees on the beach near here. Why don't you go pick a few? Or are you looking for some specific kind of palm frond?
That reminds me. I like the nomadic way of life, too! So I must get on with it.  Bye!
I can do that! Happy to help!
So you need some kind of fronds from a specific palm or something?
I've got dinner waiting, but I'll get right on that task when I have some time! Bye for now.
Are you sure I can't just pay you for that pot?

chatpoints.chat_text: If it was that easy, I would have already done that. And to be honest, that pot is heavy. Lugging it around in the desert is no fun.  I'm happy to trade it for your help.

replies.reply_text: Good point. Okay, I'll help.
I hadn't thought of that. Maybe I'll just let Stinky find someone else to help it. Thanks for pointing that out! Adios!
I realize everyone needs a little help now and then. So when I find some time, I'll come back and help you.
It does look heavy. Good thing I've got my trusty and noble steed to carry it for me! So, sure, I'd be happy to help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure don't. Sorry. I only heard about the place from a guy that traveled through here.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll do my best. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's the nomadic way! What do you have?

replies.reply_text: I've got your palm fronds!
Oops. My mistake. I thought I had something for you.  I'll be back.
Popcorn, peanuts, crackjacks... Oops! My mistake... I was having a sports event moment. I've actually got your palm fronds right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Palm fronds. For those, I will trade you my copper-bottomed stock pot.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I've got them right here.
Right. I have to rake around some specific oasis -- but you have no clue which one!
I can't believe it! I've got the pot! Wha-hooo! Thank you so much. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heavens, no! She's my little "Shadow"! A man can't go anywhere without his shadow, you know!

replies.reply_text: Okay, sounds like you need help with her diet, then? What do you think the problem is?
Aren't you the clever sort! Well, time to get back to my quests. Goodbye!
Ah, very clever! But seriously, if she isn't doing well here, what are you going to do? Move somewhere else?
Well, if you change your mind, let me know. I might be able to help you find her a new owner. I'll start thinking about who might want a kitten, just in case!

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find a diamond or two on a good day. I see a wild horse now and then. Beautiful sight. Did you know that when the summer monsoons hit, the advancing rain on the dunes sounds like pounding hooves? Gives me chills everytime I hear that.

replies.reply_text: That sounds real interesting. Really. So much so that I think I'm going to head out right now and see if I can round up a monsoon or two!
Gives me goosebumps just thinking about it! Sounds like you have a fondness for sand dunes, too.
Darn, I got sidetracked again. I meant to ask you about that pot I needed. You wanted something for it. Can you remind me, please?
Wild horses! I love wild horses. I want to catch every single one. Train it. Ride it. Race it. Sell it. Whatever. Gosh, I think I'll go look for a wild horse right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly. I need fronds that are lightweight and flexible. They'll provide shade. I can carry them with me as I wander around here. And I am tired of traveling off this island.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll help you. I travel all over anyway. I'm sure I can find something that you could use.
Umm -- I think I'll pass. I've got tons of other things to do... pick cotton, go fishing. You know, that kind of thing. Later, dude!
I'd be happy to help you with this! Sounds like a win-win situation. I need to build up my quest experience, and you need help! We'll both benefit from this.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks. She's a sweetie. But she's getting pretty thin living the desert life with me.
