Hi again Mercurius.  You know, you kind of grow on me after a while.
Thanks for the hug!  I've forgotten what I was doing... Could you send me back to Big Blue?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't help myself!  Teehee!  You're so cuuuute!  Just look at you there!  Awww!

replies.reply_text: Heh... Well, I'm here to bring you some presents from Big Blue...
Ugh, they should've named you the Purple Fish of Sentimental Mush.  See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Teary eyed.) No way! NEVER! (Bearhug.) Oh, hugs! Doublehugs! I just never heard of such a wonderful thing! What are they?

replies.reply_text: Oof!  You know, you weren't exactly what I had in mind when Big Blue told me of the Three Wise Fish... Maybe I should go back to Big Blue and check.  Could you send me back please?
Here they are - some beautiful grapes and an amethyst.
You're welcome. Could you please send me back to the blue fish now, and quickly?
You're welcome.  I'm just going to have a look around your isle now.  Bye.
Ahh, missed.  Well, I'm used to that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooooh, you're so sweet as usual!

replies.reply_text: Could you please send me back to the blue fish now?
(Sarcastically.) Well, I try. See you later.
Thank you! I was wondering if you could tell me where I might find Ariela?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! My lovely friend Ariela! You can find her somewhere along the island shore. Enjoy the lovely sea view while you are looking for her.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will. Can you send me back to your isle so I can start looking for her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: Vesuvius
npc_list.long_description: A huge, verbose Blue Sea Perch

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow!  You're back, kid!  Ya found me!  Small world, isn't it?

replies.reply_text: Hi!  You haven't changed much, have you?
Yep!  Could you send me back to Little Blue now?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've got a fancy new alias, but it's still me, Big Blue.   How ya been?  Any troll trouble lately?  How's my kid liking his independence?

replies.reply_text: Hahaha!  Everything is going well.  Little Blue has done a fine job taking over for you!
Woof, you still talk too much.  See you later.
Hm, I should go check.  Could you send me back to Little Blue now?
I'll try to remember.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  It's good to catch up on old times!  Thanks for coming by to visit!

replies.reply_text: I enjoyed it.  I'm just going to have a look around this island now.  Talk to you soon!
Yep!  Could you send me back to Little Blue now?

npc_list.name: Dotti
npc_list.long_description: Dotti wanders the forest happily humming to herself.  Living a solitary life has made her socially inept, and perhaps little loopy.  Her dress is made of something brown and crumbly and she wears a pine cone in her hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow!  Someone in Dotti's forest!  How should Dotti approach them?  She wonders what they want!

replies.reply_text: Hi there, are you talking to me?
Cuckoo!  I'd better go.
Hi, I'm back.  What was I doing for you?
Hi, Dotti, I'm back.  The scary noise was just a guinea hen, sitting on a nest, so please don't worry about it anymore.  Guinea fowl are notoriously very noisy.
Good to see you again, Dotti!  Just stopping by to say "Hi!"

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh goodness, they're talking to Dotti.  Dotti wonders what would happen if she didn't say anything back.

replies.reply_text: It's okay, you don't have to talk to me.  I just thought since you lived alone in the forest, you might like someone to chat with.

chatpoints.chat_text: On the other hand, this person might be able to help!

replies.reply_text: Do you need help with something?
This person pretends not to notice Dotti's monologue, and walks away.

chatpoints.chat_text: (<i>Nods<i>)

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm your man, as they say.  Can you tell me what I can do to help you, or is it a surprise?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dotti doesn't know if she likes the tone this person is taking with her.  How they ever guessed Dotti needed help is beyond her!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  I didn't mean anything by it.  Please indicate to me how I can help you!
Sensitive, aren't we?  I'll deal with you later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shivers, points at tree, points north)

replies.reply_text: The northern trees are cold?
I'm really not in the mood for charades.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shakes head sadly)

replies.reply_text: Sorry... I'm sure I'll get it, just keep trying!
I know you can talk!  You were talking to yourself just a minute ago!   This is too frustrating for me.
Wait!  I think I can read your mind!  This is great!  Let me guess:  Your name is Dotti,  and you heard a scary noise coming from the forest north of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dotti goggles incredulously.)

replies.reply_text: Well, Dotti, I'm just the person who can help you.  I'll go figure out what the scary noise is, and come report back to you.
Sorry, I'm going to have to come back later.  Don't worry too much, I'm sure it's nothing that bad.

chatpoints.chat_text: That person is back.  Dotti wonders if they looked for the scary thing in the forest to the north of this one.

replies.reply_text: Nevermind Dotti, I just remembered what I was doing.  I'll be back shortly, and in the mean time, try not to worry about it.
I sense that you want to give these most special possessions to me, Dotti.  Thank you very much!

npc_list.name: Mama Guinea
npc_list.long_description: Nestled into a large embankment of leaves and pine needles, you spot the wrinkly, bald head of a guinea hen.  Mama Guinea watches you with a suspicious beady eye.

replies.reply_text: Gesundheit!
I'm sorry to disturb you, but Dotti wanted me to find out what you were... I'll leave you be now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mama Guinea clumsily rises from her nest, and pulls weakly on your shoe.) Puh-kawk, puh-kawk!

replies.reply_text: You look really weak.  Do you need something?  I'd love to help you.
Hey!  Get off my shoe!  That's not food!

chatpoints.chat_text: Puh-kawk!

replies.reply_text: Gesundheit!
I'm sorry to disturb you, I was curious what that funny noise was.  I'll leave you be now.
Hi Mama Guinea!  I think I brought you what you need to get your strength back!
You're looking much healthier.  I'm glad to see you so well!  How is the brooding coming along?

chatpoints.chat_text: Puh-kawk, puh-kawk! (Mama Guinea ducks into her massive nest, and emerges with an acorn cap in her beak.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see.  You're weak from hunger, you can't leave your clutch, and you need acorns?  I can get those.  How many shall I bring?
Sorry, I don't get it.  I'll leave you be.
Ah, I think I understand.  I'll be back shortly.
Sorry, I don't speak Guinea Fowlese.  Well, at least I figured out what the funny noise was.  Bye.
Thank you!  Good luck with those eggs!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Mama Guinea lifts her skirts a bit, and you catch a glimpse of roly-poly balls of fluff, peeping around her ankles.)

replies.reply_text: How sweet!  Good luck with your new family!

npc_list.name: Jack B. Nimble
npc_list.admin_description: who jumps over candlesticks

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  Do I know you?

replies.reply_text: You do now!  Hi there!  I'm wandering around looking for jobs.  Got anything that needs doing?
I'm not sure I know me.  I don't know you, though.  Who are you?
Oops, wrong hallucination.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jobs?  Like what?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't know.  Do you, uhm... need anything from Down Below?  Anything I can fetch for you or have made?
Oh, forget it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who am I? I'm Jack B. Nimble. I jump over candlesticks, nimbly and quickly. Well, okay, I used to.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  Now, about that job...?
You used to?  Why did you stop?
I should have known.  Well, must be off.  I need to dust my caterpillars.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Jack looks down, and shuffles his feet.) Dog ate my candlestick.

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear.  Well, maybe you need one the dog can't chew up, then.
Hmmm.  Yeah, they can be a problem, those dogs.  Well, I guess I'll leave you to discuss it with him, then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess I could use a new one... Hey, I've got a job for you! You can go down to some... body or other Down Below, and have them make me a new candlestick that Fluffy can't chew on!

replies.reply_text: What?  No, sorry, that's not really my idea of a job.  See you.
Uhm, yeah, okay, I can do that.  Any specifications?
Okay, I can do that.  While I'm down there, do you want candles as well?
Okay, will do.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Candles?  What for?

replies.reply_text: Well, isn't that what you do?  Isn't that why you need to be nimble and quick, so you can jump over a lighted candle?
Nevermind, I'm off.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jump over a LIGHTED CANDLE? Are you INSANE?! That's dangerous! Ouch! Ow, ow, ow!

replies.reply_text: Good, less work for me, then!  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  You again.  Got my copper candlestick?

replies.reply_text: Right here.
Oh, is that what I was doing for you? Oops, forgot. I'll be back.
Oh.  Wrong fairy-tale character.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again.  What's up?

replies.reply_text: Nothing much, just wandering around.  Bye.
Thanks!  Enjoy.  With or without a lighted candle!

npc_list.name: Gingerbread Man
npc_list.long_description: Freshly baked and full of sugary goodness, this guy is ready to run!  In fact, he's stretching his legs on the muffin tin as you speak.

chatpoints.chat_text: Run, run as fast as you can. You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man! (He starts jogging in place.)

replies.reply_text: Why are you running?
Aww, you are so cute!  I could just eat you up, but I have to run ...err go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, to be honest, I am training to run a 5-mile marathon next weekend. I just got some new "Air Giordano's" from the Muffin Man... (He smiles a big icing smile.) Do you know the Muffin Man?

replies.reply_text: The Muffin Man?
Who?
Uhhh... no.  See ya little man!

chatpoints.chat_text: The Muffin Man!

replies.reply_text: The Muffin Man?
I am not falling for this.  I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, the Muffin Man! Do you know the Muffin Man?

replies.reply_text: Who lives on Drury Lane?
Oh, sheesh.  Nursery rhymes are for kids!  I'm too old for that.  See ya, man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, that's the guy.  He gave me some new running shoes as a present to get me motivated for my upcoming race.  The only problem is when I was on my way home from the Muffin Man's house, I bent down to tie my new shoes, and lost a gumdrop button!

replies.reply_text: That's not good.  Did you want me to find your gumdrop button for you?
Sorry, I think I left my stove on and my muffins in the oven.  I gotta go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, please!  I think I lost it somewhere on my way back here in the Cloud Candy forest.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'll go look for your gumdrop button right away!
Naw, I'm too busy right now.  Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I remember stopping to tie my new shoes, seeing a candy cane on the right and a sucker on my left.  I think if you have a tool to see smaller things, it might help, too.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I think I might have an idea now.  I'll keep looking.
Okay, I'll be back!
Thank you for the shoes and good luck in your marathon race!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find my gumdrop button yet? (He starts doing jumping jacks while little flecks of gingerbread cookie fly in different directions.)

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did.  It was so tiny and I had to look very hard to find it!
I think it's too small to see...  Maybe you could give me a hint as to where it might be?
No, I'll look for it later.

chatpoints.chat_text: (When you walk back into the candy house, you see the Gingerbread Man using suckers as dumb bells, lifting them one at a time.)

replies.reply_text: How's the marathon training going?

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! I should be ready to go by next weekend! (He huffs and puffs as he continues to lift his weights.)

replies.reply_text: Good luck!

npc_list.name: Waldo
npc_list.admin_description: a walrus whose bucket has been taken.
npc_list.long_description: Walruses look sad at the best of times, but Waldo looks particularly upset.

chatpoints.chat_text: Has you seen it?

replies.reply_text: Uhm.... Seen what?
Whoa there, proper English, please.  What happened?
Oops.  Big walrus.  I'm out of here.
Hi, Waldo.  You mentioned someone I should see?  Who was that again?
No, but I think I may know who has.  Just wanted to let you know.  See you!
I have it right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mah bukkit!  They took my bukkit!

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  I'm not going there.  Goodbye.
They took your bucket?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aww, pweez, I be just a walrus, after all.  A walrus what got his bukkit took!  Do you has it?

replies.reply_text: No, I do not have it.  Do you know who took your bucket?  Maybe I can find it for you.
Sorry, I only help people who speak properly.  Not even cats speak like this!  Must be off, good day to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I not know dem.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm afraid that doesn't advance us very much.  Can you describe your bucket?
Forget it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blue and floppy and smells like fish.  Will you find mah bukkit?  I pays you good!

replies.reply_text: No.  Sorry.
Well... sure, I'll try to find your bucket.  How could I not help such a sad face?  Are you sure there's nothing you can tell me about the people who took it?
Maybe some other time.  Not today, thanks.  Bye.
I'll be back as soon as I can.
Don't wait up!

chatpoints.chat_text: Viola...  Right down there...

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Right!  Thanks!
Enjoy!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Fergus O'Toole
npc_list.admin_description: A Leprechaun on Flower Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ya brains made of cottage cheese? I sent ya ta Ferrel Ironman on Bird Isle!

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, that's right.  Bird Isle.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo, watch it now!  Watch where ya be steppin'!

replies.reply_text: Are you talking to me?
Didn't see you, sorry.
Hi Fergus, I'm back with your new pot!
Hello again. I gave you Ferrel's message, right?
I'm sorry, but who did you say I should see?
Oh, hey.  Sorry about that.  How have you been?
Oops, sorry.  What was I doing for you again?
I found your gold chests!
Yikes! Sorry about that! Can I get two sneezes of leprechaun dust from you? Gnorman the Gnome sent me. And I really hope that's just a figure of speech!
Oh dear. I am sorry. I've come to ask if a rider came through here? He mentioned giant mushrooms and an Irish Elf - which I thought might be you?
I'm sorry to bother you again, but can you remind me what the mysterious rider talked about?

chatpoints.chat_text: And who else be around fer me ta be talkin' to?

replies.reply_text: Oh.
No one, I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yer a regular brain trust ain't ya?  I said, watch yer step ya hulkin' beastie, ya nearly stepped on me!

replies.reply_text: Geez, I didn't see you, sorry already!
How am I supposed to see someone so short?  Oops!
I don't think I'm going to stick around and be insulted like this.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yer an insolent scamp!  If me magic was workin' I'd turn ya inta a warty toad, I would!

replies.reply_text: You're magical? (Looks really hard at Fergus.) You're a leprechaun, aren't you?! Let's see, I found you... Does that mean I get your pot of gold? Or maybe 3 wishes? How about just some magically delicious cereal? I could use a snack!
Magic?  I don't do magic, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yer truly pluckin' me last nerve!  Ya think it's funny that me magic is gone?

replies.reply_text: You're really upset. Is there anything I can do to help you get your magic back?
A leprechaun without magic?  Yeah that's funny, wait 'til I tell my friends!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hush now, are ya really willing ta help me? Or are ya pullin' me leg?

replies.reply_text: No, really, helping folks is what I do best!
Yep, and it looks like the right one is a bit longer than the left... See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well then, pull up a mushroom and I'll tell ya me tale of woe.  I once was one of the most powerful of the wee folk.  King Brian himself would seek me council.  All was well until that fateful day...

replies.reply_text: What happened, pray tell me?
Oh boy, I can see a really long story coming. I've got to go, tata!

chatpoints.chat_text: One fine day, I was bringin' some more coins ta me pot o' gold and faith 'n' begorra, all me gold was gone... and so was me pot!  I searched all over and nary a clue did I find.  All me treasure, me pot, and me magic gone.  All gone in the blink of an eye!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I think you lost me here. I understand that someone took your pot of gold, but how did you lose your magic?
My mom always told me that I should take care of my things.  You got what was coming for not listening to your mother!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right, ya might not know... If ya find a leprechaun, ya can make him give ya his pot o' gold. What really happens is that we give ya the treasure, but we always keep our pot. The pot is the source of our magic, no pot, no magic!

replies.reply_text: So if I take a leprechaun's pot along with the gold, I get all your magic too?
No magic, no reward... Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: The magic won't work fer a mortal like ya, it only works for us wee folk. Ya could take a leprechaun's pot, but that's all ya'd get... a pot.

replies.reply_text: Do you have any idea of who might have taken the pot?  Could it have been another leprechaun?

chatpoints.chat_text: The debbil ya say! No leprechaun would take another's pot 'o gold.  We might move it a little as a prank, but not take it!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I get it.  It wasn't another of the wee folk.  Getting back to my original question, what can I do to help you get your magic back?
As a mortal, I resent your implications here... You should've taken better care of your precious magic then!  Good day ta ya!
And where can I find Ferrel Ironman?

chatpoints.chat_text: He runs the workshop on Bird Isle.  Now be off with ya!

replies.reply_text: Okay, Bird Isle it is.  See you later!
Ferrel said to tell you thanks, but now he's square.  By the way, when are you going to fill your new pot?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why ya be askin'?

replies.reply_text: Just trying to be polite, geesh.  Bye.
Because I'm wondering how you're doing and if you have anything you would like me to do for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh really.  Well.  Hmph.  Ya did help me out before, maybe ya can be trusted with this.

replies.reply_text: Of course I can be trusted!  What do you need?
You know what?  Nevermind.  I'll just be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine.  Well, ya see I seemed ta have forgotten' where I buried me gold chests.

replies.reply_text: Searching for buried treasure?    Where do you think they could be?
I am really not in shape for all the digging that's probably going to require.  You'll have to find someone else.  Bye!
Shouldn't be too bad.  I'll let you know what I find.
Twins?  What does that mean?

chatpoints.chat_text: What do ya think?  Two plants that look the same right next to each other.  Right next to.  Not close by neither.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ya said ya would find me gold chests!   All I can tell ya is they're on Flower and they're buried next to twin plants.

replies.reply_text: Twins?  What does that mean?
Oh that's right.  I'll see what I can find.
Umm..  Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course it is a figure of speech! Are ya squirrelly in the head thinking anything else? It be similiar to saying a pinch. Or a speck. Two, ya say?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please. He's working on a project involving garden gnomes.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't be needin' all the details. Iff'n Gnorman needs two sneezes worth, I'll be giving you two sneezes worth.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye walkin' around blindfolded? Do I look like an Elf? I'm a leprechaun, through and through. My daddy was a leprechaun just like his daddy 'afore him and his granddaddy 'afore him. I come from a long line of leprechauns!

replies.reply_text: I would never say you look like an elf. Unfortunately, that's what this rider said, and I'm just trying to figure out where he came from. He was also talking about monkeys, and he might have been, perhaps, losing his bananas? A bit crazy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go on wit' you. You think someone is batty on account of them mentioning giant mushrooms? Look around! And by the by, the rider came through here, sure as sure can be. What ye be wantin' of him?

replies.reply_text: Umm, no. I don't think he's crazy. Someone else thought that. But I'm glad to hear I'm on the right track. He left behind something valuable and I'm hoping I can find out where he is from. To let him know, of course.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds like a noble cause. I kin tell you this much and nuttin' more. He was talkin' 'bout dinosaur bones and garden gnomes. Now, begone wit' ya. I've got leprechaun things that need tendin' to.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. Both for the clues and the cute ferrets. I love them!

chatpoints.chat_text: Dinosaur bones and garden gnomes. Bones and gnomes.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Miah
npc_list.admin_description: Character isn't currently set up to be around for more than the one quest.  CP does revert to 0, just in case.
npc_list.long_description: Miah, one of Hans and Martha's children, is a sweet little girl with fine black hair.  She seems a bit more soft-spoken and polite than her siblings.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there.  Did you want to talk to me about something?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I noticed that you look a little downhearted.  Is something the matter?
Not really, no.  I'll catch you later.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, I haven't told Mom yet, but I had some trouble earlier, while I was riding my little black Shetland Pony, Minty...
er...

replies.reply_text: You can tell me.  Maybe I can help!
You should tell your mom, she can help you with it.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: You see, I wanted to jump Minty while we were riding through the forest - there's a log in there that we always jump over.  I cantered her toward it, but she refused the jump, I fell off and she galloped away.  She hasn't come back yet, and I'm starting to get really worried.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  I can't go into that forest, though, it gives me a headache.  She'll probably wander out, eventually.  Good luck!
I'm pretty good at making my way through the forest.  I can probably find her for you!
Where in the forest did you fall, and do you have any idea which direction Minty went?
Sure, I was headed in there anyway.  I'll probably spot her as I wander around.  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: It was after we went through Allaire's meadow, we were nearly at the next meadow when I fell.  Minty loves the little hidden meadows full of flowers in the forest.  I keep hoping she's found her way into one of those.

replies.reply_text: That'll help.  I'll check those meadows first.  I'll be back soon with any news.
Oh, that's a really long way in.  I think I'll have to come back later and look.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back!  Did you find Minty?

replies.reply_text: Could you remind me where you fell?
No, not yet.  I'm heading in to look now.
Yes!  She's right outside, and I'm sure she's happy to be home again.  You were right, she was in one of those flowery meadows.
Thank you very much!  I'm glad it all worked out.

npc_list.name: Minty
npc_list.long_description: Minty is a pure black Shetland Pony.  She is one of the sweetest, gentlest ponies you think you've ever met.

chatpoints.chat_text: (<i>Nickers politely.<i>)

replies.reply_text: Awww!  You're awfully sweet!  Miah is really worried about you.  Would you like me to lead you back to her?
Aaargh!  Mad horse!  Run away!
Great!  I'll take you back to her right now.

npc_list.name: Little Miss Moufet
npc_list.long_description: This is a rather slender, kind looking middle-aged woman. Although she is not a young woman, she has such a sweetness to her that she almost seems ageless. Unfortunately, ever since the unfortunate incident with a tarantula, people call her by her nickname. She's given up on reminding them that her first name is actually Patience. Not Little Miss!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patience, a middle aged woman, is fishing off the shoreline, singing in a carefree and lovely way. Her voice is delicate and sweet and drifts out over the ocean waves.)

replies.reply_text: (You hate to interrupt, but how else are you going to find out about Humpty Dumpty's true love?) Excuse me, Patience? May I have a word with you?
(You decide it would be better to simply listen, than interrupt such a sweet song.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patience is startled and stops mid-song.) Oh! I was so lost in my song that I didn't realize anyone else was out here. However did you know where to find me? And thank you for calling me Patience.

replies.reply_text: You are welcome. It is a long story, but the short of it is - I am here on behalf of Humpty Dumpty! Ta daaa!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patience turns pale and shudders at the thought of the giant tarantula.)

replies.reply_text: Oh I am so sorry! I guess I just gave you an awful flashback to that ... um... thing with Humpty. He is dreadfully sorry. Really. I am here to help get you two lovebirds back together.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Patience frowns.) Lovebirds? You are clearly mistaken.

replies.reply_text: Wait. I thought... Humpty said... he was trying to court you? And he brought a gift to your dad?

chatpoints.chat_text: While you say his intent was to court me, I have never met the man. I'm not sure if he mislead you, or if there was some communication breakdown, but let me reassure you, we are not lovebirds.

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. He's clearly head over heels in love with you!

chatpoints.chat_text: The poor man is delusional. How can he be in love with me when he's never said a single word to me?

replies.reply_text: I am so sorry I interrupted your fishing. I have clearly been mislead. I intend to give Humpty a piece of my mind. I hope I haven’t spoiled your day. Good luck on your fishing.

npc_list.name: Ferrel Ironman
npc_list.admin_description: Owner of the Blacksmith Workshop
npc_list.short_description: Ferrel is an artisan of iron.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sent you for 25 pieces of iron and 5 pinches of pixie dust.  Now, could you get a move on, please?

replies.reply_text: That's right... 25 and 5.  I'm on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: How do, how do, how do. What brings you to my little corner of Paradise?

replies.reply_text: Just looking thanks!
Howdy! Fergus O'Toole sent me.  He said it's time to repay him.
Hi!  I'm back with your supplies.
Just wondering, is Fergus' pot ready?
What did you need for the pot again?
Where am I supposed to go again?
Hello! I was hoping there would be something to do in your corner of Paradise. Do you need to have anything done?
Was I doing something for you?
Hi Ferrel!  Gofer sent me to pick up his new bicycle chain, is it ready yet?
You were helping me with Fergus O'Toole's request, and I still need Pixie Dust. Do you have any suggestions for me, since I'm not adventurous enough to get to the Clouds?
Hi Ferrel!  I was wondering if you could repair this brass bell for me?
Hi Ferrel!  I was wondering if you ever work with brass?

chatpoints.chat_text: He did, did he?  Well. I'm a man of my word, what does he need?

replies.reply_text: That's it?  I show up, tell you this pushy little guy says it's time to pay up, and you say okay?  What's up with that!
Someone took his pot of gold, pot and all.  He needs a new pot so he can get his magic back.

chatpoints.chat_text: The poor little guy has lost his magic?  Then I had better make him a new pot to hold his magic.  I'm going to need you to get me some special supplies, though.

replies.reply_text: That figures. What do you need me to get, and how are you going to replace his magic? Are you a magician or something?
Well, too bad. I don't have time right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Goodbye.
Let's see, the iron ore should be no problem, but why the pixie dust?

chatpoints.chat_text: The pixie dust is just magical enough to help Fergus jump start his magic.

replies.reply_text: But where can I find pixie dust?
Okay, I'll be back with your stuff.  Bye!
Sure, tell me!
Sure, I'll be back later.
Thanks, this looks great!  I'm sure he'll appreciate it.  So long!

chatpoints.chat_text: I owe him for saving my life a long time ago, not that it's any business of yours! If he sent you, it's serious.  What happened?

replies.reply_text: Someone took his pot of gold, pot and all.  He needs a new pot so he can get his magic back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, yes, there is something you can do for me. Could you take some bits down to Goodwin Ryder in Appleton for me? I've been so busy that I haven't had time to do it myself.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'd love to!
Nah, I'll pass. Appleton's too far away.
And away I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed. You were going to give Goodwin Ryder some bits for me. I gave you 3 each of English and Western bits to bring to him.

replies.reply_text: Ohhh, that's right! Thanks for the reminder!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You could talk to Mrs. Claus about that. I bet she has some Pixie Dust she can spare.

replies.reply_text: Great idea! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suggested that you might ask Mrs. Claus for some.

replies.reply_text: That's right. Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not me, I'm an iron man!  But...I've heard tell that there is a fellow over on Horse Island that tinkers with brass.

replies.reply_text: I guess I need to get over to Horse Isle and keep looking, thanks for the tip, Ferrel!

npc_list.name: Melanie the Gryphon
npc_list.long_description: What do you know! Looks like Horse Isle has one of those legendary creatures that doesn't quite know what its supposed to be! It has the body of a lion and the head of an eagle. Don't get too close. That beak and those talons look deadly.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Melanie doesn't look very menacing. In fact, she looks pretty lethargic, just laying there.)

replies.reply_text: Hey there, Gryphon! How's it going?
I'm back! Antonio thought you might like these for lunch!
I'm back! Antonio thought you might like this pet!
I'm back. Let's try this for a pet -- but DON'T eat it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Grr--purrrrppp...............grrr-purrrrpppp.

replies.reply_text: How rude! I'm outta here.
Are you growling? Or purring? Or burping?

chatpoints.chat_text: Grr-puuurrrrp awkkkk!

replies.reply_text: Sorry. Wish I could help you, but I just don't speak gryphon!
Let me ask around, and see if someone knows what you are trying to say. I'll be back.
Awww! That made your tummy feel better, huh? But you still don't look very happy.
Flaming Dragon's Breath! You weren't supposed to eat that! I gotta go talk to Antonio. Let me tell you, he is NOT going to be happy about this!
Awww! That is so darn cute! Nighty-night Melanie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Purrrrr--gurp! Grrrurrrrppp.

replies.reply_text: I'm happy I could help with lunch. But that's all I've got time for now. Later, gator! Umm - I mean later, gryphon!
Hmmm. Maybe Antonio and I can think of something else to make you happy. I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Melanie is sleeping peacefully. She's just too cute to wake up!)

replies.reply_text: (You back away quietly.)

npc_list.name: Rodney
npc_list.admin_description: New quest start at CP21
npc_list.long_description: Standing outside of Hoof Isle’s Wagon is a sharp looking man with a straw hat, red bow tie and bright white smile.  You get the impression he wants you to listen to his sales pitch.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.  I'm Rodney from Al Arrington’s Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man Emporium and Warehouse!  I am here to pass the savings on to yoooooooouuu!

replies.reply_text: Uhhh... huh.  Go on?
Ack! Crazy salesman!  I am so not buying this.

chatpoints.chat_text: So, I bet you are wondering what you can do with a Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man?  No, the question is what CAN'T you do with a Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man!!??  Attract customers to your business!  Make a splash at your next presentation! Keep Grandma company!  Protect your crops!  Confuse your neighbors!  Or just raise the roof!!

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow!  I want one!  How much???
No, thanks.  I don’t want something that crazy.  Next thing you know, I’ll be buying a time share in Alaska!  I am so out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: To be honest, I sort of lost all of my Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Men when I got off this wagon here and the wind picked them up!  They flew off in four different directions!!  My boss, Mr. Arrington, from Al Arrington’s Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man Emporium and Warehouse, is going to be so mad with me if I don’t find them soon!  And I have deliveries to make and more cold calling…

replies.reply_text: Easy, now.  You seem really upset.  How can I help?
Oh, no!  I am not buying this sales pitch either!  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the red one flew off and I think I see it waving in those palm trees just to the north of here.  Do you think you can help me?

replies.reply_text: Don't worry about it.  I'll go take a look for you!
No thanks.  I have heard enough cold sales calls to know that this could be a scam somehow!
Sure thing!  I am off to find the Red Wacky Inflatable… something-or-other!

chatpoints.chat_text: If you look up high in the palm trees just north of here, near the bridge, I'm sure you'll find it!

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!
There you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now you need to find the other three Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube men and they went off in different directions!  I think I saw the Green Wacky Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube man go east and it crossed the ocean.

replies.reply_text: You know, I think I'm done for now.
Okay, I'll take a look, but all the way across the ocean?
Where do you think it went again?
I'm back with the green tube do-dad!
Green Wacky Inflata... something on Puuhonua Isle...

chatpoints.chat_text: I think the Green Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man might be on or near Puuhonua Isle.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  Thank you for reminding me!
Oh, here, I'll help you!

chatpoints.chat_text: So now we need to find the other two...   You still want to help find the other Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Men?

replies.reply_text: I'm in!
I think I would rather buy that time-share in Alaska than continue with this craziness!
Yes, but where do you think the blue one went again?
I found the blue one!  It was up at Harry’s barn in Shellton.  He says he might want to buy one in the future.
Maybe if I head to Shellton and ask around, people might know where to find the blue wacky thingy?

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe I saw the Blue Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man fly off to the north and it crossed the water to the bigger isle up there.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll check around in Shellton.  Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh good! Your first sale as a Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man Emporium and Warehouse Sales Person! I will mark that down on the list to go and speak with Harry. You will get compensated for your sale, of course. (He flashes you another brilliant smile.)

replies.reply_text: Here's the blue man.  And compensated?  How much?
That sounds promising!

chatpoints.chat_text: The Pink Wacky Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man didn’t go very far at all.  Just a little east of here, into the woods.  I can’t leave the rest of these guys here alone, because they might fly off again!  Could you be so kind as to look for the last one for me, please?

replies.reply_text: It's the last one and I really need to get compensated for my time... so... yeah, I guess.
All this arm flailing and bright colors is making me kind of nauseous!
Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: But we still need to find the last Wacky Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man.  The pink one.

replies.reply_text: Pink?  Ew!  Pink isn't a man color!  Pink is for girls!  I'm outta here.
Sounds great!  I think.  Where did the last one fly off to, do you remember?
Where did you say the pink one was again?
Here is the LAST wacky crazy arm pink guy thingy!
The pink one in the woods east of here.  Got it!   Be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well it’s all muddy? Tsk tsk! This will have to come out of your 5% sales comp. (He flashes you another salesy smile.)

replies.reply_text: (You toss the mud-soaked Pink Tube Man at Rodney.)
Yeah, thanks for all the wackiness!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.  I'm Rodney from Al Arrington’s Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man Emporium and Warehouse!  I am here to pass the savings on to yoooooooouuu!

replies.reply_text: Oh... great.  Another high-pressure salesman!  No thank you!
Hi Rodney!  Still trying to sell those things, huh?
Umm, yeah.  Hi Rodney.  It looks like one of your wacky tube men got swiped while you weren't looking.  Would you like it back?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find the Red Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man yet?

replies.reply_text: I found the Red tube man in the palm trees, like you said!
Where do you think the Red thingy ma bobby is again?
Not quite yet.  I'll go look now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  Want one?

replies.reply_text: Not now, thanks though.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  I was worried I had lost it again!

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
All right.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Marcus
npc_list.long_description: A very strong and gruff looking man with weathered skin and dark eyes that never seem to miss a detail.  You get the feeling that he's been through a lot in his life and you definitely don't want to get on his bad side.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He squints his eyes, and asks you cautiously:) What do you want?

replies.reply_text: Yes, Sir.  Hello, Sir.  I was wondering, since I worked for my release and all, umm, how do I get back to the mainland?
Uhhh heh heh.  Nothing.  Just passing through!  I didn't do anything, I swear!
Hello again, Sir.  Did you enjoy your peppermints?
I'm back, Sir!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just keep going around, over the bridge to the west, and you'll find a dock back to Earton.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, Sir! Have a nice day! (You back away slowly.)
So what is it that you do around here?

chatpoints.chat_text: I stand here, keep an eye on things, and make sure no one starts any trouble. (He points his finger at you.) What do you do around here?

replies.reply_text: I... uhh... find stuff for people... and take... uhhh stuff to people... Sir.

chatpoints.chat_text: You do, do you?  Hrm.   You know... there is something I need that you could get for me.

replies.reply_text: Yes, Sir!  I can do that.  What do you need?
I could, but.... I have to go.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: All the sand and wind around here really makes my mouth dry.  Do you think you could find me some peppermint candies?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I mean... Yes, Sir!  I think I can manage to do that for you.
I'm sorry, Sir.  I'll need to come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have any luck with my peppermint candies?  I only need 5.  It shouldn't be that hard to find 5 peppermint candies!

replies.reply_text: I, uhhh... forgot. I'll be right back! (You try to gulp, but the air is too dry.)
Where can I find peppermint candies?
I've got them right here, Sir!

chatpoints.chat_text: I hear that Cloud Isle has a magical candy forest where candies are just laying around for you to pick up and they fall off of trees. Like in the movies! (You get the feeling he's being sarcastic, and he starts laughing at his own private joke.) I don't know, kid! Just bring me back 5 peppermint candies, okay?

replies.reply_text: Okay, Sir.  Right away, Sir.
Gee, thanks!  Enjoy your candy, Sir!
Yes, Sir!  Right away, Sir!

chatpoints.chat_text: (This time he gives you a genuine smile.) Yes, I did. That was very nice of you to do that for me.

replies.reply_text: You are very welcome.  I like to do nice things for people.  Is there anything else you need?
You're welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I remember when I was a child, my grandfather would sit me on his lap, tell me stories and stuff peppermint candies in my pockets before I would leave. He's been long gone now, but that was something I have always wanted to do for my grandchildren. Except I am stuck here guarding Prison Isle. (He lets out a sad sigh.)

replies.reply_text: That's such a nice story!  What can I do to help you?
I feel another long errand coming on.  I better go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It would be great to at least share my love of peppermint candies with my grandson, Elliott.  Do you think you could give him some candies from his Papaw?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I can do that for you, Sir.  Where does Elliott live?
Sorry, but I'll come back to help.  I promise!
Yes, Sir!  I'll be right back!
Thank you, and you're welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are?  Did you find my grandson, Elliott, and find those 5 peppermints for him?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did.  He made you something!
Oh, I forgot.  I'll be back later, I guess.

npc_list.name: Haku
npc_list.long_description: You can't even believe it but this sneaky monkey is living in a potted tree at the Hotton Bank!

chatpoints.chat_text: (A little monkey peeks his head out from behind a leaf and chitters at you quietly.)

replies.reply_text: Hello!  You must be Haku!
Such a cute monkey!  See you.
Where am I going next?  I forgot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo. Ooo ooo ooo?

replies.reply_text: (You whisper softly.) I am here to give you bananas from the Monkey Thieves Gui...err... from Matata!
This is nuts.  Later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo ooo eeek!

replies.reply_text: Here you go, little guy.  Where am I supposed to go next?
I don't understand.  I'll come back when I learn Monkish.
A race track?  But which one?  There's the one in Appleton and the one at Equestrian Park!  Well... I guess I will have to try both, huh?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo eeek eek aaaak! (Haku quickly starts running in place.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right!  I need to find the next monkey at a race track!  Maybe I'll check in Appleton first.

npc_list.name: Kuna
npc_list.long_description: Another sneaky monkey hidden behind a fake fern near the ticket counter of the Appleton race track!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eek ooo ooo eeek!

replies.reply_text: There you are, you sneaky little monkey!  I have something for you from your President.
Hello, cute monkey!
I forgot where I was going again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo oooeek? Ooo oo oo eek eek?

replies.reply_text: Uh... It's some bananas from Matata?  Here you go.
Yeah... I'm still not getting it.  Gotta go!
You're welcome.  So I need to go to the Blacksmith on Bird Isle?  I think I might be getting the hang of this!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kuna flaps her arms like a bird, and points at her feet!) Ooo oooo eek!

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay, I get it now!  You said the next monkey is on Bird... probably near the blacksmith!  Got it!

npc_list.name: Unama
npc_list.long_description: Another sneaky monkey hidden in a metal tree.  You can't believe Liam has never seen her before!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eek eek eek ooo?

replies.reply_text: Hello, monkey.  I come bearing gifts from the President of the Monkey Thieves Guild!
Adorable! See ya later, monkey.
Where was I headed again?  I have mushy bananas for brains today!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo eek ooo?

replies.reply_text: Yes, for you.  You like bananas, right?
Yeah, I'm gonna split.  Bye bye monkey.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo eek eek eek!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome very much!  Here you go!  So who's next that I need to see in the Guild?  So far I have seen you, Kuna and Haku.
Bananas, I tell you!  Bye.
Wow!  I didn't know monkeys could sing!  Neat.  I think I will head to Santa's workshop and look for more monkeys there.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Unama seems to hum Santa Claus Is Coming To Town while she swings back and forth on her metal tree.)

replies.reply_text: Ooohhhhh, I get it!  Santa might know where the next monkey lives.  He does have a knack for knowing those sorts of things!

npc_list.name: Akun
npc_list.long_description: Another sneaky monkey hanging from a Christmas tree!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eek ooo?

replies.reply_text: I come with a delivery from Matata, the President of the Monkey Thieves Guild.
Forget this craziness!  I have better things to do, like simple jumping!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oo. Oo eek eek?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Really.  Why don't you believe me?
Nevermind!  I think all this monkey business is getting out of hand.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo eek eek ooo ooo ak. Ooo ak ak eek eek oo. Ooo eek eek ooo ak ooo eek!

replies.reply_text: Huh, really?  I'm sorry to hear that.  Do you still want your bananas?
What?  I don't understand!  Forget it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo eek? Ooo eek eek!

replies.reply_text: Here you go.  I hope things work out for you.  Now who do I see next?
I forgot what I was doing.  I'll be back later.
Hey, wait!  Where are you going? I don't know who the last monkey to see in the Thieves Guild is!  Come back!

npc_list.name: Tahaku
npc_list.long_description: Hidden in the tree behind the Tropicton wishing well is the sneakiest monkey of them all!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eeeek!

replies.reply_text: Shame on you, Tahaku!  You can't steal people's wishes!
I'll come back when I remember what I was going to do here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo oooeek? Ooo oo oo eek eek?

replies.reply_text: I'll make you a deal.  You can have these nice bananas if you give me those coins and stop stealing wishes from now on.  Good deal?
This is just as bad as the remade version of Planet of the Apes!  I gotta go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aak.

replies.reply_text: No more stealing money and wishing coins, okay?  Here are your bananas.
I'm gonna go play on the playground now.  You know... on the monkey bars?  Ha!  Later.
Thank goodness that business is over!  Sheesh!

npc_list.name: BugBug the Ferret
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP14
npc_list.long_description: BugBug is quite an elderly ferret, but happy and lively in her way.

chatpoints.chat_text: ..............Ask Amariel. zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz

replies.reply_text: (You walk away quietly.)
Aww, come on, just a hint?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Hello, dear.

replies.reply_text: EEEE! A RAT! (You run away.)
Hi there, little one.  Maybe you can help me in a quest.  I'm looking for the Magenta Dragon's Egg.
BugBug, you wanted a peppermint ball?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes?

replies.reply_text: Uhm.... And I wondered if you have it?  Or a piece of it?
So, can you help me here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Probably.

replies.reply_text: Okay... So... Do you have what I'm looking for?
Forget it.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You mean this? (BugBug holds up a large shard, magenta on the outside, with a bit of gold on the rim. Evidently, it's a piece off the end of the egg.)

replies.reply_text: Yes, that's what I want.  May I have it?
That's it.  Please let me have it.
Okay, nevermind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why?

replies.reply_text: Because I want it.
Well, okay, you needn't just give it to me. But I promised the Magenta Dragon I'd get it for him, so please... Is there anything you would take in trade for it?
Nevermind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tough. (BugBug pulls her towel over herself and tries to go back to sleep.)

replies.reply_text: All right, all right.  Well, how about we trade?  Is there anything you'd like in exchange for it?
Fine, be that way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Yes, there is.

replies.reply_text: Good, now we're getting somewhere.  What would you like?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would like... One of Mrs. Claus' famous peppermint balls.

replies.reply_text: You want me to go all the way to Christmas Isle?  That's a long, expensive trip!  And besides, it's cold!
Peppermint balls? I think that's doable.
No, sorry, that's too far.  Isn't there something else?
I'm on my way.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  Forget it then.  Bye.
All right then, Christmas Isle it is, I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Just making sure I'm after the right thing.  I'll head to Christmas Isle to get it now.  Bye.
I have it here.  You said you'd trade it for the eggshell, remember?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did I say that?

replies.reply_text: Yes, you did.
Great, now I don't remember either.  Let's start over.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Now I remember.  Did you bring me a peppermint ball?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I just told you I did.  Here it is.
Oh, that was what you wanted.  I'll head to Christmas Isle to get that now.  Bye.
Great!  Thanks!  Goodbye!  Enjoy your treat!
Mended.... Yeah, I'll need to do that.  And I really don't want to have to shlep all the way to Grey Slate!
Mended... Yeah, I'll need to do that.  Any idea where to go to get that done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Do I know you?

replies.reply_text: That's all right, go back to sleep.
Umm..  Yeah, but I guess that doesn't matter.  I need to know where to bring the egg shards.

npc_list.name: Postmaster General
npc_list.admin_description: use 2nd PostGen'l for new cps
npc_list.long_description: A kindly looking gentleman with warm eyes and a caring expression.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  You must be our new recruit to the Pony Express!

replies.reply_text: What's the Pony Express?
I am?  Oh, right.  I am!  Let's get started!
I don't think I am.  What do I have to do?
No, sorry, you have the wrong person.

Sorry, but I'm not here to help you out today. Maybe another time. I'm here because Quincy, the Third Little Pig, received a load of adobe bricks instead of the red bricks he ordered. He's pretty upset about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here at the Pony Express, we deliver parcels and packages to people all over the world.  All you need to do is deliver mail and get paid.  It's that easy.

replies.reply_text: That's it? No finding things in hidden places? No gathering a million things to make something else? No finding lost people in the jungle then traveling all the way across the world again? No gimmicks? Just deliver mail??
I know there's got to be a catch.  Nothing is that easy around here!  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's it. You get paid upon your delivery from the customer and you get to keep all of that money.  There's no need to run back here after every delivery.  That would be silly!  Just come back when you are ready to carry more packages to people.

replies.reply_text: Wow!  That's really easy!
Great!  Well, let's get started!
On my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have been so efficient in delivering parcels for the Pony Express that we don't have any more left to deliver!  Maybe check back in a few days.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Ready for your next delivery?

replies.reply_text: Okay, let's do this again!
I'm sorry, what is this all about again?
Maybe later.
Yup.  Where to next?
This is too easy.  Where's the next package headed?
Ready and waiting!
I'm ready!
I'm ready for more!
Yes, I am!
Okay, I'm ready!
Yuppers!
I'm saddled up and ready to go!
All set and ready to go!
This is too much fun!  I'm ready for more!
Ready to make some more money!
I hope to get more like the last one!  What's next?
I'm good to go!
That Jayne... He sure is a character!  Well, I think I'm ready to go again.
I'm back!
Are there more deliveries?
I'm back and Mr. Bromegrass sends his best to you!  Anything else to deliver?
That was neat! I got a pet rock from Spike!  Do you have any more packages that need delivery?
All done and ready for more!
I'm back, Mr. General, and ready for more deliveries!
Yes, got any more?
I'm ready and so is my horse!
Sure thing, boss. Where to next?
I guess.  I hope people aren't as grumpy today as the last one!
All righty.  I can go again.
I'm ready!
What now?  I'm up for it.
Caelin seemed very nice.  Now what?
Finally found her.  Where to next?

Sorry, but I'm not here to help you out today. Maybe another time. I'm here because Quincy, the Third Little Pig, received a load of adobe bricks instead of the red bricks he ordered. He's pretty upset about it.
That was a cold trip! Brrrrr! I'm ready for another one.
I'm baaaccckk! And ready to roll!
Woody said to say hello. Where do I head next?
Yikes, that was two cold deliveries in a row. Hoping for something warmer this time!
Itzel has the cutest Alpacas! So adorable! Okay, I'm ready for the next one.
Here I go!
Let's ride!
Hi ho, horsey!  Awaaaay!
I'm skiddaddling... er... yeah.  I'm going!
I'm like the Easter Bunny!
But I was just in Hotton for the last delivery!  Ugggghh.
Movin' up and movin' on!
I'm like a little woodland creature... hehe!
I'm shaking a leg... Whatever that means!
I've never seen a vamoose before!!  Ha!  Okay, I'm going!
I'm like a ball and on a roll!
I'm going, but I don't have a tail... nor do I want one!
I'mma tracking!
Willamena Webster in Whiskerton!  Willamena Webster in Whiskerton!  Willaweber..Willamena... Whiskington!
All righty, I'm dashing!
I'mma scurrying!  Bye!
Okay, I'm doing the best I can!
I'll be quick like I have Icarus tack on my horse!
I'm like a speeding mouse!  ¡Andale!
I'm sailing away!
Got it!  I'm outta here like a lamb... but, errr, like a really, really fast lamb!  Yeah...  Bye!
I might have to stop at a clothing store and grab a new winter coat!
I'm breaking! Err, break dancing!  Yeah!
I'm going.  At least this one is close!
I'm off!  Bye!
Hotton!  Okay, I'll be quick.
Caelin?  Great!
Oh, my.  She's such a pain to find!  All right, all right.  I'll go find her.
Brrr!  I'm going!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, that mix-up! It's so embarrassing to admit I made a mistake in getting two deliveries ready. You see, I had one order for red bricks and another for adobe bricks. I was in a hurry, with this being the Pony Express and all, so I must have misread the orders and accidentally swapped the pallets. Luckily, the other person realized the mistake, too, and returned the red bricks they received.

replies.reply_text: It's only natural to make a mistake once in a while. Nobody's perfect! Quincy had me bring back the adobe he got and pick up the brick he ordered.
Okay, I shall! Good luck with your other deliveries.
Pedal to the metal it is, Sir! Whatever that means.

chatpoints.chat_text: Warmer, indeed!

replies.reply_text: I shall follow, follow, follow, follow - Follow the yellow brick road!
I'll weave my way over to Web pronto!
Giddy-upping as fast as I can go!

chatpoints.chat_text: This one goes to a place that is the polar opposite of some place noisy!

replies.reply_text: Wow. You are right. It is heavy. I wonder what's in the package. I'll deliver it now.

npc_list.name: Max the Ferret
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must begin at CP 14

chatpoints.chat_text: Who are you, and why did you wreck my nest?!  It took me days to put all this stuff together!  Sheesh!  Have a care!

replies.reply_text: Uhm... I'm sorry, I, uhm... just didn't know how else to find you.
Yikes! A big, hairy rat! Augh! (You run away.)
Sorry, Max, but... what was I doing for you again?
Okay, Max, I'm back with your pillow!

chatpoints.chat_text: You didn't know how to find a ferret?  Are you crazy?  Just make a noise like a rubber ball with a bell in it.  We'll be right there!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Didn't know that.  Anyway, you wouldn't happen to know what's become of the Magenta Dragon's egg, would you?
Oh, yeah, right.  Silly of me not to think of it.  By the way, you don't know anything at all about the whereabouts of the Magenta Dragon's egg, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The ferret stares you right in the eyes, and then begins bouncing about merrily!) Mine, mine, mine, all mine! Hahahahaha! Finders keepers, losers weepers! Mine, mine, mine!

replies.reply_text: It's very important to the Magenta Dragon, you know.  He'd kind of like it back.
Fine, be that way.
Oh, well, I'll just have to tell the Dragon, "Finders keepers," I suppose.  And then he'll breathe fire on me, and oh well...

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll bet he would!  But I found it, so it's mine now.  Ha!

replies.reply_text: No, it's not! Just because you found it doesn't make it yours! Give me that! (You reach down to take the egg shard, in which Max is comfortably curled.)
Awww, pleeeeeeeeeeease?  The Magenta Dragon wants it really badly!
Nevermind, this quest has been too complicated already.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The ferret stands up, bares his teeth, bushes out his tail, hisses furiously... and suddenly there is an incredible stink all around you!)

replies.reply_text: Augh! PEW!!! EWWW, YUCK! Nobody'd want that stupid eggshell now! Good-bye.
Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeewww! Aww, come on, please? I promised the Magenta Dragon I'd find his egg.

chatpoints.chat_text: This isn't his egg.  It's only part off his egg and anyway, it's mine now.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  Whatever.  See ya.

Okay, okay, well.... look.  Maybe there's something you'd like that you'd be willing to trade for the egg?  I doubt you have any use for money, but if there's something else you want, I'll get it for you in return for the eggshell.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Hmmmm... hmmmm.... well, hmmm....
Okay, well, you know, there is one thing I've always, always wanted. A hotel pillow to sleep on. Hotel pillows are the best kind.

replies.reply_text: What's so special about a hotel pillow?  Or, an Inn pillow, since I haven't run across any hotels here, actually.
No, no.  No more travelling.  I've done enough for a while.  Forget it.  Bye.
Okay, I can do this, I think.  Any particular hotel you fancy?

chatpoints.chat_text: They're made of down, you see.  And they have the name of the hotel... inn, whatever... on it.

replies.reply_text: Ooooooo-kay.  I can do this.  Any particular... hotel... you have in mind?
And you'll give me the eggshell then, right?
Okay, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Max stands on his hind legs and looks highly -- though rather comically -- offended!) My dear rider, I am a weasel of my word!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  It's you.  You were getting me a nice pillow from the Inn in Shellton.  And I want one with the name of the inn on it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are?!  You really did go get me a hotel pillow?!  A real hotel pillow?!

replies.reply_text: Just like I said I would.  Here you go.
Glad you like it.  Bye.
You're very welcome.  Say, by the way, you don't know where I could get the egg put back together, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... you know, I remember... hmmm.... I think I heard Eris say something about Amariel and gold... (After nudging his pillow into exactly the right spot, Max curls up contentedly in the very middle and sighs.) A hotel pillow! And she inscribed it! To me! I won't sleep! I don't want to miss a second of this luxury!

replies.reply_text: Ferrets...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hi, it's you again! (Max jumps around a little and makes soft, "Kyehh-kyehh-khehh!" noises.)

replies.reply_text: Glad to see you're enjoying your pillow!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Rick Hammerstroke
npc_list.long_description: Rick is a very old man, strong and wiry, who has just started a new farriery here in Witherton.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there.  Need some work done?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around, thanks.
That was what I wanted to ask you. I'm pretty handy at finding lost things and stuff like that. Have you lost something that needs finding?
Hey! I'm back with a bit of a problem.
Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back with your wind chimes!
Not exactly, Gofer asked me to see if his bicycle wheels are ready yet.
Hey Rick. Actually, Vladyk does. He said you could fix his chainsaw. I've got it right here.
I'm baaaccckkk! I'm ready to pick up Vladyk's chainsaw and hit the open seas!
I wandered around a bit. Is the chainsaw ready yet?
I practiced being patient. I'm not sure how good I was at it, but I'm hoping it was good enough. Is the chainsaw done now?
As a matter of fact, yes I do!  Can you fix this brass bell?
Yes, if you can....do you work with brass?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'll be a monkey's uncle. I've never been asked that before. You say you're good at finding stuff?

replies.reply_text: Depends on what it is. But I especially like buried treasure and things of that nature!
I'm one of the best on these isles. You can bet your dinner on it. Oh, speaking of dinner -- I need to eat. I'll be back later, gator!
I am, indeed! Sometimes it takes me longer than I'd like, but I get the job done.
Monkey's uncle? Don't tell me you escaped from the zoo!

chatpoints.chat_text: I made a bunch of finely detailed copper trinkets and strung some up to catch the wind. Made the prettiest little sound. Only had 'em up two days before they went missing.

replies.reply_text: I bet I could track them down. I could ask people around here if they've seen them. Then I'll follow the trail of answers!
Sounds like a waste of time to me. Who likes wind chimes anyway? Not me! So I'll just skedaddle right on out of here!
Speaking of the wind, I have to catch it myself! I've got things to do, places to see, and all that stuff. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. But when I was a kid, I sure wanted to run away and join one. I've been working with horse shoeing since I was a toddler.

replies.reply_text: Wait! That can't be right. A little kid can't shoe a horse.
I wanted to join the zoo, but I heard you have to clean up after the elephants. Yucky! This zoo talk is for the animals. Speaking of which, I need to feed mine now. Bye!
I'm glad to see you didn't run away. I'm sure you would have been missed. Speaking of missed, I think I missed my dinner. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I helped my dad. Fanning the fires, listening to him pound out the shoes. My granddaddy and my great-granddaddy were farriers, too.

replies.reply_text: No wonder you wanted to run away. It must get boring doing the same thing over and over again.
Wow. That's a lot of horse shoeing! Makes my head swim just thinking about it. I'm going to go lay down for a bit. Bye.
That's way too many farriers for me! I'm heading out now. Have a nice day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I haven't got any treasure for you, I'm sorry to say. Not in the typical treasure sense. But I enjoyed my wind chimes -- pretty little copper trinkets that the slightest breeze would set off. If you could find them, I'd surely appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I'm not into wind chimes. Too noisy for me! I'm outta here.
Wind chimes? I could do that for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: It does indeed. That's why I started making copper trinkets. Out of sheer boredom. Then I didn't know what to do with all these little things, so I strung 'em up and hung them on the rafter.

replies.reply_text: You know, I bet other people would like your wind chimes. Maybe you could be a farrier AND a coppersmith.
Speaking of boredom... this conversation is putting me to sleep! Bye!
Sounds interesting. Maybe I can come back and talk to you some more later. Right now, homework is calling! Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You might be on to something there. Tell you what, you find my wind chimes and you and I can go into business! Are you willing to look for the missing ones?

replies.reply_text: That sounds great! You make them, I deliver them. But of course, you'll need a sample, right? That's why you need me to find the first one! I am ready, Freddy. I mean, Rick. Yea, I'm ready!
Partners? You know, I really prefer working alone. But I appreciate the offer. Have a great day.
I'll think about it. Right now, I've got to meet up with some friends. Later!
I'll start asking the town's folk right away. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to ask around town and see if anyone had seen my missing wind chimes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right. You know, I just don't have time for this kind of nonsense. I'm gone like yesterday!
I'll get right to it! Be back in a few.

chatpoints.chat_text: What kind of problem?

replies.reply_text: I found out the Bridge Troll took your wind chimes. Problem is, he won't give them to me unless I give him copper ore in return!
Nothing I can't handle. I'll just need more time to get this quest done. Don't you worry about a thing. I'll get those wind chimes back to you soon. Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid I can't help you. I need more copper ore myself.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Thanks anyway. I'll see if I can dig some up on Saddle Isle. See you later.
Thanks so much!  See you around.
Thanks, I'll get these right back to Gofer.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cutting ice blocks is really hard on a chainsaw. Seems I fix this thing every couple of months. I'll just put this on Vladyk's tab.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll be back soon.
Okay. Maybe I'll go pick up logs or sticks in the forest.
Alrighty then! Be back soon.
Whew! My lack of patience was getting the best of me. Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I don't work with brass or bronze.  I've hear tell of a fellow on the big island who works with brass as a kind of a hobby.  I'd try to find him.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for the suggestion, looks like I'm on my way to Horse Isle.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Timothy Bromegrass
npc_list.admin_description: Livery owner in Witherton

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there, welcome to Witherton Livery.  Can I do anything for you?

replies.reply_text: Just looking, thanks.

Yes, maybe you can.  Sumiko Stallman down in Appleton is setting up a Riding for the Handicapped program.  She needs buckets and tubs for the new barn.  Do you have any of those that you can part with?
I was hoping you had six empty feed sacks you'd be willing to part with.
Excuse me, but I have a package from the Pony Express for you!
You sure can. Rick Hammerstroke is missing his wind chimes. You wouldn't happen to know anything about them, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, no, sorry, I don't.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.
I sure will and thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. Not really.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Bye.

npc_list.name: Hansel
npc_list.short_description: A New Baker on the Cloud Isles
npc_list.long_description: Hansel is an over achieving entrepreneurial type, out to take over Horse Isle one cookie at a time.

chatpoints.chat_text: We're not open for business yet.  Come back next month!

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry.  I'll come back once you're open.
What kind of business are you opening?
Hi!  I'm back with your supplies and the signed copies of the letters of credit.
Sorry, but what am I doing for you again?
I'm back with the produce from your list.
I'm back with the pantry items from your list.
I'm back with the dairy items from your list.
I gave you everything, right?
Oops, I'm sorry.  I just had a "moment"...  What about this incredibly long list?
Sorry, but I'm here from Olivia, and--
I know, but, Martina sent me with a wedding cake order.
Sorry, I got a little distracted.  Is everything ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Isn't it obvious? We're in a gingerbread house... Duh!! (Over his shoulder.) Gretel, make sure the sign painter makes the sign nice and big for the outside of the bakery!

replies.reply_text: So, could you use some help getting this place up and running?
I can see that you are busy, so I'll be going.  Nice meeting you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now that you mention it, I could use some help here.  I've been so busy with the designs and equipment for the bakery that I haven't really had the time to set up my suppliers.

replies.reply_text: I'm way too busy for such a big job right now, maybe later. Good luck with the shop!
Sure, I can help.  What do I have to do?
Wow, this is a mighty long list!
You need all of this!?
So, all I have to do is find you a supplier and give them one of these letters.  That's it?
Well... I guess, if all I have to do is run down a bunch of names for you....

chatpoints.chat_text: Heavens, no! I need you to bring back one shipment per vendor.  You can bring them back all at once or as you collect them.  Make sure that they sign the letter and give you a copy!  That's as important as the actual supplies.

replies.reply_text: (Looking over the supply list.) If you don't mind my asking, how can you run a bakery without sugar? There's no sugar on the list.
Don't you use honey in a bakery?  You don't list honey here....

chatpoints.chat_text: Not to worry, I have my sugars and honey vendors all set, as well as yeast and assorted other nuts.  That's all I still need.

replies.reply_text: Okay, but I have one more question.  Do you have any idea where I should begin looking for your suppliers?
Oh, okay then. I don't have a clue where to start though, any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Who are you, Lt. Columbo? I don't know.  Why don't you ask at the grocery stores and see where they get their supplies?

replies.reply_text: Very well then, I'm off.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
Geez, I'm sorry.  I'll be back as soon as I can find your vendors.

chatpoints.chat_text: What superb produce.  You've done an incredible job!

replies.reply_text: Here are the apples.
Here are the oranges.
Here are the berries.
Here are the coconuts.
Here are the walnuts.
I'll be back with the rest soon!
That should be all of the produce!

chatpoints.chat_text: I gave you a list of vendors that I need to find for our bakery.... Remember??

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, the list.  I'm on it.  See you soon!
So, all I have to do is find you a supplier and give them one of these letters.  That's it?
Don't worry, there's more!
I have to get the rest of the items, I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the produce!
Wait, I've got more!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the produce!
There's more, don't worry.
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
I've got more, okay?

That should be all of the dairy items!
That should be all of the dairy items!
And there's still more!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
Hold on, there's more!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the dairy items!
And the produce keeps on coming!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the produce!
Hold on, I've got more!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the dairy items!
Calm down, I've got more.
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
And there is still more!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the produce!
Here's something else to cross off of your list.
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be all of the produce!
There's some real prime things here, just wait and see!
I have to get the rest of the items.  I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
Thanks!  Good luck with the final preparations and opening!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful, now follow me and we'll put the dairy products in the refrigerator.  That's the butter, eggs, milk and cream cheese.

replies.reply_text: I'll be back with the rest soon!
Here's the milk.
Here's the butter.
Here's the cream cheese.
Here are the eggs.
That should be all of the dairy items!
Here are the apples.
Here are the oranges.
Here are the berries.
Here are the coconuts.
Here are the walnuts.
I'll be back with the rest soon!
That should be all of the produce!
Here are the spices. Rika added a few more that she thought you might need.  She said to let her know if there are any more spices you need.
Here's the flour.  Chaffie said that she sent an assortment of flours that she thought you would need.  She wants you to let her know exactly which ones you want with your next order.
Here's the molasses.
I'll be back with the rest soon!
That should be everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! You can put it on that shelf.

replies.reply_text: Here are the spices.  Rika added a few more that she thought you might need.  She said to let her know if there are any more spices you need.
Here's the flour.  Chaffie said that she sent an assortment of flours that she thought you would need.  She wants you to let her know exactly which ones you want with your next order.
Here's the molasses.
I'll be back with the rest soon!
That should be everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, it's different for Olivia. We struck a deal- she'll use our sprinkles, and make sure to tell everyone where they came from! Ours aren't ordinary sprinkles- they're made with magic! So her cookies will be outrageous and everyone will want to know about our products! Win-win!

replies.reply_text: Made with magic? Is that so?
I'll make sure she remembers. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: A wedding cake?? Whose wedding is Martina planning?

replies.reply_text: Oh, Holli Daysin from Tropicton.
Martina is working for a girl in Tropicton, Holli Daysin.
Sure I'll wait right here, (Everything around you looks so delicious you are tempted to help yourself to it all!)
No problem, I'll wait.

Thanks, I'll get this right back to Martina. By the way, I don't suppose....could I get a sample for myself? (Hansel hands you a creme puff, which you pop into your mouth.) Soooo good! Thanks and bye.

npc_list.name: Gretel
npc_list.long_description: Gretel is another overachieving type, just like her brother.

chatpoints.chat_text: You there, are you from the Architect, the Contractor, or the Sign Painter?

replies.reply_text: Um, none of the above?  I was just passing by and thought I'd drop in, but I can see that you're busy.  Bye!
Sorry to disturb you, I was sent to pick up Lord Oberon's order.  Is it ready?
Excuse me, Gretel, but what did you need me to get again?
Hi!  I'm back with the feathers and moonbeams.  Are the cookies ready?
Sorry to bother you again, but who gets these trays?
Um, no, none of those, actually.  I was just wondering if there is anything I can do for you.
I have the feeling I was doing something for you. Was I?
None of the above. I'm looking for a baker who was once known as, er, Long Matty Black. I don't suppose...?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's almost ready, would you mind helping me out a bit here?

replies.reply_text: I guess so.  What do you need?
No, I'm here to get the cakes, that's all.  I'll come back later!
That's all you need?  I'll be back in no time, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Rolling her eyes.) I swear, the help these days! I asked you to get me 6 sparkling feathers and 6 moonbeams.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, now I remember.  I'll be right back.
Will do, thanks, Gretel!

chatpoints.chat_text: Honestly!  Couldn't they have found anyone more reliable than you?!  Bring those trays to Oberon.  I believe he said he'd be in the clearing in Mystic Forest.

replies.reply_text: Right.  I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do for me? Well, Hansel and I have been wanting to bring Mother Goose a plate of cookies, but we just haven't had the time.

replies.reply_text: Mother Goose? Does she live up here? And why do you want to give her cookies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, she lives up here. Her home is near where Winchell's balloon drops you off. We're giving her cookies to celebrate the nearing grand-opening of our bakery! Besides, who doesn't love receiving cookies?

replies.reply_text: I see. I don't think I could think of anyone who doesn't like cookies! I'd be more than happy to give some to Mother Goose, if you want.
You can't trust me with cookies. I'd eat them all before I got out of this candy forest! I'll pass, sorry.
It's no problem. I just have to resist eating them, that's all! I'll be sure to get these to Mother Goose right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She groans.) Of course you're doing something for me! Why else would you be carrying around a bunch of cookies? Give those to Mother Goose. She lives by the place Winchell's balloon drops you off at.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right! I'll go give those to her now.

chatpoints.chat_text: My goodness, no! That sounds like the name of a pirate!

replies.reply_text: It is, actually, but I can tell it wasn't you. Thanks for your time.

npc_list.name: Humpty Dumpty
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start on CP38
npc_list.long_description: Humpty looks nothing like an egg! In fact, he sort of reminds you of a chubby and rosy cheeked Sherlock Holmes as he sits there puffing on his Calabash pipe. Humpty is sitting on a finely crafted and tufted red velvet chaise lounge that clearly looks out of place in this quaint cottage.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day. Perchance you've come with tales of adventure?  Please? I so long for a fine tale of intrigue and mystery.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, no can do. But maybe you can clear something up for me. You're Humpty Dumpty, right?
Hello again. No tales of adventure today. But the last time we chatted, I left with the impression that you might have come to Cloud to escape your past, or maybe it was to find your true love?
Hey there. I need to discuss somethings with you about my search for Patience. Got a minute?
Nope. Not in the mood to rescue anyone. I've got things to gather. So off I go, gathering!
You once mentioned a small favor. Did you still need that taken care of?
Here's a story for you. Telling me you love someone you have never even spoken to! I've found the Patience you were looking for, but this has been a wild goose chase!
Can we talk a bit more about your true love?
Can you remind me what we had just discussed?
There was so much to take in with what you were telling me, I've forgotten where I planned to head next.
What was the third thing you told me about Patience?
Please tell me more about your true love.
I think I was doing something for you. Can you remind me what it was?
I'm back with the perfect birthday gift for your mother!
