replies.reply_text: All right.  I guess I really don't have much of a choice here.  What do you want?
Oh, no!  Puck just said to notify you, not go running around for you!
I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ten candy canes and a Geode.  Remember, a Geode will look like any other rock, except it weighs less than it would appear to.

replies.reply_text: Right!!  On it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hast thou brought all that I asked of thee?

replies.reply_text: Yes, ma'am.  I have it all right here.  Ten candy canes and a Geode!
I'm off to Jungle Isle, then.  Thank you, m'lady.

chatpoints.chat_text: On the outer islands of Jungle Isle by the native woodworker.  And he shall send thee further.

replies.reply_text: I forgot.  Once again, thank you, m'lady!

npc_list.name: Laurence
npc_list.admin_description: Northern most hut on Torrid Isle/New Quests begin at CP9
npc_list.long_description: It appears that Laurence has been trying, for rather a long time, to learn to tie a long piece of cloth into a desert turban--and has been failing miserably!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello... Just a moment... I'll be right with you... Oh bother, can you help me?

replies.reply_text: I guess I can.  What are you trying to do?
Nope, sorry, it doesn't look like anyone could help you!
Sorry, but where am I going for you again?
Hi Laurence, I'm back with everything you asked for, and a bonus!
Hi, I have the material for your turban!
I might be able to, when I have some time. I was wondering if you knew of a man by the name of Sundance?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to tie my desert turban, but I can't quite get the hang of it. Do you know how to make one? (Laurence is wrapping his head with a long, ratty piece of cloth. He looks like a ghost tied up in knots!)

replies.reply_text: Hmmmm...  I saw "Lawrence of Arabia" once, maybe I can help.
No, that is definitely out of my league.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, T.E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia.  He's my idol!!  I want a turban just like his.

replies.reply_text: I sense a job coming.  I'm sorry, I don't have time for any more errands.
All right, I can do this.  What do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: You might want to check in the library to find out how to make one. This material is getting too raggedy.  Could you also get me some fresh cotton or linen material?

replies.reply_text: I could do that for you. Do you have any particular library in mind?
Shellton it is!  I'll be back as soon as I can, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, I asked you to talk to Miss Beatrice in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: Shellton it is!  I'll be back as soon as I can, bye!
Thank you.  Good luck with that turban now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Let me see what you brought!

replies.reply_text: Well, Miss Beatrice sent these simple instructions for tying a turban, oh, and she sent this book about T.E. Lawrence for you, too.
But wait, there's more!  I have some new linen for you to make your turban with!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again! Thanks for the help with my turban. Doesn't it look smashing? (Laurence does a short spin to show off the turban.)

replies.reply_text: Well, you certainly look like Lawrence of Arabia now. See you around, bye!
Hello again, Laurence, how are things going?
Sorry Laurence, but where was I going for you again?
Hi Laurence, I'm back from Hessa's.  Wait till you see this gear!
Laurence, I'm sorry, but where did you say I should look for Chauncey?
Hey Laurence, I'm back and I've brought Chauncey back with me!
By the way Laurence, has Chauncey come back yet?
Hey there, Laurence! I've brought you something.
Hey there, Laurence! I've brought you something.
It does look smashing. Utterly and completely smashing. Say, would you happen to know a man by the name of Sundance? I understand he lives on this island but I am not sure where.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank goodness, it's you again!  I'm so happy you came by, I'm afraid I need your help again.

replies.reply_text: Well... what seems to be the matter?
I'm sorry to hear that, Laurence, but I'm a little pressed for time.  Maybe next time I'm in the neighborhood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you happen to see Chauncey by my hut when you got here?

replies.reply_text: That depends, who's Chauncey?
There wasn't anybody outside your hut, why?

chatpoints.chat_text: Chauncey is gone!  We had a bit of a disagreement, and now he's gone!!  You have to help me!!!

replies.reply_text: Slow down, Laurence, who is Chauncey?
I can't help you if I don't know who I'm looking for...

chatpoints.chat_text: Chauncey is... (Laurence is becoming more upset.) Chauncey is my beloved... Chauncey is my beloved companion.

replies.reply_text: There, there, Laurence... Can you give me a description of Chauncey?  That way I could ask around and try to find him.
Oh, calm down, Laurence.  I'm sure Chauncey will come back once he calms down.  I could look around for him.  What does he look like?

chatpoints.chat_text: He's tall, tan, big brown eyes... and he spits when he's mad.  Oh, and he has 1 hump...

replies.reply_text: You know, it sounds like you're describing a camel...
A hump???  Are you sure you're not describing Quasimodo?

chatpoints.chat_text: Chauncey is my camel... (Stares coldly at you.) What did you think I was talking about?

replies.reply_text: A camel?  You want me to find a camel??  I'm sorry, I don't do camels.  Hope you find him, bye!
Okay, I'm not doing much else right now, what can you tell me about his disappearance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he wanted a new harness and saddle... and I ordered some very special ones for him... but he ran off yesterday... (Laurence is getting upset again.)

replies.reply_text: All right, calm down.  What do you need me to do?
Okay, now this is getting too involved, perhaps another time. See ya!
So, I'm off to Santon... I'll be back in a jiff!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, the desert plays tricks with your mind... I asked you to go to Santon's Special Gear.

replies.reply_text: That's right, for Chauncey's new tack.  I'll be right back.
Uh oh... I sense a "but" coming... Isn't Chauncey back yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I thought for sure he'd come back by now... You've got to help me find him!

replies.reply_text: I guess I could help. Where do you think he might be?
All right, calm down... I'll help. Any suggestions?
I really can't right now.  I'll come back, okay?

chatpoints.chat_text: He likes the desert trees like the one outside of this hut.  He likes the berry patches, the coconut palms and of course the oasis. Remember, he doesn't like cacti.

replies.reply_text: Okay, let's see... desert trees, coconut palms, berry patches, the oasis... but forget about cactus plants.  I got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Chauncey's back? You found him? Oh, happy day! Let me give him his tack and I'll be right back. (Laurence brings the tack out to Chauncey and returns.) It fits perfectly! How can I thank you?

replies.reply_text: That's okay... (After Laurence returns.) So how does Chauncey look?
Thanks, Laurence!  If you need anything else, just let me know.  Bye!
Okay, let's see... desert trees, coconut palms, berry patches, the oasis... but forget about cactus plants.  I got it!  See you soon!
Hope he likes them! I'll be sure to tell her that, and have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but these toothbrushes will never do. Chauncey loves chewing, and will bite right through these. I guess I shouldn't have ordered them.

replies.reply_text: Darn! Karee Dentin did say something about that. No worries, I'll be back shortly! I've got to see Liam, the blacksmith.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do indeed! Odd fellow. A bit of a teller of tall tales. I believe he is what you'd call a wandering man. He is off somewhere on the other side of the island. Good luck finding him.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.

npc_list.name: Vivian
npc_list.admin_description: Lives in South West Hut, Torrid Isle
npc_list.long_description: Vivian is a tall, slender woman, with a classy, graceful style.  Her relaxed, pleasant manner puts you instantly at ease.  You feel like you could talk with her about anything, and she'd understand.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings!

replies.reply_text: Hello.  I don't think I've met you before.  Did you just move here?
Hello again, Vivian.  I have returned with the inspiring item!
Sorry, I can't remember.  What was it that you wanted me to do for you?
I had to leave quickly, after I showed you the inspiring item.  I was just wondering, were you inspired?
Farewell!
Greetings, to you also. I was wondering if you might know of a man by the name of Sundance? I understand he lives on this island, but I have no clue where to find him.
And greetings to you! Leif sent me to pick up a coloring book and asked me to tell you how much he appreciates your efforts. Would that be ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: I did indeed, thank you for asking.  You are my first visitor,  in fact.

replies.reply_text: Well, it must be a busy time for you.  Do you have any errands you'd like me to run for you?
Ah, well, I try to pop in on everyone I find!  Goodbye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's nice of you to ask -  I do have one favor you could do for me, though it might seem a little strange.

replies.reply_text: Oh, really?  Try me.  I'm sure I've heard stranger.
Naw, strange errands are not my cup of tea.  Never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd love a fresh decorating theme for my new house.  I was hoping the fates would intervene with inspiration.  How would you like to play fate for me?

replies.reply_text: Sounds fun!  What should I do?
Sounds silly.  You should figure it out for yourself.
That sounds very simple!  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please just walk around on the yellow desert sand until you find any item.  The first item you find, bring it back to me and perhaps I'll be inspired by it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I remember now.  I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Splendid!  Quickly, let me see what you found!  I won't keep whatever you've brought, by the way, I'll just look.

replies.reply_text: I found this vivacious little lizard!
I found an ominous scorpion!
I found a glorious diamond!
I found a coconut... I'm not sure if that's very inspiring.
Oh, I didn't find anything yet.  Sorry, I'll go back and look again.
Wow, you got all that out of it?  That sounds like a great theme to me!
Hmm, well, to each his own.  It sounds like a theme that you'll be happy with, though.
Wow, you got all that out of it?  That sounds like a great theme to me!
Hmm, well, to each his own.  It sounds like a theme that you'll be happy with, though.
Wow, you got all that out of it?  That sounds like a great theme to me!
Hmm, well, to each his own.  It sounds like a theme that you'll be happy with, though.
Wow, you got all that out of it?  That sounds like a great theme to me!
Hmm, well, to each his own.  It sounds like a theme that you'll be happy with, though.
Thanks.  I'm always glad to help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sundance? Oh my. He has an amazing horse. A splendid and intelligent example of what a horse can be. I love horses, don't you? Any hoo - you find him on the other end of the island. Seems like he enjoys strolling through the desert.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have the coloring book right here! I've know Lief since grade school. He's a good man. Please tell him I was happy to do it.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she'll love it! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Janice
npc_list.admin_description: Easternmost hut on Torrid Isle   new quests start on CP#12
npc_list.short_description: A Young Woman with Startlingly Blue Eyes
npc_list.long_description: Janice watches as you approach her. You wonder, is she looking at you, or past you, or just plain not paying attention to anything at all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhhh, like, hiii...  Where did you come from?

replies.reply_text: Heyyyy man, I don't know!  I'll go find out!  Byeee!
I came from the outside.  Now I'm inside.  Where did you come from?

Hi back. Doesn't matter where I came from, where I want to go is more important. I want to go to where ever Sundance is. I understand he's quite an interesting person. Do you know where I might find him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Woah -  A true existentialist.  Far out!  You should stay and rap with me for a while, and join me in a beverage.  Fer shurrr!

replies.reply_text: That would be great!  It's awfully hot here.
No thanks.  I'm in a hurry, and you talk too slowly.  Bye.
Oh, right, I get it.  Thanks!
Oh, right, I get it.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: So, like, that was such awesome ginger ale.  Are you wondering what you might be able to do to return the favor?

replies.reply_text: Oh, er... yeah.  I was, indeed.  I was just too shy to ask.
No, not really.  I figured it must have made your day to be able to share your ginger ale with me.  I'll be off now!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's so funny that you bring it up, man! I totally could use a favor!

replies.reply_text: You don't say!  What can I do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: So, I guess I like, need to explain a little, you know?  Do you know what a spinner is, man?

replies.reply_text: Like a spider, right?
A fishing lure?
Like Koko on Igneous Isle, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haw! Haw, haw, haw, man! Yer really cracking me up! Oh, gee! Oh, fer shur! (Gasp.) Ooh! I've gotta tell my mom that one! Noooo man, a spinner is someone who takes like, some kind of fiber and like, twists it up into a thread, man.

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course I knew that. I was just checking if you did. So, are you a spinner?
I'll be back after you're done cracking up.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: I totally know what a spinner is!  I'm not one, but, like, my mom is!

replies.reply_text: So, forgive me for getting to the point, but is there something I can help you with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, man. Now here comes the bummer part of my tale. Do you want a tissue? I'll have one. (Sniff.) We just moved here, and like, on the way, all my mom's stuff like, totally got ruined, man.

replies.reply_text: Ew, that's bad.  So I'm supposed to have someone make you a new, er... spinning wheel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, man.  I think just find someone who could sell you one.  They're kinda fancy, right?  I don't think we want a homemade one.  I'd totally give you the money fer one, as long as it wasn't more than like, $6,000.  Do you think you can do it, man?

replies.reply_text: Piece of cake!
I'll pass.  Maybe some other time.
Thanks!  I know the perfect person to ask.  I'll be back shortly!
Do you have any ideas about who might have a spinning wheel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, there you are again, man!  Totally!  You're there!

replies.reply_text: Hi!  Do you have any ideas about who might have a spinning wheel?
Yes, I am, and so is your new spinning wheel!
Totally!  It's good to see you again, Janice.
No, I'm not there.  Can't you see that I'm here?  Sheesh!  I'm outta here!
Here and there. A bit of everywhere. Where I'd like to be next is where ever Sundance is. I understand he is quite the character. Would you know?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, man... but like, if you don't know anyone with a spinning wheel lying around, you might ask someone who makes cloth.

replies.reply_text: Got it.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooooh, it's totally so beautiful!  Woooah!  I never expected you to get such a nice one, man.  Did you really buy it for under $6,000?

replies.reply_text: I don't remember.  I'd better go.  There's some money burning a hole in my pocket.  Not sure how I got it, but it's got to be spent.  Bye.
Actually, I got it for free!  The lady who gave it to me said it was a gift to her, and wouldn't take money.  So here is your $6,000 back!
Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Woooah! That's totally interesting, man! Totally don't know the man. Maybe I'd like too? Wish I could help you, but no can do!

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks for your time.

npc_list.name: Maude
npc_list.short_description: A Woman with Startlingly Blue Eyes
npc_list.long_description: This is Maude, the mother of them all.  She has the same electric blue stare as her daughters.  She seems slightly distracted.  Perhaps she just woke up!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Yawn!) Hello there! Please forgive me for being uninteresting at the moment. I just woke up.

replies.reply_text: You're forgiven!  I'll stop by a little later.
No problem! I remembered that your daughter said you were a spinner. I was wondering if I could get a skein of silken strands.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh I'm sorry. I wanted to take up spinning, but I haven't gotten around to it yet. But I wish you well in finding what you need.

replies.reply_text: Well darn. Thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Felicia
npc_list.long_description: This must be Janice's little sister.  Felicia looks to be a few years younger, but many times more alert.  She also has strikingly beautiful blue eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Have you met my big sister?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I've met her.  Who are you?
Nope.  Bye!
You're the one I want to talk to you. I'm hoping you might know a man by the name of Sundance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no one, really.  I haven't learned anything yet.  I probably never will.  Janice is the one.

replies.reply_text: The one?
Sounds creepy!  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, she's the next spinner, you know.  Mom has been teaching Janice nearly her whole life.  She's important!

replies.reply_text: Aw!  You're important to your mom, too, I'm sure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah, I am.  I'm just into different things.  I like scrapbooking and stuff.  I've never liked spinning.  So, Mom and Janice have more in common, that's all.

replies.reply_text: Where IS your mom, by the way?  I keep hearing about her, but I've certainly never met her.
I know the feeling.  Well, goodbye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I - I'm not quite sure.  She was around here somewhere.  I haven't seen her for a few hours now.  I hope she's okay.

replies.reply_text: Didn't you just move in?  Maybe she dashed off to run an errand?
Maybe there was a cave-in.  Did you check under these huge piles of stuff?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, you're probably right.  I guess she'll be back soon.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she will be.  I'll come back and meet her soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no!  Do you think so?  Can you help me check?

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she's not really, I was just making a joke.
Er, maybe she is.  I'll help you search!  Hey, I've always wondered if cleaning house with a rake would work.  Do you mind if I try?
No problem.  This will be fun!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.  Did you find my mom?

replies.reply_text: Felicia, you'll never believe it.  Your mom is taking a nap in a big pile of papers over there.
No, I just sort of stood here looking around, then decided to talk to you again.  I was hoping that she'd show up in the mean time.  I'll get back to looking through these piles now.
I hardly did anything, but thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  My mom is awake now, so you can meet her properly, or have a chat with my sister!

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I was just wondering how you are doing.
That's okay, I was just wondering how you are doing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, me?  I'm fine.  Happy as a clam.  Thanks for asking!

replies.reply_text: Great.  Just making sure.
Great.  Just making sure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I don't talk to strangers. I'm sorry I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: No worries. Sounds like you are a smart young lady. Have a great day.

npc_list.name: Jordan Row
npc_list.admin_description: will get players without enough money off the isle
npc_list.long_description: Standing before you is a large, gruff looking man with a beard that is maybe only a few days old.  His face and skin look weathered from a lot of sun exposure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.

replies.reply_text: Hello.  I think I'm just heading out.  Glad this dock is here!  Bye.
Umm...  Hi.  I actually, ummm, don't have the boat fare.  I noticed there are no stores on the isle, so I can't really earn more.
Package delivery from Pony Express!
Hello! I am looking for a man by the name of Sundance. You wouldn't happen to know him, would you? I need to find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you better start swimming, then.

replies.reply_text: What?!?  Swim?!  Are you crazy?  I guess I'll go talk to others and see if there is any way I can possibly get some money.
Swim?!  Well, I do really need to get off this isle.  Which way do I go?

chatpoints.chat_text: (He points due north.) It's not far. I'm sure you'll make it fine.

replies.reply_text: (Gulp.) All right... Here I go!
That looks like an awfully long way.  On second thought, I'll see if there's any way I can get some money on this isle.
Thanks and good luck on that!

chatpoints.chat_text: More than I'd like to. That man is a talker. He wanders around in the desert. Past the pyramid.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.

npc_list.name: Wendy
npc_list.long_description: A young girl who looks upset.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The young girl stares up at an object that appears to be stuck in the nearby tree.)

replies.reply_text: Hello there.  Are you Wendy?
Sorry to bother you.  I was just passing through.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.

replies.reply_text: Good point.  I'll just be leaving now.
Oh, I'm sorry.  Your uncle sent me to bring you home.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you're not a stranger, then you should prove it.

replies.reply_text: This is getting ridiculous.  I'm leaving.
Okay.  How would you like me to do that?
That doesn't sound too bad.  I'll just need to stop by Griffin's, I mean your uncle's, and then I'll come back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you bring the ladder yet?

replies.reply_text: No, I'm sorry, not yet.
Where did you say I could get the ladder again?
Yes, I did!  Here it is.

chatpoints.chat_text: My uncle Griffin has it.  I can't talk to you until you bring me the ladder.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I should be back shortly.
You're welcome.  I'll be back later.
Of course, but we need to go back to your uncle now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for getting my kite out of the tree for me.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome, but we do need to be going now.
Okay.

npc_list.name: Emmett Perl
npc_list.admin_description: sends player to Rain Isle ..
npc_list.long_description: In front of you is a small, older man with spectacles that are far too small for his face.  He obviously spends a lot of time hunched over things as it appears his back is stuck that way.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Without looking up from the stones in front of him.) Please, do come in. Let me know if I can help you in any way.

replies.reply_text: I can see you're busy.  I'll just go.  Bye.
Thanks!  Umm...  Why are you out on this island?  It's so far away from everything.
You can.  Could you please send me back to Rain Isle?
Hi there.  Got a minute?
I hope you can.  I stumbled upon a poor soul at the very end of this island chain.  He really needs to get inside from the elements. Do you have any suggestions where he could move?

chatpoints.chat_text: (He answers without lifting his head.) The farther from the masses, the more interesting things there are to be found!

replies.reply_text: Huh...  Interesting.  I never thought of it that way.  Well, I'll leave you to your work.  Bye!
Neat!  Say, do you know anything about that small isle just north of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: (He sets his magnifying glass down and finally looks up at you with a small, but friendly smile on his face.) Rain Isle? Sure. Many fascinating things come from there. There is something odd about the isle, though. I believe the person that lives there is a little.... well, peculiar, if you understand what I mean.

replies.reply_text: Crazy?  A crazy person lives there?
Thanks for letting me know.  I think I'll just avoid that isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He lets out a laugh that seems out of place for his small stature.) That would be one way to put it. Let's say eccentric.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I'll just leave it at that.  Thanks for the warning!  Bye.
Would you be able to send me there?  I would love to check out this place.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure can.  Hopefully you will be able to find a way back.

replies.reply_text: Oh, there's no guarantee I can get back?!  Forget that.  I'll just stay on Vine, then.  Bye.
I'm sure I'll figure something out.  Go ahead and send me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Got minutes galore.  What do you need?

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.  Better wait on that, I've got to be elsewhere.  See you later.
I've just met Leontine, and I wanted to ask you about her.

chatpoints.chat_text: O-ho-hooo!  Too bad you aren't them!  Good old Leontine!

replies.reply_text: Yeah... What is all that about, do you know?
Sounds like there's a good story here...
Uh oh.  I think I'll back out now while I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... (Emmett straightens a tiny bit, takes off his glasses, blows off a piece of dust and puts them back on again.) Leontine is a pearl diver, you see. She gets nice pearls. And she sells them... well, she used to sell them... to me for a good price. But... then she got this scare about revenuers...

replies.reply_text: Revenuers?  What are revenuers?
Oooooooh... I see... Tell me more?

chatpoints.chat_text: Revenuers.  Tax collectors.  Workers for the Department of Revenue.  Well, that's what she usually says, anyway.  She's a little touched in the head, you know.  She... doesn't realize she's alone on that island.

replies.reply_text: Ah.  Okay, but... there is no Department of Revenue on these isles.  Where'd she get that idea?

chatpoints.chat_text: I figure it was some pirate came and scared her.

replies.reply_text: Okay, this is too weird, I'm out.  Bye!
Who else does she think lives there?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't think she thinks anyone else actually lives there, but she does seem to keep expecting people to show up.  Every now and then she mentions throwing parties.

replies.reply_text: Weird...  Well, thanks for the heads up, I'll keep that in mind.  Bye!
I'll take a look at it.  Thanks for the suggestion!

npc_list.name: Anabelle
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests Must Start at CP 7

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwak! Haawwak! (The eagle belts out a few worried cries.)

replies.reply_text: (Slowly you approach the eagle.) Is everything okay? I won't hurt you, I promise.
I'm sorry to bother you.  I'll just be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwak! Haaawk haww hawk haaaawwwwaaak! (The eagle makes frenzied noises and points toward a spot where her nest was.)

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to hear that.  I hope you get a new nest soon.  Good luck.
Your nest blew away?  Oh, no!  Where will you hatch your eggs?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaaawwwwaaak hawk haaawwwkkk haaww haaaaawwwwk! (She nudges her eggs.)

replies.reply_text: You need to make a new nest and can't leave your eggs?  I could find you some feathers and sticks to rebuild it!
I'm sorry. I wish I could help, but I need to be going.  Bye.
I'll try to be as fast as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawkk?  (<i>She makes a questioning sound.<i>)

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I can't remember what I was doing for you.
Here are some feathers and sticks I brought for you to rebuild your nest.
No, I'm sorry, I don't have them yet.  I was just leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaawwwwakk! (She motions at her feathers and a branch, then her eggs.)

replies.reply_text: That's right.  You needed 10 feathers and 20 strong skinny branches to build your nest.  I'll be back when I have them.
I'm glad I could help you out.  I hope everything goes well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawwwk! (The eagle seems to be excited to see you.)

replies.reply_text: You're welcome for your nest.  I'm glad to see you, too.  Is there anything else that you need help with?
Your nest looks great!  I was just glad to help.  I need to be going now.  Goodbye.
I brought you some grasshoppers and worms for your eaglets.
What was it that I was doing for you again?  I seem to have been sidetracked.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwwwk! Haww haaawk! (She nudges her eaglets.)

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I don't have time to do that right now, but if I get a chance I'll come back later.
Oh, I see.  Your eaglets are hungry, but you can't leave them.  I could bring you some food for them, if you'd like.  Maybe some worms and grasshoppers?
Okay, I will come back once I have them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwwaak! (She nudges her eaglets.) Hawwwkk!

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I remember now.  I'll come back when I have 10 grasshoppers and 10 earthworms.  That should be enough.
You're welcome.  I'll check back in later.

npc_list.name: Leontine
npc_list.admin_description: Old Bat on Rain Isle
npc_list.long_description: Leontine has a voice like a hawk with a headcold, and a way of looking at you, at once with desperate hope, and a moment later with deep suspicion, that can be quite unsettling... or entertaining...

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you them?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... Excuse me?  Am I... Whom are you expecting?
Obviously not.  Sorry to bother you, I'll just... go over there.
Hey, not to be rude or anything, but can you send me to Vine Isle?
Hi, I thought about it and... maybe I can help you with... whatever ... is going on.  Hmmm?
Hi there.  I hate to say this, but which general store exactly was it that you wanted me to get those party favors from?
Hi, I've got your party favors right here.
No, not them. Just Pony Express with a delivery!
(Just for kicks, you go along Leontine's suspicion.) Yes I am. Every single one of them!
No. Seriously, we've been over that before. Where did you say the hooting was coming from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha!  If you were them, you'd know it all right!  Now get over here where I can have a good look at you!  Come on, I don't bite.

replies.reply_text: (You walk up a little closer, and look carefully at the woman to see if she is wearing a red ribbon, by any chance. Not seeing one, you decide to be safe by asking.) Do you kick?
Not in a hundred years, lady!  I'm off!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. You're not them.

replies.reply_text: Not whom?
That's comforting...
Never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're not the person who's going to get me my stuff! That's not whom! (She pronounces "whom" like a great old owl warning off a skunk.)

replies.reply_text: Oh?  Well, maybe I am.  What stuff do you mean?
Oh, this is pointless.  Goodbye.
Fine, be that way.  Bye!
No, hang on there, how do you know I'm not them?  Maybe I'm them in disguise!

chatpoints.chat_text: (There she goes, squinting at you with just one eye again, the other eye wide open!) Hunh! There's something in that, yeah, I suppose you're right. Hmmmm.... Well, if you're in disguise, you can just undisguise yourself and let me see if you're them!

replies.reply_text: (You think fast! Suddenly, you crouch down and look around yourself suspiciously. You whisper.) No, not now. I don't think it's safe!
Please, let's not get over-dramatic here.  If there's something you need or want, just tell me, please.
Look, okay, I'm kind of stuck for time here. Maybe some other time.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no! Don't tell me them... I mean... (She too starts looking around suspiciously.) We don't want to be overheard. I'll send you back to... uhm... whatever that place is called. You come back when it's safe! But be sure to make sure when you come back that you're really them, and not just some other them in disguise! Or I will kick!

replies.reply_text: Wait a minute, just a minute, maybe I can help you with... whatever... is going on.  Hmmm?
Okay, fine.  Please send me back to Vine Isle.
I think I'll just wander around here a bit... Throw them off the scent, you know.  Then I'll leave!  Shhhhh!
(You nod in agreement, and remind yourself that you should probably talk to Emmett Perl.)
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you invited?!  HAHAHA!  You're not THEM!  If you don't have a bright red mane, and aren't able to turn into various forms of produce or see the future or sing in Morse Code, you're not invited and that's it!  Now are you gonna get me my party favors or not?

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way.
Only if I'm invited to the party.

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't look like them!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, probably not.  Whom exactly did you have in mind?
That's good to know.  I'll just wander off by myself now. See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Those big black horses.  I hear they can turn into kumquats to escape detection.  Maybe they can turn into you.

replies.reply_text: Well, when I was little I used to pretend to be a horse, all the time!  But alas, it wasn't to be.  Is there something I can help you with?  You look a little lost.
Which big black horses?  Horse Isle is full of big, black horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hah!  Them ones with the fancy manes.  You're not them.  If you were them, you'd have known that.  Well, goodbye.  Come back if you're ever them!

replies.reply_text: No, no, no, wait a sec.  Uhm... Say, do you by any chance... need... uhm... something?  You're all alone here and you seem to be a bit lost, if you don't mind me saying so.
I'm sorry but... do you need help with something?
Okay, well, let's just drop it then.  Can you send me back to Vine Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Weeeeeeelllllll... Well, maybe there is something.

replies.reply_text: I changed my mind.  I have to go home and mop the curtains.  Bye!
Great! What is it?
Wow, you're having a party?!  Am I invited?
Okay, I'm off to Treeton!  I'll be back.
Treeton.  Party favors.  I'll pick those up next time I'm there.  Bye!
Please send me to Vine Isle and I'll head to Treeton to get them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, forget it, then.  I was gonna pay you and everything, but harrumph!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right, I'm going.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I ought to send you to the wrong place.  But I'm in a hurry.  It's Treeton you need to go to.

replies.reply_text: Ah!  Okay!  Thanks!
All right.  Please send me to Vine Isle then and I'll go get them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, do you?  Weelll, let's see them.  Hand 'em over!

replies.reply_text: Here you are, ma'am!
Wait a minute, first I have to run home and feed the chairs.  Bye!
Thanks a lot!  Have fun with .........Them!
Um. Thanks. I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: What? How? Wait! (She squints at you with just one eye, the other eye wide open!) Hunh! You're not them. If you were them you wouldn't be YOU! Is it you that's making all that racket?

replies.reply_text: Well, you got me there. I'm certainly me and nobody else. What racket are you talking about?

chatpoints.chat_text: The hooting! What d'ja think I'm talking about. Crazy hooter! Hoot-hooting here. Hoot-hooting there. Maybe it's a tiny hooter needing help. I'm not helping it. It's mostly hoot-hooting several paces north of the cave. Wait! Do you live in that cave?

replies.reply_text: Umm. No. I don't live in the cave. Bats might live there, but I assure you, I do not.  I don't know anything about hooting, but I'm happy to check it out.

chatpoints.chat_text: There's hooting? In the cave? That's crazy! Go on with you.

replies.reply_text: Yup - this is crazy. Still, I'l check things out and let you know what I find. If you even care...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh! The hooting! Why are you hooting and hooting and hooting? You are driving me nuts! And why are you hanging out north of the cave? Shouldn't you be IN the cave? Crazy! That's what you are!

replies.reply_text: (You let out a sigh and head out to investigate.)
(You decide to help Gneville keep his privacy.) It isn't me making that noise. But I heard the hooting, too. Sounds just like an owl, doesn't it?
Why thank you. I'm so glad to be done with this. Toodle-loo!

npc_list.name: Danner
npc_list.long_description: A rather stout and tough looking man.  By looking at him, you can tell the sea hasn't been very kind to him over the years.

chatpoints.chat_text: The name's Danner, but most folks aroun' here call me "Cap'n D".  What can I do ye for?

replies.reply_text: Nothing today.  Just take me back to Tropicton, please!
I was wondering if there is anything I can do for you?
Hello Cap'n D!  What was I doing for you again?
I'm back with everything you needed, Cap'n D!
Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for any available housing for a shipwrecked sailor.  Do you have any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, there is in fact.  This old girl of a ship seems to be needin' repairs and I ain't got the supplies to do it.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I could help you out.  I mean, I wouldn't want the boat to fall apart while I was in it!  What can I do?
That's too bad.  Hope you don't sink anytime soon!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: What I need is some wood to fix 'er hull and some new rope to tie 'er off at the docks. Think ye can handle that?

replies.reply_text: I think so.  What exactly do you need?
No.  I'm terrible at finding things.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Bring me back ten pieces of that dark wood ye find in the deepest parts of the jungle and some rope.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I think I can get the ten pieces of wood, no problem, but where can I find rope?
You know, I think I'll come back later.
Thanks, I'll be back as soon as I find everything!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were bringing me back ten ebony wood and some rope.

replies.reply_text: Right.  Where do I get rope again?
Great.  Thanks for reminding me!
Okay, but where can I find ebony wood?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy! Let's see what ye got 'ere, matey!

replies.reply_text: Here's what you need to fix your ship!
What was I doing for you again?
Thanks and good luck on the boat!

chatpoints.chat_text: Look around in the jungle, matey.  You'll find the good logs there on the ground.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for reminding me!
I'll do that, thanks!

npc_list.name: Esther
npc_list.long_description: A very crafty woman covered in leaves, flowers, and glue.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Please excuse the clutter, but I am working on a few projects at the moment.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, but I have to go anyway.  Bye!
Hi there!  Would you happen to have any vines that could be made into rope?
I'm back and I found the vines!
I forget where the vines are...  Can you remind me?
That's okay.  Actually, I'm looking for available housing on these islands.  Do you have any suggestions?
Oh, no problem.  Is that easel one of your projects?
I've got another one for you! (Hold out the pony sculpture.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do have some very nice vine rope right over here.  How much do you need?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure.  A lot?  It's to help repair a boat.
Forget it.  I'll find some elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dear, dear.  I don't have that much.  But if you could go out into the jungle and look around, you'll be able to find some vines that I could turn into rope for you!

replies.reply_text: On second thought, this is going to take forever!  I'll come back later.
Where should I look, exactly?
Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Look just to the west of here in the trees.  I need five really good vines, so use your binoculars to find the best vines in the trees.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: You did?  That's fantastic.  Now we can make some rope!  Hand them here, dear.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.  I picked the very best ones!
Thanks so much for your help!
Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sort of.  I have so many other things that I haven't gotten to that.

replies.reply_text: I could paint if for you if you like.  Painting is fun!
Good luck!  I'm sure you'll get to it some day.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, that sounds like a good idea.  Well, it's a banana split.  There are 3 scoops of strawberry ice cream covered in dark fudge, white whipped cream and a bright red cherry.  Just for something interesting, there is also a tan chocolate chip cookie with black chips and a scoop of mint ice cream with chocolate chunks in it.  I wanted it to look like it was outside even though it's probably just sitting on a dark green table.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound too hard.  I'll give it a shot.
I'm sure it'll be really neat, whatever you decide!

npc_list.name: Robinson
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.short_description: A Lost Soul on Vine Isle
npc_list.long_description: Robinson is a man who has been out in the elements too long.  His only companions are a monkey named Weekday and a coconut.  He needs to come in from the sun!

chatpoints.chat_text: Weekday! Help me, I'm hallucinating again!!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'm real... but you seem to be real gone!  Sorry to have bothered you.
Calm down, you're not hallucinating, I'm really real.  What are you doing out here alone?
Oh.  No, it's okay because I'm a real person!  I'm sorry to bother you, but do you know where I can find some rope?
It's okay Robinson, I told you I'm real. I'm back with your request.
All right already, we've established that I'm real, remember?  I forgot what you asked me to get.
Okay, Robinson, we've already covered this...I'm real and you are not hallucinating.  I came back because I have some interesting news for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was washed ashore after a violent storm... gee, I don't even know how long ago. Do you remember how long it's been, Weekday? (Weekday looks at Rob, then at you and shrugs.)

replies.reply_text: It's been that long?  Why are you still sitting here?
Well, I guess everybody has to be somewhere.  Nice meeting you, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I just knew that if I stayed put a ship will eventually find me.

replies.reply_text: As I'm sure it will... eventually. Hope you still have enough sun block, bye!
Do you still have enough supplies?  Can I get you anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, I have plenty of fish, walnuts, berries, and of course coconuts... but I sure do miss oranges and Weekday would love some bananas.  I don't suppose you have any on you?

replies.reply_text: Not on me, but I could get you some. How many do you need?
Sorry, I don't have any fruit. Hope you find some. Bye!
You've been here that long and all you want is some fruit?  Sure, I'll get it for you.  I'll be back in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know you can make some sturdy rope out of the jungle vines, but I sure don't have any to spare.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  Thanks for your help. I'll just keep looking!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's okay, I get a little forgetful myself.  I asked if you could get us 12 oranges and 6 bananas.

replies.reply_text: Oranges and bananas... I remember now.  I'll be back soon, bye!
(You look over and realize that Weekday is wildly gesturing at you, maybe you should see what he wants!) Gee, thanks Rob, it was nothing! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: News?  You have news for me??  Pray tell, what is it?

replies.reply_text: Well, like I tried to tell you before, you are actually at the end of an island chain...

chatpoints.chat_text: (You notice a look of panic coming across Robinson's face as he reaches for his coconut.) Weekday, do you know what our friend here is saying?

replies.reply_text: And while exploring the islands I found a tree house with a ship's log in it.  It's a really nice house and I'm sure you could rest up while you read the log.

chatpoints.chat_text: A ship's log, you say?  Maybe it will tell me how to get off this island!  How do I find this tree house you speak of?

replies.reply_text: I thought you'd never ask! (You wink at Weekday.) All you have to do is follow the beach. Keep the sea to your right and when you get to the 9th palm tree, walk north into the jungle about 10 paces and there's the tree house.
Gee, thanks! Hope you like the tree house!

npc_list.name: Weekday
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: Weekday is a highly intelligent monkey who is Robinson's only companion.  Too bad Robinson doesn't realize how intelligent Weekday really is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Dear me, you haven't been here as long as Robinson... is this a human trait?  I asked you to find Robinson some shelter here on this island.

replies.reply_text: That's right, sorry.  I have a lot on my mind!  I'll be back shortly, promise!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo eee eee ooo ooo eee.

replies.reply_text: Cute monkey!
What are you trying to tell me, Weekday?  Gee, I wish I could understand what you want!
Sorry, but what did you ask me to do for you again?
Weekday, I'm back and I have wonderful news!

chatpoints.chat_text: Pssssssst...  Could you help a monkey out, here?

replies.reply_text: Talking monkeys now?  That's too much for me, I'm out!!
I guess so...  Hey, wait a minute!  How come you're talking to me, but you don't talk to Robinson?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would, but poor Robinson is so close to the edge.  I'm afraid if he knew I could talk it would push him right over!

replies.reply_text: I can see your logic, but I don't do talking critters, either!
Makes sense, I guess. (You look over at Robinson who is having an extremely animated argument with a coconut!) What can I do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've tried to show him that he's at the tail end of an island chain, but he's not grasping what I'm trying to show him!  I've got to get him inside before the sun roasts his last remaining brain cells.

replies.reply_text: Am I wearing a yellow blazer?  Do I look like a realtor?  No dice, bye!
Okay, I've seen a few people around the islands.  I'll ask all of them and let you know.
I'll be back when I find something for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: What is it? Do tell!

replies.reply_text: I asked around the islands and I found a sweet tree house on the second island.  Move in condition!

chatpoints.chat_text: That sounds absolutely perfect!  I love tree houses... and Robinson, if he's in out of the weather, he'll adjust. Only, how do we get him to the tree?

replies.reply_text: I already worked that out.  I'm going to tell him about the tree house, but I'm going to tell him I found a ship's log inside it.  He'll want to see it to see if it can help him get off this island.
(You notice that Robinson is still talking to that same coconut.) All right, I'll give it a try, wish me luck!

npc_list.name: Robinson
npc_list.short_description: Happily fixing up his new home.
npc_list.long_description: Robinson looks a lot healthier since the last time you saw him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, friend!

replies.reply_text: Just stopped by to see how you are doing.  Pretty good, it seems!
So, Robinson, now that you are settled in, what are you doing with yourself?
Sorry Robinson, but where did the log say to look for the first clue?
Hi Robinson!  Guess what, I found the Dread Pirate Robert's buried treasure!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you stopped by!  I wanted to thank you again for finding this for me.  It's so nice not to have sand in everything I eat, drink, or wear!

replies.reply_text: I'm sure!  Well, catch you on the rebound, bye!
That's nice, but what are you doing to keep yourself occupied?

chatpoints.chat_text: I sell driftwood and coconuts that I find along the beach, and I give tours of the Jungle Temple.  Which reminds me, I found that ship's log you told me about.  Very interesting!

replies.reply_text: Log book....did I mention anything about a log book?
Log book....yeah, sure, enjoy the read.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was straightening up the house one day and I found an old sea chest stuffed in a dark corner. I opened the chest and found the ship's log, just like you said! (Holds up a battered ship's log book.)

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure I like where this is headed, I've got to go now.  Enjoy reading your book!
Really??  Um....er....really!!   What does it say?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's the ship's log from the Dread Pirate Robert's ship, Revenge! I've been reading it and the last entry is the start of a treasure hunt!

replies.reply_text: A treasure hunt?  Get outta here!  Really??
You don't really believe that there is a treasure out there just waiting to be found, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: There really is!  I did a lot of research into missing pirate treasures, before I was shipwrecked.  You'd be surprised how many treasures are still unfound.

replies.reply_text: And you're sure this is one of the unfound treasures?
I'm sure I would, but I have to go now, take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, there are treasures all over these islands, and the dread Pirate Robert's treasure is said to be one of the largest ever hidden!

replies.reply_text: That's nice, have fun treasure seeking!  I'm on my way, bye!
That's cool!  So when are you leaving on your hunt?

chatpoints.chat_text: Much as I would love to go look for this treasure myself, I'm afraid it's my busy season for the temple tour business.  I was rather thinking that you could look for the treasure, as my thanks for all your help.

replies.reply_text: I don't know, (Looking outside of the treehouse...there's no one there but you and Robinson.) I can see how busy you are, but I'm too busy right now, myself. Sorry!
I'm flattered by your offer, where does the hunt begin?

chatpoints.chat_text: It says here...<i>"Aye, adventurer, ye need to be sharp to find Ol' Dread Pirate Robert's hidden booty!  If ye be adventurous enough, ye can read the rest of the log...

replies.reply_text: Let me see....
Okay...I'm off...wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, it says, Look closely at the bark of the trees around this here shelter fer yer first clue!

replies.reply_text: That's right look closely at the trees...got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You did!? How hard was it to find?  How big a treasure was it?

replies.reply_text: Slow down...it took a while because the clues lead me to 8 different islands. The treasure was buried on Magma Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: But the treasure, what was the treasure?

replies.reply_text: I was getting to that...It was gold coins and diamond necklaces, do you want some of them?
Wow, thank you!  Any time you have any more old maps to follow, let me know.  See you next time!

npc_list.name: Weekday
npc_list.short_description: Playing in trees around his new home.
npc_list.long_description: Weekday looks happy and waves enthusiastically at you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, friend!  You'll be happy to know that I can talk to Robinson now.  Thanks for all your help!

replies.reply_text: Glad I could help out.  See you around!

npc_list.name: Cheeky
npc_list.long_description: A very different colored monkey, if you ever saw one before!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooooo oooo eeeeep eep. (Cheeky seems to be very sad.)

replies.reply_text: What a silly monkey!  Bye.
Oh, you poor thing!  What's wrong?
What was I doing for you again?
Cheeky, I'm back and I have good news!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cheeky looks up at you with tear-filled eyes.) Ooo ooo ooop. Eeee ooop ooo ooop. Eeeee ooo ooo. (Cheeky sniffles and his lower lip quivers.)

replies.reply_text: Aww, that mean old Matata won't let you into the Monkey Thieves Guild?
Umm, I still don't speak "monkish", so good luck with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: (A single tear falls down Cheeky's cheek.) Ooo. Ooop. Eeee eee oooo eeep eep!

replies.reply_text: Just because you are different than all the other monkeys?
What?  Forget this.  Bye bye, monkey.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo eeep eep?

replies.reply_text: No, that's not fair at all!  Being different just makes you special.  You should be allowed to play with the other monkeys, even if what they do is... questionable.
I have no idea what you mean.  Being different makes you weird and you will always be weird!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo ooo eeeeep ooo ooo eeeep? (Cheeky has a renewed sense of hope in his eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Yes, I guess I could go speak to Matata on your behalf.  But we're still in negotiations to have a treaty with the Monkey Thieves Guild, and well... this better help me out!
No way!  You monkeys are weird and you smell bad.  See ya!
All right, I'll be back. (You mutter under your breath:) And this better be worth it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooooo oooo eep!  Eeep eeeep!

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I was going to go speak to Matata for you.  I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooo oo?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I do!  You have been accepted into the Monkey Thieves Guild.  They meet on the first of every month by the pyramid in the middle of Torrid Isle.
Yeah, you're in the Guild.  Congrats.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cheeky laughs deeply and speaks in a dark, ominous voice.) Exxxxxxcellent.

replies.reply_text: Woah.  You can talk?
Weird and creepy!  I'm out of here!!
Uh oh... This can't be good.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right! I'm not a monkey at all. I'm a detective! And I'm an APE.

replies.reply_text: Are you kidding me???
Hurray!  No more monkeys!  Thanks, Detective!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm afraid I'm not.  I've been a detective for some time and the residents of Horse Isle have been fed up with the monkeys stealing their gold.

replies.reply_text: But you're still a monkey?
Before this gets more confusing, I'm leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, apes are very different than monkeys.  We have different diets, live longer and are much bigger in size. Probably the most noticeable difference is that we don't have tails like monkeys have.

replies.reply_text: Really?  I had no idea.  So you are going to stop the monkeys from stealing people's money?
This is just weird, wrong, and silly.  I think I better go.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm going to try to infiltrate their organization and bring it down from the inside.  It's going to take some time, though.  I do appreciate all that you have done for me.  With your help, soon the Monkey Thieves Guild will be no more!

replies.reply_text: I guess I'm just still in shock.  You're welcome?
Yeah, okay, well that was fun.  Good luck with your monkey suit.
Good luck and let me know how it goes!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for your help earlier. Those cheeky monkeys haven't a clue that I'm infiltrating their guild! Once I figure out their plans, I can stop them in their monkey tracks!

replies.reply_text: That's great!  Keep up the good work, Detective.

npc_list.name: Jada
npc_list.long_description: A perky woman with crystal blue eyes and a comforting smile.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's quite nice here in my cottage.  I don't venture out into the cold much.  But that does remind me... Could you do me a very quick favor?

replies.reply_text: Sure, as long as it means I don't have to run out into the cold for you.
No, I can't.  Sorry, but I have to go now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Please come in and sit by the fire!  It's a bit brisk today, isn't it?

replies.reply_text: No, thank you.  I really should get going.
Brisk?  More like... Well, frigid!  How can you stand this cold all the time?
What was I doing for you again?  It's so cold and I just can't remember a thing!
Yes, still very cold out!  Nedrick says thank you, by the way.
It is.  I have a Pony Express delivery, though!
It is a bit.  Oh, say, that easel over there looks a bit dusty.
It is very brisk! And I thank you for the offer but what I would really like is to find the woman who makes dolls on this island.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, you have to go out into the cold, but only for a short minute.  Is that still all right?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I suppose.  Just let me get my gloves on first.
No, I'd rather stay here and just warm up then be on my way.
Great.  Here I go... off into the cold again.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to run that interesting bug I found over to Nedrick for me.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the reminder.  I'm headed that way now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, goodie!  I am so glad he liked it! He does love his bugs and butterflies ever so much!

replies.reply_text: Yes, he does.  Now, I'm just going to warm myself by the fire and be on my way, thank you!
Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes.  I always mean to paint that.  It would make it a lot more colorful in here, but I'm not very good, I must say.

replies.reply_text: I'll do it.  It will be fun!
Well, practice makes perfect!  Have fun.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  The ribbon should be red, but the inside of the bow will need to be pink.  Let's see...  The present should be purple and green stripes.  Alternating of course.  That will mean the nearest end and stripe is the light green.  The tag should be blue and the background would look great if it were orange.  That will be nice and colorful.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you must mean Kelda. She lives on the far west side of the island. She is an amazingly talented woman.

replies.reply_text: Then I'll head that way now! Thanks so much for the heads up.

npc_list.name: Clarissa
npc_list.admin_description: SW house on polar isle
npc_list.long_description: Clarissa looks rather frayed around the edges, as if she's got way too much to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Hi there.  Here for mineral water?

replies.reply_text: Me?  No, I'm just passing through.   Bye.
Mineral water?
Sorry, but... what was it you wanted again?
Hi, I'm back with the bottles you wanted.
Hi, I'm back with the labels you wanted.
I think I brought everything you needed.
No, but thank you for asking. I'm looking for a woman who makes dolls. Would that be you?

chatpoints.chat_text: The hot spring.  Mineral water.  Everybody comes here for mineral water.  Leave empty bottles all over the place, and candy wrappers and who has to clean it all up?  ME!  I don't have time to THINK!

replies.reply_text: Whoa, there!  I think you're a bit strung out.
I think I'll just go.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry.  Yes, I'm strung out.  Somehow or other, word got out about the hot spring and then everybody had to come up here and get some.

replies.reply_text: Does the water have any special properties?
I just remembered, I need to go home and repot the refrigerator.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it tastes funny.  That's about all I know.  But everybody has to come up here with bottles and fill up, and they leave all kinds of stuff around...

replies.reply_text: Hmmm... Maybe you would be better off if you bottled the water yourself and then sold the water already bottled.  You'd make some money, and it would save all the visitors a lot of work.
Oh, well, I'm sure you'll figure out something.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Saaaaayyyy.... that's not a bad idea.  Except I don't have bottles.  Or labels, they'd need labels, right?  Hmmm.... Can you get me some bottles and labels?  I'll pay you.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that!
I don't have time right now.  Maybe I'll come back after a while.  Bye-bye!
I'll be back as soon as I can.
Do you have any idea where I can get the bottles?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd try the Chillton general store.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 24 empty bottles and labels for the bottles.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll get right on that.
Do you have any idea where I can get the bottles?
Do you know where I could find labels?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good!  Let's see them.

replies.reply_text: Here they are, in a convenient wooden crate.
I have the labels, too!
Is that everything?
I'll be back with the labels as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  May I have them, please?

replies.reply_text: Here you go.
I have the bottles, too!
Is that everything?
I'll be back with the bottles as soon as I can!
Thanks a lot!  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: I would guess you should find a papermaker.

replies.reply_text: I'll try that.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, not at all! Not at all! You might try on the west end of the island.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Nedrick
npc_list.admin_description: Collects butterflies
npc_list.short_description: an older man who squints a lot.
npc_list.long_description: Nedrick squints even when not looking at things close to him.  He must have spent a good deal of time studying things.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... hello.  Have we met?

replies.reply_text: Umm..  Nope.  Bye!
No, I don't think we have.  How are you?
Hi there... Uhm... Sorry, but how many butterflies was it you wanted?
Hi there, I'm back.
I'm not sure?  The cold is getting to my brain, I think!  Anyways, I have something for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm okay. (He turns and sneers at a dog, who is sitting in the corner of the house licking his lips guiltily). Well, up until a little while ago.

replies.reply_text: Uh oh, what happened?
I think I'll go now.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Dratted dog ate my butterfly collection! (He looks as if he may burst into tears!) I had some of those butterflies since I was knee high to an ant!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's terrible!  Bad dog!  Sorry to hear that.  But I've got to go home and dust the laundry.  Goodbye.
Oh, no!  I'm sorry to hear that.  Is there anything I can do to help?  I can travel around and get butterflies to replace some of the ones you've lost.  Would you like me to do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I don't know....  Wouldn't be the same...

replies.reply_text: No, but it would be something!  Would you like me to get them for you?
You're right.  It wouldn't.  Well, I'm off!  Bye-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nedrick squints up at you, bewildered.) You'd do that for me?

replies.reply_text: Nah, I was just kidding!  Bye, pops!
Of course I would!  How many butterflies would you like me to find?
I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Three.  They're tiny!  You may need to use a magnifying glass.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Okay, thanks.
Where did you say I could find them again?

chatpoints.chat_text: With the butterflies?

replies.reply_text: Right here!  Here you are!
Oh... Uhm, no, I forgot those.  I'll be back.
Thank you!  I hope you enjoy them!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do? (Nedrick curiously squints up at you.) What is it?

replies.reply_text: It's a bug that Jada said she found and thought you might like it.  Here you go.
Nothing.  I forgot.  I'll come back later.
You're welcome.  I'll be sure to tell Jada you liked it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Art Isle, and you find them where it's very rocky, just on the edges of the different environments.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! I'll be back in a jiffy.

npc_list.name: Icy the Snowman
npc_list.long_description: Made of snowballs, a carrot nose, and two eyes made out of iron ore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!

replies.reply_text: Are you talking to me?
Did someone say something? Hrm, guess not.  Well, I'll be going now.
I found your magic button!
Hello, Icy!  Is there a way I can get back to Icicle Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, you seem to be the only one here, right?  How are you today?

replies.reply_text: I'm fine, thank you for asking.  But wait!  A talking snowman?
That must be the wind or I'm hearing things.  I should go.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a bit of a shock, isn't it?  One day I was just a snowman, then *POOF*!   Here I am, talking and living!  Well, actually not here.  I was on Icicle Isle for the longest time.

replies.reply_text: Icicle Isle?  Where is that?
Magic isn't real and doesn't make things come to life so bye bye, Mister.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's over there a ways, actually.  You know, I lost my favorite button before I left.  Do you think you could find it for me if I send you there?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I just love adventuring!
No, I should really get moving on.  The cold is making my feet freeze.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Super!  I really miss that button.  It goes with everything!  So look really close by the rocks to find it, okay?  I'm sure I left it by a big rock.

replies.reply_text: Wait, once I get to Icicle Isle, how do I get back?
Forget it.  I just know I'll be lost and confused for days.  Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Once you find my button, the magic that's left will bring you back.  Are you ready?  You can't come back until you find my button.

replies.reply_text: I'm ready and I'll be back with your button!
On second thought, no.  I'll be back to help some other time.
Wait, where is your button again?  I want to make sure I know exactly where to look first.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Pfefferneusse are an old family recipe! The name is German; it means "pepper nuts," and that's just what you'll find in these. They're a small spice nut cookie and while they're delicious eaten alone, they take on a delightful flavor when dipped in coffee. They taste best at least a week after being cooked as the spice flavors meld together.
In a medium-sized bowl, cream together 1 cup butter and 3/4 cup brown sugar. Beat in 1 egg. Add 2 cups flour and your spices. You can adjust this to taste, but I use 1/2 teaspoon allspice, 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves, 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, 1/8 teaspoon ginger, and 1/8 teaspoon white pepper. Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Stir well. Then mix in 2 cups chopped pecans.
Now you're ready to form the cookies. To get an idea of the target size for these, place your thumb and forefinger together; each cookie should be about the size of the circle formed by your fingers. Roll the dough into balls about that size and place on an oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes. Let cool in pan for about 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
If you won't be dipping your pfefferneusse in coffee or cocoa, you may wish to roll them in powered sugar to serve.

chatpoints.chat_text:
These chocolate peanut butter truffles are delicious, and really easy to make too! They're one of my personal favorites.
Stir together 1 3/4 cups smooth peanut butter, 1 cup softened butter, and 1 tsp vanilla until well combined. Stir in 3 cups confectioner's sugar, 1 cup at a time, until it forms a stiff dough. Depending on your local climate, you may be able to use less sugar to form the dough without sacrificing taste, so go slowly! Allow this ganache to cool in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.
Once the dough has hardened, use a teaspoon to scoop it out and roll into small balls. Melt 1 1/2 cups of the chocolate of your choice- I use a mix of milk and dark- and immerse the peanut butter balls in the chocolate until coated.
Cool until the chocolate has hardened. You can then drizzle the truffles with a lighter melted chocolate, icing, or candy coating for extra deliciousness!

replies.reply_text: Chocolate and peanut butter, a winning combination!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Sugar cookies are easy to make and a lot of fun, since they can easily be cut out into shapes or flavored with icing, sprinkles, or candy.
Cream together 1 1/2 cup butter and 2 cups white sugar until smooth. Stir in 4 eggs and at least 1 teaspoon vanilla. I always use more vanilla than called for. Stir in 5 cups flour and 2 teaspoons baking powder. If you don't typically use salted butter, also stir in 1 teaspoon salt.
If you'll be cutting out cookies into shapes, chill the dough for at least an hour before rolling out the dough and cutting. If not, you can simply drop them onto the cooking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 7 minutes or so.
To decorate, you can make a simple icing with confectioner's sugar and milk, thickness adjusted for your taste. Use food coloring to tint if you'd like something other than a white icing. Decorate with colored sugar, sprinkles, or candy.
