chatpoints.chat_text: Polar Isle? Well, why are you still standing here? You must go search for Farley. You must. I can't leave. Surely you understand. He may still wash up here. After all, this IS where I washed up. Please hurry!

replies.reply_text: What? You want me to go search for him? I think I've done enough. See you later... NOT!
I understand completely. I would be happy to do that for you.
I'm on my way!

npc_list.name: Farley
npc_list.admin_description: No New Quests on this id

chatpoints.chat_text: (Even though he is on the beach, the waves still nudge him. With every nudge, you hear what sounds like a groan. Must be the wood rubbing against the sand. A dummy isn't really alive, right? He is way too creepy-looking to carry. You decide to let Edgar do the honors.)

replies.reply_text: Hey, little guy. I'm going to go let your buddy, Edgar, know you are here. You just hang tight. I'm sure he'll be here in no time.
Creepy! I'm outta here!

npc_list.name: Edgar
npc_list.admin_description: [after Farley has been found] New quests cp27

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Good day! Come in, come in!

replies.reply_text: Hello! How's Lava treating you?
Hi there! Just wanted to see who lives here. And now that I see, I think I'll flee!
Yikes! Crazy man and his dummy. Run!
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hey there, Edgar. I talked to Farley and it looks like he can't wait for a new set of dentures. He was... chomping at the bit, you might say! Ha, ha, ha!
You wouldn't happen to have any ideas on where I might look for a dentist, would you? Farley can't wait to get a new set of dentures.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I found a dentist! She's in Wington, and said her appointments are filling up fast. You'll want to get Farley in there as soon as possible.
I've got the new dentures. I think they are just the thing to get Farley smiling again!
I've spoken with Farley and he willing to have a makeover! But by the looks of him, this will cost more than his new teeth did.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Whew! It was a ton of work, but I'm back and Farley's Extreme Makeover is done!
Hey there, Edgar! I'm working on Farley's makeover and need his measurements. I've got a tape measure right here. Could you kindly do the honors?
checking Karee Dentin's quest

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent! Much warmer than living on the coast up north. However, Farley is all up in arms these days.

replies.reply_text: Up in arms? What's he so upset about?
You know, I realize YOU think Farley is real. But he's just a dummy. Seriously. He is a mechanical doll. And really, aren't you a bit old to be playing with dolls?
Sorry to hear Farley's unhappy. Well, I've got things to do, places to be. Have a great day!
Up in arms? What's he so upset about?
Really? After getting those amazing new teeth? What's his problem now?
What's his problem now?
Speaking of Farley, I spoke with him about the Extreme Makeover. He's all for it, but I think this is going to cost more than his teeth did.

chatpoints.chat_text: I beg your pardon! He is not a doll. He is an exquisite work of art! He is an exceptional example of an early basswood figure. His glass eyes are the perfect shade of blue. He not only has real hair on his head, his brows and eyelashes are real! His suit is made from the finest linen. His shoes are handmade leather. Why, look, he even has dimples carved into his rosy cheeks.

replies.reply_text: Whoa, there. Didn't mean to upset you. I would like to point out that that it looks like Farley has seen better days.
Now that you point those things out, I can see why you care so much about him. I think I'll leave you two alone. Good day!
Okay, maybe Farley was special - once! But still, you have to admit you are too old to be playing with dolls!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Edgar drops his head, clearly distressed.) Sadly, that's all too true. Poor Farley! I've removed the mirror I had. Farley's reflection upset him dreadfully!

replies.reply_text: That's a sad story and all, but I'd rather be happy, so I'm heading on out. Have a nice day!
That doesn't sound good. How bad of shape can he be in?

chatpoints.chat_text: Being adrift in the ocean was not in his best interest. Farley's lost much of his hair. His clothing is in shreds. His nails are chipped. Even his fine hand-made leather shoes look awful. Worse yet, he needs new teeth. You can barely understand what the poor guy is saying.

replies.reply_text: I can understand why he's upset. Can his teeth be fixed? There must be someone on the isles that could help. I'd be happy to see if I can find one.
Ohhh, that's why he looks so creepy now. I'm not big on creepy, so I'll just leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Again, I would like to point out the error of your assumption! I am not 'playing!' Ventriloquism is an ancient artform of voice distortion and manipulation. It takes years to perfect the technique of voice throwing.

replies.reply_text: Wow. Apologies. I had no clue.
That's really interesting. So why is Farley 'up in arms' as you put it?
I'll go talk to him now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right. Surely it wouldn't take much to have new clothes sewn. I'm not sure about his hair, but maybe that can be fixed, too. If you could find someone who works with leather, his shoes could be replaced. Egads! There is so much to be done, it feels overwhelming!

replies.reply_text: No worries! Let me help. We'll call it Farley's Extreme Makeover! What do you say?
Well, that sound like a lot of work, and I'm just chill'in today! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to talk to Farley about some repair work.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll head over there now.
That's right! I did talk to him, and he's chomping at the bit for a new set of dentures! Ha, ha, ha!
Of course! I need to ask the dentist in Wington if she has any ideas on how to get this done.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't find that amusing. But if he agreed to this, I'll pay for it. You ARE willing to do the necessary legwork, right? I can hardly take him out with me, looking as sorrowful as he does.

replies.reply_text: Of course I am! Happy to do that. I understand why you wouldn't want to take Farley out in public right now. No one would be able to understand a word he was saying.
Hmm. I suppose there would be a lot of legwork on this errand, since I don't know of any dentist on the isles. You're right. Too much for me today. Maybe I'll come back another day. Have a good one!
I'm willing if the price is right!
No problem. I'll go see if I can find a dentist now.

chatpoints.chat_text: The only places I know that treat medical issues are the veterinarians. It might be wise to try asking them.

replies.reply_text: Good point! I'm on my way.
You know, I can think of at least 7 vets on the islands. That's more work than I care to undertake right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not possible. As I explained, Farley is in no condition to be seen in public. You'll need to figure out another way of getting this accomplished.

replies.reply_text: I'm all out of ideas for today. Maybe I'll think of something else tomorrow.
Okay. How about I go explain the situation to the dentist. Maybe she has some ideas. Sound good?
I don't think that's possible either. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: You said you'd work on getting Farley a new set of teeth, and he is still waiting.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll go work on it now.
Thanks for reminding me! I have been working on it. I need to go see to Farley now.
Of course! And I have his new teeth right here in my backpack.

That's right. Here's the deal. Farley's not talking to me, and I need to get a wax impression of his mouth for the dentist. (You explain how to do it.) If you'll get the impression, I'll take it back to the dentist.
That's right! You gave me the impression, now I just need to get it to the dentist. Thanks for reminding me!
Correct, you are! Karee Dentin, the dentist, is making them as we speak! I'll go see if they are ready.
And I can't do that until you get the impression! Oh wait. You wanted me to get something for you, right? Can you remind me what it was?
Of course! And you asked me for a paper bag to protect the wax impression. Here it is!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting a paper bag from Ricky at The Good Egg to protect the wax impressiom.

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'm on my way.
Silly me! I did that. Here it is and I'm ready to pick up the impression!
I'm on my way!
I'll head up there now.
I will. I'll head over to Wington right now.
I enjoyed helping! Thanks for the rewards. If Farley has any trouble with those, send a message to Karee Dentin, the dentist in Wington. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting a bag from Ricky, just north of here.

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'm gone like yesterday's wind!

chatpoints.chat_text: As you know, being adrift in the ocean was not in his best interest. His fine leather shoes are water damaged. His suit has been shredded to threads. His nails are chipped. Even his fine wool hair is matted and falling off in clumps. On the bright side, he does have a great smile now. Thanks to you!

replies.reply_text: We got his smile fixed. Why not the rest? I know a seamstress who could sew a new suit. I'm sure we can find someone who works with leather. And I saw some sheep on one of the islands. We could give him a total makeover!
Whoa! Sounds like he's a big mess. A bigger mess than I want to get involved with. Maybe some other day, but not today. No thank you!
I'll go ask him now!
Terrific! I'll head to Barb's place now. She's a seamstress so it makes sense to start with her.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to talk to Farley about a makeover.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm on my way now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You said you'd work on getting Farley a TOTAL makeover, and he is still waiting.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm working on it now.
Of course! And that reminds me, I need his measurements, and I've got a tape measure right here. Could you kindly do the honors?
Right. On that note, would you happen to know who might work on leather? I need to get new shoes made for him.
I need to do something about his hair. Would you have any tips on that?
Perfect! Now that I can get started. I've got a lead on a seamstress on Hoof Isle. I'll head there now.
Thanks so much! Have a super-duper day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our humble abode.

replies.reply_text: How's Lava treating you and Farley these days?
Yikes! A man who plays with dolls! Run!
You know, I realize YOU think Farley is real. But he's just a dummy. Seriously. He is a mechanical doll. And really, aren't you a bit old to be playing with dolls?
Thank you, Edgar! Nice to see you again. I've brought you a gift from Karee Dentin. She's Wington's dentist and wants to spread the word.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent! Since Farley's makeover, we've been giving performances for the residents of Molten Meadows every Saturday night. They seem to really enjoy the show.

replies.reply_text: That sounds wonderful! I'll have to catch your show one of these days! Have a great one!
Fantastic! Hey, while I'm here... I've got a delivery for you from Karee Dentin.

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard there was a leather craftsman in Appleton. You might try asking the residents there.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I need also need to do something about his hair. Would you have any tips on that?

chatpoints.chat_text: You mentioned that Candide has sheep. Have you tried asking him?

replies.reply_text: Silly me! I totally forgot that! I'll head there now.
Oh, I have another question. Would you happen to know who might work on leather? I need to get new shoes made for him.
I would be happy to tell her. And no worries about Farley. I have toothbrushes for everyone. In the meantime, have a great day!

npc_list.name: Farley
npc_list.admin_description: [after he's been found] New quests CP28

chatpoints.chat_text: (Farley looks at you with an unblinking gaze, while his arms flap up and down.)

replies.reply_text: Hey there, little guy. What's up?
Scary dummy! Run!
Hey there, Farley! What's shakin', bacon?
Hey, Farley! I'm back. I found a dentist. The next step is for you to go see her.
I'm back, I'm back! You are going to love these! I've got new choppers for you.
What are you so up in arms for?
Hey there, Farley! Just came by to see if Tuque buffed your nails.
What was I doing for you again?
Hey Farley! Was there something else I was supposed to be doing for you?
What was it that you needed me to do? I can't remember.
Hey there, Little Man! I've come to measure your shortness!
quest checking

chatpoints.chat_text: Wrhmm WROT wriddle!

replies.reply_text: Ah, what ever!
Looks like you could use an extreme makeover! Would you like that?
You're not little? Is that what you are trying to say? You know, I bet a new set of dentures would make it a whole lot easier for people to understand you. Would you like that?
You most definitely little in size. But I am sure you have a big heart. Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: (It almost looks like Farley is tearing up. But that can't be! He's just a dummy.)Yehz peaz!

replies.reply_text: Sure! Give you a new 'do, manicure, clothes. The whole bit.
Crying dummy? Too creepy! Run!
Okay, first things first. Let me talk to Edgar about getting a dentist involved. We'll have you smiling in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Farley glares at you.)

replies.reply_text: Hmm. Not funny, huh? Alrighty, then. I'll just take my sense of humor elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah ew uts?

replies.reply_text: Me? Nuts? I don't think so! But I am offended that you'd say that, so I'm leaving.
Of course not! You need the teeth. The dentist in is Wington. You need to go to Wington. Simple!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Farley glares at you.)

replies.reply_text: Fine! Be that way. I'll just tell Edgar the agreement is off.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look at me! I'm in shambles! A mess! A fashion disaster! Oh, woe is me! Woe is me!

replies.reply_text: Yes, but look at that amazing new smile!
And that's just what I wanted to talk to you about.

chatpoints.chat_text: You wanted to talk to me about the fact that I'm a fashion disaster? Thanks a lot! That's cruel. Cruel, cruel, cruel.

replies.reply_text: Now hold up there a bit. I wanted to talk to you about giving you a makeover.
You know, I came willing to do you a HUGE favor, but since you are acting like that, you can forget about it!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Farley lowers his eyes as if he's embarrassed. Is that even possible for a dummy? Suddenly, his head snaps back up and stares at you. His eyes seem to be glittering with excitement.)
Like a ... TOTAL makeover?

replies.reply_text: Indeed! I'm sure I can find a leather craftsman who can make you new shoes. Candide has sheep. I'll bet he'll donate some wool for a hairpiece. Barb in Shellton is a seamstress. New shoes, new cloths, new 'do!' What do you say?
Wow. You go from 'I've got nothing' to all 'give me everything!' I think I just changed my mind about helping  you.
Looks like I'm going to need to find a sponsor to pay for all of this. I'm going to ask Edgar. Hopefully, you'll be one happy camper soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well don't keep me guessing! What do you have?

replies.reply_text: I've got spiffy new shoes for you!
Oh, actually, I think I've given you everything for your Extreme Makeover!
I've got a fine new shirt for you!
I've got some amazing Argyle socks for you!
I've got a wonderful new hairpiece for you!
I've got spiffy new shoes for you!
I've got a finely made suit for you! That covers both the dress pants and the dinner jacket on your list!
Oops! My mistake. But I'm sure I'll be back soon enough with something on your list!
I've got a finely made pair of dress pants, and a matching dinner jacket for you!
I've got a brand new toothbrush from Wington's dentist, Karee Dentin.
Just so you know, Argyle socks are NOT on your wish list! Guess I'll go ask Zerena if she can help me.
But wait, there's more!
But wait, there's more!
But wait, there's more!
But wait, there's more!
But wait, there's more!

Wait a minute! That wasn't on your list! I checked and rechecked the list. You've got new hair, pants, shirt, jacket, and shoes. And let's not forget about the argyle socks, which weren't on the list either!

chatpoints.chat_text: Anyone with any sense of fashion wouldn't need to have nails on a silly list!

replies.reply_text: Fine, fine, fine! I'll got find someone who can fix your nails! I've put so much time into this makeover I'd hate to quit now.
Okay, so maybe I don't have a fine sense of fashion. But I worked hard at trying to making you happy. You should appreciate what I HAVE done! What grouch! I am so outta here!
Right. I did say that. Nails it is then. And I think I saw someone who works with wood right here in Molten Meadows.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were giving me an Extreme Makeover! Look at me! I'm in shambles! A mess! A fashion disaster! Oh, woe is me! Woe is me! What are you waiting for?

replies.reply_text: But you won't look that way for long! I've got something for you!
Ah, yes. I'll start working on that right now. Looks like you better let Edgar know you've agreed to this.
Right you are! I'll get back to work on that now.
And I am! However, I need to get your measurements, and I've got a tape measure right here to do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find someone to fix my ragged fingernails, which are a fashion disaster! They simply ruin the effects of all my new improvements.

replies.reply_text: That's right! Let me check around here in Molten Meadows. I'm sure there's someone here that works on wood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah yes. I must express my gratitude. Now if you'll excuse me, I must practice for my act.

replies.reply_text: Dang! That's not much of a thank you for all the work I did! Guess its time for me to let Edgar know that the Extreme Makeover is complete.
Well, excuse me, Mr. Huffy-Puffy! I've got the shirt right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: My nails! Look at them. They totally ruin the effect.

replies.reply_text: Fine, fine. I'll find someone who can fix your nails!
Aren't you looking sharp and spiffy these days, including your nails! Looks like the Extreme Makeover did you an extreme amount of good!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Farley is checking himself out in the mirror. By the way he is grinning ear to ear, his makeover is a success!)

replies.reply_text: Scary dummy! Time to leave!
Just came by to say hi! And now I'm saying good-bye. See you later, alligator!
Hello, Farley! You are looking all that and more these days! Hey, guess what? I've got a gift for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: In a while, crocodile!

replies.reply_text: Ha, ha! Glad to see you've gotten your sense of humor back. Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: What? You measure me? That's just way too personal! You'll have to figure out something else.

replies.reply_text: Nope, not gonna happen. There's no other way. Since you won't let me measure you, you can kiss your Extreme Makeover goodbye! And goodbye to you, too!
Gesh! Okay, let me go talk to Edgar.
Still haven't learned to say 'thank-you' yet, huh? Oh well, enjoy!

npc_list.name: Stacie
npc_list.admin_description: no more quests on this
npc_list.long_description: Stacie has bright red hair and deep blue eyes, just like her father!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! I am SOOOO happy to see you. I feel like I've been here for days!

replies.reply_text: You poor thing! How long have you been out here and why are you out here by yourself?
I know how you feel. I hate getting lost in the jungle. I think I'll just leave right now.
Oh, dear! Was I helping you with something?
Did your aunt say where to look, exactly?
I'm back with something for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I've been here about an hour. But the sun is REALLY hot! I need to find some Venus Flytraps for my Aunt Heather. She collects exotic plants.

replies.reply_text: Really? Where are these plants supposed to be?
Ugh. Those plants sound disgusting. I am outta here!
I hope you're wearing sunscreen and drinking plenty of water! Good luck finding the plants.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aunt Heather said on the top half of the isle where it rains the most.

replies.reply_text: Rain? I'm sick and tired of rain. Gesh! I am so outta here.
Ah ha! That might be your problem. This isn't the wettest part of the Jungle. The little Isle of Rain is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no! I don't have enough money to go there AND get back to my Aunt Heather. I'm doomed!

replies.reply_text: No need to be a drama queen. Sheesh!
How about if I go to Rain and find them for you? Would that help you?
You are probably right. I don't like hanging around people who are doomed, so I will just be riding off now. Bye!
Good thing I packed my magnifying glass.  I'm sure I'll need it! Bye for now.
Thanks! I can always use these. Remember to drink plenty of water and travel safely!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find some Venus Flytraps on Rain Isle for me. Remember?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right! Be back in a jiffy!
Did your aunt say exacly where to find the plants on Rain Isle?
Indeed I was. And I did. And here they are!

chatpoints.chat_text: She said to examine the floor of the jungle closely. So I guess that means not in the grass, and not on the beach. Hope that helps.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! I'll just use my handy dandy magnifying glass. I'll be back before you know it.
Yuck! Crawl around on the jungle floor? I don't think so!  Maybe I'll feel different later.

npc_list.name: Heather Awlaboard
npc_list.long_description: The inside of the office is filled with plants. Some look suspiciously familiar. You look more closely and realize they are Venus Flytraps.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, there! Come in and sit awhile.

replies.reply_text: Hello again. Oh, my. I just realized how humid it is in here.
Hello to you, too. I really can't stay, but thank you for the offer.
Hello, hello! Say, would you by any chance have any errands you need done? I'm trying to earn some money.
Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
Where did you say I needed to search for those plants?
Was there something I was doing for you?
I am back and I have good news!
I am back with your flies!
I'm baaaccckkk! Last time I was here, you mentioned something about having Stacie search the forests on Wington for some plants.
I'm back and I've got your plants!
Hello there, to you, too. Wow. You've got a lot of plants. Say! If you need more, I'd be happy to go get some for you.
Thank you, I could use a rest.  I was wondering if you could help me, Iona sent me with invitations for the artisans here, but not the collectors. Who's who?
I appreciate the offer but I'm just delivering a package from Pony Express!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is! The perfect climate for my plants. Especially my prized Venus Flytraps.

replies.reply_text: Well, your plants must love the feel of the jungle, because that's just what it feels like in here.
It looks like a jungle in here! And I've had enough of the jungle for today. See you later!
Then your job suits you well! I'll leave you to enjoy it, now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed they do. Thankfully, the ocean spray across the docks keeps things plenty wet.

replies.reply_text: That's interesting. Looks like you've got quite a collection in here.
I think I prefer a dryer climate. I feel so sticky and sweaty here.

chatpoints.chat_text: For a true collector, one can never have enough. Never!

replies.reply_text: I travel all around these islands. Maybe I could help you out sometime.
Looks like way too many for me! Sheesh. There's hardly any room to walk in the place.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, if you have some time, I'm in need of flies. These Venus Flytraps eat more than I expected.

replies.reply_text: Flies? Yuck. No thank you. No way!
Ewwww. I try to stay away from flies. Nasty, germ-spreading pests! They annoy the daylights out of my horse.
Hmmm.  I've seen flies near mud holes. Sure, why not? I'd be happy to help.
I'll be back in a jiffy!
Actually, as crazy as it may sound, I've got those flies right here.
Glad to be able to help you out. Have a terrific day, and thanks for the reward.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly. You were going to get me flies. A half dozen bunches would be great. I think you said you could find them around mud puddles.

replies.reply_text: Well, slap a DUH on my forehead! That's why I've got a buzzing in my saddlebags! Here you go.
I'm on my way now. I'll be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: I could certainly use some help now. I need to track down my niece, Stacie.

replies.reply_text: Stacie? I met her on Jungle. Sweet kid. I see the resemblance now, with the red hair and all. Did she bring you back the Venus Flytraps?
Well, hello and goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: She did indeed. I sent her out on another plant expedition, but I'm a little worried. She should be back by now.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound good. Hope she turns up soon.
Where was she supposed to go?
She didn't do really well on the last plant expedition. Maybe you need to find someone else to send out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just to Bird Isle.  I asked her to search the forests west of Wington.  But that was hours ago.

replies.reply_text: Oh, dear. I would be happy to go look for her.
You know how kids get distracted. Give her a couple more hours. I'm sure she'll turn up.
Maybe she shouldn't go out by herself anymore.
I'm on my way to Bird Isle now. I'll be sure to check the forested areas for her.

chatpoints.chat_text: I agree! She's here on vacation and was just so bored, I thought I'd give her something to do. That's the last errand I'm sending her on!

replies.reply_text: Maybe she could take up reading. Speaking of that, there's a good book I need to finish. Bye!
Why don't I head over there and see if I can find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: You were heading over to Bird Isle to see if you could find my niece.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right. I'll head over there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I could use some good news. Please, tell me you've found my niece.

replies.reply_text: I found her all right. A little worse for wear, but I think she'll be fine.
Maybe I did. Maybe I didn't. I can't remember. Let me think about it. I'll get back to you.
As soon as Elaina has her bandaged up, she'll bring her home.  Thank you for the generous reward and have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good memory! Would you be willing to get those plants for me?

replies.reply_text: Are you wanting more Venus Flytraps? Carnivorous plants kind of creep me out.
Ugggh. No, thank you. I was just wondering.
Oh, goody! More bug-eating plants. I'm perfect for the job!

chatpoints.chat_text: I want the Hooded Pitcher Plant this time. It is a carnivorous plant, too, but you have nothing to fear.

replies.reply_text: Hmm. Wington's not far and it doesn't have much forest area to search. Sure. I'll do it.
Wington has wild bees. I might get stung. Maybe even a kabillion times! I think I'll just pass.
Hooded Pitcher Plant? What, is it related to Little Red Riding Hood? Ha, ha, ha! No thank you!
This magnifying glass is sure coming in handy lately! I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need you to search the forest floors on Bird Isle.

replies.reply_text: Easy-peasy! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: I agree. Are you up for the job?

replies.reply_text: Oh, buggers. I wasn't volunteering. Not at all. But if I see anyone who wants to dig up plants, I'll send them your way.
I might be, but first things first. Where was Stacie heading?
Oh, darn. I just remembered I've got some homework that needs attention. If I find some spare time, I'll come back.
Wowzers! Thanks a lot. Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you offering, but I just sent my niece Stacie to the jungle. She should be looking for the plants as we speak.

replies.reply_text: I hope she doesn't run into the monkeys there. They are a pesky bunch. Well, I guess I'll saddle up and look for work elsewhere, then. Bye.
Really? Maybe she could use some help. Mind if I go and offer her help?
Okay. Well, if you ever need extra help, please feel free to ask me. I ride through here every once and awhile. Have a great day, and keep me in mind!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all. Knowing her, she's somewhere on the top part of Jungle. She doesn't pay the closest attention to directions I give her. Just look for a kid with red hair.

replies.reply_text: Will do! Thanks for the tip.
Jungle. Yea, the more I think about it, the more I think I'll pass. I get lost way too easily there.
Hmm. I'm guilty of that myself, sometimes! Oh, well, never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now, that's an interesting question.  Everybody here is an artisan of some sort, except two of the residents.  And of course Remy, I don't know what he does besides make the best bagels and bialys in all the isles!

replies.reply_text: So, who are the two residents who aren't artisans?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sure. They would be Old Gritty in Sandy Palms and Holly in Snowy Acres.

replies.reply_text: Gritty and Holly... Got it, thanks!
How exciting! Thanks so much and have a great day.

npc_list.name: Stacie
npc_list.admin_description: (2nd Stacie -- after the flytrap quest - no more quests on this)
npc_list.short_description: a young girl who is crying
npc_list.long_description: Stacie has bright red hair and deep blue eyes, just like her father!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Stacie has her head buried in her lap and is sobbing loudly.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, no! Stacie, are you okay?
You think you've got things to cry about now? Wait until your Aunt Heather catches up to you!
Oh my gosh, oh my gosh! You are scaring me with all that crying. I am so outta here!
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She shakes her head no and sobs even louder. You notice a beehive just north in the forest.)

replies.reply_text: Stacie, did you get stung by the bees?
Bees! Run for your lives!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She shakes her head no.) The bees scared me. So I ran. Right into a tree! It hurts! Really, really bad!

replies.reply_text: (You notice a large bump on her head.) Okay, tell you what. Sit here really, REALLY quietly. You don't want to disturb the bees. I'll go get some help. Okay?
If I were you, I'd stay away from bees in the future. Far, far away!  Which is where I'm going now.  You'll be fine.
I'm going over to Elaina's house. She's always serving cookies and milk, so I'm sure she'll know just what to do.
See ya later, alligator!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to ask Elaina for help! Hurry, please.

replies.reply_text: Right! I am so on my way.

npc_list.name: Yazhi
npc_list.long_description: Yahzi is a small woman who is busy making dolls dressed in deerskin clothing.

chatpoints.chat_text: I could do that, especially for that bundle of wool. It is an amazing shade of gold!

replies.reply_text: Now that you mention it, the shade really is amazing. I think I'd like to keep it. Would you be willing to make me a toupée for money?
Wonderful! (You give her the measurements of Farley's head.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our home. Please, have a seat.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! I noticed that you are quite the artisan when it comes to making dolls.
I'm back! Is Farley's toupée ready yet?
Thank you! I would love to sit for a bit. It is very hot out there. (You wipe the sweat off your brow.)
Hi Yazhi, Kendi wants to know if you have anything you could pitch in for her latest batch of sand soup.
Thank you. Let me offer you a bowl of this... delightful... sand soup of your daughter's. She'd really like you to sample it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. I take pride in my efforts. I'm glad it shows.

replies.reply_text: I noticed that your dolls have very realistic looking braids.
It does. Well, time for me to get going. I've got places to go, people to visit and things to do. Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I use wool and dye it. Then I carefully create the braids and sew it onto the sackcloth of the doll's head.

replies.reply_text: Would you be able to create a hair piece? I have some beautiful golden fleece to trade. But this wool is not the right color. I need a hairpiece that is dark brown.
Wow. That sounds like a lot of work. I think I'll stop bothering you. See ya!
Good idea! I'll be back in a few.
He's not my... never mind. Thanks for the toupée. It looks terrific!

chatpoints.chat_text: You offered the wool, and I agreed. Now that I've seen the wool, that's the only agreement I will honor.

replies.reply_text: Well then, never mind! Farley will just have to make do with what he's got!
You are right. We made an agreement. Okay, let's do it. (You give her the measurements of Farley's head.)
Okay, I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh well... I do want her to learn to cook. I suppose I have to taste it to encourage her...

replies.reply_text: Might be you do. Hold your nose so you won't taste it?
That's a pleasant surprise!

npc_list.name: Yiska
npc_list.long_description: Kendi's father is a quiet man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings.

replies.reply_text: Hello. Just thought I'd say hi.
Hi Yiska, I don't suppose you don't have any spare ingredients laying around for Kendi's sand soup?
Hi Yiska... I'm afraid Kendi wants you to sample her soup.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nooooo, not the sand soup!

replies.reply_text: Uh... yeah, the sand soup. Is there a problem?
You are a patient man.

chatpoints.chat_text: The things we do for our children... I suppose you might as well hand me the bowl.

replies.reply_text: Bottoms up.
Well, that's a pleasant surprise!

npc_list.name: Chauncey
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: Chauncey is a proud camel.  He has been a faithful companion for Laurence of Torrid for many years.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maaaww  mmmaaaawwww.

replies.reply_text: Chauncey, I assume?  Laurence asked me to find you.
A camel... Run away!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mmmmaaaawww?

replies.reply_text: Really!  He's very upset.  You know, he got that camel saddle he promised you... You're going to be the best-dressed camel in all these islands!
Look, I don't speak camel.  Laurence wanted me to find you, I found you, I'm out!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mmmaamwww bbbrrraaakkk.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I saw the saddle... All tassels and fringe.  You even got a hand-braided head piece!  Come on back with me and see for yourself.
That's a good boy, Chauncey, let's go home.

npc_list.name: Hessa Hackamore
npc_list.long_description: Cheerful,outgoing woman, eager to share her knowledge of Camel Tack with anyone coming by.

chatpoints.chat_text: Marhaba, welcome to my shop! How may I help you today?

replies.reply_text: (Looking around.) These saddles are very ornate, but they don't look like they would fit on a horse...
Don't you have any horse tack here?
Good day, Hessa.  Laurence asked me to pick up the camel tack he ordered.
Hello there, Hessa! I understand you organize camel trail rides.
Hi there, again! What did you say you remembered about Lelu and her lost necklace?
It is just me again. What can you tell me about packrats?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, that is why I call my shop "Special Gear".  These saddles are only for camels.

replies.reply_text: They certainly are colorful!  Where can I find a camel?
Too bad, I'm not a fan of camels myself... I guess I'll see you around... Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, every once in a while I get some horse tack, but I prefer camels.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad, I prefer horses.  It's been nice meeting you.
Okay, but where do you find camels?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find horses all over the Horse Isles, but you can only find camels here in the deserts of the Desert Isles.

replies.reply_text: I guess I'll come back if I find a camel... Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, the special order for Chauncey. He had me make it from an old photograph of Lawrence of Arabia sitting on a camel. It certainly was a challenge, but I think he'll like it. I'll go get it.

replies.reply_text: Again with the Lawrence of Arabia thing!  I'll wait...
This sure is colorful...  Look at all this fringe and tassels!  It's not my thing, but I bet Laurence will love it. Does he owe you anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it's all paid for.  Ma'a salaama my friend, till we meet again!

replies.reply_text: Ma'a salaama, Hessa!

chatpoints.chat_text: I used to, but not anymore. Tourists wanted to see the same thing - pyramids, pyramids, pyramids. I grew bored with that and sold my last camel several years ago. Is there anything else I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. Maybe. Did you have a specific route you would take? I'm trying to help a friend. She lost an antique locket while riding one of the camels.
I can't say I blame them. Speaking of which, I think I'll head over to a pyramid or two now. Bye!
Well, there isn't much else to see out here. Other than scorpions, lizards, and cactus!
Packrat? That's a great clue! Thanks for the help and have a great day!
Speaking of hours, I think I've spent too much time looking for adventure today. I'd better get some horse chores done. Maybe I can work on this adventure later. See ya!
What can you tell me about packrats?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh! Scourge of the earth! That's what I can tell you! They chew up anything they can, carry off everything that sparkles, and leave droppings on my saddles and all over my tent. Vermin, I tell you, vermin!

replies.reply_text: Then maybe one carried off Lelu's locket. It certainly would have sparkled in this desert! Thanks for telling me that. I think I know where to look now.
Personally, I can't stand rats! If this adventure means dealing with rats, I think I'll pass! Bye!
I wonder what kind of stuff you could find in some of those piles.  Huh.

chatpoints.chat_text: A packrat darted out, and the camel she was riding bolted. Seems her necklace flew right off her neck.

replies.reply_text: That's right! And packrats collect shiny things. All I need to do is find a packrat midden now. Thanks again!
Oh shudders! I forgot about the packrat. I'm just not in the mood for vermin today! Later!

npc_list.name: Chauncey
npc_list.long_description: Chauncey is resting by Laurence's hut, proudly displaying his new tack.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bbbrrraaaakkkk mmmmmaaaarrrrwwww.

replies.reply_text: Hello, Chauncey!  That new tack certainly is magnificent.  Enjoy!

npc_list.name: Chiropticon
npc_list.long_description: Chiropticon always stands in a heroic pose, which does look a little ridiculous considering he's a moose!

chatpoints.chat_text: Beware, evil doer, for I am Chiropticon!  Super moose of the Yukon!

replies.reply_text: Excuse me?!?!?!  Crazy alert, run away!
(Staring at the moose.) Chiropticon? Hmmmmmm...that name rings a bell somehow.
Hello again!  I forgot what you told me to do with these photographs.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Taking another heroic pose.) As well it should! All know of me, why nations shiver at my power.

replies.reply_text: (Think out loud.) Evil doers...super moose...nations shiver... Oh yeah, now I remember, that little kid in Hotton was pretending to be you. I thought he made all that stuff up, especially the fire-breathing moose part.
Okay....this is getting too weird, I'm out!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I'm real....everything about my adventures is factual. (Sheepishly) Except the fire breathing thing.....look, it's cold up here and some twerp saw my breath in the cold and ASSUMED it was smoke left over from a blast of fire.....the fool!

replies.reply_text: That's all very interesting, but I think I forgot to feed my ferret, bye!
So....what do you do around here?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am the guardian of the frozen isles!  I keep a watchful eye on the residents of the frozen North.

replies.reply_text: Well, does that include snooping around a certain young lady's cabin?
Sounds like peeping to me.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was just checking to make sure she was okay.  A young lady living alone out there...someone has to protect her.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she'll be just sooo happy to know that's why a big moose was snooping around her house!
That's very nice and all, but you really should have introduced yourself before you started checking on her. You scared her half to death.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I didn't realize that I had scared her....I didn't mean to!  If there was only some way I could make it up to her....I know!!

replies.reply_text: What do you have in mind?
Okay, I'll deliver these photos.  Mind a suggestion though?

chatpoints.chat_text: What is it?

replies.reply_text: Next time you check on Kelda, stop in and say hello first!  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Taking another heroic stance.) One is for Kelda here on Polar Isle, and the other is for that child in Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, Kelda and Enzo, now I remember.  I'll make sure they get them, see ya!

npc_list.name: Kelda
npc_list.admin_description: Carves wooden dolls
npc_list.long_description: Kelda is a young woman in her first house.  Her house is filled with Nesting Dolls and Swedish Dala Horses of all sizes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in and warm yourself by my fireplace.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm just passing through.  Maybe next time.
Why, thank you, I think I will.
Sorry, Kelda...  What am I doing for you?
Hi Kelda, I'm back and boy do I have news for you!
Sorry to bother you again, but what am I looking for again?
Kelda....I'm back!
Thanks, I could use a little warmth about now.  Wow! These dolls are really something!
Hi! I was wondering if you could paint this carved fish for me?  It has to be realistic and life like.
Hello! I come bearing a pony sculpture!
Thank you, Kelda.  Actually, I'm here with a proposition for you.
I'm not sure, but I kinda remember agreeing to do something for you. Does that ring a bell?
I've brought back something for you!
Hello there. Just wondering if you are done with the nesting doll set yet?
Ummm - any chance that doll set is done yet?
Looking for a completed doll set. Is today my lucky day?
So, I worked on having patience. I looked for wild horses. I twiddled my thumbs and counted my toes about a kabillion times. I am sooooo hoping that the doll set is finished and ready to go!
Just dropping by to let you know that Stacie absolutely loved the nesting doll set you made for her.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad you stopped by.....you've got to help me!!!

replies.reply_text: Okay, what seems to be the problem?
Uh oh, looks like I found another crazy!  I gotta go, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I keep hearing strange noises coming from the trees near my house....and sometimes I get the feeling that I'm being watched.

replies.reply_text: Calm down, what sort of noises?
Really?  You're being watched?  By whom?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know what or who! It makes a bellowing noise like this (Kelda demonstrates a noise that can only be described as a gigantic, asthmatic cat trying to cough up a fur ball!)

replies.reply_text: Sorry, but I don't want to find out what makes a noise like that!  Bye!
I tell you what, I'll go outside by the trees and look high and low for clues and I'll let you know what I find.
I'll be careful, don't worry.  I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to look for clues to see what has been outside my cabin.  You said you'd look high and low around my cabin and the trees outside.

replies.reply_text: Doh!  That's right, look high and low for clues by the trees outside.  Be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: What did you find?

replies.reply_text: I found evidence that something large has been chewing on the upper branches of the tree outside your window, and I found some tracks outside heading East, could be an elk or a reindeer or even a moose, way too big for a horse!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Chewing on the pine trees?  Do you think that you can find that poor creature and see if there's anything I can do to help it?

replies.reply_text: The same dreadful monster you were so afraid of is now a poor creature!?  I'm out!
Suppose I can find it for you.  What am I supposed to do once I find it?
Okay...I'll be back as soon as I find out what it wants.  Bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to follow the tracks and find the animal that has been outside my house.  You said that they were heading East, maybe you should head that way too. I'd look around the trees for the tracks if I were you.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay, now I remember!  Look for the tracks near trees...I'll be back as soon as I found it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh good!  Did you find that poor creature?

replies.reply_text: I sure did, but I wouldn't exactly call him a "poor creature".

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't leave me hanging!  Give me details.  How can I help him?

replies.reply_text: Your mysterious visitor is none other than the famous Chiropticon, Super Moose of the Yukon!  He thought that living out here alone, somebody should keep an eye on you.  He didn't mean to scare you. Oh yeah, he also sent you this.
Thanks for the penguin!  Oh, I told Chiropticon to say hello next time he comes by.  Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why thank you, that's what I do, I paint these nesting dolls and Dala horses.  My parents and grandparents taught me the designs, I keep it somewhat traditional, but I like to experiment with nontraditional colors.

replies.reply_text: These are really wonderful.  Thanks for the warm-up, but I have to go now.  See you around!
You do beautiful work, but I bet you don't get many visitors way out here.
Would you by any chance be willing to sell one? I'm trying to find a doll for a young lady who was a bit traumatized by a visit to the jungle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm sorry, I paint folk designs, I don't paint realism.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll keep looking, thanks anyway!
I'm sure you'll come up with something really special!

chatpoints.chat_text: What sort of proposition do you have in mind?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival. She's hoping you can attend and display your work. Here's your invitation.
Like I always say, any excuse is a good excuse to travel!  I'll give Iona your answer.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear! I can imagine how scary the jungle could be. (Kelda hesitates for a moment. It looks like she's debating whether or not she'd be willing to sell one. Finally, she nods, as if to herself. ) I'd be happy to make a set for her. I'll need some supplies though.

replies.reply_text: A set? Really, I'm only looking for one doll.
Supplies? Well, this seems to be a bit more involved than I was planning on. Perhaps I'll come back another day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you see, the dolls nest within each other, creating an entire set of dolls. (She opens a wooden doll to reveal another smaller doll inside. When she opens the smaller doll, there is even a smaller doll inside that doll!) I could make one that incorporates the best of what Jungle has to offer.

replies.reply_text: That's amazing! I'm happy to help. What supplies will you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, when you first asked me, I was thinking how I could both create a nesting doll and make the jungle a little less frightening. I think I've come up with a clever way, but I'll need things I don't currently stock.

replies.reply_text: I'll head out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It certainly does. You wanted a nesting doll for a child that was frightened by the jungle. I needed ebony nesting forms, beetle shells and gold leaf.

replies.reply_text: Now THAT rings a bell! I'm on my way.
Oh my! I had completely forgotten. I've got them right here!
Where did you say I could get the gold leaf?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm anxious to see what you've brought.

replies.reply_text: I've brought you the nesting forms. Oh, and Xamba said hi. He really thinks highly of your crafting skills.
I've brought you the beetle shells.
Looky here, looky here! One delicate sheet of gold leaf!
Opps! My mistake. I think you have everything you asked for, right?
That's it.  I think I have more to get.  I'll be back soon!
I have something else for you!
I think that's all you asked for, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh silly you! I've got days of work in front of me. But let me show you how fun the 3rd form has come out! Look at all the silly monkees I've painted on it.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Maybe I'll go find some wild horses to catch. That should fill up a couple of days.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh Heaven's no! I've got tons more hours of painting and gilding in front of me. But look at the smallest one! I've covered it in beautiful jungle flowers.

replies.reply_text: Okay dokey. I'll be back in a few.
And I've got something else for you!
That should be everything that you asked me to get you.
Okay, I'm pretty sure I brought you every thing you asked me to.
There's something else I've brought for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm. Patience isn't your strongest suit, is it? Not done, not by a long shot. But look how beautifully the 5th form has come out! I've covered it in beautiful beetle shell butterflies with gilded edges.

replies.reply_text: Well alrighty then. I'll go work on building up some patience!
I'll see you around then!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is indeed! Must be your lucky day! This has been the most difficult, but most satisfying set I've ever made. Thank you for giving me that honor. I will happily hand it over for payment of $2500.

replies.reply_text: What? I had no clue it would cost that much. I'm afraid I will have to run to the bank. I'll be back shortly.
Most difficult AND most satisfying? I'm sure it is worthy every penny. Here you go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Notice how I made the outside look like a beautiful young girl. Her painted dress is highlighted with the jewel colored beetle shells and dashes of gold leaf!

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she'll love it. And yes, I'll happily let you when I'm out here again.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is so heartwarming to hear! Thank you so much for letting me know.

replies.reply_text: You are most welcome! Have a wonderful week!

chatpoints.chat_text: Smiddy Jones should have some.

replies.reply_text: Ah yes.  Great.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Barnacle Bob
npc_list.admin_description: Boatman on Hat Isle, Barnacle Ben's brother.
npc_list.short_description: a pirate who'd rather be elsewhere
npc_list.long_description: This poor, long-suffering pirate has obviously had his beard trimmed recently, and he is constantly toying with it in order to get it back to its ratty normality.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well?  Seen enough?

replies.reply_text: Enough of what?
Yeah, let's go.
Not yet. I haven't seen a kraken. I was looking for one. Have you ever seen a kraken?

chatpoints.chat_text: Shockin' ain't it?  Such behavior in a pirate I ain't never seen, and arr, I ain't of no mind to see it again neither!  Let's be gettin' away afore'n we catch whatever it is makes 'em weird.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I don't know, I kind of like weird.  A little oddity is good for a body.
Oh that.  Yeah, just terrible.  Let's go back to Skullton now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Says you!  I be leavin'.  Be ye comin', or be ye not?

replies.reply_text: No, I think I'll go around and try to catch some of this contageous crazy.
Yeah, let's go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Kraken, eh? I seen plenty of awfully big squid, but I ain't never seen no kraken.

replies.reply_text: I haven't, either. Bah. Thanks anyhow.

npc_list.name: Mirah
npc_list.admin_description: MrsWaterLine as a kid. Western house, Whorl isle
npc_list.long_description: Mirah squints at everything around her, as if she needs glasses. When she sees you, though, her face lights up in a bright, friendly grin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there!

replies.reply_text: Hi! This is some island!
Hi!  Say, what's that easel in the corner for?
Hello! I have a pony sculpture for you from Mona!

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh-huh! There isn't a single one like it in all of Horse Isle!

replies.reply_text: It looks pretty idyllic! You have a little of everything. Little beach, little forest, little swamp grass...

chatpoints.chat_text: And the little pond for my koi!

replies.reply_text: Yeah!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  That would be lovely.  It's a brown dog with a nice black nose, back and tail.  I wanted the dog to look a little royal, so the collar is an appropriate color for that.  I want a nice bright day and grass too.  Thanks!

replies.reply_text: I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that?  I was going to paint a picture of a dog, but I never got around to it.

replies.reply_text: I could do it for you if you want.
Oh, well.  I bet you'll get to it some day.  Bye!
She gave it to you because you're her friend- I'm sure she'll love whatever you come up with!

npc_list.name: Beebonnet Buck
npc_list.admin_description: Southeast pirate hut, Hat Isle.
npc_list.long_description: Beebonnet Buck has a bee on, not in, his bonnet. He knitted it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, what be you lookin' at?

replies.reply_text: Er... Nothing?
I dunno. I was doing something for you, wasn't I?
I be lookin' at your needles in my hand! (You hand over the cloth bundle of knitting needles.)
I be lookin' at that big hole in your roof! You haven't fixed that yet?
That big hole in your roof... I forgot what you needed to fix it.
That big hole in your roof! I'm back with the straw and sticks you needed to fix it.

chatpoints.chat_text: You be lookin' at my needles?

replies.reply_text: Er... No, sir, I am not looking at your knitting needles which you have just shoved up against my nose. Could you, er, back up?
No, what needles?

chatpoints.chat_text: ARR, YOU BE LOOKIN' AT THEM!

replies.reply_text: (You bolt.)

chatpoints.chat_text: ARR, WHY AIN'T YOU LOOKIN' AT MY NEEDLES? THEY ARE GREEN AND POINTY!

replies.reply_text: Like a cactus?
Er... I don't see any needles.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, they be knittin' needles! For knittin'! Not for cacti, cacti don't knit!

replies.reply_text: Right. Just so.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wot? (He looks at his hands.) My needles! They be missin'!

replies.reply_text: What needles? Maybe I could help you find them.
Well yes, obviously.
A bird? How do you know it was a bird?
Sure thing! Gonna bring out my trusty binoculars!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, that bird always be stealin' me stuff! (He points to a small hole in the thatching of his roof.) Swoops in here an' takes it!

replies.reply_text: Don't you maybe want to fix your roof, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: NEEDLES FIRST!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, you was findin' that bird in the trees north up here and findin' what she did with my needles!

replies.reply_text: Right, I'll go look for her some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, but ye've layers deeper to be talkin' to!

Yer conscious mind says, "Dunno why I came here, matey." Yer unconscious mind knows. But there be two segments to the unconscious mind- one that has a reason, and one that just be wantin'!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeh! They're influenced by stuff in yer unconscious- it's real, or it seems real, but yer not aware of it until ye delve down deep into yer mind and really think about it!

chatpoints.chat_text: The thoughts that be in yer unconscious mind, they be repressed there. Stuff yer conscious mind doesn't want to think about. Say for instance ye had a bad moment as a wee kiddo where ye felt like a fool. Ye were ashamed. replies.reply_text: But if it stayed down under the rug the whole time, how would we know that the unconscious mind is there?

replies.reply_text: Okay then!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yer psychosis has to come from somewhere!

chatpoints.chat_text: ARRR! BEGONE WITH YE! YE BEEN TALKIN' TO THAT BOXY BERNIE!

chatpoints.chat_text: THE MOST DELUDED PIRATE TO EVER WALK THE PLANK! I wish he'd walk the plank. ARRR!

replies.reply_text: Whoo, I am getting out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, ye got two parts to yer unconscious mind. One be sayin, "I be wantin' this, I be wantin' that, I be wantin' it all now!" And that be all it thinks about. The other part says, "Is it right? Is it moral? Can I be sleepin' with meself at night if'n I do this?"

Who's Mum's-The-Word Maria?

chatpoints.chat_text: ONLY THE MOST MISGUIDED PIRATE TO HAVE SET FOOT ON HAT ISLE! Except that crazy poet. I WISH SHE'D LEAVE, ARR!

replies.reply_text: What crazy poet?

chatpoints.chat_text: The one wanderin' up an' down the shoreline, shoutin' rhyme! Arr, a body can't sleep at nights!

replies.reply_text: He sounds mad!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, Maria be only the most misguided piratess to have set foot on Hat Isle!
