chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up from her desk, where she's fiddling with a rusty, circular piece of equipment.) May I help you?

replies.reply_text: Just passing through, thanks though.
I'm just wandering around. What's that you've got there?
Yes. This is going to sound odd, but... have you seen a pony around? I'm looking for some missing ponies...
Hi Cara, remember that quadrant a pony stole- I've brought it back.
I hope so.  I'm looking for a woodworker who lives in Treeton, any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: This? It's an astrolabe. It's gotten a bit rusty, see?

replies.reply_text: (You look closer.) Sure has. Is that made of iron? I thought most astrolabes were made of brass?
An astro-what?
Oh, it sure has. I didn't recognize it at first.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mariners use these to determine the latitude of their ships. It measures either the declination of the sun, or of a star.

replies.reply_text: Oh! I see. It seems like an awfully inefficient method, though.
Slow down, lady, you're speaking- what is that, Latin? What's "declination"?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's like the latitude of stars. For the sun, for instance, it's the angle of the sun's rays compared to the equator.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I get it!
I... see.
(Skeptically:)And this is the best method for judging latitude?

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right, brass is usually used for these- for one thing, it doesn't rust. If this were brass, I wouldn't have this problem. This one isn't mine, though, it's an old one someone found on the beach. I'm just polishing it up.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you're right about that. It's not the best, but it's what we've got right now.

replies.reply_text: I guess. Maybe one of these days people will figure out a better option.
Sounds like a trip to the livery may be in order... and I'll bring your quadrant back after, shall I?
You're welcome. I'm sorry about that.

chatpoints.chat_text: A woodworker here in Treeton? (Snaps fingers.) I got it! I bet you are looking for Cecil Shuteye at the Inn. He carves beautiful miniatures.

replies.reply_text: I'm off to the Inn then....thanks!

npc_list.name: April May Rain
npc_list.admin_description: a child in Treeton who is justifiably livid at her parents
npc_list.long_description: The most common expression on April May Rain's face is a scowl, and that's because people call her by her full name. She much prefers to be called Sir Spike- Spike to her closest friends- which her classmates freely admit is more suitable.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha! En garde! (Leaps in front of you, brandishing a stick.)

replies.reply_text: Et tu, you! (Pick up a stick yourself and swish it around.)
Whoa! What are you doing there, kiddo? You could hurt somebody!
Eek! Fierce child with pigtails and stick! No good can come of this!
Easy there! All I want to know is if you've seen a pony running around.
Take it easy, Spike. You wanted something from me, right? Something a pony took from you? What was that again?
Disarm yourself, noble knight! I hath brought thee a cookie!
Et tu, you! (Pick up a stick yourself and swish it around.)
Easy there. What was I doing for you?
Easy there. What was I doing for you?
Hi Spike, I've brought those books back! And let me tell you, it wasn't easy for sure!
Hi Spike, done reading yet?
Hi Spike, how about now?
How about NOW? Finished reading?
Don't whack me with that stick, I'll have to defend myself... with your brand new shield!

chatpoints.chat_text: THAT'S "SIR SPIKE THE NOBLE" TO YOU, KNAVE! HAVE AT THEE! (Points the stick at you.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay. Sir Spike it is. What on earth are you doing?
Sir Spike the Noble it is. And the Great Me the Uncertain of Motives of Children With Big Sticks is heading out.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm fencing! Haven't you ever fenced before?

replies.reply_text: No, I can't say that I have. What is it?
Oh, sure! But I thought fencing was done with a sword.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's a sport. It's like swordplay. Only the wicked witch who happens to live in my house won't let me have a sword, so instead I have a stick.

replies.reply_text: I hope you don't mean your mother when you say that...
Frankly, at- how old are you?- I wouldn't want you to have a sword either.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Scowling.) Some people call her that.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's a heck of a thing to say about your mom.
Well, having not met your mother, I'm not going to judge.

chatpoints.chat_text: If your mother wouldn't let you have a sword or a pony, what would you call her?

replies.reply_text: I'd still call her Mom, I guess.
When I was your age I got a pony and a sword and a real live elephant, so I'm not sure I can sympathize.
I'm not sure I blame your mom for not letting you have a sword.
Speaking of ponies... I'm on a hunt for one. Has one happened to have come through here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the wicked witch who lives in my house won't let me have a sword, so I've got this instead. For practice.

replies.reply_text: Whoa, do you mean your mother?
You have a real live wicked witch in your house? Are you from Cloud Isle? So cool...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Swishes her stick around angrily.) Yeah! I did see a pony! I tried to lure it over with my cookie- every good knight needs a noble steed, see, and that woman won't let me have a pony 'cause she says I don't know how to take responsibility or something- anyway, I tried to lure it over with my cookie, but all it did was take the cookie and run!

replies.reply_text: That's a pony for you. Where's the pony now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I let it run! Straight back to the livery, it went, chewing all the way!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry for the loss of your cookie, but I'm glad the pony went home... see, she escaped earlier today and I've been trying to track her down.
I can do that, sure. Maybe I'll run by an inn once I've rounded up all three ponies.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were bringing me a cookie since that darn pony ran off with mine! Chocolate chip walnut please!

replies.reply_text: That's right. Off to an inn with me.
Glad you like it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Your form is totally awful! You're even holding your sword the wrong way. Don't you know anything about swordfighting?

replies.reply_text: I know plenty about swordfighting, thank you. What do you know about swordfighting?
Uh, you realize we're talking about sticks here, not swords?
Not a darn thing! You probably know more than I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know lots and lots about swordfighting! I've read all the books in the library.

replies.reply_text: Yeah? So, what's in your armory, then?
And that makes you an expert, huh? I'm getting out of here before you whack me with your stick again.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've got my trusty sword here, Lightning! (She brandishes it in what she probably considers to be a heroic pose.) And I had a dagger too, but I lost it.

replies.reply_text: That seems safe, just losing your dagger somewhere.  You should probably find that.  Bye.
What about a shield? Don't you have one of those?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm working on that. See, I want to make a real shield. The kind a knight would have! All the books are really specific about the heraldic devices and what they mean, so that must be important. But to do the research I need to go to the library, and that's a problem.

replies.reply_text: Why is it ever a problem to go to the library?

chatpoints.chat_text: See, I'm kind of not allowed in the library right now. The wicked witch who lives in my house says until I pay off all my overdue fees and get better at remembering when they're due I can't take out any more books.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Well, I'm not doing much right now, I could go to the library and get a book on armory for you. But you have to promise me you'll return it on time. My library card can't stand more fines either.
That cramps your style. Best of luck with that problem.
Sure, back in a jiff.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to the library to check out a book on heraldry and armory for me.

replies.reply_text: Oh right. Thanks.
Yeah, that got a little more complicated than expected... I'll get back on it.
...does that happen a lot?
...I'll just come back later.
Okay.
Argh... okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have! Just now! (She shuts the bigger hardback.) Thank you so much for bringing those books, I learned so much! And I decided what device I want on my shield!

replies.reply_text: Yeah? And what's that?
Well it's about darn time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Loads of times. That's okay. I can read better when nobody bothers me, so it's okay if nobody's around, even if the wicked witch who lives in my house says I'll never get properly socialized with my nose in a book. (Indeed, throughout this speech she hasn't taken her nose out of the one you brought back for her.)

replies.reply_text: I can take a hint. I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you know that traditionally, heraldic animals represented different traits? Actually, everything on the shield was representative of something!

replies.reply_text: So... what would you like on yours?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would like! (Pauses for effect.) A bear rampant guardant vol holding a sword, on a field of or and argent per bend sinister! The bear should be brown, the wings painted like an eagle's, and the sword, well, like a sword.

replies.reply_text: Whoa. Whoa now, wait, what? What does all that mean?
Wow, that sounds complicated! I don't know half of what you just said.
...you want to speak English?
Wow, you really did your research, didn't you?

chatpoints.chat_text: The bear means "strength" and "cunning." The rest of the stuff about the bear, rampant guardant, means how it's standing- it's standing up on its hind legs looking at you. "Vol" means it has wings, which represent protection! A shield is made for protection, so that suits. The sword stands for justice and honor. The way the field is divided doesn't really mean anything, it's just the design, and technically the gold means "generosity" and the silver means "sincerity" but really I just think it'll look nice against the bear.

replies.reply_text: Why exactly does the bear have wings?
Wow. That sounds really complicated. What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's going to be a little difficult. First I'll need a master woodcarver to make the shield, and probably cover it over in leather- that's how it's done, you know? And then I'll have to get it painted.

replies.reply_text: Which probably means I'm going to be getting that done for you, right?
Off I go in pursuit of a wingy-bear shield!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you know, if you had a bear, why wouldn't you want it to have wings?

replies.reply_text: I see where you're going with that. So what's next?
...I can think of a couple of reasons. What's next, anyhow?

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting my shield made for me! I needed you to go to a woodworker to have it made, and then to have it painted.

replies.reply_text: Right, I remember now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooh! Ooh, oooh, let me see!

replies.reply_text: (Hand her the shield.)
(Present the shield to her with great ceremony.)
Bear it in good health!

npc_list.name: Devie
npc_list.admin_description: A Very Bad Shetland! involved in Paul Paddock's Pony Pandemonium
npc_list.long_description: Though she be but small, she be fierce- and apparently hungry, although, to judge by the size of her barrel, she's in no danger of starvation.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nibbles at the grass, then opens her jaw to take a big bite of the wood frame!)

replies.reply_text: Oh no you don't! (Quickly apprehend the pony, buckling your belt around her neck so you can lead her home.)

npc_list.name: Lapis Maki
npc_list.long_description: Lapis Maki, like her cousin Jade, is a walking jewelry display. Necklaces, bracelets and rings adorn her with patterns and styles from all over the world.

chatpoints.chat_text: My, my, I didn't hear you come in. What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Nothing really, I'm just looking.  Nice shop though!
You look vaguely familiar, do you make jewelry?
Hi! Nomasonto asked me to see you, she needs a coming of age necklace for Mtomka.  She said you would know just what to make.
So sorry, but I forgot what you asked me to bring back.
I'm back and I have everything you asked for.
Is Mtomka's necklace ready yet?
I'm hoping you can make a very particular necklace. Coral and obsidian.
It's not what you can do for me, but what I can do for you.  I have a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: That I do.  Just bring me the proper materials, and I can make anything on that list.  The ores are most important, of course.

replies.reply_text: What good is jewelry?
Ores?  Where do I get those?
Of course. Thanks for the tour,  but I have to go now.  Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's mostly for looks.  It's also worth a lot.  So, if you can find a good rock store and sell it there for normally quite a bit.

replies.reply_text: Do you know where the best place to sell it would be?
Your jewelry looks more tribal than those in Whiskerton, in fact, you sort of look like the owner there too.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know Rocco Shale sells and buys things at really good prices.  I don't know where his rock store is right now, though.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for the information!

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find all ores on rock piles, you can find turquoise there too..  The only ores I use are copper and silver.  No need to bring me any gold or iron ore.  I don't work with either of those.

replies.reply_text: Silver, copper and turquoise....sounds nice.  I'll be back when I have enough materials to get some of your jewelry, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: My cousin, Jade, owns the Whiskerton shop.  She's far more into fine jewelry than I am.  I much prefer the tribal styles, they have more character, don't you think?

replies.reply_text: I kinda like all jewelry, guess I'll be bringing both of you a lot of business.  Till next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is Mtomka really that old already?  Seems like only yesterday she was crawling around our feet while Nomasonto and I enjoyed our jasmine tea....  Well now, I'll need a few items, if you wouldn't mind.

replies.reply_text: I should have seen this coming.  What do you need?
Okay, I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's okay...I need 5 peacock feathers and a chunk of coral.  If you head due south from my shop and go all the way down to the water's edge...you'll find the coral.  Don't forget your shovel!

replies.reply_text: Five peacock feathers and go south as far as I can go and dig at the water's edge for the coral....got it, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  I finished the turquoise, silver and copper beads and braided the leather strappings, now all I have to do is make some beads from the coral and put it all together.  Let's see what you brought!

replies.reply_text: Sure thing....here they are! (You hand over the coral and feathers.)
Will do, see you later!
This is so beautiful...and so unique! Do I owe you anything for this? (Lapis shakes her head, no, and smiles.) Great! I'll get this right back to Nomasonto, thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm afraid that's not really in my line of work. You would want someone who works with sea things.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: What sort of proposition are you talking about?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your jewelry.  Here's your Invitation.
Catching up with your cousin would be nice  I'll let Iona know you are coming.

npc_list.name: Lydia
npc_list.admin_description: George Napper's daughter, Appleton
npc_list.long_description: You hardly notice Lydia when you first walk into the inn- although the upper floor of the inn rings with the giggles and screeches of her younger siblings, she is sitting quietly in the corner, reading a book and looking thoroughly content.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Reading quietly to herself.) "If a good thought passed through a man's mind, then a grin was seen in the mirror, and the sprite laughed heartily at his clever discovery..."
Oh! (Slams the book shut, turning pink.) Sorry, I didn't hear you come up. May I help you? Tea? We have wonderful tea here, or pizza perhaps?

npc_list.name: Carmina
npc_list.admin_description: Master of Foxhounds for the Earton Hunt
npc_list.long_description: Carmina is kneeling as she scratches the ear of a nearby foxhound, but when she notices your eyes on her, she stands to shake your hand. A handsome woman, she strikes you as one of considerable perception and of singular attitude.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there. Come to rest your horses, have you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, we've just come in from a big adventure. What brings you here?
No, I was aiming for the hay pile but missed. Pleased to meet you, gonna go get my horse some grub now.
Sorta kinda. I was doing something for you, I know, but I lost track.
No, come to update you on the fox situation.
No, come to update you on the fox situation.
Carmina, I'm back, and I've sorted out your fox problem!
What was I working on for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am the Master of Foxhounds for the Earton Hunt, of course. (She indicates her pink coat.) Just getting my big gray ready to go this morning.

replies.reply_text: You mean a fox hunt? Isn't that cruel to foxes?
Yes, that coat is very attractive. You know, maybe you can tell me. What's with all the red coats?
Oh. Well, good luck to you!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not at all- although the hunts I know that do still chase foxes very, very rarely, if ever, harm the foxes. What we do instead is called drag hunting. Are you familiar with it?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I know what that is.
No, what's that?
Uh... sorta kinda maybe?

chatpoints.chat_text: So you know that when I sent my brother- he's the "fox" for the day- out to drag a trail clear down to Appleton, it was to prepare for this morning's hunt! Maybe you saw him?

replies.reply_text: Uhh... no, I didn't. It must have been quite a sight. Don't you have foxes around here too?
Maybe I did and maybe I didn't... you meet all kinds of strange folk around here. I think I'll go meet some more of them.
I... can't say that I did. But you see some really unusual people around these parts...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's like fox hunting, except that, instead of chasing after foxes, we send a volunteer out to drag- hence the name- a scent around the country. It gives us a specific path the hounds will follow, and bothers no foxes.

replies.reply_text: Ohhh, that makes sense. So you control your path too, and you know where you're going. But don't you have foxes around here too?
Bothers no foxes? Do you have a lot of foxes around here?
Oh, I see. That sounds like fun.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sighs heavily.) Actually, we are having a problem in that regard.

replies.reply_text: How do you mean?
Are foxes a problem for a drag hunt?
Uh-oh. Problems? I smell problems for me to solve. Uh-uh, not today, I just came in here to rest my ponies, and I am not getting them tuckered out again.

chatpoints.chat_text: There is one fox in the area that, well, I think he is taunting our hounds. Not one of my hounds has ever hared after a fox- at least not once they grew up and got the puppy out of them. But this fox will, almost deliberately, run in front of them. It's really rather... trying.

replies.reply_text: How so? Wouldn't it be a nice change for your hounds to have a different scent?
Taunting your hounds? What, does he run after your drag and do the hula? What makes him such a problem?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it disrupts the hunt. One of the reasons we drag hunt, aside from it being courteous to foxes, is that it allows us to set the terrain for the hunt. So we know, for instance, that a certain day's hunt will be safe for children on ponies, or if it might be trying. It's nice as an introduction for our members. But when you've got a fox involved, all your plans go out the window! I have a number of young riders joining me today for a gentle trot cross-country. If my hounds go after a fox, it may take them over terrain at a pace that's unsafe for the young entry.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see the problem. So you don't want him to tempt the hounds into switching scents because you don't want to have your young riders hitting the dirt! Well, maybe I could, I don't know, occupy him while you go out?
Oh, that does sound like a problem. Good luck with that, or something. I do not meddle in the affairs of foxes.
Okay! Do you have any idea where I could find the wily critter?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, mostly he lives south of here, I think. The last time I saw him, he was stalking rabbits- alas, a fox will- and the rabbits tend to be out by the vegetables. I can't tell you much more than that, I'm afraid.

replies.reply_text: Well, that at least gives me something. I'll, well, I guess I'll go on a fox hunt of my own!

chatpoints.chat_text: Staff of the hunts here wear scarlet- "pink," we call them- coats. Like privileged members, we also have specific colors on our collars for our hunt, as well as a hunt-specific button. Here, take a look.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see. I didn't know that. So are you going on a fox hunt then? Isn't that cruel to foxes?
I didn't know that foxhunters were such fashionistas!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were trying to find our local fox and convince him to occupy himself differently this morning.

replies.reply_text: That's right. Do you have any idea where I could find him?

chatpoints.chat_text: And?

replies.reply_text: Well, it appears you've got a wily one. He has a bet on- please don't laugh- that he can disrupt your hunt today. I couldn't talk him out of it.
(You grin.) Well, I have him sorted. But I can't tell you how, and I have to go- I think something about me is bothering your hounds... (Indeed, you- or your pack- are getting a lot of attention!)

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's what one gets for reasoning with foxes, I suppose. It's all right- I sent my brother up towards Tail Forest with a drag instead. That way the kids still get to go on their hunt, and I can guarantee- as close as you can get with horses and hounds- that it will be an experience suitable to their level.

replies.reply_text: So your kids will still be safe no matter what! That's great.
Thanks! I'm glad this worked out well and safe for your kids. Happy hunting!
Yeah, I don't know what's upsetting them so... (Fingers crossed behind your back.) Oh well. I've got to go see an owl about a fox. Seriously.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, have you?

replies.reply_text: (You explain how, by getting Renard into the livery, you managed to help him fulfill his bet by confusing the hounds, and get him to leave the hounds alone today.)

chatpoints.chat_text: You were sorting out my fox problem. Something about how you had the situation under control and would come back when you're done. I'm dying to know what's going on- have you finished whatever it was?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have!
Not yet. I'll go take care of that. Something about an owl... no kidding...

npc_list.name: Señor Cangrejo
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP10
npc_list.long_description: Watch out! There's a huge hairy crab spider sulking in the skull.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye carumba! A human! Go away. Now. Or I will bite you! Twice! Run! Run fast!

replies.reply_text: Yikes! A hairy spider. Flee!
Riiight! You don't look all that scary to me. Actually, you look boring to me. I'll just go find something more exciting to do.
I can see why you are called a crab spider. Because you are a grouchy CRAB!

chatpoints.chat_text: Back away now. Or I will bite you. Twice. Maybe three times!

replies.reply_text: Oh yikes! I'm shaking in my brand new cowboy boots! NOT! I think I'll go find a more pleasant spider to talk to. Adiós!
You ARE a grouch. Are you related to Ebenezer, the horseshoe crab on Welcome Isle?
Señor Cangrejo, Carlotta sent me here with a welcoming gift for you.
quest check

chatpoints.chat_text: Carlotta? You are trying to trick me! I don't believe you. You cannot be talking about my friend. Go away! Hurry. Before I bite you.

replies.reply_text: Carlotta said she knew you when you were a little spider called Cahngy. She asked me to give you this gift to welcome you to Horse Isle.
Fine, fine. I'm leaving already.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cahngy? Yes! I was called that. Then it is true. You have seen my friend Carlotta. But a gift? For ME? But... no one has ever given me a gift before. This is a joke, yes?

replies.reply_text: Nope. No joke. Carlotta has a really big heart. Here, take it.
Look, if you don't want it, its no skin off my back. I'll just tell Carlotta you rejected her gift.
Maybe it is, maybe it isn't. But I'm not staying around to find out! This quest has already taken too much of my time. Adios!
You don't look very fierce to me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ebenezer? I do not know this crab.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? You didn't trip over him when you were on Welcome Isle?
Yea, right! You act just like him. I am so outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: But I am, as you say, a grouch. A big grouch. I do not deserve a gift.

replies.reply_text: Oh, we all have days when we feel a little grouchy. Here. Take the gift.
You're right. I'll be leaving now.

chatpoints.chat_text: No! Wait. It is not my wish to offend her. She offers a gift? I must do nothing less than accept it!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! Here it is.

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! You were bringing me a gift from Carlotta. May I have it now?

replies.reply_text: That's right! Here it is.
Whew! That will free up some space in my saddle bags.
I've had a change of heart. I'm not giving it to you. Sorry!
I'll tell her. And welcome to Horse Isle!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hola! How are you, my friend?

replies.reply_text: I'm great! Hope you are, too. See you later.
I'm great! I assume you are too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome Isle?

replies.reply_text: Yea, the isle with Roxie the turtle and Welcome Willy?
I don't have time for this! I've got horses to feed and homework to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was shipwrecked here. On this very island! No other! I had a friend. Once. I looked for Carlotta. She is not here. So leave me be already. Go. Before I bite you.

replies.reply_text: Well that explains a lot! Yikes! Look at the time. Gotta gallop!

npc_list.name: Shastri
npc_list.short_description: A young resident of Vine Isle
npc_list.long_description: Shastri is a  young girl seated on Smokey, her grey Fell Pony.

chatpoints.chat_text: Whatcha doin' here?

replies.reply_text: I'm moving on now, thank you!
I'm exploring this island, what are you doing out here?
Aren't I doing something for you?
I came back because I found Samantha for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me and Smokey are 'sploring too!

replies.reply_text: Okay, but you look a little upset, is anything the matter?
Well, have fun 'sploring, bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! (Starting to sniffle.) I've been waiting for some one to pass this way....I really need help with something.

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll bite, what do you need help with?
Oh no, don't look at me!  I avoid children in need of help at all costs.  See ya kid!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sammy is lost and I have to find her before Auntie Esther finds out that I lost her!

replies.reply_text: This is starting to sound too complicated. I'm sure that someone else will come along soon.  Bye!
(Sighs.) Okay, who or what is Sammy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sammy is my Auntie's kitty cat, Samantha. We were out here riding along the jungle edge, when an old silly-head parrot swooped down and scared Smokey, and Sammy jumped off my saddle and ran into the jungle. (Shastri is now crying.) She's all alone in there and I can't find her and...and...and my Auntie will be mad at me if I come back without Sammy!

replies.reply_text: Why don't you just tie off your pony to this tree and look for Samantha yourself?
Sorry, I can't help you, I'm allergic to cats.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sniffling again.) Oh no, I can't leave Smokey all alone too! And besides, I'm not allowed to go into the jungle alone.

replies.reply_text: Can't help you...I don't do jungles either....too many creepy things!
Well it looks like you're going to have to tell your Aunt Esther that you lost her cat.  Besides, Samantha will probably come back on her own.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please?... Pretty please?... Pretty please with sugar on top?

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll help you look for the cat, just stop crying!
I hate to see little girls cry. I guess I could try to find the cat for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yea! Oh thank you ever so much!

replies.reply_text: Okay, you've hooked me!  What does Samantha look like?

chatpoints.chat_text: She's big and fluffy and black and white and super duper friendly!

replies.reply_text: So, where did this big, fluffy, super duper friendly cat go?
On second thought, I really can't.  Good luck!
Okay, wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh you silly willy, you said you'd find my Auntie's kitty, Samantha. You said you'd look real careful at the bushes and trees over there (Points Northeast.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, now I remember, that super duper friendly fluffy cat.  Be back soon!
Thanks, but shouldn't you get Samantha back to your Aunt Esther?  Bye bye!

npc_list.name: Sand Dollar
npc_list.admin_description: Ricardo's horse, pre-quest
npc_list.long_description: This horse definitely did not come from around here- he's still a little furry and he's sticking close to the scant shade of the palm tree.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He snuffles around in the grass, panting a little.)

replies.reply_text: Poor guy... looks like you need a cold shower!

npc_list.name: Sand Dollar
npc_list.admin_description: Sand Dollar post-quest.
npc_list.long_description: Sand Dollar looks thoroughly northern, but he's currently sporting a sleek new clip job. He doesn't seem to mind the desert heat.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He snuffles around in the grass, absently flicking his tail at a passing fly.)

replies.reply_text: Aww, you look like a happy pony.

npc_list.name: Madame Babushka
npc_list.admin_description: New quests at CP25
npc_list.long_description: A tiny delicate slip of a woman, dressed in layers and layers of flowing colorful scarves. She looks as if a stiff wind could blow her away.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka is whirling and twirling slowly in the breeze. Her scarves flutter about her as she hums to herself.)

replies.reply_text: Hello! I gave you a scarf earlier. I was hoping you could help me.
The scarves you are wearing are beautiful! I wonder if you might tell me a little bit more about them?
Excuse me, I wonder if I could speak with you for a moment?
Hello there! I'm so glad I found you! I need help, and I need it now!
Ohhh, creepy woman! I am gone like the breeze!
Hello again. You were going to help me with some bats, to eat some crickets and scorpions.
Hello again!
Hello there! I was wondering if there were any errands that I could do for you?
Quest check to bypass prior quests w/Mdm Babushka

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka glances at you and then continues to sway and hum, seemingly ignoring you.)

replies.reply_text: Where are my manners? Hello, I think I found something of yours. (You offer Madame Baruska the scarf.)
Hello? Hello, there? I'm talkin' to you! Does this mean you aren't going to talk to me? Guess not. Which reminds me, I need to head home now. Giddy-up and away!
Harriet was right. You are definitely unique! A bit too much so for my taste. I'll just take my trusty steed and ride on outta here!
I've found your scarves!
You are so very welcome. I was wondering if you might help me?
The scarves you are wearing are beautiful! I wonder if you might tell me a little bit more about them?
Dang. I don't even remember the quest I was doing, its been forever since I started it. I think I'll go start a new one.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what help might a traveler like you need?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly tell her about the crickets and scorpions keeping Crow's Nest Carrie awake, and how Sando suggested she might know where to find Pallid Bats.)
A rest from these long and complicated quests! Gesh! I'm heading back to the nearest town. Have a great day.
Oh, let me think. A nice, refreshing lemonade. A yummy meal. Snacks and water for my noble steed. That reminds me, I've got to go feed and clean the barn. Have a scarf-filled day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Tell? What is there to tell? They are beautiful. Yes? So. Now you know all about my scarves.

replies.reply_text: Uh, okay. I think I'll just take a hike right on outta here now. Bye!

You're right. They are beautiful. Forgive me, I almost forgot why I've come here. (You quickly tell her about the crickets and scorpions keeping Crow's Nest Carrie awake, and how Sando suggested she might know where to find Pallid Bats.)
Okay, this is way to different and unique for my blood. Have a nice day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can do this for you. Once they have cleaned up the lighthouse insects, they will return here. This will be a good thing for all involved. Let me get some for you. (Madame Babushka suddenly becomes a flurry of motion and scarves at the large boulder. She ends up with a bundled bunch of scarves in her hands.)

replies.reply_text: I take it the bats are in there? Perfect!
Gosh. I'm having second thoughts about this. I don't want to make Crow's Nest Carrie any angrier. I'll need to think about this. If I change my mind, I'll be back.
I can't thank you enough. Have a wonderful day!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka is whirling and twirling slowly in the breeze. Her scarves flutter about her as she hums to herself.)

replies.reply_text: Hello, Madame Babushka! Just thought I'd stop and say hi. And now, I think I'll say good bye!
Madame Babushka, if I may have the honor of your attention for a moment?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka comes to a complete standstill.) You've found my scarves? Can this be true?

replies.reply_text: As true as I'm standing here!
Absolutely, positively and ever so adamantly true!
Wow! Thank you so much. Have a terrific day.
Crying woman! Leave, quickly.
I'm sorry you are upset, but you might need more help than I can provide!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka stops whirling and her scarves stop fluttering. She sighs heavily.) My scarves! My beautiful scarves, scattered in the desert. So sad! So sad!

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound good! Is there anything I can do to help?
Well, this is just too sad for me! Good bye!
You know, Harriet mentioned that you were a bit unique. I can see that she is totally right! I think you might be just a bit too unique for my tastes! Have a good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka is whirling and twirling slowly in the breeze. Her scarves flutter about her as she softly sobs to herself.)

replies.reply_text: The scarves you are wearing are beautiful! I wonder if you might tell me a little bit more about them?
Ohhh, creepy woman! I am gone like the breeze!
Good news, I've found your scarves!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka slowly stops and her whirling scarves flutter down about her skirt.) Hello? Do I know you?

replies.reply_text: Indeed you do. I found your lost scarves for you.
Well, you may not remember me. Its been awhile since I've been here.
Indeed you do! I have another odd key for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't seem familiar. Not at all, not at all.

replies.reply_text: Well gosh. I don't know what to say to that, other than you might remember me from when you lost your scarves and I found them and returned them to you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! My lovely, lovely scarves. You don't want them back, do you? I couldn't bare to part with them. And they are mine, after all.

replies.reply_text: No, no, no. Not at all. Actually, it is because you love scarves that I've come to ask you about a mystery. I've found an odd key, and it has a bit of scarf attached to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka's eyes twinkle.) Indeed? The Fates have brought you to me, as I am the Keeper of the Keys. May I have it please?

replies.reply_text: Sure. Here is one Odd Copper Key.
Sure. Here is one Odd Gold Key.
Sure. Here is one Odd Platinum Key.
Sure. Here is one Odd Silver Key.
Looks like I don't have any more. I'm happy to go find another key if you can give me a hint as to where to search.
Well darn. Looks like I gave you everything I had.
Sure. Here is one Odd Purple Key.
Just so you know, it wasn't as simple as getting a key from the Oracle. I had to use that key to get this key, and at this point, I'm totally sick of keys! Here you go. One Odd Iron Key.
What do you mean, my journey? What Prophecy?
Whoa there! This is way over my head. If I'm up to it someday in the far, far distant future, I may be back.
Well, if I need to give you more keys, can you at least tell me where I can get them?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka shakes her head at you and pulls a gazing ball from the folds of her skirt. Holding the crystal ball in one hand, she waves her other hand over the top of it and mutters some strange incantations). Ah! I see the unfolding of an ancient prophecy has begun. It appears that you have been chosen to reunite The Five Keys Of Chaos!

replies.reply_text: Five keys? But I only found four. I have no clue what to do now.
That chaos bit? Doesn't sound like a good thing. I think I'll pass.
Lucky for me, I have another one.
But I don't have any more! Is there some place I can find them?
Lucky for me, I have another one.
But I don't have another one! Look, not a single key on me. Tell me where to find them and I'll go look now.
Lucky for me, I have another one.
Look. I am devoid of any more keys. I've got zilch, nada, none. Tell me where I can get another, and I will go get it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka suddenly whirls around several times and then stares deeply into your eyes.) This is your journey and life's path. It has been decreed!

replies.reply_text: That chaos bit? Doesn't sound like a good thing. I think I'll pass.
Ummm. And that means what, exactly?

chatpoints.chat_text: In a pond near flowered meadows where unicorns dwell.

replies.reply_text: Okey-dokey!
Lucky for me, I have another one.
I haven't got another one. How about a hint or a clue as to where I can get another?
Alrighty then. Sounds very, very odd to me, but the keys were odd too. Off I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: You cannot just go out and get another. The Keys appear only when THEY are ready.  And they are only ready when YOU have enough knowledge. They will find their way into your hands. Bring them to me, as you get them.

replies.reply_text: Wait a minute. I don't understand this and it doesn't make any sense to me.
So I'm just supposed to twiddle my thumbs? Tell you what, if and when I'm bored stiff, I might revisit you and your odd key mystery.

chatpoints.chat_text: Chaos cannot be understood or made sense of. It is what it is and will be what it shall be. All will unfold in time. Be patient, for answers come to those who are patient. In the meantime, I am the Keeper of the Keys and will be, until the Fates tell me otherwise.

replies.reply_text: Look, I want to help you. You said you need another key. I've given you four keys now. Is it just one more key that you need? Or more than that?
Can you at least tell me how many keys I need to give you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka is whirling and twirling slowly in the breeze. Her scarves flutter about her as she hums to herself.)

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, Madame Babushka. You mentioned something about the fates and my journey?
Hello again, and goodbye again!
Could you please remind me as to where I'm supposed to find the Oracle?
I found the Oracle and brought you another key.

chatpoints.chat_text: It means if you accept your destiny, you must seek the Great Oracle! Only then will you be given the 5th key. Do you accept your destiny?

replies.reply_text: Nah, don't think so! I am outta here!
Okaaaayyyyy. I'm not exactly sure about where this is all going, but why not? I have some time to spare.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Madame Babushka closes her eyes, taps the center of her forehead and mutters some mumble jumble. ) I hear the number 4 and the number 5.

replies.reply_text: So, 4 or 5 keys? Alright. I'll go look around some more.
Nice! I was sure you were going to send me off somewhere else, but if I'm done, I'm celebrating!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not the key I need! Go away!

replies.reply_text: Fine. I'm gone like yesterday's ice cream!

npc_list.name: Bruno
npc_list.long_description: Bruno is a burly looking guy who is clearly not afraid of working hard to maintain the apple trees.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello! Come in and chat for awhile.

replies.reply_text: I just came in to tell you how great your apple trees look. And the apples look delicious!
You say hello, and I say goodbye!
I was wondering if you needed any help today?
Hello and howdy! I was wondering if you had anymore deliveries that you need help with?
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I've finished all of the deliveries!
Could you tell me what I was doing for you?
Hi Bruno, I'm back with a bit of disquieting news. When I delivered the apples to Allaire, she said someone had stolen her other apples.
Hello, there! Would you happen to work with leather?
Thank you, but I'm really here trying to find Archy. Has he been here?
Hello again, Bruno.  Sorry to be a pest, but where did you say Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! It does a body good to hear a compliment now and then. Feel free to help yourself to any apples that have fallen off the trees. But be sure to look for holes. You wouldn't want to bite down and discover you've just bitten a worm in half!

replies.reply_text: Yuck! I'll be sure to remember that. Thanks!
Do you get a lot of apples with worms in them?
Feel complimented well and good, then! Your orchards are well kept, your trees are well trimmed, and your apples are delicious!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can always use help, if you don't mind delivering some bushels of apples for me. We have an abundant crop this year.

replies.reply_text: I would love to help!
Deliveries? I'm tired of doing deliveries. I like things that are a bit more challenging. Have a great day!
Abundant? Hmmm. Maybe I can find someone to make some apple pies for me! Ohhh, with ice cream on top! I'm sure I can find someone! Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: More than I care for. Seems a lot of the apples go to waste.

replies.reply_text: What a shame. Well, I've got to go now. Have a great day.
Oh dear! What if I already ate an apple and didn't see the worm and SWALLOWED it? I'm going to be sick! I feel feverish. Is my face breaking out in hives?
Good point. I'm going to go put my thinking cap on and see if I can figure out a market for those spoiled apples. If I come up with a brilliant plan, I'll come back and let you know!

chatpoints.chat_text: Calm yourself. You won't get sick, physically. But the thought of eating a worm might be upsetting to you.

replies.reply_text: Oh. You mean I'm going to be fine. Well in that case, I feel good enough to enter a competition! I'm tough, I can do it! See you around!
Darn. I was hoping to get out of chores today.
Well maybe I should eat a few more, just to make sure!
I'll be back as soon as I've delivered all of these!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were delivery apples for me. You should have the list that tells you who is expecting an apple delivery.

replies.reply_text: Oh my gosh! You're right. There's the list, right there in my inventory! I'll be back soon.
Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, I do have another one. But this one is a bit more.. slow in the going, shall we say?

replies.reply_text: Well, that's not for me! I'm all about hurry here, hurry there. So I guess I'll just hurry on out of here!
Slow in the going? In what way?
Oh gosh! Look at the time. I need to get going myself. Hope you find someone else to make that delivery for you. Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: This delivery needs to go to Allaire, and she's in the Mystic Forest maze. Some people aren't too keen on tangling with a maze!

replies.reply_text: And you can count me as one of those. No thank you! They get me dizzy.
I'm good at mazes. I'd be happy to do that for you.
I've got feathers I want to sell to her anyway, so this will make the trip that much more worthwhile!
Happy to do it! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure! You were delivering a bushel of apples to Allaire! Enjoy the ride.

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I think I'll collect some feathers along the way.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is disquieting. I'll have to send someone to her place to see if she's okay. Thanks for letting me know. In the meantime, are you ready for your reward?

replies.reply_text: Of course I am! I'm always ready for rewards.
Thanks again, and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, but my neighbor does occasionally. You are just one cabin away!

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!
Thanks Bruno!  I'm sure I'll find him there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Archy was heading to Faustus. He might still be there.

replies.reply_text: Faustus... He's in the cabin in the woods west of here, right? (Bruno nods.)

npc_list.name: Marina Mooring
npc_list.long_description: With the exception of an enormous portrait of a military-looking lady hanging on the wall, the office is filled with different photographs of a woman on a small wooden sailboat with a bright blue sail. You wonder if the woman in the photos is Marina. Whoever it is has the same wild red hair!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, how's the sea breeze treating you?

replies.reply_text: Not bad. Much better than a week or so ago. There was a big storm that just about blew me off my trusty steed!
Same as usual, blowing me around!
Hi Marina. Was there something I was doing for you?
It's done! Your headsail is finished and ready! And Barb did an amazing job!
The breeze is fine. It's just the rest of my day so far. I'm here from Polly and Mal. Please tell me that Mal's coffee shipment has come in.
Not bad, not bad. Listen, do you have any old mail lying around by any chance?

Same old, same old! I was talking to Vee, down on Cabin Isle. I"m wondering if you could tell me a bit more about the supply boat that was pirated or have any suggestions on where I might find that information?
Not bad. Not bad at all. That said, I'm wondering if a rider came through here wearing a purple vest?
Can you remind me where you thought the rider with the purple vest came from?

chatpoints.chat_text: It blew through here, too! Ripped the headsail right off of my antique, and all time favorite, sail boat.

replies.reply_text: How sad for you. Sorry to hear it.
That's awful! Would you like me to try to find it? I'm really good at that sort of thing.
Guess its time you had another one made. I could help with that if you'd like. I know someone who could probably make you one.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's really kind of you, but the ocean is extremely deep and vast. You don't look like you've got the gear to go scuba diving.

replies.reply_text: Ohhh! So the sail went into the ocean! Yup, I don't have scuba equipment, so that won't work. What about having another one made?
Scuba diving sounds like fun! I think I'll go see it there's any such sport here on Horse Isle.
Okay, don't say I didn't offer.

chatpoints.chat_text: You would really do that for me?

replies.reply_text: Of course! I can see that you are busy, and I've got time on my hands. I'm ready and willing. What more could you ask for?
Hmmm. Good point. I don't know you. You don't know me. Let me think about it. I'll come back if I decide to help you. In the meantime, have a great day!
Depends on what you are willing to do for me! Joking! Yes, I would do that for you. But not today. I didn't realize the time. Later, gator!
You'll be sailing that beloved sailboat in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed! You were helping me get a new headsail made. You said you knew someone who might be able to sew me a new one.

replies.reply_text: That's right! Let me go check on it now.
Thank you so much! Enjoy your sailing!
Yes, I could tell she was really... keen... on getting this delivery. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Old mail? Hah! (She gestures to the piles of old sacks in the dock house.) There's more old mail around here than you can shake a stick at!

replies.reply_text: Why's that? Why don't you deliver all your mail?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not just us- practically every place where people are settled has an old mail sack like this, and here's why. You ever watched a lady or a gentleman of a certain age try to address a letter that's supposed to go to the other side of the isles? Most of our residents used to live in main towns, where everybody knows everybody, so they wrote to "Marianne who sells apples at the market" and it would get delivered. Out here... we don't know who Marianne is or where she lives!

replies.reply_text: Can't you tell the person that you don't know Marianne and you need more information to deliver it?
What happened when you let the sender know you need an address?
Don't you have a record of who lives where? Couldn't you use that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, you can tell them, but every single time, you get "But it was always delivered this way before, dearie, you just try." And I'm sure that's how things worked on the big isles, don't get me wrong, but it doesn't work like that out here. You'd be surprised how many people think it does. Even our old dockmistress was that way!

replies.reply_text: Old dockmistress? You mean Jack?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, there's a whole sack here just from her! Now, Commander Jack, she was really smart. She'd had a lifetime of adventures, I can tell you, and knew where everything was. I'm sure she could have delivered any of these letters herself. Used to insist that our mail service was incompetent.

replies.reply_text: Incompetent how?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, let me just show you an example. (Rifles around in an overstuffed sack and pulls out a letter yellowed with age.) It's addressed to "Miss Hanska Hennig, most recently of the Whiskerton Ballet, aspiring toymaker." Now, where would you send that?

replies.reply_text: I figure I'd send it to Whiskerton, since that was the best I could guess based on the address.
You'd send it to Whiskerton, wouldn't you?

chatpoints.chat_text: And that's where all these went- Whiskerton. Because that's what you'd think, wouldn't you? At first the mail boats brought them back, but Commander Jack kept insisting they weren't trying hard enough to find the destination, and then the mail just started stuffing them all in this sack and ignoring them.

replies.reply_text: I don't understand. If Jack was such a smart, competent person, why didn't she understand that mail wouldn't get delivered this way?

chatpoints.chat_text: I figure it was two reasons. One was that it worked that way from wherever she came from, and the other because she'd known the whole world and everyone in it, as far as I'm aware, and if it were up to her she'd probably have stopped at the docks of every isle in the world and asked whether Hanska Hennig lived on that isle. She was an extraordinarily competent woman. But zero tolerance for what she saw as foolishness or laziness.

replies.reply_text: Well, anyhow, as it happens... I know Hanska, the woman all these were to be sent to. It's a little late now, but can I take all these letters to her anyway?
I sure can believe it... (You put what you'd thought was Jack's "Last" Letter into the sack so you don't lose it.)

chatpoints.chat_text: We don't have a master list of who everybody is and where they live. Not out here. Maybe they do in the big towns.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Well, didn't you ever tell people "We need to know where this person lives if you want this delivered?"

chatpoints.chat_text: Not much. Best thing I could suggest would be to talk to the captains and see who answers the most suspiciously!

replies.reply_text: That's a great idea! I'll head out and do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes indeed. Heading towards Polar and I haven't seen him since.

replies.reply_text: Would you know where he was coming from? I'm trying to backtrack his movements.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suspect the island south of here. That would be the most logical. Assuming he came by boat.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Trudy is standing quietly next to Ed, while he expertly clips the horse in front of him.)

replies.reply_text: Hello, Trudy. May I have a word with you?
(You wave to Trudy. She smiles at you.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Trudy nods and quietly walks to the far side of the room.) How can I be of assistance?

replies.reply_text: I need a bolt of fabric dyed indigo, and Kilye isn't available. Barb Sower suggested that you might be able to dye it.
I was wondering what it was like to work for Ed. He seems to be a real cleanliness nut.
I've got the indigo dye for you!
What was it that I was doing for you?
I'm back for the cloth. Is it ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: I could do that for you. I would need you to order the indigo dye, as I can't leave my job here to do that.  I'll also need $500. That's a lot of material. I'll need to buy a stock tank to dye it in.

replies.reply_text: That seems fair. I've got the money right here!
Yikes. I'm not carrying that much on me. Be back in a few.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you know what they say about cleanliness. Besides, it suits my nature.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay. Well, don't let me stop you from your job. I'll see myself out.
I like cleanliness too. It just seems so hard to keep my room that way!
I'll head to Sasha's to order the dye now. I'll be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were ordering indigo dye for me from Sasha in Treeton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! I'm on my way!
I'll be back in a day or so!
It's beautiful! Thank you so much, and have a super clean day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my little outpost! Let me know if you need any help.

replies.reply_text: Hello, hello! I'm delivering apples for Bruno.
Hello there! I was wandering around the desert and thought I'd check your place out.  Now I'll know to come here for water when I've spent too much time in the sun! Have a great day.
Thanks for the welcome, and I sure hope you can help me. Hershel from Appleton was hoping you would have some Jojoba oil in stock.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back with your bundles of sage!
Thanks for the welcome, and I sure hope you can help me.  Hershel from Appleton was hoping you would have some Jojoba oil in stock.
I do need a little help. I agreed to get you a dozen bundles of sage blossoms, but I don't remember where to find them. Can you point me in the right direction?
Actually, I have just the thing that will help both of us! I've got a dozen bundles of sage for you.
Thanks! And enjoy those apples!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do, but its very time consuming to produce. I must harvest the seeds from the jojoba bushes, which are a bit of a distance from here. Unfortunately, they do not ripen at the same time. So I must make several trips. Then I must press the seeds to squeeze out the oil.

replies.reply_text: That's all very interesting and all, but all I want to do is buy some oil!
Wow. That's a lot of work. Just hearing you describe it has made me sleepy. I think I'll go take a nap.
With so much work, it doesn't seem like the jojoba oil would be worth it. Why bother?

chatpoints.chat_text: This oil is very labor intensive for me to make. I do not part with it easily. I will not sell you any, but I will exchange your labor for a bottle of it. Would you be willing to harvest 12 bundles of sage blossoms and bring them to me?

replies.reply_text: Hmm. Sounds like a lot of work. I don't have time today, but maybe I'll have time some day soon.
I'm more than willing! I've got plenty of time and I am a good worker. Where do I start looking for the sage and what does it look like?
I remember doing that when I needed Hershel to make shoes for a little dude that lives in Molton Meadows. If I remember correctly, it wasn't difficult. So sure, I'll go find sage for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jojoba oil provides a renewable source of a unique high-quality oil. It is used for many, many things. I use it to treat sores and wounds.

replies.reply_text: No wonder Hershel loves the stuff! Okay, I'm ready to buy some!
I'll head out right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting one dozen bundles of desert sage blossoms for me. They won't all have blossoms on them, as many desert critters love to eat them.

replies.reply_text: That's right! You said there were a couple in the immediate area. I better start scouring the desert for more of those plants. I am on my way now!
How will I recognize them again?
Thanks for the Jojoba oil!

chatpoints.chat_text: They are small compared to  saguaros. You are most likely to find them around areas where people are living in the desert. Please get stalks of sage that have blossoms on them.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll get right on that.  Bye!
I will get busy looking for those sage blossoms right now!
A win win situation. Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: They are spikey bushes with purple flowers on them. I usually find them in areas where residents live. We agreed to one dozen.

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! See you in a bit!
One dozen? I think I actually have that many already.

npc_list.name: Spencer
npc_list.short_description: An elder resident of Mystic Forest
npc_list.long_description: An elderly gentleman who looks a little lost.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The unshaved elderly man is wearing clothing that has clearly seen better days. He is surrounded by apple peelings, and what looks like... umm shrunken heads!)

replies.reply_text: Hello there! I noticed a trail of apple peelings leading from Allaire's home to you. I was wondering why you took something that didn't belong to you.
Scary man! Run!
Shrunken heads! Run away FAST!
Are you the homeless guy people have been talking about?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not belong to me? Did they belong to the dead tree? The forest? The squirrels? Could it be that they belong to no one? Or maybe they belong to the wind!

replies.reply_text: Nope on all of those. They belonged to Allaire.
Belong to the dead tree? The forest? What are you, a bit fruity in the head?
I don't think the wind would have much use for them! But speaking of that, I'm gone like the wind!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear me, dear me! She wasn't trying to dispose of them? I thought... oh, dear! What have I done?

replies.reply_text: It's okay. Really. She isn't angry. She's just worried about you.
Exactly! Sometimes it isn't what you thought but what you never stopped to consider! Consider me gone!
I was wondering why you wanted those apples, anyway? Does it have anything to do with voodoo and those... shrunken heads?

chatpoints.chat_text: Worried? About me? Whatever for?

replies.reply_text: Well, I told her you looked, umm. Well, hungry. And tired. And maybe even, well. Homeless.
Can you believe it? Why would anyone worry about you? On the other hand, its time for me to worry about eating. I'm hungry, and so gone!
Now there's an excellent point! I'm sure if you needed something you would have knocked on her door. You know where she lives, after all! You have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Shrunken Heads? (The old man laughs so hard, he has to wipe a tear from his eye.) I guess that IS what they look like. But fear not, Forest Traveler. They are nothing but carved apples. Once they dry, they look like faces of the elderly.

replies.reply_text: (You look more closely at the shrunken heads.) I'll be darned. You are right! That's exactly what they look like. Can I have one for Allaire? That way, she'll know what happened to her apples.
Say, there might be a market for these. If I come up with something, I'll let you know.
They still look like shrunken heads to me! Creepy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Homeless? Not at all. This forest is my home.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Don't you get cold at night? Or wet when it rains? And what about food?
What is there to do all day in the forest? There aren't any horse competitions. You can't play any games. You can't find pirate's treasures.
And on that note, I need to head home myself!

chatpoints.chat_text: I make a small lean-to when necessary. That keeps me sufficiently warm and dry. And there are plenty of things to eat in this forest. Nuts, the wild berry I find here and there.

replies.reply_text: And speaking of nuts... I'm outta here!
Cool! So you are kind of like a true life Buckskin Bill. Pretty awesome, if you ask me. Well, take care! Hope to see you again, sometime.
That's very interesting. What I would really like to know more about are those shrunken heads.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have no need of such things. I study the sky. The weather. The plants. The animals. What else would I need?

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I would get awfully bored. But if this life suits you, I say, enjoy!
Looks like you need more apples! Maybe I'll bring you more some day. Ta-ta, for now!
I'll take it to her right now! Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't come any closer or I will bite you!

replies.reply_text: That's not a very nice greeting!
Be nice or I won't give you your Birthday goodies!
Bite me? Yikes! Run!
I've got something for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, show me! Please!

replies.reply_text: Your aunt Carlotta made you a piñata and sent along two animal balloons.
I've brought you a birthday beverage!
I've brought you a birthday dessert!
Sorry! My mistake. I think I've given you everything.
Oops! My mistake. I already gave it to you!
They sure liven the place up! Enjoy!
Enjoy!
I've got something for you!
Enjoy!
I've got something for you!

npc_list.name: Karee Dentin
npc_list.long_description: Karee Dentin is a serious young woman who is very concerned about dental health.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome and come in, please. What can I do for you? Have you brushed your teeth today? You know, brushing should never be considered optional!

replies.reply_text: Yikes, a dentist. RUN!!!
Are you talking to me or my trusty steed?
Hello there! I have brushed my teeth today! I was wondering if you could help me.
Was there something I was doing for you?

Yes, I brush them every day! Thank you for the reminder. I've talked to Farley, and it just isn't going to be possible for him to come in. He has a phobia of water, so traveling across the ocean is just not going to happen.
Could you remind me what I was supposed to be doing for you?
I always brush them! I'm wondering if you have any errands you need done?
Are Farley's new teeth ready yet?
I"m back with the wax impression for Farley's new teeth!
I've got the polishing creme!
Was I doing something for you?
Can you remind me where I'm supposed to deliver these toothbrushes to?
I've finished delivering the toothbrushes!
Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
I've finished delivering the toothbrushes! Laurence was really pleased that you thought of reinforcing them and said thanks.
Can you remind me where I'm supposed to deliver these toothbrushes to?

I've finished delivering the toothbrushes. It seems most people were thankful to receive them. Edgar was concerned that Farley's feelings might be hurt, but I had an extra one that I gave Farley, so that worked out. I didn't have one for Ricky.
Was there something I was doing for you?
I've delivered the toothbrushes to everyone around Flipperton.
I left before I picked up my pay - silly me!
I've got brushing down to a fine art! I was actually checking to see if there were any errands you need done.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you need a dental check-up? I can set up an appointment for you, if you'd like. Or were you needing something for your horse?

replies.reply_text: Not today, thank you anyway! I've changed my mind.
Neither, but I'll keep that in mind. For now, I've got a different kind of problem. (You quickly explained about Farley's problem.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. He may need a new set of dentures. Have him come in and I'll take a look at his condition.

replies.reply_text: Sounds great! I'll go tell him... er... tell Edgar right now!
That's not going to be possible. Sounds like a dead-end errand to me!
This will have to wait. I'm in no mood to travel back to Lava today.
I'll be sure to tell him that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why both, of course! As the old saying goes, ignore those teeth and they'll go away!

replies.reply_text: Now that you've mentioned it, I better go brush my teeth!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to have your friend Farley come in for an appointment.

replies.reply_text: He's not really a friend of mine... But thanks for the reminder.
Oh, that's right. So I talked to him and that's just not going to be possible.
Was I? Guess I forgot about that. Seems I forgot who Farley is too!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. Okay, we can work around that. I'll need you to take a dental impression. Oh, you should know, this type of work doesn't come cheaply. It will cost $1500.

replies.reply_text: That sounds yucky! I think I'll pass.
Ummm.... okay. I think. No problem on the cost. I've got the money. But what does getting an impression involve?
Seriously? You want me to do that? I don't think I'm qualified. I'm not a dental assistant. Guess Farley will have to learn to live with what he has.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll need to get a lump of wax from Evelynn. She lives right across the meadow from here. Then you'll need to have Farley bite down firmly on it. Tell him not to move his jaw back and forth. Just straight down.

replies.reply_text: That's convenient! Unfortunately, dinner is calling. I come back later.
I can do that! I'll head over to Evelynn's now.
I'll be back before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get wax from Evelynn and then take a dental impression from Farley.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll be back soon. I hope!
Silly me! I've got the wax, now all I need is the impression. Heading to Molten Meadows now!
Thank you for reminding me! I need to go see if Edgar has the impression ready yet.
Good golly! Would you look at that? I've got the impression right here in this bag.
Sounds good. I've got some chores to tend to. I'll try to be back for the dentures later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Almost. I need some polishing paste to give them a nice shine. Would you mind running over to Cara Cook's for me? I ordered some and it should be in by now.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I thought I was almost finished with this whole new teeth thing. I'll be back later.
That's just a hop, skip and a jump from here. I'd be happy to do that for you.
I'll be back in a flash!

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed, you were. I've ordered dental polishing paste from Cara. You agreed to pick it up for me.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I was. I'm on my way!
That's right! Silly me. I've got the paste right here.
These look terrific! He's sure to love them. Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not today, but thanks for asking. I may have some tomorrow.

replies.reply_text: Okay, see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! How adventurous are you feeling today?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure. Maybe just a little adventurous.
I've been to Lava, and you have to be pretty adventurous to go there! I think I'm up to it!
I've been to Lava and Pirate, so I'm very adventurous. {change CP16 to REQ 3681 when ready]
I've done tons of quests. I've even been to the Cloud Isles. So I can handle whatever you throw my way!
You know, I'm not feeling the least bit adventurous today. I think I'd rather go enter a horse competition or something. See you later!
I could probably be talked into being a little adventurous.
Sure. I'm bold. I'm brave. I'm ready for action!

chatpoints.chat_text: You must be adventurous if you've been around pirates!

replies.reply_text: Woot! Woot! I'm ready to do it. What now?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's no problem. I think you'll be able to handle things just fine. I'd be happy to pay you. Here's where I need deliveries made. (She points to a map on her wall.) What do you say?

replies.reply_text: Then I am bound and determined to prove you right! I can tell by that map that Soaring Meadows is just a gallop or two away. I'll do it!
Looking at that map, I can see one of the deliveries will be to Torrid Isle. I'm up for that!
Hmm. I can see one of the deliveries includes a trip to Torrid Isle. I'm just not up for that today. Sorry. Maybe some other day.
Looks like I can't do any deliveries today.  Thanks anyway.
That's a smart idea! I'm heading down there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It says right there on the toothbrushes!

replies.reply_text: Silly me! I'm on my way now.
I know, but it seems I have 2 left over.
Thanks so much!
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly! You were going to have the camel toothbrushes reinforced by Liam. Then you agreed to deliver them to Laurence, on Torrid Isle.

replies.reply_text: Now I remember! Thanks for reminding me.
Thanks! Have a terrific day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Looks like you'll be able to handle these deliveries with no problems! Here's where I need deliveries made. (She points to a map on her wall.) What do you say?

replies.reply_text: Dolphin is close enough, and I'm sure I can pick up some things I need while on the Lava Isles. So I say, let's do it!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll need you to make some deliveries to Dolphin Isle and the Lava Isles. Actually, to Molten Meadows and Igneous Isle. I'm trying to cheer Cupid up.

replies.reply_text: Looks like I've got some traveling to do, so I had better head out!

chatpoints.chat_text: You had delivered toothbrushes to Molten Meadows for me, but you hadn't agreed to deliver the next set yet.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for reminding me. I don't have time today, so I'll check back when I do.
That's right! I'd be happy to do that for you. Where do I head now?
Yup, Farley's the dummy. What's next on the delivery schedule?
You know, I'll have to come back. I've got some other things I need to do right now. Bye!
Awesome! Thanks so much and have a great day.
I'm on my way!
Thank you so much!
I am, and yes please!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, here are toothbrushes for Flavious, Helga and Trixie on Dolphin. Two more for Farley and Ricky in Molten, and then one of each kind for Cupid on Igneous. I think he'll get a kick out of them!
One of each kind was to go to Cupid. And then there was one each for Trixie and Ricky, the storekeepers. I hope that helps.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

npc_list.name: Evan
npc_list.long_description: Evan shares his love of music with his wife Joanna, and their children. HIs intentions are to introduce his family to as many different instruments as possible.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, welcome! Would you like to learn to play the didgeridoo?

replies.reply_text: No thanks! Not today.

npc_list.name: Curtis
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start at CP5
npc_list.long_description: You see a bright-eyed, happy young man with a deep love of stringed instruments. He is accomplished in playing the Ukelele and fiddle.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Curtis is busy fiddling when he suddenly stops.) Oh no! I just broke the strings on my bow.

replies.reply_text: Is that something I could go buy for you?
That's too bad.  Sorry.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really, but thank you for asking. I will need to send the bow out to be fixed.

replies.reply_text: Well, maybe I can do that for you. I travel quit a bit, I'm just not sure I've met someone who fixes bows before.

chatpoints.chat_text: Donna up in Crystalton can do it. She stables a gorgeous white horse native to cold climates and it has the best tail hair ever for bows!

replies.reply_text: I had no clue bow strings were made from horse hair! Very interesting. I'd be happy to take your bow to Donna.
Happy to help out. I'll be back as quickly as I can.
Thank you so much! I'm sure you are anxious to get back to your music so I'll just skedaddle right on out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Curtis is busy fiddling his ukelele.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to bother him.)
I'm back! And look what I have for you!
Sorry to bother you.  I was doing something for you, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep!  You were heading to Crystalton to see Donna and have her fix my bow.

replies.reply_text: Oh right.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hola. I trust you have not come to step on me?

replies.reply_text: Absolutely not! I don't enjoy stepping on spiders.
You trust right! I have gifts for you.
Hairy spider! Run!
I've got something for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: For me? I'm so excited. What it is?

replies.reply_text: Oops! My mistake. I already gave it to you!
Your aunt Carlotta made you a piñata and sent along two animal balloons.
I've brought you a birthday beverage!
I've brought you a birthday dessert!
My mistake! Looks like I've brought you everything.
They sure make the place look festive! Enjoy!
Don't forget to wipe off your milk moustache!
I've got something else for you!
Enjoy it!
I've got something else for you!

npc_list.name: Murigal
npc_list.admin_description: No New quests on this Murigal

replies.reply_text: Goodness! A dramatic frog. I think I'll leave!

chatpoints.chat_text: Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh, woe is me! All for naught, I say. All for naught. Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup!

replies.reply_text: Hello? Hello? I don't like to interrupt, but I must tell you, you are making such a ruckus, it is disturbing your neighbors.

Hey, Frog! You've got your sounds mixed up. Some frogs sound like 'ribbit-ribbit', but others sound like 'ka-blurp'. Or 'greedeep.' Or 'bruddup.' Some bark. Some meow. But they don't make ALL those noises!
Yikes! A talking frog! Run!
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back with your gemstones!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! Now someone tells me! How was I supposed to know that? Oh woe is me! Expectations! The expectations put upon me. Woe is me!

replies.reply_text: Well, you are a frog, right?
Maybe you could research it and learn something, instead of sitting around feeling sorry for yourself! Gesh! I'm outta here.
Maybe you are a special frog! Can you grant wishes?

chatpoints.chat_text: No am I not, thank you very much! Contrary to my current appearance, I'm actually a princess! How dreadful! Woe is me. All for naught, I say. All for naught.

replies.reply_text: Ohhhhh, right! A princess. And I'm a dragon in disguise! This is not a Halloween party, you know! Shesh!
Really? I've heard of a frog prince, but never a princess! Tell me more!
I think you might be delusional! I'm getting out of here, now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm distressed! What do you expect?

replies.reply_text: Okay, fine. But can you bring the noise level down a bit? And why are you distressed anyway?
I expect I'm going to ride my horse right out of here with that kind of attitude! Good-bye!
Distressed? A frog in distress? How weird. Too weird for me!

chatpoints.chat_text: My mother told me "If you kiss enough frogs, you'll find a prince." So I asked my fairy godmother to change me into a frog, so I could check out frogs on Horse Isle. But I just used up my last gem from my necklace!

replies.reply_text: Kissing frogs? Yuck! Get me out of here!
Okay, I'm a little confused. How does gems from your necklace have anything to do with this?
You have a fairy godmother? I want one! I think I'll go look for one now.

chatpoints.chat_text: No! If I could, I would wish you away from here! Oh, woe is me! Woe is me!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! You don't have to be such a grouch...
Okay, if you can't grant wishes, I'm outta here!

Look, I made a deal with the lady in the house over there to find you and get you to stop making such a ruckus. If I agree to help you with this 'woe is me, all is for naught' stuff, will you please hush up?

chatpoints.chat_text: Every time I make a wish to jump to another pond, one of the gems in my necklace pops out. I haven't found a prince yet, and now my necklace is gemless! If I can't make more wishes, how am I suppose to find anymore frogs?

replies.reply_text: Now I understand.  There is a gem in every pond you've been in. So if I go find those gems and bring them back to you, would that convince you to stop making all that ruckus?
I am so totally confused! And totally gone!
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find my ten missing gems and return them to me!

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm off to search ponds now.
You know, there are a lot of islands to search. Can you give me some clues as to where I should look?

chatpoints.chat_text: How would I know? Ponds pretty much look the same to me. Wait! I don't know if this will help or not, but I avoided the desert islands. Much too hot for me. And the lack of humidity is really bad for my complexion.

replies.reply_text: Actually, that helps more than you realize! Thanks.
Thanks a ton! Good luck finding your prince!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hush up? Isn't that rather harsh? I might be willing to "lower the volume," shall we say? However! I need you to go check out all the ponds on Horse Isle for my gems and return them to me. Agreed?

replies.reply_text: ALL the ponds? And gems? What gems?
Whoa there, Nellie! That sounds suspiciously like a quest to me. And I am not doing this quest. Good bye!
That is going to take a lot of travel, and time. And it is time I just don't have right now.

npc_list.name: Hershel
npc_list.long_description: Hershel has hair dyed a fashionable apple green, to compliment his wife Adrianna's current hair shade.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our small abode!

replies.reply_text: Thank you for that warm welcome! I wanted you to know that I check on Wildfire now and then. He seems content and healthy. I wanted to give you an update just in case you were worried about him. Have a great day!
I noticed your workbench in the corner, and its hard to miss the pungent smell of leather. Are you a leather craftsman, by any chance?
Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
I've got the Jojoba oil you wanted!
What was it that I needed to get you?
Thank you so much. You crafted such a lovely pair of shoes for Farley, I was hoping you could craft some handsome cowboy boots. If I provide the leather, of course.
I've got that leather for you.
Hello there! Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi!  So I brought you the leather strappings and pieces, was there anything else you needed?
Hello.  I'm back with the jojoba oil!
Just wondering if the boots are done yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am! Unfortunately, leather is a bit costly, so I don't indulge in my artistic pleasure often.

replies.reply_text: Maybe we could work out a trade. If I get you the leather, with some extra leather thrown in, could you make some shoes for me? (You quickly explain about Farley's Extreme Makeover, and give Hershel Farley's feet measurements.)
