Well, its been nice chatting with you, but dinner is calling my name! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Who knows. Maybe she thought it had a nice ring to it. That was her stage name.

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks for the info. Time for me to ride on outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd like to take you up on that offer. I ordered some supplies from Vee at the Whoa and Go. If you could pick those up for me, I'd be much obliged.

replies.reply_text: I'll be riding right past there, so I'd be happy to do that for you.
Tell you what, I've got some quick chores to do. I'll be back shortly and we can discuss the details then.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you could just have her add it to my tab, I'd appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: No problem! Be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunate news?

replies.reply_text: Umm, you don't look very happy. I am not comfortable around unhappy people so I'm just gonna mosey on outta here and let someone else pass on the news!
Yes. Seems the boat that was delivering your supplies was waylaid by pirates. Vee said your order was one of several in the shipment she was expecting.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well that's dreadful! I need those supplies. What to do, what to do!

replies.reply_text: I think I'll just leave you to your dilemma! Have a great day.
Thanks for the pine cone. I have a suggestion. If you don't need much, maybe I could get some things for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I appreciate the offer. And while I'm sorely tempted to pay you to run down the supplies I need there's a greater task at hand.

replies.reply_text: Oh, this sounds suspiciously like something that will take more time than I have. I'm gone like Santa Claus!
A greater task? Is that something I can help with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Seems at least a pirate or two have gone rogue. The issue is to find out who did this dasterdly deed.

replies.reply_text: You want me to go after pirates? Yikes, you must be nuts. I'm not up for that. See you later.
Okay, I can do that. Any suggestions on where to start?

chatpoints.chat_text: Follow the trail of clues, starting with everything that Vee knows, and then talk to anyone that she might suggest.

replies.reply_text: I'm on it like cold on an iceberg!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a brave soul to ask around and figure out which pirates waylaid the supply boat.

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! Vee had the initial information, so I need to talk to her, and go on from there. I'll find out the truth of the matter. I'm great at that sort of thing!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to pick up supplies for me at Vee's.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'm on it like a horse on a bucket of feed!

chatpoints.chat_text: He did indeed! It is good citizens like yourself that make my day.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much for making MY day! Have a great one!

chatpoints.chat_text: That belongs to the gnome in the woods here. Although I doubt he'd want back something that ugly.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well you've come to the right place. but it wasn't a funky bandana I was looking for. Vee has a hearing problem at times. I think she misunderstood. A rider came through here a couple of days ago and I asked him to get me bananas for a poor little lost monkey.

replies.reply_text: A monkey and bananas! Now I see the mixup. So, you needed a banana for a monkey. Did he come back with one?

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, I've seen neither hide nor hair of the man since I asked him for help several days ago. And there is still a scared little monkey in a cluster of palm trees on the beach. I'm sure someone must be missing that poor little creature.

replies.reply_text: Hopefully, he'll be riding up here any time now, with a whole bushel of bananas for you and that monkey. Good luck and good day!
Gosh, I must have tracked that man through at least a dozen different islands. I still need to figure out where he ended up, but I would be happy to get you some bananas.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's very kind of you, but a traveler already brought me the bananas. I just haven't had time to get back to the monkey.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to try helping out with the monkey before I continue my journey on backtracking the rider.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be ever so helpful! Here, take these bananas and see if you can catch it. Check out the cluster of palm trees east of here on the beach.

replies.reply_text: Hopefully, I'll be back with the monkey in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: You said you'd try to catch the lost monkey. I am worried about it out in the elements, away from its home. It is by a cluster of palm trees on the beach east of here.

replies.reply_text: Oh I did agree to that, didn't I? I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! It certainly looks friendly enough. (Frannie gently takes the monkey from you and it immediately snuggles up to her. How sweet!) If you hear of anyone missing a monkey, please let them know I'm keeping him safe. Oh, before I forget, after you left to catch the monkey, I remembered something about the rider that might help you in your search.

replies.reply_text: That would be awesome! Please tell me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. He said something about some guy that was called Crazy Freddy? I think that's what he said. I know that's not much.

replies.reply_text: Its a clue and one I'll follow. Thank you so much.

npc_list.name: Gnorman
npc_list.long_description: A gnarly beast of a gnome. He has wild gray hair that is barely kept in check by the wizard hat he wears. Good thing you can't see his ears - talk about hairy! Gnorman is the Great Grand Poobah Wizard Gnome Caretaker of Gnomeman's Land, Grand Landscaper of the Past Its Prime Forest,  Zen Master Raker of the Sea of Sand and Expert Thorn Remover of Prickly Spit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! I didn't see you. You aren't here to make trouble, are you?

replies.reply_text: No, no trouble. But it sure has been a lot of trouble getting here!
Absolutely not!  Your brother Gnigal sent me here. He told me to tell you hi.
Trouble? Not even. You know me! I've brought you another Garden Gnome.
No trouble at all! I've got another flamingo for you.
Nope! Not me. I'm back with the two flamingos you asked for.
Not at all. I'm here to make you happy! I've got the two garden gnomes and leprechaun dust you asked for.
Actually, I have another one for you!
Okay. thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need two to complete a project I'm working on.

replies.reply_text: Umm. Will I have any trouble leaving this place? I only ask because it was so hard getting here.
No worries! I know just where to find some.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gnigal is the Gnome Caretaker of Cabin Forest. He is a most wonderful brother.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I met him. That's a really nice thing to say about him, that he's a most wonderful brother.  So tell me something about yourself.
As opposed to your least wonderful brother? How many gnomes are there? Probably more than I care to think about. I think I'll just leave.
Yeah, he didn't seem real thrilled with that title. I was wondering if you could tell me a little bit about this island.

chatpoints.chat_text: Leaving is easy. Gnigal created some wormholes in the Past Its Prime Forest. But who knows where you'll end up.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! Thanks so much. I think I'll check out this island a bit then find a dead tree to dig at! Bye.
And what about getting back here? Is asking your brother to send me here the only way?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am the Great Grand Poobah Wizard Gnome Caretaker of Gnomeman's Land, Grand Landscaper of the Past Its Prime Forest,  Zen Master Raker of the Sea of Sand and Expert Thorn Remover of Prickly Spit.

replies.reply_text: Wow. That's an impressive set of titles. Your brother mentioned that you liked titles. What I'd really like to know is how to pronounce is your name.
Gnome Man's Land? So, are there more gnomes on the island, besides you?
And I am the Great Grand Poobah Horse Rider heading off to win a competition! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: The G is silent. Just like in gnome. Or like the K in know. Know what I mean?

replies.reply_text: I know just what you mean, Gnorman the Gnome! Thanks for explaining.
Gotcha. So, what do you do on this island? It seems like a very weird island.
On that note, I think I'd like to go now. Can you tell me how to leave this island?

chatpoints.chat_text: I prefer to describe it as unusual and interesting and even unique. And I'd like to think that what I do could be described in those same terms.

replies.reply_text: Okay, fine. Unusual, interesting and unique. So what is it you do all day?
Well, here's something unusual for you - hasta la-bye-bye-and-don't-you-cry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, tinker on this, and tinker on that. Say! You might be able to help me out!

replies.reply_text: I've heard that one too many times lately. I'm not in the mood to go on any errands, or quests. So I'll just say good-bye right now.
Actually, I don't have anything else that I have my heart set on doing, so sure, I'll help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a really marvelous Sea of Sand. Fascinating! And the Past its Prime Forest! The dead trees are interesting in that they don't rot. And of course, the Prickly Spit. A place where cactus grow that really shouldn't. Watch out for getting stuck!

replies.reply_text: What is so fascinating about a bunch of dirt?
How can something dead not rot?

chatpoints.chat_text: Its hardly just dirt. Its a SEA of sand! The waves shift and ripple, shimmer and slide.

replies.reply_text: Right. Like any sand dune? The wind does that you know, blow the sand into ripples and stuff.
Okay. I see you have your heart set on believing that. I think I'll just leave you here with your beliefs. Good day, Sir!

chatpoints.chat_text: You think you see what you are used to seeing, but there are strange fish that live in its depths.

replies.reply_text: Really? That is odd. Er - I mean interesting. I think I'll go see if I can see anything in that Sea of Sand!
Hmm. That bares thinking about. What about the Past its Prime Forest. How come the dead trees don't rot?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm working on that. Say! Maybe you can help me. Would you be willing to fetch me some Garden Gnomes? I'm in serious need of some.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I could do that for you. Why not?
I am seriously not in the mood for any more quests today! I'm gone like yesterday's rain storm.
Wait! I have another one.
Thanks! If I find any more, I'll be sure to come see you.
So, just out of curiosity's sake, what is it that you do with the garden gnomes?

chatpoints.chat_text: As Gnorman always says, "Rake to get back, rake to get back!"

replies.reply_text: That sure sounds familiar! I should have known. Thanks so much.
That's good to know. So, I was wondering, you said this was Gnome Man's Land. Are there more gnomes here than just you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am in the market for plastic pink flamingos! Would you be willing to bring me some?

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to do that for you!
No, sorry. But if I ever come across some, I'll let you know.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is as if they are petrified, but not fossilized. Frozen in time. I often wonder if the worm holes have something to do with that. You know, all that space time relativity stuff. But thinking about it makes my head hurt.

replies.reply_text: Wow. That is interesting.  So, what is it that you do here?
So what's the deal with the Prickly Spit?
That IS interesting. It looks like you are the only gnome on this island.
And lucky you, I've got another one!
So, just out of curiosity's sake, what is it that you do with the flamingos?
Looks like that's it. If I get more, I'll be sure to head this way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, a tinker here, a tinker there, and ta-daa! I end up with a bit more gnome magic. And a little bit of gnome magic goes a long way.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Well. I guess that makes sense - to a gnome. I think I've got errands to run. Have a great day!
Can you tell me a little more about gnome magic?
Gnome magic? Wow. Can I have some of that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, its a prickly, sticky spit, alright. One wouldn't think you'd find cacti this far north and all, but some cactus can be found just about anywhere.

replies.reply_text: What can you tell me about the Sea of Sand? To me, it doesn't look like anything more than a bit of desert.
Oh. Not quite as interesting as I thought it might be. Thanks for the information.

chatpoints.chat_text: No. Nope. Not going to happen.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay. Well, I've got chores waiting, so I'll say good-bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need two garden gnomes and two sneezes of leprechaun magic.

replies.reply_text: Two sneezes of leprechaun magic, too? Thankfully, I think I know just who to ask for that! I'll be back soon.
Can you remind me how to leave Mane Isle? I'm worried that it might be as difficult as it was getting here.
Thanks so much for the reward! See you around.
I appreciate the reward, and you might appreciate the fact that I have another gnome for you!

npc_list.name: Tighe Debowt
npc_list.long_description: Tighe's shorts and t-shirt are well-worn and very comfortable looking! He stands barefoot on the dock, with a tan that lets you know he spends as much time as he can in the fresh sea air.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fair winds and favorable waters, to ya!

replies.reply_text: Uh, thanks?
Well thank you, kindly! I was looking to earn a bit of spending money. Would you have any jobs I could do?
And the same to you! I've got a package for you from Pony Express.
Did you provide passage to a rider wearing a purple vest a few days back? I'm trying to figure out where he was before he left Cabin Isle.
Thank you kindly!

chatpoints.chat_text: I would, indeed! I need 20 coconuts and a fair bit of rope.

replies.reply_text: Coconuts are easy to get, but offhand, I'm not sure where to get the rope.

chatpoints.chat_text: I did indeed. He was snacking on Vee's pie a la mode - you might want to check with her.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy!

replies.reply_text: Hello there. I was wondering if you know how to get to Glacier Isle?
Hello and good bye!
I'm back with two hot cocoas to use your boat, please!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll let you use my boat to get there and back for two hot cocoas.

replies.reply_text: I haven't got any on me. I'll be back shortly!
I've got two right here!
Thanks so much, and I'll be sure to take good care of it.

npc_list.name: Zetchu
npc_list.short_description: A cute little off-white male alpaca.
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The adorable alpaca looks at you with cautious interest. )

replies.reply_text: Hello there cutie. Lookie here, lookie here. I've got a little treat for you! (You hold out the Alpaca Treat and get ready to snatch a clump of fleece. )
No worries. I'm backing up, see? I'm going away now, so you don't have to be scared.
Ugh! You took the treat and didn't give me anything in return! Oh wait! You aren't really white. You're off-white. That's not the color I need!

npc_list.name: Gnigal
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start on CP#2

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there! Slow down. You almost ran right over me.

replies.reply_text: Opps! Sorry about that. Gnomes are pretty small. Maybe you should carry around a flag so people can see you. Speaking of that - I'm outta here. See ya! Ha-ha-ha-ha!
Hello there and apologies. I didn't see you. I think this cap belongs to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh! Hideous thing. I thought I buried it. My brother is fond of titles. He gave this to me when he decided I should have the title of Gnome Caretaker of Cabin Forest. I have no need of titles or gnome caps! He gave himself ridiculous titles on an isle he calls Gnome Man's Land.

replies.reply_text: Thank you for the pine cones, but you mentioned Gnome Man's Land? I don't think I've ever seen an isle called that.
I wasn't expecting a reward, but thank you anyway. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! What brings you out to this neck of the woods?

replies.reply_text: Hello there! You had mentioned Gnome Man's Land. Can you tell me about that?

So, Rafiki told me about a Gnome digging 'worm holes'. I'm guessing he was talking about you. He said that if I followed the worm holes, I'd end up some place amazing. This doesn't seem like a very amazing place.
I'm not sure I even remember any more! If I do remember, I'll come back. In the meantime, I think its time for a snack.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hey there, Gnigal. I was hoping you could send me back to see your brother?
Hi Gnigal. I forgot to ask you what you wanted with those stinky, smelling toadstools.
I've got your miniature magical toadstools!
I've got another plush unicorn for you!
I've got another plush pegasus for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! Gnorman's Gnome Man's Land. A very odd place indeed. It has a stand of mostly dead trees that he has named the Past Its Prime Forest. There's a sea of sand and Prickly Spit.

replies.reply_text: Prickly Spit? I supposed you are going to tell me it has a spit of land that has something prickly on it?
Sea of Sand? How is that even possible? Sounds too crazy for me. I'll just leave you to your day. Have a good one.
Gnome Man's Land! Ha! That's pretty clever if you ask me. But of course, you didn't ask me, so I think I'll just leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: At every wormhole, you simple dig to move forward, rake to return.

replies.reply_text: Okay. thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: The boy doesn't get out much. Any place other than his home isle would be exciting to him.  However, if an odd and unusual isle is of interest to you, you might want to visit my brother.

replies.reply_text: Hmm. That does sound interesting. Please send me there.
Can you tell me a little more about this odd and unusual isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hold your horses! I require a favor first.

replies.reply_text: Of course! I expected nothing less. I'm happy to do you a favor. Kind of that whole "ask and receive" thing! What do you need?
Seriously? I should have known there was a catch. I think I'll pass on visiting this odd and unusual place. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: There was a hole in my bag, and I dropped half a dozen miniature magical toadstools in my journey creating these wormholes. I need you to retrace my footsteps.

replies.reply_text: Happy to do that. And no worries, I shall return them all to you, shortly.
You said retrace your steps... is there an easy way to do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Mostly Prickly Pear cactus! Doesn't seem right that cactus would grow that far north in a climate that surely has more rain than most deserts, but it remains true.

replies.reply_text: Ohhhhh. I've heard that you can find prickly pear cactus all over the place! Guess the prickly pear isn't very picky, is it?  Ha! Ha! Ha!
That does seem strange but strange in kind of an amazing way. Maybe that was where Rafiki was talking about!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know if you'd consider it easy or not, but you just go back the way you came. Rack to return to the previous island.

replies.reply_text: Well that's interesting! Rack to return. I'll be sure to remember that. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were retracing my footsteps to find my lost toadstools. Half a dozen of them. Ring a bell?

replies.reply_text: Why yes it does! I'll head over to the dead tree to the far east side of Cabin Isle now. Rake to return - yup! Rings plenty of bells now.
Not really. I must have agreed to help you ages and ages ago. Can you give me a little more information, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness! Seems like I've been waiting forever for you to return with them.

replies.reply_text: Will do, and thank you!
I've got to be honest with you. Those magical toadstools are some nasty, foul smelling fungi!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Tell him I said hi.

replies.reply_text: Will do, and thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! They are rather foul smelling, aren't they? Well, unfortunately, magic isn't always pretty and it isn't always the sweetest smelling.

replies.reply_text: Umm. Okay. I get that. But what do you USE them for?
You can say that again! Okay, I'm gone like last year's hiccups. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Creating something living out of something not, of course! I've got orders to fill you know. Say, perhaps you can help me.

replies.reply_text: Wait, is this another quest or something? Not sure I'm interested. Thanks anyways.
I might be able to help you. What is it you need?
Orders to fill? Creating something living out of something not? Man, you are talking in riddles. I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have great need of plush unicorns and plush pegai. For every one you bring me, I will pay you seven hundred and fifty dollars.

replies.reply_text: I have a plush unicorn right here!
Sounds great. When I end up with one I don't need, I'll be sure to bring it here. Bye!
Looky here, looky here! I have a plush pegasus right here!
Wait, I have another one.
I'll be back with more! See ya around.
Wait a minute. Are you saying you turn these plush unicorns into living ones?
Yikes!

chatpoints.chat_text: There was a hole in my bag, and I dropped half a dozen miniature magical toadstools in creating the wormholes. I need you to retrace my footsteps. Just rake, instead of digging, at each wormhole to go back to the previous one. You should find the toadstools not more than 3 steps from each hole.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay. So it seems like I popped up near the old tree on the east side of this island. I'll head there now. Thanks.
It tires me just to think about how much effort I'll have to put into this. Maybe I'll pursue it another time. Have a great day!
How do I go back?  You might have told me, but I can't remember.
Wait a minute. Are you saying you turn plush pegai into living ones?
Wait, I have another one.
I'll be back with more! See ya on the rebound!
I heard that you are now in the market for plush

npc_list.name: Zhivago
npc_list.admin_description: Colbert's alpaca herding dog
npc_list.long_description: Zhivago is a male Great Pyrenees dog who loves guarding his alpacas. This breed of dog is known for its natural guardian instinct.

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Hey Boy. Its okay. I'm not going to hurt your alpacas.

npc_list.name: Buddy Bumboo
npc_list.short_description: Proprietor of Ye Olde Grog Shack
npc_list.long_description: Buddy looks like your typical pirate - except for the blue eyeliner he's wearing! Other than that, he's wearing the typical eye patch, scruffy beard, and smelly old hat. When he smiles, you see that he hasn't kept up on his dental needs!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey!  Can I be gettin' ya somethin' ter wet yer whistle?

replies.reply_text: Ahoy there!  You know, something to drink about now sounds delightful, what do you have?
Not right now thanks.  Maybe I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: See that 'ere sign? That be my menu. And like me menu be sayin' - I gots lemonade, coffee and soda pop. That be all the drinks I be carryin'. What be yer poison?

replies.reply_text: Poison? Are you nuts! I'm so gone!

npc_list.name: Marilyn Pugg
npc_list.admin_description: after player talks to Raleigh on the beach
npc_list.short_description: A stunner--until she opens her mouth.
npc_list.long_description: This face could launch a thousand ships.  Alas, her words would immediately cause their crew to scuttle the ships and live as hermits.

npc_list.name: Tika
npc_list.admin_description: prior quest req 4377
npc_list.long_description: A little monkey with a sparkly pink collar around its neck. What a cutie!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little monkey looks scared and is chittering very quietly.)

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. You look a little frightened! I won't hurt you. Why don't you come here and let me help you?
Wild animal! RUN!!! Before it attacks and bites and spreads infectious diseases.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little monkey looks at you with frightened eyes and huddles up into a ball, trying to make itself as small as possible. )

replies.reply_text: Hey there. Its okay. I'm not going to hurt you. I'll just leave right now.
Giuliana is very worried about you.

chatpoints.chat_text: ( The little monkey scratches its head and looks around as if to escape. )

replies.reply_text: No, no, no! Do not run off. I need to take you back to Giulianna. Come on, Tika. Here, climb up on my shoulder. (You reach your hand out to Tika, but then suddenly, the monkey screams and leaps into the trees.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (You can hear the nervous chattering of the monkey fading into the tree tops.)

replies.reply_text: Great! That didn't go well.

npc_list.name: Zoltana
npc_list.short_description: A cute rose gray baby female alpaca
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmmm. Hmmmmm.

npc_list.name: Zhavetta
npc_list.admin_description: Colbert's alpaca herding dog
npc_list.long_description: Zhavetta is a female Great Pyrenees dog who loves guarding the herd of alpacas. This breed of dog is known for its natural guardian instinct.

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Aren't you a pretty girl? No worries - I'm not going to hurt your adorable alpacas!

npc_list.name: Kuzco
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Kuzco is named after a great Emperor of a foreign land, and this Alpaca certainly acts like a big shot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm? Hmmmm? Hmmm?

replies.reply_text: Sorry fellow. I have no clue what you are asking. Or saying. Or whatever!

npc_list.name: Quya
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Quya's name is Quechuan meaning Queen, and that's exactly how she acts!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The large red alpaca just looks at you with big brown eyes.)

npc_list.name: Qhuri
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Qhuri's name is Quechuan, meaning gold, and she acts like she's all that and a bag of chips, too!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Qhuri reminds you of a fuzzy palomino foal, and she struts around like one, too! )

npc_list.name: Qullqi
npc_list.short_description: a female baby silvery grey alpaca
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Qullqi's name is Quechuan, meaning silver. In her case, it might as well mean 'quicksilver' because she is hard to hold on to!

chatpoints.chat_text: (This adorable alpaca is so cute, you just want to take it home with you! Fortunately, you know better than to do something like that. )

npc_list.name: Qhawa
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Qhawa's name is Quechuan meaning watchful. It fits her to a 'T' as she is very curious and is always looking around with her big eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Qhawa looks at you with her huge brown eyes. She seems very curious about you.)

replies.reply_text: Well aren't you a cutie-patootie!

npc_list.name: Qhispi
npc_list.short_description: a gorgeous rose grey female adult alpaca
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle. Qhispi's name is Quechuan and means free - and she likes it that way. You'll have to work hard to catch this cutie!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Qhispi looks like she's ready to dart away. You don't want to scare her so you decide to back away. )

npc_list.name: Hank Halyard
npc_list.long_description: A friendly looking man with an easy smile.

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy, howdy. Hang on to your hat. The winds don't play nice, here. What can I do for you this fine day?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, thanks for asking. I was just checking out the island.
I appreciate you asking but I am just here to deliver a package from Pony Express.
Hey there Hank. Barbette asked me to deliver this to you.
Good day, Hank. Was there something I was doing for you?
Thank you! And have an awesome day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were indeed! You were going to deliver a Plastic Pink Flamingo to Barbette.

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'll do that right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Hank takes the package and starts laughing. He evidently knows exactly what's in the package, but he's not telling you. Darn it!)

replies.reply_text: Will do.

npc_list.name: Postmaster General
npc_list.admin_description: #2 Postmaster after 35th delivery/goto CP#34 for new deliveries/chat after 55th delivery
npc_list.long_description: A kindly looking gentleman with warm eyes and a caring expression.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Ready for your next delivery?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, what is this all about again?
Maybe later.
Yes I am. The last delivery was so heavy because it was filled with books! An appropriate pastime for Quiet Isle! Okay, where to now?
Boy, Leontine an odd one. I hope the next delivery is to someone more normal.
Okay, who do I visit next?
That was nice and quick! What next?
Yes I am!
Brrrr! That is one really cold place! Yup. Point me in the right direction and I'll head out!
Where to next?
That was an interesting little island! And the next delivery goes to...?
That was a sad delivery, but I hope the package from his brother makes Dusty happy! Okay, where to next, Mr. Postmaster General?
I love the quick and easy ones! Hoping this next delivery is the same.
I am ready for the next delivery!
I am saddled up and ready for the next delivery!
I'm really getting to know the population with all these deliveries. Where to next?
My horse is saddled and raring to go. Where to next?
I am ready to head out once again!
I'm back for action!
If you've got it ready, I'm set to go.
I am indeed! Oh, and Andrea said to say hi.
I'm ready if the package is!

Sorry, but I'm not here to help you out today. Maybe another time. I'm here because Quincy, the Third Little Pig, received a load of adobe bricks instead of the red bricks he ordered. He's pretty upset about it.
I'm back and ready for the next package.
I'm back and raring to go. I love delivering packages! Where to next?
Okay, I delivered the package to Haley. Where to next?
I'm all geared up and ready to go - where's the next delivery to? Hopefully some place warmer than Glacier!
I've delivered 50 packages and I'm raring to deliver more. Because, I'm just that awesome! Got any more deliveries ready for me?
Ready and willing for the next delivery, General! If you have one, that is.
Looking to make some fast money - got any packages you need to have delivered?
The Admiral sends his good wishes to you. Who gets the next package?
Do you have another package that needs delivering?
I need to get to Chat point #34 pease to check deliveries 61-65

chatpoints.chat_text: Here at the Pony Express, we deliver parcels and packages to people all over the world.  All you need to do is deliver mail and get paid.  It's that easy.

replies.reply_text: That's it? No finding things in hidden places? No gathering a million things to make something else? No finding lost people in the jungle then traveling all the way across the world again? No gimmicks? Just deliver mail??
I know there's got to be a catch.  Nothing is that easy around here!  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's it. You get paid upon your delivery from the customer and you get to keep all of that money.  There's no need to run back here after every delivery.  That would be silly!  Just come back when you are ready to carry more packages to people.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Well, let's get started!
Wow!  That's really easy!  But I think I'll pass on that today.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have been so efficient in delivering parcels for the Pony Express that we don't have any more left to deliver!  Maybe check back in a few days.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right. Thank you for the compliment, and have a great day!
Got one handy right here! I'll be back soon.
Ugh. Not one of my favorite places to visit. See you in a bit!
Awesome, another quick and easy one! I'm on it like ants on a picnic.
Gosh, maybe she'll give me some Strawberry Pie while I'm there! Be back soon.
Guess I better bundle up. Glaciers aren't known for being warm!
Hmmm.That's a long trip. I'll make sure to pack plenty of munchies.
Looks like I need to head north for this one. Off I go!
Guess I better take some tissue. The dust in that place always makes me sneeze!
Oh joy, oh boy! A quick trip!
Heading out there now!

chatpoints.chat_text: You still need to deliver the package to Leontine on Rain Isle. Skedaddle already!

replies.reply_text: Okay dokey!

chatpoints.chat_text: You still need to deliver the package to Venda on Quiet Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh right. On my way!
I'm on my way!
Hi-ho, hi-ho and away I go!
I'll go ring up Andrea! Ha-ha-ha! Just a little joke there.
Jungle, eh? I'll swing over there now.
Woof! Woof! A-wooooooo! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have been amazingly efficient! Do you know you completed 50 deliveries?

replies.reply_text: Wow. I hadn't kept track! Thank you so much. It's so cute. I love it!
Okay, I shall! Good luck with your other deliveries.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, that mix-up! It's so embarrassing to admit I made a mistake in getting two deliveries ready. You see, I had one order for red bricks and another for adobe bricks. I was in a hurry, with this being the Pony Express and all, so I must have misread the orders and accidentally swapped the pallets. Luckily, the other person realized the mistake, too, and returned the red bricks they received.

replies.reply_text: It's only natural to make a mistake once in a while. Nobody's perfect! Quincy had me bring back the adobe he got and pick up the brick he ordered.
Haley? That's a resident I haven't met yet. And she gets two? I think that's a first. I'll head there now.
Lucky for me, I have a nice winter coat. I'm on my way!
I'll head there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes I do. Right here.

replies.reply_text: I'm on it, General!
I will get that delivered ASAP!

chatpoints.chat_text: I must say, I am impressed with your enthusiasm.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the compliment. Looks like I need to deliver this right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness! Aren't you the eager one?

replies.reply_text: I'm just eager to explore the islands and chat with all the fascinate people there are. It keeps life interesting. That said, I best be taking the package to her right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure she's much happier now.

replies.reply_text: Well drat. That's a long journey. But neither snow nor rain nor gloom of night will stop me from delivering this package!
(You quickly swallow the snack you had just popped into your mouth.) Ack! On my way.
I don't know that I've ever met the man. Guess I'll do that now!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Postmaster appears to be one busy man!) Hello again! And what can I do for you this fine day?

replies.reply_text: It's me again! Ready to ride.
I was hoping you had another package that needs delivering.
Delivering packages is a great way to explore the islands! Got another one ready for me?
I am looking forward to delivering more packages. More and more and more, please!
It isn't what you can do for me, it's what I can do for you! My horse and I are at your service! Who does the next delivery go to?
I delivered the package to Felicity. So where's the next package heading?
Bettina was thrilled with the package. Where to next, General?
That was quick and easy. Did you have another delivery for me?
Nothing for now.  Thanks!
What is all this Pony Express stuff about again?
I'm here because Quincy, the Third Little Pig, received a load of adobe bricks instead of the red bricks he ordered. He's pretty upset about it.
What's the puzzled look for? This is our routine, remember? I come in, you give me a package or a letter to deliver, and I deliver it!
Who did you say I should see about this letter?

Hello, hello! I've got an update for you. The letter explained how to make a map, which I did, and it lead me to an old jewelry box that had five diamond necklaces in it. I suppose I should give them to you?
For some reason or other, I don't remember what the deal with this letter is. Can you refresh my memory? It has some gibberish about a map?
Do you remember what numbers were written on the envelope?
Hello there! Remember that mysterious letter that you put in the dead letter file? Could I have a peek at it again? I have misplaced my map and need to make another one.
I'm just wondering if you have any deliveries ready to go out?
Batten's package has been delivered so I'm back for the next one!
Lavender thinks you are a funny man! Any more deliveries?
That was an interesting delivery. I'd never heard of Día de los Muertos before. Victor said its a very important celebration for him. Do you have anything else for me to deliver?
Peony said it was a tambourine, hence the rattle sound it made! I'm ready to deliver another package.
Dixie had ordered grafts for some amazing sounding fruit! What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, this letter has no provenance. Who sent it? What time did it arrive? Who is this to be delivered to? This is not how things are done in this office. There are procedures that need to be followed.

replies.reply_text: Oh goody! A mystery and I love mysteries.
Now that's suspicious. This breaks the pattern we've established. I don't trust this. I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, while it is a mystery, it is horribly frustrating. I log in each and every letter and package and I log them out when you pick them up for delivery. There is no log in entry for this. It was slipped under my door sometime during the night. That's a problem!

replies.reply_text: Dear me. Do you think it is dangerous? It is surely suspicious. Maybe I shouldn't get involved. I think I'll just leave this mystery to you. Bye!

I know you run a tight office here, with everything running like a well-oiled machine. So I can understand why this is unsettling to you. I'd be happy to open it and see if that helps solve the mystery of who it goes to.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good idea. It would be improper for me to open it and since you are the delivery person, that would make sense. Here you go.

replies.reply_text: Maybe it will lead to some great discovery! (You open the envelope and read the letter. ) This is interesting and very puzzling at the same time! It doesn't say who it is to, or who it is from.

chatpoints.chat_text: Michaela in Earton. I really appreciate your efforts in this.

replies.reply_text: No problem! I love to solve a good mystery.
No problem.  Oh!  Also, do you remember what the numbers were on the envelope?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well darn. This puzzles me to no end. What to do, what to do?

replies.reply_text: This is hardly helpful. There's some gibberish about creating a map to get what is needed. Needed for what? Do you know anything about maps?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't. Would you be so kind as to talk to Michaela in Earton? She’s very smart and if she doesn’t know the answer, she can surely point you in the right direction.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to do that. I'll head up there now. I won't stop until I find out what this letter is all about!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! I've been trying to figure out what they mean so they've been on my mind a lot. They were (-2,1) and (-3,0).

replies.reply_text: Perfect! They are graph coordinates. There must be something important at those sites. Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Heaven's no. I have no use for jewelry. You keep them. At this point, the matter is settled enough for my paperwork. No record of where it came from or who it goes to - that's the best I can do. I'm done with the matter.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's the letter that has no provenance. You opened it to see if you could figure out who it is meant for. Why don't you take another look at the letter.

replies.reply_text: Oh right! So, it doesn't say who it is to, or who it is from. It appears to have something to do with making a map or something. Do you know anything about making one?

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, we had a horrible storm and I'd forgotten to close the windows. That letter, with several others, was blown away. Such a shame!

replies.reply_text: Oh no! I really need another map. Do you have any suggestions?
Well that settles that. I guess I'm just out of luck.
Do you remember what the two numbers were on the envelope?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why don't you ask whoever it was that helped you make the map in the first place. Maybe they'll remember what the letter said.

replies.reply_text: What an awesome idea! I'll head there now.
I don't believe I've ever met the man. I'm on my way to do just that!
Oh, this package does smell good. I'll almost be sorry to let it go. But never fear! I always deliver the goods!
Two packages! I'll head over to his place now.
Why yes it does! I wonder what's inside. I'll head over there now.
I wonder what kind of oranges these grafts will grow up to be? Heading to Dixie's now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sending you to chatpoint #34 - remind me what you need again once you get there.

replies.reply_text: Okay dokey!

npc_list.name: Angelica Ankurs
npc_list.long_description: Although she is bundled up against the cold, you can see that Angelica is a lovely fair-haired young lady with pale skin and pink cheeks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Brrrr! Do come in out of the cold. The wind is icy off the waters today.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. I would have thought the wind would always be icy here.

Thank you. Would you happen to know if a rider with a purple chest came through here? I'm trying to backtrack his movements to figure out where he's from. He left something of value behind and I'd like to let him know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, it almost always is. But once in a while, we get a warm breeze. I wish we had more of those!

replies.reply_text: I don't blame you. It must be a cold job to be the Harbor Mistress here.
Me too. I think I'll head some place warmer.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is. But this is my home. And I do love the beautiful snow.

replies.reply_text: Ah! I understand. Speaking of home, I think I'll head back to mine.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I can't help you. Purple is my favorite color. I would definitely noticed someone with a chest that color.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Jackie Sparrow
npc_list.admin_description: No new quests, 1 time appearance.
npc_list.long_description: Looks like Jackie is taking a nap.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You nudge Jackie to wake him up.) What! Who be ya? What do ye be doing in here?

replies.reply_text: The better question is, what are you doing in here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Doing? What ya think I be doing? And what ye be doing askin' me about it!

replies.reply_text: Jackie Sparrow I presume?  Your Boss, Mary, sent me to find you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were sent by herself?  I think I'm in a real bind, aren't I?

replies.reply_text: That's not for me to say. You'll have to talk to her about it. But why ARE you here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Truth be told, I got bored sitting in that tent waiting for somebody to come by...so I decided to go on walkabout.

replies.reply_text: And that's why you were in here asleep? If you straighten up the beach tent, I won't tell Mary where I found you!

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd do that for me?  Thank ye kindly!  I had better get back to the tent right away.

replies.reply_text: You do that, and I'll let Mary know that you are back at work.

npc_list.name: Jackie Sparrow
npc_list.admin_description: Use this Jackie for any new quests
npc_list.long_description: Jackie is ready to serve the resort guests.

chatpoints.chat_text: G'day matey!  Can I be gettin' ya any of our fine equipment ta enjoy yer stay?

replies.reply_text: I'm just looking thanks.
You have a lot of equipment here, is there a rental charge to use any of them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nay, all this be free to any seadog that be stayin' here at Treasure Isle Resort.

replies.reply_text: That's good to know, maybe next time.  See ya!

npc_list.name: Harlan Hard Tack
npc_list.long_description: Harlan has the kind of face that tells you he's had a lot of adventures, and many of the not-so-nice kind! But he has a twinkle in his eye and an easy smile that assures you that he won't be taking his hardships out on you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey! Harlan's me name and good grub be me game.  Can I be fixin' ye some of me world class vittles?

replies.reply_text: Hey Harlan. I'd like to give you the burrito back.
Hi Harlan.  That sounds interesting, what can I get?
Sorry, I'm not particularly hungry right now.  I'm just looking around.  Nice to meet you!
Actually, I was wondering if there were any odd jobs you might need done?
Harlan, please don't get mad, but I forgot what you asked me to do for you.
Hi Harlan, I'm back!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm most famous fer my Fish 'n' Chips, but I make some mean fried Chicken, and my Rice 'n' Beans puts ol' Stinky Breeches Vincent's ta shame!

replies.reply_text: Wow, I've heard about Vincent's recipe, I'm impressed.
I think I'll just set a spell and maybe get a bite to eat, let me see the menu and I'll let you know.

chatpoints.chat_text: One of these days I'm gonna challange that scurvy sea dog to a rice 'n' beans cook off.  Just you see if I don't!

replies.reply_text: Well, if you ever make up your mind, let me know, I'd love to help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Say now, matey, since yer offerin', I needs ta get me provisions picked up from Zeke over on Rider Isle.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I know Zeke.  What do you need me to pick up?
I'm sorry, but that's really out of my way.  Maybe I can help the next time I'm here.
Ok, I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries, mate, I asked ya to go see Zeke on Rider Isle to pick up me provisions fer the Tavern.

replies.reply_text: Now I remember, I have to see Zeke Sacker. I'll head there right away!
Thanks Harlan, and the pie looks delicious!  Bye!
Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Cordelia Corsair
npc_list.short_description: Runs the Treasure Isle Gift Shop

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome aboard!  Does ya see anythin' ya likes?

replies.reply_text: Wow!  You have quite a large selecion of piratey souveniers here, don' you.
I didn't know pirates like souveniers, go figure!
I'm looking for something and was told that maybe you could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, the pirates what stay here tend to sell me their shineys to settle their bills with Mary.

replies.reply_text: So that's how you keep up your inventory.  But if the pirates sell their goods to you, who buys them?

chatpoints.chat_text: The pirates don't be buyin' much in the way of souveniers, but the land lubbers loves them anythin' piratey (winks a you)

replies.reply_text: Well, this has been very informative, but I have to go now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Look around do ya see anything like what ye want?  What do ye want?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for information about the Lioness of Brittany, can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: I only deal with booty, not stories, sorry, can't help ya.

replies.reply_text: I just figured I'd ask, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, welcome, good day and how can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Just passing through, thanks anyway.
I was noticing how appropriate your name is for Appleton. There's an apple named Gala!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aren't you the clever one! Well, I've got work to do, so unless you need something, I'll be getting back to it.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay. Bye.

npc_list.name: Gertie Ghangwhey
npc_list.long_description: Gertie is a lovely young woman. Its a shame that she's on a island where not much action takes place.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Hello, hello, hello! Welcome to Dolphin Isle. Lots to see, but not much to do. Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Well hello to you too! No thanks, I was just passing through.

npc_list.name: Cygnus Parq-De-Bout
npc_list.long_description: There is something strangely different about Cygnus, but you just can't put your finger on it. Maybe the hat rack in the corner that is filled with tons of different hats has you puzzled. Or maybe the pile of shoes in the other corner of the office that you find odd.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Ello. May I help you perhaps? Perhaps not?

replies.reply_text: No thank you. Perhaps another time.
No thanks. I'm here to deliver a package to you. It is a big one!
I'd love some help. Did a strange rider come through here talking about cat allergies and birds?
Ummm. Thanks. I guess?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! You must be talking about the rider sneezing up a storm and gasping for air. I think he was allergic to cats or birds or critters of some sort.

replies.reply_text: Do you happen to know where he was coming from?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll give you one guess - where on this island are ya gonna find a bunch of critters?

replies.reply_text: Of course! I should have thought of that. Thanks.

npc_list.name: Peony Puddening
npc_list.long_description: Peony is a delightful young lady who loves reading mysteries!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Peony is deeply engrossed in a thick book titled The Most Mysterious Riddle of The Ancient Mystic.)

replies.reply_text: (You hate to bother her and decide to leave.)
Good day, Peony. I hate to bother you but I see you like mysteries, and this package from Pony Express is mysterious to me. Listen. (You shake the box to make it rattle.)

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not mysterious! That's the tambourine I ordered! This isle is a bit too quiet for me and I needed something to liven it up.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! Enjoy your tambourine.

npc_list.name: Stacie
npc_list.admin_description: Stacie after Aunt Heather sends her home.
npc_list.long_description: Stacie has bright red hair and deep blue eyes, just like her father!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! I remember you.

replies.reply_text: And I remember you! Visiting your Aunt Heather ended up being kind of scary for you!
And I remember you, too! Are you still enjoying the nesting doll set?

chatpoints.chat_text: Getting lost in the jungle was the worst! No wait. The bees chasing me and me bumping my head on the tree. That was!

replies.reply_text: But look, now you've got great stories to tell! That's ever so much better than saying the visit was just 'fine.' Now it sounds like it was a real adventure!
And because of that, your mom had me bring you this! To make you feel better.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks at you dubiously.) If you say so.

replies.reply_text: I do! Think of all the drama. The action! This will go down as an exciting chapter in your life. And here's a great closing chapter - a gift from your mom for all misadventures of the trip!
Of course I do! And someday, when you are older, you'll completely see what I mean. In the meantime, have a good day.
So glad you like it! See you around, Kiddo!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am! And it is so pretty, with all the pretty butterflies and the silly monkeys and flowers and everything else! Its all just so beautiful. It reminds me of the good parts of the Jungle. I might even go visit my Aunt Heather again some day!

replies.reply_text: I am so glad about that. There is plenty to like on the Jungle Islands and I'm sure your Aunt Heather would love to see you again. Have fun in the meantime. Bye!

npc_list.name: Gnella
npc_list.long_description: Gnella is about knee-high to a natterjack. Gnella is a purple fluttery butterflyish creature darting about in the raspberry bushes.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(A burst of giggles erupts from the little creature, sending her head over wings and back again through the bushes.)

Ohhhhh! A Human! You are the first human I've seen today.

replies.reply_text: Well, imagine that!
Hello there! I was wondering if you could tell me about the witch that imprisoned the frog in the dead tree?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(You hear a flurry of commotion in the blackberry bushes just north of the pond.)

Don't mind her. She's just jealous that you are talking to ME. I don't much abide by witches. They scare me. You might want to ask one of my sisters.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that. Thank you for your time.

npc_list.name: Gnessa
npc_list.long_description: Gnessa is about knee-high to a natterjack. Gnessa is busy fluttering about in the Blackberry bushes.

chatpoints.chat_text: A human! A human! I'm allergic to humans. (The little fairy sneezes and tumbles up into the sky and right back down again.)

replies.reply_text: Bless you! Humans make you sneeze? That's ... different. So, I was wondering if you could give me some information about the witch? I guess one imprisoned Murigal and I agreed to help her out.
Bless you! (You hand the tiny creature a tissue.) I'll just leave you be. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why thank you! Ah-choooo! Ah-choooo! Ah-choooo! (The little fairy sneezes and tumbles up into the sky and right back down again.)

replies.reply_text: Maybe I had better leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not me. Ah-choooo! You should talk to Gnetta. She told Ah-choooo! the frog not to vex the witch. Ah-choooo! Ah-choooo!

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! Sorry to make you sneeze! Bye now.

npc_list.name: Gnetta
npc_list.admin_description: Future quests/chat start at CP 10
npc_list.long_description: Gnetta is about knee-high to a natterjack. She flutters about the Thimbleberry bushes.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The tiny creature looks startled, and unhappy, to see you. She crosses her arms over her chest as she flutters in front of you.)

Ugh. Just my luck. A human to ruin what was a glorious day. Please go away. You're blocking the sun. You're ruining my view. And now you've trampled the bushes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, my. You aren't a very happy camper! I'll just leave you be.
Oh dear! It wasn't my intent to upset you. Sorry to block the sun and trample the bushes. I'm hoping you can help me. Please do, and I'll be out of your view before you know it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why would I help a human? You creatures trample the berries. Scatter them here and yon. You're noisy and obnoxious and mean and unruly and LOUD.

replies.reply_text: I agree that you've described more than one human. But seriously? We aren't ALL like that. Since you don't like noise, I would think you'd be happy for my help in hushing that noisy frog over there.
Why, indeed! With that, I think I'll just leave, you grumpy creature, you!
Because I'm helping you by rescuing Murigal, which should hush her up. Remember? But I need a small reminder of where I can find the witch that she vexed.
Well, do you hear anything noisy and loud? Like a frog making a bunch of ruckus?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can hush that silly creature up? That would certainly make helping you more appealing. (Gnetta taps her lips as she considers the idea of helping you.)

replies.reply_text: I'm hoping to. But I need help in finding out why a witch put a spell on Murigal, and where I might find this witch.
Unfortunately, I noticed the time and I don't have time for this now! Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: I warned the toad not to vex the witch. I told her and told her and told her. But did she listen? No! She wouldn't hush up. So she vexed the witch and the witch hexed her.

replies.reply_text: Thank you for that information. Would you by any chance know where I might find the witch?
Hey, she's a frog. Not a toad. Actually, she's a princess turned into a grouchy frog. Speaking of that, I'm going to turn into a grouch if I don't have any food. See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Which witch? (Gnetta is frolicking among the berries. She seems distracted by their lovely scent.)

replies.reply_text: Which witch? The Wicked Witch! The vexed witch that hexed Murigal! Can you tell me where I might find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhhh! THAT witch. She lives where it's all prickly and sandy. There's a black widow named Draculetta that might be able to offer help.

replies.reply_text: Fairies, and witches AND spiders? Oh, my! I am so gone!
Yikes. That doesn't sound fun. Well, I'm off before Murigal ruins my hearing and concentration.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, right. Some desert isle where a black widow lives. Now please, can you stop ruining my view?

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry again. Thanks and I'm gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh! That frog. That horrid, noisy frog! But wait. I don't hear her anymore!

replies.reply_text: And that is thanks to me! So I was wondering if you would be so kind as to reward me for all my troubles in bringing you peace!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why doesn't the frog reward you? You set HER free!

replies.reply_text: True, but she rushed off to find her true love before she could do that. I've restored peace and quiet to your berry bush neighborhood. So I've set you free from her noise!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent point.  I will reward you, but you must seek out the frog. She owes you immensely!

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The tiny creature looks startled to see you. She crosses her arms over her chest as she flutters in front of you.)

Ugh. Just my luck. The human returns to ruin what was a glorious day. Please go away. You're blocking the sun. You're ruining my view. And now you've trampled the berry bushes, too.

replies.reply_text: Well hello to you, too, Miss Grumpy Britches!

npc_list.name: Maksum
npc_list.admin_description: Mandy's dog
npc_list.short_description: A shaggy sheepdog on Tail Isle
npc_list.long_description: Maksum is a mischievous looking shaggy dog with a wide grin and fluffy tail that wags like crazy. He reminds you of Muktdar, the sheepdog on Glacier Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: What a cutie you are! I can see you want to play. However, I don't have time for that right now. Bye for now!

npc_list.name: Ariela
npc_list.admin_description: After you find her necklace/no new quests on this id
npc_list.long_description: A beautiful little mermaid. Somehow, you expected her to be larger, but Ariela is only about 3 feet tall, and her very fancy tail takes up at least one foot of that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my! I didn't expect to see you there. I was afraid you were the fox.

replies.reply_text: Hello Ariela. I haven't seen you in ages. I'm not the fox, but why would you be worried about him?
Nope, I'm not the fox. I'll just leave you be. Have a wonderful day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Foxes hunt and eat fish. I am afraid the fox on this isle will mistake me for one.

replies.reply_text: Oh gosh. I hadn't thought of that. But not even Renard would confuse you for a fish. He thinks you are a beautiful Sirène. And he's worried about you. What can I do to assure you that he is not a threat?
I think he'd rather eat grapes and cheese. But if it still worries you, maybe you should swim home. Speaking of home, I need to head there now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sirène? Their singing makes sailors swim towards them until they are exhausted and near to drowning! I am nothing like that! I would never harm anyone or anything! Please tell him that!

replies.reply_text: I really don't think that's necessary. I believe you are being a tad overly sensitive. I don't think I want to get involved in a bunch of drama, so I'll just wave goodbye! Get it? Wave? Ha ha ha!
I will happily tell him that. But first, why are you here? This isn't your home island, is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all. But I have lovely tidepools around the isle I live on.  There was an awful storm and it washed away all the starfish. I was hoping to find some in the tidepools here, but I think the storm must have hit this island, too.

replies.reply_text: So, I'm guessing you didn't find any starfish here. Would you like me to get some for you? There's a pet shop that sells them.
Gosh. That's a shame. Well, maybe you should swim to some other tidepools. Good luck on finding those starfish.

chatpoints.chat_text: You would do that for me? That would be wonderful! I don't have much to pay you with, but I make lovely pearl necklaces. Oh, this is so exciting!

replies.reply_text: But wait! I don't know where you live!
Alrighty then! I am on my way to get those starfish for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh silly me! I live on the island of Mercurius, the Purple Fish of Love! Bye now!

replies.reply_text: See you soon!

npc_list.name: Ariela
npc_list.admin_description: After you agree to get her starfish
npc_list.long_description: A beautiful little mermaid. Somehow, you expected her to be larger, but Ariela is only about 3 feet tall. And her very fancy tail takes up at least one foot of that!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! You startled me. I wasn't expecting anyone. This isle rarely sees visitors. But I'm very happy to see you!

replies.reply_text: I'm happy to see you, too, but I've no time to chat. See you later!
I'm so glad I've found you! I've got your starfish for you.
Can you get me off this isle? I've got things to do and places to go and people to talk to!
Thanks so much! I think I'll just explore your isle a bit.
Thanks so much. Can you get me off this isle now? I've got some work to tend to.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so sorry, I don't know how to do that, but Mercurius should be able to help you.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay, no worries. I'll go talk to him now.

npc_list.name: Murigal
npc_list.admin_description: No new quests on this  #2 Murigal
npc_list.long_description: Murigal is in a locked cage that looks like it is fused into the bark of the dead tree. She looks miserable!

chatpoints.chat_text: Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Of course it's me! Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Am I not still a frog? Am I not still without a prince? Oh woe, is me! Oh woe! Oh woe!

replies.reply_text: Oh no, oh dear! Is that cage locked? Heavens! How did that happen? Did you lose the key? Do you need me to find it?
Hmmm. Sounds like you are still on your foolish quest of kissing frogs. Personally, I can't abide by the thought. Matter of fact, it upsets me so much, I am going to take my leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(You hear a loud ruckous coming from the tree. You can see a caged frog. It looks like the cage is fused into the bark of the old dead tree. The frog looks suspiciously familiar).

Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh, woe is me! All for naught, I say. All for naught. Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup!

replies.reply_text: Murigal? Is that you?
Oh oh. This doesn't look good at all. Too scary, too noisy for me. I am so outta here!
quest check

chatpoints.chat_text: Ribbit! Greedeep! I never had a key to lose! Croak! Ka-blurp! Oh woe is me! Oh woe! Greedeep! Bruddup!

replies.reply_text: Seriously, Murigal? If you want my help, you are going to have to stop with all this ruckous! I can't even think straight with all the noise you are making!
You know, if I listen to my instincts, creepy frog in even creepier tree cage means RUN!

chatpoints.chat_text: Greedeep! Bruddup! Ribbit-kadump! My soul is wretched. My eyes puffed from crying. This is no state for a princess such as myself to be in! Croak! Ka-blurp! And yet, you ask me to HUSH?

replies.reply_text: Look. I get that you are upset. But you are croaking in a dozen different ways. That just adds to the drama and confusion. If you have to make frog sounds, just choose one.
So, you must be some kind of Drama Queen. I mean, Drama Princess. You are sure overly dramatic. Oh woe! Oh woe! Gesh! Get a life already. Next time I ride through here, I'll remember NOT to stop!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just one? Greedeep! Bruddup! And which one would best suit me? A ribbit? A croak? Or perhaps a ribbit-kadump? Just what is a Princess turned into a frog supposed to sound like? Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh woe! Oh woe!

replies.reply_text: Well darn. I don't know. You are the only one I've ever dealt with. So, that means that you get to choose. Any single sound you want. So, while you are thinking about that, how about you tell me what happened for you to end up here?
For all I care you can just croak to your heart's content. And as you do that, I'm going to ske-daddle right on out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you think happened? Use your head, before I'm dead! Croak! Ka-blurp! A witch! A witch! A wicked old witch! Greedeep! Bruddup! She did this to me. She locked me in here. Oh woe! Oh woe! Croak! Ka-blurp!

replies.reply_text: Which old witch?
Witches and caged frogs that talk. I think I'll head over to the library and do some research. Right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Which old witch? The WICKED Witch! Croak! Ka-blurp! Help me, before I perish here from fright!

replies.reply_text: So, I don't see a yellow brick road, and this sure isn't OZ. Which witch might you be speaking of?
You know, I think you woke up on the wrong side of the bed. I mean lilypad, today. Why don't you take a little froggy nap and I just might come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greedeep! The wicked witch that caged me here! She's warty and old and ugly as a toad! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! And talk about mean! She's meaner than a rattlesnake! Croak! Ka-blurp! Oh woe is me! I am wasting away!

replies.reply_text: I don't do wicked witches. Most especially one that is meaner than a rattlesnake.
Okay, so how do I help you? Can you tell me where the witch is?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Murigal stops crying and looks at you in surprise. If a frog can look surprised, that is.)

Does this mean Hiccup! you'll help me? Hiccup! So sorry. Crying makes hiccup! me do that.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I'll help you, but I need more information. Other than she's mean and ugly as a toad, where can I find her?
No. I just wanted you to hush up. Now you've hushed so I'm getting back to picking berries, thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't hiccup! know!

replies.reply_text: I didn't know there were berry fairies! Okay, I'll go check out the bushes here.
Berry fairies and a wicked witch. Can this get any weirder? I don't think I'm going to wait around to find out.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(There’s a loud ruckous coming from the tree. You can see Murigal is caged. It looks like the cage is fused into the bark of the old dead tree. Murigal looks very unhappy.)

Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh, woe is me! All for naught, I say. All for naught. Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup!

replies.reply_text: Murigal? Can you remind me just what I need to do to get you out of that cage?
Murigal, get as close to the edge of the cage as you can. I have something to share with you. (You lean forward and quickly dose Murigal with the rest of the Love Potion #9.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Do? I have no clue! Croak! Ka-blurp! What did the berry fairies say?

replies.reply_text: Something about you vexed a witch and then she hexed you?
I don't remember but I'll go ask them again.

chatpoints.chat_text: So you've come to mock me? Oh woe is me! Croak! Ka-blurp!

replies.reply_text: Well, anyone who would vex a witch most certainly deserves to be hexed. However, since I agreed to help you, I will go back and talk to the fairies again.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murigal is so startled that she flips backwards and smacks her head against the back of the cage. Then she jiggles and wiggles like a bowl full of jello. And she spins around thrice. She falls to her side, her eyes roll back, and her tongue slides out. Oh dear! She looks lifeless! Thankfully, you are more prepared for the reaction to the potion this time!)

replies.reply_text: Murigal, wake up! (You wiggle and jiggle and nudge and budge Murigal. Finally she lets out a long, slow moan.)
Oh dear! This looks bad. Walking away now. Backing away from the frog. Staying away from the frog - far, far away!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ribbbbb-dribbbbb. What... hit... me? Oh... dear... I feel... so... weird. dribbbb-burpppp. Oh... woe... is... me.

replies.reply_text: You'll be fine in a wink of an eye. Or a zap of your tongue. Just give it a second or two. This is good news! I've sprayed you with Love Potion #9.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murigal stares at the bars still surrounding her.) Oh, woe! Oh, woe! Why, oh why? Ribbit! Greedeep! All for naught. All for naught. Croak! What good is a love potion when I am still caged? (Murigal bursts into a loud ruckous of ribbits and croaks and kablups.)

replies.reply_text: Well this isn't good. I'd better head back to the old witch and see what's up with that.
I've talked to the Wicked Witch. Here's the deal. I need your Royal Gemstones. I give them to her, she sets you free.
Okay, you don't have the gemstones that the witch requires to set you free. Can you tell me again where you went, and where you didn't go, in looking for your true love?
Good news, Murigal! (You hold up the gnarly wooden key that will set her free.)
I've found some of the gemstones at least.  I'll bring all 10 to Elphiblah once I have them so you can be freed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Croak! Ka-blurp! Oh woe is me! How can I find my true love without my gemstones? Croak! Ka-blurp! (Murigal suddenly realizes she might be stuck in this cage forever and she bursts out crying.)

replies.reply_text: No fears. There's a prince waiting for you on Loch Isle. Give me the gemstones so I can get you out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murigal throws herself to the floor of the cage and cries even louder.)

replies.reply_text: Murigal! Stop this crying. I can't help you with all that blubbering you are doing. The noise is driving any thought of reason right out of my brain! Just give me the gems and we'll be done with all this drama shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Murigal stops crying.) But hiccup I don't hiccup hiccup have them! Hiccup hiccup I used them to hiccup jump to more hiccup hiccup ponds!

replies.reply_text: Ugh! Must this be so difficult? Last time it was a nightmare tracking down your lost gemstones, and now I have to do that again?  Where did you jump this time?
I do not have time for this nonsense. Enjoy your life. I can't help you anymore.

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't go hiccup to any pond hiccup hiccup that I went to hiccup before. And I didn't hiccup go to hiccup any jungle isle. And the idea of either ice or fire gave me nightmares. Oh! I was desperate so I jumped to some ponds in a desert or two.

replies.reply_text: While I appreciate that information, that isn't enough. What else can you tell me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ummm. Hiccup I think hiccup I was on an island hiccup hiccup in the shape of a reptile? Maybe. And I jumped here hiccup hiccup. And then hiccup north of here.

replies.reply_text: Places you went to - a reptile-shaped isle, this pond and north of here. Any other place you can think of?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hiccup There was another pond. Hiccup a lonely hiccup little pond just north hiccup hiccup of a dock. Hiccup and I tried some other places hiccup. Oh woe hiccup hiccup is me!

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll find the ten gemstones as quickly as I can. In the meantime, please keep the noise down.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh hurry! Hurry! Croak! Ka-blurp! My true love waits on an isle called Loch! So please, unlock this dreadful cage and set me free! Free to be with my True Love... whatever his name is! Wait! When he kisses me will I turn back into a princess?

replies.reply_text: His name is Charles. And I don't know. You'd have to ask the witch.

chatpoints.chat_text: Charles? The perfect name for a true love! I certainly don't want to vex the witch again. I shall just have to assume all will go well. Ribbit-kadump! Can you tell me what my true love looks like? So I might know who to kiss? Ka-blurp!

replies.reply_text: He's a regal looking fellow. A frog wearing cool looking shades.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh woe! Oh woe is me! I have to kiss a frog? (Murigal collapses on the floor of the cage. She throws one arm over her eyes as if to block out the harsh reality of the situation.) Oh woe!

replies.reply_text: Murigal! Did you forget that you've been looking for a frog to kiss? Now buck up! You are going to pull yourself together. You WILL go to Loch Isle and you WILL find your true love.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are right! I am on a mission to find my true love! And I shall kiss Charles the Frog if he will have me! Please, use the key and set me free!

replies.reply_text: (You push the key into the keyhole of the tree cage and turn it.)
Hey! What about a thank you? Or a reward? Gesh! Crazy frog.

npc_list.name: Elphiblah
npc_list.admin_description: req visibility 4466
npc_list.long_description: Elphiblah is a very grumpy prickly old toad of a witch. She is so mean, she probably eats scorpions. Maybe even rattlesnakes!

chatpoints.chat_text: (You hear a wicked screech below you.) You oaf! You heavy lead-footed creature! You almost stepped on me!

replies.reply_text: Ummm. you're a frog. A talking frog?
RUN!!! Scary talking frog!
Please don't hex me. I know you make a habit of doing that. I've just come to ask you what I'm doing for you. Please?
A small favor? Where did you say I could find the frog named Charles again?
Hey! We had a deal! You help me and I help you! Murigal is still caged up. What's with that? Aren't you going to release her?
Excuse me, Elphiblah. There's seems to be some confusion. We made a deal. I help you and you help me. But Murigal is still caged and making a greater fuss than ever.
Who did you say I should talk to about getting you those gemstones?
I've got your gems, Elphiblah. I hope I haven't taken too long.
I used the potion on Charles. Now what?
My most humble apologies! (Best keep on her good side - if she has one! You've seen the trouble she can cause!)
Can you remind me again of what The Three Dares are?
I've brought you something!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am NOT a frog! I am a witch! You slow-witted oaf!

replies.reply_text: Well. You certainly don't look like a witch to me. And you are green just like a frog.
Keep up all the rude comments and the results won't be pretty! Actually, I'm not going to stay and listen to another rude comment. I'm leaving. Have fun being rude to yourself!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am NOT NOT NOT a frog! Frogs do not live in the desert! Toads do!

replies.reply_text: Ah! So you're a toad. A warty old toad!
Umm, I'm not sure that's exactly true. But regardless, I didn't mean to offend you by calling you a frog. What should I call you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am Elphiblah, the grandest Witch in all Toad Kingdom.

replies.reply_text: Okay. So you are a warty old toad WITCH. Do I have that right?
Elphiblah?
Yikes! I guess that means no.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Elphiblah! Now, why are you wasting my time? Don't make me put a hex you!

replies.reply_text: Sorry...  Anyway, I understand a frog vexed you and you hexed it.
Actually, neither do I! I think I'll head out to the library and do some research on this...

chatpoints.chat_text: (A shudder runs through Elphiblah and her eyes bug out more than usual for a second there.) Oh that horrid creature! Noisy creature! Creature most foul! My sense of hearing will never be the same again. NEVER!

replies.reply_text: I understand completely. She's making more noise than ever because she is caged. Is there anything I can do to set her free?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've hexed many a frog. Which frog are you speaking of, exactly?

replies.reply_text: Many? Oh dear! Murigal is the name. She croaks and ribbits and makes a bunch of other noises. It appears that you've caged her into a tree in the middle of a cotton patch. Does that ring a bell?

chatpoints.chat_text: Set her free? Will that hush her? Completely? Forever? Never to hear another peep from her evermore?

replies.reply_text: Well, no not really. That would be the first step. Then I have to find her a prince to kiss and fall in love with. I don't think there's really a way to make that possible.
Ahhh. No. Not really. Not ever. This seems to be a lost cause. I think I'll just head on over to another island now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elphiblah twitches. Then she jumps up and down and spins around. Her tongue zaps out and her eyes bug out. She is one creepy toad!) Yes! Yes, there is! I have a brilliant plan. You help me, and I'll help you!

replies.reply_text: Okay. I think. Maybe? Well, what the heck. Why not. Okay, I'll help you.
Oh my gosh you are scary! No way! I'm gone like yesterday's ice cream!
I get the feeling that helping you might end up being one of those almost never ending sagas. I think I'll pass.
(Yikes! Better do whatever it takes to help her without vexing her.) Okay. So what's your plan? What do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I remember with fondess a prince I turned into a frog. (Elphiblah rubs her front feet together gleefully.) He will do perfectly. I need ingredients!

replies.reply_text: Ingredients? What kind of ingredients? And what exactly is your plan?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elphiblah pulls a tiny book out of a pocket and flips through it, muttering and murmuring to herself. Toads have pockets? Who knew! Maybe just witch toads.) I need one Moonbeam, one Silver Lining, one Obsidian Chunk, one Pumice Stone, one Pixie Dust, one 4 Leaf Clover, one Wishing Coin and a Bunch of Flies. That should do it for now.

replies.reply_text: That's quite a list. Any chance you've got that written down for me?
Okay, I've taken notes. I'll be back shortly.
Perfect! I have some of those things for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have need of an assortment of ingredients. I'll make my famous Love Potion #9. You will do the necessary hexing. Murigal will fall in love. Quiet will be restored.

replies.reply_text: Hexing? That doesn't sound good. But okay. What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't dawdle. Get on with it. What have you brought?

replies.reply_text: I've brought you the moonbeam and silver lining. Although I'm confused why you would need those.
I've got the wishing coin and the flies right here. But why would you need either of those for a love potion?
I've brought the obsidian and pumice. But those seem like the opposite of what a love potion should contain.
So, I totally understand a 4 Leaf Clover for the potion, but Pixie Dust?
I think that's everything. You should be able to make the potion now.
Wait! I've got more!
Can you remind me what else I was supposed to bring you?
That should be everything.
That's not all I've brought you.
If you could just remind me of what else you needed, that would be wonderful!
If you'll check, you'll see that I've brought you everything you've asked for.
And lookie here! More stuff!
Well, that looks like it. I think I've brought you every thing you've asked for.
I've brought you something else you asked for.
(You check your saddlebags and find nothing else to give Elphiblah) That's it! The whole shebang! Now you can make the potion.
Okay. Can you tell me where I might find this Charles?

chatpoints.chat_text: I poofed him to some dinky island with several ponds. Now go! Before I become vexed. You wouldn't want to vex me.
