replies.reply_text: Wow. What a bra..... brilliant young lady you are. I didn't expect that from a bra... well, young lady like yourself. You know, Jungle has a lot of trees which are great at noise reduction. How about Jungle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. Not going to happen. Too rainy. I like the Cloud Isles. As the Most Beautiful Goddess of Thunder - the Cloud Isles are the most fitting. Don't you think? (She glares at you daring you to disagree.)

replies.reply_text: Well, its hard to argue with that point. You know, Obsidian would really magnify your brilliant booming. And of course, there's plenty of that on the volcanic islands.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. I don't like the heat there. I like the Cloud Isles. As the Most Beautiful Goddess of Thunder - the Cloud Isles are the most fitting. Don't you think? (She glares at you daring you to disagree.)

replies.reply_text: Its hard to argue with that. What about the snow islands? Snow is a great sound absorber. I'm sure your music wouldn't bother anyone there. Especially if you were on Icicle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Too cold. Cloud is just right! Kinda like Goldilocks and the Three Bears! (Brooklyn performs another long and ferocious drum roll.)

replies.reply_text: Look. Is there any other place that you like almost as much as Cloud? There are baby kittens that need their sleep. As do the other residents of Cloud.

chatpoints.chat_text: Its possible. But you'd have to be really smart and an amazing negotiator.

replies.reply_text: With you? With your sister? Or with someone else?
This sounds way to complicated for me. I'm going to head out and look for some wild horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: With our parents. They have to agree to buy us new instruments.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I am willing to talk to them. But new instruments are expensive and they may want you girls to contribute to the cost.

chatpoints.chat_text: We aren't old enough to have real jobs. You'll have to be smart enough to figure something out.

replies.reply_text: So where do I find your parents?
You know, this is way more complicated than I thought it would be. I'll just head home now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Given what you already know about me and what I like and don't like, you'll have to figure it out.

replies.reply_text: Look, you want me to help you. You need to give me more information than that.

chatpoints.chat_text: You've agreed to talk to our parents, and you know what kinds of islands I like and don't like. So go talk to our parents already!

replies.reply_text: Ugh! You are a contrary child! Guess I'd better start figuring this out.

chatpoints.chat_text: DUH! My mom! And I'm not telling you her name. So the faster you find her and negotiate new instruments for my sister and me, the faster we'll all be happy!

replies.reply_text: How about just her first initial? There are hundreds and hundreds of residents on these islands. Can you PLEASE give me that much of a hint?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Bronte does a drum roll on her very impressive set of drums.) So. One hint. Her name does NOT start with a letter from the last one third of the alphabet!

replies.reply_text: Seriously? That's all you're gonna give me? You must be missing a hot tasty breakfast, and a scrumptious belly-filling lunch by now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Bronte performs another impressive but very long drum roll, glaring at you the entire time. Finally, she stops.) Fine. Her name doesn't start with the first letter from the last half of the alphabet. And that's all I'm telling you!

replies.reply_text: You are so obstinate! I am so gone! (You wonder if you can get any more hints from Astrape.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (The girl ignores you and continues to do drum roll after drum roll after drum roll.)

replies.reply_text: UGH!!!

npc_list.name: Blaze
npc_list.long_description: Blaze is a proud pink flamingo who is strutting her stuff, despite the fact that her paint is peeling off and the end of her nose is chipped!

chatpoints.chat_text: And soil my magnificent plumage? Such a ridiculous thought! Begone with such silly ideas! Say - could you possibly have some apple treats on you? I'd drool for one or two. Do make it two. Please, please, please with a cherry on top?

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't bore me about horses, Darling. You are what you eat and I must, I must, I MUST be pink!

replies.reply_text: Soooo. If I get you two apple treats...

chatpoints.chat_text: Go on! Tell me more! Tell me more!

replies.reply_text: Ummm. I was thinking you'd give ME something if I gave you the apple treats.

replies.reply_text: I'd like....

chatpoints.chat_text: Sold! To the highest bidder!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well don't just stand there like a silly goose. Tell me already!

replies.reply_text: I want 7 silver linings in exchange.

chatpoints.chat_text: Easy peasy! Stick a fork in the deal, call it done and hand me those treats!

replies.reply_text: I don't have any on me, but I'll be back in a jiffy!
You'll be happy to know I have two right here!
Thanks.
Thank you, and can you tell me how to get off of this cloud?

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll need to talk to Mr. Poppers about that! He's around here somewhere.

replies.reply_text: Alright then! Guess I'd better start looking for him.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is you again! Delightful. Charmed I'm sure! Are you here to feed me or ruffle my feathers?

replies.reply_text: Neither. I'm here to talk about Curlicue. It isn't nice to call her names. Pinky Stinky? That's just mean.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear! Now I'm all a flutter! I'd never be mean to that sweet adorable girl. I've got quite the infection on my little toe and it stinks! And if you'll notice, Darling, I'm pink. My feet, my beak. I'm pink. I'm PINK!

replies.reply_text: Poor Curlicue. She thought you were talking about her! I'll let her know right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Garden plants? Do you mean like root vegetables? Carrots? Potatoes? Parsnips and Beets? Not a thing! Not a thing!

replies.reply_text: That was a suspiciously specific list of vegetables. I never mentioned what kind. Come on, fess up. You obviously know something.

replies.reply_text: So you stole the garden plants!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't be such an angry petunia! Not at all! I said I saw them. That's all. Well, and maybe nibbled one or two. But if you ask me where, I can't but help shrug my fabulous feathers. I'm here and there and everywhere. Who knows where it was that I spotted them.

replies.reply_text: Ricochet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! He's quite the carrot muncher. I'd ask him if I were you - but thankfully I'm ME! Delightfully, pink-fully ME! You'll find him in the southern regions of this cloud.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: There was! You said you'd bring me two juicy delectable yummy Apple Treats. I'm ready and waiting and eager with anticipation!

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'll be back with them shortly.
Here they are!

chatpoints.chat_text: Near Ricochet, as I recall. Say, could you possibly bring me a lovely deep pink beet if you find one?

replies.reply_text: Right, near Ricochet. And I'm sorry, but those aren't my vegetables to give away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Such a fuss budget! You remind me of Mr. Poppers. He's a stickler for rules, too.

replies.reply_text: Mr. Poppers?

chatpoints.chat_text: You know. The dude in a box! He's around here somewhere....

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll go look for him.

npc_list.name: Mr. Poppers
npc_list.long_description: Mr. Poppers is a rather shabby looking and very old Jack-in-the-box. There are areas where the paint has been worn off and you can see several rust spots.

chatpoints.chat_text: (As you approach, the Jack-in-the Box pops open.) Eh? Who are you? What do you want? I suppose you've come to hear my music. (Without waiting for you to answer, the Jack-in-the-Box cranks his handle and fills the air with a lovely tune.)

replies.reply_text: That's a very lovely melody. Thank you and have a lovely day.

replies.reply_text: But there are houses on Cloud Isles! Even castles. I don't understand.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I never thought about it before. That's super cool! Or not - if you are missing your garden! Guess I'd better go tell Contrary Larry the bad news.

npc_list.name: Theodosia
npc_list.long_description: A not-so-plump teddy bear! Theodosia was obviously well-loved at one point of her life. The fur of one ear is missing and you can see blue thread where the left leg was stitched back on.

chatpoints.chat_text: At the quack of Dawn! Ha-honk! Ha-honk ha ha! Well, I was trying to quack you up, but it seems my humor has fallen like a plucked feather.

I guess I'm just not in the mood for humor today. Maybe I should come back when I'm in a better mood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meh, vegetables aren't all quacked up to be what everyone thinks they are. I prefer quackers and cheese! Ha-honk! Ha-honk. Sorry. I did hear a rumor about those veggies, but you might want to ask Blaze. She's here and there and everywhere!

replies.reply_text: So I've heard! Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blaze. She's here and there and everywhere!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Bruiser
npc_list.long_description: Bruiser is an adorable not-so-plush triceratops. It looks like it was once well loved. Now its looking worn and shabby, but still very cute!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nom-nom-nom.

replies.reply_text: Oh! Silly me. I apologize. I thought you were ignoring me. I could see you were chewing, but I thought maybe you were chewing on gum.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. No gum for me! It could get stuck in my plushy hide. I don't know anything about your missing garden, except the turnip I stumbled upon. I did hear a rumor - something about food falling from the sky. You should talk to Blaze. I think she must know everything!

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks, and sorry to have bothered you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Hello! Please stay, don't go!

replies.reply_text: Well, hello there! I just got here, so I can stay for a bit. You are just adorable! I've never seen a potbellied pig quite as pink as you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Curlicue looks embarrassed but she gives you a shy smile.)

replies.reply_text: Looks like that's all sorted out, so I'll be on my way! Have a great day.

npc_list.name: Chip
npc_list.long_description: Chip is a small dark colored rock.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Chip is a small rather nondescript rock. Not big. Not medium. Just a small lump of a rock.)

replies.reply_text: Hello?

npc_list.name: Hedda
npc_list.long_description: Hedda is the town gossip. She loves to hear a good tale and considers herself to be the Grande Dame Teller of Tall Tales!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh do come in and sit for a spell. Are you well-traveled? Do tell me, where have you been? What excitement have you seen? Have you heard news most bizarre?

replies.reply_text: Umm. Well. I've been around a bit. But speaking of excitement, if I don't head home there'll be all kinds of explaining for me to do. Tally ho!

Actually, I'm looking for a little excitement myself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well then, get cozy, because the tale I'm going to tell you is quite a doozy! One of the best I've heard this year, without bragging!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! Fire away.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Poor George! (She points to her husband who is busy at the counter.) He had the strangest customer last night. Most strange! The rider was rambling on about monkeys in a barrel and gnomes' bones and some kind of Irish Elf! As if I believe in gnomes or elves! And giant mushrooms. Giant mushrooms! Said he'd gotten lost in amazing flowers. Lost in flowers! Aren't all flowers amazing? How ridiculous is that? He muttered on about indigenous people and vicious flowers that stole his money and cats that grabbed him by the throat and some carrot poet or a parrot that ate carrots and a dead tree that swallowed him whole and spit him out somewhere else!

(Hedda pauses to catch her breath.) He was babbling about losing his bananas - I tell you - I completely agree! Never heard it described that way before - but losing your bananas, or losing your marbles, or heading to the funny farm - they are all the same to me. Loony as a bird, I tell you! He paid for a night's rest and when we got up this morning, he'd vanished. And if you ask me, that's just as well. Last thing he told George was that he just couldn't go on. That he'd gotten lost one too many times and just couldn't go through with it. Something about cabin fever. Seriously, I do believe the man was delirious!

replies.reply_text: That is most amazing! So you really think he was crazy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well you DO know that monkeys in a barrel is just a kid's game right? Why would he be upset about some game? And have YOU ever seen an Irish Elf or giant mushrooms or gnome bones? Have YOU ever gotten lost in flowers? I wonder if he thought the mushrooms were big enough to live in! He probably thought he could walk on clouds, too! Ha! Loony as a loon!

replies.reply_text: Umm. Well... (Good thing you think fast on your feet - you don't want her to think you are crazy too.) I guess you are right. All's well that ends well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes and no. Unfortunately the man left this tiny carved box behind. It appears to be very valuable. Alas, it is locked so any clues to the man or his whereabouts are unobtainable. Good heavens! This might hold some lost artifact that might be very valuable!

replies.reply_text: Why don't I try to backtrack where he came from. Maybe someone along the way will know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent idea!

replies.reply_text: Bananas! Thanks, don't mind if I do take them. I've got some ideas on where to head to. I'll let you know if I get this figured out.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see if you could find the stranger that left this lovely carved box behind.

replies.reply_text: That maybe kinda sorta rings a bell. Did you say he was talking about clouds or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: You certainly don't listen very well! And I am too busy to repeat everything. But I'll give you the highlights. An elf, giant mushrooms, gnome bones, and thieving flowers.

replies.reply_text: Now that does ring a bell! Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well that's a shame. I mean - that's great. Yes indeed. (Hedda looks sadly at the little carved box. It seems she's grown attached to it.) You know, this box reminds me of my grandfather. He carved things.

replies.reply_text: Really? You should ask him where he got it from. So, I have to tell you, it took a lot of time, travel and deductive reasoning to find Josten. (You proceed to tell her everything about all the details in the huge effort to find him.)

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well now. That was quite some adventure you had. (Hedda squints. You can see her concentrating hard, taking in all that you told her. Suddenly she gets a twinkle in her eye and gives you a big grin.) But on the bright side, that means you got:
Twelve Starfish waving,
Eleven Geckos blinking,
Ten Bananas stinking,
Nine Ferrets leaping
Eight Bunnies munching,
Seven Chickens clucking,
Six Birds a humming,
Five…….… Di…no…. Bones,
Four Prison Rats,
Three Telescopes,
Two Persian Cats,
And a Monkey rescued near a palm tree!

replies.reply_text: That was really clever of you, and funny to boot. I'm impressed. Your token of appreciation is much appreciated! Have a most splendiferous day.
I think I'll meander over to Frank's and see what that's all about. Thanks for the heads up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Frank. Frank Tackle.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Josten
npc_list.long_description: Josten doesn't seem to be as comfortable around bugs and grasshoppers as his sister Joylyn is.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Josten is sunburnt and is wearing a purple vest.) Hello.

replies.reply_text: Hello! Hello! I've been all over the place trying to find you!
Hello and good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you?

replies.reply_text: Oh my gosh, yes! Hedda down in Appleton said you left a small carved box.  I had to backtrack your journey from Flower to Frannie's and back to here.

chatpoints.chat_text: My grandmother's box! Thank you for letting me know. And Frannie! She asked me to help her rescue a monkey. I really wanted to. But then, so many things tripped me up.

replies.reply_text: No worries. I helped her and the monkey is safe now. But what happened to you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Josten puts his head in his hands and takes a deep breath. Then he looks up at you with a really sad expression.) I decided to go on a little adventure. But nothing went as planned. When I got to Crazy Eddie’s island, he said a small boat had washed up and I could have it. I’m no sailor. But I was foolish. I jumped in and headed out into the sea. There was a huge storm and the rudder broke off and I ended up crashing on rocks. I grabbed a plank and hung on, hoping to be rescued. I remember the sun was relentless, beating down on me. Then the cool night breeze. Next thing I knew, I washed up on a beach of Cabin Isle.

replies.reply_text: Wow! That's some adventure!

chatpoints.chat_text: That was just the beginning. I knew I had a long way to go to get bananas for Frannie, so every island I stopped at I tried to get stuff that would finance my travels. And there were islands I’d never been to before, so I wanted to see the flora and fauna and folks that were on each. On Jungle, there were some huge blooming plants that stole all my money. At one point, I thought I could bring chickens home to sell eggs. Seemed like a nice idea - but I left those behind. And a score of other animals. It just became so hard traveling with all these creatures that I had to be responsible for.

replies.reply_text: You know, that really is an adventure that people would want to hear about. Especially how convoluted the story got from my side of things. You should hear how you were described. Including having a purple chest full of gold!

chatpoints.chat_text: A purple chest? That's crazy!

replies.reply_text: That's not the half of it. But you could go on lots of adventures and write a series of books. You should do it!

chatpoints.chat_text: No thank you. That one adventure was enough to last me a life time. But I'll think about writing it down.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the telescopes! And I'll let Hedda know that you'll come by to get your carved box.

npc_list.name: Gneville
npc_list.long_description: A gnarly beast of a gnome. Gneville has wild gray hair that is barely kept in check by the wizard hat he wears. Good thing you can't see his ears - talk about hairy! It is no coincidence that he reminds you of Gnorman and Gnigal, as they are the famous Gnome Brothers Three. Except of course, they really aren't famous at all, unless it is in their dreams.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. Didn't expect to see anyone out here in the middle of nowhere. Did the old bat send you? She's afraid of owls. Did you know that? And she drives me absolutely batty.

replies.reply_text: I know what you mean. She drives me batty, too. She mentioned some hooting. I offered to check it out. I'm guessing that was you making the noise?
No. I'm here of my own volition. And now I'm leaving.
I've got some lawn ornaments for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Gneville shrugs but he's trying hard to suppress a grin.) Don't know anything about that.

replies.reply_text: Just because I'm curious, why are you up here, all alone, away from people, tucked into this little grove?  Do you hate people or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: I beg your pardon! I am no misanthrope! I'll have you know that Gnomes tend to be introverts. It's in our nature to be reclusive, possibly even eccentric or quirky - but that doesn't mean we hate anyone.

replies.reply_text: I am sorry. I meant no offense. This just seemed like... well... a lonely place to live.

chatpoints.chat_text: Harumpf! Being alone is not the same as being lonely. I am perfectly happy in my own company. Do I look sad to you?

replies.reply_text: Absolutely not. I don't know if I'm an introvert or an extrovert. I like being around a lot of people, but then I'm exhausted and just want to be by myself. But then, I get lonely!

chatpoints.chat_text: You need a hobby. Speaking of hobbies, would you mind getting me some pink flamingos and garden gnomes? I'll pay you for them.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? Why on earth would you want lawn ornaments?

chatpoints.chat_text: Doesn't everybody love garden gnomes? No matter - I'm working on a spell. Just in the experimental stages of course, but I have great expectations. I need both the flamingos and the gnomes.

replies.reply_text: Well I don't have much use for them. Actually, I don't know of anyone who has found much use for them. I'd love to sell them to you. I don't have any on me now, but in case I come across some in the future, much will you pay?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would be happy to pay you $500 for each pink flamingo and garden gnome you bring me. For my experimental spell work, of course.

replies.reply_text: Awesome! I'll be back.
I've got a pink flamingo for you!
I've got a garden gnome for you!
Thanks. See you around!
But wait, I've got more!
Thanks, Gneville. If I end up with anymore, I'll bring them to you.
But wait, I've got more!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, again! Did you bring me something? Any pink flamingos? Or how about some garden gnomes?

replies.reply_text: No, sorry. Just passing through,
Yes indeed I did!

npc_list.long_description: A young girl with bright fuchsia hair, wearing pajamas embroidered with lightening bolts. She has two large brand new cymbals that she loves to clang together.

npc_list.admin_description: aka Bronte after cloud adventure
npc_list.long_description: A young girl with bright green hair wearing pajamas embroidered with clouds. She has what looks like a very impressive sparkling new set of drums.
